recommendation:
Level as **DW Fury with Blood Drinker**. At 60 you have three routes:

- **DPS:** raid as **Arms** until you have about 23% unbuffed crit, then move to **2H Fury** (or its Sweeping Strikes "Lawnmower" variant) or **DW Fury**.
- **Tank:** main-tank as **Defensive Tactics (DefTac)**. Since the 1.18.1 release it outperforms FuryProt in almost every case, and FuryProt stays the off-tank spec.
- **PvP:** warrior is the weakest class in 1.18.1. Play DW Fury with Blood Drinker, or Arms with a healer.
overview:
**Recommendation:** level as **DW Fury with Blood Drinker**. At 60 you have three routes:

- **DPS:** raid as **Arms** until you have about 23% unbuffed crit, then move to **2H Fury** (or its Sweeping Strikes "Lawnmower" variant) or **DW Fury**.
- **Tank:** main-tank as **Defensive Tactics (DefTac)**. Since the 1.18.1 release it outperforms FuryProt in almost every case, and FuryProt stays the off-tank spec.
- **PvP:** warrior is the weakest class in 1.18.1. Play DW Fury with Blood Drinker, or Arms with a healer.

Turtle's warrior differs a lot from vanilla, so vanilla guides don't transfer:

- 2H Fury is a **Slam** build (Flurry shortens the cast).
- **Blood Drinker** heals off every hit.
- **Defensive Tactics** carries Defiance's threat bonus into Battle and Berserker Stance.
- **Precision Cut** turns the extra rage into bigger Executes.
- Weapon-skill racials and hit caps have been reworked.

readme.heading: Roles
readme.markdown: - **Melee DPS:** 2H Fury, Lawnmower, DW Fury, MS Arms, Death Wish Arms ("Deathcute"). "Realistically there's 5 dps builds" Dodging · 2026-03-29, Lipibidy · 2026-03-29, Lipibidy · 2026-03-29. - **Tank:** DefTac (main tank), FuryProt (off-tank, or a high-threat MT), Death Wish Prot, and Revenge deep prot for fresh 60s and dungeons. Warrior is the single-target "cooldown tank" and ranks behind bear and paladin as a complete package. See [Protection](#/class/warrior/protection-tank). - **Utility:** Sunder Armor, Battle Shout, Demoralizing Shout, Disarm, Intervene, Thunder Clap, Mortal Strike's healing debuff, and the biggest Executes in the game.

readme.heading: What changed in 1.18.1
readme.markdown: **Release (2026-03-20)** - **Precision Cut** and **Boundless Anger** swapped places in the Arms tree, and Precision Cut now needs Boundless Anger 3 Nonono · 2026-03-29. - **Improved Whirlwind** became **Ravager**, which also cuts Cleave's rage cost evella · 2026-01-23. - **Tier sets:** - T1 Arms/Fury 3-piece: 10% chance on ability hit to gain 15 rage nudel12 · 2026-03-18. - T3 4-piece: +4% ability crit damage Don't ping me · 2026-01-23. - **Flurry and Slam:** a patch-day Flurry bug was hotfixed. 5/5 Flurry now makes Slam a 1.92 s cast Lhian · 2026-03-20, [Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608), Czasku · 2026-03-24. A shield-block bug was fixed a few days later [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139). **Mid-cycle hotfixes (January 2026, still live)** - **Defiance** now scales 4/8/12/15/20%. **Shield Slam** went from 15% to 20% AP, and its threat modifier from 50% to 75% Black Hat · 2026-03-11, [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). This is why DefTac became the default main tank. - **Execute** costs 10 rage instead of 15, a net damage buff Don't ping me · 2026-02-01. - **Sweeping Strikes** can no longer crit, and its extra hits deal 20% of the damage casey · 2026-01-22. - The paladin **Champion** buffs were removed, so tanks have less threat headroom Thirtyseven · 2026-01-24. **After release** - **Hamstring** has no cooldown again Yagsick · 2026-04-11. - **Slam** no longer delays your next swing if you start it right after a hit (2026-04) Piemelbrie / siswet · 2026-04-17. - **Orc Hardiness** and **Iron Will** changed from stun-resist chance to a 15% stun-duration reduction Ionnatra · 2026-04-01.

readme.heading: Professions
readme.markdown: - **Engineering** is "the only profession" that matters for a warrior: Sappers, grenades, dummies and Battle Chicken Velanir · 2026-03-04, casey · 2026-03-04. Level it with Mining, then drop Mining for a gold profession Nako · 2025-12-18. Go Gnomish first; switching to Goblin later is mainly to craft your own Sappers evella · 2025-10-25. - **Blacksmithing** is contested. Some say "avoid like the plague" Sylvaira · 2026-01-24; others say it "has some good bits now", mostly pre-raid Aubreykun · 2025-12-02. The Elementium weapons need Swordsmith (Champion) or Axesmith (Reaper) darthpenance · 2026-04-05. - **Alchemy** covers your own flasks and Mighty Rage Potions, but an alt can do it Aubreykun · 2025-11-29, Lipibidy · 2025-12-02. - **Dual spec** costs 350g at level 50 Nabuhodonozo · 2025-08-16. It is worth getting for DPS/tank or PvE/PvP swaps. Full guide: [Professions](#/class/warrior/professions). Leveling notes: [Leveling](#/class/warrior/leveling). Shared pages: [Professions overview](#/professions) · [PvP systems](#/pvp) (honor, battlegrounds, Warmode) · [Game mechanics](#/mechanics) (buff and consumable stacking, enchant sources) · [Client setup](#/client-setup) (launcher, SuperWoW, addons). playbooks.title: Protection Warrior (tank)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** in 1.18.1, main-tank as **Defensive Tactics ("DefTac", 17/3/31 or 0/20/31)**. That means a shield and a fast one-hander, tanking in **Battle Stance** for most of the pull, with **Shield Slam and Heroic Strike** as your threat. Swap to Defensive Stance to taunt or to block-dance through dangerous hits. The January patch raised Defiance to 20% and buffed Shield Slam, and that closed most of DefTac's threat gap to FuryProt: "going dtac is better in 99.9% of cases instead of 95% it was before" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22, Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - **FuryProt (0/31/20)** stays the best **off-tank** spec and the answer when a raid "really need[s] that extra ~150 tps" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22, Velanir · 2026-01-30. - **Death Wish Prot (0/21/30)** is a high-end MT variant Tole · 2026-04-16. - **Revenge/Reprisal deep prot** is for fresh 60s and dungeons. Warrior is the single-target "cooldown tank". It trails bear and paladin overall, and it has almost no AoE threat of its own. | | | |---|---| | Role | Main tank, off-tank; Sunder Armor, Demoralizing Shout, Disarm, Shield Wall | | Viability (1.18.1) | **A (raid MT/OT).** "More than viable for all the content in the current patch" but "the worst MT" of the three tank classes Black Hat · 2026-03-15. talents.heading: Which build?
talents.markdown: | Situation | Build | Why | |---|---|---| | Main tank, most raids | **DefTac Impale 17/3/31** | Pinned reference build; "impaleProt is the easiest to learn", and among FuryProt, DeathTactics and ImpaleProt "there isn't a clear winner" Velanir · 2026-03-23, Velanir · 2026-03-23 | | MT without a reliable second warrior keeping shouts up | **DefTac Enrage ("shouts") 0/20/31** | "If you have a warrior you trust to keep BS and demo up impale is better. I don't trust anybody so I go shouts" Cannondorf · 2026-03-16 | | High-end MT | **Death Wish Prot 0/21/30** | Tole's favored MT build after the buffs; "21/30 is definitely the path because you get dtac" Tole · 2026-04-16, Tole · 2026-04-16 | | Off-tank; raids that need more threat | **FuryProt 0/31/20** | Ideal off-tank because its DPS stays acceptable when not tanking Virasan · 2026-02-25, Velanir · 2026-01-30 | | Fresh 60, dungeons, low gear | **Revenge/Reprisal deep prot** | Low gear: Defensive Stance Revenge/Reprisal; mid/high gear: DefTac or FuryProt Virasan · 2026-01-14, Ascuz · 2026-02-26 | **Contested: should warriors play FuryProt at all now?** Weirdthing: "the only reason to go fprot now is if you _really_ need that extra 150 tps" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22. Tole still runs FuryProt "for every warrior other than MT because it does much better dps" Tole · 2026-04-16. Lipibidy argues the three sub-specs "all compete with each other for relevancy" and that "at the high end, there's no reason to play the prot tree specs" Lipibidy · 2026-04-05. The older, still-quoted rule: "for casual guild any form of deep prot is >>>> furyProt" Velanir · 2026-02-08. For a new tank, "start out Dtac but try furyprot once you have some gear and if threat is an issue" Jakeends · 2026-02-05.

stats.heading: Stats and caps
stats.markdown: **DefTac:** "you ape out on threat stats and wear a shield with a fast weapon" Dodging · 2026-03-21. 1. **Hit to the yellow cap** (8% at 300 weapon skill, 5% at 315) Black Hat · 2026-01-04. Hit matters for Shield Slam: a parried or dodged Slam "causes eternal pain" Dodging · 2025-10-30. Above the cap, "every point... does exactly nothing for 1h+shield" Velanir · 2026-03-16. 2. **Agility/crit > Strength > AP > block value > haste** for threat worlds #1 ppm expert · 2025-10-29. If you need threat, "Agi/crit >> Str/AP > SBV"; if you need mitigation, "Stam/armor do the heavy lifting" Black Hat · 2025-11-18. 3. **Weapon skill barely matters for a shield tank:** Heroic Strike swings cannot glance Lipibidy · 2026-03-22, Lipibidy · 2026-03-22. 4. **Block value** is weak: a typical piece has about 20. **Glyph of Deflection** is "the only block value item worth using for damage" Lipibidy · 2026-03-14; for DefTac it is "like a small deathwish in terms of threat" Weirdthing · 2025-12-25. 5. **Stamina** for survival. Stamina enchants are better for effective health Lipibidy · 2026-04-03. Avoidance is not mitigation: "dodge>dodge>crush" gives healers heart attacks Lipibidy · 2026-02-22. **FuryProt:** Stamina > Agility > Strength; hit cap and weapon skill preferred; crit always welcome Lipibidy · 2025-11-18. "Stats are king, you double dip on stats like crazy as fprot" Hayden · 2026-03-29. Hit matters a bit less because most of your main-hand swings are Heroic Strikes Hayden · 2026-03-29. | Threshold | Value | Source | |---|---|---| | Defense for an MT | ~370-400; much higher tanks your TPS | L0s7 · 2026-02-25 | | Crit/crush immunity | Use Shield Slam's buff and Shield Block in sequence (they overwrite each other) rather than stacking Defense | 30 · 2026-02-25, Lipibidy · 2026-02-25, Lipibidy · 2025-12-23 | | Daze immunity | 400 Defense vs level 60, 415 vs level 63 (another poster: 420); matters mainly on Twin Emperors | oliverwz · 2025-10-10, Virasan · 2025-10-10, Dodging · 2025-10-09 | | Avoidance | 50-60% total block + dodge + parry is "a good place to be" | L0s7 · 2026-01-29 | | Trash crits | ~360-380 Defense from gear stops most trash crits; Chromaggus and Twins can still crit below ~400 | Arkaris · 2025-10-29 | | HP for Four Horsemen | ~6.5k buffed minimum | Kyrsie · 2025-11-20 | Dodge and other avoidance also cost rage, because you gain rage from being hit Don't ping me · 2026-01-21. A priest's Power Word: Shield on you does the same Ionnatra · 2026-04-11. FuryProt takes the same +10% physical damage as DefTac and 10% less spell damage, but has no Shield Slam buff and no block, so its damage intake is spikier. The Shield Slam buff alone prevents about half of all crits Nost · 2026-02-18, Nost · 2026-02-18.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### DefTac (bot-ready) 1. **Pre-pull:** Battle Shout and Bloodrage about a minute before the pull 30 · 2025-10-19. Mighty Rage Potion on the pull Lipibidy · 2025-12-09. For a burst of pull threat, stack Recklessness + Enrage + Death Wish + Mighty Rage Potion Thirtyseven · 2026-03-03. 2. **Stance:** tank in **Battle Stance** for every pull you safely can. Dodging does so "for every single pull in the game besides the drake in bwl that gets ranged pulled and thrashes" Dodging · 2026-03-31. Swap to Defensive Stance to taunt, or to block-dance once threat is safe Dodging · 2026-03-31. 3. **Opener:** Shield Slam or Concussion Blow first; after the buffs the two are within variance, with Shield Slam about 2 TPS ahead Jakeends · 2026-03-18. 4. **Shield Slam** on cooldown. 5. **Overpower** when it procs (dodge only; Overpower off parries was a bug and has been fixed) Lans · 2026-03-04, Kyrsie · 2026-01-27. 6. **Concussion Blow** on cooldown (Impale/Enrage builds). It generates rage Lans · 2026-01-13. 7. **Heroic Strike** as the rage dump on every swing you can afford. 8. **Sunder Armor** as filler. Its rage cost is now 10, down from 15 Lipibidy · 2026-02-09. 9. **Crit/crush safety:** sequence Shield Slam's buff and Shield Block. They overwrite each other, so press Shield Block after a hit has consumed the Shield Slam buff 30 · 2026-02-25, Black Hat · 2025-12-26. ### FuryProt 1. **Pull:** start in Defensive Stance with as much rage as possible. Bloodrage, then **Bloodthirst + Heroic Strike on the first GCD**. On bosses, run in with Death Wish used just before 30 · 2026-02-23, 30 · 2026-02-23. Don't waste early GCDs on Thunder Clap or Demoralizing Shout D.C.V. · 2026-02-23. 2. **Bloodthirst** on cooldown; it sits above Revenge Hayden · 2026-03-29. 3. **Revenge** when it procs. 4. **Heroic Strike** is your rage-management tool: keep rage at roughly 50-60 Velanir · 2026-03-29, Velanir · 2026-03-29. 5. **Sunder Armor** once you are rage-capped Velanir · 2026-03-29. 6. In the **Execute phase** stance doesn't change threat, but tanking in Berserker Stance is risky. Stay in Defensive Stance; with a huge lead, focus on mitigation and save rage for the next pull Sebastian_ · 2026-02-15, 30 · 2026-02-15. ### Death Wish Prot Pull with Death Wish and Bloodrage (Enrage), then Shield Slam, Heroic Strike and Sunder as for DefTac. Death Wish Prot has "the worst consistency" but the best average TPS in sims: "pump the shit out of it and hope nothing gets parried" Velanir · 2026-02-08, Lipibidy · 2026-02-08.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE threat
rotationAoe.markdown: Warrior has **no dedicated AoE threat tool**, and 1.18.1 did not add one ("we're complaining why all tanks get aoe but warrior... so wtf is twow doing") Lans · 2026-03-20, Hayden · 2026-03-20. "Warrior lacks tools for tanking anything but a boss" Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. Plan your pulls around that. 1. **Mark** the kill order (skull, cross, square) and let DPS own their mistakes VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-08. 2. **Demoralizing Shout** is "warriors best real aoe threat ability if you don't have thunderfury". It is uncapped and cheap, and you can spam it Virasan · 2026-03-22, Virasan · 2026-03-22. 3. **Tab-Cleave**: spread auto-attack Cleaves across the pack. Hayden calls it "your best aoe threat ability thats not dynamite" Hayden · 2026-03-20. Pool rage between pulls so you have some for the next pack Hayden · 2026-03-20. 4. **Thunder Clap** hits at most 4 targets. It is coded as a spell (spell crit, can be resisted, cannot proc Deep Wounds) and has no AP scaling Lipibidy · 2026-01-26, Lans · 2026-02-16. Kyrsie measured about 243 damage with the talent and the T2.5 set against a zero-armor dummy Kyrsie · 2026-02-09. 5. **Whirlwind** briefly from Berserker Stance: "tclap whirlwind tclap", and losing some mobs is expected casey · 2026-02-18. DefTac with a Thunderfall Whirlwind is "very decent for aoe tanking" Fafu · 2026-03-20. 6. **External tools:** Thunderfury ("a cheatcode for small aoe threat"), Force Reactive Disk, Oil of Immolation, Goblin Sapper Charges and Dense Dynamite Dodging · 2026-03-26, casey · 2026-01-08, Weirdthing · 2026-01-12. Sappers are the reliable answer for hard pulls such as Garr Dodging · 2026-03-20. 7. **Challenging Shout** is your emergency AoE taunt; AoE tanking gets noticeably harder while it is on cooldown Ascuz · 2026-02-16. "The 4 packs in the entire game that actually allow you to do real aoe tanking are warrior assignments" Dodging · 2026-03-22. Otherwise, leave big AoE pulls to paladins and bears casey · 2026-04-02.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: - **Shield Wall** needs a shield equipped Velanir · 2026-02-19. It shares one 30-minute cooldown with Recklessness and Retaliation Gilnean · 2026-01-18, ScoobertDoobert · 2026-03-05. FuryProt losing Shield Wall "is really annoying for a solid 4 fights in the game" Hayden · 2026-03-08. - **Last Stand**, a healthstone and Nordanaar Herbal Tea are part of your job when low. Missing them is your fault, not the healer's Virasan · 2025-10-09. - **Improved Berserker Rage** removes roots and slows (Kara40 curses, Noth, Gothik) Neurospicy · 2025-09-26. Never use it during Sanv Tas'dal's add phase JohnGood · 2026-02-03. - **Death Wish** (FuryProt, Death Wish Prot) before the pull 30 · 2026-02-23.

roleStrategy.heading: Threat mechanics
roleStrategy.markdown: | Item | Value | Source | |---|---|---| | Stance modifiers | Defensive 1.3 (×1.2 with 5/5 Defiance = 1.56); Battle/Berserker 0.8 | 30 · 2026-01-24, Lipibidy · 2026-03-31 | | DefTac in Battle/Berserker | 1.6064 with 5/5 Defiance (1.5128 before the Defiance buff) | 30 · 2026-01-24, Ravenhost · 2026-01-24 | | Shield Slam | damage = 303 + block value + 0.2 × AP; threat = damage × 1.75 × stance modifier (was 0.15 AP / ×1.5 before 1.18.1) | 30 · 2026-03-07, 30 · 2026-03-07 | | Revenge | (damage + 355) × stance modifier; ≈528 flat with Defiance | 30 · 2026-01-19, Lipibidy · 2026-02-23 | | Sunder Armor | 260 base threat, 390 in Defensive Stance with Defiance; costs 10 rage | Lipibidy · 2026-02-25, Lipibidy · 2026-02-09 | | Heroic Strike | (damage + flat threat) × stance modifier; the flat part is not multiplied by anything else | Velanir · 2026-02-19, 30 · 2026-01-17 | | Thunderfury proc | damage × modifier + 234 × modifier; unaffected by stance multipliers | 30 · 2026-03-25, 30 · 2026-03-26 | | Buff/debuff application | ~25 threat per affected target, split across targets | Lipibidy · 2025-12-24, Lipibidy · 2026-01-05 | What this means in play: - **Shield Slam and Heroic Strike are your threat.** Heroic Strike is "your main threat in a raid environment (or roughly equal to shield slam)", which is why you need a fast weapon Virasan · 2026-03-21. Shield Slam "overshadows any other active ability; even as revenge prot, you could press only shield slam and heroic strike and do the majority of your threat" Lipibidy · 2026-04-10. - **Your opener hinges on Shield Slam landing.** Its combined miss + dodge + parry chance against a boss is about 19% at 315 weapon skill Jakeends · 2026-03-27. "If you miss 2 shield slams in a row on opener youre doomed" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22. FuryProt is "so much better at chasing a bad opener than dtac" Dodging · 2025-12-23. - **Ask DPS to hold 2-3 GCDs on the pull** to cover parry/dodge streaks Nost · 2025-11-21. The opener matters far more than average TPS Not Normal · 2025-11-21. - **Taunt** copies the target's aggro only when the debuff lands, and can fail on a crowd-controlled or target-less mob MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23, MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23. **Contested:** spell data gives Taunt a 10 s cooldown, but players report 9 s Virasan · 2026-01-28; it can be resisted (about 1 in 6), requires Defensive Stance Black Hat · 2026-03-28, and has only 5 yards of range Virasan · 2026-01-11.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Keep **three sets**: full threat, beefy threat, full mitigation 30 · 2025-10-21. "There is no such thing as full BiS for FuryProt"; your gear changes by fight 30 · 2025-11-22. DPS gear is threat gear: gear "like a DPS warrior" minus leather and mail Nost · 2026-01-01, Dodging · 2025-10-24. - **Pre-raid:** the Stormwind Vault drop set is a good pre-BiS deep prot set Kyrsie · 2026-02-21. Pair Corrosive Core with Breadth of the Earthmother for sure; Hand of Justice "isn't that good" for this set Kyrsie · 2026-02-21, Kyrsie · 2026-02-21. Other picks: Anasterian's Legacy, Darkflame Helm, T1 Might pieces Dodging · 2026-03-21. T1 tank set: "a ton of % chance to block which is all useless" worlds #1 ppm expert · 2025-11-16. - **Shields:** Aegis for DefTac, **Scaleshield** for FuryProt. Lipibidy prefers Scaleshield all around: "12 str/agi/stam > block stats, and the fear break active is also useful" Black Hat · 2026-04-08, Lipibidy · 2026-04-08. - **Weapons:** fast. "Slow weapon is not worth it due to massively reduced amount of heroics" Velanir · 2026-01-27. Don't DefTac-tank with anything slower than Thunderfury Virasan · 2026-03-21. Warblades are only about 8 DPS behind BWL-BiS weapons for FuryProt: "excellent choice if you don't have Thunderfury yet" ScoobertDoobert · 2026-02-07. Without Thunderfury, THC is BiS Velanir · 2026-01-27. **Contested:** one player called Broodwarden "bis till thc" then walked it back, and another didn't see it show up in the sim Hayden · 2026-04-07, Woogz · 2026-04-07; the same player later called it "undervalued by a lot of people" with an "incredibly strong" sword proc Hayden · 2026-04-18. - **FuryProt BWL checklist** (a player's list the channel answered): Chromatic Boots; T2 DPS or Legguards of the Fallen Crusader legs; T2 DPS, Taut Dragonhide or Drake Talon shoulders; Tempest's Rage/Maladath or Thunderfury; Heart of Dreams + Drake Fang Talisman. Add the Kara10 Darkflame Helm BFlorry · 2026-03-29, Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-29. For rings, Circle of Applied Force (buffed to 15 Str / 12 Stam / 22 Agi), or Band of Accuria if you still need hit Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-29, Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-29. - **Tier:** T2 tank is "mitigation BIS forever" Cannondorf · 2026-03-16. The T3 tank set is "the most mit you can get going into k40" Lipibidy · 2026-02-06, and its 2-piece is a genuine TPS gain Velanir · 2026-03-17. The T3 4-piece (taunt hit) is only really needed for Four Horsemen Lans · 2026-01-03. T3.5 is "better enough that it will replace your t3 pieces" Virasan · 2026-02-06. The new T3 PvP chest + gloves 2-set is argued to beat raid tank gear Velanir · 2026-03-11, Lipibidy · 2026-04-10. - **Mixing sets:** swap bracers first, then helm and legs toward threat. Keep a couple of thick-stamina pieces (T3 tank boots/helm); T3 tank pants carry enough block value for a threat set Sylvaira · 2026-01-22, Jakeends · 2026-01-22. "Err on the side of mitigation until you know your raid can farm a boss" Lipibidy · 2025-12-06. - **Trinkets:** Kiss of the Spider is favored for the opener (hastened autos give more rolls against dodge/parry streaks); never Heart of Dreams over two actives 30 · 2025-10-17, 30 · 2025-10-18. For DefTac, Glyph of Deflection + Kiss beats any Mark of the Champion combo Velanir · 2026-02-17. Diamond Flask: use it "like a second Death Wish" (**contested**) Hayden · 2026-04-18, Junak'Salsa · 2026-04-18. - **Fortune** is multiplicative (a 5% proc with 5% Fortune becomes 5.25%) and weak Dodging · 2026-03-20.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Taking Revenge talents in a DefTac build, or DefTac in a Revenge build Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - Tanking DefTac in Defensive Stance the whole fight. Battle Stance is higher threat Dodging · 2026-03-20. - A slow weapon on a tank Velanir · 2026-01-27. - Stacking Defense or avoidance past what the fight needs. It costs rage and threat L0s7 · 2026-02-25, 30 · 2025-12-28. - Wasting early GCDs on Thunder Clap or Demoralizing Shout during a single-target opener D.C.V. · 2026-02-23. - FuryProt with a shield, or FuryProt before your healers and gear can carry it Velanir · 2026-03-03, Lipibidy · 2026-01-20. - Taunting a stunned or crowd-controlled target MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23. - Expecting to AoE-tank like a paladin garras · 2026-04-01.

enchants.heading: Enchants
enchants.markdown: | Slot | Enchant | Notes | |---|---|---| | Gloves | +15 Agility, or +2% threat | **Contested.** Agility gives crit, dodge and armor all fight long Lipibidy · 2025-11-30; Nost's sim found the threat enchant "much better than the agi one" Nost · 2025-12-25 | | Head / Legs | Agility (dodge), 32 AP, or Stamina | Agility when threat is fine; Strength/AP when threat is the struggle Syd · 2026-02-01, Ascuz · 2026-02-01; Stamina for effective health Lipibidy · 2026-04-03 | | Belt | Strength buckle on Girdle of the Mentor; block-value buckle on a T3 belt | Syd · 2026-04-18 | | Rings | +3 all stats | "Fury prot you definitely want +3 all stats" Ascuz · 2026-02-22 | | Weapon | Crusader; keep Weapon Chain on at least one weapon for dungeons | Julian · 2025-11-04, casey · 2026-03-06 | | Cloak | Arcane resistance enchant for Kara40 | Black Hat · 2026-04-17 |

consumables.heading: Consumables
consumables.markdown: - **Pull:** Mighty Rage Potion Ascuz · 2026-02-23. Extra pre-pull rage: pop-and-swap the ZG trinket for 30 rage (swap a static trinket, not your on-use one), or beat Unconscious Dig Rats at a mailbox Lipibidy · 2025-12-09, Lipibidy · 2025-12-09. On-use items share a 30 s cooldown Lipibidy · 2026-04-10; the class-quest chest and belt rage items can only be used about once an hour Lipibidy · 2026-04-10, and behave the same way as the trinket Lipibidy · 2026-04-10. - **Food:** Power Mushroom on non-mitigation fights; Hardened Mushroom + Gurubashi Gumbo (they stack) on mitigation fights Don't ping me · 2026-01-21, Don't ping me · 2026-01-21. - **Naxx resist potions:** Shadow for Four Horsemen and Loatheb; Frost for Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad 30 · 2026-01-11. Greater Fire and Greater Nature Protection stack for Faerlina 30 · 2026-01-11. - **Kara40:** Magic Resistance Potion on Anomalus (there is no Arcane Resistance aura) Kyrsie · 2026-01-09. The MT needs a Frost or Arcane Reflector for the trash before Incantagos Virasan · 2026-01-28.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: A decision loop for a level-60 warrior tank. The details are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/warrior/protection-tank), [AoE threat](#/class/warrior/protection-tank) and [Cooldowns](#/class/warrior/protection-tank). 1. **Pull setup:** Battle Shout and Bloodrage about a minute before the pull, and a Mighty Rage Potion on the pull 30 · 2025-10-19, Lipibidy · 2025-12-09. Ask DPS to hold 2–3 GCDs Nost · 2025-11-21. Stance and weapon by build: - **DefTac:** shield and a fast one-hander, in **Battle Stance** Dodging · 2026-03-31. - **FuryProt:** dual wield, in **Defensive Stance** with as much rage as possible. Use Death Wish just before running in 30 · 2026-02-23. - **Revenge deep prot** (fresh 60, dungeons): shield, in Defensive Stance. 2. **First 3–5 GCDs:** threat skills only. Don't open a single target with Thunder Clap or Demoralizing Shout D.C.V. · 2026-02-23. - **DefTac:** Shield Slam (or Concussion Blow; within variance Jakeends · 2026-03-18) → Sunder Armor → Overpower or Sunder → Shield Slam again at 6 s. Queue Heroic Strike on every swing you can afford. - **FuryProt:** Bloodrage → Bloodthirst + Heroic Strike on the first GCD 30 · 2026-02-23 → Revenge / Sunder → Bloodthirst. 3. **Steady threat loop:** - **DefTac:** Shield Slam on cooldown > Overpower on a dodge > Concussion Blow on cooldown > Sunder Armor filler. Heroic Strike is the rage dump and your main threat with Shield Slam ([DefTac](#/class/warrior/protection-tank)). - **FuryProt:** Bloodthirst > Revenge > Sunder Armor when rage-capped. Heroic Strike keeps rage at about 50–60 ([FuryProt](#/class/warrior/protection-tank)). - **Revenge deep prot:** Shield Slam > Revenge > Sunder Armor > Heroic Strike dump ([Revenge/Reprisal](#/class/warrior/protection-tank)). 4. **Multi-mob:** - Mark skull > cross > square VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-08. - Spam Demoralizing Shout Virasan · 2026-03-22. Tab-Cleave on autos Hayden · 2026-03-20. - Thunder Clap hits at most 4 targets. - Make a short Berserker swap for "tclap whirlwind tclap" casey · 2026-02-18. - For hard pulls, use Thunderfury, Sappers or dynamite. Don't try to AoE-tank like a paladin. 5. **Taunt / threat recovery:** - **Taunt** needs Defensive Stance and 5 yd, has a 10 s cooldown, and can be resisted. It fails on a crowd-controlled mob MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23. - **Mocking Blow** (Battle Stance, 120 s) is the backup; **Challenging Shout** (10 min) is the AoE emergency. - Where the threat value must transfer (Four Horsemen), only Taunt copies it chain · 2025-06-02. 6. **Defensive cooldown rules:** - Sequence Shield Slam's block buff and Shield Block for crit safety; they overwrite each other 30 · 2026-02-25. - Once your threat lead is safe on a dangerous boss, block-dance in Defensive Stance Dodging · 2026-03-31. - When low: Last Stand, healthstone, tea. - **Shield Wall** needs a shield and shares a 30-minute cooldown with Recklessness and Retaliation Gilnean · 2026-01-18. - Improved Berserker Rage breaks roots. 7. **Avoid:** - Revenge talents in a DefTac build. - DefTac in Defensive Stance all fight. - A slow weapon. - Taunting a crowd-controlled mob. - FuryProt with a shield or in fresh gear. See also [Common mistakes](#/class/warrior/protection-tank).

extraSections.heading: What changed in 1.18.1
extraSections.markdown: - **Defiance:** +4/8/12/15/20% threat in Defensive Stance (the last rank went from 15% to 20%). **Shield Slam:** Attack Power scaling 15% → 20% and its extra threat modifier 50% → 75%. The developers called these "targeted improvements" and promised "a more comprehensive review of the Protection talent tree" later [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Black Hat · 2026-03-11. - **The new DefTac math:** with 5/5 Defiance, Defensive Stance has a 156% threat modifier. Defensive Tactics carries 180% of that bonus into Battle and Berserker Stance, and the 0.8 stance penalty then gives **160.64%**, more than Defensive Stance's 156% 30 · 2026-01-24. Developer Lhian said it "should be the same math as current deftac" Lhian · 2026-01-24. Battle Stance also avoids Defensive Stance's damage penalty, so DefTac out-threatens itself in Battle Stance Dodging · 2026-03-20, Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - **First reports after the patch:** "deftac threat is insane now" Peer · 2026-03-21; "on bwl as deep prot I was number 1 on threat at basically all times after the update" darthpenance · 2026-03-22; "tanked naxx tonight and everything felt good" Dodging · 2026-03-22. - **Champion buffs were removed** from the game. Some tanks felt lower threat after the patch for that reason, not because of their spec Dodging · 2026-03-22, Thirtyseven · 2026-01-24. Bear Maul threat was cut 15% in the same pass 30 · 2026-01-24. - **Shield block fix** (March 25): block classes had been taking their full damage even after a block evella · 2026-03-25, [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139). - **Older Turtle changes you need to know:** - Concussion Blow now *generates* rage Lans · 2026-01-13. - Shield Slam grants one Shield Block-style buff that overwrites Shield Block, instead of Shield Block's old two charges 30 · 2026-01-13, Lipibidy · 2026-02-25. - Thunder Clap works in Defensive Stance Koae · 2025-12-18. - Shield Wall requires a shield; you can no longer use it while dual-wielding Velanir · 2026-02-19.

[calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=warrior&t=050053-05-2500510031055122001) · VALID - **Fresh raiding** (Impale dip + Revenge/Reprisal): `aQFAAYAQ-AY-UAAoIDAopSAAB` (17/3/31). [calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=warrior&t=32205000302-03-2400510030055122001) · VALID With fresh-60 gear Revenge is actually good Zaakir · 2025-10-27. Revenge's threat is flat, though (max rank = (damage + 355) × stance modifier) 30 · 2026-01-19, so it falls behind as you gear Lipibidy · 2026-03-22. Revenge Prot is "essentially a leveling/dungeon-only build" at endgame Lipibidy · 2026-04-05. After reaching 60, one tank concluded that Reprisal's refund is not worth it even as MT nUKe13 · 2026-04-17. A Death Wish Revenge build is one player's choice for dungeon-only tanking Madcrep · 2026-03-22.

extraSections.heading: Thunderfury
extraSections.markdown: - For a warrior tank, Thunderfury is close to mandatory. It is the main AoE threat source, and in DefTac sims it adds about 100-150 TPS over THC Jakeends · 2026-01-09, Virasan · 2026-01-09. - Velanir's DefTac threat-BiS sim ranks **Thunderfury > THC > Rockslicer/Crul'shorukh**, and "Thunderfall is explicitly... bad for tanking" Velanir · 2026-02-17. - Thunderfury in the main hand beat THC in the main hand in a dummy test Artifyce · 2026-03-18. FuryProt BiS is Thunderfury + Riftcarver; for consistency, "tf/riftcarver > tf/thc >> tf/thunderfall" 30 · 2026-01-27, 30 · 2026-01-18. - The proc does not re-hit targets that already carry its debuff, so it is safe around crowd-controlled mobs, but take it off for Twins-style split fights Cannondorf · 2026-03-18. Other things it won't pull include Kel'Thuzad's lightning adds and the Twins scarabs .Hitchslap. · 2026-01-20, .Hitchslap. · 2026-01-20; for those, swap to a fast 60+ DPS weapon Lipibidy · 2026-01-20, Lipibidy · 2026-01-20. - **Contested: how weak is it in AQ40?** One player claims AQ40 is "the only raid with nature resist" VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-06; another corrects that "AQ40 doesn't have high NR... only the final bosses have high resists, and they have high ALL resists" 30 · 2026-02-06, 30 · 2026-02-06 (same dispute exists for shaman Elemental). - **Contested:** Lipibidy calls Thunderfury being "the solution to warrior tanking... the next worst design in WoW" Lipibidy · 2026-04-05; Velanir says "TF got massive competetion" Velanir · 2026-04-05.

extraSections.heading: Raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **[Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core):** - Ragnaros needs about 315 buffed fire resistance. Dark Iron Helm + Leggings with FR enchants do most of the work Spiff · 2026-02-05, casey · 2026-02-05. - Taunt Golemagg's dogs for rage, then dump it on Golemagg Black Hat · 2025-11-10, worlds #1 ppm expert · 2025-11-10. - Only Ragnaros, Domo and (if healers struggle) Golemagg need a shield from a DPS-spec tank Dodging · 2025-10-30. - **[Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair):** - BWL is "literally built around warrior tanks": Recklessness on the Vael pull, backup taunts on the drakes, Shield Wall and anti-fear on Chromaggus and Nefarian eric4225 · 2026-04-06. - Chromaggus enrages at 20%; alternate Improved Shield Slam and Shield Block Lipibidy · 2026-04-03. - Firemaw: an FR-geared tank takes over when the main tank has to shed stacks Velanir · 2025-10-25. - **AQ40:** - Twin Emperors is the one fight where the daze cap matters Dodging · 2025-10-09. - Tanks don't need Nature Resistance gear beyond a Barov Peasant Caller 30 · 2025-11-04. - Take Thunderfury off on Twins Cannondorf · 2026-03-18. - **Naxxramas:** - Stack mitigation mainly for Sapphiron and Patchwerk (if not the MT) and Maexxna Aladar · 2026-03-04, Lans · 2025-12-28. - Hateful Strike soaking wants a 1H hit cap plus maximum stamina 30 · 2025-11-21. One MT tanked Patchwerk as FuryProt with only 340 Defense Aladar · 2026-01-10. - Maexxna's Web Spray stuns you, so you cannot avoid attacks. Put the shield on before the spray, or rotate LGG, Last Stand and Shield Wall across sprays Julian · 2025-11-15, Dodging · 2025-11-15, mark vasko · 2025-11-15. - Sapphiron: no FR gear on this server because his aura is bugged Kyrsie · 2025-12-13; just use Greater Frost Protection potions instead Virasan · 2026-01-08. - Thaddius resets threat about 0.5 s after engaging Velanir · 2025-10-18. - Heigan can resist Taunt Black Hat · 2026-03-28. - Don't taunt Blaumeux during her ~1 s Void Zone cast 30 · 2025-11-03. - Four Horsemen: use Taunt (not Mocking Blow or Challenging Shout) to take a horseman, because only Taunt copies the threat value chain · 2025-06-02. - On low-damage bosses (Anub'Rekhan) a rage-starved deep prot can lose threat to a couple of Shield Slam parries Weirdthing · 2025-10-29. - **[Lower Karazhan Halls](#/instances/lower-karazhan-halls) (Kara10):** tankable in pre-raid BiS. Clawlord Howlfang is a mechanics check; bring a decurser Kyrsie · 2026-01-22, Virasan · 2026-01-22. - **[Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan) (Kara40):** - Needs about 7 tanks (5 with strong crowd control) Coxy · 2026-03-09, Coxy · 2026-03-09. - For a first-time Kara40 tank, DefTac is recommended over FuryProt (single source) Ryiana · 2026-04-19. - **Anomalus:** dodge/parry prevents Manabound Strikes stacks; resistance and block do not, which makes a bear a good third tank 30 · 2026-04-17, 30 · 2026-04-17. AR requirements are **contested** (110 to 200+) Yorb · 2026-03-27, 30 · 2026-03-27. The crafted AR set plus enchants gives about 170 Virasan · 2026-02-06. - **Chess:** the Knight tank goes maximum mitigation or ~70% avoidance, since threat doesn't matter there. Tank it in the bottom-right corner "so every healer can reach them", and keep the PvP trinket equipped 30 · 2026-02-06, Weirdthing · 2026-02-06, 30 · 2026-02-20, Kyrsie · 2026-04-02. - **Kruul:** melee penetrates armor and avoidance, so stack stamina; taunt chains are mandatory. Shield Wall cannot solo the enrage, so 2-3 warriors trade it 30 · 2026-01-08, Thirtyseven · 2025-12-04, 30 · 2026-03-03. - **Mephistroth:** FuryProt needs about 440 Defense to dual-wield-tank him Velanir · 2026-02-08. - **Incantagos:** warrior is the best tank here, since its flat threat ignores his 100%-reduction window Velanir · 2026-03-08. - **[Emerald Sanctum](#/instances/emerald-sanctum):** - Ursol: tank him away from the "poo zones" and pop cooldowns early to push him to 30% 30 · 2026-04-02, 30 · 2026-04-02. - Hard-mode second boss: tank avoidance is effectively 0 Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-31.

glance.recommendation: In 1.18.1, main-tank as **Defensive Tactics ("DefTac", 17/3/31 or 0/20/31)**. That means a shield and a fast one-hander, tanking in **Battle Stance** for most of the pull, with **Shield Slam and Heroic Strike** as your threat. Swap to Defensive Stance to taunt or to block-dance through dangerous hits. The January patch raised Defiance to 20% and buffed Shield Slam, and that closed most of DefTac's threat gap to FuryProt: "going dtac is better in 99.9% of cases instead of 95% it was before" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22, Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - **FuryProt (0/31/20)** stays the best **off-tank** spec and the answer when a raid "really need[s] that extra ~150 tps" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22, Velanir · 2026-01-30. - **Death Wish Prot (0/21/30)** is a high-end MT variant Tole · 2026-04-16. - **Revenge/Reprisal deep prot** is for fresh 60s and dungeons.

facts.markdown: DefTac: medium (stance and shield-buff management). FuryProt: high (healer trust, rage and threat juggling)

facts.label: Strengths

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: AoE threat ("we are the single target tank class") garras · 2026-04-01; openers depend on Shield Slam landing Weirdthing · 2026-03-22; mitigation costs rage and therefore threat 30 · 2025-12-28

glance.rest: Warrior is the single-target "cooldown tank". It trails bear and paladin overall, and it has almost no AoE threat of its own.

talents.markdown: | Situation | Build | Why | |---|---|---| | Main tank, most raids | **DefTac Impale 17/3/31** | Pinned reference build; "impaleProt is the easiest to learn", and among FuryProt, DeathTactics and ImpaleProt "there isn't a clear winner" Velanir · 2026-03-23, Velanir · 2026-03-23 | | MT without a reliable second warrior keeping shouts up | **DefTac Enrage ("shouts") 0/20/31** | "If you have a warrior you trust to keep BS and demo up impale is better. I don't trust anybody so I go shouts" Cannondorf · 2026-03-16 | | High-end MT | **Death Wish Prot 0/21/30** | Tole's favored MT build after the buffs; "21/30 is definitely the path because you get dtac" Tole · 2026-04-16, Tole · 2026-04-16 | | Off-tank; raids that need more threat | **FuryProt 0/31/20** | Ideal off-tank because its DPS stays acceptable when not tanking Virasan · 2026-02-25, Velanir · 2026-01-30 | | Fresh 60, dungeons, low gear | **Revenge/Reprisal deep prot** | Low gear: Defensive Stance Revenge/Reprisal; mid/high gear: DefTac or FuryProt Virasan · 2026-01-14, Ascuz · 2026-02-26 | **Contested: should warriors play FuryProt at all now?** Weirdthing: "the only reason to go fprot now is if you _really_ need that extra 150 tps" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22. Tole still runs FuryProt "for every warrior other than MT because it does much better dps" Tole · 2026-04-16. Lipibidy argues the three sub-specs "all compete with each other for relevancy" and that "at the high end, there's no reason to play the prot tree specs" Lipibidy · 2026-04-05. stats.heading: Stats and caps
stats.markdown: **DefTac:** "you ape out on threat stats and wear a shield with a fast weapon" Dodging · 2026-03-21. 1. **Hit to the yellow cap** (8% at 300 weapon skill, 5% at 315) Black Hat · 2026-01-04. Hit matters for Shield Slam: a parried or dodged Slam "causes eternal pain" Dodging · 2025-10-30. Above the cap, "every point... does exactly nothing for 1h+shield" Velanir · 2026-03-16. 2. **Agility/crit > Strength > AP > block value > haste** for threat worlds #1 ppm expert · 2025-10-29. If you need threat, "Agi/crit >> Str/AP > SBV"; if you need mitigation, "Stam/armor do the heavy lifting" Black Hat · 2025-11-18. 3. **Weapon skill barely matters for a shield tank:** Heroic Strike swings cannot glance Lipibidy · 2026-03-22, Lipibidy · 2026-03-22. 4. **Block value** is weak: a typical piece has about 20. **Glyph of Deflection** is "the only block value item worth using for damage" Lipibidy · 2026-03-14; for DefTac it is "like a small deathwish in terms of threat" Weirdthing · 2025-12-25. 5. **Stamina** for survival. Stamina enchants are better for effective health Lipibidy · 2026-04-03. Avoidance is not mitigation: "dodge>dodge>crush" gives healers heart attacks Lipibidy · 2026-02-22. **FuryProt:** Stamina > Agility > Strength; hit cap and weapon skill preferred; crit always welcome Lipibidy · 2025-11-18. "Stats are king, you double dip on stats like crazy as fprot" Hayden · 2026-03-29. Hit matters a bit less because most of your main-hand swings are Heroic Strikes Hayden · 2026-03-29. | Threshold | Value | Source | |---|---|---| | Defense for an MT | ~370-400; much higher tanks your TPS | L0s7 · 2026-02-25 | | Crit/crush immunity | Use Shield Slam's buff and Shield Block in sequence (they overwrite each other) rather than stacking Defense | 30 · 2026-02-25, Lipibidy · 2026-02-25, Lipibidy · 2025-12-23 | | Daze immunity | 400 Defense vs level 60, 415 vs level 63 (another poster: 420); matters mainly on Twin Emperors | oliverwz · 2025-10-10, Virasan · 2025-10-10, Dodging · 2025-10-09 | | Avoidance | 50-60% total block + dodge + parry is "a good place to be" | L0s7 · 2026-01-29 | | Trash crits | ~360-380 Defense from gear stops most trash crits; Chromaggus and Twins can still crit below ~400 | Arkaris · 2025-10-29 | | HP for Four Horsemen | ~6.5k buffed minimum | Kyrsie · 2025-11-20 | Dodge and other avoidance also cost rage, because you gain rage from being hit Don't ping me · 2026-01-21. A priest's Power Word: Shield on you does the same Ionnatra · 2026-04-11. FuryProt takes the same +10% physical damage as DefTac and 10% less spell damage, but has no Shield Slam buff and no block, so its damage intake is spikier. The Shield Slam buff alone prevents about half of all crits Nost · 2026-02-18, Nost · 2026-02-18.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### DefTac (bot-ready) 1. **Pre-pull:** Battle Shout and Bloodrage about a minute before the pull 30 · 2025-10-19. Mighty Rage Potion on the pull Lipibidy · 2025-12-09. For a burst of pull threat, stack Recklessness + Enrage + Death Wish + Mighty Rage Potion Thirtyseven · 2026-03-03. 2. **Stance:** tank in **Battle Stance** for every pull you safely can. Dodging does so "for every single pull in the game besides the drake in bwl that gets ranged pulled and thrashes" Dodging · 2026-03-31. Swap to Defensive Stance to taunt, or to block-dance once threat is safe Dodging · 2026-03-31. 3. **Opener:** Shield Slam or Concussion Blow first; after the buffs the two are within variance, with Shield Slam about 2 TPS ahead Jakeends · 2026-03-18. 4. **Shield Slam** on cooldown. 5. **Overpower** when it procs (dodge only; Overpower off parries was a bug and has been fixed) Lans · 2026-03-04, Kyrsie · 2026-01-27. 6. **Concussion Blow** on cooldown (Impale/Enrage builds). It generates rage Lans · 2026-01-13. 7. **Heroic Strike** as the rage dump on every swing you can afford. 8. **Sunder Armor** as filler. Its rage cost is now 10, down from 15 Lipibidy · 2026-02-09. 9. **Crit/crush safety:** sequence Shield Slam's buff and Shield Block. They overwrite each other, so press Shield Block after a hit has consumed the Shield Slam buff 30 · 2026-02-25, Black Hat · 2025-12-26. ### FuryProt 1. **Pull:** start in Defensive Stance with as much rage as possible. Bloodrage, then **Bloodthirst + Heroic Strike on the first GCD**. On bosses, run in with Death Wish used just before 30 · 2026-02-23, 30 · 2026-02-23. Don't waste early GCDs on Thunder Clap or Demoralizing Shout D.C.V. · 2026-02-23. 2. **Bloodthirst** on cooldown; it sits above Revenge Hayden · 2026-03-29. 3. **Revenge** when it procs. 4. **Heroic Strike** is your rage-management tool: keep rage at roughly 50-60 Velanir · 2026-03-29, Velanir · 2026-03-29. 5. **Sunder Armor** once you are rage-capped Velanir · 2026-03-29. 6. In the **Execute phase** stance doesn't change threat, but tanking in Berserker Stance is risky. Stay in Defensive Stance; with a huge lead, focus on mitigation and save rage for the next pull Sebastian_ · 2026-02-15, 30 · 2026-02-15. ### Death Wish Prot Pull with Death Wish and Bloodrage (Enrage), then Shield Slam, Heroic Strike and Sunder as for DefTac. Death Wish Prot has "the worst consistency" but the best average TPS in sims: "pump the shit out of it and hope nothing gets parried" Velanir · 2026-02-08, Lipibidy · 2026-02-08.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE threat
rotationAoe.markdown: Warrior has **no dedicated AoE threat tool**, and 1.18.1 did not add one ("we're complaining why all tanks get aoe but warrior... so wtf is twow doing") Lans · 2026-03-20, Hayden · 2026-03-20. "Warrior lacks tools for tanking anything but a boss" Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. Plan your pulls around that. 1. **Mark** the kill order (skull, cross, square) and let DPS own their mistakes VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-08. 2. **Demoralizing Shout** is "warriors best real aoe threat ability if you don't have thunderfury". It is uncapped and cheap, and you can spam it Virasan · 2026-03-22, Virasan · 2026-03-22. 3. **Tab-Cleave**: spread auto-attack Cleaves across the pack. Hayden calls it "your best aoe threat ability thats not dynamite" Hayden · 2026-03-20. Pool rage between pulls so you have some for the next pack Hayden · 2026-03-20. 4. **Thunder Clap** hits at most 4 targets. It is coded as a spell (spell crit, can be resisted, cannot proc Deep Wounds) and has no AP scaling Lipibidy · 2026-01-26, Lans · 2026-02-16. Kyrsie measured about 243 damage with the talent and the T2.5 set against a zero-armor dummy Kyrsie · 2026-02-09. 5. **Whirlwind** briefly from Berserker Stance: "tclap whirlwind tclap", and losing some mobs is expected casey · 2026-02-18. DefTac with a Thunderfall Whirlwind is "very decent for aoe tanking" Fafu · 2026-03-20. 6. **External tools:** Thunderfury ("a cheatcode for small aoe threat"), Force Reactive Disk, Oil of Immolation, Goblin Sapper Charges and Dense Dynamite Dodging · 2026-03-26, casey · 2026-01-08, Weirdthing · 2026-01-12. Sappers are the reliable answer for hard pulls such as Garr Dodging · 2026-03-20. 7. **Challenging Shout** is your emergency AoE taunt; AoE tanking gets noticeably harder while it is on cooldown Ascuz · 2026-02-16. "The 4 packs in the entire game that actually allow you to do real aoe tanking are warrior assignments" Dodging · 2026-03-22. Otherwise, leave big AoE pulls to paladins and bears casey · 2026-04-02.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: - **Shield Wall** needs a shield equipped Velanir · 2026-02-19. It shares one 30-minute cooldown with Recklessness and Retaliation Gilnean · 2026-01-18, ScoobertDoobert · 2026-03-05. FuryProt losing Shield Wall "is really annoying for a solid 4 fights in the game" Hayden · 2026-03-08. - **Last Stand**, a healthstone and Nordanaar Herbal Tea are part of your job when low. Missing them is your fault, not the healer's Virasan · 2025-10-09. - **Improved Berserker Rage** removes roots and slows (Kara40 curses, Noth, Gothik) Neurospicy · 2025-09-26. Never use it during Sanv Tas'dal's add phase JohnGood · 2026-02-03. - **Death Wish** (FuryProt, Death Wish Prot) before the pull 30 · 2026-02-23.

roleStrategy.heading: Threat mechanics
roleStrategy.markdown: | Item | Value | Source | |---|---|---| | Stance modifiers | Defensive 1.3 (×1.2 with 5/5 Defiance = 1.56); Battle/Berserker 0.8 | 30 · 2026-01-24, Lipibidy · 2026-03-31 | | DefTac in Battle/Berserker | 1.6064 with 5/5 Defiance (1.5128 before the Defiance buff) | 30 · 2026-01-24, Ravenhost · 2026-01-24 | | Shield Slam | damage = 303 + block value + 0.2 × AP; threat = damage × 1.75 × stance modifier (was 0.15 AP / ×1.5 before 1.18.1) | 30 · 2026-03-07, 30 · 2026-03-07 | | Revenge | (damage + 355) × stance modifier; ≈528 flat with Defiance | 30 · 2026-01-19, Lipibidy · 2026-02-23 | | Sunder Armor | 260 base threat, 390 in Defensive Stance with Defiance; costs 10 rage | Lipibidy · 2026-02-25, Lipibidy · 2026-02-09 | | Heroic Strike | (damage + flat threat) × stance modifier; the flat part is not multiplied by anything else | Velanir · 2026-02-19, 30 · 2026-01-17 | | Thunderfury proc | damage × modifier + 234 × modifier; unaffected by stance multipliers | 30 · 2026-03-25, 30 · 2026-03-26 | | Buff/debuff application | ~25 threat per affected target, split across targets | Lipibidy · 2025-12-24, Lipibidy · 2026-01-05 | What this means in play: - **Shield Slam and Heroic Strike are your threat.** Heroic Strike is "your main threat in a raid environment (or roughly equal to shield slam)", which is why you need a fast weapon Virasan · 2026-03-21. Shield Slam "overshadows any other active ability; even as revenge prot, you could press only shield slam and heroic strike and do the majority of your threat" Lipibidy · 2026-04-10. - **Your opener hinges on Shield Slam landing.** Its combined miss + dodge + parry chance against a boss is about 19% at 315 weapon skill Jakeends · 2026-03-27. "If you miss 2 shield slams in a row on opener youre doomed" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22. FuryProt is "so much better at chasing a bad opener than dtac" Dodging · 2025-12-23. - **Ask DPS to hold 2-3 GCDs on the pull** to cover parry/dodge streaks Nost · 2025-11-21. The opener matters far more than average TPS Not Normal · 2025-11-21. - **Taunt** copies the target's aggro only when the debuff lands, and can fail on a crowd-controlled or target-less mob MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23, MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23. **Contested:** spell data gives Taunt a 10 s cooldown, but players report 9 s Virasan · 2026-01-28; it can be resisted (about 1 in 6), requires Defensive Stance Black Hat · 2026-03-28, and has only 5 yards of range Virasan · 2026-01-11.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Keep **three sets**: full threat, beefy threat, full mitigation 30 · 2025-10-21. "There is no such thing as full BiS for FuryProt"; your gear changes by fight 30 · 2025-11-22. DPS gear is threat gear: gear "like a DPS warrior" minus leather and mail Nost · 2026-01-01, Dodging · 2025-10-24. - **Pre-raid:** the Stormwind Vault drop set is a good pre-BiS deep prot set Kyrsie · 2026-02-21. Pair Corrosive Core with Breadth of the Earthmother for sure; Hand of Justice "isn't that good" for this set Kyrsie · 2026-02-21, Kyrsie · 2026-02-21. Other picks: Anasterian's Legacy, Darkflame Helm, T1 Might pieces Dodging · 2026-03-21. T1 tank set: "a ton of % chance to block which is all useless" worlds #1 ppm expert · 2025-11-16. - **Shields:** Aegis for DefTac, **Scaleshield** for FuryProt. Lipibidy prefers Scaleshield all around: "12 str/agi/stam > block stats, and the fear break active is also useful" Black Hat · 2026-04-08, Lipibidy · 2026-04-08. - **Weapons:** fast. "Slow weapon is not worth it due to massively reduced amount of heroics" Velanir · 2026-01-27. Don't DefTac-tank with anything slower than Thunderfury Virasan · 2026-03-21. Warblades are only about 8 DPS behind BWL-BiS weapons for FuryProt: "excellent choice if you don't have Thunderfury yet" ScoobertDoobert · 2026-02-07. Without Thunderfury, THC is BiS Velanir · 2026-01-27. **Contested:** one player called Broodwarden "bis till thc" then walked it back, and another didn't see it show up in the sim Hayden · 2026-04-07, Woogz · 2026-04-07; the same player later called it "undervalued by a lot of people" with an "incredibly strong" sword proc Hayden · 2026-04-18. - **FuryProt BWL checklist** (a player's list the channel answered): Chromatic Boots; T2 DPS or Legguards of the Fallen Crusader legs; T2 DPS, Taut Dragonhide or Drake Talon shoulders; Tempest's Rage/Maladath or Thunderfury; Heart of Dreams + Drake Fang Talisman. Add the Kara10 Darkflame Helm BFlorry · 2026-03-29, Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-29. For rings, Circle of Applied Force (buffed to 15 Str / 12 Stam / 22 Agi), or Band of Accuria if you still need hit Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-29, Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-29. - **Tier:** T2 tank is "mitigation BIS forever" Cannondorf · 2026-03-16. The T3 tank set is "the most mit you can get going into k40" Lipibidy · 2026-02-06, and its 2-piece is a genuine TPS gain Velanir · 2026-03-17. The T3 4-piece (taunt hit) is only really needed for Four Horsemen Lans · 2026-01-03. T3.5 is "better enough that it will replace your t3 pieces" Virasan · 2026-02-06. The new T3 PvP chest + gloves 2-set is argued to beat raid tank gear Velanir · 2026-03-11, Lipibidy · 2026-04-10. - **Mixing sets:** swap bracers first, then helm and legs toward threat. Keep a couple of thick-stamina pieces (T3 tank boots/helm); T3 tank pants carry enough block value for a threat set Sylvaira · 2026-01-22, Jakeends · 2026-01-22. "Err on the side of mitigation until you know your raid can farm a boss" Lipibidy · 2025-12-06. - **Trinkets:** Kiss of the Spider is favored for the opener (hastened autos give more rolls against dodge/parry streaks); never Heart of Dreams over two actives 30 · 2025-10-17, 30 · 2025-10-18. For DefTac, Glyph of Deflection + Kiss beats any Mark of the Champion combo Velanir · 2026-02-17. Diamond Flask: use it "like a second Death Wish" (**contested**) Hayden · 2026-04-18, Junak'Salsa · 2026-04-18. - **Fortune** is multiplicative (a 5% proc with 5% Fortune becomes 5.25%) and weak Dodging · 2026-03-20.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Taking Revenge talents in a DefTac build, or DefTac in a Revenge build Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - Tanking DefTac in Defensive Stance the whole fight. Battle Stance is higher threat Dodging · 2026-03-20. - A slow weapon on a tank Velanir · 2026-01-27. - Stacking Defense or avoidance past what the fight needs. It costs rage and threat L0s7 · 2026-02-25, 30 · 2025-12-28. - Wasting early GCDs on Thunder Clap or Demoralizing Shout during a single-target opener D.C.V. · 2026-02-23. - FuryProt with a shield, or FuryProt before your healers and gear can carry it Velanir · 2026-03-03, Lipibidy · 2026-01-20. - Taunting a stunned or crowd-controlled target MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23. - Expecting to AoE-tank like a paladin garras · 2026-04-01.

enchants.heading: Enchants
enchants.markdown: | Slot | Enchant | Notes | |---|---|---| | Gloves | +15 Agility, or +2% threat | **Contested.** Agility gives crit, dodge and armor all fight long Lipibidy · 2025-11-30; Nost's sim found the threat enchant "much better than the agi one" Nost · 2025-12-25 | | Head / Legs | Agility (dodge), 32 AP, or Stamina | Agility when threat is fine; Strength/AP when threat is the struggle Syd · 2026-02-01, Ascuz · 2026-02-01; Stamina for effective health Lipibidy · 2026-04-03 | | Belt | Strength buckle on Girdle of the Mentor; block-value buckle on a T3 belt | Syd · 2026-04-18 | | Rings | +3 all stats | "Fury prot you definitely want +3 all stats" Ascuz · 2026-02-22 | | Weapon | Crusader; keep Weapon Chain on at least one weapon for dungeons | Julian · 2025-11-04, casey · 2026-03-06 | | Cloak | Arcane resistance enchant for Kara40 | Black Hat · 2026-04-17 |

consumables.heading: Consumables
consumables.markdown: - **Pull:** Mighty Rage Potion Ascuz · 2026-02-23. Extra pre-pull rage: pop-and-swap the ZG trinket for 30 rage (swap a static trinket, not your on-use one), or beat Unconscious Dig Rats at a mailbox Lipibidy · 2025-12-09, Lipibidy · 2025-12-09. On-use items share a 30 s cooldown Lipibidy · 2026-04-10; the class-quest chest and belt rage items can only be used about once an hour Lipibidy · 2026-04-10, and behave the same way as the trinket Lipibidy · 2026-04-10. - **Food:** Power Mushroom on non-mitigation fights; Hardened Mushroom + Gurubashi Gumbo (they stack) on mitigation fights Don't ping me · 2026-01-21, Don't ping me · 2026-01-21. - **Naxx resist potions:** Shadow for Four Horsemen and Loatheb; Frost for Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad 30 · 2026-01-11. Greater Fire and Greater Nature Protection stack for Faerlina 30 · 2026-01-11. - **Kara40:** Magic Resistance Potion on Anomalus (there is no Arcane Resistance aura) Kyrsie · 2026-01-09. The MT needs a Frost or Arcane Reflector for the trash before Incantagos Virasan · 2026-01-28.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: A decision loop for a level-60 warrior tank. The details are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/warrior/protection-tank), [AoE threat](#/class/warrior/protection-tank) and [Cooldowns](#/class/warrior/protection-tank). 1. **Pull setup:** Battle Shout and Bloodrage about a minute before the pull, and a Mighty Rage Potion on the pull 30 · 2025-10-19, Lipibidy · 2025-12-09. Ask DPS to hold 2–3 GCDs Nost · 2025-11-21. Stance and weapon by build: - **DefTac:** shield and a fast one-hander, in **Battle Stance** Dodging · 2026-03-31. - **FuryProt:** dual wield, in **Defensive Stance** with as much rage as possible. Use Death Wish just before running in 30 · 2026-02-23. - **Revenge deep prot** (fresh 60, dungeons): shield, in Defensive Stance. 2. **First 3–5 GCDs:** threat skills only. Don't open a single target with Thunder Clap or Demoralizing Shout D.C.V. · 2026-02-23. - **DefTac:** Shield Slam (or Concussion Blow; within variance Jakeends · 2026-03-18) → Sunder Armor → Overpower or Sunder → Shield Slam again at 6 s. Queue Heroic Strike on every swing you can afford. - **FuryProt:** Bloodrage → Bloodthirst + Heroic Strike on the first GCD 30 · 2026-02-23 → Revenge / Sunder → Bloodthirst. 3. **Steady threat loop:** - **DefTac:** Shield Slam on cooldown > Overpower on a dodge > Concussion Blow on cooldown > Sunder Armor filler. Heroic Strike is the rage dump and your main threat with Shield Slam ([DefTac](#/class/warrior/protection-tank)). - **FuryProt:** Bloodthirst > Revenge > Sunder Armor when rage-capped. Heroic Strike keeps rage at about 50–60 ([FuryProt](#/class/warrior/protection-tank)). - **Revenge deep prot:** Shield Slam > Revenge > Sunder Armor > Heroic Strike dump ([Revenge/Reprisal](#/class/warrior/protection-tank)). 4. **Multi-mob:** - Mark skull > cross > square VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-08. - Spam Demoralizing Shout Virasan · 2026-03-22. Tab-Cleave on autos Hayden · 2026-03-20. - Thunder Clap hits at most 4 targets. - Make a short Berserker swap for "tclap whirlwind tclap" casey · 2026-02-18. - For hard pulls, use Thunderfury, Sappers or dynamite. Don't try to AoE-tank like a paladin. 5. **Taunt / threat recovery:** - **Taunt** needs Defensive Stance and 5 yd, has a 10 s cooldown, and can be resisted. It fails on a crowd-controlled mob MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23. - **Mocking Blow** (Battle Stance, 120 s) is the backup; **Challenging Shout** (10 min) is the AoE emergency. - Where the threat value must transfer (Four Horsemen), only Taunt copies it chain · 2025-06-02. 6. **Defensive cooldown rules:** - Sequence Shield Slam's block buff and Shield Block for crit safety; they overwrite each other 30 · 2026-02-25. - Once your threat lead is safe on a dangerous boss, block-dance in Defensive Stance Dodging · 2026-03-31. - When low: Last Stand, healthstone, tea. - **Shield Wall** needs a shield and shares a 30-minute cooldown with Recklessness and Retaliation Gilnean · 2026-01-18. - Improved Berserker Rage breaks roots. 7. **Avoid:** - Revenge talents in a DefTac build. - DefTac in Defensive Stance all fight. - A slow weapon. - Taunting a crowd-controlled mob. - FuryProt with a shield or in fresh gear. See also [Common mistakes](#/class/warrior/protection-tank).

extraSections.heading: What changed in 1.18.1
extraSections.markdown: - **Defiance:** +4/8/12/15/20% threat in Defensive Stance (the last rank went from 15% to 20%). **Shield Slam:** Attack Power scaling 15% → 20% and its extra threat modifier 50% → 75%. The developers called these "targeted improvements" and promised "a more comprehensive review of the Protection talent tree" later [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Black Hat · 2026-03-11. - **The new DefTac math:** with 5/5 Defiance, Defensive Stance has a 156% threat modifier. Defensive Tactics carries 180% of that bonus into Battle and Berserker Stance, and the 0.8 stance penalty then gives **160.64%**, more than Defensive Stance's 156% 30 · 2026-01-24. Developer Lhian said it "should be the same math as current deftac" Lhian · 2026-01-24. Battle Stance also avoids Defensive Stance's damage penalty, so DefTac out-threatens itself in Battle Stance Dodging · 2026-03-20, Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - **First reports after the patch:** "deftac threat is insane now" Peer · 2026-03-21; "on bwl as deep prot I was number 1 on threat at basically all times after the update" darthpenance · 2026-03-22; "tanked naxx tonight and everything felt good" Dodging · 2026-03-22. - **Champion buffs were removed** from the game. Some tanks felt lower threat after the patch for that reason, not because of their spec Dodging · 2026-03-22, Thirtyseven · 2026-01-24. Bear Maul threat was cut 15% in the same pass 30 · 2026-01-24. - **Shield block fix** (March 25): block classes had been taking their full damage even after a block evella · 2026-03-25, [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139). - **Older Turtle changes you need to know:** - Concussion Blow now *generates* rage Lans · 2026-01-13. - Shield Slam grants one Shield Block-style buff that overwrites Shield Block, instead of Shield Block's old two charges 30 · 2026-01-13, Lipibidy · 2026-02-25. - Thunder Clap works in Defensive Stance Koae · 2025-12-18. - Shield Wall requires a shield; you can no longer use it while dual-wielding Velanir · 2026-02-19.

extraSections.heading: Thunderfury
extraSections.markdown: - For a warrior tank, Thunderfury is close to mandatory. It is the main AoE threat source, and in DefTac sims it adds about 100-150 TPS over THC Jakeends · 2026-01-09, Virasan · 2026-01-09. - Velanir's DefTac threat-BiS sim ranks **Thunderfury > THC > Rockslicer/Crul'shorukh**, and "Thunderfall is explicitly... bad for tanking" Velanir · 2026-02-17. - Thunderfury in the main hand beat THC in the main hand in a dummy test Artifyce · 2026-03-18. FuryProt BiS is Thunderfury + Riftcarver; for consistency, "tf/riftcarver > tf/thc >> tf/thunderfall" 30 · 2026-01-27, 30 · 2026-01-18. - The proc does not re-hit targets that already carry its debuff, so it is safe around crowd-controlled mobs, but take it off for Twins-style split fights Cannondorf · 2026-03-18. Other things it won't pull include Kel'Thuzad's lightning adds and the Twins scarabs .Hitchslap. · 2026-01-20, .Hitchslap. · 2026-01-20; for those, swap to a fast 60+ DPS weapon Lipibidy · 2026-01-20, Lipibidy · 2026-01-20. - **Contested: how weak is it in AQ40?** One player claims AQ40 is "the only raid with nature resist" VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-06; another corrects that "AQ40 doesn't have high NR... only the final bosses have high resists, and they have high ALL resists" 30 · 2026-02-06, 30 · 2026-02-06 (same dispute exists for shaman Elemental). - **Contested:** Lipibidy calls Thunderfury being "the solution to warrior tanking... the next worst design in WoW" Lipibidy · 2026-04-05; Velanir says "TF got massive competetion" Velanir · 2026-04-05.

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **TwThreat** reads real server threat; KTM only estimates Kyrsie · 2026-04-07. - **Mouseover taunt:** `/cast [@mouseover]Taunt;Taunt` Don't ping me · 2025-11-07. - Don't stack "Revenge if available else Sunder" into one macro; use separate binds Lipibidy · 2026-01-29. - **Tankalyze** tracks taunts and removes Salvation clutter Black Hat · 2026-03-14. **ShaguPlates** has threat nameplates (needs SuperWoW) Kyrsie · 2026-01-10. **AdvancedLogger** counts wasted Sunders per player 30 · 2026-01-14. - **Weapon swaps** each cost a GCD and reset the swing timer somedeadguy · 2026-01-04, and they misbehave in combat on the Turtle client 30 · 2026-03-12.

extraSections.heading: Raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **[Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core):** - Ragnaros needs about 315 buffed fire resistance. Dark Iron Helm + Leggings with FR enchants do most of the work Spiff · 2026-02-05, casey · 2026-02-05. - Taunt Golemagg's dogs for rage, then dump it on Golemagg Black Hat · 2025-11-10, worlds #1 ppm expert · 2025-11-10. - Only Ragnaros, Domo and (if healers struggle) Golemagg need a shield from a DPS-spec tank Dodging · 2025-10-30. - **[Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair):** - BWL is "literally built around warrior tanks": Recklessness on the Vael pull, backup taunts on the drakes, Shield Wall and anti-fear on Chromaggus and Nefarian eric4225 · 2026-04-06. - Chromaggus enrages at 20%; alternate Improved Shield Slam and Shield Block Lipibidy · 2026-04-03. - Firemaw: an FR-geared tank takes over when the main tank has to shed stacks Velanir · 2025-10-25. - **AQ40:** - Twin Emperors is the one fight where the daze cap matters Dodging · 2025-10-09. - Tanks don't need Nature Resistance gear beyond a Barov Peasant Caller 30 · 2025-11-04. - Take Thunderfury off on Twins Cannondorf · 2026-03-18. - **Naxxramas:** - Stack mitigation mainly for Sapphiron and Patchwerk (if not the MT) and Maexxna Aladar · 2026-03-04, Lans · 2025-12-28. - Hateful Strike soaking wants a 1H hit cap plus maximum stamina 30 · 2025-11-21. One MT tanked Patchwerk as FuryProt with only 340 Defense Aladar · 2026-01-10. - Maexxna's Web Spray stuns you, so you cannot avoid attacks. Put the shield on before the spray, or rotate LGG, Last Stand and Shield Wall across sprays Julian · 2025-11-15, Dodging · 2025-11-15, mark vasko · 2025-11-15. - Sapphiron: no FR gear on this server because his aura is bugged Kyrsie · 2025-12-13; just use Greater Frost Protection potions instead Virasan · 2026-01-08. - Thaddius resets threat about 0.5 s after engaging Velanir · 2025-10-18. - Heigan can resist Taunt Black Hat · 2026-03-28. - Don't taunt Blaumeux during her ~1 s Void Zone cast 30 · 2025-11-03. - Four Horsemen: use Taunt (not Mocking Blow or Challenging Shout) to take a horseman, because only Taunt copies the threat value chain · 2025-06-02. - On low-damage bosses (Anub'Rekhan) a rage-starved deep prot can lose threat to a couple of Shield Slam parries Weirdthing · 2025-10-29. - **[Lower Karazhan Halls](#/instances/lower-karazhan-halls) (Kara10):** tankable in pre-raid BiS. Clawlord Howlfang is a mechanics check; bring a decurser Kyrsie · 2026-01-22, Virasan · 2026-01-22. - **[Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan) (Kara40):** - Needs about 7 tanks (5 with strong crowd control) Coxy · 2026-03-09, Coxy · 2026-03-09. - For a first-time Kara40 tank, DefTac is recommended over FuryProt (single source) Ryiana · 2026-04-19. - **Anomalus:** dodge/parry prevents Manabound Strikes stacks; resistance and block do not, which makes a bear a good third tank 30 · 2026-04-17, 30 · 2026-04-17. AR requirements are **contested** (110 to 200+) Yorb · 2026-03-27, 30 · 2026-03-27. The crafted AR set plus enchants gives about 170 Virasan · 2026-02-06. - **Chess:** the Knight tank goes maximum mitigation or ~70% avoidance, since threat doesn't matter there. Tank it in the bottom-right corner "so every healer can reach them", and keep the PvP trinket equipped 30 · 2026-02-06, Weirdthing · 2026-02-06, 30 · 2026-02-20, Kyrsie · 2026-04-02. - **Kruul:** melee penetrates armor and avoidance, so stack stamina; taunt chains are mandatory. Shield Wall cannot solo the enrage, so 2-3 warriors trade it 30 · 2026-01-08, Thirtyseven · 2025-12-04, 30 · 2026-03-03. - **Mephistroth:** FuryProt needs about 440 Defense to dual-wield-tank him Velanir · 2026-02-08. - **Incantagos:** warrior is the best tank here, since its flat threat ignores his 100%-reduction window Velanir · 2026-03-08. - **[Emerald Sanctum](#/instances/emerald-sanctum):** - Ursol: tank him away from the "poo zones" and pop cooldowns early to push him to 30% 30 · 2026-04-02, 30 · 2026-04-02. - Hard-mode second boss: tank avoidance is effectively 0 Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-31.

glance.recommendation: In 1.18.1, main-tank as **Defensive Tactics ("DefTac", 17/3/31 or 0/20/31)**. That means a shield and a fast one-hander, tanking in **Battle Stance** for most of the pull, with **Shield Slam and Heroic Strike** as your threat. Swap to Defensive Stance to taunt or to block-dance through dangerous hits. The January patch raised Defiance to 20% and buffed Shield Slam, and that closed most of DefTac's threat gap to FuryProt: "going dtac is better in 99.9% of cases instead of 95% it was before" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22, Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - **FuryProt (0/31/20)** stays the best **off-tank** spec and the answer when a raid "really need[s] that extra ~150 tps" Weirdthing · 2026-03-22, Velanir · 2026-01-30. - **Death Wish Prot (0/21/30)** is a high-end MT variant Tole · 2026-04-16. - **Revenge/Reprisal deep prot** is for fresh 60s and dungeons.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Main tank, off-tank; Sunder Armor, Demoralizing Shout, Disarm, Shield Wall

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **A (raid MT/OT).** "More than viable for all the content in the current patch" but "the worst MT" of the three tank classes Black Hat · 2026-03-15. Bear > Paladin ≈ Warrior as a complete package Lipibidy · 2026-04-09, Lipibidy · 2026-03-21

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: DefTac: medium (stance and shield-buff management). FuryProt: high (healer trust, rage and threat juggling)

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: "Warrior is the cooldown tank. Best defensive and offensive cds" Tole · 2026-04-02; best Vael tank casey · 2026-04-02; best Incantagos tank thanks to flat threat Velanir · 2026-03-08, Velanir · 2026-02-13

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: AoE threat ("we are the single target tank class") garras · 2026-04-01; openers depend on Shield Slam landing Weirdthing · 2026-03-22; mitigation costs rage and therefore threat 30 · 2025-12-28

glance.rest: Warrior is the single-target "cooldown tank". It trails bear and paladin overall, and it has almost no AoE threat of its own.

playbooks.title: Arms Warrior (melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** Arms is the **fresh-60 and progression DPS spec**. It needs no Flurry uptime, so it works in low-crit gear, and it is the better choice until you reach about 23% unbuffed crit Kyrsie · 2026-02-05, Kyrsie · 2026-02-05. In endgame raids it trails 2H Fury on most fights, except long fights and cleave fights Lipibidy · 2026-04-03, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-12. It comes in two builds: - **MS Arms (35/16/0):** Mortal Strike, Master of Arms and Precision Cut, with Slam as filler. This is the consistent build. - **Death Wish Arms, "Deathcute" (30/21/0):** skips Mortal Strike to reach Death Wish and Enrage, and puts everything into a buffed Precision Cut Execute. The Execute numbers are huge, but it plays slowly. If you have the crit for Flurry, [2H Fury or Lawnmower](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps) does more real damage. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee DPS; Mortal Strike healing debuff; Sweeping Strikes cleave; the biggest Executes in the game | | Viability (1.18.1) | **B (raid), A (fresh 60 / low gear).** "Arms can do big executes now, still trailing 2h fury on most fights" Lipibidy · 2026-04-03. "Only one arms warr makes it to the top and dude is a great player" Thirtyseven · 2026-04-17. "Arms is generally better for lower geared warriors" Kyrsie · 2026-03-22 | | Difficulty | Medium: swing-timed Slam, Sweeping Strikes charge management, rage banking for Execute | | Strengths | No crit gate; "Mortal hits like a truck on ST" Guts · 2026-03-25; relatively better on long fights (Kara40) than on short Naxx fights axelfrog · 2026-02-12 | | Weaknesses | "Still feels like it's missing something outside of cleave. And lawnmower is still better at cleave" Lipibidy · 2026-03-25. Deathcute's Execute damage is partly overkill Thirtyseven · 2026-03-21 | **Contested: is Arms competitive?** Some players' logs say yes. One Ambershire DW Fury player saw "a large DPS increase" in MC after switching to 31/20 Arms Neurospicy · 2026-02-20, and VeganCourage's Arms raidmate "routinely out dps" his 2H Fury on Patchwerk, Thaddius and Loatheb VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-20. Both reports predate 1.18.1. Since the patch, the consensus is that 2H Fury and Lawnmower are ahead ("Lawnmower and 2h fury are still better than arms") Painfool · 2026-03-21, Kyrsie · 2026-03-22. Shardphoenix called the two "very similar results depending on fight length" right before adding that 2H Fury is "a clear winner in PvE at high gear lvl (AQ40+ basically)" Shardphoenix · 2026-04-12, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-12.
