stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to the yellow cap:** 8% at 300 weapon skill, 5% at 315 Black Hat · 2026-01-04. 2. **Weapon skill 310-315.** Two-Handed Weapon Specialization already gives +3 Shardphoenix · 2026-04-13, Virasan · 2026-01-08. 3. **Crit (Agility).** Arms keeps valuing Agility above 34% crit, unlike Fury, which loses Flurry value there VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-02. Early raiders pick an **axe** for the +5% crit from the Arms weapon talent, to avoid rage starvation VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-09. 4. **Strength / AP.** Mortal Strike, Slam and Whirlwind scale with weapon damage and AP. Execute scales with AP, armor penetration and rage Gwendalyn · 2026-03-21. 5. **Armor penetration** has its best case on Arms, because Execute scales with it Kyrsie · 2026-03-22. It is still weak against fully debuffed bosses Shardphoenix · 2026-03-30. 6. **Haste** gives Arms no value on Whirlwind or Sweeping Strikes damage Sylvaira · 2026-03-07.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### MS Arms 1. **Opener:** Charge → Sunder Armor on the first GCD → Bloodrage (it procs Enrage because its self-damage counts as a crit) Kyrsie · 2026-03-29. 2. **Mortal Strike** on cooldown. 3. **Slam** right after each auto lands. The basic loop is "auto -> slam -> something (hamstring for example)" Guts · 2026-03-24. Use a slow weapon: 3.4 speed clips, 3.6 works, 3.8 is ideal for fitting two Slams around one swing Lipibidy · 2025-12-29. 4. **Whirlwind** on cooldown Thirtyseven · 2026-03-01. 5. **Overpower** when it procs. For Arms it is worth a little more than for 2H Fury: "id prio it over ww as arms (still slam tho)". It is a small consistency gain worth chasing only if you play near the top Guts · 2026-04-13. Watch the stance-swap cost: most of the time a swap to Overpower throws away 50+ rage casey · 2026-03-25. 6. **Hamstring** as a cheap filler GCD; it has no cooldown now Guts · 2026-03-24. 7. **Heroic Strike** only when rage would otherwise cap (vanilla baseline). The Heroic Strike swing generates no rage Breaddy · 2026-02-18. 8. **Execute phase (under 20%):** bank rage before 20% so you can Execute from 20% to 0 Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. Precision Cut turns every extra rage point into 25/50/75% more damage [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). ### Deathcute - **Before 20%:** Slam is your filler ("ur filler is slam") Guts · 2026-03-24. Keep Mortal-Strike-less damage up with Whirlwind, Overpower and Sweeping Strikes on packs. - **Under 20%:** pool rage, then Death Wish + Bloodrage (Enrage) and **spam Execute** ("execute XD") Guts · 2026-03-24. Expect dead time at 0 rage between Executes Thirtyseven · 2026-03-27.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE / cleave
rotationAoe.markdown: - **Sweeping Strikes** first on any 2+ target pull, then Mortal Strike, Whirlwind and Cleave. MS Arms is "strong on trash/cleave via Sweeping Strikes cleave window" every ~3.8 s, or ~2.4 s with Flurry Kyrsie · 2026-03-25, Kyrsie · 2026-03-25. - Sweeping Strikes hits the second target for 20% of the damage casey · 2026-01-22. It does not copy the Mortal Strike debuff 30 · 2026-02-18. It copies an Execute only onto a second target that is also below 20% 30 · 2025-10-18. - Do not spend Sweeping Strikes charges on low-damage buttons such as Hamstring or Pummel (pre-1.18.1 advice) Forlorn Shade · 2025-04-08. - A dungeon version from a Jan-2026 slow-2H AoE build: Bloodrage → Demoralizing Shout → Sweeping Strikes → Mortal Strike Phyie · 2026-01-20 (single source). - On pure trash and cleave, [Lawnmower](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps) still wins Lipibidy · 2026-03-25.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: - **Death Wish** (Deathcute only): save it for the Execute phase Cannondorf · 2026-03-15. - **Recklessness** in the Execute phase. It shares a 30-minute cooldown with Shield Wall and Retaliation Gilnean · 2026-01-18. - **Bloodrage** on the pull, and again into Execute on fights of 1:15 or longer 30 · 2025-10-30. - **Kiss of the Spider** is very strong when the Execute phase is the most important part of the fight Guts · 2026-02-03, Don't ping me · 2026-04-10.

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Kara40 ([Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan)):** Arms does relatively better with longer kill times axelfrog · 2026-02-12. Kruul is a no-adds fight where only the enrage phase below 25% matters, and that is where Arms gets to Execute 30 · 2025-05-12. - **Naxx:** short kill times favor Fury: "arms is gonna stay getting mogged in naxx where everything dies quick" axelfrog · 2026-02-12.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Arms uses the same two-handers as 2H Fury (see [Fury → Two-handers](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps)): - **BWL phase:** Untamed Blade over Ashkandi (certain) and probably over BRE; BRE can carry you to Naxx Dodging · 2026-03-13, Dodging · 2026-03-13. - **Mortal Strike scales with weapon damage.** Choose between a high-weapon-skill slow weapon and a higher-DPS new one by your raid's armor-debuff coverage Madcrep · 2026-02-01, evella · 2026-02-01. - **Pre-BiS:** there is no Arms pre-BiS list; use the database and build your own Virasan · 2026-01-08. - **Sets:** the T3 4-piece (+4% ability crit damage) and the T1 3-piece rage proc help Arms as they help Fury [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Enchants, stones, consumables, macros and addons are the same as for Fury: see [Fury → Enchants](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps) and [Fury → Consumables](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps). One Arms-specific difference: on gloves, many take **+9 Strength**, but Agility stays good for Arms above 34% crit VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-02.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Taking Master of Arms over Enrage in a Precision Cut build Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - Stance-swapping for Overpower while holding a lot of rage casey · 2026-03-25. - Playing Deathcute in a raid that kills bosses too fast for the Execute phase to matter Thirtyseven · 2026-03-27. - Reading pre-1.18 Arms guides, which assume Execute has a cooldown or rely on the old Precision Cut refund camilongus · 2025-07-25, 30 · 2025-08-10.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: A decision loop for a level-60 Arms warrior. The details are in [MS Arms](#/class/warrior/arms-melee-dps), [Deathcute](#/class/warrior/arms-melee-dps), [AoE / cleave](#/class/warrior/arms-melee-dps) and [Cooldowns](#/class/warrior/arms-melee-dps). 1. **Opener:** Charge → Sunder Armor on the first GCD → Bloodrage (Enrage) Kyrsie · 2026-03-29. 2. **Single-target loop (MS Arms):** 1. Mortal Strike on cooldown. 2. Slam right after each auto with a slow two-hander: "auto -> slam -> something" Guts · 2026-03-24. 3. Whirlwind on cooldown. 4. Overpower when it procs, if the swap won't throw away rage. 5. Hamstring as a cheap filler. 6. Heroic Strike only at the rage cap. - **Deathcute:** Slam is the filler until 20%. 3. **Execute phase:** bank rage before 20% and Execute from 20% to 0 Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. Precision Cut turns extra rage into damage. Deathcute: Death Wish + Bloodrage, then spam Execute. 4. **Cooldowns:** - **Recklessness** in the Execute phase; it shares a 30-minute cooldown with Shield Wall and Retaliation Gilnean · 2026-01-18. - **Bloodrage** on the pull, and again into Execute on fights of 1:15 or longer. - **Death Wish** (Deathcute) for the Execute phase. 5. **AoE switch (2+ targets):** 1. Sweeping Strikes first, in Battle Stance. 2. Then Mortal Strike, Whirlwind and Cleave. 3. Don't spend Sweeping Strikes on low-damage buttons. 6. **Resource rule:** - A stance swap to Overpower costs 50+ rage about 80–90% of the time casey · 2026-03-25, so only swap with little rage banked. - The Heroic Strike swing makes no rage.

extraSections.heading: What changed in 1.18.1
extraSections.markdown: - **Precision Cut** now raises the damage per extra rage point spent on Execute by 25/50/75%. It swapped tree positions with Boundless Anger, so Precision Cut now requires 3/3 Boundless Anger [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Nonono · 2026-03-29. Result: "You drop MoA for enrage now, precision cut got big buffed" Lipibidy · 2026-03-21, and "arms got actually good executes back" Kyrsie · 2026-03-12. - **Execute:** **Contested:** spell data still lists all ranks at 15 rage, but players report the cost dropped to 10, with the freed rage becoming damage Don't ping me · 2026-02-01. It scales with Attack Power, armor penetration and rage spent, not with weapon damage Gwendalyn · 2026-03-21, Kyrsie · 2026-03-22. - **Sweeping Strikes** (January hotfix) no longer double-dips damage modifiers. It hits for 20% of the damage and cannot crit casey · 2026-01-22, limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2026-03-23. - **Hamstring** has no cooldown again [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - The **T1 3-piece** and **T3 4-piece** (+4% ability crit damage) changes apply to Arms as well [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - The pre-1.18 "Execute on a cooldown" change from Class Changes 2 was reverted. The developers said it "forced most Arms players to spec into the Fury tree" camilongus · 2025-07-25.

glance.recommendation: Arms is the **fresh-60 and progression DPS spec**. It needs no Flurry uptime, so it works in low-crit gear, and it is the better choice until you reach about 23% unbuffed crit Kyrsie · 2026-02-05, Kyrsie · 2026-02-05. In endgame raids it trails 2H Fury on most fights, except long fights and cleave fights Lipibidy · 2026-04-03, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-12. It comes in two builds: - **MS Arms (35/16/0):** Mortal Strike, Master of Arms and Precision Cut, with Slam as filler. This is the consistent build. - **Death Wish Arms, "Deathcute" (30/21/0):** skips Mortal Strike to reach Death Wish and Enrage, and puts everything into a buffed Precision Cut Execute. The Execute numbers are huge, but it plays slowly.

glance.rest: If you have the crit for Flurry, [2H Fury or Lawnmower](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps) does more real damage. **Contested: is Arms competitive?** Some players' logs say yes. One Ambershire DW Fury player saw "a large DPS increase" in MC after switching to 31/20 Arms Neurospicy · 2026-02-20, and VeganCourage's Arms raidmate "routinely out dps" his 2H Fury on Patchwerk, Thaddius and Loatheb VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-20. Both reports predate 1.18.1. Since the patch, the consensus is that 2H Fury and Lawnmower are ahead ("Lawnmower and 2h fury are still better than arms") Painfool · 2026-03-21, Kyrsie · 2026-03-22. Shardphoenix called the two "very similar results depending on fight length" right before adding that 2H Fury is "a clear winner in PvE at high gear lvl (AQ40+ basically)" Shardphoenix · 2026-04-12, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-12.

playbooks.title: Fury Warrior (melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** Fury is the warrior raid DPS tree in 1.18.1, and it comes in three shapes. **2H Fury (20/31/0)** is the top overall-damage build once you have raid gear and roughly 30% crit: Bloodthirst and Whirlwind on cooldown, **Slam** woven between swings whenever Flurry is up. **Lawnmower (21/30/0)** is the same build with Sweeping Strikes instead of Bloodthirst, for trash- and cleave-heavy raids such as Kara40. **Dual Wield Fury (17/34/0)** has no cast bar, forgives mistakes, has the best Execute phase and holds server records. Its weakness is gear: it needs two good one-handers and weapon skill for both. None of the three is a fresh-60 spec. If you have under about 23% unbuffed crit, play [Arms](#/class/warrior/arms-melee-dps) first. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee DPS; Sunder Armor, Battle/Demoralizing Shout, Disarm, off-tanking on demand | | Viability (1.18.1) | **S (raid).** 2H Fury "still leads DW Fury and Arms on most fights" Lipibidy · 2026-04-03; "2h fury, 2h fury with sweeping strikes instead of Bloodthirst and dual wield fury are the meta dps specs" Velanir · 2026-03-15 | | Difficulty | 2H: high (swing-timer management for Slam). DW: medium (no cast, three buttons plus fillers) | | Strengths | Three big damage steroids (Enrage, Death Wish, Flurry) Lipibidy · 2026-03-02; strong cleave; DW can off-tank or tank in DPS gear Velanir · 2026-02-08 | | Weaknesses | Flurry needs crit, so both builds feel bad in fresh-60 gear Shardphoenix · 2026-04-13; 2H is rage-starved on trash without Windfury 30 · 2025-10-08; DW is bottlenecked on weapons and weapon skill | **2H or DW? (contested).** At equal gear and skill 2H Fury comes out ahead, but skill decides it at the margin: "dual wield is close behind or better in single target" Kyrsie · 2026-01-13, Kyrsie · 2026-01-13, Guts · 2026-01-05. After the patch 2H is "ahead of dw fury" Lipibidy · 2026-03-26, and the trash gap between the two "isn't a massive gap" Lipibidy · 2026-04-01. Against that, a DW warrior (Lashara) set consecutive Grobbulus DPS records with no Champion buff in April 2026, and the channel reposted it as proof that DW is "batshit broken" Blackjack · 2026-04-18. Before Bonereaver's Edge drops, DW often wins because it has far more usable weapons eric4225 · 2026-02-05. Pick by the weapons you own.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to the yellow cap.** Yellow attacks (abilities) need **8% hit against a boss at 300 weapon skill**. Turtle removed vanilla's extra +1% boss miss Dodging · 2025-12-19. Each weapon-skill point above 300 lowers that by 0.2%: 7% at 305, 6% at 310, 5% at 315. This is the same for DW, 2H and sword-and-board Black Hat · 2026-01-04, Black Hat · 2026-01-04. 2. **Weapon skill to 310-315** for your weapon type Virasan · 2026-01-08. Each point above 300 gives "+0.2% hit chance, +2% dmg on glancing blows, +0.1% crit chance and -0.1% dodge chance" (30 quoting the formula) 30 · 2026-02-04. White hits against a boss glance 40% of the time no matter what; weapon skill only raises glancing damage from 65% at 300 to 95% at 315 30 · 2025-11-26. **Do not go past 315.** A bug removes about 0.6% crit at 316 Black Hat · 2026-03-07, 30 · 2026-02-04. Weapon skill does nothing to parry chance (tested over 100k autos) 30 · 2026-03-25. 3. **Strength / AP and crit.** Crit is worth roughly 30-40 AP. In practice "~92 ap + 2 crit is worth more than 33ap + ~3.7 crit most of the time" 30 · 2026-01-31, 30 · 2026-01-31. 1 Strength = 2 AP (2.2 with Kings); 20 Agility = 1% crit Shardphoenix · 2026-04-10. Crit still matters for Flurry, Impale and Deep Wounds Guts · 2026-03-30. 4. **Haste.** It stacks multiplicatively and gets stronger the more crit and AP you already have Lipibidy · 2025-12-08, Lipibidy · 2025-12-08. For 2H, Strength vs haste is **contested**: "Str is better, don't let hastechuds fool you" axelfrog · 2026-03-16 versus "haste has a double benefit for 2h" evella · 2026-03-16. 5. **Armor penetration** is weak. It is a flat stat, and raid bosses sit near 0 armor once Sunder, Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness are up. It matters mostly against trash or bosses with armor left Shardphoenix · 2026-03-30, Tole · 2026-03-21. | Cap / threshold | Value | Source | |---|---|---| | Yellow hit vs boss | 8% at 300 skill → 5% at 315 | Black Hat · 2026-01-04 | | Weapon skill | 315 hard stop (316 costs ~0.6% crit) | 30 · 2026-03-17, Squid · 2026-03-07 | | DW white-hit cap | 27% (26.4% at 303 skill); chasing it is sub-optimal, but DW still gets some value from hit above the yellow cap | Squid · 2026-03-09, Black Hat · 2026-01-04 | | Crit for 2H Fury | ~23% unbuffed before 2H/Fury beats Arms; Flurry crit value drops after ~34% | Kyrsie · 2026-02-05, VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-02 | | 2H crit cap | above 52% (Better Character Stats shows ~55% at 315 skill); "not worth thinking about" | Shardphoenix · 2026-04-10, 30 · 2026-01-31 | Once you are hit-capped, do not trade crit for hit Sylvaira · 2026-01-28. Sim your own gear with a high iteration count; the sim needs 100k+ iterations before single-stat differences mean anything 30 · 2026-03-14.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### How Slam works on Turtle - Slam **does not reset** the swing timer. The auto-attack keeps counting while Slam casts, and the swing only waits if its timer runs out before Slam finishes. You can cast Slam while moving Virasan · 2026-01-11. Since mid-April 2026, a Slam that lands before the next auto no longer delays that auto at all Piemelbrie / siswet · 2026-04-17. - Slam **resets your off-hand swing**, which keeps it out of DW rotations Sylvaira · 2025-11-14. - Slam damage is not normalized, so **use the slowest two-hander you can** Shardphoenix · 2026-04-13, 30 · 2026-04-15. - Whirlwind cannot clip your swing. If your next auto is under about 1 second away, press Whirlwind instead of Slam 30 · 2026-04-10, Kyrsie · 2026-04-10. ### 2H Fury (Bloodthirst build) priority 1. **Opener:** Charge (if allowed) → Sunder Armor on the first GCD → Bloodrage for Enrage. On a fight longer than about 1 minute, Bloodrage on the pull and again going into Execute Jerso · 2026-01-09, 30 · 2025-10-30. 2. **Bloodthirst** on cooldown. Do not delay it to fit a Slam Bassilthorne/Achuak · 2026-03-23. 3. **Whirlwind** on cooldown. Top parsers use it even on a single target Grettt · 2026-03-04. 4. **Slam** when Flurry is up and the cast will land before your next auto. Otherwise press another instant Bassilthorne/Achuak · 2026-03-23, Fury · 2026-04-15. The working pattern is "Slam bt auto slam ww auto" evella · 2026-04-15. 5. **Heroic Strike** queued at about 70 rage or more, so you are never rage-starved ScoobertDoobert · 2026-04-03, Dodging · 2025-11-25. If a Slam cannot land before the next auto, a Heroic Strike beats clipping the auto Fury · 2026-04-15. 6. **Execute phase (target under 20%):** bank rage before 20% so a single Execute can take the target from 20% to 0 Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. Execute scales with AP, armor penetration and rage spent, not weapon damage Gwendalyn · 2026-03-21, Kyrsie · 2026-03-22. **Contested:** spell data still lists 15 rage on every rank, but players report the cost dropped to 10, with the freed rage becoming damage Don't ping me · 2026-02-01. With enough crit, weaving Slam between Executes adds damage Julian · 2026-04-01. **Training-wheels version** (Guts): "ignore swingtimer, ignore autos and always cast 1 slam and then use bt, slam ww, slam bt, slam 3x repeat". He says that alone, plus good cooldown timing, puts you in the top 10% Guts · 2026-03-26, Guts · 2026-03-26. VeganCourage's 5-minute dummy test with a 3.8-speed weapon ranked "Slam > Auto > Slam > Auto > Slam > Auto > WW > BT" at 176k damage, ahead of Slam-only at 153k VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-01-26. **Slam macros (contested).** A no-clip macro needs SuperWoW, SP_SwingTimer and SuperCleveRoidMacros: `#showtooltip Slam` / `/startattack` / `/cast [noslamclip] Slam` Nabuhodonozo · 2026-04-02. Others say "don't macro Slam into your swing — just spam it manually" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-02-12. Swing-timer addons drift around Slam and Flurry procs Nabuhodonozo · 2026-03-24. ### Lawnmower priority Without Bloodthirst: **Whirlwind > Slam**, with Heroic Strike or Cleave as the rage dump Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-02-14. On packs, open with **Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind** on the first GCD Blackjack · 2026-04-05. Trigger Sweeping Strikes off the Charge auto (or fund it with Bloodrage) while still in Battle Stance — the spell data allows it only there — then swap to Berserker Stance for Whirlwind, swapping back to Battle Stance to press it again if the trash is still alive about 30 s later Lipibidy · 2026-02-19, Guts · 2026-02-19. ### Dual Wield Fury priority 1. **Opener:** Charge → Sunder Armor → Bloodrage just before Bloodthirst, so you fit two Bloodthirsts into the Enrage window Velanir · 2025-10-21, Sylvaira · 2025-12-02. 2. **Execute** when the target is under 20%. DW is "the best way to execute" because two autos refill rage Kyrsie · 2026-01-24. Skip Heroic Strike during the Execute phase mark vasko · 2025-10-25. 3. **Bloodthirst** on cooldown. 4. **Whirlwind** on cooldown, even on one target Kyrsie · 2026-04-10. 5. **Heroic Strike** as the rage dump when capping. It is queued alongside other GCDs, never pressed "instead of" them Lipibidy · 2026-03-01, Wizzeh · 2026-02-09. 6. **Filler** when Bloodthirst and Whirlwind are down: **Master Strike > Pummel > Hamstring > Sunder Armor**. These fish for Windfury and Crusader procs; spamming only BT/WW/HS "gimps" DW DPS Don't ping me · 2025-10-20. Hamstring does not reset your own swing; it only fishes for Windfury Bitmap · 2026-04-12. 7. **Do not stance-dance for Overpower** as DW: "No, that's a waste" Soulafei · 2026-02-09. A single-source exception is fully buffed Kara40-level play with Windfury, where rage is no issue Theodore · 2026-02-28.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown: | Targets | Build | Priority | |---|---|---| | 2+ | 2H Fury / Lawnmower | Sweeping Strikes (Lawnmower) → **Whirlwind > Cleave > Bloodthirst/Slam** 30 · 2025-10-10, Blackjack · 2026-04-05 | | 2+ | DW Fury | Bloodthirst/Whirlwind on cooldown, **Cleave** as the rage dump instead of Heroic Strike (Ravager makes Cleave cheaper: "3 rage off cleave with improved whi...i mean ravager") Lipibidy · 2026-03-19, Don't ping me · 2026-03-20 | | 2+ | any | A slow main hand hits harder with Whirlwind; a fast one rage-starves you 30 · 2026-04-15 | | slow trash pace | Lawnmower | Sweeping Strikes gains value the longer the gap between pulls mark vasko · 2025-11-08, Guts · 2025-12-08 | - Whirlwind hits up to 4 targets (vanilla baseline). - Sweeping Strikes copies an Execute's damage only onto a second target that is also below 20% 30 · 2025-10-18. It does not proc off fully absorbed swings (open bug 17867) Donka · 2026-04-03 and cannot crit under Recklessness Kyrsie · 2026-01-13. - With the new T1 3-piece, Sweeping Strikes becomes "rage positive most of the time" evella · 2026-03-18. - **Execute on trash:** executing low mobs is worth it when pulls are slow, because rage decays anyway. Save rage when the next pack is coming right away 30 · 2025-11-23, 30 · 2025-11-23.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: - **Death Wish** (30 s): the only real damage cooldown for every warrior spec ("5 warriors enter a bar... they all use deathwish") Black Hat · 2026-03-21. For consistency, pop it in the last ~30 s of the fight or in the Execute phase Cannondorf · 2026-03-15. It can be used twice on long fights such as Chromaggus, Gothik, Four Horsemen, Loatheb and Kel'Thuzad mark vasko · 2025-10-25, 30 · 2025-10-04. It is a toggle and can get cancelled by accident Vlad · 2025-10-30. - **Recklessness**: there is "almost no wrong time"; use it on pull in DPS races Squid · 2025-10-25. It shares a **30-minute** cooldown with Shield Wall and Retaliation Gilnean · 2026-01-18. - **Bloodrage**: pull, and again into Execute on fights of 1:15 or longer. Enrage (+20% damage) stacks with Death Wish 30 · 2025-10-30. Bloodrage also self-dazes you ("sometimes you even daze yourself!!") and applies Gift of Arthas to you Stonehands · 2026-03-27, Dodging · 2026-03-27. - **Juju Flurry, Mighty Rage Potion and Bloodrage** are all off the GCD and fit in one macro; Death Wish is on the GCD Woogz · 2026-04-15. Mighty Rage Potion and Potion of Quickness share the 2-minute potion cooldown; Juju Flurry does not Woogz · 2026-04-15. - **Perception** (Human racial) belongs before the pull, not in the Execute phase, because it costs a GCD for about 2% crit evella · 2026-04-15. - **Time-to-kill macro** (TTK addon + SuperCleveRoidMacros): `/cast [type:boss ttk:<32&>27]Death Wish` Don't ping me · 2026-02-13. - **Improved Berserker Rage** breaks roots and most slows, including Kara40 curses, Noth's Cripple and Gothik's horse stomp Neurospicy · 2025-09-26, 30 · 2025-11-03. Do **not** use Berserker Rage in Sanv Tas'dal's add phase: it strips the debuff that protects you from Rift Feedback, and you get one-shot JohnGood · 2026-02-03.

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **MC:** cleave Sulfuron's pack Dodging · 2025-12-05. Keep the two "double golems" apart Dodging · 2025-10-06. - **BWL:** Sunder on the first GCD even when a paladin tanks Vael; one reviewed log had only 4 stacks after 44 s mark vasko · 2025-10-25. Melee wear the Onyxia Scale Cloak on Firemaw and Nefarian Dodging · 2025-10-28, Diabase · 2025-10-28. - **AQ40:** Viscidus needs Frost Oil or Coldrage Daggers, and Sappers are "BiS" there Virasan · 2025-10-22. Thunderfury's proc mostly loses value against the final bosses, which resist all damage types highly; AQ40 doesn't otherwise have widespread nature-resistant trash 30 · 2026-02-06, 30 · 2026-02-06. - **Naxx:** Death Wish twice on long fights 30 · 2025-10-04. On Anub'Rekhan, stand between the flanking guards so Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind hits the boss three times Velanir · 2026-03-09. On Kel'Thuzad phase 1, don't pop Death Wish and then die to the Abomination combo Thirtyseven · 2025-10-04. - **Kara40:** see [Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan). Kara40 needs 35+ raiders Lans · 2026-03-26. On Kruul, full-DPS Fury off-tanks were "disastrous", but "Rupturan, Sanv, and Mediv, you could easily do as Fury" Tole · 2026-04-16, Tole · 2026-04-16.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: There is no endorsed static BiS list. The item pool is large and custom, so sim your own gear Kyrsie · 2025-12-06, Minces · 2025-10-26. The **current 1.18.1 sim is jrc13245's** (`jrc13245.github.io/WarriorSim-TurtleWoW`); thrunk112's is the outdated 1.18 version Shardphoenix · 2026-04-15, Don't ping me · 2026-03-30. Classic pre-BiS lists do not carry over: "classic prebis is really not even close to prebis on Turtle" Dodging · 2025-12-14. ### Fresh 60 / pre-raid - **Priorities:** hit cap, then crit, Strength and AP Dodging · 2025-12-12. The only pre-raid item "worth stressing over" is **Blackhand's Breadth**. extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: A decision loop for a level-60 Fury warrior. The details are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps), [AoE rotation](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps), [Cooldowns](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps) and [Rage management](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps). 1. **Opener:** Charge → Sunder Armor on the first GCD → Bloodrage for Enrage Jerso · 2026-01-09. DW: press Bloodrage right before Bloodthirst so two Bloodthirsts fit in Enrage Velanir · 2025-10-21. 2. **Single-target loop:** - **2H (Bloodthirst):** Bloodthirst > Whirlwind on cooldown > Slam only with Flurry up and the cast landing before your next auto > Heroic Strike queued at about 70+ rage Bassilthorne/Achuak · 2026-03-23, ScoobertDoobert · 2026-04-03. See [2H priority](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps) and [How Slam works](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps). - **DW:** Execute under 20% > Bloodthirst > Whirlwind > Heroic Strike only when capping > filler Master Strike > Pummel > Hamstring > Sunder Armor Don't ping me · 2025-10-20. See [DW priority](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps). - **Lawnmower:** Whirlwind > Slam, with Heroic Strike or Cleave as the dump. See [Lawnmower priority](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps). 3. **Cooldowns:** - **Death Wish** in the last ~30 s or the Execute phase Cannondorf · 2026-03-15. - **Recklessness** on the pull in DPS races. It shares a 30-minute cooldown with Shield Wall and Retaliation. - **Bloodrage** on the pull, and again into Execute on long fights. - Mighty Rage Potion, Juju Flurry and Bloodrage are off the GCD. 4. **AoE switch (2+ targets):** - **Lawnmower:** Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind on the first GCD Blackjack · 2026-04-05. - **2H:** Whirlwind > Cleave > Bloodthirst / Slam. - **DW:** Bloodthirst / Whirlwind on cooldown, with Cleave instead of Heroic Strike. - Whirlwind hits up to 4 targets (vanilla baseline). 5. **Resource rule:** - Bank rage before 20% so one Execute can take the target from 20% to 0 Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. - Heroic Strike is a dump, never a choice over a skill Lipibidy · 2026-03-01. Skip it during the DW Execute phase. - A queued Heroic Strike unqueues below its cost. - Stance swaps keep at most 25 rage. 6. **Movement / situational:** - Slam can be cast while moving. - Whirlwind cannot clip your swing, so press it instead of Slam when the next auto is under about 1 s away. - Improved Berserker Rage breaks roots, but not in Sanv Tas'dal's add phase. - DW does not stance-dance for Overpower Soulafei · 2026-02-09.

extraSections.heading: What changed in 1.18.1
extraSections.markdown: - **Flurry and Slam:** 5/5 Flurry now cuts Slam's cast to **1.92 s** (2.5 / 1.3) instead of the bugged 1.75 s [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Czasku · 2026-03-24, 30 · 2026-03-31. On patch day Flurry stopped being consumed; that was hotfixed at the next restart Lhian · 2026-03-20, [Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608). 2H Fury lost some Slam speed but kept its damage: "its still the same thing you just benefit way less" roboclam · 2026-01-24, Guts · 2026-01-24. - **Improved Whirlwind is now Ravager:** it lowers Whirlwind's cooldown by 1/1.5/2 s and Cleave's rage cost by 1/2/3 [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). For DW this was "nothing really changed" Dodging · 2026-03-21, Yorb · 2026-03-20. - **Hamstring has no cooldown again**, so it works as spammable filler [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Kyrsie · 2026-04-11. - **Set bonuses:** T1 3-piece is now "Whenever you hit with an ability, 10% chance to gain 15 rage"; T3 4-piece is now "+4% critical strike damage bonus of your abilities" [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). The T3 change is worth roughly 40-50k damage per Naxx run roboclam · 2026-01-24. - **Mid-cycle (January 2026):** Sweeping Strikes no longer double-dips damage modifiers. It now hits the second target for 20% of the damage and cannot crit casey · 2026-01-22, limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2026-03-23. Stance swapping no longer procs Windfury Totem Jakeends · 2026-01-21. - **Enrage is a baseline cooldown for everyone:** Bloodrage's self-damage counts as a crit, so it procs Enrage, and warriors share a 1-minute Enrage cycle Kyrsie · 2026-03-29, Lipibidy · 2026-04-06.

extraSections.heading: Rage management
extraSections.markdown: - Rage comes from damage dealt plus a term for the weapon's **base** swing time: per hit `(dmg*7.5/230.6)/1.075 + (base_swing_timer*3.5)/2.25`, with 7.5 in place of 3.5 on a crit 30 · 2026-04-17. - Heroic Strike replaces your auto, and that swing generates no rage. Slam is a separate attack, so the next auto still gives rage Fyzix · 2026-02-22, Breaddy · 2026-02-18. - A queued Heroic Strike now **unqueues** the moment your rage drops below its cost. Bind it to the mouse wheel so you can re-queue it constantly eric4225 · 2025-11-26, 30 · 2025-11-27. - Heroic Strike still guarantees the main hand cannot miss or glance, but no longer the off hand 30 · 2026-04-17. - Stance swaps keep at most 25 rage (with Tactical Mastery) Lans · 2026-02-15, Lipibidy · 2026-02-13.

glance.recommendation: Fury is the warrior raid DPS tree in 1.18.1, and it comes in three shapes. **2H Fury (20/31/0)** is the top overall-damage build once you have raid gear and roughly 30% crit: Bloodthirst and Whirlwind on cooldown, **Slam** woven between swings whenever Flurry is up. **Lawnmower (21/30/0)** is the same build with Sweeping Strikes instead of Bloodthirst, for trash- and cleave-heavy raids such as Kara40. **Dual Wield Fury (17/34/0)** has no cast bar, forgives mistakes, has the best Execute phase and holds server records. Its weakness is gear: it needs two good one-handers and weapon skill for both. None of the three is a fresh-60 spec. If you have under about 23% unbuffed crit, play [Arms](#/class/warrior/arms-melee-dps) first.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Melee DPS; Sunder Armor, Battle/Demoralizing Shout, Disarm, off-tanking on demand

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **S (raid).** 2H Fury "still leads DW Fury and Arms on most fights" Lipibidy · 2026-04-03; "2h fury, 2h fury with sweeping strikes instead of Bloodthirst and dual wield fury are the meta dps specs" Velanir · 2026-03-15

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: 2H: high (swing-timer management for Slam). DW: medium (no cast, three buttons plus fillers)

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Three big damage steroids (Enrage, Death Wish, Flurry) Lipibidy · 2026-03-02; strong cleave; DW can off-tank or tank in DPS gear Velanir · 2026-02-08

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Flurry needs crit, so both builds feel bad in fresh-60 gear Shardphoenix · 2026-04-13; 2H is rage-starved on trash without Windfury 30 · 2025-10-08; DW is bottlenecked on weapons and weapon skill

glance.rest: **2H or DW? (contested).** At equal gear and skill 2H Fury comes out ahead, but skill decides it at the margin: "dual wield is close behind or better in single target" Kyrsie · 2026-01-13, Kyrsie · 2026-01-13, Guts · 2026-01-05. After the patch 2H is "ahead of dw fury" Lipibidy · 2026-03-26, and the trash gap between the two "isn't a massive gap" Lipibidy · 2026-04-01. Against that, a DW warrior (Lashara) set consecutive Grobbulus DPS records with no Champion buff in April 2026, and the channel reposted it as proof that DW is "batshit broken" Blackjack · 2026-04-18. Before Bonereaver's Edge drops, DW often wins because it has far more usable weapons eric4225 · 2026-02-05. Pick by the weapons you own.

playbooks.title: Warrior PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** warrior is widely rated the **weakest PvP class on Turtle** in 1.18.1, unless you have top Kara40 gear or a healer casey · 2026-04-01, Kyrsie · 2026-04-03. Pick a spec by how you queue: Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). - **Solo and unorganized battlegrounds: Dual Wield Fury with Blood Drinker.** It "gobble[s] a lot of free 1v1s in unorganized play off of blood drinkers back" Hayden · 2026-04-05, and Blood Drinker heals from Thunderfury, trinket and ring procs too Thirtyseven · 2026-02-24. - **Mobility-focused: 2H Fury with Improved Berserker Rage.** A root break every 30 s "makes Fury the best pvp spec atm... especially vs mages" Czasku · 2026-03-24. - **Organized premades: Arms (Mortal Strike),** "only better vs a team that demands mortal strike" Kyrsie · 2026-04-12. Protection is not a PvP spec Thirtyseven · 2026-04-18. **Contested:** Ionnatra argues much of the weakness is player knowledge, since "it is just a lot about knowing your class" and warriors "beat Shaman, Warlock, Druid, Priest pretty easily" with cooldowns Ionnatra · 2026-04-17, Ionnatra · 2026-04-01. Most regulars disagree: "warrior has never been in a weaker state in pvp than on turtle wow" casey · 2026-04-01. Before the patch, a tier list in #pvp-general put warrior alone in F tier Thirtyseven · 2025-10-11. A healer helps warriors most, because it "lets the war actually be in the middle of stuff disrupting without dieing instantly" Bipst · 2025-10-20; Kyrsie calls that "not powerhouse, just usable" Kyrsie · 2025-10-20.

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Weapon skill does nothing against players.** Weapon skill is normalized to level in PvP, and glancing blows don't apply 30 · 2026-02-19, Lipibidy · 2026-02-19, Black Hat · 2025-11-23. 5% hit is enough against players without defense skill Kyrsie · 2026-01-28, but some opponents wear defense tank gear in PvP, so a little extra hit helps Kyrsie · 2026-01-28. - **Health:** a warrior "needs 6.5k+ hp to be useful in a bg" Thirtyseven · 2026-01-26. Warrior avoidance tops out around 30% Thirtyseven · 2026-02-20. - **Armor:** you deal about 40% less damage even to a cloth wearer, more against plate Thirtyseven · 2026-02-19. Bleeds ignore armor, so Rend is worth putting on tanks Kyrsie · 2026-01-15. - **Gear sets:** "BiS pvp warr uses 3 set t3.5, 3 set marshal and 3 set dps t3" Thirtyseven · 2026-02-17. One full list: T3.5 helm/shoulder/chest/legs, Marshal gloves and boots, T3 tank bracers and ring, Sadist Collar, Cloak of the Scourge, T3 DPS ring, Raka'Sishi, Slayer's/Sliver, Insignia Thirtyseven · 2026-01-15. - **PvP honor gear costs** in 1.18.1: T1 24,000 honor, T2 144,000, T3 520,000 plus 21,000 Conquest, with a 20k-per-week cap ("8+ months") Thirtyseven · 2026-04-11. The PvP cloak has more stamina than any other cloak Kyrsie · 2026-04-11. The PvP set 3-piece shortens Intercept's cooldown by 5 s Thirtyseven · 2026-03-02. Ranks do not decay. Under the pre-1.18.1 system R13 took about 2 months (2026-01) Thirtyseven · 2026-01-04; for the 1.18.1 currency honor and its 20k weekly cap see [PvP systems](#/pvp). - **Weapons:** - **Raka'Sishi** is "the current PvP 2h bis wep" Thirtyseven · 2026-01-24. - Kyrsie's pick is Thunderfall + Thunderfury for DW Kyrsie · 2026-01-24. - Slow two-handers plus Mortal Strike for Arms Lisin · 2026-01-01. - **Trinkets:** Shieldrender Talisman is the PvP damage trinket Coxy · 2026-02-17, 30 · 2026-04-15. A warrior can carry the Kara40 trinket, 2× Zanza and 2 reflectors that don't share a cooldown, for example a physical reflector against Cheap Shot, Charge and Intercept dindunuffinz · 2025-10-29. - **Enchants:** Weapon Chain on either hand makes you immune to Disarm (Disarm always hits the main hand) Kyrsie · 2025-12-06. The only other anti-disarm option is gloves Piemelbrie / siswet · 2026-04-12.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control
rotationSingle.markdown: - **Opener (Arms/2H):** Charge → auto-attack → Slam + Mortal Strike Bitmap · 2026-04-21. - **Execute kill:** once a target is under 20%, Bloodrage + Death Wish and one Execute ends it Ionnatra · 2026-04-06. - **Stuns share diminishing returns:** you can't Charge and then Intercept within 5 s, "or your enemy is just immune" Thirtyseven · 2026-01-26. Intercept shares its cooldown with Intervene Donka · 2026-01-26. When you are slowed, Intercept can travel slowly and end yards away from the target casey · 2026-01-21. - **Pummel and Shield Bash** share a cooldown, so swapping to a shield for Shield Bash doesn't give you a second interrupt jsl · 2025-12-28. - **Shield Wall** needs a shield. Unequipping the shield to swap to a two-hander loses the buff Kyrsie · 2026-01-13. It shares a cooldown with Recklessness Gilnean · 2026-01-18. - **Retaliation** now also procs off dodges Spiff · 2025-10-26. - **Sunder stacking** is unrealistic in later-phase PvP; frontload damage instead Kyrsie · 2026-04-03. Train Sunder Armor's max rank, because lower ranks can block stacking Jesse Potter · 2025-10-30.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: A decision loop for level-60 PvP. The details are in [Burst and control](#/class/warrior/arms-pvp), [Target priority](#/class/warrior/arms-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/warrior/arms-pvp). 1. **Before the fight:** - Pick a low-armor target first Ionnatra · 2026-04-03. - Stay in Charge range, and keep Bloodrage going through a stance swap so you can Intercept Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. - **2H Fury:** start fights in Berserker Stance only while Berserker Rage is ready; when it is on cooldown, stay in Battle Stance Kyrsie · 2026-01-13. 2. **Opener:** - **Arms/2H:** Charge → auto-attack → Slam + Mortal Strike Bitmap · 2026-04-21. - **DW Fury:** Charge → Hamstring → Bloodthirst / Whirlwind (vanilla baseline). 3. **Loop:** 1. Keep Hamstring up; it has no cooldown in 1.18.1. 2. Mortal Strike or Bloodthirst on cooldown (6 s). 3. Whirlwind. 4. Rend on plate targets, because bleeds ignore armor Kyrsie · 2026-01-15. 5. Don't try to stack Sunder Kyrsie · 2026-04-03. 4. **Kill:** once the target is under 20%, Bloodrage + Death Wish and Execute Ionnatra · 2026-04-06. 5. **Control:** - Charge and Intercept share stun diminishing returns: don't Intercept within 5 s of a Charge Thirtyseven · 2026-01-26. Intercept (30 s) shares its cooldown with Intervene Donka · 2026-01-26. - Pummel and Shield Bash share a cooldown jsl · 2025-12-28. Pummel casters and healers STORMGUARD · 2024-12-26. - Piercing Howl on groups; Disarm (60 s) melee. Weapon Chain on either hand makes a target immune to Disarm Kyrsie · 2025-12-06. - Deep Wounds ticks break your own Intimidating Shout Blackjack · 2026-01-27. 6. **Survive / escape:** - Berserker Rage (30 s) breaks fear (vanilla baseline); Improved Berserker Rage also breaks roots Czasku · 2026-03-24. Death Wish lets Fury push through Fear in any stance Spiff · 2025-10-27. - **Arms** has no root break: carry Free Action Potions Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. - Retaliation, which also procs off dodges Spiff · 2025-10-26. Shield Wall only with a shield equipped; it shares a cooldown with Recklessness Gilnean · 2026-01-18. - Against casters, a physical or spell reflector trinket and Zanza's; expect a Lesser Invulnerability Potion when you Charge dindunuffinz · 2025-10-29, betcover · 2025-10-29. 7. **Target priority:** hunt rogues and make kamikaze pushes on healers while your team works Dodging · 2026-04-03. Ignore bears and plate as long as you can. Intervene a healer under pressure; with a healer behind you, stay in melee Bipst · 2025-10-20. 8. **Reset:** out of cooldowns and losing, Fear + bandage, then kite dindunuffinz · 2025-12-13. Don't facetank a melee specialist. **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/warrior/arms-pvp)): - **Shaman / Paladin:** your weakest matchups Thirtyseven · 2025-12-29. Disarm Enhancement; Berserker Rage breaks Repentance dindunuffinz · 2025-10-31. - **Rogue:** stunlocks beat you; Arms Overpower helps Kyrsie · 2025-11-04. - **Hunter:** Intercept + Disarm together, then Piercing Howl; reflect the opener's Explosive Trap Spiff · 2025-10-20, Spiff · 2025-10-20. - **Priest:** they bait Berserker Rage with Fear and then Net you Spiff · 2025-10-27. - **Mage:** save the Improved Berserker Rage root break for their roots Czasku · 2026-03-24. - **Warlock:** your strongest matchup Thirtyseven · 2025-12-29.

extraSections.heading: What changed for PvP in 1.18.1
extraSections.markdown: - **Hamstring has no cooldown.** It had 6 s from Class Changes 2 until the patch, including a brief February reinstatement Donka · 2026-02-24, [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Combined with Blood Drinker it turns kiting into self-healing, "a health potion every single enrage proc" Hayden · 2026-03-20, Hayden · 2026-03-20. - **No warrior-specific dampening** arrived with the patch limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2026-03-23, casey · 2026-03-22. After the April dampening pass, warrior Donka noticed white hits looked nearly undampened ("5% tops?"), and Kyrsie added that "warriors are definitely a little better now since everyone else does less damage overall" Donka · 2026-04-05, Kyrsie · 2026-04-08. - **Sweeping Strikes** can no longer crit, and its extra hits now deal 20% of the damage limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2026-03-23, casey · 2026-01-22. - **Racials and talents:** Orc Hardiness and Iron Will now reduce stun duration by 15% instead of giving a chance to resist stuns Ionnatra · 2026-04-01, Velanir · 2026-03-14. Improved Intervene is now "Wrecking Ball": 50/100% chance to become immune to movement-impairing effects for 3 s after Charge, Intervene or Intercept Kyrsie · 2026-03-14. - **Shieldrender Talisman** was reworked, first to a stacking buff that one Whirlwind would consume Delf · 2026-02-15, then to a flat ~1.5 PPM that can proc from abilities. It favors two-handers ("1.5-2x uptime for 2h") 30 · 2026-04-15, 30 · 2026-04-15.

extraSections.heading: Target priority and battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **Priority:** ignore bears and plate targets as long as you can, and kill low-armor classes before you get crowd-controlled Ionnatra · 2026-04-03. Dodging adds: "Ignore all druids, priests, mages and most warlocks as well" Dodging · 2026-04-03. - **Flag carrying:** Pastor argued a Protection warrior can do well carrying flags; Spiff disagrees: "a lot of nearly pointless talents to be a mediocre fc that fury can do better" Pastor · 2025-10-08, Spiff · 2025-10-29. Deep Prot with Thunderfury is playable "but its meme" Velanir · 2026-04-18. - **Warsong Gulch:** Berserker Stance (+10%) and the WSG "zerker" buff (+10%) add up to about 20% extra damage taken Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07. - **Server:** Kyrsie recommends Ambershire for PvP "until all raids release" Kyrsie · 2026-02-14.

extraSections.heading: Leveling brackets
extraSections.markdown: - **Core skills:** zone for Charge range, stance-dance, keep Bloodrage up through a stance swap so you can Intercept, break roots with Berserker Rage, Disarm, Intervene to peel for healers, and use instant Battle Stance + Charge out of combat. Ionnatra recommends 2H or DW Fury for PvP leveling Ionnatra · 2026-04-17, Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. - **Twinks:** the 20s/30s/40s brackets are "completely dead" on some realms Lans · 2026-04-06.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - `/cast [nocombat] Charge` + `/cast [combat] Intercept` Velanir · 2026-03-13. - A stance-dancing Charge/Intercept macro that keeps the right icon (SuperCleveRoidMacros): ``` #showtooltip /cast [combat nomybuff]Berserker Stance;[nomybuff]Battle Stance /cast [combat stance:3]Intercept;[stance:1]Charge ``` Don't ping me · 2026-02-18 - `/cast Charge` + `/cast Hamstring` on one button works, because the client picks whichever is in range Hayden · 2026-03-25. - Berserker Rage without spending a GCD on the stance swap: `/cast [nostance:3] Berserker Stance; Berserker Rage` Purple Haze · 2026-04-08.

standing.notes: The class's PvP spec because of Mortal Strike. Standing is the single most argued topic in the Warrior forum and splits on one axis - support: worthless solo, 'strongest class in PvP if they get supported well'. All Hamstring-cooldown-era advice (2024-11 to 2026-03-19) is obsolete and nobody re-evaluated PvP after the cooldown was removed.

glance.recommendation: Warrior is widely rated the **weakest PvP class on Turtle** in 1.18.1, unless you have top Kara40 gear or a healer casey · 2026-04-01, Kyrsie · 2026-04-03. Pick a spec by how you queue:
glance.rest: Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). - **Solo and unorganized battlegrounds: Dual Wield Fury with Blood Drinker.** It "gobble[s] a lot of free 1v1s in unorganized play off of blood drinkers back" Hayden · 2026-04-05, and Blood Drinker heals from Thunderfury, trinket and ring procs too Thirtyseven · 2026-02-24. - **Mobility-focused: 2H Fury with Improved Berserker Rage.** A root break every 30 s "makes Fury the best pvp spec atm... especially vs mages" Czasku · 2026-03-24. - **Organized premades: Arms (Mortal Strike),** "only better vs a team that demands mortal strike" Kyrsie · 2026-04-12. Protection is not a PvP spec Thirtyseven · 2026-04-18. **Contested:** Ionnatra argues much of the weakness is player knowledge, since "it is just a lot about knowing your class" and warriors "beat Shaman, Warlock, Druid, Priest pretty easily" with cooldowns Ionnatra · 2026-04-17, Ionnatra · 2026-04-01. Most regulars disagree: "warrior has never been in a weaker state in pvp than on turtle wow" casey · 2026-04-01. Before the patch, a tier list in #pvp-general put warrior alone in F tier Thirtyseven · 2025-10-11. A healer helps warriors most, because it "lets the war actually be in the middle of stuff disrupting without dieing instantly" Bipst · 2025-10-20; Kyrsie calls that "not powerhouse, just usable" Kyrsie · 2025-10-20.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level **Fury**. Take Cruelty first and use a two-hander early. Pick up the off-hand hit talent and go **dual wield with Blood Drinker at level 35**; from there you rarely need to eat Hayden · 2026-03-20, Very smart · 2026-03-20, Hayden · 2026-04-15. The same Fury build tanks leveling dungeons with a shield swapped in: "you will have a better time tanking while leveling as full fury" Hayden · 2026-03-21. If you mostly run dungeons as DPS, level **Arms with a slow two-hander** casey · 2026-03-24. If you want to tank, take Tactical Mastery and Improved Thunder Clap early, and go **Protection only once Shield Slam is available at 30** casey · 2026-04-01, Jakeends · 2026-03-24. sections.markdown: What to press in each bracket, for the recommended **DW Fury** route and the **Arms (no respec)** route, plus how to **tank dungeons** at that level. Learn levels, rage costs and cooldowns are from the 1.18.1 game data. Talent unlocks follow the two talent-order tables above. Stances: **Battle** has Charge, Overpower, Mocking Blow, Retaliation and Sweeping Strikes. **Defensive** has Taunt, Revenge, Shield Block, Disarm, Shield Wall and Intervene. **Berserker** has Whirlwind, Intercept, Berserker Rage and Recklessness. Sunder Armor, Shield Slam, Bloodthirst, Mortal Strike, Demoralizing Shout and the shouts work in any stance (vanilla baseline), and on Turtle, unlike vanilla, Thunder Clap also works in Defensive as well as Battle Koae · 2025-12-18. **Rage through a stance swap:** without Tactical Mastery a swap costs you your rage (vanilla baseline). With 5/5 you keep up to 25 Lipibidy · 2026-02-13. The Arms route has 5/5 by 24; the Fury route only gets it at 44–48. Until then, Fury should pick one stance per pull. ### Levels 1–9 - **New now:** L1 Battle Shout (10 rage); L4 Charge (8–25 yd, generates rage, 15 s cooldown) and Rend Rank 1 (9 s bleed); L6 Thunder Clap Rank 1 (20 rage, 4 s cooldown); L8 Hamstring Rank 1 (10 rage, no cooldown) and Heroic Strike Rank 2. No talents yet. - **Single target** (both routes; use a cheap vendor two-hander Necesito_Nikotino · 2026-02-09): 1. Battle Shout before the pull Virasan · 2026-02-26. 2. Charge an isolated mob. Pull dense groups with a thrown or ranged weapon instead Virasan · 2026-02-26. 3. Rend, but only on a mob that will live for the full bleed casey · 2026-01-02. 4. Auto-attack. Heroic Strike only if rage would cap 30 · 2025-10-29; its swing makes no rage Breaddy · 2026-02-18. 5. Hamstring a mob that runs (vanilla baseline). - **Resources:** keep some rage for the next pull Virasan · 2026-02-26. Fight green mobs, one at a time, and bandage instead of eating where you can VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-09. - **Multi-target:** avoid it. If a second mob joins, Thunder Clap once to slow both and kill one (vanilla baseline). - **Tanking:** none yet. Defensive Stance, Sunder Armor and Taunt come from the level-10 quest. ### Levels 10–19 - **New now:** L10 Defensive Stance, Sunder Armor Rank 1 and Taunt (quest: "don't skip that quest" Lipibidy · 2025-11-21); L10 Bloodrage (60 s cooldown) and Rend Rank 2; L12 Overpower Rank 1 (5 rage, after a dodge), Shield Bash Rank 1 and Battle Shout Rank 2; L14 Demoralizing Shout Rank 1 and Revenge Rank 1 (5 rage, 6 s cooldown); L16 Mocking Blow Rank 1 (10 rage, 120 s cooldown), Shield Block (10 rage, 5 s) and Heroic Strike Rank 3; L18 Disarm (20 rage, 60 s cooldown) and Thunder Clap Rank 2. **Talents:** Cruelty 10–14 on both routes. Then Dual Wield Specialization 15–19 (Fury; Unbridled Wrath while still on a two-hander), or Improved Rend and 3/5 Tactical Mastery 15–19 (Arms). - **Single target** (both routes, Battle Stance): 1. Battle Shout up → Charge (or thrown pull). 2. Demoralizing Shout on the first GCD from 14; mobs deal about 25% less damage casey · 2026-04-15. 3. Sunder Armor: one on a normal mob. Stack toward 5 only while the mob is above 50% HP Dodging · 2026-03-19, Virasan · 2026-02-26. 4. Overpower whenever the target dodges. It is "your only weaponskill button for a long time" Lipibidy · 2026-02-04. 5. Rend on long fights; Heroic Strike only near the rage cap. 6. Bloodrage on the pull for rage (vanilla baseline). - **Multi-target:** still one mob at a time. On an accidental add: Demoralizing Shout → Thunder Clap → focus one mob; Hamstring a runner. - **Tanking (Deadmines, Wailing Caverns, Shadowfang Keep):** - **Setup:** a two-hander is fine. Keep a shield and a one-hander in your bags on a swap macro for bosses that hit hard eric4225 · 2026-02-19, Dodging · 2026-03-25. Be at least the final boss's level Jerso · 2026-01-09. Expect to run out of rage while shield-tanking this early Crummy · 2026-03-12. - **Pull:** line-of-sight or ranged pull → Bloodrage → Demoralizing Shout → tab-Sunder across the pack. Thunder Clap only if you already have spare rage Virasan · 2026-02-26. Charge variant: Charge → switch to Defensive Stance mid-Charge → Demoralizing Shout → Thunder Clap → tab-Sunder Aubreykun · 2025-12-04. - **Single-target threat:** Sunder Armor is your rage-efficient filler and Heroic Strike your rage dump Black Hat · 2026-02-22. Revenge whenever it lights up (Defensive Stance). At this level it hits for almost nothing Flauschi/dewoy · 2026-02-26, but it only costs 5 rage. - **Packs:** mark skull > cross > square VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-08. Your job is to keep the healer alive, not to hold every mob Aubreykun · 2025-12-04. - **Taunt / recovery:** Taunt (Defensive Stance, 5 yd, 10 s cooldown) the mob on the healer. It can fail on a crowd-controlled mob MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-10-23. From 16, Mocking Blow (Battle Stance, 120 s cooldown) is your backup. - **Defensives:** Shield Block with a shield on (16); Disarm a hard-hitting melee boss (18, Defensive Stance). ### Levels 20–29 - **New now:** L20 Cleave Rank 1 (20 rage, on next swing), Intimidating Shout, Retaliation (Battle Stance) and Rend Rank 3; L22 Sunder Armor Rank 2 and Battle Shout Rank 3; L24 Execute Rank 1 (15 rage, target under 20%), Demoralizing Shout Rank 2, Revenge Rank 2 and Heroic Strike Rank 4; L26 Challenging Shout (5 rage, 10 min cooldown), Charge Rank 2 and Mocking Blow Rank 2; L28 Shield Wall (Defensive Stance, needs a shield), Overpower Rank 2 and Thunder Clap Rank 3. **Talents:** Fury gets Improved Shouts 20–24, then Enrage 25–29. Arms gets Improved Thunder Clap 1/3 (20), Improved Charge (21–22), Tactical Mastery 5/5 (23–24), Improved Overpower (25–26) and Deep Wounds (27–29). - **Single target:** 1. Battle Shout → Charge → Demoralizing Shout → Sunder Armor (rules above). 2. **Fury, from 25:** Bloodrage while you are above about 75% HP, so its self-damage procs Enrage Foreseen · 2026-03-22. 3. Overpower on every dodge (Arms: stronger with Improved Overpower). 4. Execute below 20%. 5. Heroic Strike only to dump rage near the cap. - **Multi-target:** still mostly single pulls. With two mobs, use Cleave instead of Heroic Strike as the dump. Retaliation (30 min cooldown, shared with Shield Wall and Recklessness Gilnean · 2026-01-18) or Intimidating Shout when a pull goes wrong (vanilla baseline). - **Tanking (Blackfathom Deeps and the other 20s dungeons):** - **Arms route:** by 24 you have Tactical Mastery 5/5 and Improved Thunder Clap, the leveling tank kit: "5/5 tact mastery into 3/3 imp tclap" Velanir · 2026-02-26. Thunder Clap works in Defensive Stance and is "very solid aoe threat while leveling" worlds #1 ppm expert · 2025-10-03. - **Stance dance (Arms):** Charge in Battle Stance → Defensive Stance for Demoralizing Shout, Thunder Clap, Sunder, Revenge, Taunt and Shield Block → back to Battle Stance for an Overpower or Mocking Blow. Each swap keeps up to 25 rage. - **Fury route:** no Tactical Mastery, so stay in Defensive Stance for the whole pull and bank rage from the previous pull (vanilla baseline). - **Pack loop:** Thunder Clap first, then tab through the mobs with Sunder, and Cleave when rage is high; expect to chase some with Taunt Jakeends · 2026-01-29. - **Emergency:** Challenging Shout (26) when a pack runs to the healer. AoE tanking gets hard while it is on cooldown Ascuz · 2026-02-16. Shield Wall (28) on a boss that is killing you. ### Levels 30–39 - **New now:** L30 Berserker Stance and Intercept Rank 1 (quest; Berserker Stance, 10 rage, 30 s cooldown), Cleave Rank 2 and Rend Rank 4; L32 Berserker Rage (30 s cooldown), Execute Rank 2, Hamstring Rank 2, Heroic Strike Rank 5, Shield Bash Rank 2 and Battle Shout Rank 4; L34 Sunder Armor Rank 3, Demoralizing Shout Rank 3 and Revenge Rank 3; L36 **Whirlwind** (Berserker Stance, 25 rage, 10 s cooldown) and Mocking Blow Rank 3; L38 Pummel (10 rage, 10 s cooldown), Thunder Clap Rank 4 and Shield Slam Rank 2. **Talents:** - **Fury:** Death Wish (30; 10 rage, 3 min cooldown), Blood Craze (31–33), Piercing Howl (34; 10 rage), Blood Drinker (35: start dual wielding), Flurry (36–39). - **Arms:** Two-Handed Weapon Specialization (30–32), Impale (33–34), **Sweeping Strikes** (35; Battle Stance, 20 rage, 30 s cooldown), Master Strike (36; 20 rage, 30 s cooldown), Master of Arms (37–41). - **Protection** (only if you respec for tanking): **Shield Slam** at 30 (20 rage, 6 s cooldown) Velanir · 2026-04-14. - **Single target, DW Fury:** 1. Battle Shout → Charge (or thrown pull) → Demoralizing Shout → one Sunder Armor. 2. Bloodrage above 75% HP for Enrage. 3. From 36, **Whirlwind** on cooldown in Berserker Stance casey · 2026-03-19. 4. Execute below 20%. 5. Heroic Strike as the dump; if the mob lives long, Sunder instead casey · 2026-03-19. 6. Hamstring as filler. With no cooldown, Hamstring-kiting while Blood Drinker heals works Hayden · 2026-03-20. 7. Death Wish on an elite or a dangerous pull. - **Single target, Arms:** 1. Same opener. 2. Overpower on every dodge. 3. Master Strike on cooldown (36+). 4. Whirlwind on cooldown (Berserker Stance, 36+). 5. Execute below 20%. 6. Heroic Strike dump. Skip Slam before about 36, and cast it right after a two-hander swing Istrefi · 2026-04-17. - **Multi-target:** from about 30, pull 2+ green mobs for better experience per hour ugoboom · 2022-10-24. Once you have Whirlwind and Cleave, pull 2–3; Sweeping Strikes makes it easier VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-01-26. 1. Demoralizing Shout. 2. **Arms:** Sweeping Strikes in Battle Stance → swap to Berserker Stance → Whirlwind. Then Cleave as the dump. 3. **Fury:** Whirlwind on cooldown, Cleave as the dump. Piercing Howl slows a runner. 4. Don't pull more than you can Demoralizing-Shout and Whirlwind down. Retaliation is the panic button. - **Tanking (Scarlet Monastery, Razorfen Downs, Gilneas City):** - **Arms/Fury with a shield or a two-hander:** open with Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind, the best AoE threat opener at this level casey · 2026-04-09, Blackjack · 2026-04-05. Then go back to Defensive Stance, tab-Sunder, Cleave and Thunder Clap when rage allows, and Taunt stragglers as their threat runs out Fhakin · 2025-09-19. Use all three stances: Battle and Defensive for threat, mitigation and taunts, a short Berserker swap for Whirlwind, and keep Mocking Blow on your bars Cannondorf · 2026-03-16, Cannondorf · 2026-03-16. - **Fury without Tactical Mastery:** pool rage in Defensive Stance from the previous pull, spend it on Thunder Clap, Cleave and Sunder down to about 25, then make one stance swap for Whirlwind bhop · 2025-04-25. - **Protection from 30:** play Shield Slam on cooldown > Revenge when lit > Sunder Armor > Heroic Strike dump, in Defensive Stance with a shield. "From 30 on you can level as prot, less killing speed ofc but basically zero downtime" Black Hat · 2025-11-02. While leveling, stay in Defensive Stance with Taunt + Revenge rather than chasing Defensive Tactics Lans · 2026-01-28. "39 is high enough for prot leveling/tanking to be good" Lipibidy · 2026-03-21. - **Interrupts:** Shield Bash (shield) or Pummel (38) on casters; they share a cooldown jsl · 2025-12-28. ### Levels 40–49 - **New now:** L40 **Bloodthirst** (Fury talent; 30 rage, 6 s cooldown), **Concussion Blow** (Protection talent; 20 s cooldown, generates rage Lans · 2026-01-13), Execute Rank 3, Cleave Rank 3, Heroic Strike Rank 6 and Rend Rank 5; L42 Battle Shout Rank 5 and Intercept Rank 2; L44 Overpower Rank 3, Revenge Rank 4 and Demoralizing Shout Rank 4; L46 Shield Slam Rank 3, Sunder Armor Rank 4, Charge Rank 3 and Mocking Blow Rank 4; L48 Bloodthirst Rank 2, Mortal Strike Rank 2, Concussion Blow Rank 2, Execute Rank 4, Heroic Strike Rank 7 and Thunder Clap Rank 5. **Talents:** - **Fury:** Flurry 5/5 (41), Improved Berserker Rage (42–43), then **Tactical Mastery 44–48**. Stance swaps now keep rage. - **Arms:** Master of Arms 5/5 (41), Improved Slam (42–43), Improved Thunder Clap 2/3 (44), **Mortal Strike at 45** (30 rage, 6 s cooldown), then Unbridled Wrath (46–50). - **Single target, DW Fury:** 1. Opener as above. 2. **Bloodthirst > Whirlwind** on cooldown casey · 2026-03-19. 3. Execute below 20%. 4. Heroic Strike only when capping; it is a dump, never a choice over a skill Lipibidy · 2026-03-01. 5. Hamstring or Sunder Armor as filler. 6. Bloodrage (Enrage) and Death Wish for elites. - **Single target, Arms:** 1. Opener as above. 2. Mortal Strike on cooldown (45+). 3. Whirlwind. 4. Overpower (a Battle Stance swap now keeps 25 rage). 5. Master Strike. 6. Slam right after a swing, if trained (see the note below the brackets). 7. Execute below 20%. - **Multi-target:** pull 2–3 as before. Fury: Whirlwind > Bloodthirst, Cleave as the dump. Arms: Sweeping Strikes → Whirlwind → Mortal Strike → Cleave. - **Tanking (Zul'Farrak, Maraudon, Hateforge Quarry):** - **Two-hander tanking gets harder here.** "You can tank in 2h fury easilly untill about 45 lvl" VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-09. Past 40, one player found an Arms shield tank took too much damage and respecced Prot Xeraz · 2025-10-20. - **Protection pug-tank trash order:** mark skull → Charge → Demoralizing Shout → Thunder Clap → Concussion Blow → Shield Slam → Sunders, with Overpower on procs. Stay mostly in Battle Stance on trash, and switch to Defensive Stance on bosses for Revenge and less damage Raphael · 2025-08-28. - **AoE priority on a pack:** Whirlwind > Thunder Clap > Concussion Blow > Shield Slam, Heroic Strike with extra rage, and switch targets as needed casey · 2025-12-14. - **Fury tank:** Bloodthirst is now your best single-target threat. With Tactical Mastery from 44, you can stance-dance like Arms. ### Levels 50–60 - **New now:** - L50: Recklessness (Berserker Stance, 30 min cooldown shared with Shield Wall and Retaliation), Intervene Rank 1 (item-taught; Defensive Stance, 10 rage, 30 s cooldown, 8–25 yd), Cleave Rank 4, Rend Rank 6. - L52: Intercept Rank 3, Shield Bash Rank 3, Battle Shout Rank 6. - L54: Bloodthirst Rank 3, Mortal Strike Rank 3, Shield Slam Rank 4, Concussion Blow Rank 3, Revenge Rank 5, Demoralizing Shout Rank 5, Hamstring Rank 3. - L56: Execute Rank 5, Heroic Strike Rank 8, Mocking Blow Rank 5. - L58: Sunder Armor Rank 5, Thunder Clap Rank 6. - L60: Bloodthirst Rank 4, Mortal Strike Rank 4, Concussion Blow Rank 4, Overpower Rank 4, Cleave Rank 5, Rend Rank 7; item-taught Battle Shout Rank 7, Heroic Strike Rank 9, Revenge Rank 6. - **Talents:** Fury takes the Arms dip (Improved Rend, Improved Heroic Strike, Deep Wounds, Improved Charge, Impale). Arms takes Improved Shouts (51–55), then Enrage (56–60). - **Single target / multi-target:** same loops as 40–49. From 50, add Recklessness on a dangerous elite or pull (30 min cooldown, shared with Shield Wall and Retaliation). - **Tanking (Black Morass, Stratholme, Scholomance, UBRS):** - **When to switch:** go full Protection for dungeon-spam and pre-raid ("swap at 55 or so"), then finish leveling through dungeons and attunements Black Hat · 2025-10-06. - **Loop:** same as 40–49, with Concussion Blow or Shield Slam as the opener. - **Utility:** Intervene (50) to peel for a healer Ionnatra · 2026-04-17. - **At 60:** pick a raid tank build and follow [Protection → How to play](#/class/warrior/protection-tank). **Contested: Slam learn level.** The 1.18.1 game data lists every Slam rank (50% → 100% weapon damage) at trainer level 54. A player post gives Rank 2 at 24, Rank 3 at 34, Rank 4 at 44 and Rank 5 at 54 Blackjack · 2026-04-08. Check your trainer. Either way, Slam is not part of the leveling loop before about 36.

sections.heading: Going Protection while leveling
sections.markdown: - Nothing useful sits in the Protection tree before Shield Slam, so don't spec it before level 30 Jakeends · 2026-03-24, Dodging · 2026-03-22. - Until then a shield on an Arms or Fury build tanks better. Improved Shield Slam is reachable at 32 Dodging · 2026-03-22, Magik · 2026-03-22. Tank early dungeons as Arms with Tactical Mastery and Improved Thunder Clap casey · 2026-04-01. - From 30, respec Shield Slam, Improved Shield Slam and One-Handed Weapon Specialization, then add Cruelty. Skip Defensive Tactics and Revenge talents while leveling Aubreykun · 2025-01-14, Lans · 2026-01-28. - **Contested:** Gibom leveled Prot to 50+ "0 downtime, did not grab food with me the whole way" Gibom · 2026-02-16. Lipibidy calls Prot the worst early tree until Shield Slam and the worst tree again at 60 Lipibidy · 2026-02-16, Lipibidy · 2026-02-16. - The Burnt Inn quest in Dustwallow Marsh gives a Defender's Shield at 34-35 that lasts to 50+ Gibom · 2026-02-16.

sections.heading: Abilities: when to use and what to skip
sections.markdown: - **Dual Wield** is available at level 10. You cannot equip a non-shield off-hand until you have it trained, and dual wield needs Fury talents to be worthwhile Hayden · 2026-04-09, JohnGood · 2026-01-04. - **Revenge** at 14. **Sunder Armor** comes with the Defensive Stance quest: "don't skip that quest" Lipibidy · 2025-11-21. - **Cleave** at 20 Hayden · 2026-04-09. **Bloodthirst** (talent) at 40 in the order above. **Whirlwind** at 36 casey · 2026-03-19. - **Slam:** skip it before about 36. Its weapon-damage ranks are 60→65% (24), 70→80% (34), 80→90% (44) and 90→100% (54) Blackjack · 2026-04-08. Cast it right after a two-hander swing or you lose DPS Istrefi · 2026-04-17. - **Rend:** good below 30 on mobs that live its full duration, "almost entirely useless" after that casey · 2026-01-02. Don't Rend anything that dies in under 15 s Virasan · 2026-02-26. - **Heroic Strike:** rage-inefficient while leveling. Use it only when rage would cap 30 · 2025-10-29, Peremin · 2026-03-12. - **Don't buy every rank** of every ability; train what you use VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-09. - **Weapon-skill quests** on Fray Island (where you learn Berserker Stance) cost 250 g per weapon type, cover both the 1H and 2H versions, and give +5 skill. They are "the single most impactful 250 (or 500g) you can/will spend" Dodging · 2025-11-02, Dodging · 2025-11-02, Neurospicy · 2026-03-29.

sections.heading: Pull and kill loop (bot-ready)
sections.markdown: 1. Keep **Battle Shout** up between pulls Virasan · 2026-02-26, Dodging · 2026-03-19. 2. **Pull** with Charge on isolated mobs. For dense groups or dungeons, pull with a thrown or ranged weapon Virasan · 2026-02-26, casey · 2026-04-15. 3. **Demoralizing Shout** on melee mobs; they deal about 25% less damage afterwards casey · 2026-04-15. 4. **Sunder Armor:** usually one on a normal quest mob. Stack up to 5 only on elites or long fights, and never below 50% HP Dodging · 2026-03-19, Lipibidy · 2026-03-19, Virasan · 2026-02-26. 5. **Bloodthirst > Whirlwind** on cooldown once you have them (Fury) casey · 2026-03-19. sections.heading: Tanking dungeons while leveling
sections.markdown: - **Any spec can tank at level.** Arms or Fury with a shield in your bag out-threatens a leveling Prot warrior Kyrsie · 2025-10-29, Kyrsie · 2025-10-29, oliverwz · 2025-10-06. 2H Fury tanks easily to about 45 VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-09. On Hardcore, 2H Arms with a shield swap on bosses works until about 45 VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-08. - **Be at least the level of the dungeon's final boss** Jerso · 2026-01-09. - **Pull:** line-of-sight pull → Bloodrage → Demoralizing Shout → tab-Sunder across the pack. Thunder Clap only with spare rage; it hits 4 targets Virasan · 2026-02-26. Charge variant: Charge → swap to Defensive Stance mid-Charge → Demoralizing Shout → Thunder Clap → tab-Sunder Aubreykun · 2025-12-04. - **Mark skull > cross > square.** Warriors can't hold much AoE threat, and an opening Whirlwind on a Fury build helps VeganCourage <Stonewall Inn> · 2026-02-08. Your real job is keeping the healer alive; let a DPS who over-pulls tank it briefly Aubreykun · 2025-12-04. - **Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind** (Arms, from about 36) is the best AoE opener while leveling casey · 2026-04-09. At low level without Defensive Tactics, Improved Thunder Clap is still "a threat beast" Dinousek · 2026-04-09.

gaps:
1. **2H vs DW Fury:** 2H leads on most fights by consensus, but DW holds server records. No sim set comparable gear and skill side by side after the release.
2. **Deathcute's real value:** its Execute numbers include large overkill. No one posted a log comparing it with MS Arms over a full raid.
3. **DefTac stat priority** (Strength vs Agility/crit) and whether 440 defense is necessary were argued for months without a numeric resolution.
4. **Glancing-blow penalty:** Turtle's exact glancing formula is not public. The 65% → 95% scaling comes from community tests with small samples.
5. **Rend:** whether the April 2026 change made it scale with AP is disputed within the channel.
6. **Tactical Mastery:** whether it was quietly nerfed to keep rage only on some stance swaps is reported but unconfirmed.
7. **Bloodthirst's flat damage** (100 vs 200 plus 35% AP) is disputed, and so is the value of **Blood Craze** in raids.
8. **AoE thresholds:** the target counts where Whirlwind/Cleave overtake the single-target priority, and where DefTac loses AoE threat, are rules of thumb, not measured numbers.
9. **PvP:** no complete 2H Fury PvP code was posted for 1.18.1, and per-class dampening numbers were never published. Most `#pvp-general` matchup material predates 1.18.1.
10. **Leveling:** the DW Fury leveling order is built from several players' advice and validated with the tool. It is not one player's log. The Arms order is Virasan's pinned order.
11. **Kara40/Naxx tanking:** boss-specific tank notes are scattered and often single-source. Treat them as tips, not strategies.

gear.about: Gear recommendations for Warrior (Arms, Fury, Fury-Protection hybrid, Protection) by spec/role and level bracket, with where-to-obtain, built from the Warrior forum (f40), General forum BiS-request threads, the existing class playbooks' "Gear, enchants and consumables" sections, and the 1.18.1 itemization changelog. The forum's own repeated finding is that **no maintained Turtle-specific pre-raid or raid BiS list exists** for any Warrior spec; every slot table below is built from named-item fragments scattered across many threads, not from a single curated list. Treat ranks as directional, not a simmed BiS order.
caveats: No dedicated Warrior pre-raid or raid BiS list was found anywhere in the corpus. Every 'Pre-BiS/BiS list?' thread in the Warrior forum (t4804, t19772, t14987) and in General (t13556, t18604) ends with players saying no such list exists and pointing to AtlasLoot, a third-party sim (zebouski.github.io/WarriorSim-TurtleWoW), or 'scour the database' — [Philandros (player), 2022-11-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28796#p28796); [Ugoboom (player), 2023-02-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=35760#p35760).

Warrior leveling has no itemized gear list in any source read for this guide (synthesis/classes/warrior/leveling.md covers talents and playstyle only, zero named items) — leveling-10-29/30-49/50-59 brackets are omitted entirely below; see gaps.

Raid-tier mapping used to bucket items below (inferred from repeated pairings in the sources, not stated as a table anywhere): raid-t1 = Molten Core, raid-t2 = Blackwing Lair, raid-t2.5 = Ahn'Qiraj 40, raid-t3 = Naxxramas, raid-t3.5 = Kara40 (Tower of Karazhan, Turtle-custom). This mapping is the synthesis agent's inference from context, not a direct source statement — flagged per item where it matters.

Item IDs are filled only where a source links database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N (Turtle's own item database). Several posts link db.vanillagaming.org instead (a generic vanilla database, not Turtle's) — those IDs are NOT copied into item_id since they cannot be confirmed against Turtle's own numbering; source_type/source_place are still recorded from the post text.

- No pre-raid-60 or raid-tier item list exists for Warrior Protection tank in the sources — only scattered stat-priority and set-bonus mentions.
- No leveling gear (leveling-10-29 / leveling-30-49 / leveling-50-59) exists for any Warrior spec. `synthesis/classes/warrior/leveling.md` covers talents and playstyle only — zero named items. A bot has to fall back to generic "best available armor of the right type" logic.
- Runeblade of Baron Rivendare vs. Dal'Rend's swords (a named 2H-vs-DW weapon question) got only trinket answers (Hand of Justice, Rune of the Guard Captain, Blackhand's Breadth); the weapon question itself is unanswered in the source thread.
- Kel'Thuzad mace, Dark Edge of Insanity and Severance are named only as "end weapons" with no slot/stat detail; Severance's custom-vs-vanilla status is unconfirmed.
- Dreadslayer (Kara40 mini-set) is named as part of a T3.5 BiS combo but no individual item names or slots are given anywhere in the corpus.
- "The best gloves for fury warriors are mail" (Balake, 2020-07-02) is an old one-line claim with no item name and no clear kit context — not usable as a current recommendation.
- No enchant list exists for any Warrior spec/role. The only enchant facts found: Windfury Totem interacts with sharpening stones but grants no bonus AP for the extra attack ([Xudo (player), 2024-10-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103287#p103287)); world buffs give a 20-40% DPS increase ([Abiozan (player), 2024-12-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112930#p112930)). Neither is a per-slot enchant recommendation.
- No PvP-specific gear list exists for pure Fury or pure Protection; the PvP section above is explicitly shared across all three specs because the forum does not split PvP gear discussion by spec.

sections.heading: Experts relied on (and why)
sections.markdown:
- **30:** runs his own warrior DPS/threat sim and posts rage-economy, hit-table and threat math that others defer to. Hit and weapon-skill caps, race sims, the 316-skill crit bug, Shieldrender, 2H vs DW.
- **Lipibidy:** detailed haste, weapon-speed and Deep Wounds theorycraft, and the "5 DPS builds" list. Consistently accurate on Fury and DefTac.
- **Velanir:** hit-table and itemization answers, a Troll/Human threat sim, and pre-release DeathTactics and DefTac analysis. Frequently deferred to.
- **Dodging, Black Hat, Weirdthing, Tole:** the tank core. They covered DefTac vs FuryProt, stance threat math, avoidance and defense trade-offs, and post-release MT specs (Weirdthing's "99.9%" DefTac verdict, Tole's Death Wish Prot).
- **Guts, Shardphoenix, Thirtyseven:** Arms/Fury raid-performance comparisons, the Guts Arms builds and race list, and Thirtyseven's PvP gear, cost and matchup numbers.
- **Kyrsie, Hayden, casey:** PvP builds and practice (Kara-geared solo PvP, Blood Drinker, Arms PvP build review).
- **VeganCourage, Virasan, Doite:** leveling advice. Virasan's pinned Arms leveling order is used verbatim.
- **Don't ping me, JohnGood:** macros and addons (SuperCleveRoidMacros, BattleStat), plus accurate patch-note transcriptions.
- **Spiff, dindunuffinz, Bipst** (`#pvp-general`): warrior matchup advice from both sides of the fight.

sections.heading: Gaps (what the sources do not settle)
sections.markdown:
1. **2H vs DW Fury:** 2H leads on most fights by consensus, but DW holds server records. No sim set comparable gear and skill side by side after the release.
2. **Deathcute's real value:** its Execute numbers include large overkill. No one posted a log comparing it with MS Arms over a full raid.
3. **DefTac stat priority** (Strength vs Agility/crit) and whether 440 defense is necessary were argued for months without a numeric resolution.
4. **Glancing-blow penalty:** Turtle's exact glancing formula is not public. The 65% → 95% scaling comes from community tests with small samples.
5. **Rend:** whether the April 2026 change made it scale with AP is disputed within the channel.
6. **Tactical Mastery:** whether it was quietly nerfed to keep rage only on some stance swaps is reported but unconfirmed.
7. **Bloodthirst's flat damage** (100 vs 200 plus 35% AP) is disputed, and so is the value of **Blood Craze** in raids.
8. **AoE thresholds:** the target counts where Whirlwind/Cleave overtake the single-target priority, and where DefTac loses AoE threat, are rules of thumb, not measured numbers.
9. **PvP:** no complete 2H Fury PvP code was posted for 1.18.1, and per-class dampening numbers were never published. Most `#pvp-general` matchup material predates 1.18.1.
10. **Leveling:** the DW Fury leveling order is built from several players' advice and validated with the tool. It is not one player's log. The Arms order is Virasan's pinned order.
11. **Kara40/Naxx tanking:** boss-specific tank notes are scattered and often single-source. Treat them as tips, not strategies.

guidePages.title: Warrior professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** take **Engineering** on every warrior and pair it with **Mining** while you level. Once Engineering is maxed, drop Mining for whatever earns you steady gold (Herbalism, Enchanting, Alchemy) Nako · 2025-12-18, Sylvaira · 2026-01-24. Engineering is "the only profession that is" worth it for a warrior, according to a respected tank Velanir · 2026-03-04, casey · 2026-03-04. The reasons are **Goblin Sapper Charges** (big raid AoE and threat), **target dummies**, grenades and trinkets. **Blacksmithing** is the only real alternative, and it is **contested**. **Alchemy** is the self-sufficiency pick. It is easiest to level while you level the character, or you can leave it to an alt.

sections.heading: Best pairs by goal

Mining also funds Engineering and supplies its materials | Aubreykun · 2024-11-07, Nako · 2025-12-18, Blackjack · 2026-03-21 | | **Leveling (Hardcore / no AH)** | Mining + Skinning first, then swap Skinning for Engineering | Target dummies, stun grenades and escape tools save lives.
