sections.heading: What each profession gives a warrior
sections.markdown: ### Engineering (take it) - **Goblin Sapper Charges** are the main reason to take it. Players drop a Sapper on every pack, at Garr ("A sapper is literally the only thing you need for that pull. Literally better than consecrate"), and at Viscidus ("Sappers is bis for Visc") Dodging · 2026-03-20, Virasan · 2025-10-22, Weirdthing · 2026-02-08. Players also use **Dense Dynamite** in raids Guts · 2026-01-30. - **Tank AoE kit:** Sapper + Oil of Immolation + Force Reactive Disk handles AoE threat better than any warrior ability Jakeends · 2026-03-20, Jakeends · 2026-03-20. See [Protection](#/class/warrior/protection-tank). - **Target dummies** are the leveling and Hardcore favourite. On Hardcore, skip the basic dummy and go straight to **Advanced Target Dummies**, which "will last you to 60" Virasan · 2026-01-09, Virasan · 2025-06-17. - **Craftable helms** (goggles) come up as a reason for leveling warriors Magik · 2026-01-10. There are **no 1.18.1 engineering goggles for Fury/Arms at 60**, only caster and Retribution goggles. Warriors get sharpening stones instead Dramafever · 2026-03-28, evella · 2026-03-28 (single source). - **Gnomish vs Goblin:** - Most players go **Gnomish** first for the BoP crafted trinkets and items. They respec Goblin later only to craft their own Sappers, and Sappers are cheap on the AH anyway Dodging · 2025-10-25, evella · 2025-10-25, evella · 2025-10-25. - Switching specialisation means unlearning Engineering and leveling it again from scratch. One player does Gnomish on the main and Goblin on an alt for Sappers Velanir · 2026-03-10, eric4225 · 2026-03-10. - **Battle Chicken** (Gnomish) is for "max max max" damage: pop it before the pull, then swap trinkets. The Goblin Bomb Dispenser adds "maybe 0.1%" MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2026-01-30, MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2026-01-30, MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2026-01-30 (single source). - Goblin engineering also makes gold and is needed to fully upgrade a **T0.5 (Heroism)** set goyut1 · 2025-10-25, goyut1 · 2025-10-25 (single source). - **Buy instead?** If you don't raid seriously, buy Sappers on the AH MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2026-01-30. Engineering is "so expensive to grind up" before 60 unless another character funds it Aubreykun · 2025-11-29. ### Blacksmithing (contested) - **Against:** "blacksmith is dogshit, avoid like the plague … go engi and something that makes constant revenue" Sylvaira · 2026-01-24, Sylvaira · 2026-01-24. Low-level crafts are overpriced for their materials (10 Arcanite Bars for an entry-dungeon blue) Sylvaira · 2025-12-03, Madcrep · 2025-12-03. It becomes recipe-gated and expensive past level 50, so don't take it on a first character Bassilthorne/Achuak · 2026-02-28, NotPudding · 2026-02-28. - **For:** it "has some good bits now", mostly pre-raid. The Rune-Etched pieces and the **Tempered Runeblade** let you skip some pre-raid gearing. It also gives you "free" Elemental Sharpening Stones Aubreykun · 2025-12-02, Aubreykun · 2025-12-02, Aubreykun · 2025-11-29. A guild still needs a blacksmith for **belt buckles and sharpening stones** Kirchhoff · 2025-09-22. - **Dreamsteel** armor is "kinda meh" after a nerf and with alternative tier sets available Sylvaira · 2025-12-02. - **Elementium Reaper / Elementium Champion** (BWL upgrade of the Arcanite Reaper/Champion) are among the best Fury weapons ([Fury gear](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps)): - The Reaper needs **Axesmith** and the Champion needs **Swordsmith**. Plate-armor upgrades can be worn by any plate wearer darthpenance · 2026-04-05, darthpenance · 2026-04-05. - The upgrade stone is self-use only; you can't upgrade someone else's weapon through the trade window Lipibidy · 2026-03-26. For how the upgrade works, see [the crafted-upgrade notes (forum)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272). - **Specialisation:** - **Armorsmith** is "the one that is most useful and makes the most money on average". Most output from either specialisation is BoE Forlorn Shade · 2025-04-12. For a crafting-only warrior, "armor, always go for high hp as a warr" Thirtyseven · 2025-11-17. - **Weaponsmith** is needed for the **Untempered → Tempered Runeblade** quest chain (the Untempered blade is sacrificed) Forlorn Shade · 2025-04-12. - Weaponsmith sub-specialisations lock the character. One blacksmith says they made a lot of gold regardless Fury · 2026-04-09 (single source). - **Leveling crafts:** a custom plate set and a life-leech 2H sword become available in the 40s and "will carry you to late game". Add Rugged Armor Kits for stamina Virasan · 2025-06-17, Virasan · 2026-01-06. Blacksmithing wants Mining alongside it for bars, gems and elemental reagents Forlorn Shade · 2025-04-13. ### Alchemy (+ Herbalism) - Alchemy is the best profession to "build up while levelling", because you use what you make. Leveling it at 60 is far less efficient Aubreykun · 2024-11-07. Self-made food, elixirs and scrolls speed up kills, and some outputs such as Frost Oil sell Aubreykun · 2025-11-29. - At 60 it makes **Mojo Madness, flasks and your own Mighty Rage Potions** Aubreykun · 2025-11-29. A flask is mandatory for Fury in Naxx ([Fury consumables](#/class/warrior/fury-melee-dps)). - **Buy or use an alt:** "It's worth having an alch and making your own consumes, but an alt can do that" Lipibidy · 2025-12-02. "Alchemy on a main is lowkey troll" Hayden · 2026-03-10. Herbalism on the main feeds a guild alchemist Nost · 2025-11-29. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle-custom) - **Ring enchant** for Fury: **+3 all stats** from Jewelcrafting, or +Strength 30 · 2025-11-20, Virasan · 2026-03-21. The enchant is applied by a jewelcrafter; the synthesis notes that enchanted gemstones need no Goldsmith spec to benefit from ([staff note](https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/976193120809123881/1385337387206578301)). - **Obsidian Brooch** is a non-unique +11 Stamina Jewelcrafting trinket, "pretty much bis for leveling hardcore" Virasan · 2025-06-17. A crafting-only warrior misses "the stam trinkets from jc and armor kits from leather working" Virasan · 2026-01-06. - **Goldsmith vs Gemology:** - Goldsmith's warrior-relevant item is a magic-damage-reduction piece, "probably shit except for specific raid scenarios". +stat gems are more broadly useful Virasan · 2025-10-29, Naraya · 2025-10-29. - A tank who collected rare Goldsmithing recipes says the items "have a lot of flavor" but "currently they sadly just aren't good". He calls one "good for tanking Medivh" Velanir · 2026-03-11, Velanir · 2026-03-11, Velanir · 2026-03-11. - A **Goldsmith goblet** trinket is named as an effect-trinket option ScoobertDoobert · 2026-03-20, ScoobertDoobert · 2026-03-20. - The "drop a profession for Goldsmithing to get Talisman of Hindrance" advice was sarcasm ("/s, don't do it") Velanir · 2026-01-04. ### Leatherworking - **Chromatic Leggings** are the best-stat pants on Ambershire at the time of that post. They need MC drops plus about 6 Cured Rugged Hides, which are expensive somedeadguy · 2026-01-26, Virasan · 2026-01-26. Buy them instead; you don't need Leatherworking. Rugged Armor Kits are the leveling stamina boost Virasan · 2025-06-17. ### Enchanting - A profession to pick up after dropping Mining Nako · 2025-12-18. It earns a little early gold, but you have to sell enchants yourself Aubreykun · 2025-11-29. Disenchanting "is like lottery" Ionnatra · 2026-03-31. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) - **Before 1.18.1:** Survival was mainly **tents**. Resting in a tent gave rested XP ("15 min under those and get 2x EXP"), and the warrior channel treated tent questing as the fastest way to level Black Hat · 2025-10-28, Dodging · 2025-11-25. - **The 1.18.1 rework:** 80+ recipes, Woodcutting, gathering bags, and slow/root/trap tools ([Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). Rested XP from kills was cut to 50%, and tents only fill up to 25% rested ([same](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). Warriors noted that "they also wrecked tents" and "Bg spam is now king" Black Hat · 2026-02-17, Black Hat · 2026-02-17. - **Survival for warriors:** there is little class-specific evidence. Survival "perks (nets etc.)" are listed as twink PvP tools alongside Alchemy and Engineering Ionnatra · 2026-04-06. Another warrior "found the nets on survival to be quite dissapointing" Madcrep · 2026-04-06. **Verdict:** optional. Take it for Hardcore, twinks or fun, not for performance. - **Gardening:** its **Power Mushrooms** are the cheap alternative to Smoked Desert Dumplings / sandworm meat as warrior raid food Don't ping me · 2025-10-20, 30 · 2026-01-04, 30 · 2026-01-04. Gardening requires Survival 75 ([official page](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening)). See the [Professions overview](#/professions) for how Gardening works.

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **Levels 1-~40:** Mining (plus Skinning on Hardcore) to stockpile ore and leather. Light and Heavy Leather feed Engineering's goggles and armor kits, and Mining pays for the Engineering grind Virasan · 2025-08-13, Virasan · 2025-10-07, Blackjack · 2026-03-21. 2. **Swap Skinning (or Mining) for Engineering** once you have a few stacks. "Keep your mined crap" Virasan · 2025-10-07, Virasan · 2025-06-17. 3. **Engineering maxed:** drop Mining for a gold or cooldown profession Nako · 2025-12-18, Blackjack · 2026-03-21. 4. **Specialisation:** choose Gnomish (BoP items, Battle Chicken) unless you only want to craft Sappers. Changing later means leveling Engineering again eric4225 · 2026-03-10. 5. **If you want the Elementium Reaper/Champion**, you must be a 300 Blacksmith with the matching Axesmith/Swordsmith specialisation darthpenance · 2026-04-05. No skill thresholds are sourced beyond these.

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: - **Goblin:** Goblin-only Engineering recipes include rocket boots. The usual plan is Gnomish first, then unlearn and switch to Goblin roguecraft · 2026-03-30. The Goblin racial **Prospecting** grants Mining *and* Jewelcrafting skill ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102965#p102965)). - The warrior channel has no profession notes on the other races (Gnome, Tauren and so on). See [Races](#/class/warrior).

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - Warriors are "extremely poor at making money" solo. Estimates are about 20-30 g/h solo farming, against 100 g+/h for a hunter on the ZG farm Aubreykun · 2025-11-19, eric4225 · 2026-03-10. That makes gathering professions and the AH more important than on other classes: "play any other class" for solo farming, "just oldschool mining and herb, auction flipping etc" instead limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2026-03-27 — e.g. buying and reselling Bijous Thirtyseven · 2026-03-27. - **Gathering:** mining while fresh Black Hat · 2025-10-04; Skinning + Herbalism to 60 "made plenty of gold for skills and riding" Bassilthorne/Achuak · 2026-03-14; a tank + healer dungeon duo where the healer has Herbalism/Enchanting is "easy money" ScoobertDoobert · 2026-02-11. - **Crafting:** Goblin engineers can "make sapper charges for yourself and sell the extra" 🆂🅾🅻🅰🆁 · 2026-02-15. Alchemy converts cheap raw materials into sellable consumables Black Hat · 2026-04-06. - **Big gold sinks:** the weapon-skill quests (250 g per weapon type) are "the single most impactful 250 (or 500) you can or will spend" Guts · 2026-01-22, Dodging · 2025-11-02. Dual spec costs 350 g at level 50 Nabuhodonozo · 2025-08-16. - Farming routes (lashers, ZG crocs, Hyjal satyrs, Winterfall) are on the [Leveling](#/class/warrior/leveling) and class pages.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- No 1.18.1 list of Engineering items that matter for warriors beyond Sappers, dynamite, dummies and Battle Chicken. Nothing on reflector recipes or skill levels.
- The Survival rework's value for warriors is barely discussed. The only sources are one twink PvP remark and one complaint about nets.
- Goldsmith and Gemology recipe names for warriors are not documented in text.
- No skill thresholds for Engineering items (Sappers, dummies) are sourced in the warrior channel.

See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/warrior)

readme.heading: What changed for paladins in 1.18.1
readme.markdown: 1.18.1 went live on 2026-03-20. The class notes: [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). | Area | Change | What it means in play | |---|---|---| | All | **Holy Strike** now deals weapon damage + Holy damage (rank 8: 40% weapon damage + 129-146), spell power scaling 43% → 71% | Holy Strike scales with your weapon and Strength; it opens most fights Jesse Potter · 2026-03-18, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-18 | | Ret | **Seal of Command 7 → 9 PPM**; Crusader Strike rank 5 90% → 100% weapon damage; Repentance ticks with 8% AP | SoC Ret is competitive again Gilfrey · 2026-03-23 | | Prot | Holy Shield threat 30% → 50%; **Righteous Strikes** now +25% Holy Strike damage and threat, with Crusader Strike granting Zealous Defence | About 10% more threat at high-end gear Proph · 2026-03-22 | | All | **Consecration** +8% and front-loaded (first tick 156% of the old value, last 44%) | Better on fast-dying trash and for pull threat | | Holy | **Daybreak** 289 → 248 base, 43% → 32% scaling; Holy T3.5 5-piece no longer adds Holy Strike targets | Less AoE healing; "raid ended up jumping too much back" Mithreon · 2026-01-25 | | Sets | Tier 2.5 3-piece (Ret/Prot) now +15% Judgement of Righteousness/Command; Ret T3.5 5-piece is 4% non-stacking haste; Prot T3.5 bonuses reshuffled | | | All | **Swapping librams in combat costs a GCD** | Equip one libram per fight | | Items | New stat **Fortune** (necks, cloaks, trinkets) Destroses · 2026-02-18; new **Libram of Ardour** (+1 SoC PPM) Destroses · 2026-03-31; Libram of Final Judgement scales with 8% SP ([Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272)) | Fortune is weak Dodging · 2026-03-18 | | Content | **Timbermaw Hold** (TMH20) raid with Pysan's New Greatsword Iseut · 2026-04-03; a new Onyxia's Lair boss | See [Retribution: gear](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps) | Launch bugs (Holy Strike healing, Block Value, Righteous Fury snapshots) were hotfixed in the first days ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139)); see the spec pages. **Fake patch news:** the 2026-04-01 "next patch" post by Lhian (spellstrikes stop proccing, Holy Strike becomes a next-swing attack) was an April Fools joke Lhian · 2026-04-01, tripleXDengine · 2026-04-01. Earlier "leaked" talent trees and changelogs were also fake Destroses · 2025-12-03, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-07. Things you will meet in older guides: - **Strikes do not trigger seals**; only auto-attacks do Dodging · 2025-10-27. Crusader Strike and Holy Strike share a cooldown. - **Seal twisting no longer works** Excinerus · 2025-12-30. - **Judgement is a melee attack** (melee hit and crit) Wulf (Th0r1369) · 2025-10-31, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-20. - **Sanctity Aura lives in the Holy tree** (11-point sink) and every Ret takes it Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-04. - **Seal of Command is a level-30 talent** on Turtle (20 in Classic) Beldrin · 2026-01-11; Consecration is baseline at 20 Mima · 2026-01-02. - **Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control**; Hand of Freedom has a longer cooldown Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28. - **Melee hit cap is 8%** against bosses; 5 weapon skill = 1% hit Destroses · 2025-11-08, Dodging · 2026-04-01.

readme.heading: Professions
readme.markdown: - **Level with two of Herbalism, Mining and Skinning** Destroses · 2025-11-08. - **At 60, take Engineering.** "The only main profession that benefits you in raids is engineering" donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-27, because "no other proffession offers unique enchants/abilities" tripleXDengine · 2025-11-11. It gives Sappers, grenades and, for Prot and farming, the Force Reactive Disk Silverhand · 2026-04-01. It is "not required unless you're planning to be even semi serious in raids" Dodging · 2025-10-18. The second main profession can be anything PowerPaladin · 2026-03-27. Keep Herbalism for lashers or Mining for ZG. - **Retribution:** Blacksmithing (Swordsmith) makes the Tempered Runeblade, a pre-raid Spellret weapon ("gives bis sword for 2 phases of a server") Breaddy · 2025-10-16. Otherwise Blacksmithing is only a leveling-gear profession Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-03. Full guide: [Professions](#/class/paladin/professions) Shared pages: [Professions overview](#/professions) · [PvP systems](#/pvp) (honor, battlegrounds, Warmode) · [Game mechanics](#/mechanics) (buff and consumable stacking, enchant sources) · [Client setup](#/client-setup) (launcher, SuperWoW, addons). Tier sets: to swap a tier piece to another spec's version, see [Tier sets: spec exchange](#/mechanics). Two paladin loot bugs: Tier 1 shoulders drop at about 8%, against about 33% for other classes, and were still at 8% in April 2026 Lyrazia · 2026-03-13, Rindal · 2026-04-13. Ragnaros could drop paladin and shaman Tier 2 legs only once per kill; the reply to a bug report confirmed it as a bug to be fixed "with the next update" (2026-03-13) Nabwek · 2026-03-13.

playbooks.title: Protection Paladin (tank)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **11/33/7** build with **Sanctity Aura** and **Righteous Fury** always on. Your threat is Holy damage scaled by spell power. Press **Holy Strike** on cooldown and never delay it. Use **Judgement of Righteousness** on cooldown and re-seal Righteousness. Add **Consecration** only when more than two mobs are on you, and **Holy Shield** when mana allows. Gear spell power first, then Stamina, then avoidance. Aim for about 7,500–8,000 HP for raid bosses and **102.4% combined avoidance with Holy Shield up** from AQ40 onward. Do not chase 440 Defense. | | | |---|---| | Role | Main or off-tank in raids, dungeon tank, one of the best AoE and solo farmers | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Strong.** The 1.18.1 Holy Strike and Consecration changes fixed the old high-end threat problem. Players report "threat is already not a problem for prot paladins" Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-11 and about 10% more threat at high-end gear Proph · 2026-03-22. Right after release one raider called paladin "best single target and best aoe tank" Dziadmroz · 2026-03-23. **Contested:** bears are still rated the top tank by some regulars Grey · 2026-03-15, and paladin has no AoE taunt L-star · 2026-04-11 | | Difficulty | Easy to play (a short priority list), hard to gear: you juggle threat, HP and avoidance sets per boss Dodging · 2025-12-22 | | Strengths | Huge opener threat (Holy Strike is about 60% of it) Grey · 2026-03-23; strong AoE threat from front-loaded Consecration Grey · 2026-03-23; near-infinite mana on bosses Grey · 2026-02-08; Blessing of Protection, bubble, Cleanse; a reliable taunt | | Weaknesses | Low HP on paladin gear, and mitigation mostly from block Grey · 2026-01-21; threat comes almost only from Holy damage, so a missed Holy Strike leaves only Judgement of Righteousness as backup Grey · 2026-03-15; no AoE taunt; no ranged pull without items | "High floor, low ceiling": a decent prot paladin can be the best tank in an average guild. Threat problems mostly show up in the top ~1% of speed-running guilds Silverhand · 2026-03-07, Grey · 2026-03-07. !!! warning "Fake patch news" The 2026-04-01 "next patch" post was an April Fools joke, not a real change. It said Holy Strike becomes a next-swing attack, Crusader Strike loses its cooldown and spellstrikes stop proccing Lhian · 2026-04-01, gastro · 2026-04-01. Nothing in this guide assumes it.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Main tank 11/33/7 (recommended) This is the "general raid prot" build Mithreon reposted after release Mithreon · 2026-03-22, Mithreon · 2026-04-10. 11/33/7 is the long-standing cookie-cutter tank split Grey · 2026-02-08, Grey · 2026-01-14. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Holy | Divine Intellect | 5/5 | | Holy | Improved Seal of Righteousness | 5/5 | | Holy | Sanctity Aura | 1/1 | | Protection | Redoubt | 5/5 | | Protection | Precision | 3/3 | | Protection | Toughness | 3/5 | | Protection | Improved Righteous Fury | 3/3 | | Protection | Blessing of Sanctuary | 1/1 | | Protection | Shield Specialization | 3/3 | | Protection | Improved Hand of Reckoning | 2/2 | | Protection | Righteous Defense | 3/3 | | Protection | Holy Shield | 1/1 | | Protection | Reckoning | 3/5 | | Protection | Righteous Strikes | 5/5 | | Protection | Bulwark of the Righteous | 1/1 | | Retribution | Benediction | 5/5 | | Retribution | Improved Judgement | 2/2 | Split **11/33/7**, validated with `talent_tool.py` (VALID). [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=0500501-0530331302031351-052) · code `AoAoB-AoYDZYCAZYAoB-AoQ` Why these points: - **Sanctity Aura (11 Holy points) is effectively mandatory** unless another paladin in your group brings it. It is about 9% of your total threat ("Sanctity is king") Proph · 2026-02-07, and prot is "balanced around the assumption of Sanctity Aura" Grey · 2025-12-12. The same 11 points buy Improved Seal of Righteousness Grey · 2026-01-14. - **Divine Intellect over Divine Strength:** your mana pool also works as mp5 through Shield Specialization. With about 6,000 mana, rank-3 Holy Shield slightly drains mana and rank-1 slightly gains Grey · 2026-03-20. - **Improved Righteous Fury 3/3:** Righteous Fury gives +60% threat on Holy damage, and the talent adds 45 points, for **+105%** total Jesse Potter · 2026-01-26, Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-03-18. - **Righteous Strikes 5/5 for a main tank:** "the fat opener threat is too hard to pass up" Grey · 2026-03-28. Grey's opener math: Righteous Strikes and Improved Seal of Righteousness raise your minimum opening threat by about 30% Grey · 2026-02-07. - **Reckoning 3/5:** "at least 1 point … most run 2~3"; 4–5 points only pay off when many mobs are hitting you Grey · 2026-01-14. - **Improved Hand of Reckoning 2/2:** with 3/3 Precision your taunt misses only 5% of the time Grey · 2025-12-12. It is never guaranteed against raid bosses Mithreon · 2026-01-21. - **Benediction vs Improved Blessings:** Grey prefers Improved Blessings when nobody else takes it. Benediction saves only about 5 mana per second, while Improved Blessings gives the raid about 20% more Wisdom/Might Grey · 2026-01-14. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Imp Blessings MT** | Improved Blessings 5/5 instead of Benediction | [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=0500501-0530331302031351-502) · `AoAoB-AoYDZYCAZYAoB-FAQ` | "Trade benediction for imp blessings if needed" Grey · 2026-01-10, Grey · 2026-01-14 | | **Max Toughness** | Toughness 5/5, no Improved Hand of Reckoning. The extra armor is about 2% damage reduction; Improved Hand of Reckoning matters mostly for Four Horsemen and the BWL drakes | [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=0500501-0530531300031351-052) · `AoAoB-AoYFZYAAZYAoB-AoQ` | Grey · 2026-03-30 | | **Vengeprot (off-tank)** 0/26/25 | Righteous Strikes 1/5 and Reckoning 1/5 in Prot; Conviction, 2H Weapon Specialization and Vengeance 5/5 in Ret. More threat goes into Seal of Righteousness, autos and Consecration. An off-tank does not benefit from Reckoning or Holy Shield anyway | [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=-053043030203111-0520405103005) · `-AoYEYYCAZIAI-AoQgFIYAF` | angels1m ("to maximise threat") angels1m · 2026-03-23; Grey: "If you're OT definitely vengeance" Grey · 2026-03-28, Grey · 2026-04-04 | Points you can move without a new code (Grey's "wiggle room"): Blessing of Sanctuary, Toughness and 2 Reckoning points can go into Guardian's Favor, Anticipation, Improved Hand of Reckoning or Improved Lay on Hands Grey · 2026-03-26. **Contested: Anticipation (Defense).** Some players run 2/5 Toughness + 3/3 Anticipation Grey · 2026-03-23. Others call Defense "a noob trap", because by AQ40 your gear reaches the avoidance cap without it Raugtreefell · 2026-04-12, Destroses · 2026-04-12. Leveling into this build: see [Leveling](#/class/paladin/leveling). A validated tank-path order (Redoubt → Precision → Toughness 2 → Blessing of Sanctuary → Improved Righteous Fury → Shield Specialization → … → Holy Shield at 30 → Righteous Strikes → Bulwark at 42 → Holy → Ret) is stored in `structured/classes/paladin/protection-tank.yaml`. !!! note "Pre-1.18.1 builds" Old builds that max Reckoning or skip Righteous Strikes were built around the pre-patch talent text. Builds from before March 2026 that value "Zeal block value" from Crusader Strike are out of date Grey · 2026-01-28.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: Threat stat order: **spell power > hit > crit > Agility > Strength** Mithreon · 2026-03-15. 1 SP ≈ 1 threat per second (about 1.2 after the Holy Strike buff) Destroses · 2026-04-05. At about 1,000 SP, 1% crit ≈ 8 SP Grey · 2026-03-08. How to gear, in order Silverhand · 2026-04-05, Mithreon · 2026-04-09: 1. **Getting one-shot?** More Stamina. Most bosses "global" a tank somewhere between 7,000 and 8,000 HP. Aim for 7,500–8,000 unbuffed (without Titans) as soon as you can Grey · 2026-03-25, Grey · 2026-03-05. BWL: 7,500 is the minimum and 8,000 preferred Grey · 2025-12-30. 2. **Healers struggling?** More avoidance. 3. **DPS pulling threat?** More spell power. Grey's first step is the other way round: equip spell power until you can hold the boss for the first 10 seconds against your top DPS, then Stamina/armor until you survive 4–5 s without heals, then avoidance Grey · 2026-01-05. | Stat | Verdict | |---|---| | Spell power | The threat stat. Still dominant after the Holy Strike weapon-damage change gastro · 2026-03-24, Grey · 2026-03-24 | | Stamina | Survival. Paladin gear carries less of it than other tanks' gear Grey · 2026-01-21 | | Intellect | Good: more mana and more Shield Specialization return Grey · 2026-03-20 | | Agility | Cheap and fine: 6 Agility = 12 armor, 0.3% crit, 0.3% dodge Silverhand · 2026-04-12 | | Strength / attack power | No longer worthless (Holy Strike's weapon part), but weak. 12 Strength gives less than one point of block value plus a little Holy Strike damage. Raid AP buffs are a nice bonus Silverhand · 2026-04-12, dumbid · 2026-03-30 | | Defense | Only as a part of total avoidance: 1 Defense = 0.04% each to dodge, parry, block, miss and crit avoidance Grey · 2026-01-14. Do not chase 440 dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-08 | **Caps** | Cap | Value | |---|---| | Melee hit | **8% at 300 weapon skill, 7% at 305–308.** Precision gives 3%, so you need 4% from gear after the weapon-skill book quest Grey · 2026-02-13. A main tank should be hit-capped, because a miss is 0 threat from Holy Strike or Judgement Mithreon · 2025-12-15. Off-tanks and dungeon tanks can be 1–2% under, and many run 6–7% Mithreon · 2025-12-15, gastro · 2026-02-09. Do not drop a big spell-power item to fix hit Silverhand · 2026-04-05 | | Spell hit | Not needed. Take what comes on spell-power gear. It only matters for taunt, Consecration, Exorcism and procs theoloras/warkrak · 2026-04-01, Grey · 2026-03-19 | | **Avoidance (crush and crit cap)** | **102.4% combined dodge + parry + block + miss with Holy Shield up** against level-63 bosses Destroses · 2026-04-08, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-05. Being around 90% "is basically the same" for most purposes Grey · 2026-03-30. It only matters from AQ40 onward Mithreon · 2026-02-28 | | AQ40 Twin Emperors | Unbalancing Strike removes 100 Defense, so you need **118.4%** to stay crush- and crit-immune against the melee twin Grey · 2026-01-26, Grey · 2025-12-12 | | Kara40 | **Knight and Rupturan require crush immunity**; Rook and Mephistroth "very strongly encourage it" Grey · 2026-01-26 | **Contested: how much to chase crush immunity.** Grey's Mephistroth math: a crushable 8k-HP tank gets killed from full in half a second about once every 3 kills Grey · 2026-03-15. angels1m answers that you never have 100% Holy Shield uptime anyway, and that giving up a trinket slot for avoidance is not worth it in T3.5 angels1m · 2026-03-15.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (priority list)
rotationSingle.markdown: Before the pull: **Righteous Fury** (re-apply it first after any death) bela · 2026-03-29, **Sanctity Aura** (Retribution Aura if another paladin brings Sanctity) Proph · 2026-02-07, your blessing, Seal of Righteousness. Mark the skull. **Opener:** pre-cast Holy Shield → run in → Judgement of Righteousness → Holy Strike → re-seal Righteousness Grey · 2026-03-07, Beldrin · 2025-11-07. Pop your active spell-power trinket right before the first Judgement or Holy Strike Cobanana · 2026-02-19, Grey · 2025-12-15. The first Holy Strike is the most important GCD of the fight Dodging · 2026-01-04. 1. **`Holy Strike` the moment it is off cooldown.** Never delay it Grey · 2026-03-07. 2. **`Judgement` of Righteousness about 2 s after Holy Strike, on cooldown.** Judgement is off the GCD, so weave it into the GCD of another cast (usually Holy Shield) Grey · 2026-03-07, Pastor · 2026-01-20. 3. **`Seal of Righteousness`** in the next GCD after you judge. Never leave Righteousness for another seal on a boss: you lose Seal of Righteousness, Judgement of Righteousness, and extra Wisdom and Windfury procs Grey · 2026-02-24. 4. **`Holy Shield`** when mana permits Grey · 2026-03-23. Rank 1 saves mana on long fights Grey · 2025-12-17. 5. **`Consecration`** with the remaining GCDs: rank 5 until your threat lead is established, then rank 1 Grey · 2026-03-07. Keep a rank-1 Consecration on your bar; at about 950 SP it hits for about 90 per tick Grey · 2026-02-08. Below about 30% mana, switch to rank 1 until you are back at 50% Proph · 2026-02-08. 6. **`Exorcism`** on Undead and Demons when nothing else is ready. If both are available, Consecration does more threat angels1m · 2026-01-19. 7. **`Hand of Reckoning`** when a mob leaves you. 8. **`Crusader Strike` is never a threat button.** Holy Strike does "nearly 10x as much threat", and it would take about 5 minutes of auto-attacking for Zeal's haste to pay back the lost Holy Strikes Grey · 2026-03-28, Grey · 2026-03-28. Lhian himself has "given up on even considering crusader strike to be part of normal prot rotation" Lhian · 2026-01-26. The only use is **Zealous Defence** before a planned big hit or a tank swap: Holy Shield → taunt → Crusader Strike → hit → Bulwark → as Bulwark ends, Crusader Strike again bela · 2026-03-21. That fits Patchwerk, Twins and Knight Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-03-21. Threat sources on a real Patchwerk parse: Holy Strike 599, Seal of Righteousness 367, Judgement of Righteousness 354, auto-attack 212, Holy Shield 200, Consecration 194, others small, for **about 2,085 threat per second**. Holy Strike is 28.7% of the total Grey · 2026-03-23. At high gear the rotation has dead GCDs, which is expected Grey · 2026-03-26. **Libram:** Libram of the Eternal Tower (-0.5 s Holy Strike/Crusader Strike cooldown) for single target. It also stops Holy Strike from lining up with your other cooldowns Grey · 2026-03-28, Kindousen · 2026-04-01.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE tanking
rotationAoe.markdown: | Mobs | Action | |---|---| | 2 | No Consecration. Holy Strike the skull, Judgement on the second, tab between them Grey · 2026-03-23 | | 3+ | **Pre-cast Consecration** where the mobs will meet you. The front-load triggers when each mob enters it, so casting early is fine Grey · 2026-03-21. Then run the single-target priority on the skull, and tab Judgement / Holy Strike / taunt onto the others Grey · 2026-01-15, gastro · 2025-10-28 | | Big trash pulls | Consecration gives only about 30–40% of AoE threat against 3–5 targets. Lock mobs down one at a time ("get 7–8k threat on a mob, move to the next"), and use taunt and stuns for the extras Grey · 2026-02-08, Grey · 2026-01-03. Cast rank-5 Consecration at most 1–2 times per pack Grey · 2026-02-08 | | Mana-heavy multi-target | Seal of Wisdom + Consecration beats Seal of Righteousness on many targets angels1m · 2026-02-01 | | Adds that must look at you instantly (Incantagos, Faerlina trash, Noth adds) | Spam Greater Blessings (not Wisdom). Each cast does 60 threat per buffed player, before Righteous Fury, split across all mobs Grey · 2026-01-23, Grey · 2025-12-14 | - **Goblin Sapper Charges** double your opening AoE threat (about 500, the same as a Consecration tick). Sappers are "borderline required" for serious raiding Grey · 2026-04-04, Dodging · 2026-04-04. Tanks want Engineering for Sappers and the Force Reactive Disk Grey · 2026-01-25. - Libram of the Hallowed Ground on trash Kindousen · 2026-04-01. - In later raids the meta is one fury warrior per add, because Consecration alone will not out-threat geared AoE Grey · 2026-04-04.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: | Cooldown | Use | |---|---| | **Bulwark of the Righteous** | Big damage reduction plus threat. Save it for Maexxna and Gothik in Naxx angels1m · 2026-01-19. On Anomalus in Kara40, save it with a Greater Arcane Protection Potion for 30+ stacks Grey · 2025-12-06 | | **Holy Shield** | Your crit/crush cap depends on it being up. Pre-cast it before pulls | | **Divine Shield** | Drops your threat (it returns to max once it ends) and halves your damage. Use it for mechanics (Firemaw stacks, fear) or when you would otherwise die Ryken · 2022-08-17, theoloras/warkrak · 2025-03-13, Jesse Potter · 2026-02-17 | | **Blessing of Protection** | On the other tank, to take the boss back from them when a mechanic needs it Silverhand · 2025-12-10. On a DPS who pulled aggro | | **Greater Stoneshield Potion** | Patchwerk, Kel'Thuzad, Sapphiron, Loatheb, Faerlina angels1m · 2026-01-19 | | **Active trinkets** | Draconic Infused Emblem / Talisman of Ephemeral Power / Essence of Sapphiron, used on pull before the first Holy Strike Grey · 2025-12-15, Grey · 2026-03-16 |

roleStrategy.heading: Raid and dungeon notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **[Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core):** - Ragnaros needs 250–315 fire resistance to reduce knockbacks, and he resets threat after a knockback Grey · 2025-12-18. - Geddon: about 260+ fire resistance is recommended for pugs Beldrin · 2026-03-17. - Garr's adds hit physical, so the off-tank needs avoidance and HP, not fire resistance Dodging · 2025-12-21. - **[Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair):** - Broodlord's Mortal Strike hits for 5,500–6,000 plus an auto Grey · 2026-03-13. - Firemaw: Shadowflame is about 5,000 armor-ignoring damage and does not reset the swing timer. Wear a fire-resist cloak and have enough Stamina Grey · 2026-03-27. You need strong snap threat Dodging · 2026-03-27. Count the Wing Buffet timer Silverhand · 2026-04-02. - Only Firemaw needs fire resistance Grey · 2026-03-13. - **AQ40 Twin Emperors:** the melee twin needs 118.4% avoidance (see Caps). Many paladins prefer to tank the caster twin Silverhand · 2026-01-26. For the caster twin, aim for about 180 arcane and 180 shadow resistance and about 8,000 HP. Use a weapon with magic-type white damage (Thunderfury etc.) and the Black Morass shield (SP + shadow resistance). Keep armor, because he weaves in melee Grey · 2026-01-06, Grey · 2026-01-06. Alternatively, tank him at range with Judgement of Righteousness, Holy Shock and blessings Pastor · 2026-01-06. - **Naxxramas:** see the Stoneshield and Bulwark list above. - Loatheb: a patch-day log shows 227k threat against 115.6k damage Grey · 2026-03-21. - Do not pull Four Horsemen with Thunderfury (its chain proc) dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-01-09. - Web Wrap does not fully disable dodge Grey · 2026-01-17. - **[Tower of Karazhan (Kara40)](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan):** - Grey's gear per boss: T3 for Ravens, T2.5 for Gnarlmoon, an arcane-resist set for Incantagos and Anomalus, T2.5 for Medivh, T3 + full mitigation for Knight, T2.5 for Rook and Sanv, T3 + full mitigation for Rupturan, T3 + spell power for Mephistroth Grey · 2026-03-17. - Ravens: drop a Consecration toward the left before they spawn Mithreon · 2026-03-23. - Incantagos: spam Greater Blessings on the pull, because his damage-reduction stacks stop damage threat Grey · 2025-12-14. - Anomalus: front-load threat in the first ~30 s while healers focus the main tank angels1m · 2025-12-06. Stamina, arcane resistance and enough threat to hold until the first bomb matter most Grey · 2025-12-24. Grey runs 315 arcane resistance Grey · 2026-03-28. - Rupturan: stand more than 20 yd from the boss to hold its aggro mechanic Mithreon · 2025-12-24. The fight is "hit holy strike, move 12 yards" Grey · 2026-03-20. - **[Lower Karazhan Halls (Kara10)](#/instances/lower-karazhan-halls):** pulling the whole basement needs at least 2 shamans (poison totems) Grey · 2026-03-17. - **[Emerald Sanctum](#/instances/emerald-sanctum):** an anti-kite mechanic teleports the tank onto certain mobs on pull Grey · 2026-03-17. ### Necrodin, spellstrike and Shock-prot as they affect tanking - **Necrodin is not a tank build.** You do not get your pets' threat dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-03-22. Some tanks swap to a Vengeprot/Necrodin spec for trash and back to prot for bosses gastro · 2026-01-26. Speed-run guilds avoid mid-raid respecs Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-01-26. - **Shock-prot** (Holy/Prot 30/21 or 21/30) works: Holy Shock costs less mana over time than Judgement of Righteousness (485 per 20 s vs 300 per 8 s). Threat per second is a bit lower, you get better burst and utility, and you lose Bulwark Grey · 2026-04-04, Grey · 2026-04-04, Destroses · 2026-04-04. No calculator code was posted.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: ### Threat vs mitigation sets Tanks keep several sets and swap per boss Grey · 2025-12-19, Dodging · 2025-12-15. | Set | Pieces | Use | |---|---|---| | **Threat** | 3 T2.5 + 3 T3.5 | Most bosses and trash. T2.5 is "squishy" with little HP Ash · 2026-03-09, Grey · 2026-03-11 | | **Mitigation** | 5 T3.5 + 4 T3 | Hard hitters Grey · 2026-03-19 | | **Hybrid** | 3 T2.5 + 3 T3.5 + 4 T3 | Grey reached 8,400 HP, 58.4% avoidance (crush-immune with Holy Shield) and 767 SP with Thunderfury, 895 with Desecration, before trinkets. "Basically the same threat as now but with an extra 1400hp and crush immunity" Grey · 2026-03-19 | T3 is BiS for fights with frequent big hits compared with your max HP (BWL drakes, Chromaggus, Broodlord, Twins, Patchwerk, Sapphiron, Thaddius, Kel'Thuzad, Rupturan, Mephistroth). Its block value also wins on Maexxna, Loatheb and Four Horsemen Grey · 2026-03-11. For Naxx, add about 4 pieces of T3 on top of T2.5 Mithreon · 2026-04-05. Shoulders/legs mix: T2.5 shoulders + T3.5 legs gives more spell power than the reverse Mithreon · 2026-04-12. **Reference set (Grey's raid main tank):** T2.5 helm/shoulders/chest; T3 bracers/gloves/belt/ring; T3.5 neck/legs/boots; Chess cape or Rookguard; Wrath of Cenarius; Essence of Sapphiron; Remains of Overwhelming Power; Mark of the Champion; Desecration or Thunderfury (+30 SP); Bulwark of Enduring Earth (+2% block) Grey · 2026-03-19. **PvP gear:** the Veteran's 6-piece has much more HP than T3.5 but less threat. It is "probably BiS" for tanks who need mitigation Grey · 2026-03-28. The Partisan's gloves beat T2 Grey · 2026-03-28. ### Pre-raid - Pre-raid prot is "largely like gearing a spelladin". Get **4 pieces of T0.5** and mix in tank off-pieces dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-05. Four T0.5 pieces beat T1, T2 or other raid off-pieces in those slots Grey · 2026-03-19, Destroses · 2026-03-19. The 4-piece T0.5 bonus gives about 95 SP; you want the specific pieces dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-08. **Contested:** some players use full T1 8-piece for threat dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-14, angels1m · 2026-04-14. - **Soulforge 4-piece** is the stepping stone for Black Morass and lasts until T2.5-level gear Jesse Potter · 2026-03-17. - R1/R2 PvP sets are good pre-raid Stamina Destroses · 2026-04-05. - Black Morass, Stormwind Vault and Karazhan Crypt are the only level-60 dungeons that need gear preparation for a fresh tank Jesse Potter · 2025-10-27. See [Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass), [Stormwind Vault](#/instances/stormwind-vault), [Karazhan Crypt](#/instances/karazhan-crypt). ### Weapons (1H + shield) | Weapon | Verdict | Source | |---|---|---| | **Desecration** | Best single-target threat | Proph · 2026-03-22 | | **Thunderfury** | Only about 0.5% behind Desecration. It also gives about 20% less damage taken from boss auto-attacks (its attack-speed slow), and its proc chains on AoE. No longer a prerequisite for high-end tanking | Proph · 2026-03-23, Grey · 2026-03-10, Destroses · 2026-03-23, Mithreon · 2026-04-02 | | **Comet Signaller** | Within 1.5% of both, and better than everything else | Proph · 2026-03-24 | | Lok'amir il Romathis, Wraith Blade | Lok'amir is the Ambershire pick (Desecration on the other realms) | angels1m · 2026-03-22, Mithreon · 2026-03-23 | | Pre-raid | Azuresong Mageblade over Blade of Infinite Mysteries or Nefarian's mace. Crimson Spellblade beats Mass of McGowan even on fire-immune bosses (25.8 vs 21.5 non-auto threat per second) | Grey · 2026-03-24, Grey · 2026-03-24 | **2H tanking** is a real niche now. It is "outright bis" on Incantagos and Medivh, which do not melee or deal physical damage, and good on elemental-damage fights (Ragnaros, Geddon, BWL drakes, Vaelastrasz, Viscidus, Huhuran, Thaddius, Grobbulus) Grey · 2026-04-02, Grey · 2026-04-02. Elsewhere, 1H + shield stays ahead: "it's really hard to beat 128sp with 40% weapon damage", and 2H loses Holy Shield, Reckoning and block Grey · 2026-03-28, bela · 2026-04-10. With a 2H, take Righteous Strikes as main tank and Vengeance as off-tank Grey · 2026-03-28. ### Shields, trinkets, librams - **Shields:** when choosing between two, take the one with more Stamina and armor Grey · 2026-03-24. Useful options: - The new Onyxia's Lair boss shield is about equal to BWL's Elementium shield and easier to get Silverhand · 2026-03-24. - Bulwark of Enduring Earth Grey · 2026-03-19. - Jadestone Shield until AQ40. Scaleshield for Nefarian and Solnius Hard Mode Grey · 2026-03-03. - The Argent Dawn shield only for big dungeon pulls and farming Silverhand · 2026-01-18. - Vault Defender is "basically a budget Drillborer" and the best shield until a raid shield drops Silverhand · 2026-01-18. - Force Reactive Disk for AoE snap threat and farming, useful up to Kara40. It needs repairs about once per Naxx wing gastro · 2026-01-16, Grey · 2026-01-17. - Skip Skullflame Shield: it is too unreliable gastro · 2026-01-16. - **Trinkets:** always wear at least one active spell-power trinket. Slot 1 progression: Briarwood Reed / Mind's Key / Fabric of Time / Royal Seal → Shard of Nightmare / Corrupted Reed → Neltharion's Tear → Remains / Mark of the Champion. Slot 2: Draconic Infused Emblem → Talisman of Ephemeral Power → Essence of Sapphiron Grey · 2026-03-16. "If you get Nelth's Tear you will not unequip it until k40" Grey · 2026-03-19. Styleen's for raw mitigation tripleXDengine · 2025-12-27. Sigil of Ancient Accord is "okay for damage, awful for threat" Grey · 2026-03-26. - **Cloak:** Cloak of the Brood Lord becomes the highest spell-power cape in the game Grey · 2026-03-20. - **Neck:** Choker of the Firelord, then Choker of the Emerald Lord (Emerald Sanctum) until T3.5 Grey · 2026-02-13, Grey · 2026-03-08. - **Set bonuses to skip:** Ret T2 3-piece "proc memes" do little for prot, because Righteous Fury only doubles Holy damage Grey · 2026-03-26. Ret T3 2-piece is not worth it below about 1,000 SP Grey · 2026-03-26.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Not re-applying Righteous Fury after dying, or not toggling it after a respec bela · 2026-03-29, donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-22. - Pressing Crusader Strike for threat Grey · 2026-03-28. - Delaying Holy Strike, or opening without it Grey · 2026-03-07. - Consecrating single targets Grey · 2026-03-23. - Chasing 440 Defense or stacking Strength dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-08, Silverhand · 2026-04-12. - Running below about 7,000 HP on BWL and Naxx bosses Grey · 2026-03-25. - Wearing Ret T2 for spellstrike procs Grey · 2026-03-17. - Trusting a threat meter that does not read Improved Righteous Fury Mithreon · 2025-08-22.

enchants.heading: Enchants
enchants.markdown: Grey's main-tank list Grey · 2026-03-19: | Slot | Enchant | |---|---| | Head / Legs | Zul'Gurub enchant (dodge/defense) Grey · 2025-12-12 | | Shoulders | Sapphiron Stamina | | Chest | +100 HP | | Cloak | 1% dodge | | Bracers | 9 Stamina | | Gloves | 15 Agility | | Belt | 5 Defense (Agility over Strength if you use the buckle for stats) Silverhand · 2026-04-12 | | Boots | 15 Stamina (movement speed on movement fights) Grey · 2025-12-12 | | Neck / Rings | 6 Stamina (5 SP for pure threat) Grey · 2026-03-05 | | Weapon | **+30 spell power**, "by a wide margin" over Crusader Grey · 2026-03-28, Grey · 2026-03-23 | | Shield | +2% block over +7 Stamina Grey · 2025-12-12 |

consumables.heading: Weapon oil, consumables and world buffs
consumables.markdown: | Item | Note | |---|---| | Wizard Oil (Brilliant) | Standard weapon oil. extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 tank loop. The details are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/paladin/protection-tank), [AoE tanking](#/class/paladin/protection-tank), [Cooldowns](#/class/paladin/protection-tank) and [Mana](#/class/paladin/protection-tank). 1. **Before the pull:** Righteous Fury (re-apply it after every death), Sanctity Aura (Retribution Aura if another paladin has Sanctity), your blessing, Seal of Righteousness. Mark the skull Krúsidúlla · 2022-04-28 bela · 2026-03-29, Proph · 2026-02-07. 2. **Pull and first GCDs:** pre-cast Holy Shield → run in (pre-cast Consecration where 3+ mobs will meet you) → active spell-power trinket → **Judgement of Righteousness** → **Holy Strike** → re-seal Righteousness Grey · 2026-03-07, Cobanana · 2026-02-19, Grey · 2026-03-21. The first Holy Strike is the most important GCD of the fight Dodging · 2026-01-04. 3. **Steady threat loop:** 1. **Holy Strike** the moment it is ready. 2. **Judgement** about 2 s later, then re-seal Righteousness. 3. **Holy Shield** when mana permits. 4. Filler: **Consecration** (rank 5 early, then rank 1), then **Exorcism** on Undead and Demons. Never press Crusader Strike for threat Grey · 2026-03-28. 4. **Multiple mobs:** with 2 mobs, no Consecration: Holy Strike the skull, Judgement on the other, tab between them. With **3+**, Consecration first, then the loop on the skull, and tab Judgement, Holy Strike or taunt onto the others. On big pulls, lock mobs one at a time and cast rank-5 Consecration at most 1–2 times per pack Grey · 2026-03-23, Grey · 2026-02-08, Grey · 2026-02-08. For adds that must stick instantly, spam Greater Blessings Grey · 2026-01-23. 5. **Taunt and recovery:** Hand of Reckoning on a mob that leaves you, then Holy Strike it. There is no AoE taunt, so pick up loose mobs with Holy Strike and Judgement. 6. **Defensive cooldowns:** Holy Shield up for every big hit (your crit/crush cap depends on it). Save Bulwark of the Righteous and Greater Stoneshield for known burst. Divine Shield drops your threat, so use it only for mechanics or to avoid dying. Use Blessing of Protection on the other tank or on a DPS with aggro. See [Cooldowns](#/class/paladin/protection-tank). 7. **Mana:** boss tanking is near-infinite. On trash, Seal of Wisdom costs about 30% of your threat. Below about 30% mana, use rank-1 Consecration until you are back at 50% Grey · 2026-03-23, Proph · 2026-02-08. 8. **Avoid:** Consecration on a single target, delaying Holy Strike, swapping off Righteousness on a boss, and forgetting Righteous Fury Grey · 2026-02-24.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for Protection
extraSections.markdown: | Change | Effect on you | Source | |---|---|---| | **Holy Strike** now deals 40% of normalized weapon damage as Physical damage, plus 129–146 Holy damage (rank 8). Spell power coefficient raised from 43% to 71%. Only the Holy portion is boosted by Righteous Fury and Sanctity Aura now | About 10–20% more Holy Strike damage normally and 40–50% at peak buffs for BiS tanks. Fresh-60 tanks with no gear lose a little; with any gear or buffs you roughly break even | [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), goyut1 · 2026-01-25, Lhian · 2026-01-26, Grey · 2026-03-20, Grey · 2026-03-20 | | **Righteous Strikes:** +5..25% Holy Strike damage and threat. Crusader Strike now grants **Zealous Defence**: the next *blocked* attack deals 6..30% less damage | Crusader Strike becomes a defensive button, not a threat button | [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Grey · 2026-01-28 | | **Holy Shield** threat modifier 30% → 50% | More sustained threat when you are being hit | [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) | | **Consecration** front-loaded: ticks go 156% → 140% → … → 44% of the old base. The front-load starts when **each mob enters** the Consecration, not when you cast it | About 600 threat on the first tick and 475 on the second. You can pre-place it safely | [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Grey · 2026-03-21, Grey · 2026-03-23 | | Set bonuses: **T2.5 3-piece** → +15% Judgement of Righteousness. **T3.5**: the old 5-piece (+40% Holy Shield threat) moved to the 3-piece; the new 5-piece is damage reduction while Holy Shield is up (shipped as 3%, previewed as 4%) | Threat set = 3 T2.5 + 3 T3.5; mitigation set = 5 T3.5 + 4 T3 | Grey · 2026-03-19, angels1m · 2026-03-19, Proph · 2026-03-21, Lhian · 2026-03-21 | | New librams: **Libram of the Hallowed Ground** (extra instant Consecration tick, about 4% spell power scaling). Libram swaps now cost a GCD | Use Hallowed Ground for AoE and Eternal Tower for single target | Grey · 2026-04-03, Kindousen · 2026-04-01 | Launch bugs, all fixed or harmless now: - **Improved Righteous Fury seemed to do nothing.** Righteous Fury snapshots your talents when you cast it. After any respec, toggle it off and on Proph · 2026-03-22, donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-22. - **Block value was inverted on auto-attacks for a few days** (you took your block value and blocked the rest). It was caused by Zealous Defence and is fixed Grey · 2026-03-23, Lhian · 2026-03-23. - **Threat meters under-reported Righteous Strikes** until TWThreat updated Mithreon · 2026-03-21. Mechanics that fail silently (not fixed as of the last reports): - **Improved Devotion Aura and Improved Retribution Aura** do nothing until you recast the aura after taking the talent, like the Righteous Fury snapshot above (2026-01) Leo · 2026-01-28. - **Blessing of Sanctuary's absorb is applied before armor,** so the more armor you wear, the less damage it actually saves you (2025-12) Excinerus · 2025-12-06, Excinerus · 2025-12-06. - **Holy Shield can't block spell-damage auto-attacks,** so it does little against elementals that melee with spells (2025-10, pre-1.18.1) Destroses · 2025-10-24. - **Greater Blessings:** only Greater Blessing of Salvation costs a percentage of *base* mana; the others are a flat 250/260/270 mana, according to Grey Grey · 2026-01-19, Grey · 2026-01-19. - **Judgements last 10 s** unless a paladin keeps hitting the target Jesse Potter · 2025-11-19. **Contested:** who refreshes what. Some say any paladin attack, autos included, refreshes every Judgement on the target Mithreon · 2025-11-23, Faithroll · 2025-11-23; others say strikes refresh every Judgement but your auto-attacks refresh only your own Aelgagar · 2025-11-23, Adamant · 2025-11-23.

extraSections.heading: Mana
extraSections.markdown: - Boss tanking is close to **infinite mana** with Blessing of Wisdom, Judgement of Wisdom (from another paladin or when your threat is safe), Shield Specialization and free Holy Strikes. Just avoid wasteful max-rank Holy Shield and Consecration Grey · 2026-02-08. - Trash: Seal of Wisdom and Nordanaar Herbal Tea / Major Mana Potions Grey · 2026-02-08. Seal of Wisdom costs you about 30% of your threat Grey · 2026-03-23. - **Spellstrike items are not needed.** Some tanks run none at all Silverhand · 2026-04-17. **Contested:** a spellstrike ring is fine for comfort before you have Wrath of Cenarius Arle · 2026-04-17. - On Thaddius, judge Wisdom onto the other side's target before the polarity switch, or you will run out of mana angels1m · 2026-01-19.

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Righteous Fury + Holy Shield + taunt in one button** (shift = rank-1 Holy Shield; careful, it can taunt): `#showtooltip Holy Shield` / `/cast [nomybuff:Righteous_Fury] Righteous Fury` / `/cast [mod:shift nocooldown:"Holy_Shield"]Holy Shield(Rank 1)` / `/cast [nocooldown:"Holy_Shield"]Holy Shield; [notargeting:player]Hand of Reckoning` Grey · 2025-12-17 - Put Judgement inside another ability's macro (preferably Holy Strike) instead of a separate button. Judging is free, re-sealing costs a GCD Grey · 2026-01-03. - **TWThreat** (it reads Improved Righteous Fury correctly; KTM did not) Mithreon · 2025-08-22, **Tankalyze** for taunt-resist announcements Dodging · 2025-10-31. - Ranged pull: paladins have no ranged pull. Item 51778 on the Turtle database is the usual answer (about 60 s cooldown) 30 · 2026-02-23, Jesse Potter · 2026-02-23.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Everran (p=143606) gives two separate orders, not one list. The array above is his survival order, the one a tank gears by, in the sequence he enumerates it: stamina first ("Stam until you can survive the tier you are in"), then defense ("Defense is nice but not mendatory" [sic]), then agility ("18 agi is about 1% dodge and 1% crit in raid scenario"), then block chance until the crush cap with Holy Shield. Agility versus defense is a per-point trade rather than a ranking, and he states his own preference the other way: "so i usualy go 15 agi>5def but i pref the def over lower amount of agi (personnal pref)" [sic]. His THREAT order is a separate ranking from the same post, given there as a list: spell power, then agility because of crit, then strength. Spell power is the threat stat — all of a paladin tank's aggro is holy damage. Block on gear plus Holy Shield is the staff-intended route to crush immunity. Defense is wanted but the 440 (420 with Anticipation) crit cap is "often not worth reaching when you consider what you have to sacrifice". Strength is CONTESTED: called irrelevant to threat by Kerenis (p=153860) and defended by others. "Adds X damage to melee attacks" items are valued separately because they trigger Judgement of Wisdom an extra time per swing.

glance.recommendation: Play the **11/33/7** build with **Sanctity Aura** and **Righteous Fury** always on. Your threat is Holy damage scaled by spell power. Press **Holy Strike** on cooldown and never delay it. Use **Judgement of Righteousness** on cooldown and re-seal Righteousness. Add **Consecration** only when more than two mobs are on you, and **Holy Shield** when mana allows. Gear spell power first, then Stamina, then avoidance. Aim for about 7,500–8,000 HP for raid bosses and **102.4% combined avoidance with Holy Shield up** from AQ40 onward. Do not chase 440 Defense.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Main or off-tank in raids, dungeon tank, one of the best AoE and solo farmers

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Strong.** The 1.18.1 Holy Strike and Consecration changes fixed the old high-end threat problem. Players report "threat is already not a problem for prot paladins" Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-11 and about 10% more threat at high-end gear Proph · 2026-03-22. Right after release one raider called paladin "best single target and best aoe tank" Dziadmroz · 2026-03-23. **Contested:** bears are still rated the top tank by some regulars Grey · 2026-03-15, and paladin has no AoE taunt L-star · 2026-04-11

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Easy to play (a short priority list), hard to gear: you juggle threat, HP and avoidance sets per boss Dodging · 2025-12-22

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Huge opener threat (Holy Strike is about 60% of it) Grey · 2026-03-23; strong AoE threat from front-loaded Consecration Grey · 2026-03-23; near-infinite mana on bosses Grey · 2026-02-08; Blessing of Protection, bubble, Cleanse; a reliable taunt

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Low HP on paladin gear, and mitigation mostly from block Grey · 2026-01-21; threat comes almost only from Holy damage, so a missed Holy Strike leaves only Judgement of Righteousness as backup Grey · 2026-03-15; no AoE taunt; no ranged pull without items

glance.rest: "High floor, low ceiling": a decent prot paladin can be the best tank in an average guild. Threat problems mostly show up in the top ~1% of speed-running guilds Silverhand · 2026-03-07, Grey · 2026-03-07. !!! warning "Fake patch news" The 2026-04-01 "next patch" post was an April Fools joke, not a real change. It said Holy Strike becomes a next-swing attack, Crusader Strike loses its cooldown and spellstrikes stop proccing Lhian · 2026-04-01, gastro · 2026-04-01. Nothing in this guide assumes it.

playbooks.title: Holy Paladin (healer)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **38/0/13** raid build. Make **Flash of Light** your main heal. Stand with the melee when the fight allows it, and press **Holy Strike** on cooldown: it heals up to five injured people near you for no net mana. Use **Holy Shock** when someone is about to die, and cast a 1.5-second **Holy Light** after each Judgement for big tank hits. Keep Seal of Wisdom up and judge Wisdom, and you will not run out of mana. | | | |---|---| | Role | Raid and dungeon healer in plate. Tank healing (Flash of Light), free smart AoE healing (Holy Strike), Cleanse (magic, poison and disease), blessings, Lay on Hands, Blessing of Protection, Divine Intervention | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Strong, and still a core raid healer.** It was the strongest paladin spec before the patch Nesushka · 2026-01-21. 1.18.1 cut its AoE healing (Daybreak nerf, T3.5 bonus change, a Holy Strike targeting bug). Players measured about 10% less healing in Kara40 Mithreon · 2026-03-26. The raid comp players recommend is still "2 hpal, 2 resto sham, and then 2-3 slots for sham/priest/dru" Mithreon · 2026-04-09. | | Difficulty | Easy at range (Flash of Light spam). Medium in melee: you need to know which fights allow melee, track positioning, and know which boss abilities silence or stun you | | Strengths | The best mana economy of any healer when you melee-weave Ragnardbd · 2026-04-03, Dzonathan · 2026-03-28. Almost no healing threat Mithreon · 2026-01-16. Free AoE healing, one of only two classes that remove magic from allies, blessings and bubbles Grey · 2026-03-21 | | Weaknesses | Weak AoE healing without Holy Strike. Holy Priests got stronger AoE healing in the same patch Excinerus · 2026-01-24. Melee healing is impossible or dangerous on some fights. Cleanse costs a GCD and hits a single target Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2025-10-30. Healing meters under-report your value Grey · 2026-03-21 | !!! warning "Old guides and fake patch news" - Guides from before 1.18.1 over-rate Holy Strike healing. It used to hit up to 7 targets with the T3.5 set, and Daybreak was stronger Grey · 2026-03-21. - On 2026-04-01 the paladin developer posted a "next patch" list: Holy Strike healing removed, Holy Strike turned into a next-swing attack, spellstrikes no longer proccing. **It was an April Fools joke, not a real change** Lhian · 2026-04-01, tripleXDengine · 2026-04-01. Ignore any guide that treats it as real.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid healer 38/0/13 (recommended) This is Mithreon's build, posted before the patch ("I'm ready for you, 1.18.1") Mithreon · 2026-02-22. He reposted it unchanged after release, including in answer to "any pro hpal that can show me their build?" Mithreon · 2026-04-02, Mithreon · 2026-04-17. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Holy | Divine Intellect | 5/5 | | Holy | Holy Judgement | 3/3 | | Holy | Spiritual Focus | 2/2 | | Holy | Healing Light | 3/3 | | Holy | Sanctity Aura | 1/1 | | Holy | Improved Lay on Hands | 2/2 | | Holy | Illumination | 5/5 | | Holy | Ironclad | 2/2 | | Holy | Divine Favor | 5/5 | | Holy | Holy Shock | 1/1 | | Holy | Holy Power | 3/3 | | Holy | Blessed Strikes | 5/5 | | Holy | Daybreak | 1/1 | | Retribution | Improved Blessings | 5/5 | | Retribution | Improved Judgement | 2/2 | | Retribution | Improved Seal of the Crusader | 3/3 | | Retribution | Blessing of Kings | 1/1 | | Retribution | Pursuit of Justice | 2/2 | Split **38/0/13**, validated with `talent_tool.py` (VALID). [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=05320312005251351--502300012) · code `AoaAZQFQpAYoB--FATAAK` Why these points: - **Holy Judgement 3/3:** each Judgement makes your next Holy Light 1 second faster (2.5 s → 1.5 s). The buff lasts until you use it or die Mithreon · 2026-01-03. This is your "pocket" big heal. - **Blessed Strikes 5/5:** Crusader Strike resets Holy Shock, and Holy Strike's heal gets +100% healing and +25% of healing power. Its coefficient goes from 0.05 to 0.30 Mithreon · 2025-11-07, [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460). Without it, Holy Strike healing is weak Aelgagar · 2026-01-16. - **Ironclad 2/2:** 2% of the armor on your items becomes healing power. It is the reason Holy wears plate and a shield Mithreon · 2026-02-12, Mithreon · 2026-01-03. - **Illumination 5/5:** mana back on crit heals, the core of your mana economy Mithreon · 2025-11-18. 3/5 with about 30% crit already keeps you above 30% mana everywhere except Kara40 Mithreon · 2025-12-20. - **Divine Favor 5/5** is passive in this era: +10..50% Holy Shock crit chance [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460). - **Spiritual Focus 2/2** gives 70% pushback protection. Concentration Aura covers the other 30% Moorea · 2026-03-11, Arle · 2026-03-11. - **Improved Seal of the Crusader** is "for seal duty". **Sanctity Aura** is "for an unfortunate event when you have a smiter in the party" Mithreon · 2026-04-17. Both are the flexible points. - **Improved Blessings + Blessing of Kings:** raid blessings are a large part of why raids bring Holy paladins Grey · 2026-03-21, Grey · 2026-03-23. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Benediction 38/0/13** (most-posted build before the patch) | Benediction 5/5 and Unyielding Faith 1/2 instead of Sanctity Aura, Improved Seal of the Crusader and Pursuit of Justice. Take it if another paladin covers seals and Sanctity | [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=05320302105251351--55200001) · `AoaAYRFQpAYoB--FoQAAI` | Mithreon ("in the end it should look like this") Mithreon · 2025-11-30, Mithreon · 2025-11-09 | | **37/0/14 run-speed** | Benediction 5/5 and Pursuit of Justice 1/2, no Unyielding Faith ("1 point in run speed is whatever") | [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=05320302005251351--552000011) · `AoaAYQFQpAYoB--FoQAAJ` | Mithreon Mithreon · 2026-01-03 | | **Your own mix** | Grey's rule: take 31 Holy points for Blessed Strikes and Holy Shock, plus Improved Blessings, Guardian's Favor and Kings. Choose the rest by personal preference. No calculator code posted | — | Grey · 2026-03-23, Grey · 2026-03-23 | Optional swaps players argue about: - **Improved Lay on Hands vs. the fear-resist talent (Unyielding Faith):** Faithroll skips Improved Lay on Hands, because a single fear-resist proc in a whole run is worth more than it Faithroll · 2025-12-14. Improved Lay on Hands does have a raid use on Maexxna (see Raid notes). - **Sanctity Aura** is not worth taking in raids, where another paladin brings the aura. Take it for dungeons or a Smite priest Destroses · 2025-11-18, Mithreon · 2026-04-17. !!! note "Pre-1.18.1 builds" The talent tree layout did not change in 1.18.1. Builds from late 2025 are still valid, but their reasoning assumed the stronger Daybreak. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Healing power** until about 1,000 Jesse Potter · 2026-01-16. 2. **Spell crit.** It feeds Illumination and Daybreak. At about 1,200 healing power, 1% crit ≈ 30–40 healing power Mithreon · 2025-10-18, keungzhe · 2026-01-06. After the Daybreak nerf, crit is worth somewhat less than before Mithreon · 2026-03-26. 3. **Intellect.** Core stats are "INT, Spell Crit and Healing Power" Dzonathan · 2026-03-28. 4. **Item armor** (plate and a shield) through Ironclad. The effect is real but modest: about 110 healing power in one test with raw gear bela · 2026-03-23, about 180 in full BiS Mithreon · 2025-11-20. 5. **Haste:** stop at about **3–4%**. Flash of Light's cast already matches the GCD, so more haste is wasted on it Infertile · 2026-04-15, Mithreon · 2026-02-12. 6. **Mp5 and Spirit:** low value. A Major Mana Potion is worth more than several points of mp5 angels1m · 2025-12-26, angels1m · 2025-12-26. Spirit is described as viable only for a Holy Light build Numi · 2026-01-14. Caps: none for healing. Hit does nothing for your heals, because Mending Light and the Holy Shock reset both happen on a miss Destroses · 2025-11-17, [Elisleris, 2026-03-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170509#p170509).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target healing (priority list)
rotationSingle.markdown: Setup before the pull: Seal of Wisdom on yourself, Blessing of Wisdom (or your raid assignment), Concentration Aura if you will melee Arle · 2026-03-11. 1. **Target about to die, and no time for a cast:** `Holy Shock` Grey · 2026-04-04. 2. **Tank took a big hit and you have the Holy Judgement buff:** `Holy Light` (1.5 s). Use it on a target that just took 1.5–2k or during haste windows. Some raiders cast one Holy Light per 7 Flash of Lights; others none at all Iseut · 2025-12-07, Iseut · 2025-12-07. 3. **In melee, Holy Strike off cooldown and 3+ people near you injured (but not about to die):** `Holy Strike` Mithreon · 2025-07-29. 4. **Otherwise:** `Flash of Light` on the tank. This is most of your casting Grey · 2026-04-04. 5. **After a 1.5 s Holy Light, or when the Judgement debuff is about to drop:** spend a GCD on Judgement + re-seal instead of another Flash of Light Mithreon · 2025-12-07. 6. **Crusader Strike only when moving and you specifically need a Holy Shock reset.** "Much rather do 2 FoL and 1 shock than 2 shock and 1 CS" Infertile · 2026-03-31, Infertile · 2026-03-31. In PvP and open world, Crusader Strike → Holy Shock is still the burst tool Jesse Potter · 2025-12-05. 7. **Trash downtime:** a rank-1 Flash of Light on the tank is almost free and can crit to leave a Daybreak Vindaven · 2025-10-07, Mccnl1ght · 2025-10-29. Spell ranks: in raids you use max rank almost always Silverhand · 2026-01-02. Keep Holy Shock and the 1.5 s Holy Light at max rank as emergency heals. Holy Light can drop to about rank 6 if you spam it on long-autoattack bosses Mithreon · 2025-10-11. After the patch, reset the ranks in healing addons, because some of them broke auto-ranking Mithreon · 2026-03-22. **Contested: how often to judge for Holy Light.** Vindaven (QuickHeal developer) saves Holy Light for targets under about 40% when you already have the Judgement buff, and otherwise just casts Flash of Light Vindaven · 2025-10-07, Vindaven · 2025-10-07. Raid melee healers judge Wisdom on every pack or boss anyway for mana, so the fast Holy Light comes "once per judgement" for free PraylorSwift · 2026-04-12.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE healing
rotationAoe.markdown: Holy has no AoE heal other than Holy Strike. "Paladin aoe healing is non existent without holy strike/consecration adding to its value" Domy · 2025-12-26. | Situation | Action | |---|---| | 3+ injured players within about 7 yd of you, none about to die | `Holy Strike` on cooldown, then Flash of Light, at most 3 Flash of Lights per Holy Strike Mithreon · 2025-07-29. In practice, run in with the melee, judge and seal Wisdom, spam Flash of Light, and Holy Strike on cooldown. It is "at least 30% of your healing" depending on tier PraylorSwift · 2026-04-12 | | Heavy raid damage that keeps interrupting you (Vaelastrasz) | "3 FoL and 1 HS rotate" Mithreon · 2026-04-03 | | Easy raids | Also keep a Judgement up and use rank-1 Consecration with the Kara10 libram, if you know the fight bela · 2026-04-03 | | Several Holy paladins in one raid | Your Holy Strikes stack into large party-wide coverage. This is the main reason raids bring two or more Mithreon · 2025-12-14 | | 1–2 injured | Single-target list | Holy Strike is a damage dampener, not a save: do not count on it to rescue someone at 20% Mithreon · 2025-12-07.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and utility
cooldowns.markdown: | Cooldown | Use | |---|---| | **Lay on Hands** | Tank emergency. With Improved Lay on Hands it also gives the target +30% item armor; on Maexxna, cast it on the tank just before Web Wrap, for 30% armor through the Web/Enrage window Jesse Potter · 2026-01-28 | | **Divine Intervention** | Maexxna "DI strat": pre-DI a healer, who comes back to heal the MT during Web Wrap. Assign a paladin to DI the same healer before each wrap Grey · 2026-01-28 | | **Divine Shield** | Heals keep working inside the bubble. Use it against Nefarian's fear, or you get breathed and die Mithreon · 2026-01-26. It does not remove Vaelastrasz's Adrenaline Mithreon · 2026-01-26. It is better than Divine Protection for a healer, because Divine Protection disables melee but costs less mana Dodging · 2025-11-03, Oito · 2025-11-03 | | **Blessing of Protection** | Save a DPS who pulled aggro, or bubble casters during AoE damage Grey · 2026-03-21 | | **Cleanse** | One GCD removes magic, poison and disease. Pre-cast it before the Naxx spider-wing poisons Thaodan · 2026-01-14 | | **Blessings** | With 4 paladins: Improved Might, Improved Wisdom, Kings, Salvation angels1m · 2026-02-05. **Blessing of Light** helps only Holy paladins. Skip it unless you have spare paladins dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-06, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-06. If you are the only paladin: Wisdom on yourself, Salvation on everyone else Dzonathan · 2025-11-18 |

roleStrategy.heading: Threat
roleStrategy.markdown: Paladin healing threat is very low. Heals have a -50% modifier, and Holy Light a further -70% Mithreon · 2026-01-16. In practice Holy paladins almost never pull adds Mithreon · 2025-12-04. Holy Shock damage does normal damage threat.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: ### Pre-raid - **Holy is the easiest healer to gear:** about 80% of pre-raid BiS is on the auction house, and half of it is "more than ready for MC" Beldrin · 2025-12-23, Beldrin · 2025-12-23. - **Red Dragonscale set** (Leatherworking): lots of healing power, no Intellect. A good starter set to buy, not mandatory Mithreon · 2026-04-10. Its 4-piece HoT proc can be triggered by Holy Strike's healing Destroses · 2025-10-29. - **Dzonathan's budget list** (mostly from the auction house) Dzonathan · 2025-04-19: | Slot | Item | |---|---| | Weapon | Hammer of Grace (BRD), Crimson Spellblade (Stratholme), or Hand of Edward the Odd (world drop) | | Shield | Defender of Nordrassil (Hyjal quest) or Spellguard's Shield (Dalaran rep) | | Head | Whitesoul Helmet (crafted) | | Shoulders | Dawnbringer Shoulders | | Chest | Verdant Dreamer's Breastplate (Leatherworking) | | Wrist | T1 bracers | | Hands | Gauntlets of the Lost Crusader | Other slots: Corehound/Hide of the Wild pieces, Animated Choker, Fordring's Seal, Time-Shifted Wheel Mima · 2026-01-02. A full pre-raid set reaches about 900 healing Confessor · 2025-09-19. - **Shields** are the best off-hand because of Ironclad. Healing power from armor + stats: Dark Iron Wardguard (Hateforge Quarry) 51, Defender of Nordrassil 61, Draconian Aegis of the Legion (UBRS) 63, Time-Shifting Wheel 82, Red Dragonscale Protector (Vaelastrasz) 92, Wormscale Blocker (Ouro) 90, Death's Bargain (Gluth) 91, Shield of Condemnation (Kel'Thuzad) 127 Aubreykun · 2024-11-02. Keep Death's Bargain until you get a Kara40 shield Mithreon · 2025-11-18. ### Raid progression | Phase | Recommendation | Source | |---|---|---| | MC | T1 3-piece is good. T1 5-piece is OK. **8/8 T1 is not worth it** (the 8-piece proc was nerfed from 50% to about 10–15%) | Mithreon · 2025-11-04, Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-03-24, Destroses · 2026-03-31 | | BWL | **T2 3-piece** is a top bonus, about +19 healing power per piece. Recommended mix: 3 T1 + 3 T2 (T2 helm) + Wild Growth + Empowered Leggings. Mithreon's math has the T2-helm version at 507 healing / 11.8% crit, vs 458 / 13.8% with Mish'undare | Iseut · 2026-01-06, Mithreon · 2026-03-26, Mithreon · 2026-03-26 | | AQ40 / Naxx | T3 2-piece is "great". Full 8/8 T3 is only for dispel-heavy fights (Viscidus). Otherwise run 5–6 T3 + 3 T2 | Mithreon · 2025-11-04, Mithreon · 2025-10-13 | | Kara40 | **T3.5 is still the most stat-heavy set** and BiS. The heal reaches only about 7.6 yd McSavage · 2026-03-03. - Meleeing fights with melee stuns, silences or knockbacks. extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 healing loop. The details are in [Single-target healing](#/class/paladin/holy-healer), [AoE healing](#/class/paladin/holy-healer), [Melee or range](#/class/paladin/holy-healer), [Cooldowns and utility](#/class/paladin/holy-healer) and [Mana management](#/class/paladin/holy-healer). 1. **Setup:** Seal of Wisdom on yourself, your assigned blessing, and Concentration Aura if you will melee Arle · 2026-03-11. Decide per fight whether you melee: mirror the melee DPS Dzonathan · 2025-11-16. 2. **Default heal by damage pattern:** - **Tank damage:** Flash of Light, which is most of your casting Grey · 2026-04-04. After a Judgement, a 1.5 s Holy Light for a big hit. - **Spot damage:** Flash of Light on the target. If they are about to die, use Holy Shock. - **Group/raid-wide damage in melee range:** Holy Strike on cooldown with at most 3 Flash of Lights between strikes. It heals up to 4 wounded allies within about 7.6 yd and you for no net mana Mithreon · 2025-07-29, McSavage · 2026-03-03. - **Group/raid-wide damage at range:** Flash of Light spam. You have no other AoE heal. 3. **Triage order:** someone about to die → **Holy Shock**. Tank took a big hit and you have the Holy Judgement buff → **Holy Light**. 3+ hurt near you → **Holy Strike**. Everyone else → **Flash of Light** Grey · 2026-04-04. 4. **Keep up:** Seal of Wisdom, and Judgement of Wisdom on a long-lived target. Spend a GCD on Judgement + re-seal after a fast Holy Light or when the debuff is about to drop Mithreon · 2025-12-07. On trash downtime, a rank-1 Flash of Light on the tank can crit and leave a Daybreak Mccnl1ght · 2025-10-29. 5. **Mana plan:** Seal/Judgement of Wisdom, Holy Strike, Illumination, Major Mana Potions and Nordanaar tea Dzonathan · 2026-03-28. Do not spam max-rank Holy Light Mithreon · 2025-11-06. Use Crusader Strike only when moving and you need a Holy Shock reset Mithreon · 2026-03-31. 6. **Cooldowns:** Lay on Hands on a dying tank. Divine Shield keeps you healing through fear or lethal mechanics. Blessing of Protection saves a DPS who has aggro. Divine Intervention is for planned strats such as Maexxna, and for wipe recovery (vanilla baseline). 7. **Dispels and utility:** Cleanse removes magic, poison and disease, but it costs a GCD, so pre-cast it before known debuffs. Blessings follow the raid assignment Thaodan · 2026-01-14, angels1m · 2026-02-05.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for Holy
extraSections.markdown: | Change | Effect on you | Source | |---|---|---| | Daybreak base healing 289 → 248, and its scaling cut | The nerf costs about 16% of base healing and 26% of scaling. Crit is worth less than before, and parse-level Holy Strike and Holy Shock numbers dropped | Mithreon · 2026-01-24, Grey · 2026-03-21, [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) | | Holy T3.5 5-piece no longer adds Holy Strike targets or its +40% | The top-end AoE healing of T3.5 raiders was the main target of the nerf | Grey · 2026-03-21, [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) | | Libram swaps now cost a GCD | Swapping librams mid-rotation to fish for crits is no longer worth it for a healer | Mithreon · 2026-01-31, Mithreon · 2026-01-31 | | Launch bugs (see below) | For about three weeks Holy Strike healed less than intended | Mithreon · 2026-03-21, Fabian · 2026-03-27 | Developers gave the reason for the nerf: raids were skipping too much damage because of Daybreak and T3.5 healing. No compensation was planned Mithreon · 2026-01-25. ### Launch bugs and their status - **Mending Light (Holy Strike's heal) was missing its base 5% healing-power scaling** and did not heal when the strike missed, was dodged or was parried. Lhian confirmed it ("base scaling is missing") Lhian · 2026-03-22. It was fixed around 2026-03-23/24 Mithreon · 2026-03-23, [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139). - **For about 3 hours at launch Holy Strike had no target cap**, so logs from that window overstate its healing Grey · 2026-03-30. - **Holy Strike healed full-health players** and ignored the wounded ones. Logs showed heal events per cast halving (49 casts → 166 heals before the patch, 36 casts → 72 after) Infertile · 2026-03-26. Lhian said "this will be fixed" Lhian · 2026-03-28. The intended behaviour is that Holy Strike heals **wounded** party members, not the **most** wounded Destroses · 2026-04-02. Players reported it healing the right number of people again after the 2026-04-08 reset Sookie · 2026-04-09, and it was called fixed on 2026-04-12 Mithreon · 2026-04-12. Treat it as a semi-smart heal. It will not always pick the lowest player, so move to where the injured players are. - **Holy Shock heals about 20% less since the 2026-04-07 reset.** Players reported healing 1k less per cast Sookie · 2026-04-09, Mithreon · 2026-04-09. It was still unfixed on 2026-04-19 ronron · 2026-04-19. - **Ironclad was never bugged.** A lower healing-power number on your character sheet comes from an outdated BetterCharacterStats addon Grey · 2026-03-26, Grey · 2026-03-23.
