extraSections.markdown: | Spell | What it does | Source | |---|---|---| | **Flash of Light** | 1.5 s cast, which matches the GCD. Your main heal and very mana-efficient. Rank 7 heals 428–493 for 180 mana | Mithreon · 2026-01-03, [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102969#p102969) | | **Holy Light** | 2.5 s cast, 1.5 s after a Judgement (Holy Judgement 3/3). Big but expensive: in BiS gear you get only about 20 casts before you are out of mana | Mithreon · 2026-01-03, Mithreon · 2025-10-22 | | **Holy Shock** | Instant, 20 s cooldown. Crusader Strike resets it (Blessed Strikes). It can also reset itself on a crit (5% + 1% per 100 healing power). Divine Favor adds up to +50% crit chance | Mithreon · 2025-11-18, [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460) | | **Holy Strike / Mending Light** | A melee strike that heals you (half amount) and up to 4 wounded allies near you. It will not heal full-health players; if nobody is hurt, it only deals damage | Iron-Bound · 2025-12-14, Mithreon · 2026-03-06, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-06 | | Holy Strike range | The tooltip says 10 yd, but in testing the heal stops at about **7.6 yd** from you. The heal rolls its own **spell** crit | dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-04-10 | | **Daybreak** (capstone) | A crit heal leaves an "aftershock" on the target, a Flash of Light-sized heal that fires the next time they take damage | Mithreon · 2025-11-18 | | **Illumination** | Mana back on crit heals. It triggers on Holy Shock's heal, not on its damage | Mithreon · 2025-11-18, Grey · 2026-03-18 | | **Ironclad** | 2% of **item** armor becomes healing power (Devotion Aura, Toughness and enchants do not count). Every 50 armor ≈ 1 healing power | Destroses · 2026-01-11, Silverhand · 2026-02-12 | | **Judgement of Light** | Heals whoever hits the judged target. extraSections.heading: Melee or range: choosing per fight
extraSections.markdown: "Melee holy is the same as ordinary holy, you just become aware that pressing holy strike between flash of lights is better than only doing flash of lights" L-star · 2026-04-12. Stay at range, doing pure Flash of Light spam, whenever melee is unsafe. That is "only a few fights" gastro · 2026-03-14. - **Melee freely:** fights with predictable damage and a melee stack. Heigan ("100% do it"), Patchwerk, Loatheb Dodging · 2026-03-14; Mephistroth Iseut · 2025-05-19; Anomalus, where the raid stacks Mithreon · 2025-09-04. - **Stay at range:** Rupturan Iseut · 2025-06-11, Kruul (too fast for the small heals to matter) Mithreon · 2025-09-29, and anything with melee stuns, silences, knockbacks or fear. **Contested:** some Holy paladins call Abyssal Lords, Ragnaros, Geddon and Onyxia phase 2 "unmeleeable", while others melee-heal all of them Mima · 2025-12-26, Domy · 2025-12-26. A forum list of fights where melee is unsafe (Gehennas, Garr adds, Shazzrah, Sulfuron, Majordomo, Ragnaros, Razorgore, Broodlord, Chromaggus, Nefarian, Bug Trio, Sartura, Twins, C'Thun) is the safe default for a new player [Atreidon, 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144592#p144592). - **Rule of thumb:** mirror the melee DPS. If they run in, you run in; if they leave, you leave Dzonathan · 2025-11-16.

extraSections.heading: Mana management
extraSections.markdown: - **Seal of Wisdom → Judgement of Wisdom → Seal of Wisdom, Holy Strike, Illumination, Major Mana Potions and tea.** This is "plenty enough for Paladin to never run out of mana" Dzonathan · 2026-03-28. - **Nordanaar Herbal Tea** (Hyjal, 5 for 1 small Dream Shard) restores about 600 health and 1,100 mana on a 2-minute cooldown, separate from potions Grey · 2026-03-23. - In raids with few long-lived targets (MC), keep Judgement of Wisdom on one big target. With lots of short trash (Kara10), just keep Seal of Wisdom up Silverhand · 2025-12-22. - Flash of Light is cheap: rank 1 is mana-positive with Dark Runes and Major Mana Potions Grey · 2026-01-14. - The classic mistake is spamming max-rank Holy Light Mithreon · 2025-11-06. Under-geared healers also struggle with max-rank Flash of Light spam in MC Mithreon · 2025-10-22.

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Mouse-over Holy Shock** (works on unit frames): `/run i=(GetMouseFocus().unit) if i then ClearTarget() CastSpellByName("Holy Shock") SpellTargetUnit(i) TargetLastTarget() else CastSpellByName("Holy Shock") end` Sidiros · 2026-03-02 - **Self-Holy Shock on a modifier:** `/script if IsAltKeyDown() or IsControlKeyDown() or IsShiftKeyDown() then TargetUnit("player"); CastSpellByName("Holy Shock"); TargetLastTarget(); else CastSpellByName("Holy Shock"); end` Ruth · 2025-09-24 - **PallyPower** to assign blessings per class donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-02-03. **A raid-frame addon** (for example Puppeteer) is a big help for melee healing Mithreon · 2026-01-16. **Update BetterCharacterStats** so it shows Ironclad Grey · 2026-03-23. - **QuickHeal** (heal automation) is allowed, but some players find it distasteful and uninstall it Yappa · 2026-04-09. Combined with Nampower it can mis-cast a self Holy Light after Holy Shock or Holy Strike Faithroll · 2025-12-05.

extraSections.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **Dungeons:** melee-weaving matters "arguably more for 5-mans than raids" Jesse Potter · 2026-04-04. Watch for mobs that silence in melee PraylorSwift · 2026-04-12. - **[Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core):** Magmadar: stay on the dog and use Fire Protection Potions before and during the fight (you will get feared into fire). Shazzrah: an Arcane Protection Potion, and do not cast into his Counterspell. Geddon: Fire Protection Potion, run from Inferno (you can bubble through it). Ragnaros: move out and back in on the knockback Dzonathan · 2025-11-16. - **[Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair)** (Mithreon's walkthrough) Mithreon · 2026-01-26: - Razorgore can stun in melee: use a Free Action Potion or bubble. - Vaelastrasz: 3 Flash of Light + 1 Holy Strike. With Adrenaline, hide behind the left column (bubble does not help). - The suppression room is a mana gauntlet. - Firemaw: Holy Shock the active tank on the breath. - Chromaggus: dispel everything and bring about 3 Hourglass Sand. You can bubble off the bronze debuff yourself to save a Sand Beldrin · 2026-01-26. - Nefarian: bubble the fear. - **Naxxramas:** - Loatheb: Holy Strike heals through the healing lockout, but Daybreak does not fire while you are silenced Mithreon · 2026-01-19. With a full-mitigation tank, melee healing "trivializes the healer mechanic" Iseut · 2025-06-11. - Maexxna: use Divine Intervention and Lay on Hands (see Cooldowns). - Spider wing: pre-cast Cleanse Thaodan · 2026-01-14. - Heigan: melee-heal Dodging · 2026-03-14. - **[Tower of Karazhan (Kara40)](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan):** - Flash of Light spam alone can heal through Kara40 Mithreon · 2025-10-15. - Anomalus: you need an arcane-resist set, and mail resist pieces keep more healing power than plate ones Mithreon · 2025-07-13. - Kruul and Rupturan: heal from range (see above). - Mephistroth: safe to melee-heal. - **[Onyxia's Lair](#/instances/onyxias-lair):** some Holy paladins stand in the melee group and alternate Holy Shock on the main tank with Crusader Strike Stanley · 2026-03-24.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Healing power first ("a great stat for everyone"; Holy Strike scales with it too), then flat item armor on plate because Ironclad converts it, then spell crit (it applies Daybreak, procs Illumination and drives Mending Light, but overhealing limits its value), then mp5 and Spirit, which are low. Haste is nearly useless because Flash of Light sits on the global cooldown, and hit is not needed for heals. mp5 and Spirit are a tie: no cited post ranks them against each other, so their order in the array above carries no ranking. Grouping them is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.

glance.recommendation: Play the **38/0/13** raid build. Make **Flash of Light** your main heal. Stand with the melee when the fight allows it, and press **Holy Strike** on cooldown: it heals up to five injured people near you for no net mana. Use **Holy Shock** when someone is about to die, and cast a 1.5-second **Holy Light** after each Judgement for big tank hits. Keep Seal of Wisdom up and judge Wisdom, and you will not run out of mana.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Raid and dungeon healer in plate. Tank healing (Flash of Light), free smart AoE healing (Holy Strike), Cleanse (magic, poison and disease), blessings, Lay on Hands, Blessing of Protection, Divine Intervention

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Strong, and still a core raid healer.** It was the strongest paladin spec before the patch Nesushka · 2026-01-21. 1.18.1 cut its AoE healing (Daybreak nerf, T3.5 bonus change, a Holy Strike targeting bug). Players measured about 10% less healing in Kara40 Mithreon · 2026-03-26. The raid comp players recommend is still "2 hpal, 2 resto sham, and then 2-3 slots for sham/priest/dru" Mithreon · 2026-04-09.

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Easy at range (Flash of Light spam). Medium in melee: you need to know which fights allow melee, track positioning, and know which boss abilities silence or stun you

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: The best mana economy of any healer when you melee-weave Ragnardbd · 2026-04-03, Dzonathan · 2026-03-28. Almost no healing threat Mithreon · 2026-01-16. Free AoE healing, one of only two classes that remove magic from allies, blessings and bubbles Grey · 2026-03-21

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Weak AoE healing without Holy Strike. Holy Priests got stronger AoE healing in the same patch Excinerus · 2026-01-24. Melee healing is impossible or dangerous on some fights. Cleanse costs a GCD and hits a single target Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2025-10-30. Healing meters under-report your value Grey · 2026-03-21

glance.rest: !!! warning "Old guides and fake patch news" - Guides from before 1.18.1 over-rate Holy Strike healing. It used to hit up to 7 targets with the T3.5 set, and Daybreak was stronger Grey · 2026-03-21. - On 2026-04-01 the paladin developer posted a "next patch" list: Holy Strike healing removed, Holy Strike turned into a next-swing attack, spellstrikes no longer proccing. **It was an April Fools joke, not a real change** Lhian · 2026-04-01, tripleXDengine · 2026-04-01. Ignore any guide that treats it as real.

playbooks.title: Retribution Paladin (melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **11/8/32** Retribution build and pick your seal by your gear. With spell power gear and a proc weapon, run **Seal of Righteousness ("spellret", SoR)**. With Strength gear and a slow, hard-hitting two-hander, run **Seal of Command (SoC)**. The talents differ by only a few points. "Seal of crusader is exclusively judged for the 130sp bonus. If you stack spellpower gear, you run seal of righteousness; if you stack strength, you run seal of command" Grey · 2026-03-26. After 1.18.1 both are real raid specs: "all 3 specs of pally are fully raid viable, ret is an actual dps spec now" Destroses · 2026-03-27. SoR is still slightly ahead at the top: "Top 4/5 in K40 is SoR, 3rd being SoC since patch" Jesse Potter · 2026-04-13. **Necrodin** (double Tier 2 3-piece plus the Lost set) is a third, niche build for long single-target fights. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee DPS; Blessings, Judgement debuffs, Hand of Freedom/Protection, Cleanse, Repentance | | Viability (1.18.1) | **B (raid)**: about 1.8k DPS on Patchwerk-type fights, best log 2.3k Grey · 2026-03-27, Grey · 2026-03-27; in Kara40 on par with druids and shamans, behind the top specs Mithreon · 2026-04-03, Mithreon · 2026-04-03 | | Difficulty | Medium: few buttons, but seal uptime on every swing and buff upkeep separate a good Ret from a bad one Beldrin · 2025-10-25 | | Strengths | Garbage-disposal gearing: almost any Strength, spell power, crit or hit item works Grey · 2026-03-06; fun and very powerful while leveling Perrapys · 2025-12-04; SoR adds real AoE through Consecration Excinerus · 2026-01-26 | | Weaknesses | Slow ramp (Zeal, Holy Might, Vengeance) that hurts on short fights Mithreon · 2026-04-03; heavy Windfury Totem dependence dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-12-02; expensive consumables Jesse Potter · 2025-12-02; low health (about 3.2k for a near-BiS Ret) Pastor · 2025-12-23 |

talents.heading: Talent builds
talents.markdown: ### Seal of Righteousness "spellret", 11/8/32 (recommended) Mithreon's current SoR build, reposted after 1.18.1 Mithreon · 2026-04-10 and pinned in the same form before it Mithreon · 2025-11-18. "11/8/32 should be the standard on MC/BWL gear regardless of spec" (Beldrin) Beldrin · 2026-01-06. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Holy | Divine Strength | 5/5 | | Holy | Improved Seal of Righteousness | 5/5 | | Holy | Sanctity Aura | 1/1 | | Protection | Improved Devotion Aura | 5/5 | | Protection | Precision | 3/3 | | Retribution | Benediction | 5/5 | | Retribution | Improved Judgement | 2/2 | | Retribution | Improved Seal of the Crusader | 3/3 | | Retribution | Conviction | 5/5 | | Retribution | Blessing of Kings | 1/1 | | Retribution | Pursuit of Justice | 2/2 | | Retribution | Two-Handed Weapon Specialization | 3/3 | | Retribution | Vengeance | 5/5 | | Retribution | Vengeful Strikes | 5/5 | | Retribution | Repentance | 1/1 | Split **11/8/32**, validated (VALID). [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=5000501-503-0523005123005051) · code `FAAoB-FAY-AoTAFKYAFAFAB` ### Seal of Command "AP Ret", 11/8/32 The same tree with **Divine Intellect** instead of Improved Seal of Righteousness, **Seal of Command** 1/1, and Pursuit of Justice 1/2 Mithreon · 2026-04-10. "Talent build for SoC is the same as SoR build but remove points from Improved SoR" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-16. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Holy | Divine Strength | 5/5 | | Holy | Divine Intellect | 5/5 | | Holy | Sanctity Aura | 1/1 | | Protection | Improved Devotion Aura | 5/5 | | Protection | Precision | 3/3 | | Retribution | Benediction | 5/5 | | Retribution | Improved Judgement | 2/2 | | Retribution | Improved Seal of the Crusader | 3/3 | | Retribution | Conviction | 5/5 | | Retribution | Blessing of Kings | 1/1 | | Retribution | Pursuit of Justice | 1/2 | | Retribution | Two-Handed Weapon Specialization | 3/3 | | Retribution | Vengeance | 5/5 | | Retribution | Seal of Command | 1/1 | | Retribution | Vengeful Strikes | 5/5 | | Retribution | Repentance | 1/1 | Split **11/8/32**, validated (VALID). [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=paladin&t=5500001-503-0523005113005151) · code `FoAAB-FAY-AoTAFJYAFIFAB` ### Why these points, and what you may change - **Sanctity Aura (Holy, 11-point sink)** is in every Ret build: +10% Holy damage for you and your group Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-04. If another paladin in your group already brings it, you may skip it Achmodeus · 2025-11-18. - **Improved Devotion Aura is only a path to Precision.** Row 1 of Protection needs 5 points first. Redoubt works just as well; "Does not really matter. you dont use ether" Trojh · 2026-04-16, Olivaar of Moments · 2026-04-16, Olivaar of Moments · 2026-03-23. - **Precision (3% hit)** is a crutch for the hit cap. SoC builds cannot drop it until Tier 3 gear; SoR builds move those points into Improved Seal of Righteousness once gear covers hit (Tier 3.5 alone gives 3%) Jesse Potter · 2026-01-06, Beldrin · 2026-01-06, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-06. If you cannot reach the hit cap even with Precision, Lightbourne's advice is to drop the Protection tree entirely Grey · 2026-03-23. - **Improved Blessings: never on SoR, only on SoC with enough gear hit.** "Ret should never take Improved Blessings (leave that to healers) unless running SoC with enough hit already on gear" gastro · 2026-01-06, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-06. Jesse Potter's 13/0/38 SoC build takes 5/5 Improved Blessings and 2/2 Unyielding Faith instead of the Protection points Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30, Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30. - **Benediction** is weak in raids ("like 5 wasted talents") but it is a prerequisite path and helps while duoing or leveling Faithroll · 2025-12-14, Jesse Potter · 2025-12-14. - **Improved Seal of the Crusader** only matters if you are the paladin who judges Crusader; the talent improves the debuff only when you apply it Silverhand · 2025-12-22. It is for "seal duty"; skip it if someone else reliably judges Crusader Mithreon · 2026-04-17, Silverhand · 2026-04-16. - **Vindication is a trap:** it does not work on bosses Destroses · 2025-10-25, Isvash · 2026-04-10. Prefer Pursuit of Justice or Parry Jesse Potter · 2026-01-09. - **Improved Retribution Aura** is great while leveling and useless in a raid DPS spot Arle · 2026-02-08. If a Protection paladin runs with you, ask them to take it: "Basically every sor ret that runs with a prot paladin should have imp ret aura" Grey · 2026-03-26. - **Two-Handed Weapon Specialization** does not boost polearms by design (Lhian) theoloras/warkrak · 2025-12-15. - **Necrodin** uses the same 11/8/32 split: "typical 11/8/32 split, didn't bother resetting talents from my standard ret setup" Iseut · 2026-03-14, Beldrin · 2026-04-07. - **AoE farming** uses 0/26/25 (Reckoning and Holy Shield in Protection, Improved Retribution Aura and Vengeance in Retribution) Destroses · 2026-04-08; see [Leveling](#/class/paladin/leveling).

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: | Build | Priority | |---|---| | **SoR** | Hit to 8% > spell power > haste ≈ Strength > crit to about 30% buffed. SP enchants beat 1% haste enchants on helm, legs and gloves, unless you carry Nightfall theoloras/warkrak · 2026-04-11; "spell power > attack speed > physical stats, but don't stack pure SP" Iseut · 2026-01-09. You "dont really care about spell hit or crit" Iseut · 2026-03-20 | | **SoC** | Hit to 8% > crit to ~33% unbuffed > haste > Strength > spell power > attack power > Agility (Mithreon) Mithreon · 2026-03-27. Beldrin's short form: "8% hit > crit = ap > haste" Beldrin · 2026-03-28. "If not 30% crit unbuffed go agi. Else str everywhere" Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-06 | | **Necrodin** | Attack speed and proc count; spell power matters little Excinerus · 2026-01-11 | **Caps and numbers:** - **Melee hit cap: 8%** against raid bosses, for one- and two-handers alike Destroses · 2025-11-08. Missing an auto also loses that swing's seal Mithreon · 2025-10-11. - **Weapon skill:** every point above 300 is 0.2% hit and reduces glancing damage, up to 315 Mithreon · 2025-12-31; "5 weapon skill = 1% hit" Dodging · 2026-04-01. 310 is plenty for SoR; 315 is good for SoC; above 315 is wasted Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-03-30. The +5 weapon-skill book is a 250g quest on Fray Island, per weapon type Shucky · 2025-12-30, TRUE HEIR · 2026-03-12. - **Glancing blows** stay at ~40% of your autos; weapon skill only reduces their penalty (95% damage at 315) Jesse Potter · 2026-02-03. - **SoC crit targets:** 33% unbuffed, or ~51% if your raid has Rogue and feral Druid crit buffs; values in between are the weak spot Jesse Potter · 2026-01-21, Jesse Potter · 2026-04-10. **Contested:** whether these "breakpoints" matter over a whole raid rather than one short fight Jesse Potter · 2026-02-03, Proph · 2026-02-03. - **SoR crit:** 20-30% fully buffed is enough; above that, 25 Strength beats more crit Jesse Potter · 2025-10-21, Jesse Potter · 2025-12-04. - **Haste** stacks multiplicatively across sources Not Normal · 2026-02-07 and scales SoC damage almost 1:1 because SoC procs off autos Grey · 2026-01-09. A haste point only counts if it adds a whole swing over the fight Mithreon · 2026-03-14. - **Strength** is multiplied by Kings, Divine Strength and Holy Might Mithreon · 2025-11-07; 300 Strength is roughly 1200 attack power for Ret Jesse Potter · 2026-04-14. - **Spell hit, spell crit and spell penetration** barely matter. Everything except Exorcism, Holy Wrath and Consecration uses the melee hit table Silverhand · 2026-02-06; spell crit only affects Ashbringer's proc, Exorcism and Holy Wrath Mithreon · 2026-03-14; nothing resists Holy Mithreon · 2025-10-28.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### The one rule **Every auto-attack must land with a seal active.** Judge right after an auto lands, then re-seal before the next one; if a Judgement would leave the next swing seal-less, delay it Dodging · 2025-10-16, theoloras/warkrak · 2026-02-12. A log review found one raider with no Seal of Righteousness on half of his swings Beldrin · 2025-10-25. A swing timer addon is close to mandatory: "playing ret properly without a swing timer is borderline insanity" Beldrin · 2026-03-23. ### Opener (boss) 1. Pre-pull: Blessings, **Sanctity Aura** (Retribution Aura until you have it Grey · 2026-03-23), your seal, `/startattack`. 2. While running in: Exorcism at 30 yards (Undead/Demon), **Repentance** at 20 yards, Judgement at 10 yards Excinerus · 2025-10-25. 3. **Judge Seal of the Crusader** (only if you are the Crusader judge), re-seal SoR or SoC. Do not judge Crusader on trash that dies in two GCDs Perudo · 2026-03-20, donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-20. 4. **Holy Strike first**: Holy damage ignores the armor that Sunder Armor has not yet removed, and its Holy Might Strength buff makes the next Holy Strike stronger Jesse Potter · 2026-03-18, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-14. 5. Crusader Strike to stack Zeal; pop trinkets, Juju and haste potions a few GCDs in, once Vengeance, Zeal and armor debuffs are up Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30. ### Priority (SoR; bot-ready) Adapted from the community APL forsooth · 2026-03-18 and the coaching rules of Beldrin and Grey Beldrin · 2026-03-23, Beldrin · 2026-03-23, Grey · 2026-03-16: 1. **Seal of Righteousness** if it is missing and an auto will land within the GCD. 2. **Holy Strike** if Zeal is at 3 stacks and Holy Might has ≤ 6 s left (or is missing). 3. **Crusader Strike** if Zeal has < 3 stacks or expires within 4 s. 4. **Judgement** (Righteousness, or your assigned Judgement) only if (a) an auto just landed, so the seal is back before the next one, and (b) Crusader/Holy Strike is not about to come off cooldown. Re-seal immediately. 5. **Exorcism** on Undead and Demons. 6. **Hammer of Wrath** below 20% health, if it will not delay a strike. Many top players skip it; it is low damage for its mana Mithreon · 2025-11-21. 7. **Crusader Strike or Holy Strike**, whichever hits harder on this target (see below), to keep both buffs rolling. 8. **Repentance** on cooldown on bosses that are immune to its stun; "free damage is free damage" Beldrin · 2025-11-13. It resets your swing timer, which swing addons do not show Peberro · 2026-03-23. 9. **Consecration** only with spare mana: on 2+ targets, or on a single target in high-tier gear Jesse Potter · 2026-04-10, Mithreon · 2025-11-28. Never let a strike sit off cooldown for long: "Extending your 6sec CD into a 9sec CD is rarely worth it" Grey · 2026-03-16. **Crusader Strike or Holy Strike? (contested after 1.18.1).** The damage of each strike matters less than the buffs: "once you have max zeal and holy might, you just keep both buffs up" Protoman · 2026-04-16. On top of that: - Against a fully Sundered raid boss, Crusader Strike usually hits harder: "Even with demonbane, CS>HS, unless noone sunders" K24 · 2026-03-24. - Some spellrets find Holy Strike stronger after the patch: "for Spell Ret HS is out damaging CS against raid bosses now" Aljeron · 2026-03-24, and some top SoR players drop Crusader Strike entirely forsooth · 2026-04-16. Istenneveben's summary: keep both buffs, then "spam whichever ability hits harder", which depends on armor, your spell power and weapon damage Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-21, Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-21. - On trash, Holy Strike first (no Sunders yet); skip Holy Might entirely on packs that die before it pays off Grey · 2026-03-16. - Nazeth's tie-breaker: with **SoC** keep Holy Might ahead of Zeal (weapon-damage scaling); with **SoR** keep Zeal ahead of Holy Might (haste = more SoR hits) Nazeth · 2026-03-14. A one-button macro picks the strike for you (it fails if you are at the buff cap and Holy Might is hidden) donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-23, donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-23: ``` #showtooltip /cast [nomybuff:"Holy Might"] Holy Strike /cast [mybuff:"Holy Might"] Crusader Strike ``` ### SoC differences - Same priority with Seal of Command and Judgement of Command. Judge right after an auto so the next swing still gets its SoC roll Jesse Potter · 2026-03-10. - Jesse Potter's SoC boss opener (pre-1.18.1): Repentance → Seal of the Crusader → Judge Crusader → Seal of Command → Crusader Strike → Consecration → Crusader Strike → Perception, Juju and trinket → Holy Strike, then Judgement, Consecration and Exorcism on cooldown, Crusader Strike on cooldown with a Holy Strike every third strike Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30. - SoC Ret is mana-tight on long fights and trash; on trash only, a few swings with Seal of Wisdom refill mana Jesse Potter · 2025-12-14. ### Necrodin differences - Crusader Strike until 3 Zeal, then spam Holy Strike, refresh Zeal as needed: "CS until 3 zeal stacks > spam HS > refresh zeal" Beldrin · 2026-02-11; for one-handed Necrodin "HS is stronger" Arle · 2026-03-14. - Swap to your normal SoR/SoC set on trash; Necrodin is weak on trash, and its summons break crowd control Destroses · 2026-02-16, Pastor · 2026-03-24.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown: Consecration is the Ret's only AoE, it scales only with spell power, and that is why SoR wins on multi-target fights Beldrin · 2025-10-17, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-23. | Targets | Play | |---|---| | 1 | Single-target priority; no Consecration unless you have excess mana | | 2-3 | Single-target priority on the Judgement of Wisdom target; add Consecration if mana allows Mithreon · 2026-01-19 | | 4+ | Consecration on cooldown (downrank to rank 1 when mana is short Grey · 2026-04-04), then the single-target loop on the target that lives longest | - Stay on the target you judged with Wisdom; switching targets costs mana Beldrin · 2026-03-23. - Zeal falls off between packs; keep pulls fast and use Crusader Strike on fresh adds (a warlock pet is fine) to keep the stacks angels1m · 2025-12-04. - Goblin Sapper Charges add a flat 500-600 damage on AoE pulls Jesse Potter · 2025-10-17. - Holy Wrath is only worth pressing against Undead packs such as Nefarian's skeletons dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-03-17, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-17.

cooldowns.heading: Mana and resources
cooldowns.markdown: - **Judgement of Wisdom** is the mana engine. SoR builds need 1-2 spellstrike items with a one-hander, 2-3 with a two-hander, when no Windfury/Flametongue Totem is present; the Fiery and Lifestealing enchants count as spellstrikes Destroses · 2026-04-04. Example: Ring of Electrical Binding + JoW + SoR = 4 chances at +59 mana per swing Excinerus · 2026-04-10. - If another paladin keeps Judgement of Wisdom up, you can judge Crusader or Righteousness instead Beldrin · 2026-03-23, Jesse Potter · 2026-04-10. - **When you run out of mana** (Grey's order, stop at the step that fixes it): 1) more teas and mana potions, 2) Consecration rank 1, 3) Holy Strike instead of Crusader Strike as filler, 4) stop casting Judgement of Righteousness, 5) stop casting Consecration. "Going past step 3 means something is up" Grey · 2026-04-04. - On the last 1-2 mobs of a trash pack, swap to Seal of Wisdom for a swing or two Beldrin · 2026-03-23. - **Buff cap:** Zeal and Vengeance take several buff slots; at the cap, extra buffs still work but go invisible, which breaks buff-checking macros Grey · 2026-02-04, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-07. Cancel low-value buffs (Blessing of Light, Blessing of Sanctuary, Thorns, Healing Way, Inspiration) with an auto-cancel addon Jesse Potter · 2026-02-07.

roleStrategy.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Fire-immune bosses** (Ragnaros, Firemaw, Ebonroc, Flamegor, Nefarian, Onyxia, and others) take nothing from fire procs, so fire-proc weapons and the Ring of Burning Talons are weaker in [Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core) and [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair) Jesse Potter · 2026-02-01. Swap Dragonbreath Chili for other food there Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-04. - **Fire-vulnerable Chromaggus and Firemaw**: Rets rip threat; one died at 1.6k DPS, another capped at 1.7k because of threat Peberro · 2026-04-13, Jesse Potter · 2026-04-14. Watch the threat meter when damage-taken debuffs are up. - **Nefarian's paladin class call**: any paladin's Blessing of Protection or Divine Shield clears it 30 · 2026-02-13. - **Naxx, Feugen and Stalagg**: Ret goes to the left miniboss Wzz · 2026-04-13, theoloras/warkrak · 2026-04-13. - **AQ40 Twin Emperors**: automate the Crusader/Holy Strike upkeep and use the switch window: leave with ~4 s to spare after a fresh Consecration and a Repentance Excinerus · 2025-10-25. - **[Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan)**: Anomalus and Kruul punish mana-using melee Mithreon · 2025-10-18, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-12-02. On Kruul a paladin's job can be to wear fire resistance and drag each new Infernal out of the melee stack with Exorcism and Judgement Grey · 2026-01-06. - **[Lower Karazhan Halls](#/instances/lower-karazhan-halls), Moroes**: a Ret in plate with Righteous Fury can off-tank the repeated stuns and threat drops (not in a zero-Stamina set) Silverhand · 2025-12-24. - **[Onyxia's Lair](#/instances/onyxias-lair)** new boss: its trash puts a fire debuff on melee that paladins and priests must dispel Hexadin · 2026-03-20. It drops the Libram of Ardour. - **Nightfall**: rets are common carriers. One Kara40 log showed 86k-140k extra raid damage per boss from its procs theoloras/warkrak · 2025-11-03. Rotate the job; it costs the carrier personal DPS and loot priority 30 · 2025-11-21. - **Windfury is not everything**: Grey, a paladin without Windfury, out-damaged a rogue who demanded a Windfury group Grey · 2026-03-26. Consumables and uptime are the bigger levers: "you need to be fully consumed to do competitive damage in the raid" donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-26. - **Flametongue Totem bug (April 2026)**: Flametongue briefly scaled with spell power again and inflated SoR and Necrodin parses Not Normal · 2026-04-07, Mithreon · 2026-04-13. Do not compare your logs against parses from that window.

gear.heading: Gear

Ret's pre-raid gear is scattered across many sources Mima · 2026-01-02. ### Weapons | Stage | SoR (spellret) | SoC (AP) | |---|---|---| | Starter / pre-raid | **Demonsbane** (Argent Dawn exalted) Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-10, Jesse Potter · 2026-04-15; **Tempered Runeblade** (Blacksmithing craft) or Shadowstrike Adamant · 2026-01-09 | **Demonsbane** Jesse Potter · 2025-10-06; the Argent Dawn two-hander if you skip Blacksmithing Raugtreefell · 2026-04-08; Obsidian Edged Blade (weapon skill) Jesse Potter · 2025-10-14 | | BWL | **Untamed Blade (UTB)**, "the clear winner for SoR" Mithreon · 2026-04-03; its Strength proc is "the best buff in the game" keungzhe · 2026-02-03 | **UTB** Jesse Potter · 2025-10-14, bigdaddyd · 2026-04-03 | | Timbermaw Hold (TMH20) | **Pysan's New Greatsword**, from the hydra boss Iseut · 2026-04-03: 3.5 speed; chance on hit deals 350-400 Holy damage and triggers your seal (more and a stun vs Undead/Demons) Arle · 2026-03-17. No spell power scaling, but Sanctity and Vengeance apply and both hits can crit Gilfrey · 2026-03-28. Roughly on par with UTB Destroses · 2026-04-02; on Nordanaar it "lasts until MoM" Jesse Potter · 2026-04-15 | Same sword; for parses on fights under ~45 s it can beat Shar'tateth through lucky procs Jesse Potter · 2026-04-18 | | Naxx / Kara40 | **Corrupted Ashbringer** (its Drain Life proc scales 1:1 with spell power) Destroses · 2026-01-02; "UTB = MoM for SoR, but CA beats them" Jesse Potter · 2026-01-31 | **Might of Menethil** or **Shar'tateth**; Corrupted Ashbringer is close but not BiS dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-01-23. Scythe of the Harvest was cut from 3 to 2 PPM (Ashbringer: 1.6) Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-04, Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-13. Elementium Champion (drop plus Swordsmithing) looks weaker than UTB and Pysan's for similar effort (single source) Spaghett Victim #1 · 2026-04-04. SoC wants big raw weapon damage, not weapon DPS Mithreon · 2026-04-01. ### Armor by phase **SoR (spellret)** | Phase | Core | |---|---| | Pre-raid | Tempered Runeblade, Helm of the Executioner, Soulforge (Tier 0.5) set, Fabric of Time, Briarwood Reed, Argent Dawn neck (Istenneveben) Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2025-10-18. **Soulforge 4-piece** (a 95 spell power proc) is near-mandatory until BWL Mithreon · 2025-11-23 | | MC | 4-piece Soulforge, 3-piece Tier 1, Choker of the Fire Lord, two spell power rings, Talisman of Ephemeral Power + another SP trinket gastro · 2025-12-07 | | BWL | UTB, 4-piece Tier 0.5, **3-piece Tier 2**, 3% hit (4% for High Elf and Dwarf), Sigil of Ancient Accord Mithreon · 2026-04-03 | | AQ40 / Naxx | **Tier 2.5 5-piece** + Tier 2 3-piece + Sigil, then Corrupted Ashbringer gastro · 2026-03-28, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-01-23 | | Kara40 | **Tier 3.5 5-piece** with Tier 2 helm, belt and gloves, Bindings of Contained Magic, Sigil of Ancient Accord and Wrath of Cenarius gastro · 2026-02-06 | Jesse Potter's post-patch summary of the three SoR setups: "basic" (Tier 2.5 + Tier 2 3-piece until Tier 3.5, Anomalus bracers, Turalyon's Hope), "The Lost" (two Tier 2 3-pieces) and "AoE proc" (two Tier 2 3-pieces) Jesse Potter · 2026-04-10. Trinkets: Slayer's Crest and Kiss of the Spider, swapped only for specific fights gastro · 2026-04-18, Jesse Potter · 2026-04-18. ### Necrodin gear Necrodin wears **three Ret Tier 2 pieces + three Protection Tier 2 pieces**, **three pieces of the Lost set** (neck, ring and off-hand book, from Karazhan Crypt and UBRS) and a fast weapon Adamant · 2026-01-08, HollyBallz · 2026-03-31. mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. **Auto-attacking without a seal**, usually from judging right before a swing theoloras/warkrak · 2025-10-25, Beldrin · 2025-10-25. 2. **Over-prioritizing the Judge-reseal** and clipping Crusader/Holy Strike cooldowns Beldrin · 2026-03-23, Beldrin · 2026-03-23. 3. **Mixing gear types**: Strength gear with SoR, or a spell weapon with SoC. A raider whose SoR "hit like a noodle" in Strength gear was told: "different gear for different seals" Alandin · 2025-12-03, Excinerus · 2025-12-03. 4. **Letting Zeal or Holy Might drop**; many Rets waste the first 30 s of a pull rebuilding them angels1m · 2026-03-13. 5. **Binding several seals and Judgement into one macro**: it cost some raiders over 20% ability downtime Excinerus · 2025-10-25. 6. **Raiding under the 8% hit cap**, or pushing weapon skill past 315 Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-03-30. 7. **Consecration spam on single targets in low gear** Jesse Potter · 2026-04-10. 8. **Taking Improved Blessings on SoR, or Vindication in any PvE build** gastro · 2026-01-06, Destroses · 2025-10-25. 9. **Swapping librams mid-fight**: since 1.18.1 every swap costs a GCD ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). 10. **Playing Necrodin on trash** or with only one Tier 2 3-piece: "You half your spell effects with only 1 set of t2" keungzhe · 2026-02-09. 11. **Seal twisting**: it no longer gives the old extra procs Excinerus · 2025-12-30, and the developers do not want it back Jesse Potter · 2026-02-09.

consumables.heading: Weapon oils, stones and Windfury
consumables.markdown: - **SoR: Wizard Oil. SoC: sharpening stones** gastro · 2026-03-18. Brilliant Wizard Oil does more total damage through Consecration on trash; stones can win on bosses Grey · 2026-03-08. - Windfury Totem on Turtle is an aura, not a weapon imbue, so an oil or stone goes on top of it Aelgagar · 2026-01-29. - Consecrated Sharpening Stone or Oil against Undead Jesse Potter · 2026-04-16. - Leveling: Fiery or Lifestealing weapon enchant (both count as spellstrikes for mana) Mima · 2025-12-22, Destroses · 2026-04-04.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 loop to keep in your head. The details are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps), [AoE rotation](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps), [Mana and resources](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps) and [Cooldowns](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps). 1. **Before the pull:** blessings, Sanctity Aura (Retribution Aura without the talent), your seal (SoR or SoC), `/startattack`. Use a swing timer. 2. **Opener:** Exorcism at 30 yd (Undead/Demon) → Repentance at 20 yd → Judgement at 10 yd. Judge Crusader only if you are the Crusader judge, then re-seal. Holy Strike is your first strike Excinerus · 2025-10-25, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-18. See [Opener](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps). 3. **Single-target loop:** every auto-attack must land with a seal on Dodging · 2025-10-16. 1. Re-seal if the seal is missing and a swing is coming. 2. Strike on the shared 6 s cooldown: **Crusader Strike** while Zeal is below 3 stacks or about to expire, **Holy Strike** when Holy Might has ≤ 6 s left, otherwise whichever hits harder on this target forsooth · 2026-03-18, Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-21. 3. **Judgement** right after an auto lands and not just before a strike comes off cooldown, then re-seal. 4. Exorcism on Undead and Demons. Hammer of Wrath below 20% is optional. 5. Repentance on cooldown on bosses immune to its stun. 6. Consecration only with spare mana. Never let a strike sit off cooldown for long Grey · 2026-03-16. 4. **Cooldowns:** trinkets, Juju Flurry and haste potions two or three GCDs in, once Zeal and Vengeance are up Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30. 5. **AoE switch:** at **4+ targets**, Consecration on cooldown (rank 1 when mana is short), then the single-target loop on the longest-lived mob. With 2–3 targets, add Consecration only if mana allows. 6. **Mana:** Judgement of Wisdom is the engine. When you run short, fix it in this order and stop at the step that works: teas and potions → rank-1 Consecration → Holy Strike instead of Crusader Strike → no Judgement of Righteousness → no Consecration Grey · 2026-04-04. On the last trash mob, a few swings with Seal of Wisdom refill you. 7. **Situational:** swap your seal only between swings. Divine Shield is for threat or death only. Hand of Freedom or Protection goes on raid members when it does not cost a strike.

extraSections.markdown: 1.18.1 went live on 2026-03-20. The class notes were announced on 2026-01-23 ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) and quoted in-channel goyut1 · 2026-01-25. | Change | Effect in play | |---|---| | **Seal of Command 7 → 9 procs per minute** ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), zfwn111 · 2026-01-24) | About 50-57% proc chance per swing on a 3.8-speed weapon Destroses · 2026-01-24, Mithreon · 2026-04-03. Together with Libram of Ardour, SoC is "so back" Gilfrey · 2026-03-23 | | **Crusader Strike rank 5: 90% → 100% weapon damage** ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | Developer comment: attack-power Ret "underperforming for several patches" | | **Holy Strike reworked**: now X% weapon damage plus Holy damage (rank 8: 40% weapon damage + 129-146), spell power scaling 43% → 71% ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | Unbuffed damage is about the same; everything from Strength, attack power and weapon damage is new bonus Grey · 2026-02-12. Holy Strike now beats an un-Sundered Crusader Strike, so it opens fights Jesse Potter · 2026-03-14, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-18 | | **Repentance** on immune targets now ticks for 8% of attack power ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | Small AP-build buff | | **Consecration** base damage +8% and front-loaded: ticks go 156% → 44% of the old per-tick value ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | Better on trash that dies fast | | **Tier 2.5 3-piece (Ret/Prot)** now +15% Judgement of Righteousness/Command damage; **Tier 3.5 5-piece (Ret)** Crusade is 4% attack speed for 20 s and no longer stacks ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | The old +6% Crusader Strike bonus is gone, which is why Crusader Strike itself was buffed Lhian · 2026-01-24 | | **Swapping librams in combat costs a GCD** ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | No more libram twisting; equip one libram for the fight dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-24 | | **Libram of Final Judgement** now scales with 8% of spell power ([Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272)) | | | **New Libram of Ardour** (+1 SoC proc per minute) Destroses · 2026-03-31, Destroses · 2026-04-05 | The item that made SoC competitive with SoR Aljeron · 2026-03-26 | | **New stat: Fortune** (necks, cloaks, trinkets) Destroses · 2026-02-18 | Weak; see [Fortune](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps) | Things that did **not** change: strikes still do not trigger seals Dodging · 2025-10-27, Crusader Strike and Holy Strike still share a cooldown, and the Tier 2 3-piece spellstrike was kept: "i really dont want to [change it], it enables so much stuff" (Lhian) Lhian · 2026-03-25. **Beware the April Fools post.** On 2026-04-01 Lhian posted a "next patch" announcement (spellstrikes stop proccing, Holy Strike becomes a Heroic Strike clone, Crusader Strike loses its cooldown). It was a joke Lhian · 2026-04-01, tripleXDengine · 2026-04-01. Two other widely shared "leaks" were also fake: a Chinese fan-made talent tree Destroses · 2025-12-03 and a bumped old changelog thread Jesse Potter · 2026-01-07, Beldrin · 2026-01-07.

extraSections.heading: Which Ret? SoR vs SoC vs Necrodin
extraSections.markdown: There is no separate "pure spell" Ret any more: "all rets are some shade of hybrid now" Grey · 2026-01-09, and "hybrid SoR" and "spellret" mean the same thing Dodging · 2026-03-19. Both main builds share about 11 gear pieces (the tier sets) and differ in accessories, weapon and enchants Jesse Potter · 2026-02-10, Jesse Potter · 2025-12-20. | | **SoR "spellret"** | **SoC "AP Ret"** | **Necrodin** | |---|---|---|---| | Seal | Seal of Righteousness | Seal of Command | Seal of Righteousness | | Scales with | Spell power, haste (more swings = more SoR hits) | Strength, crit, weapon damage | Attacks per second; "all the spell power is placebo" Excinerus · 2026-01-11 | | Weapon | Proc weapon (Untamed Blade, Corrupted Ashbringer) | Slow two-hander with big weapon damage; "SoC likes heavy hitters with big weapon damage, not dps" Mithreon · 2026-04-01 | Fast weapon with a strong proc (see [Gear](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps)) | | Pros | Higher and steadier DPS, real AoE through Consecration, better mana Adamant · 2025-12-20, Excinerus · 2026-01-26 | Simple, easy gearing, burst; strong from the first second Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-03-31 | Strong on long stationary bosses keungzhe · 2026-02-09 | | Cons | Counter-intuitive itemization, few weapons Adamant · 2025-12-20 | Swingy on short fights: "feast or famine" Aljeron · 2026-03-26; little AoE; needs Windfury | Needs every slot including both trinkets Pastor · 2026-03-24; "the weakest build between all ret builds" and needs to charge up Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-03-31; weak on trash Destroses · 2026-02-16 | | Standing after 1.18.1 | Still on top of Kara40 logs Jesse Potter · 2026-04-13 | "Better than last patch but is beaten by SoR still" Jesse Potter · 2026-04-10; on a dummy with Libram of Ardour, ~30 DPS **ahead** of SoR in the same gear Aljeron · 2026-03-26 | "The best thing that happened to ret in a while" Adamant · 2026-03-22 | **Contested: is SoC now equal to SoR?** A controlled dummy test (same pre-Kara40 BiS spell gear, only seal and libram changed) put SoC about 30 DPS ahead Aljeron · 2026-03-26, and a top SoR Ret switched to SoC Alexander · 2026-03-26. Others want proof in raid logs: "until i see a SoC ret beating lonsell i'll just assume SoR is still better" Beldrin · 2026-03-31. In Nordanaar Kara40 logs a SoC Ret sat 3 DPS behind a SoR Ret Jesse Potter · 2026-04-06. The practical answer: "play what you want ... the difference between them is prolly like 100 dps more or less" douwi · 2026-03-31. **How to choose:** 1. **Fresh 60 or leveling:** SoC. SP cannot be stacked high enough early for SoR to pull ahead Mithreon · 2025-12-10; with an Untamed Blade and only ~139 spell power "you should be using seal of command" Proph · 2026-02-04. 2. **Tier 2.5 5-piece and a proc weapon:** SoR generally overtakes SoC once you have the T2.5 set Jesse Potter · 2026-02-04. 3. **No Windfury Totem (Tel'Abim, or no Alliance-side shaman):** SoR. "SoR still kinda works on TA without WF, SoC doesn't" Excinerus · 2025-10-26; "On TA, spelladin wins because SoC really suffers from not having WF" dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-01-23. 4. **You own both Tier 2 3-pieces (Ret and Prot) and the Lost set:** Necrodin for long bosses, a normal set for trash Destroses · 2026-02-16.

extraSections.heading: How the Ret kit works on Turtle
extraSections.markdown: These mechanics decide every gear and rotation choice. - **Seals proc only from auto-attacks.** Crusader Strike, Holy Strike and Judgement do not trigger Seal of Righteousness or Seal of Command Dodging · 2025-10-27, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-17. - **Seal of Righteousness counts as a second melee hit.** Every on-hit effect (weapon procs, spellstrike items, Judgement of Wisdom, Windfury) gets a second roll per swing gastro · 2025-12-02, Dodging · 2025-11-06. SoR procs on extra attacks too; SoC does not dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-04. SoR does nothing if the auto misses Jesse Potter · 2026-01-20. - **SoR damage scales with weapon speed:** 0.092 × speed × SP per hit with a one-hander, 0.125 × speed × SP with a two-hander; Judgement of Righteousness has a 0.71 SP coefficient Grey · 2026-01-07, Grey · 2026-02-03. - **Seal of Command** is a flat 9 procs per minute, calculated from base weapon speed (haste adds swings, not chance per swing) Mithreon · 2026-03-15, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-02. It can be dodged and it can miss Jesse Potter · 2026-02-07. Judgement of Command has a 0.43 SP coefficient plus 15% of attack power; SoC's own SP coefficient is about 20-24% Jesse Potter · 2026-01-21, Excinerus · 2025-12-06. - **Judgements are melee attacks**: melee hit and crit, not reflectable, can proc Hand of Justice Wulf (Th0r1369) · 2025-10-31, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-20. Judgement is off the global cooldown; re-sealing is not Beldrin · 2025-10-25. - **Windfury Totem** procs off any melee hit, including SoR, SoC, strikes and Judgement, about 20% of the time with a ~1.5 s internal cooldown Jesse Potter · 2026-02-08. A Judgement can eat a Windfury proc without a seal on it Jesse Potter · 2026-01-07. - **"Spellstrike"** means "Equip: Adds X damage to your melee attacks" items. Each copy procs independently Beldrin · 2025-10-30. Spellstrikes trigger Judgement of Wisdom mana, Vengeance and Wrath of Cenarius, not Seal of Command or other weapon procs Silverhand · 2026-02-06, theoloras/warkrak · 2025-11-01. Their job is Judgement of Wisdom mana regen and Wrath of Cenarius spell power uptime, not raw weapon damage Adamant · 2026-01-13. - **Tier 2 3-piece is the exception.** Its Holy "spellstrike" counts as both casting and damaging with a spell Grey · 2026-01-14, so it can proc on-cast items (Sigil of Ancient Accord, the Sunken Temple chest, Insomnius) that ordinary spellstrikes cannot Adamant · 2025-12-31. "The set bonuses strength isnt its dmg but the fact it can interact with and proc numerous other effects" gastro · 2026-03-26. With both the Ret and Prot Tier 2 3-pieces and SoR up you get 4 spellstrike rolls per swing Destroses · 2026-04-05, Destroses · 2026-01-26. This is the Necrodin engine. - **Sanctity Aura and Judgement of the Crusader** only boost Holy damage; Crusader Strike is physical and gets nothing from them gastro · 2026-02-22, Silverhand · 2026-02-22. - **Zeal** (from Crusader Strike) is three separate 5% haste stacks for 30 s Destroses · 2025-11-07; **Holy Might** (from Holy Strike) is +20% Strength Mithreon · 2025-11-07; **Vengeance** stacks from any crit, melee or spell Grey · 2026-01-18. ### Windfury Totem dependence Ret's damage leans on a shaman's Windfury Totem more than any other class does. SoR procs Windfury, and each Windfury attack procs SoR again, in a loop broken only by the totem's internal cooldown; that raises the effective Windfury chance from ~25% to 40% or more and drives every other on-hit proc up with it Excinerus · 2025-10-12. "Ret suffers when you don't have WF, but so does everybody else" dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-12-02. Consequences: - **Tel'Abim** (no cross-faction Windfury) is the worst realm for Ret; AP Ret "is disabled on TA" Excinerus · 2026-01-25, and SoR is the only build that still works there Excinerus · 2025-10-26. - **Group placement:** a Ret wants the Windfury (melee) group. A Holy paladin in that group takes a slot meant for a DPS buffer such as a shaman, so Holy usually sits elsewhere Mithreon · 2025-12-26. - Wait ~2 s after a Windfury proc before your next strike or Judgement so the next proc lands on an auto Grey · 2026-03-16. ### Fortune (the new proc stat) Fortune ("Increases your chance to trigger chance-based item effects by X%") appears only on necks, cloaks and trinkets, and multiplies the base chance (5% Fortune turns a 20% proc into 21%) Destroses · 2026-02-18, Excinerus · 2026-04-02. It raises item procs (Thunderfury, Flurry Axe, Ironfoe, Pysan's sword) but not the trigger rate of set bonuses such as Tier 1 8-piece or Tier 2 3-piece Grey · 2026-04-02, Jesse Potter · 2026-04-04, and not weapon enchants, oils or Windfury dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-20. **Contested:** whether it boosts the Lost set's ghost procs Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-04, Destroses · 2026-04-05; a dev called the set-bonus behaviour a bug to be fixed carefully gyatt · 2026-03-30. Verdict: a weak stat; 5% Fortune moves Hand of Justice from ~2% to ~2.1% keungzhe · 2026-03-18, Dodging · 2026-03-18. Take it only when the item is good anyway.

extraSections.markdown: | Cooldown | Use | |---|---| | Trinkets, Juju Flurry, Potion of Quickness | Two or three GCDs into the fight, lined up with Zeal and Vengeance Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30; haste consumables are especially good for SoR donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-20 | | Perception (Human) | With the other cooldowns Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30 | | Repentance | On cooldown (60 s) on immune bosses; CC on non-immune targets | | Divine Shield | Threat or death prevention only; it also halves healing done and taken Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31 | | Hand of Protection / Freedom | On raid members who need it, when it does not cost a strike |

extraSections.markdown: Jesse Potter's damage list (post-1.18.1) Jesse Potter · 2026-04-16: - Flask of Supreme Power - Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose, Concoction of the Arcane Giant, Concoction of Dreamwater - R.O.I.D.S. or Scorpok (crit, if you are under ~33% crit unbuffed Excinerus · 2026-01-25) - Food: 20 Strength, haste or spell power food, 32 AP, or Dragonbreath Chili - Elemental Sharpening Stone or Oil; Consecrated versions against Undead - Haste: Juju Flurry and Potion of Quickness are "goated for SoR" donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-20 - Goblin Sapper Charges on AoE pulls Jesse Potter · 2025-10-17; mana potions and teas on cooldown Grey · 2026-04-04 Ret is one of the most consumable-hungry specs, about 15 potions per raid Jesse Potter · 2025-12-02. Watch the buff cap (see [Mana and resources](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps)).

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Swing timer**: mandatory Beldrin · 2026-03-23. - **Seal + Judgement on one key** without double-sealing gastro · 2025-12-03: ``` #showtooltip /cast [nomybuff:"Seal of Righteousness"] Seal of Righteousness; Judgement ``` - **Strike selector** (see [Single-target rotation](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps)). - **ExAutoCSHS** (github.com/Excinerus/ExAutoCSHS) picks Crusader or Holy Strike from your Zeal and Holy Might state and weapon type Excinerus · 2025-10-25. - **Buff management**: an auto-cancel list (ABR or VCB) for low-value buffs Jesse Potter · 2026-02-07.

glance.recommendation: Play the **11/8/32** Retribution build and pick your seal by your gear. With spell power gear and a proc weapon, run **Seal of Righteousness ("spellret", SoR)**. With Strength gear and a slow, hard-hitting two-hander, run **Seal of Command (SoC)**. The talents differ by only a few points. "Seal of crusader is exclusively judged for the 130sp bonus. If you stack spellpower gear, you run seal of righteousness; if you stack strength, you run seal of command" Grey · 2026-03-26. After 1.18.1 both are real raid specs: "all 3 specs of pally are fully raid viable, ret is an actual dps spec now" Destroses · 2026-03-27. SoR is still slightly ahead at the top: "Top 4/5 in K40 is SoR, 3rd being SoC since patch" Jesse Potter · 2026-04-13. **Necrodin** (double Tier 2 3-piece plus the Lost set) is a third, niche build for long single-target fights.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Melee DPS; Blessings, Judgement debuffs, Hand of Freedom/Protection, Cleanse, Repentance

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **B (raid)**: about 1.8k DPS on Patchwerk-type fights, best log 2.3k Grey · 2026-03-27, Grey · 2026-03-27; in Kara40 on par with druids and shamans, behind the top specs Mithreon · 2026-04-03, Mithreon · 2026-04-03

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium: few buttons, but seal uptime on every swing and buff upkeep separate a good Ret from a bad one Beldrin · 2025-10-25

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Garbage-disposal gearing: almost any Strength, spell power, crit or hit item works Grey · 2026-03-06; fun and very powerful while leveling Perrapys · 2025-12-04; SoR adds real AoE through Consecration Excinerus · 2026-01-26

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Slow ramp (Zeal, Holy Might, Vengeance) that hurts on short fights Mithreon · 2026-04-03; heavy Windfury Totem dependence dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-12-02; expensive consumables Jesse Potter · 2025-12-02; low health (about 3.2k for a near-BiS Ret) Pastor · 2025-12-23

playbooks.title: Paladin PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** for battlegrounds and arenas, **Holy** is the safest and most valued Paladin PvP spec: "Rets are ass, hpally is where paladin pvp is at" Mithreon · 2025-11-28, and for the Rank 14 grind "the answer is holy" Faithroll · 2025-12-11. **Deep Protection with a good weapon** is the surprise of 1.18.1: one tank topped the leaderboard "9/10 matches with 0 consumes and no dedicated PvP gear" Silverhand · 2026-04-06. **Retribution** works only as **Seal of Command** (AP) Ret, and it plays as utility with burst windows, not as a main damage dealer: "you gonna be ultility class on pvp, not main character dps" angels1m · 2026-02-02. 1.18.1 made SoC Ret feel much better: "Went from feeling like a noodle to actually competing in skirmishes" Jesse Potter · 2026-03-22. Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). | Spec | PvP rating | Why | |---|---|---| | **Holy** | A | Hard to kill, instant Holy Shock heals, 1.5 s Holy Lights; the default BG and arena pick Mithreon · 2026-03-12, Faithroll · 2025-12-11 | | **Protection** | A (contested) | Very tanky in PvE gear; wins 1v4 against physical classes Silverhand · 2026-04-06; a nerf is expected Silverhand · 2026-04-06 | | **Retribution (SoC)** | B | Burst through Judgement of Command and crits; no gap closer, purgeable seals, low Stamina gear Mithreon · 2026-03-12, Mithreon · 2025-11-22 | | **Retribution (SoR spellret)** | C | "Spellret doesnt have enough stam to do anything in pvp" gastro · 2025-11-20; "SoR is way less bursty then SoC, usually pvp is about burst" Adamant · 2025-11-22 | | **Shockadin / Holy-Prot** | C for kills, B for survival | "Sticky and hard to kill", creates distractions, but does not kill much Excinerus · 2025-10-03; damage and healing dampening make niche builds even weaker Mithreon · 2026-02-08 | Community tier lists from the PvP channel put Paladin in the middle: "Shaman god tier ... hunter paladin b tier, warrior f tier" Ythor · 2025-10-21; "warrior is rock bottom, paladins average, shamans god tier" Ythor · 2025-11-01.

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Stamina matters more than in PvE.** "bis and pre-bis sets for ret pretty much don't account for survivability at all beyond the barest minimum" Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Holy wants 6k+ health Mithreon · 2026-03-12. - **Ret PvP stat line:** "SoC with stam sp and crit, where you capitalize on Judgement windows. Also big bonker weapon" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. For your seal choice, compare JoR and JoC with your own spell power and attack power: "Ret pvp is basically JoR or JoC" Mithreon · 2026-03-26. - **Hit:** most of your abilities use melee hit, so spell hit matters little Silverhand · 2026-01-20. - **Sets:** Tier 2.5 is the easiest strong set and is obtainable "in like 6 weeks", better value than Rank 12/13 gear Jesse Potter · 2025-12-16; T3, T2.5 or Karazhan gear beats dedicated brawler sets SkillzMFG · 2025-10-16. Soulforge (Tier 0.5) is "still very strong for ap ret at this phase" Beldrin · 2025-12-19. For maximum PvP damage, the T2.5 and T3.5 3-sets pair well with the Final Judgement execute libram Jesse Potter · 2026-03-12. - Jesse Potter's PvP kit: Blood ring 2-set (head and shoulders) for hit and mitigation, Obsidian chest for the magic absorb, T3 bracers and belt for crit, disarm-immune Blacksmithing gloves, high-Stamina Brood rings Jesse Potter · 2026-01-21; swap in the T3 disarm gloves against Warriors Jesse Potter · 2025-11-14. - **1.18.1 PvP gear:** the set bonus buffs Judgement of the Crusader, which players call weak Bide · 2026-03-28. Some upgraded honor pieces cost over 20k honor Jesse Potter · 2026-03-13; rated arena, world PvP events and weekly BG quests reportedly weren't live yet as of April 2026 Mithreon · 2026-04-08. - **Weapons:** C'Thun's axe ("that disorient proc is godly") Pastor · 2025-10-22; Demonsbane with Icy Chill for SoC Ythor · 2025-11-06.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control
rotationSingle.markdown: **The basic battleground loop** (dindunuffinz): seal up, find your Freedom button, **Repentance into Hammer of Justice**, Crusader Strike dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19; "effective in hands of even a braindead 10iq" dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. **SoC burst window:** 1. Stun the target (Hammer of Justice, or a Seal of Justice proc). 2. **Judgement of Command** deals double damage on stunned targets Ythor · 2025-11-04; with a slow weapon, "if you get lucky and get a triple crit your target is dead in a global" Beldrin · 2025-11-04. 3. Keep Seal of Command up for the autos; SoC now procs on about 1 in 2 swings Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. **Against healers:** Ret has no interrupt besides Hammer of Justice and Repentance, so Seal of Justice is "the only 'interrupt' you have outside HoJ and Repentance" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-21. Judging Justice can proc the seal on the Judgement hit, a ranged stun; re-seal Justice and judge again Xiyanzhe 吸烟者 · 2026-04-08. **Against several rogues** (Jesse Potter): trinket the Kidney Shot, bubble or BoP, Repentance and hope they trinket it, then Hammer of Justice, or wait out Evasion Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. **Repentance notes:** it breaks on damage, unlike a fear Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12; Berserker Rage breaks it dindunuffinz · 2025-10-31; it no longer delays a Free Action-potioned flag carrier Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. Only Hammer of Justice and Repentance can be reflected; the rest of your kit is Holy damage, not Holy spells Jesse Potter · 2025-10-28, Mithreon · 2025-10-28. **Defensive tools:** - **Divine Shield**: "when the paladin pops his bubble, consider not hitting them for 12 seconds straight" Silverhand · 2026-03-27; use it to disengage or to eat a Kidney Shot and save your trinket Jesse Potter · 2025-10-20. - **Blessing of Protection** makes you immune to Blind (Blind is not a poison on Turtle) Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. - **Hand of Freedom, stuns and seals are magic and purgeable** Mithreon · 2025-11-22; Shamans can purge your seal, while their own weapon imbues cannot be removed Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07. - The class has no innate slow or movement speed ("wheelchair") Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop for each spec. The details are in [Burst and control](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp), [Battleground roles](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp). Cooldowns are from the 1.18.1 kit: Hammer of Justice 60 s (10 yd), Repentance 60 s (20 yd), Divine Shield and Hand of Protection 5 min, Hand of Freedom 24 s, Holy Shock 20 s (20 yd). **Retribution (Seal of Command):** 1. **Before the fight:** seal up and know where your Freedom button is dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. Pick a target you can reach, because Ret has no gap closer Silverhand · 2025-11-19. 2. **Opener:** Repentance, then Hammer of Justice, then Crusader Strike dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. 3. **Burst:** in the stun, Judgement of Command for double damage, with Seal of Command up for the autos Ythor · 2025-11-04, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. 4. **Against a healer or caster:** Seal of Justice is your only extra "interrupt" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. Swap to SoC, judge, and go back to SoJ while its stun lasts Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. The SoJ stun reportedly "doesnt DR with itself iirc" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. 5. **Control chain:** Repentance breaks on damage, so do not hit a repented target Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. Save Repentance for a cast or for a rogue opener or Vanish Jesse Potter · 2026-01-26. Berserker Rage breaks it, and it does nothing to a Free Action-potioned target dindunuffinz · 2025-10-31, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. 6. **Defence and escape:** use Divine Shield to disengage or to eat a Kidney Shot and save your trinket Jesse Potter · 2025-10-20. It halves your healing while it is up Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31, so use the 12 s to reset. BoP stops Blind Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. Hand of Freedom is weaker on Turtle (a longer cooldown and shorter duration), and Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control Pastor · 2025-11-22, Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28. Freedom, seals and stuns are all purgeable Mithreon · 2025-11-22. 7. **Target priority:** you are support first: "heal cleanse freedom your friends use bop smart" Dodging · 2026-03-12. A well-placed Hand beats your damage Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Keep up pressure: fish for a Seal of Justice stun on a priest or shaman, or judge Justice on a rogue or druid Excinerus · 2026-02-02. 8. **Reset:** break line of sight and heal, then re-engage. Drink out of combat (vanilla baseline). **Holy (Blessed Strikes):** 1. **Set-up:** you need 6k+ health. Either harass in melee, using Crusader Strike resets off Holy Shock, or heal priority allies from range Mithreon · 2026-03-12. Melee that cannot catch you do no damage Mithreon · 2026-03-12. 2. **Default heals:** Holy Shock (instant) for spot heals under pressure. With Holy Judgement, judge and then use 1.5 s Holy Lights: "1.5 sec holy light right after shaman uses shock, then judge and second 1.5 sec holy light, 3k hp back" Purec · 2025-10-14. Flash of Light for cheap top-ups (vanilla baseline). 3. **Triage:** you "can't heal all through the burst pvp currently has, so have to prio" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. Heal the ally who is being focused and can still be saved. 4. **Utility:** Cleanse poisons and magic on allies. Cleanse does not remove Blind, which is physical Jesse Potter · 2025-10-15, but BoP does Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. Hand of Freedom goes on rooted or slowed allies. 5. **Mana:** Holy is mana-starved without good gear and comfortable in T2 Liracrime · 2025-10-29, Liracrime · 2025-10-29. Drink between fights (vanilla baseline). 6. **Survive:** Divine Shield buys time, but you often die right after it SkillzMFG · 2025-10-14. Lay on Hands is disabled in arena Mithreon · 2025-11-21. **Shockadin (Holy with Precision):** play it as sticky support, not a killer Raugtreefell · 2026-03-30. Burst the target with SoC autos until it is low, then finish with a Holy Shock reset. The risk is running out of mana Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. Blessing of Sanctuary counters rogues, cats and fury warriors Silverhand · 2026-04-06. **Protection (deep Prot):** 1. Play in PvE tank gear with a strong weapon Silverhand · 2026-04-06. 2. Improved Hammer of Justice gives a 30 s stun indashadow · 2026-03-21. 3. Swap in Libram of Final Judgement to execute targets under 35% Jesse Potter · 2026-03-12. 4. Your one stun makes you easy to kite 1v1 angels1m · 2025-10-03. 5. Dissolvent ignores Block Excinerus · 2025-11-05. **Vs class** (the full table is in [Matchups](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp)): - **Warrior:** wear disarm-immune gloves. Expect Berserker Rage to break Repentance. - **Rogue:** trinket the Kidney, bubble or BoP, then Repentance → HoJ, or wait out Evasion Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. - **Mage:** get into melee before they notice you. This matchup is **contested**. - **Warlock:** kill the pet. - **Shaman:** expect Purge on your seal and Freedom. - **Hunter:** put on a shield, break line of sight, and use Frost Oil.

extraSections.heading: What changed for Paladin PvP
extraSections.markdown: - **Seal of Command 7 → 9 PPM** ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)): "Going to 1 in 2 chance from 1 in 3 is quite helpful" Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. With Libram of Ardour, AP Ret "feels too good to be true" Domy · 2026-03-22. - **Judgement of Justice now taunts** (Lhian) Lhian · 2026-03-12; a small utility buff, "no amount of dampening will fix the shit utility and impotence of a ret in a battlefield" (Excinerus) Excinerus · 2026-03-12. - **Repentance** ticks with 8% of attack power on immune targets ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). - **Divine Shield** also cuts healing: "Divine Shield now reduces healing taken and done by 50%" Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31 (another player reports 60% Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2025-12-29). **Contested** exact value. - Earlier Turtle PvP nerfs that still apply: Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control, Hand of Freedom has a longer cooldown and shorter duration Pastor · 2025-11-22, Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28; the HoS/HoF changes "were justified via pvp data afaik" angels1m · 2026-03-15. - **Arena:** opened after the patch Lhian · 2026-03-20; Lay on Hands is disabled in arena Mithreon · 2025-11-21, and Divine Shield is switched off in rated arena Mithreon · 2026-04-03.

extraSections.heading: Battleground roles
extraSections.markdown: - **Support first:** "a well-placed Hand will matter more than any damage you can do" Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Ret's value is the utility that Holy and Prot also bring, so it is the weakest paladin slot Silverhand · 2026-02-26, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-26; Horde sees Rets in BGs "as a wasted teammate slot" Mithreon · 2025-11-19. - **Holy:** "6k+ hp and either harassment in melee with CS resets on Shock or from afar healing prio allies" Mithreon · 2026-03-12; you "can't heal all through the burst pvp currently has, so have to prio" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. - **Defending objectives:** bubble-chaining paladins can hold flags and graveyards for a long time Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-07. - **Rank 14 / AV:** Holy Faithroll · 2025-12-11.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: The sources contain little PvP macro text. Useful from the PvE pages: the Seal + Judgement one-button macro and the Holy Might strike selector ([Retribution: macros and addons](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps)). Excinerus suggests a macro that "casts CS if your health is below a threshold and holy shock is on CD, and holy strike otherwise" (to fish for a Holy Shock reset) Excinerus · 2026-01-04; no macro text was posted.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown: **Recommendation:** for battlegrounds and arenas, **Holy** is the safest and most valued Paladin PvP spec: "Rets are ass, hpally is where paladin pvp is at" Mithreon · 2025-11-28, and for the Rank 14 grind "the answer is holy" Faithroll · 2025-12-11. **Deep Protection with a good weapon** is the surprise of 1.18.1: one tank topped the leaderboard "9/10 matches with 0 consumes and no dedicated PvP gear" Silverhand · 2026-04-06. **Retribution** works only as **Seal of Command** (AP) Ret, and it plays as utility with burst windows, not as a main damage dealer: "you gonna be ultility class on pvp, not main character dps" angels1m · 2026-02-02. 1.18.1 made SoC Ret feel much better: "Went from feeling like a noodle to actually competing in skirmishes" Jesse Potter · 2026-03-22. Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). | Spec | PvP rating | Why | |---|---|---| | **Holy** | A | Hard to kill, instant Holy Shock heals, 1.5 s Holy Lights; the default BG and arena pick Mithreon · 2026-03-12, Faithroll · 2025-12-11 | | **Protection** | A (contested) | Very tanky in PvE gear; wins 1v4 against physical classes Silverhand · 2026-04-06; a nerf is expected Silverhand · 2026-04-06 | | **Retribution (SoC)** | B | Burst through Judgement of Command and crits; no gap closer, purgeable seals, low Stamina gear Mithreon · 2026-03-12, Mithreon · 2025-11-22 | | **Retribution (SoR spellret)** | C | "Spellret doesnt have enough stam to do anything in pvp" gastro · 2025-11-20; "SoR is way less bursty then SoC, usually pvp is about burst" Adamant · 2025-11-22 | | **Shockadin / Holy-Prot** | C for kills, B for survival | "Sticky and hard to kill", creates distractions, but does not kill much Excinerus · 2025-10-03; damage and healing dampening make niche builds even weaker Mithreon · 2026-02-08 | Community tier lists from the PvP channel put Paladin in the middle: "Shaman god tier ... hunter paladin b tier, warrior f tier" Ythor · 2025-10-21; "warrior is rock bottom, paladins average, shamans god tier" Ythor · 2025-11-01.

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Stamina matters more than in PvE.** "bis and pre-bis sets for ret pretty much don't account for survivability at all beyond the barest minimum" Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Holy wants 6k+ health Mithreon · 2026-03-12. - **Ret PvP stat line:** "SoC with stam sp and crit, where you capitalize on Judgement windows. Also big bonker weapon" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. For your seal choice, compare JoR and JoC with your own spell power and attack power: "Ret pvp is basically JoR or JoC" Mithreon · 2026-03-26. - **Hit:** most of your abilities use melee hit, so spell hit matters little Silverhand · 2026-01-20. - **Sets:** Tier 2.5 is the easiest strong set and is obtainable "in like 6 weeks", better value than Rank 12/13 gear Jesse Potter · 2025-12-16; T3, T2.5 or Karazhan gear beats dedicated brawler sets SkillzMFG · 2025-10-16. Soulforge (Tier 0.5) is "still very strong for ap ret at this phase" Beldrin · 2025-12-19. For maximum PvP damage, the T2.5 and T3.5 3-sets pair well with the Final Judgement execute libram Jesse Potter · 2026-03-12. - Jesse Potter's PvP kit: Blood ring 2-set (head and shoulders) for hit and mitigation, Obsidian chest for the magic absorb, T3 bracers and belt for crit, disarm-immune Blacksmithing gloves, high-Stamina Brood rings Jesse Potter · 2026-01-21; swap in the T3 disarm gloves against Warriors Jesse Potter · 2025-11-14. - **1.18.1 PvP gear:** the set bonus buffs Judgement of the Crusader, which players call weak Bide · 2026-03-28. Some upgraded honor pieces cost over 20k honor Jesse Potter · 2026-03-13; rated arena, world PvP events and weekly BG quests reportedly weren't live yet as of April 2026 Mithreon · 2026-04-08. - **Weapons:** C'Thun's axe ("that disorient proc is godly") Pastor · 2025-10-22; Demonsbane with Icy Chill for SoC Ythor · 2025-11-06.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control
rotationSingle.markdown: **The basic battleground loop** (dindunuffinz): seal up, find your Freedom button, **Repentance into Hammer of Justice**, Crusader Strike dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19; "effective in hands of even a braindead 10iq" dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. **SoC burst window:** 1. Stun the target (Hammer of Justice, or a Seal of Justice proc). 2. **Judgement of Command** deals double damage on stunned targets Ythor · 2025-11-04; with a slow weapon, "if you get lucky and get a triple crit your target is dead in a global" Beldrin · 2025-11-04. 3. Keep Seal of Command up for the autos; SoC now procs on about 1 in 2 swings Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. **Against healers:** Ret has no interrupt besides Hammer of Justice and Repentance, so Seal of Justice is "the only 'interrupt' you have outside HoJ and Repentance" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-21. Judging Justice can proc the seal on the Judgement hit, a ranged stun; re-seal Justice and judge again Xiyanzhe 吸烟者 · 2026-04-08. **Against several rogues** (Jesse Potter): trinket the Kidney Shot, bubble or BoP, Repentance and hope they trinket it, then Hammer of Justice, or wait out Evasion Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. **Repentance notes:** it breaks on damage, unlike a fear Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12; Berserker Rage breaks it dindunuffinz · 2025-10-31; it no longer delays a Free Action-potioned flag carrier Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. Only Hammer of Justice and Repentance can be reflected; the rest of your kit is Holy damage, not Holy spells Jesse Potter · 2025-10-28, Mithreon · 2025-10-28. **Defensive tools:** - **Divine Shield**: "when the paladin pops his bubble, consider not hitting them for 12 seconds straight" Silverhand · 2026-03-27; use it to disengage or to eat a Kidney Shot and save your trinket Jesse Potter · 2025-10-20. - **Blessing of Protection** makes you immune to Blind (Blind is not a poison on Turtle) Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. - **Hand of Freedom, stuns and seals are magic and purgeable** Mithreon · 2025-11-22; Shamans can purge your seal, while their own weapon imbues cannot be removed Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07. - The class has no innate slow or movement speed ("wheelchair") Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26.
