mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. **Playing SoR spellret in PvP**: no Stamina and no burst gastro · 2025-11-20, Adamant · 2025-11-22. 2. **Taking Improved Seal of the Crusader** or keeping Crusader up Beldrin · 2025-11-14. 3. **Wearing PvE BiS without extra Stamina** Silverhand · 2025-11-22. 4. **Skipping Frost Oil and Icy Chill** dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-03-17. 5. **Hitting a bubbled paladin** instead of switching Silverhand · 2026-03-27. 6. **Relying on Hand of Sacrifice to break crowd control**: it no longer does Pastor · 2025-11-22.

enchants.heading: Enchants and consumables
enchants.markdown: - **Weapon: Icy Chill** ("Icy chill BiS enchant") Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22; "the slow has unironically been just enough to stop people getting away" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-14. - **Frost Oil** on top: "If you're not using Frost Oils, you are only making things worse on yourself and your team. They cost nothing" dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-03-17; 100% uptime is possible Pastor · 2025-10-22. - Stronghold Gauntlets against disarms Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. - Engineering grenades and sappers ([Leveling: professions](#/class/paladin/leveling)).

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop for each spec. The details are in [Burst and control](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp), [Battleground roles](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp). Cooldowns are from the 1.18.1 kit: Hammer of Justice 60 s (10 yd), Repentance 60 s (20 yd), Divine Shield and Hand of Protection 5 min, Hand of Freedom 24 s, Holy Shock 20 s (20 yd). **Retribution (Seal of Command):** 1. **Before the fight:** seal up and know where your Freedom button is dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. Pick a target you can reach, because Ret has no gap closer Silverhand · 2025-11-19. 2. **Opener:** Repentance, then Hammer of Justice, then Crusader Strike dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. 3. **Burst:** in the stun, Judgement of Command for double damage, with Seal of Command up for the autos Ythor · 2025-11-04, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. 4. **Against a healer or caster:** Seal of Justice is your only extra "interrupt" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. Swap to SoC, judge, and go back to SoJ while its stun lasts Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. The SoJ stun reportedly "doesnt DR with itself iirc" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. 5. **Control chain:** Repentance breaks on damage, so do not hit a repented target Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. Save Repentance for a cast or for a rogue opener or Vanish Jesse Potter · 2026-01-26. Berserker Rage breaks it, and it does nothing to a Free Action-potioned target dindunuffinz · 2025-10-31, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. 6. **Defence and escape:** use Divine Shield to disengage or to eat a Kidney Shot and save your trinket Jesse Potter · 2025-10-20. It halves your healing while it is up Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31, so use the 12 s to reset. BoP stops Blind Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. Hand of Freedom is weaker on Turtle (a longer cooldown and shorter duration), and Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control Pastor · 2025-11-22, Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28. Freedom, seals and stuns are all purgeable Mithreon · 2025-11-22. 7. **Target priority:** you are support first: "heal cleanse freedom your friends use bop smart" Dodging · 2026-03-12. A well-placed Hand beats your damage Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Keep up pressure: fish for a Seal of Justice stun on a priest or shaman, or judge Justice on a rogue or druid Excinerus · 2026-02-02. 8. **Reset:** break line of sight and heal, then re-engage. Drink out of combat (vanilla baseline). **Holy (Blessed Strikes):** 1. **Set-up:** you need 6k+ health. Either harass in melee, using Crusader Strike resets off Holy Shock, or heal priority allies from range Mithreon · 2026-03-12. Melee that cannot catch you do no damage Mithreon · 2026-03-12. 2. **Default heals:** Holy Shock (instant) for spot heals under pressure. With Holy Judgement, judge and then use 1.5 s Holy Lights: "1.5 sec holy light right after shaman uses shock, then judge and second 1.5 sec holy light, 3k hp back" Purec · 2025-10-14. Flash of Light for cheap top-ups (vanilla baseline). 3. **Triage:** you "can't heal all through the burst pvp currently has, so have to prio" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. Heal the ally who is being focused and can still be saved. 4. **Utility:** Cleanse poisons and magic on allies. Cleanse does not remove Blind, which is physical Jesse Potter · 2025-10-15, but BoP does Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. Hand of Freedom goes on rooted or slowed allies. 5. **Mana:** Holy is mana-starved without good gear and comfortable in T2 Liracrime · 2025-10-29, Liracrime · 2025-10-29. Drink between fights (vanilla baseline). 6. **Survive:** Divine Shield buys time, but you often die right after it SkillzMFG · 2025-10-14. Lay on Hands is disabled in arena Mithreon · 2025-11-21. **Shockadin (Holy with Precision):** play it as sticky support, not a killer Raugtreefell · 2026-03-30. Burst the target with SoC autos until it is low, then finish with a Holy Shock reset. The risk is running out of mana Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. Blessing of Sanctuary counters rogues, cats and fury warriors Silverhand · 2026-04-06. **Protection (deep Prot):** 1. Play in PvE tank gear with a strong weapon Silverhand · 2026-04-06. 2. Improved Hammer of Justice gives a 30 s stun indashadow · 2026-03-21. 3. Swap in Libram of Final Judgement to execute targets under 35% Jesse Potter · 2026-03-12. 4. Your one stun makes you easy to kite 1v1 angels1m · 2025-10-03. 5. Dissolvent ignores Block Excinerus · 2025-11-05. **Vs class** (the full table is in [Matchups](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp)): - **Warrior:** wear disarm-immune gloves. Expect Berserker Rage to break Repentance. - **Rogue:** trinket the Kidney, bubble or BoP, then Repentance → HoJ, or wait out Evasion Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. - **Mage:** get into melee before they notice you. This matchup is **contested**. - **Warlock:** kill the pet. - **Shaman:** expect Purge on your seal and Freedom. - **Hunter:** put on a shield, break line of sight, and use Frost Oil.

extraSections.heading: What changed for Paladin PvP
extraSections.markdown: - **Seal of Command 7 → 9 PPM** ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)): "Going to 1 in 2 chance from 1 in 3 is quite helpful" Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. With Libram of Ardour, AP Ret "feels too good to be true" Domy · 2026-03-22. - **Judgement of Justice now taunts** (Lhian) Lhian · 2026-03-12; a small utility buff, "no amount of dampening will fix the shit utility and impotence of a ret in a battlefield" (Excinerus) Excinerus · 2026-03-12. - **Repentance** ticks with 8% of attack power on immune targets ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). - **Divine Shield** also cuts healing: "Divine Shield now reduces healing taken and done by 50%" Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31 (another player reports 60% Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2025-12-29). **Contested** exact value. - Earlier Turtle PvP nerfs that still apply: Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control, Hand of Freedom has a longer cooldown and shorter duration Pastor · 2025-11-22, Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28; the HoS/HoF changes "were justified via pvp data afaik" angels1m · 2026-03-15. - **Arena:** opened after the patch Lhian · 2026-03-20; Lay on Hands is disabled in arena Mithreon · 2025-11-21, and Divine Shield is switched off in rated arena Mithreon · 2026-04-03.

extraSections.heading: Battleground roles
extraSections.markdown: - **Support first:** "a well-placed Hand will matter more than any damage you can do" Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Ret's value is the utility that Holy and Prot also bring, so it is the weakest paladin slot Silverhand · 2026-02-26, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-26; Horde sees Rets in BGs "as a wasted teammate slot" Mithreon · 2025-11-19. - **Holy:** "6k+ hp and either harassment in melee with CS resets on Shock or from afar healing prio allies" Mithreon · 2026-03-12; you "can't heal all through the burst pvp currently has, so have to prio" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. - **Defending objectives:** bubble-chaining paladins can hold flags and graveyards for a long time Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-07. - **Rank 14 / AV:** Holy Faithroll · 2025-12-11.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: The sources contain little PvP macro text. Useful from the PvE pages: the Seal + Judgement one-button macro and the Holy Might strike selector ([Retribution: macros and addons](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps)). Excinerus suggests a macro that "casts CS if your health is below a threshold and holy shock is on CD, and holy strike otherwise" (to fish for a Holy Shock reset) Excinerus · 2026-01-04; no macro text was posted.

glance.recommendation: For battlegrounds and arenas, **Holy** is the safest and most valued Paladin PvP spec: "Rets are ass, hpally is where paladin pvp is at" Mithreon · 2025-11-28, and for the Rank 14 grind "the answer is holy" Faithroll · 2025-12-11. **Deep Protection with a good weapon** is the surprise of 1.18.1: one tank topped the leaderboard "9/10 matches with 0 consumes and no dedicated PvP gear" Silverhand · 2026-04-06. **Retribution** works only as **Seal of Command** (AP) Ret, and it plays as utility with burst windows, not as a main damage dealer: "you gonna be ultility class on pvp, not main character dps" angels1m · 2026-02-02. 1.18.1 made SoC Ret feel much better: "Went from feeling like a noodle to actually competing in skirmishes" Jesse Potter · 2026-03-22.

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Stamina matters more than in PvE.** "bis and pre-bis sets for ret pretty much don't account for survivability at all beyond the barest minimum" Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Holy wants 6k+ health Mithreon · 2026-03-12. - **Ret PvP stat line:** "SoC with stam sp and crit, where you capitalize on Judgement windows. Also big bonker weapon" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. For your seal choice, compare JoR and JoC with your own spell power and attack power: "Ret pvp is basically JoR or JoC" Mithreon · 2026-03-26. - **Hit:** most of your abilities use melee hit, so spell hit matters little Silverhand · 2026-01-20. - **Sets:** Tier 2.5 is the easiest strong set and is obtainable "in like 6 weeks", better value than Rank 12/13 gear Jesse Potter · 2025-12-16; T3, T2.5 or Karazhan gear beats dedicated brawler sets SkillzMFG · 2025-10-16. Soulforge (Tier 0.5) is "still very strong for ap ret at this phase" Beldrin · 2025-12-19. For maximum PvP damage, the T2.5 and T3.5 3-sets pair well with the Final Judgement execute libram Jesse Potter · 2026-03-12. - Jesse Potter's PvP kit: Blood ring 2-set (head and shoulders) for hit and mitigation, Obsidian chest for the magic absorb, T3 bracers and belt for crit, disarm-immune Blacksmithing gloves, high-Stamina Brood rings Jesse Potter · 2026-01-21; swap in the T3 disarm gloves against Warriors Jesse Potter · 2025-11-14. - **1.18.1 PvP gear:** the set bonus buffs Judgement of the Crusader, which players call weak Bide · 2026-03-28. Some upgraded honor pieces cost over 20k honor Jesse Potter · 2026-03-13; rated arena, world PvP events and weekly BG quests reportedly weren't live yet as of April 2026 Mithreon · 2026-04-08. - **Weapons:** C'Thun's axe ("that disorient proc is godly") Pastor · 2025-10-22; Demonsbane with Icy Chill for SoC Ythor · 2025-11-06.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control
rotationSingle.markdown: **The basic battleground loop** (dindunuffinz): seal up, find your Freedom button, **Repentance into Hammer of Justice**, Crusader Strike dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19; "effective in hands of even a braindead 10iq" dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. **SoC burst window:** 1. Stun the target (Hammer of Justice, or a Seal of Justice proc). 2. **Judgement of Command** deals double damage on stunned targets Ythor · 2025-11-04; with a slow weapon, "if you get lucky and get a triple crit your target is dead in a global" Beldrin · 2025-11-04. 3. Keep Seal of Command up for the autos; SoC now procs on about 1 in 2 swings Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. **Against healers:** Ret has no interrupt besides Hammer of Justice and Repentance, so Seal of Justice is "the only 'interrupt' you have outside HoJ and Repentance" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-21. Judging Justice can proc the seal on the Judgement hit, a ranged stun; re-seal Justice and judge again Xiyanzhe 吸烟者 · 2026-04-08. **Against several rogues** (Jesse Potter): trinket the Kidney Shot, bubble or BoP, Repentance and hope they trinket it, then Hammer of Justice, or wait out Evasion Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. **Repentance notes:** it breaks on damage, unlike a fear Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12; Berserker Rage breaks it dindunuffinz · 2025-10-31; it no longer delays a Free Action-potioned flag carrier Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. Only Hammer of Justice and Repentance can be reflected; the rest of your kit is Holy damage, not Holy spells Jesse Potter · 2025-10-28, Mithreon · 2025-10-28. **Defensive tools:** - **Divine Shield**: "when the paladin pops his bubble, consider not hitting them for 12 seconds straight" Silverhand · 2026-03-27; use it to disengage or to eat a Kidney Shot and save your trinket Jesse Potter · 2025-10-20. - **Blessing of Protection** makes you immune to Blind (Blind is not a poison on Turtle) Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. - **Hand of Freedom, stuns and seals are magic and purgeable** Mithreon · 2025-11-22; Shamans can purge your seal, while their own weapon imbues cannot be removed Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07. - The class has no innate slow or movement speed ("wheelchair") Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26.

mistakes.markdown: 1. **Playing SoR spellret in PvP**: no Stamina and no burst gastro · 2025-11-20, Adamant · 2025-11-22. 2. **Taking Improved Seal of the Crusader** or keeping Crusader up Beldrin · 2025-11-14. 3. **Wearing PvE BiS without extra Stamina** Silverhand · 2025-11-22. 4. **Skipping Frost Oil and Icy Chill** dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-03-17. 5. **Hitting a bubbled paladin** instead of switching Silverhand · 2026-03-27. 6. **Relying on Hand of Sacrifice to break crowd control**: it no longer does Pastor · 2025-11-22.

They cost nothing" dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-03-17; 100% uptime is possible Pastor · 2025-10-22. - Stronghold Gauntlets against disarms Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. - Engineering grenades and sappers ([Leveling: professions](#/class/paladin/leveling)).

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop for each spec. The details are in [Burst and control](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp), [Battleground roles](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp). Cooldowns are from the 1.18.1 kit: Hammer of Justice 60 s (10 yd), Repentance 60 s (20 yd), Divine Shield and Hand of Protection 5 min, Hand of Freedom 24 s, Holy Shock 20 s (20 yd). **Retribution (Seal of Command):** 1. **Before the fight:** seal up and know where your Freedom button is dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. Pick a target you can reach, because Ret has no gap closer Silverhand · 2025-11-19. 2. **Opener:** Repentance, then Hammer of Justice, then Crusader Strike dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. 3. **Burst:** in the stun, Judgement of Command for double damage, with Seal of Command up for the autos Ythor · 2025-11-04, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. 4. **Against a healer or caster:** Seal of Justice is your only extra "interrupt" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. Swap to SoC, judge, and go back to SoJ while its stun lasts Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. The SoJ stun reportedly "doesnt DR with itself iirc" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. 5. **Control chain:** Repentance breaks on damage, so do not hit a repented target Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12. Save Repentance for a cast or for a rogue opener or Vanish Jesse Potter · 2026-01-26. Berserker Rage breaks it, and it does nothing to a Free Action-potioned target dindunuffinz · 2025-10-31, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22. 6. **Defence and escape:** use Divine Shield to disengage or to eat a Kidney Shot and save your trinket Jesse Potter · 2025-10-20. It halves your healing while it is up Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31, so use the 12 s to reset. BoP stops Blind Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. Hand of Freedom is weaker on Turtle (a longer cooldown and shorter duration), and Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control Pastor · 2025-11-22, Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28. Freedom, seals and stuns are all purgeable Mithreon · 2025-11-22. 7. **Target priority:** you are support first: "heal cleanse freedom your friends use bop smart" Dodging · 2026-03-12. A well-placed Hand beats your damage Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Keep up pressure: fish for a Seal of Justice stun on a priest or shaman, or judge Justice on a rogue or druid Excinerus · 2026-02-02. 8. **Reset:** break line of sight and heal, then re-engage. Drink out of combat (vanilla baseline). **Holy (Blessed Strikes):** 1. **Set-up:** you need 6k+ health. Either harass in melee, using Crusader Strike resets off Holy Shock, or heal priority allies from range Mithreon · 2026-03-12. Melee that cannot catch you do no damage Mithreon · 2026-03-12. 2. **Default heals:** Holy Shock (instant) for spot heals under pressure. With Holy Judgement, judge and then use 1.5 s Holy Lights: "1.5 sec holy light right after shaman uses shock, then judge and second 1.5 sec holy light, 3k hp back" Purec · 2025-10-14. Flash of Light for cheap top-ups (vanilla baseline). 3. **Triage:** you "can't heal all through the burst pvp currently has, so have to prio" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. Heal the ally who is being focused and can still be saved. 4. **Utility:** Cleanse poisons and magic on allies. Cleanse does not remove Blind, which is physical Jesse Potter · 2025-10-15, but BoP does Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05. Hand of Freedom goes on rooted or slowed allies. 5. **Mana:** Holy is mana-starved without good gear and comfortable in T2 Liracrime · 2025-10-29, Liracrime · 2025-10-29. Drink between fights (vanilla baseline). 6. **Survive:** Divine Shield buys time, but you often die right after it SkillzMFG · 2025-10-14. Lay on Hands is disabled in arena Mithreon · 2025-11-21. **Shockadin (Holy with Precision):** play it as sticky support, not a killer Raugtreefell · 2026-03-30. Burst the target with SoC autos until it is low, then finish with a Holy Shock reset. The risk is running out of mana Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. Blessing of Sanctuary counters rogues, cats and fury warriors Silverhand · 2026-04-06. **Protection (deep Prot):** 1. Play in PvE tank gear with a strong weapon Silverhand · 2026-04-06. 2. Improved Hammer of Justice gives a 30 s stun indashadow · 2026-03-21. 3. Swap in Libram of Final Judgement to execute targets under 35% Jesse Potter · 2026-03-12. 4. Your one stun makes you easy to kite 1v1 angels1m · 2025-10-03. 5. Dissolvent ignores Block Excinerus · 2025-11-05. **Vs class** (the full table is in [Matchups](#/class/paladin/holy-pvp)): - **Warrior:** wear disarm-immune gloves. Expect Berserker Rage to break Repentance. - **Rogue:** trinket the Kidney, bubble or BoP, then Repentance → HoJ, or wait out Evasion Jesse Potter · 2025-10-10. - **Mage:** get into melee before they notice you. This matchup is **contested**. - **Warlock:** kill the pet. - **Shaman:** expect Purge on your seal and Freedom. - **Hunter:** put on a shield, break line of sight, and use Frost Oil.

extraSections.heading: What changed for Paladin PvP
extraSections.markdown: - **Seal of Command 7 → 9 PPM** ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)): "Going to 1 in 2 chance from 1 in 3 is quite helpful" Jesse Potter · 2026-01-25. With Libram of Ardour, AP Ret "feels too good to be true" Domy · 2026-03-22. - **Judgement of Justice now taunts** (Lhian) Lhian · 2026-03-12; a small utility buff, "no amount of dampening will fix the shit utility and impotence of a ret in a battlefield" (Excinerus) Excinerus · 2026-03-12. - **Repentance** ticks with 8% of attack power on immune targets ([Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). - **Divine Shield** also cuts healing: "Divine Shield now reduces healing taken and done by 50%" Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31 (another player reports 60% Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2025-12-29). **Contested** exact value. - Earlier Turtle PvP nerfs that still apply: Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control, Hand of Freedom has a longer cooldown and shorter duration Pastor · 2025-11-22, Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28; the HoS/HoF changes "were justified via pvp data afaik" angels1m · 2026-03-15. - **Arena:** opened after the patch Lhian · 2026-03-20; Lay on Hands is disabled in arena Mithreon · 2025-11-21, and Divine Shield is switched off in rated arena Mithreon · 2026-04-03.

extraSections.heading: Battleground roles
extraSections.markdown: - **Support first:** "a well-placed Hand will matter more than any damage you can do" Silverhand · 2025-11-22. Ret's value is the utility that Holy and Prot also bring, so it is the weakest paladin slot Silverhand · 2026-02-26, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-26; Horde sees Rets in BGs "as a wasted teammate slot" Mithreon · 2025-11-19. - **Holy:** "6k+ hp and either harassment in melee with CS resets on Shock or from afar healing prio allies" Mithreon · 2026-03-12; you "can't heal all through the burst pvp currently has, so have to prio" Mithreon · 2026-03-12. - **Defending objectives:** bubble-chaining paladins can hold flags and graveyards for a long time Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-07. - **Rank 14 / AV:** Holy Faithroll · 2025-12-11.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: The sources contain little PvP macro text. Useful from the PvE pages: the Seal + Judgement one-button macro and the Holy Might strike selector ([Retribution: macros and addons](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps)). Excinerus suggests a macro that "casts CS if your health is below a threshold and holy shock is on CD, and holy strike otherwise" (to fish for a Holy Shock reset) Excinerus · 2026-01-04; no macro text was posted.

glance.recommendation: For battlegrounds and arenas, **Holy** is the safest and most valued Paladin PvP spec: "Rets are ass, hpally is where paladin pvp is at" Mithreon · 2025-11-28, and for the Rank 14 grind "the answer is holy" Faithroll · 2025-12-11. **Deep Protection with a good weapon** is the surprise of 1.18.1: one tank topped the leaderboard "9/10 matches with 0 consumes and no dedicated PvP gear" Silverhand · 2026-04-06. **Retribution** works only as **Seal of Command** (AP) Ret, and it plays as utility with burst windows, not as a main damage dealer: "you gonna be ultility class on pvp, not main character dps" angels1m · 2026-02-02. 1.18.1 made SoC Ret feel much better: "Went from feeling like a noodle to actually competing in skirmishes" Jesse Potter · 2026-03-22.
glance.rest: Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). | Spec | PvP rating | Why | |---|---|---| | **Holy** | A | Hard to kill, instant Holy Shock heals, 1.5 s Holy Lights; the default BG and arena pick Mithreon · 2026-03-12, Faithroll · 2025-12-11 | | **Protection** | A (contested) | Very tanky in PvE gear; wins 1v4 against physical classes Silverhand · 2026-04-06; a nerf is expected Silverhand · 2026-04-06 | | **Retribution (SoC)** | B | Burst through Judgement of Command and crits; no gap closer, purgeable seals, low Stamina gear Mithreon · 2026-03-12, Mithreon · 2025-11-22 | | **Retribution (SoR spellret)** | C | "Spellret doesnt have enough stam to do anything in pvp" gastro · 2025-11-20; "SoR is way less bursty then SoC, usually pvp is about burst" Adamant · 2025-11-22 | | **Shockadin / Holy-Prot** | C for kills, B for survival | "Sticky and hard to kill", creates distractions, but does not kill much Excinerus · 2025-10-03; damage and healing dampening make niche builds even weaker Mithreon · 2026-02-08 | Community tier lists from the PvP channel put Paladin in the middle: "Shaman god tier ... hunter paladin b tier, warrior f tier" Ythor · 2025-10-21; "warrior is rock bottom, paladins average, shamans god tier" Ythor · 2025-11-01.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level as **Retribution** if you want to quest and are new to the class; level as **Protection** if you want to tank dungeons all the way up or AoE-grind packs. After 1.18.1 the two are close: "ret probably has a slight edge, but it's not like prot is a crawl anymore" PowerPaladin · 2026-03-27; "if u aoe the kill quests, prot will be stronger, if u single target the kill quests, ret will be stronger" Destroses · 2025-12-18. If you plan to tank at 60, level as Prot to learn the spec donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-27. **Do not level as Holy** unless you have a permanent duo partner: "unless you have a buddy with you 24/7 going holy for leveling is bait" Beldrin · 2025-12-29, Mithreon · 2025-10-27. | Spec | Leveling rating | Why | |---|---|---| | **Retribution** | A | Simple, fast single-target questing, no special gear or knowledge needed Destroses · 2025-12-18, PowerPaladin · 2026-03-27 | | **Protection** | A (S for AoE grinders) | "One of the strongest levelling classes" gastro · 2026-04-02; instant dungeon invites; faster than Ret only if you AoE well, which "requires a bit of game knowledge" Beldrin · 2025-11-17, Dodging · 2026-03-30 | | **Holy/Prot hybrid** | A for farming | The classic AoE self-sustain route: Seal of Wisdom at 18 plus a fast weapon dumbid · 2026-02-15; "Holy prot is one of the best levelers on turtle" dumbid · 2026-04-13 | | **Holy** | C | Worst solo experience of the three specs; fine for dungeon healing after 5/5 Blessed Strikes Mithreon · 2025-10-27 | **Hardcore:** Prot or Holy/Prot is "way safer than retri, at least until you unlock repentance" orodoet · 2026-01-11, but do not AoE-farm on Hardcore, because one bad pull kills you: "you can't afford an aoe farming mistake as hc" Silverhand · 2026-03-25, Lika · 2025-11-08. Paladin is the recommended class for "slow and steady" Hardcore leveling gastro · 2026-03-25.

sections.heading: Talent order: Retribution (questing), level 10 → 60
sections.markdown: This follows Mithreon's two leveling checkpoints exactly: "For solo questing you want Seal of Command by lvl 30", then "by lvl 50 you get Vengeance, improved Zeal, even hit from Prot tree" Mithreon · 2025-11-19, Mithreon · 2025-11-19. After 50 "you can do whatever until lvl 60 and respec into one of the endgame builds" Mithreon · 2025-11-19. Stay in the Retribution tree until 5/5 Vengeance; Sanctity Aura is not worth it while leveling Excinerus · 2026-01-03, and Repentance and Sanctity should be your last points Jesse Potter · 2026-01-03. | Level | Talent | New rank | Note | |---|---|---|---| | 10-14 | Benediction | 1-5 | Cheaper seals and Judgements; worth it while leveling and duoing Jesse Potter · 2025-12-14 | | 15-17 | Deflection | 1-3 | Parry; Jesse Potter prefers Deflection over Improved Judgement early, "because that's more mana spent to reseal" Jesse Potter · 2025-12-25 | | 18-19 | Improved Judgement | 1-2 | | | 20-21 | Pursuit of Justice | 1-2 | Movement speed "means you can kite / chase mobs easier" Jesse Potter · 2025-12-25 | | 22-24 | Conviction | 1-3 | Crit | | 25-26 | Improved Retribution Aura | 1-2 | "If you're leveling it's a good talent" because you get hit Arle · 2026-02-08 | | 27-29 | Two-Handed Weapon Specialization | 1-3 | | | **30** | **Seal of Command** | 1 | "You want SoC asap" Jesse Potter · 2025-12-25; Turtle moved it to 30 (20 in Classic) Beldrin · 2026-01-11 | | 31-32 | Conviction | 4-5 | Required for Vengeance | | 33-37 | Vengeance | 1-5 | | | 38-42 | Vengeful Strikes | 1-5 | Ret "starts doing significantly more damage as you get better weapons and vengeful strikes (so after lvl 35)" Beldrin · 2026-02-01 | | 43-47 | Redoubt | 1-5 | Path to Precision | | 48-50 | Precision | 1-3 | +3% hit | | 51-52 | Deflection | 4-5 | | | 53-57 | Divine Strength | 1-5 | | | 58-59 | Divine Intellect | 1-2 | | | 60 | Repentance | 1 | Works on fewer dungeon bosses and trash than you expect Mithreon · 2025-11-17 | Result at 60: **7/8/36**, VALID. sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: What to press in each bracket, for both leveling paths above: **Ret** (questing) and **Prot** (packs and dungeons). Learn levels, ranks, costs and cooldowns come from the 1.18.1 game data. Talent abilities are listed at the level the talent orders above take them. Three rules hold at every level: - **Holy Strike and Crusader Strike share one 6 s cooldown.** You get one strike every 6 s, so choosing a strike means choosing which one to press. - **Judgement is off the global cooldown** (10 s cooldown). Re-sealing costs a GCD and mana, so every Judgement costs a re-seal. - **Holy Strike refunds its own mana** and ignores armor. While leveling it is almost always the better strike, because it also heals you Grey · 2026-02-01. Seal of Righteousness rank 1 and Holy Light rank 1 are starting spells (vanilla baseline). The trainer list begins at their next ranks. ### Levels 1–9 **New now:** L1 Devotion Aura · L4 Judgement, Blessing of Might, Holy Strike rank 1 (class quest), Divine Protection · L6 Seal of the Crusader, Holy Light rank 2 (60 mana, 2.5 s), Purify · L8 Crusader Strike, Hammer of Justice (60 s), Hand of Protection (300 s). **Single target (both specs):** 1. Blessing of Might and Devotion Aura before you pull. Devotion Aura is "BiS for leveling unless you're aoe farming" Jesse Potter · 2025-11-04. 2. Keep a seal up. **Contested:** Seal of Righteousness "is too much mana for too little benefit" at level 8 bigdaddyd · 2025-10-11, but another player says it beats Seal of the Crusader early ("at very low level they're extremely close but sor takes it over pretty early") Dodging · 2025-11-15. Use SoR if your mana lasts from pull to pull. Never judge Crusader on a mob that dies in a few swings. 3. Auto-attack. Press **Holy Strike** every time the strike cooldown is up. From 8, Crusader Strike is the other option on the same cooldown. Use it only while you are above about half mana Jesse Potter · 2026-02-19. 4. **Judgement only to finish** a mob under 20% or one that is running away Jesse Potter · 2026-02-19. 5. Between pulls, Holy Light yourself if needed, then eat or drink. **Multi-target:** you have no AoE. Pull one mob at a time. If a second one joins, Hammer of Justice it and kill the first. Divine Protection is the emergency button. **Tanking and healing:** not yet. Righteous Fury comes at 16, and the first dungeons are around 15. ### Levels 10–19 **New now:** L10 Hand of Reckoning (taunt, 10 s, off the GCD), Lay on Hands, Seal of Righteousness rank 2 · L12 Holy Strike rank 2, Redemption (quest) · L14 **Blessing of Wisdom**, Holy Light rank 3 (110 mana) · L16 **Righteous Fury**, **Retribution Aura** · L18 **Seal of Wisdom**, Seal of Righteousness rank 3, Hand of Freedom. Talents: Ret takes Benediction, Deflection and Improved Judgement; Prot takes Redoubt, Precision and Toughness. None of them changes the buttons. **Ret, single target:** 1. Blessing of Wisdom on yourself from 14 Beldrin · 2025-12-23. Aura: Devotion Aura with a two-hander ("like half a shield while using a 2h as ret") Jesse Potter · 2025-10-05, or Retribution Aura from 16 as in the kill loop below. 2. Seal of Righteousness. 3. Holy Strike on cooldown. Crusader Strike on the shared cooldown only while you are above ~50% mana Jesse Potter · 2026-02-19. "Going oom is a bigger DPS loss than not using CS" Silverhand · 2026-02-01. 4. Judgement only to finish. Do not re-seal on a dying mob Beldrin · 2025-12-23. 5. From 18: when you are low on mana on the last mob, swap to Seal of Wisdom for a few swings instead of drinking Beldrin · 2026-03-23. **Prot, solo:** play it like Ret with a shield until 20. Use Blessing of Wisdom "till sanctuary" Dodging · 2025-10-08. Prot leveling "kicks in" once you have Seal of Wisdom at 18 Magik · 2026-03-22. **Multi-target:** still single pulls. From 18, Seal of Wisdom lets a Prot handle two mobs without drinking. **Tanking (dungeons, from 16):** most players say to wait for Consecration at 20 lukatus · 2025-10-28. If you tank at 16–19: 1. Turn on Righteous Fury, which only raises threat from Holy damage Beldrin · 2025-10-08, and Devotion or Retribution Aura. Wear a shield in dungeons so the healer's mana lasts orodoet · 2026-01-04. 2. Put Seal of Righteousness on and mark a skull. 3. Spread threat by tabbing: "Holy strike on mob, press tab, judge other mob, press tab, auto attack with SoR other mob" gastro · 2025-10-08. Hammer of Justice the third Grey · 2026-01-22. 4. Hand of Reckoning on anything that leaves you. 5. Emergencies: Divine Protection on yourself, Hand of Protection on a DPS who has aggro, Lay on Hands. **Healing (dungeons, 15–19):** any spec can heal these; talents do not matter yet McSavage · 2026-03-13. "Int on gear and mana pots/mana water is all you'll need" Mithreon · 2025-10-19, and Intellect beats everything else at low level Fabian · 2026-03-27. 1. **Holy Light rank 3** (L14) is your only real heal. Use rank 2 for small top-ups. "Early on you will spam Holy Light until you get Flash of Light" Mithreon · 2026-01-03. 2. **Holy Strike** when you stand in melee. It heals you and wounded allies near you for no net mana, but it is weak without talents Mithreon · 2026-01-03. 3. **From 18:** Seal of Wisdom, then melee a mob between heals to get mana back Fjordain · 2025-07-17. 4. **Purify** poisons and diseases. 5. **Mana:** stop casting to let mana regenerate (the five-second rule, vanilla baseline) and drink between pulls. ### Levels 20–29 **New now:** L20 **Consecration** rank 1 (120 mana, 8 s cooldown), **Flash of Light** rank 1 (35 mana, 1.5 s), Exorcism (15 s), Holy Strike rank 3, Crusader Strike rank 2. Prot talent Blessing of Sanctuary at 20; Ret talent Pursuit of Justice at 20–21 · L22 **Concentration Aura**, Holy Light rank 4 (190 mana), Seal of Justice, Blessing of Salvation · L24 Hammer of Justice rank 2 · L26 Flash of Light rank 2 (50 mana), Seal of Righteousness rank 4 · L28 Holy Strike rank 4, Exorcism rank 2, Seal of Wisdom rank 2. Talents: Prot takes Improved Righteous Fury (21–23) and Shield Specialization (24–26); Ret takes Conviction, Improved Retribution Aura and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization. **Ret, single target:** the 10–19 list, plus: 1. **Exorcism** on Undead and Demons, pulled from range or during the fight Mithreon · 2026-02-19. 2. At this level, "just focus on CS and HS when you need healing" Isvash · 2026-04-10. **Ret, multi-target:** add Consecration on 3+ mobs only if you have the mana. Ret still mostly kills one mob at a time Destroses · 2025-12-18. **Prot, solo AoE (from 20):** 1. Blessing of Sanctuary, Righteous Fury, Retribution Aura Destroses · 2026-03-31. 2. Seal of Wisdom, then judge Wisdom and keep Seal of Wisdom up Drekalo, the Bringer of Light · 2026-01-31. 3. Pull 3–4 mobs 1–3 levels below you. Pull no casters: "rule n1 of prot paladin leveling is to avoid enemies with spells" Beldrin · 2026-03-03. 4. Drop Consecration before the mobs reach you, then use Holy Strike on cooldown. Consecration's front-load starts when a mob enters it, so pre-casting loses nothing Grey · 2026-03-21. Recast it every 8 s while 3+ mobs are alive. 5. Below ~50% health: Concentration Aura, then Holy Light or Flash of Light on yourself, then back to Retribution Aura Mithreon · 2025-10-12. **Tanking (dungeons):** from here you can tank properly lukatus · 2025-10-28. 1. **Buffs:** Retribution Aura, Righteous Fury, Blessing of Wisdom; Blessing of Sanctuary if you are Prot Dzonathan · 2025-10-17. 2. **Pull:** pre-cast Seal of Wisdom (trash) or Seal of Righteousness (boss). Run in and drop Consecration *before* you reach the mobs. "If you cast it as you reach them, they _will_ run straight through the consecrate without taking damage" Grey · 2026-01-14. 3. **First GCDs:** Holy Strike the skull → Judgement → re-seal → Hand of Reckoning or Hammer of Justice on a runner Dzonathan · 2025-09-27. 4. **Steady loop:** Holy Strike on cooldown, Judgement on cooldown, re-seal. Consecration only on 3+ mobs. On two mobs it is not worth the mana, because "Consecration is just there for the 4th target and up" Grey · 2026-01-21. 5. **Never Crusader Strike as a tank.** It is physical, so Righteous Fury does not boost it: "In dungeons, always holy strike" Arle · 2026-01-26, Arle · 2025-09-13. 6. **Mobs leaving you:** a mob runs to anyone who drinks, buffs, or has a heal-over-time on them Grey · 2026-01-14. Taunt it back, or Holy Strike the loose mob. 7. **Mana:** "You should be drinking whenever your healer is" Grey · 2026-01-21. **Healing (dungeons):** in low dungeons, healers "play Flash of Light simulator until you get Blessed Strikes" Dodging · 2026-03-18. | Situation | Spell | |---|---| | Normal tank damage | Flash of Light rank 1–2 (35/50 mana) on repeat Dodging · 2025-12-21 | | Tank at ~60% or lower | Holy Light rank 4 until near full, then back to Flash of Light Beldrin · 2025-12-21 | | Several people chipped, you are in melee | Holy Strike | | Pushback from mobs hitting you | Concentration Aura (from 22) | | Mana | Judge Wisdom → Seal of Wisdom → Holy Strike, then heal in a constant rhythm Bello · 2025-08-21. Avoid max ranks: in dungeons max-rank healing is "a mana waste most of the time" Zblougi · 2025-02-27. Use "whatever rank keeps people alive without draining your mana before you're ready to be at 0" Grey · 2025-12-24 | Triage: tank first, then yourself, then DPS who pulled aggro. Blessing of Protection a DPS rather than healing them through aggro (vanilla baseline). ### Levels 30–39 **New now:** L30 **Seal of Command** (Ret talent, rank 1), **Holy Shield** (Prot talent, 135 mana, 10 s cooldown), **Holy Shock** (Holy talent; only on the Holy/Prot variant; 280 mana, 20 s cooldown, 20 yd), **Cleanse**, Seal of Light, Consecration rank 2 (205 mana), Crusader Strike rank 3, Holy Light rank 5 (275 mana), Divine Intervention, Lay on Hands rank 2 · L34 **Divine Shield** (300 s), Flash of Light rank 3 (70 mana), Seal of Righteousness rank 5 · L36 Holy Strike rank 5, Exorcism rank 3 · L38 Holy Light rank 6 (365 mana), Holy Shock rank 2, Seal of Wisdom rank 3, Hand of Protection rank 3. Talents: Ret takes Conviction 4–5, Vengeance (33–37) and Vengeful Strikes (38–42); Prot takes Righteous Defense (31–33), Reckoning (34–36) and Righteous Strikes (37–41). **Ret, single target:** 1. **Seal of Command rank 1** replaces Seal of Righteousness as your seal. Ranks only change the Judgement, so rank 1 is enough Percival · 2021-08-20. 2. Holy Strike on cooldown to keep Holy Might up. Crusader Strike on the shared cooldown for Zeal while your mana allows Isvash · 2026-04-10. Crusader Strike starts to pull ahead "as you get better weapons and vengeful strikes (so after lvl 35)" Beldrin · 2026-02-01. 3. Judgement only to finish a mob. 4. Exorcism on Undead and Demons. **Ret, multi-target:** unchanged. Seal of Command has little AoE, so fight one mob at a time and add Consecration on 3+ mobs when mana allows. **Prot, solo AoE:** Holy Shield before every pull. Prot takes off "with holy shield and reckoning, so like 34ish" dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-18. In green gear, pull 1–2 packs Mithreon · 2025-11-04. Divine Shield from 34 saves a bad pull. **Tanking (dungeons):** 1. **Pull:** mark a skull, cast Seal of Righteousness, cast Holy Shield while running in, then Holy Strike and Judgement on the skull and drop Consecration Dodging · 2025-10-24. 2. **Loop:** Holy Strike on cooldown → Judgement → re-seal → Holy Shield when it drops → Consecration on 3+ mobs. 3. **Mana:** Holy Shield rank 1 "will double your consumption. Feel free to stop using it after the first cast on a pack" Grey · 2026-01-21. Downrank Consecration when packs die fast Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2025-11-08. Seal of Wisdom on trash, Seal of Righteousness on bosses Dzonathan · 2025-10-17. 4. **Pack size:** two packs at a time works at 33 unless the healer is low or you are squishy Lyrazia · 2025-10-17. 5. **Emergencies:** Divine Shield drops your threat, so use it only to survive. Lay on Hands; Hand of Protection on a DPS who has aggro. **Healing (dungeons):** 1. **Flash of Light rank 3** (70 mana, from 34) for most healing. Holy Light rank 5 or 6 for big tank damage. 2. **Holy Shock** is the emergency instant heal, but only if you took it (Holy/Prot variant); the Ret and Prot orders above skip it. It is expensive: one level-34 Holy healer reported that "shock + holy light" to keep the tank up in Stormwrought ran them out of mana Blackbiospark · 2025-12-21. 3. **Holy Strike** in melee for small party heals. The real melee-healing playstyle needs the Holy talents Ironclad (from 26) and 5/5 Blessed Strikes (from 39), so it does not work in the Ret or Prot leveling builds Fjordain · 2025-07-17. Blessed Strikes raises the heal's scaling from 5% to 30% of healing power Mithreon · 2025-12-05. 4. **Cleanse** (from 30) removes magic, poison and disease. ### Levels 40–49 **New now:** L40 Consecration rank 3 (290 mana), Crusader Strike rank 4, Seal of Command rank 3, Seal of Light rank 2, Hammer of Justice rank 3, Blessing of Light, Blessing of Sanctuary rank 2, Holy Wrath (645 mana, 2 s cast, 60 s), **Warhorse** (quest). Prot talent Bulwark of the Righteous at 42 (300 s) · L42 Flash of Light rank 4 (90 mana), Seal of Righteousness rank 6 · L44 **Hammer of Wrath** (1 s cast, 6 s cooldown), Holy Strike rank 6, Exorcism rank 4 · L46 Holy Light rank 7 (465 mana) · L48 Holy Shock rank 3, Seal of Wisdom rank 4. Talents: Ret finishes Vengeful Strikes, then Redoubt and Precision; Prot takes Divine Intellect, then Improved Seal of Righteousness. Repentance is a level-40 talent, but the Ret order takes it last, at 60. **Ret, single target:** the 30–39 list. Hammer of Wrath is an optional finisher below 20%; many players skip it because it is low damage for its mana Mithreon · 2025-11-21. The Gilneas City ring (43–44) is the first spellstrike item and a big mana boost Maddy · 2025-10-06. **Prot, solo AoE:** same loop. Bulwark of the Righteous makes bigger packs survivable dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-01-13. Fast weapons give more Seal of Wisdom procs to pay for Holy Shield and Consecration Vastus · 2026-04-16. **Tanking (dungeons):** same as 30–39. Bulwark is your big defensive cooldown for boss burst or a bad pull. **Healing (dungeons):** Flash of Light rank 4 as the default, Holy Light rank 7 for the tank, Cleanse and Purify. A Ret or Prot in an Intellect set can heal dungeons "all the way to 50lvl (then it gets significantly worse)" Anborn · 2025-04-16. ### Levels 50–60 **New now:** L50 Consecration rank 4 (390 mana), Crusader Strike rank 5, Seal of Command rank 4, Seal of Righteousness rank 7, Seal of Light rank 3, Flash of Light rank 5 (115 mana), Holy Shield rank 2, Divine Shield rank 2, Lay on Hands rank 3, Bulwark rank 2 · L52 Holy Strike rank 7, Exorcism rank 5, Hammer of Wrath rank 2, Greater Blessing of Might · L54 Holy Light rank 8 (580 mana), Greater Blessing of Wisdom, Hammer of Justice rank 4 · L56 Holy Shock rank 4 · L58 Flash of Light rank 6 (140 mana), Seal of Righteousness rank 8, Seal of Wisdom rank 5 · L60 Holy Strike rank 8, Consecration rank 5 (505 mana), Flash of Light rank 7 (180 mana), Holy Wrath rank 2, Holy Light rank 9, the other Greater Blessings, Charger (quest). Talents: Ret spends the last points on Deflection, Divine Strength, Divine Intellect and Repentance (60); Prot on Sanctity Aura (53), Benediction and Improved Judgement. **Ret:** the same loop. After 50 "you can do whatever until lvl 60 and respec" Mithreon · 2025-11-19. At 60, respec and switch to the [Retribution rotation](#/class/paladin/retribution-melee-dps). **Prot:** Lashers in Dire Maul East from 52–54 Blossom · 2026-01-11. Keep Retribution Aura over Sanctity for AoE farming Destroses · 2026-03-26. **Tanking (dungeons):** near 50–60, "you'll only really use SoW to judge then ur all SoR" Destroses · 2025-10-16. Holy Strike and Judgement of Righteousness carry single-target threat; Consecration handles packs. At 60 the loop becomes the [Protection rotation](#/class/paladin/protection-tank). **Healing (dungeons):** Flash of Light rank 5–7 as the default, Holy Light rank 8–9 for big tank hits, Holy Shock rank 4 if talented. At 60, see [Holy](#/class/paladin/holy-healer).

sections.heading: The kill loop
sections.markdown: ### Retribution (single target) "Literally just press holy strike, seal of righteousness, and judgement" Grey · 2026-02-01. In detail: 1. Blessing of Wisdom (from 14, a mana-per-5 buff) Beldrin · 2025-12-23, Beldrin · 2025-12-23; Retribution Aura. 2. Seal: **Seal of Righteousness before 30, Seal of Command (rank 1) after 30**; Seal of Wisdom for mana, Seal of Light for healing Mithreon · 2026-04-09. 3. Auto-attack. **Holy Strike** to keep Holy Might up, **Crusader Strike** as filler Isvash · 2026-04-10; below ~50% mana use Holy Strike instead of Crusader Strike, since it is mana-neutral Jesse Potter · 2026-02-19. 4. **Judgement only to finish** a mob under 20% Jesse Potter · 2026-02-19, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-07. Do not re-seal or judge a mob that is about to die: "it's better if you spend 3 extra seconds waiting for an auto than to spend 40% of your mana bar then drink for 10s" Beldrin · 2025-12-23, Beldrin · 2025-12-23. 5. Exorcism on Undead and Demons Mithreon · 2026-02-19. 6. Out of mana on the last mob: switch to Seal of Wisdom for a few swings instead of drinking Beldrin · 2026-03-23. Going out of mana is normal for Ret Jesse Potter · 2026-02-19. Blessing of Sanctuary, Righteous Fury, Retribution Aura Destroses · 2026-03-31. 2. Seal of Wisdom, judge Wisdom, keep Seal of Wisdom up Drekalo, the Bringer of Light · 2026-01-31. 3. Pull 3-4 mobs 1-3 levels below you; avoid casters Beldrin · 2026-01-20. Low on health: Concentration Aura + Spiritual Focus, Flash of Light or Holy Light, then back to Retribution Aura Mithreon · 2025-10-12. sections.heading: Tanking dungeons while leveling
sections.markdown: - **When:** from 20, once you have Consecration: "Wait till atleast 20 to tank dungeons" lukatus · 2025-10-28. Any spec can tank with Righteous Fury up "as long as your party doesn't go overboard with AOE's" Xiyanzhe 吸烟者 · 2026-04-06; from 15 to 40 your talents barely matter for tanking Grey · 2026-01-11. - **Opener:** precast Seal of Righteousness and Holy Shield, judge the cross, Holy Strike the skull, Consecrate Dodging · 2026-01-02. Grey's cookie cutter: "Holy Strike Skull, JoR X, SoR Triangle", and stun the third mob Grey · 2026-01-22. - **Trash:** Dzonathan's routine: Retribution Aura, Righteous Fury, Blessing of Wisdom; prebuff Seal of Wisdom and Holy Shield; Holy Strike + Judgement, Consecrate; re-seal Wisdom and refresh Consecration and Holy Shield; Seal of Righteousness on bosses Dzonathan · 2025-10-17. - **Always Holy Strike in dungeons.** Crusader Strike is physical and loses the Righteous Fury threat bonus: "for dungeons you will be losing on 60%+ threat" Arle · 2026-01-26, Mithreon · 2025-11-20. - **Mana:** Holy Strike and SoR autos are free; Judgement of Righteousness costs about 20 mana per second; rank-1 Holy Shield doubles that, so stop after the first cast on a pack; Consecration is "just there for the 4th target and up" Grey · 2026-01-21. - There is no big baseline AoE snap threat; Righteous Strikes and Improved Righteous Fury, then Goblin Sappers, fill the gap Mithreon · 2025-11-23. - Ret can heal most leveling dungeons: a paladin with zero talent points can heal every pre-60 dungeon in healing gear Grey · 2025-12-06.

sections.heading: Gold farming and AoE
sections.markdown: - **Lashers** (Dire Maul East) are the class gold staple from 52-54 Mithreon · 2025-10-11, Blossom · 2026-01-11, tripleXDengine · 2025-11-10. sections.heading: Common mistakes
sections.markdown: 1. **Leveling as Holy without a duo** Beldrin · 2025-12-29. 2. **Using Crusader Strike as your main strike as Prot** or in dungeons Mithreon · 2025-11-20. 3. **Keeping Seal of the Crusader active** Jesse Potter · 2026-02-20. 4. **Taking Sanctity Aura or stat talents early**: stat talents such as Divine Intellect "do absolutely next to nothing for low-level players" McSavage · 2026-03-13, and Sanctity Aura is not worth it while leveling Excinerus · 2026-01-03. 5. **Following "17/17/17" meme builds** posted as jokes Destroses · 2025-11-21. 6. **Judging and re-sealing mobs that are about to die**, then sitting to drink Beldrin · 2025-12-23. 7. **Pulling casters or mobs above your level** as an AoE Prot Beldrin · 2026-01-20. 8. **Using Nature-damage gear (FRD, thorns) on Lashers** Mithreon · 2025-10-11. 9. **AoE farming on Hardcore** Silverhand · 2026-03-25. 10. **Not recasting your aura after taking Improved Devotion Aura or Improved Retribution Aura.** The talent does nothing until you do Leo · 2026-01-28. No full-raid comparison was posted. 2. **No public Paladin DPS simulator** exists; people with private calculators refuse to share them Flensmaster ٩(◕‿◕｡)۶ · 2026-04-06, Adamant · 2026-04-10. Stat weights are rules of thumb. 3. **Crusader Strike vs Holy Strike for spellret after 1.18.1**: the answer depends on armor, spell power and weapon, and players disagree K24 · 2026-03-24, Aljeron · 2026-03-24. 4. **Fortune and the Lost set**: whether Fortune raises the Lost set's ghost procs is unconfirmed; testing needs ~10,000 casts Destroses · 2026-04-05, Dodging · 2026-03-26. 5. **Libram of Ardour vs Libram of the Eternal Tower** by fight length: two views Gilfrey · 2026-03-31, Destroses · 2026-04-13. 6. **Pysan's New Greatsword for Necrodin**: one tester calls it BiS, others doubt a 3.5-speed weapon Agnesia · 2026-03-28, L-star · 2026-03-28. Its proc rate changed after a hotfix. 7. **Necrodin Tier 2 slot split** (which pieces Ret vs Prot): several different splits, no consensus keungzhe · 2026-02-09, Mithreon · 2026-04-03. 8. **Tempered Runeblade's real proc rate**: database 1.2 PPM vs a measured 2.1 Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-11-03, Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2025-11-04. 9. **Consecration's spell power coefficient** (~0.66 claimed) was never confirmed Proph · 2026-02-03. 10. **Flametongue Totem bug (April 2026)** inflated SoR and Necrodin parses; whether and when it was fully fixed is not in the sources Mithreon · 2026-04-13. 11. **Divine Shield's healing penalty**: 50% or 60% Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31, Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2025-12-29. 12. **PvP**: no posted, complete 51-point Ret or Holy PvP build; the self-heal Ret and Shockadin trees on the PvP page are reconstructed from descriptions and marked as such. Nobody answered requests for a PvP template Flowers · 2026-02-13. No arena comp or rating data; no current data for the Priest, Druid and Paladin matchups. 13. **Leveling**: no full zone route; the Ret leveling order is Mithreon's checkpoints with the in-between order chosen for this guide; no post-1.18.1 leveling order was posted in full. 14. **After May 2026**: any later hotfix or balance patch is not covered.

Crusader Strike and Holy Strike share a cooldown. - **Seal twisting no longer works** Excinerus · 2025-12-30. - **Judgement is a melee attack** (melee hit and crit) Wulf (Th0r1369) · 2025-10-31, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-20. - **Sanctity Aura lives in the Holy tree** (11-point sink) and every Ret takes it Jesse Potter · 2025-10-12, Jesse Potter · 2025-11-04. - **Seal of Command is a level-30 talent** on Turtle (20 in Classic) Beldrin · 2026-01-11; Consecration is baseline at 20 Mima · 2026-01-02. - **Hand of Sacrifice no longer breaks crowd control**; Hand of Freedom has a longer cooldown Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-03-28. - **Melee hit cap is 8%** against bosses; 5 weapon skill = 1% hit Destroses · 2025-11-08, Dodging · 2026-04-01.

gear.about: Gear recommendations for Paladin (Holy healer, Protection tank, Retribution melee DPS) by spec/role and level bracket, with where-to-obtain, built from the Paladin forum (f41), General-forum BiS threads, the existing class playbooks' "Gear, enchants and consumables" sections, and the Itemization forum's relic list and 1.18.1 changelog. Every "is there a Turtle BiS list" thread in the Paladin forum gets the same answer: no current one exists. The one detailed pre-raid list found (t393, Protection tank) is a 2019 repost of a generic vanilla guide, explicitly declared outdated by a player in 2025 — kept here only because it is the single most complete named-item list found for any Paladin spec, with that caveat attached to every item in it.
caveats: No Turtle-specific pre-raid or raid BiS list exists for any Paladin spec. t8738, t18785, t17662 (partial), t21851, t23183 and t19282/t4568 (Holy) are all unanswered or answered with "ask Discord"/"use a vanilla guide".

t393's pre-raid Protection tank list is a 2019 repost of a generic vanilla guide (item links go to db.vanillagaming.org, not Turtle's database) and was explicitly declared outdated: "Its outdated. Tankpaladin works vastly different now and requires other gear as a result. Additionally turtlewow has added many new better fitting items for palatanks" — [Atreidon (player), 2025-07-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=140261#p140261). Every item from that thread below carries valid_for_1181: false for this reason, even where the item itself may still exist in Turtle's database.

A Retribution gearing thread (t19669) named 5 items only as raw https://database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N links with no item name in the post text (ids 83440, 83462, 83463, 80674, 60550) — names could not be resolved without a live database/network lookup, which this guide is barred from doing. Not included below; see gaps.

Relic slot items (Librams) below are Turtle-added content per the staff relic-list post; drop locations for those are staff-stated and are Turtle-specific dungeons/bosses (Emerald Sanctum, Lower/Upper Karazhan, Scarlet Monastery trash for one, Gilneas City trash for one) added across patches 1.16-1.17.2, i.e. pre-1.18.1 content still current unless stated otherwise.

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No Turtle-specific pre-raid gear list exists for Holy or Retribution; the only rich pre-raid list found (Protection tank) is a 2019 vanilla repost explicitly declared outdated in 2025.
- Retribution's t19669 thread named 5 melee items only by raw `database.turtlecraft.gg` item IDs (83440, 83462, 83463, 80674, 60550) with no item names in the post text — could not be resolved without a live database lookup, which this guide is barred from performing.
- "4HM" referenced in the Ret T2.5-vs-T3 stat debate (t18310) is an unexplained acronym, not resolved to an item name anywhere in the sources.
- "Zandalar Freethinker's" is named as part of the Ret raid kit with no item type or slot given.
- No leveling gear list (leveling-10-29 / leveling-30-49) exists for any Paladin spec; only Holy's leveling-50-59 dungeon list (from t14711) was found. Retribution and Protection leveling gear is entirely uncovered.
- No PvP gear list exists for Holy PvP, or for Retribution/Protection PvP beyond the single Fishbringer mention under Protection.
- Enchant lists exist only for Holy and Protection (from a single 2022 guide, last edited 2024-12-04); no enchant list exists for Retribution beyond a brief fragment noting the AP-vs-SP enchant choice per slot is explicitly unresolved in the sources.
- Several Libram relics from the staff relic-list post (Libram of Veracity, Libram of the Resolute, Libram of the Justicar, and the vanilla Libram of Fervor change) were not assigned to a specific spec/bracket above because their best-fit spec is ambiguous (general utility, PvP, or shared) — see [t8229](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=8229) directly for the full list.

sections.heading: Experts relied on, and why
sections.markdown: - **Lhian** (developer): posted and explained the 1.18.1 paladin changes in-channel and confirms or denies rumours directly Lhian · 2026-03-25, Lhian · 2026-03-12. His 2026-04-01 "next patch" post was an April Fools joke Lhian · 2026-04-01, tripleXDengine · 2026-04-01. - **Mithreon**: the channel's build curator; posts the pinned talent codes (the SoR, SoC, Prot and Holy builds used here Mithreon · 2026-04-10, Mithreon · 2025-11-18), the spell coefficient sheet Mithreon · 2025-07-04 and the leveling checkpoints Mithreon · 2025-11-19. - **Jesse Potter (Lightbourne)**: one of the top Seal of Command Rets on the server; detailed openers, gear and consumable lists, PvP Jesse Potter · 2025-12-30, Jesse Potter · 2026-04-16. Others note he is prolific and sometimes wrong Adamant · 2026-01-11; his claims were cross-checked. - **Istenneveben (Spelladin)**: long-time top SoR parser and author of the community spellret gear guide Breaddy · 2025-10-14; weapon skill and rotation summaries Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-03-30, Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2026-04-21. - **Grey**: careful mechanics and math (SoR formulas, mana, Fortune, tank tier lists) Grey · 2026-01-07, Grey · 2026-04-04. - **Destroses, Beldrin, gastro, dusty, Excinerus, Adamant, Silverhand, Proph, keungzhe**: repeated, mutually checked answers on Necrodin, spellstrikes, Windfury, weapons and stats. Every build and number was checked against the message text in the raw archive; misattributed note citations were corrected.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown: What the sources do not settle: 1. **SoR vs SoC under full raid buffs.** The only controlled test was a self-buffed dummy (SoC ahead by ~30 DPS) Aljeron · 2026-03-26; raid logs still favour SoR at the very top Jesse Potter · 2026-04-13. No full-raid comparison was posted. 2. **No public Paladin DPS simulator** exists; people with private calculators refuse to share them Flensmaster ٩(◕‿◕｡)۶ · 2026-04-06, Adamant · 2026-04-10. Stat weights are rules of thumb. 3. **Crusader Strike vs Holy Strike for spellret after 1.18.1**: the answer depends on armor, spell power and weapon, and players disagree K24 · 2026-03-24, Aljeron · 2026-03-24. 4. **Fortune and the Lost set**: whether Fortune raises the Lost set's ghost procs is unconfirmed; testing needs ~10,000 casts Destroses · 2026-04-05, Dodging · 2026-03-26. 5. **Libram of Ardour vs Libram of the Eternal Tower** by fight length: two views Gilfrey · 2026-03-31, Destroses · 2026-04-13. 6. **Pysan's New Greatsword for Necrodin**: one tester calls it BiS, others doubt a 3.5-speed weapon Agnesia · 2026-03-28, L-star · 2026-03-28. Its proc rate changed after a hotfix. 7. **Necrodin Tier 2 slot split** (which pieces Ret vs Prot): several different splits, no consensus keungzhe · 2026-02-09, Mithreon · 2026-04-03. 8. **Tempered Runeblade's real proc rate**: database 1.2 PPM vs a measured 2.1 Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-11-03, Istenneveben (Spelladin) · 2025-11-04. 9. **Consecration's spell power coefficient** (~0.66 claimed) was never confirmed Proph · 2026-02-03. 10. **Flametongue Totem bug (April 2026)** inflated SoR and Necrodin parses; whether and when it was fully fixed is not in the sources Mithreon · 2026-04-13. 11. **Divine Shield's healing penalty**: 50% or 60% Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-31, Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2025-12-29. 12. **PvP**: no posted, complete 51-point Ret or Holy PvP build; the self-heal Ret and Shockadin trees on the PvP page are reconstructed from descriptions and marked as such. Nobody answered requests for a PvP template Flowers · 2026-02-13. No arena comp or rating data; no current data for the Priest, Druid and Paladin matchups. 13. **Leveling**: no full zone route; the Ret leveling order is Mithreon's checkpoints with the in-between order chosen for this guide; no post-1.18.1 leveling order was posted in full. 14. **After May 2026**: any later hotfix or balance patch is not covered.

guidePages.title: Paladin professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** level with **two gathering professions**. Herbalism + Mining is the usual pair, or Skinning for early silver. At 60, swap one of them for **Engineering**, the only main profession that "benefits you in raids" donnyhathawayenjoyer · 2026-03-27, Destroses · 2026-04-08. Keep the gathering profession that fits your gold farm: **Herbalism** for the Dire Maul East lashers, **Mining** for Zul'Gurub Arcane Crystal veins Mithreon · 2026-01-14, Mithreon · 2026-02-19. A Retribution player who wants the pre-raid **Tempered Runeblade** can take Blacksmithing (Swordsmith) long enough to craft it, then drop it Mithreon · 2025-11-27. Add **Survival** as a secondary skill for the slingshot ranged pull Mithreon · 2026-03-26, Arle · 2026-03-26.

sections.heading: Best pairs by goal
sections.markdown: | Goal | Pair | Why | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Leveling** | Two of Herbalism, Mining, Skinning | Gold while you level; "don't bother with creating items yourself" | Destroses · 2025-11-08, bela · 2026-04-08, Destroses · 2026-04-08 | | **Raiding: Protection** | Engineering + Herbalism or Mining | Sappers double your opening AoE threat; the Force Reactive Disk handles AoE snap threat and farming. "Consecration is effectively balanced around the assumption you're using both" | Grey · 2026-01-25, Grey · 2026-04-04 | | **Raiding: Retribution** | Engineering + Blacksmithing (Swordsmith) until the Tempered Runeblade is made, then Engineering + a gathering profession | Sappers add 500-600 damage per AoE pull; the Runeblade is BiS for Spellret before BWL | Jesse Potter · 2025-10-17, Mithreon · 2025-11-27, Mithreon · 2025-11-27 | | **Raiding: Holy** | Engineering + a gathering profession | Blacksmithing gives Holy little; Engineering lets a Holy player dual-spec Prot and farm | chincer · 2025-11-05, Arle · 2026-02-14 | | **PvP** | Engineering + anything | You want Engineering for any endgame content, PvP included (grenades, PvP trinkets) | Destroses · 2026-04-08, gastro · 2025-10-18 | | **Gold-making** | Herbalism + Alchemy or Herbalism + Enchanting (with Engineering on the farming paladin) | Herbs drop around the lasher farm, Alchemy sells transmutes and flasks, Enchanting disenchants the BoE farm | Ricvol · 2025-05-05, Iseut · 2025-06-11, Breaddy · 2025-01-05 | **How much does Engineering matter?** Most players agree it is the one profession that counts. **Contested** on how much: it is "not required unless you're planning to be even semi serious in raids" Dodging · 2025-10-18, and "people do put a lot more weight on engi than what it really is" Dodging · 2025-10-18. The strongest view is that "every other proffesion exists to serve Engineering, especially on Paladin" Southshore Crusader Vidnar · 2026-01-03.

sections.heading: What each profession gives a paladin
sections.markdown: ### Engineering - **Goblin Sapper Charges and dynamite.** For Prot they are the snap AoE threat the class otherwise lacks: a Sapper does about 500 threat, the same as Consecration's first tick Excinerus · 2025-10-29, Grey · 2026-04-04. For Ret they add 500-600 damage to each AoE pull Jesse Potter · 2025-10-17. They are also the only real raid damage a Prot paladin does Iseut · 2025-06-11. Righteous Resolve and Vengeance both raise the self-damage you take from a Sapper Mithreon · 2025-10-18, Mithreon · 2025-10-19. - **Grenades** for ranged pulls and AoE trash packs Jesse Potter · 2026-01-30. - **Force Reactive Disk** (300 Engineering; about 900 armor Excinerus · 2025-10-19). It is the paladin farming tool: "vampirism+FRD is the latchkey of paladin farming" Silverhand · 2026-04-01. It opens solo farms that are otherwise impossible, such as Stratholme Arle · 2025-12-21, gastro · 2025-10-18, and stays useful for AoE tanking up to Kara40 gastro · 2026-01-16. Drawbacks: it breaks "every second or third pull" in Stratholme Tychon · 2025-12-21, so bring a repair bot Arle · 2025-12-21. Many tanks keep Crest of Retribution on and save the Disk for big pulls Moorea · 2026-04-14. It deals Nature damage, so it does nothing against the Nature-immune lashers Mithreon · 2025-10-11, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-13. - **Electromagnetic Gigaflux Reactivator:** "too many paladins are sleeping on" it. Use it, swap it out, and the 10-minute shield stays up Dzonathan · 2025-11-11, Dzonathan · 2025-11-11. - **Teleporters:** a craftable Stormwind teleport and the Everlook teleporter Mithreon · 2026-01-14, Arle · 2025-12-21. The Gadgetzan teleporter is made obsolete by the Time-Worn Rune Arle · 2025-12-21. - **Mechanical/Battle Chicken:** you cannot force the proc as on Blizzard servers. In combat it starts a random 30-80 s timer, a "substantial nerf" 30 · 2025-10-18, Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2025-10-18. - Turtle also has a free summonable repair bot that is not the crafted one Lyrazia · 2025-11-10. - **Cost:** about 100-150g from 1 to 300 gastro · 2026-04-04, tripleXDengine · 2025-11-11. **Gnomish or Goblin?** Turtle doesn't change the classic answer: the optimal min-max path is still Gnomish first, then Goblin Grey · 2026-04-04. The three usual paths gastro · 2026-03-21: 1. **Gnomish first, then Goblin** (the "optimal" min-max path): craft the Gnomish BoP items such as the Battle Chicken, then unlearn and relevel Goblin to make your own Sappers Mithreon · 2025-12-21, Nobody-86 · 2026-04-17. You cannot swap the specialization by itself; you relearn the whole profession from 1 Mithreon · 2025-12-21. 2. **Goblin only**, buying Gnomish items on the AH. A Prot player with no arena plans was told "there aint anything worth anything in gnomish" Mima · 2025-12-26. 3. **Gnomish only**, for the Battle Chicken, buying Sappers on the AH gastro · 2026-03-21. Winterspring's Gnomish teleport is preferred over Gadgetzan because it is close to the Caverns of Time teleport. Bag-hungry Gnomish gadgets (Death Ray, Net-o-Matic) mostly stay home, because Turtle has many good trinkets bela · 2026-03-21, bela · 2026-03-21. ### Blacksmithing - **Retribution: Tempered Runeblade.** It needs 300 Blacksmithing, Weaponsmith, then Swordsmith Mithreon · 2025-11-11. Craft the Untempered Runeblade to open the quest chain (the dwarf at LHC, after the Winterspring swordsmith quest) Jesse Potter · 2025-12-01. The chain's materials cost about 150-200g KO.NC · 2025-11-30. Finishing the quest chain loses you Argent Dawn reputation Mithreon · 2025-10-30. It is BiS for Spellret before BWL, and "95% sure tempered beats fist" Mithreon · 2025-11-27, Destroses · 2026-03-11. **Contested:** "bis sword for 2 phases" Breaddy · 2025-10-16 versus "the phases are preraid and MC" gastro · 2025-10-16. If you skip Blacksmithing, take the Argent Dawn two-hander Raugtreefell · 2026-04-08. - **Axesmith** makes Nightfall Mithreon · 2025-11-11. Outside a fresh server, one player calls Swordsmithing "essentially pointless" and Axesmithing "the clear winner" (single source) Olivaar of Moments · 2025-10-16. - **1.18.1 upgrades:** BWL drops sharpening stones that raise Blacksmith-crafted weapons to BWL item level Grey · 2026-03-21. You must be a 300 Swordsmith to use the Elementium Champion Junak'Salsa · 2026-03-23. One player rates it weaker than UTB for similar effort (single source) Spaghett Victim #1 · 2026-04-04. Staff describe the system in [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272). - **Other crafts:** Fiery Plate Gauntlets and Storm Gauntlets are Spellret spellstrike hands Adamant · 2025-11-23. The Dreamsteel belt buckle is sought after Lyrazia · 2025-10-16. Armorsmithing has nothing useful for endgame. Its first quest-chain trinket is decent, and you don't need to be an Armorsmith to wear it Mithreon · 2025-11-11, Beldrin · 2025-11-13, Beldrin · 2025-11-13. - **Buy it instead:** you can buy almost every good Blacksmithing item on the AH Beldrin · 2025-12-29. Crafted leveling gear falls behind unless you farm a lot of ore bela · 2026-01-18. - **Warning:** changing specialization loses the recipes you learned in the old one Lyrazia · 2025-10-07. Unlearning Blacksmithing resets it to skill 1 Jesse Potter · 2026-01-18. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle custom) - **Value:** only on a main Prot paladin, and only if alts cover your other professions. The Goldsmith neck gives 5% magic damage reduction angels1m · 2026-02-21, angels1m · 2026-02-21, Destroses · 2026-02-27. Grey's verdict: goldsmithing is "-30%g/hr to lashers for 5% DR on like 3 boss fights" Grey · 2026-04-04. On Ambershire the neck "IS pretty damn good", but switch to Engineering eventually Arle · 2025-12-21. - **Crafts named in the channel:** a 300-JC "HoJ ring" with a fire-damage proc (Goldsmith section; name not given) Oathbreaker · 2025-10-04, Dodging · 2025-10-04. A 3% vampirism JC trinket for vamp farming sets Torbz · 2026-01-27. Embergem Cuffs, a Spellret spellstrike bracer Adamant · 2025-11-23. - **Weak points:** Goldsmith ring enchants are poor ("Can't even do +6stam") Grey · 2025-12-06. The split into two specializations was "overambitious". Gemology is the half guilds need Grey · 2026-01-30, Jesse Potter · 2026-01-30. - Leveling route, trainers and the Goldsmith quest chain: [Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106310#p106310). ### Herbalism and Mining (gathering) - **Herbalism:** herb nodes around the lasher courtyard raise lasher-farm output more than Mining does Mithreon · 2025-11-11, Iseut · 2025-06-11. It also gives Black Lotus chances in Dire Maul and Stratholme Grey · 2026-01-25. - **Mining:** mainly for Zul'Gurub runs that hit two Arcane Crystal veins Mithreon · 2025-11-11, Pastor · 2026-02-12. Outside that it is a "waste" for someone who already has Engineering and Blacksmithing at 300 (single source) Alexander · 2026-03-14. - **Skinning:** early silver bela · 2026-04-08. Rugged Hides sell for about 2g each Jesse Potter · 2025-10-13. ### Alchemy and Enchanting - **Alchemy:** "pots to give myself even more 'Oh Shit' buttons" Deleted User · 2025-10-17, plus flasks and transmutes Iseut · 2025-06-11. Arcanite transmutes earn about 6g over an Arcane Crystal every 2 days, so they pay only across several alts gastro · 2025-11-22, Mithreon · 2025-11-22. - **Enchanting:** disenchant the greens and blues from BoE farms PerchyBrown · 2025-12-02, Mithreon · 2026-02-19. It is worth going all in only if you will collect the AQ/MC and reputation enchants liaam/Durtann · 2025-12-27. Otherwise a low-level bank alt can disenchant for you Grey · 2026-01-25. ### Tailoring and Leatherworking The channel says little. A Holy player asked whether Tailoring beats Blacksmithing, and the answer was Engineering plus a gold-farm profession chincer · 2025-11-05, Destroses · 2025-11-05. The crafts paladins want are BoE, so buy them: **Spellwoven Drape of Nobility** (Tailoring BoE) for Ret Adamant · 2026-04-13, and the **Red Dragonscale** set (Leatherworking), a good starter set for Holy but not mandatory Mithreon · 2026-04-10. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) **1.18.1 (current).** The 1.18.1 patch reset Survival's skill and recipes; it is now a new profession trained mostly at the trainer near the Stormwind gates Mithreon · 2026-03-26, Mithreon · 2026-03-26. Staff list tools that slow, root or trap, gathering bags and Woodcutting [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168). What paladins use it for: - **Simple Slingshot:** the ranged pull paladins never had, with a 20-yard range Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-03-20, Arle · 2026-03-26. You get it early, before skill 80 Mithreon · 2026-03-23. In the player leveling route it sits at 35-50 [Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172915#p172915). - **Salves** and other small utility Mithreon · 2026-03-26. **Throwing Bolas** can proc Wrath of Cenarius (single source) Jesse Potter · 2026-03-22. - **Gathering trinkets:** the Black Lotus trinket multiplies the Lotus proc chance by 1.5, and the Arcane Crystal trinket adds a flat 2% (single source) Mithreon · 2026-04-02. That suits a paladin farmer on lashers or ZG. - **How far to level it:** "you only need to level survival to like 60" and "I would not really recommend getting high level with survival" Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-03-26, Seviry (#AmbershireMatters) · 2026-03-26. The standard pair in the channel is "Engineering and Survival" Mithreon · 2026-03-26. - **Tents:** rested XP from tents is capped at 25% in 1.18.1 [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168). Grey read the preview as "basically removes them from the game" Grey · 2026-02-18. **Before 1.18.1 (historical).** Survival was "for tents and an offhand" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-01. The offhand was the Repaired Electro-Lantern, a Nature spellstrike item for Spellret Adamant · 2025-11-23. Tents filled rested XP in minutes Jesse Potter · 2025-10-04, but they were "almost always" at the Stormwind entrance, so you didn't need the skill yourself Mithreon · 2025-10-01. **Gardening.** The paladin channel says little: endgame food and Power Mushrooms come from Gardening Dodging · 2025-10-21, Mithreon · 2025-10-21, and one player uses semi-AFK Gardening or Alchemy for weekly expenses Arle · 2026-01-28. The 1.18.1 reset also reset the Gardening quest [Sylveria (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171863#p171863).

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **1-60:** two gathering professions Destroses · 2025-11-08. Take Survival early for the slingshot Mithreon · 2026-03-23. 2. **At 60:** most players level Engineering after hitting 60 Destroses · 2026-04-08. If you already have Engineering while leveling, get it to 300 by 60 Dzonathan · 2025-10-28. Keep the gathering profession your farm needs: Herbalism for lashers, Mining for ZG Mithreon · 2026-01-14. 3. **Engineering for lashers:** "Don't go Engi for Lashers. Just do that when you're moving on" to Stratholme and bigger vamp pulls dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-10-14. 4. **Ret with a Runeblade plan:** Blacksmithing (Swordsmith) until you craft the blade, then drop it Mithreon · 2025-11-27. Dropping a profession resets it to 1 if you ever retrain it Jesse Potter · 2026-01-18.

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: - **Dwarf:** Blacksmithing is "cultural BiS" Silverhand · 2025-12-29. That is flavor, not a mechanical bonus. - **Goblin/Gnome:** paladins cannot be Goblins or Gnomes. Only Human, Dwarf and High Elf can be paladins Destroses · 2026-03-27.

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Dire Maul East lashers** are the staple from about level 52-54, and "prot paladin is considered the best class for lasher farming" Mithreon · 2025-10-11, Iseut · 2025-05-14. Rates depend on the server: about 80g/h on Nordanaar without Herbalism, much less on Ambershire, where herbs sell cheaply Mithreon · 2025-11-11, Faithroll · 2025-11-11. Some Ambershire reports were 35g/h Flammekat · 2026-02-13. Prices fell because so many paladins farm lashers, not because of a nerf Ythor · 2025-10-16. - **ZG as a miner** is "the most consistent" paladin farm Mithreon · 2026-04-04. - **Stratholme live** with a Force Reactive Disk and a vamp set Arle · 2025-12-21, Shokisan · 2026-04-08. - **Passive income:** transmute cooldowns across alts and Cured Rugged Hides Jesse Potter · 2026-01-12, Jesse Potter · 2025-12-24. Farm routes and builds: [Leveling: gold farming and AoE](#/class/paladin/leveling).

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- No sourced item name for the 300-JC "HoJ ring", and no full list of Goldsmith or Gemology crafts for paladins.
- The 1.18.1 Survival recipe book is only partly documented. No paladin source rates the slow/root/trap tools for PvP.
- No source compares Tailoring or Leatherworking for Holy beyond "buy the BoEs".
- The Elementium weapon upgrades are new. Their value against drop weapons is single source.

See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/paladin)

name: Hunter
recommendation: - **Leveling:** Beast Mastery, with a pet that tanks. Respec to Survival at 40 if you plan to raid melee. - **Raids:** Survival (melee, dual-wield or two-hander) is still the best overall raid DPS and AoE spec. BM is very close on single target, and MM is slightly behind but the best "safe" ranged spec Barwat · 2026-04-02, Vellasta · 2026-04-09. All three specs are raid-viable after 1.18.1: "all 3 specs eat very good right now" limbless · 2026-04-09, limbless · 2026-04-08. - **PvP:** Marksmanship (or BM for easy burst).
overview: **Recommendation:** - **Leveling:** Beast Mastery, with a pet that tanks. Respec to Survival at 40 if you plan to raid melee. - **Raids:** Survival (melee, dual-wield or two-hander) is still the best overall raid DPS and AoE spec. BM is very close on single target, and MM is slightly behind but the best "safe" ranged spec Barwat · 2026-04-02, Vellasta · 2026-04-09. All three specs are raid-viable after 1.18.1: "all 3 specs eat very good right now" limbless · 2026-04-09, limbless · 2026-04-08. - **PvP:** Marksmanship (or BM for easy burst). The hunter is a physical DPS class with a permanent pet, traps and ranged utility: Tranquilizing Shot, safe pulls and Trueshot Aura. Turtle reworked it three times: - **Class Changes 2** (1.17.2, November 2024) turned Survival into a melee spec. - **1.18.0** (August 2025) added Kill Command v1, Baited Shot, Coordinated Assault, Lacerate and a special ability for every pet family. - **1.18.1** (live 2026-03-20) rebuilt MM around Aimed Shot, Experimental Ammunition and Lock and Load, and rebuilt BM around Bestial Wrath, Scent of Blood and a new Kill Command. Most guides written before March 2026 no longer apply.
