readme.heading: Macro basics
readme.markdown: General macro and addon setup (SuperWoW, Nampower, CleveRoid, launcher problems) is on [Client setup](#/client-setup). Hunter-specific points: - **Pet attack:** `/petattack` doesn't work; use `/script PetAttack(target)` Rpecial · 2025-12-30. - **Auto Shot without toggling it off:** `/run for i=1,120 do if IsAutoRepeatAction(i) then return end end CastSpellByName("Auto Shot")` Elmgren · 2025-10-21. - **Quiver won't open (`/qq` or `/quiver` does nothing):** download the zip from the GitHub releases page and rename the extracted folder (for example `Quiver-3.1.1` or `Quiver-main`) to exactly `Quiver` Rangtuk · 2026-02-24, Carly · 2026-02-24, Screams · 2025-11-25. - **Quiver no-clip Steady Shot** (fires Steady Shot unless it would delay an Auto Shot; tune the -0.25 cutoff for your latency) nabu · 2026-01-28, Rahnd2137 · 2026-03-09: ``` /run local a, b = Quiver.GetSecondsRemainingShoot(); local c = a and b < -0.25; local f = c and CastSpellByName or Quiver.CastNoClip; f("Steady Shot") ``` With Nampower's spell queue on, the macro can still clip; turn queuing off in the Nampower settings addon for that character Vellasta · 2026-02-08, Vellasta · 2026-02-08. - **Quiver trap macro** (Quiver's Turtle workaround) Dresche · 2025-09-04, nalae · 2025-11-05. One hunter still found it unreliable in 2026-03 Trollio · 2026-03-29: ``` /run --CastSpellByName("Freezing Trap") /run Quiver.FdPrepareTrap(); CastSpellByName("Freezing Trap") ``` For Quiver's cast bar after 1.18.1, see [Marksmanship → Macros and addons](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps). Stable and pet bugs are on [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets).

readme.heading: Professions
readme.markdown: - **Engineering + Mining** is the standard pair and the best-in-slot choice. You get the +2% crit Facetted Crystal Scope, Enchanted Thorium Shells, gadgets and sappers, and Mining funds your consumables SliceOfBerry · 2026-03-25, Itron · 2026-03-20, Lilyth · 2026-03-26. - **Alchemy** (with Herbalism) is the best gold profession Sofie · 2026-02-16. **Leatherworking and Skinning** are weak at 60, mostly useful for resistance gear SliceOfBerry · 2026-03-25. - **Survival** (a secondary profession, reworked in 1.18.1) crafts your own arrows. Trees are gated by Survival skill, and the Horde trainer is in Orgrimmar near the fishing trainer Oak · 2026-03-21, nabu · 2026-03-21. - Gold farms: DME lashers (from level 45) and the ZG kite farm, the best gold once mastered Vellasta · 2026-02-10, Meta · 2026-03-18. Full guide: [Professions](#/class/hunter/professions) Shared pages: [Professions overview](#/professions) · [PvP systems](#/pvp) (honor, battlegrounds, Warmode) · [Game mechanics](#/mechanics) (buff and consumable stacking, enchant sources) · [Client setup](#/client-setup) (launcher, SuperWoW, addons). Tier sets: to swap a tier piece to another spec's version, see [Tier sets: spec exchange](#/mechanics).

playbooks.title: Survival Hunter (melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the melee **16/0/35** build (through Untamed Trapper, plus Coordinated Assault in BM). Dual-wield two good weapons for single-target bosses and switch to a slow two-hander for trash and cleave. Put your abilities on one spam macro: **Raptor Strike, Immolation Trap, Mongoose Bite, Lacerate, Carve**, with Wing Clip as the last filler. On packs, **Explosive Trap and Carve** come first. Stack Agility. Get melee hit to 8%, or more when dual-wielding, and weapon skill toward 315. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee physical DPS with in-combat fire traps; Trueshot Aura (baseline) | | Viability (1.18.1) | **S (raid overall), S (farming), A (PvP), B (leveling before 40, A after).** "For overall dps in raid survival is still best" Barwat · 2026-04-02; "surv still mogs MM" Sabagina · 2026-03-26; the best AoE of the three specs limbless · 2026-04-13. On single target MM and Survival sim about equal Vellasta · 2026-04-09. | | Difficulty | Low: "surv can just do their one-button rotation and do more dps" Vellasta · 2026-03-23 | | Strengths | AoE and cleave; benefits from melee buffs (Windfury, Battle Shout) that ranged hunters miss Vellasta · 2025-11-11; facetanks trash adds with dodge and leech Sisco the Kid · 2026-01-19 | | Weaknesses | Fire traps are dead weight on fire-immune bosses (much of MC and almost all of BWL) Vaienna · 2026-04-02, Thalenar · 2026-03-08; melee mechanics; mana hungry; Feign Death is less reliable in melee range limbless · 2026-04-17 | !!! note "What changed in 1.18.1" - **Lacerate:** 40% of AP (was 35%) and +15% damage from the side; it no longer ticks faster from the side [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **Vicious Strikes** again raises Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite damage. - **Surefooted** gives +3% extra hit while dual-wielding. - **Alone Against the World** is new (+3/6% damage with no pet out). - **Coordinated Assault** dropped from 30% to 20% (all [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23 / 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). Players summed it up as "lacerate side damage, raptor strike and mongoose bite got buffed; only Coordinated Assault went down" Swifteye · 2026-04-01. Survival's Coordinated Assault damage fell to roughly a third or a quarter of what it was Sofie · 2026-03-20. Survival is otherwise the 1.18.0 melee kit: Carve, Mongoose Bite on both weapons, and traps in combat through Untamed Trapper.

talents.markdown: ### Raid 16/0/35 (recommended) This is the most-posted Survival code across the 1.18.0 and 1.18.1 trees. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Agility.** It gives melee AP (×2.2 with Lightning Reflexes), crit and dodge. 1 Agility ≈ 2.6+ effective AP Elmgren · 2026-03-24. Strength is always worse Kantrul · 2026-02-24. 2. **Hit:** the soft cap is **8%** for both 2H and DW special attacks Dresche · 2026-03-26. - **Dual-wield:** white hits need far more. The hard cap is 28% Barwat · 2026-04-02, but players run about **11–13%**, because the dual-wield talents give "6% for free" Sofie · 2026-04-17, Bogenjochen · 2026-04-17. - Each 5 weapon skill above 300 is 1% hit and less glancing damage, up to 315 dumbid · 2026-03-24. Get weapon skill "as high as you can, to 315": about 40% of DW Survival damage is white hits Sofie · 2026-03-29. Weapon skill shown on the character sheet does not include this hit Sofie · 2026-04-17. 3. **Crit.** It is worth less than for MM: traps, the Lacerate bleed and Serpent Sting do not crit Vellasta · 2025-10-17, Vellasta · 2025-10-17. From T3 onward, take crit over haste Raggen · 2026-03-16, Vellasta · 2026-03-16. 4. **Haste.** It only speeds white swings. It was valued at 20–40 eAP before the Strike Together nerf Survival for the fittest · 2026-03-31, and is less favored since limbless · 2026-04-18. 5. Spell power only boosts the Serpent Sting that Mongoose Bite, Wing Clip and Stinging Nettle traps apply. It is not worth buying for Survival Vellasta · 2026-03-26. Consensus stat line: **Agility > crit > haste > hit (8% 2H, ~13% DW)** Rpecial · 2026-02-23.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: The whole rotation fits in one spam macro. "No reason to not just do that like 90% of the time" Sofie · 2026-03-22. Sofie's macro (needs `/startattack` from an addon, or auto-attack started manually) Sofie · 2026-03-22: ``` /cast Raptor Strike /cast Immolation Trap /cast Mongoose Bite /cast Lacerate /cast Carve /cast Wing Clip ``` Priority (bot-ready): 1. **Raptor Strike** on cooldown. 2. **Immolation Trap** on cooldown, but not on fire-immune targets or on a target about to die. Carve beats a trap on a dying mob Dresche · 2025-12-11, Youthwars · 2025-12-20. 3. **Mongoose Bite** on cooldown. **Contested:** some put Mongoose first and Raptor second Survival for the fittest · 2026-03-30; Sofie puts Raptor first Sofie · 2026-03-30. 4. **Lacerate.** Its direct hit scales from AP, not weapon damage Bakingsoda · 2026-02-05. It gets +15% from the side, so stand at the flank. 5. **Carve.** It is worth pressing even on one target Thalenar · 2025-12-11. 6. **Wing Clip** only if nothing else is ready or about to be ready Sofie · 2026-03-30. Setup: send the pet as the tank hits Dresche · 2026-03-21. For a Raptor: Bite + Savage Rend, Growl off in raids; Claw on bleed-immune bosses Kekkonen · 2025-10-15, Zwift · 2026-01-19. At range (movement phases), use baseline Steady Shot, e.g. on Heigan's dance Minces · 2026-01-28.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown: | Targets | Do | |---|---| | 1 | Single-target macro | | 2+ | **Explosive Trap → Carve → Raptor Strike → Mongoose Bite → Lacerate → Wing Clip** Sofie · 2026-03-22 | - Most of Survival's AoE damage comes from Explosive Trap, not Carve Chukis · 2026-01-30. Carve hits up to 5 targets Kantrul · 2024-11-20. - Carve uses only your main-hand weapon, so a two-hander hits harder in AoE Duciel · 2025-10-10, Destroses · 2026-01-12. - Do not trap packs that are already almost dead, or that are fire-immune Youthwars · 2025-12-20. - Do not macro Carve into careless pulls: it breaks crowd control Bakingsoda · 2025-10-21.

roleStrategy.heading: Resource and threat management
roleStrategy.markdown: - Survival is mana hungry. You tank most packs while leveling, and in raids traps are expensive. The T2.5 3-piece bonus, or the T3 6/8-piece bonuses, return mana on trap and Serpent Sting hits Sofie · 2026-02-16, yaboikeenser · 2026-01-03. - Aspect of the Viper (level 56) is for trash and farming, not boss fights rickety · 2026-01-24. - As melee you pull aggro at 110% of the tank's threat, versus 130% at range, and you have no threat-reduction talent Zugolas · 2024-12-16. Use FD early. - Geared Survival can facetank Majordomo's and Razorgore's adds with dodge and leech Sisco the Kid · 2026-01-19. - Leech from Improved Aspect of the Wolf only applies to melee hits, not traps Rpecial · 2026-03-01, Rpecial · 2026-04-03.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 decision loop for the 16/0/35 build. Details are in the sections linked below. 1. **Opener:** 1. Send the pet as the tank hits Dresche · 2026-03-21. 2. Rapid Fire, on-use trinkets and Blood Fury on the pull ([cooldowns](#/class/hunter/survival-melee-dps)). 3. Start auto-attack. 2. **Single-target loop:** one spam macro ([rotation](#/class/hunter/survival-melee-dps)). 1. Raptor Strike. 2. Immolation Trap. Skip it on fire-immune targets and on dying ones. 3. Mongoose Bite. 4. Lacerate, from the flank. 5. Carve. 6. Wing Clip only when nothing else is ready. 3. **Cooldowns:** - Rapid Fire and trinkets on pull. - Deterrence as the "just in case" defensive. - Feign Death early: in melee you pull aggro at 110% of the tank's threat. 4. **AoE switch rule** ([AoE](#/class/hunter/survival-melee-dps)): - **2 targets:** add Explosive Trap. - **3+ targets:** Explosive Trap → Carve → Raptor Strike → Mongoose Bite → Lacerate → Wing Clip. - Use the two-hander for packs and dual-wield for bosses ([DW vs 2H](#/class/hunter/survival-melee-dps)). 5. **Resource rule:** Aspect of the Viper is for trash and farming, not boss fights rickety · 2026-01-24. Otherwise watch trap mana ([resources](#/class/hunter/survival-melee-dps)). 6. **Movement and situational:** - At range, use baseline Steady Shot Minces · 2026-01-28. - On fire-immune bosses, drop fire traps from the macro ([raid notes](#/class/hunter/survival-melee-dps)). - Do not Carve into crowd control.

extraSections.heading: Dual-wield vs two-hander
extraSections.markdown: **Recommendation: dual-wield for single-target bosses, a two-hander for cleave and trash.** "I use dw for single target bosses and 2h for aoe. both are good" Wuuc · 2026-03-24. - **DW wins on single target.** You get two weapons' worth of stats and more Swift Aspects procs Dresche · 2026-04-13. Mongoose Bite hits with both weapons Destroses · 2025-10-16. With good weapons "DW always beats 2H" Dabcart(rip ambershire) · 2026-04-17. One tester (Sofie) ran matched gear on a dummy and found DW clearly ahead of 2H Sofie · 2026-01-27. - **2H wins on packs.** A two-hander's higher damage ceiling makes Carve spikes bigger Dresche · 2026-04-13. - **Your weapons decide.** "If you have a Naxx 2H and only dual wield from BWL, I would definitely take the 2H" Dresche · 2026-04-13. Dresche runs DW for Anomalus, Medivh and maybe Kruul in Kara40, and a two-hander (Rak'ishi spear) elsewhere Dresche · 2026-03-26. - **Weapon speed:** slow weapons are better, because Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite and Carve use the weapon damage roll Thula Wena · 2025-11-19, Refrigerador · 2025-11-19. Put the slowest weapon in the main hand for Raptor Strike Sofie · 2026-02-25. Daggers are too fast Sofie · 2026-01-27. Gressil (slow) + Kingsfall (fast) is a top-parser pairing Suade · 2026-02-15. - Dresche's DW-vs-2H math sheet: `docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1b5wfBLYoopE7_4r2lhrJHx395K1AlZKx8qMeu821nW4` Dresche · 2026-03-26. - Mongoose Bite registers as a single main-hand hit, so off-hand on-hit procs never trigger from it Destroses · 2026-03-22, Darkaco · 2026-03-22.

extraSections.heading: Raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **Fire immunity.** - MC: Ragnaros, Baron Geddon, Firelords, Firewalkers, Flameguards and Lava Spawns are immune. Garr and Golemagg are **not** Duciel · 2025-12-23, Duciel · 2025-12-23. Many MC bosses are bleed-immune Rpecial · 2026-01-28. - BWL: only Razorgore, Broodlord, Chromaggus and Nefarian's first phase take fire Sofie · 2026-03-08. Play "no trap surv" there Thalenar · 2026-03-08. - **Sapphiron:** place Immolation Trap directly under his belly where he spawns Dresche · 2025-12-05. - **Big hitboxes** (Ouro, Sapphiron, Thaddius) may not trigger traps Azure · 2024-12-08 (reported 2024). - **Spec swaps:** many Survival raiders switch to MM for Ragnaros or for Kara40 Rupturan and Mephistroth Dresche · 2025-12-08, Dresche · 2025-12-04. - **Kara40:** Rupturan cannot be hit in melee until phase 2, and then only its adds. Kruul's mechanic punishes melee Minces · 2025-08-25. See [Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan). - **Nefarian:** the hunter class call breaks all equipped weapons Shenten · 2026-03-30.

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - The spam macros above. Traps are situational, so some players keep them off the main button Dresche · 2025-12-08. - `/startattack` needs CleveRoidMacros (or RoidMacros); it can cause screen stutter Elmgren · 2025-11-05, Elmgren · 2025-11-05. Minimal melee macro: `/startattack` `/cast Raptor Strike` `/cast Mongoose Bite` Afraido · 2025-11-04. - SP_SwingTimer for the melee swing timer Dresche · 2025-07-12. DoiteAuras 1.8.7 tracks the Lacerate proc Doite · 2026-04-18. - Nampower can skip the trap in a multi-cast macro Lean · 2026-02-27. It only queues the last `/cast` line yaboikeenser · 2026-01-09.

glance.recommendation: Play the melee **16/0/35** build (through Untamed Trapper, plus Coordinated Assault in BM). Dual-wield two good weapons for single-target bosses and switch to a slow two-hander for trash and cleave. Put your abilities on one spam macro: **Raptor Strike, Immolation Trap, Mongoose Bite, Lacerate, Carve**, with Wing Clip as the last filler. On packs, **Explosive Trap and Carve** come first. Stack Agility. Get melee hit to 8%, or more when dual-wielding, and weapon skill toward 315.

glance.rest: !!! note "What changed in 1.18.1" - **Lacerate:** 40% of AP (was 35%) and +15% damage from the side; it no longer ticks faster from the side [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **Vicious Strikes** again raises Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite damage. - **Surefooted** gives +3% extra hit while dual-wielding. - **Alone Against the World** is new (+3/6% damage with no pet out). - **Coordinated Assault** dropped from 30% to 20% (all [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23 / 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). Players summed it up as "lacerate side damage, raptor strike and mongoose bite got buffed; only Coordinated Assault went down" Swifteye · 2026-04-01. Survival's Coordinated Assault damage fell to roughly a third or a quarter of what it was Sofie · 2026-03-20. Survival is otherwise the 1.18.0 melee kit: Carve, Mongoose Bite on both weapons, and traps in combat through Untamed Trapper.

playbooks.title: Beast Mastery Hunter (pet DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **34/17/0** build and a **Raptor** (Cat or Wind Serpent where bleeds fail). Spam **Steady Shot** between Auto Shots, weave **Arcane Shot** (or Multi-Shot on packs), and fire **Kill Command** the moment it lights up. It has no GCD, so put it in every shot macro. Use **Bestial Wrath** on cooldown. Do not take Aimed Shot, Mortal Shots or Serpent Sting. Gear for ranged AP and Agility: the pet scales on your RAP, not your crit. | | | |---|---| | Role | Ranged DPS whose pet does about half the damage Santa Bear · 2026-03-25 | | Viability (1.18.1) | **A (raid), S (leveling, solo), A (PvP).** The rework "surprised" the channel. In Naxx boss fights one tester placed BM rank 1 and MM rank 2, "very close results", with a KC crit of 7,153 Santa Bear · 2026-03-25. Another tester in T1/epics did ~780 DPS as BM vs ~650 as MM; MM was better only on AoE packs Hakuna · 2026-03-24, Hakuna · 2026-03-24. Overall consensus: Survival is still the best raid spec, and BM is "very close second or better for single target" Barwat · 2026-04-02. | | Difficulty | Low for the rotation ("SS spam baked in KC") Hakuna · 2026-03-24; high for pet survival in Kara40 RioJnfer · 2026-03-24 | | Strengths | Huge Kill Command crits (5.5k on Broodlord) The J · 2026-04-13; the pet tanks and solos while leveling; strong PvP burst | | Weaknesses | "BM hunters only problem is how group reliant it is" — raid buffs drive pet scaling Wangfirex77 · 2026-04-11; the pet dies to cleaves and breaths; pet crit is capped at 20%, so BM gains least from T3 Kaslux · 2026-04-10, Kaslux · 2026-04-10; weak on Loatheb (the pet gets no Spore buff) Kaslux · 2026-04-02 | !!! note "What changed in 1.18.1" **Baited Shot is gone** ("The barbeque is over"). **Bestial Wrath is back**: 18 s enrage, 1.5 min cooldown, no GCD. The new talent **Scent of Blood** gives your attacks a 5/10/15% chance to enrage the pet for +40% damage for 8 s. **Kill Command** is the capstone: 80% of pet AP, usable after you crit, 8 s cooldown, no GCD. Endurance Training and Thick Hide were raised again. Source: [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23, revised 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). The 1.18.0 guides (Kill Command removes pet CC, Baited Shot on crits, "Sausage Shot") are obsolete.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid 34/17/0 (recommended) Santa Bear posted this build after the Naxx test above Santa Bear · 2026-03-25. Itron reposted it twice Itron · 2026-03-30, Itron · 2026-03-30. It is the most-posted post-patch BM code. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Beast Mastery | Swift Aspects | 5/5 | | Beast Mastery | Endurance Training | 3/5 | | Beast Mastery | Improved Revive Pet | 2/2 | | Beast Mastery | Coordinated Assault | 1/1 | | Beast Mastery | Unleashed Fury | 5/5 | | Beast Mastery | Bestial Discipline | 1/2 | | Beast Mastery | Ferocity | 5/5 | | Beast Mastery | Scent of Blood | 3/3 | | Beast Mastery | Bestial Wrath | 1/1 | | Beast Mastery | Bestial Precision | 2/2 | | Beast Mastery | Spirit Bond | 2/2 | | Beast Mastery | Frenzy | 3/5 | | Beast Mastery | Kill Command | 1/1 | | Marksmanship | Efficiency | 5/5 | | Marksmanship | Lethal Shots | 5/5 | | Marksmanship | Hawk Eye | 2/2 | | Marksmanship | Swiftshot | 3/3 | | Marksmanship | Endless Quiver | 2/2 | Split **34/17/0**, validated with `talent_tool.py` (VALID). Calculator codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/hunter?points=FYACBoIoZASYB-AoAoQDQ-` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/hunter/X021V5J2F6-55CK`. [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=hunter&t=5300020151053102231-05052032) Why these points: - **No Aimed Shot.** "Dont take aimed as BM" Kekkonen · 2026-04-01. Since the Arcane Shot buff, Steady Shot lets you weave instants and is "the better choice over an aimed shot" Vellasta · 2026-04-07, Vellasta · 2026-04-07. - **Endless Quiver over Mortal Shots**, confirmed by simulation Vellasta · 2026-03-30. Mortal Shots is "a trap as a BM because your pet deal half of your damage" Focus · 2026-03-25. - **Frenzy 3/5** gives ~90% uptime and 4/5 ~100% with a 2.0-speed pet Dresche · 2026-03-21. The more crit you have, the fewer Frenzy points you need Kaslux · 2026-04-10. **Contested:** junabii thinks 2–3/5 is too low for good uptime junabii · 2026-04-10. - **Bestial Discipline** is optional. It is "a negligible increase and bm is too starved for points elsewhere" Bobob · 2026-03-20, and Endless Quiver beats 2/2 Bestial Discipline limbless · 2026-04-17. - **Lethal Shots**: Kill Command is only usable after you crit, so your own crit keeps it available [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **Coordinated Assault** is cheap, but its damage scales from *your* melee AP and its threat lands on you. It does 3–5% of BM damage Darkaco · 2026-03-22, Irithyl · 2026-04-02. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **41/10/0 deep BM** (solo / farming) | Thick Hide 3, Bestial Discipline 2, Endurance Training 5, Frenzy 4; only Efficiency and Lethal Shots in MM | `FoAaBoQoZASgB-AoAo-` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=hunter&t=5500320152053102241-0505)) | Kekkonen Kekkonen · 2026-04-01 | | 34/17/0 entry-raid (MC) | Endurance Training 5, Frenzy 4, Swiftshot 2 plus Aimed Shot, no Improved Revive Pet | `FoAABoAoZASgB-AoAoRCQ-` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=hunter&t=5500000150053102241-05052122)) | Focus, for MC with a Cat Focus · 2026-03-25 (includes Aimed Shot, against the later consensus) | Budget note: the tree is "extremely point heavy on the bottom". A common trade is dipping into MM (Lethal Shots) instead of maxing Frenzy Thalenar · 2026-04-07, Screams · 2026-04-07.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Ranged hit to 8%** (7% with +5 ranged skill), as for MM WarKeeper · 2026-04-02, Zae · 2026-03-25. 2. **Ranged AP and Agility.** Spirit Bond turns your RAP into pet AP (and pet spell power), so RAP gear beats crit gear for BM Focus · 2026-04-01. The pet gets no spell power from your gear; its only source is Spirit Bond's RAP conversion limbless · 2026-04-09, limbless · 2026-04-09. 1 Agility ≈ 3.1 AP Itron · 2026-04-18. 3. **Crit**, enough to keep Kill Command available. A crit made while KC has ≤4 s of cooldown left makes it castable as soon as the cooldown ends yaboikeenser · 2026-04-07, Focus · 2026-04-01. Kill Command itself uses the **pet's** crit chance Darkaco · 2026-03-23, Kaslux · 2026-04-08. 4. Pet crit is capped around 20% via Spirit Bond Kaslux · 2026-04-10. About 17 Agility gives the pet 1% crit Darkaco · 2026-02-13. Before 1.18.1, players debated whether BM should gear like MM. The current reasoning above (RAP > crit) is Focus's, and no one disputed it (single source).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: Loop: **Auto → Steady → Arcane (or Multi) → Auto**, with Kill Command whenever it is ready Itron · 2026-04-13. Opener: call and send the pet as the tank hits Dresche · 2026-03-21. Then Hunter's Mark and Auto Shot. Pop Bestial Wrath with your trinkets. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **Kill Command** when usable. It has no GCD and can be cast during the Auto Shot wind-up Kaslux · 2026-01-27. It **cannot** be cast while Steady Shot is casting; that resets the wind-up Itron · 2026-04-12, limbless · 2026-04-12. It stays usable for 4 s even while on cooldown, so near-100% uptime needs about one crit every 4 s yaboikeenser · 2026-04-07, limbless · 2026-04-02. Only cast it if the pet is in melee range: out of range it does nothing and still triggers its cooldown (bug 20736) Darkaco · 2026-03-21, Darkaco · 2026-04-16. 2. **Bestial Wrath** on cooldown, lined up with trinkets and Rapid Fire. 3. **Steady Shot** after each Auto Shot, without clipping. 4. **Arcane Shot** after Steady when it fits (it scales 45% with spell power for BM) Kantrul · 2026-03-22. On 2+ targets, use **Multi-Shot** instead Itron · 2026-04-13. 5. **Never** Serpent Sting ("serpent sting sucks") Kekkonen · 2026-04-01 or Aimed Shot. One-button macro (junabii): spam it until Auto Shot is ready, let the auto fire, repeat. If KC procs during Steady, let Steady finish junabii · 2026-04-13, junabii · 2026-04-13. ``` /cast Kill Command /cast Arcane Shot /cast Steady Shot ``` Pet abilities: see [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets). In short: Raptor on Growl off, Bite + Savage Rend; Claw only on bleed-immune bosses. Manual control beats autocast.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown: - **2+ targets:** Multi-Shot replaces Arcane in the loop Itron · 2026-04-13. **3+ targets:** open with **Volley** (baseline, 3 s cast) Focus · 2026-03-24. - BM AoE is only "acceptable" limbless · 2026-04-13. For dungeon and trash AoE, use a **Gorilla**: Thunderstomp does AoE damage, reduces AP and adds high threat. Pre-pop Bestial Wrath or Blood Fury before it fires for a chance at a big crit Cleric · 2026-04-08. A competitive Gorilla needs 5/5 Frenzy limbless · 2026-04-16.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: | Cooldown | Rule | |---|---| | Bestial Wrath | On cooldown (1.5 min); the pet "cannot be stopped unless killed" for 18 s [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) | | Rapid Fire | With Bestial Wrath; Juju Flurry shares its cooldown category Tydorel · 2026-04-04 | | Devilsaur Tooth | Works with Kill Command: the pet's next hit crits. Pre-use it, then use it again after the pet's first crit Cleric · 2026-04-10, Cleric · 2026-04-10 | | Trinkets | Molten Emberstone on pull plus Blackhand's Breadth as the passive; save Blood Fury for later, since it does not stack with Emberstone Sheyba · 2026-01-15, Sheyba · 2026-01-15 |

roleStrategy.heading: Pet management and threat
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Pet resistances by raid** (training points): BWL fire and shadow; AQ nature; Naxx frost and shadow. Add stamina after resistances Kaslux · 2026-03-24, Kaslux · 2026-03-24. - **Per-boss pet swaps** (Kaslux, one raid week): Wind Serpent for most bosses until Vek'nilash, then Raptor, then a Scorpid for Ouro and C'Thun Kaslux · 2026-03-24. On C'Thun, park a snapshotted Scorpid on the boss and kill tentacles yourself limbless · 2026-04-10. You cannot swap pets in combat, and there is a 1-minute lockout between swaps Sisco the Kid · 2026-02-20. - Kara40 is the hard tier for pets ("Nx is eazy to survive, K40 is not") RioJnfer · 2026-03-24. Kruul's cleave takes about half the pet's HP Psyker · 2025-11-30. - No talent reduces pet threat, and pets cannot Feign Death limbless · 2026-04-07. Coordinated Assault threat goes to you Destroses · 2026-04-08. - Healers rarely heal pets unless asked Darkaco · 2025-12-28, Darkaco · 2025-12-28. - Reviving mid-fight is usually not worth it with under ~30 s left Vellasta · 2026-03-13, Vellasta · 2026-03-13. Full pet guide: [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets).

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **Stat sticks:** Kingsfall + Scythe of the Unseen Path is "the premier BM/MM combo even in full Kara40 BiS" Lilyth · 2026-04-02. Take Crul'shorukh + Kingsfall or Scythe "if you want pet dmg" IT Mckee · 2026-04-14. - **Ranged weapon:** the same progression as MM (see [Marksmanship](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps)). - **Tier:** 8-piece T2 is worth ~180 effective AP at ~40% proc uptime Kalamity · 2026-04-10. 6/9 T3 is still a bigger jump in raw stats Kalamity · 2026-04-10. BM gains least from T3 Kaslux · 2026-04-10. The new **Timbermaw Hold set** has a strong Agility + AP structure, "really nice for BM because pet scale on AP" Focus · 2026-03-22. - **Pet-damage items (Darkaco's tests):** - Beast Mastery chest stacks with everything. - Unseen Path stacks with almost everything, but needs line of sight to the pet or it spams errors Darkaco · 2026-04-10. - Beastmaster's Boots and Charm of Dark Domination do not stack with each other. - **Ferra's Collar is bugged**: it cancels Unseen Path and the 3% boots/neck bonus. Source: Darkaco · 2026-04-11. - **T0.5** has two of the few pet-crit items in the game junabii · 2025-12-23. - Enchants and consumables: as [Marksmanship](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps), but weight RAP higher.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Taking Aimed Shot, Mortal Shots or Serpent Sting Kekkonen · 2026-04-01, Focus · 2026-03-25. - Casting Kill Command while the pet is out of melee range: it wastes the cooldown Darkaco · 2026-03-21. - Leaving Claw on autocast next to a real special ability: Claw is "obsolete on any pet that's capable of doing damage" limbless · 2026-04-03; Savage Rend costs the same as Bite and hits 5× harder than Claw limbless · 2026-04-08. - Letting the pet stand in cleaves and breaths; not training resistances Kaslux · 2026-03-24. - Stacking crit gear over RAP Focus · 2026-04-01. - Dismissing the pet with the spell halves its happiness pillow · 2026-04-07. Leave it on Stay and walk out of range instead (−10 happiness instead of −50) [Amyloriley (player), 2025-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126672#p126672).

consumables.heading: Consumables
consumables.markdown: - **Self:** the MM kit ([Marksmanship](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps)). - **On the pet:** Juju Power, Juju Might, Scroll of Strength and Scroll of Agility Hysteria · 2026-04-07. Fully buffed pets reach 7–9k Kill Command crits yaboikeenser · 2026-04-07. **Contested:** on non-BM specs this is worth only ~1% DPS Sofie · 2026-03-12.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 decision loop for the 34/17/0 build. Details are in the sections linked below. 1. **Opener:** 1. Send the pet exactly as the tank hits Dresche · 2026-03-21. 2. Hunter's Mark, then Auto Shot. 3. Bestial Wrath together with Rapid Fire and your on-use trinkets. 2. **Single-target loop:** Auto → Steady → Arcane → Auto ([rotation](#/class/hunter/beast-mastery-ranged-dps)). - **Kill Command** whenever it is usable and the pet is in melee range. It has no GCD, but do not cast it during a Steady Shot cast. - **Steady Shot** after each Auto Shot, without clipping. - **Arcane Shot** after Steady when it fits. - Never Aimed Shot or Serpent Sting. 3. **Cooldowns:** - Bestial Wrath on cooldown (90 s). - Rapid Fire (5 min) and trinkets with it. - Devilsaur Tooth: pre-use it, then use it again after the pet's first crit ([cooldowns](#/class/hunter/beast-mastery-ranged-dps)). 4. **AoE switch rule:** - **2+ targets:** Multi-Shot replaces Arcane. - **3+ targets:** open with Volley. On trash packs, a Gorilla's Thunderstomp does the work ([AoE](#/class/hunter/beast-mastery-ranged-dps)). 5. **Resource rule:** Aspect of the Hawk until you are low on mana, then Aspect of the Viper until the fight ends Kantrul · 2026-03-03. Drop Arcane first to save mana yaboikeenser · 2026-04-03. 6. **Movement and situational:** - Arcane Shot while moving Tydorel · 2026-04-17. - Keep the pet out of cleaves and breaths, and trained in the tier's resistances. - Do not revive the pet mid-fight with under ~30 s left ([pet management](#/class/hunter/beast-mastery-ranged-dps)). - Pet ability bar: see [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets).

leveling_by_bracket.note: Discord-sourced from the archived #hunter channel; see synthesis/classes/hunter/leveling.md for the full route.

brackets.advice: Do the level-10 taming chain; boar is the safe early pet (Charge snap-threat, wide diet); vendor ammo is 200/stack and the ammo pouch costs a bag slot.
BM rows 1-2; keep Growl/Bite/Claw current; a Screech bird (owl/bat/carrion) is the strongest AoE-threat leveling pet.
BM defensives then Unleashed Fury/Ferocity/Intimidation; 'BM feels weak' at 21 is common but the pet carries; Salt Flats Vulture owl (~32) gives early Screech rank 2.
Continue BM; Hinterlands Eagle (35-40) knows Screech rank 3 innately despite rank 3 needing 48; unique Hinterlands owls give max Screech from ~42.

Level 40 is the melee-SV breakpoint: Untamed Trapper + Lightning Reflexes; common plan is level BM to 40 then respec SV and accept tanking; pet aggro starts ripping in the low 40s. 'from 39 to 40, right away when I got untamed trapper, my levelling speed became ridiculously faster' [Sofie].
Finish the chosen tree; solo DME lashers from ~54. No distinct post-1.18.1 50-60 report exists.
BM is the consensus leveling spec across all three kit eras; Survival is weak until 40; post-1.18.1 baseline Steady Shot at 20 makes MM leveling viable; 'for levelling just stack agility' [Ash].
Boar (tanky, eats anything, Charge snap-threat) or a Screech bird for AoE threat; BM defensives first.

builds.note: Slot labels are the 1.18.1 grid names; ranks are CC2/CC3-era ranks (the tree was rebuilt three times). Full table in staging/hunter-core/talents.md §2.

rotation_single.claim: No authoritative full BM priority list exists in the channel; the recurring question went unanswered and several posters said BM is 'no rotation / macro it' [consensus (gap), [[d:hunter#1486410405952880663]], [[d:hunter#1489057031435587764]]]. The list in this file is reconstructed from fragments.

Kill Command (1.18.1) is off the GCD and stays usable ~4 s into its 8 s cooldown, so a hunter crit roughly every 4 s keeps it near 100% uptime; measured 99.93% uptime at 33% crit [single source (player-tested), [[d:hunter#1490812124006711457]], [[d:hunter#1490826259817562155]]].

Same-gear dummy dps: BM 700 vs MM 750 at 33% crit; in Naxx a raptor BM was rank 1 over MM rank 2 on boss fights with the pet ~50% of total damage and Kill Command crits of 7,153 [single raid sample, [[d:hunter#1490826259817562155]], [[d:hunter#1486419920332787763]]].

stat_weights.hit: 8% at 300 weapon skill (forum KB's 9% superseded) [consensus, [[d:hunter#1298063246254932059]]]
stat_weights.crit: 1% crit = 50+ eAP post-1.18.1 (up from 30 eAP pre-patch), because of MM's new crit scaling [single source, [[d:hunter#1486693663084904448]]]
stat_weights.haste: 1% haste = 12-14 eAP (MM) / 20-40 (SV); explicitly unverifiable private-sheet weights [contested, [[d:hunter#1488442215729594449]]]

caps.ranged_hit: 8% at 300 weapon skill; 1% hit per 5 weapon skill up to 315 [consensus, [[d:hunter#1298063246254932059]], [[d:hunter#1485763124253425858]]]
caps.weapon_skill: 315 is the cap of the linear bonus; historically buggy above it (316 gave bonus crit, 317/318 nothing) [single source, [[d:hunter#1486496701177921701]]]

pets.claim: Pet contribution post-1.18.1: ~50% of BM total damage in Naxx; ~8-10% for MM/SV, under 6% on several Naxx bosses [single-raid samples, [[d:hunter#1486419920332787763]], [[d:hunter#1488167502499418182]], [[d:hunter#1486310800736911400]]].

BM pet choice is fight-length dependent: MC scorpid for long fights with an Eyes-of-the-Beast snapshot (4 stacks, pop Bestial Wrath/AP trinkets, 5th stack via Eyes of the Beast); ZG snake for short fights/Kill Command; ZG raptor as the all-rounder that works in Naxx. Cat fell behind (no damaging special). Wolf is bad for BM (0% damage scaling). Contested by family multiplier: Kill Command is multiplied by the family modifier (raptor 1.1 -> 802 vs scorpion 0.94 -> 685 on dummy), Coordinated Assault is not [single source, [[d:hunter#1485789832759349258]]].

Scorpid Poison stacking-scaling bug pushed scorpion damage far above the others; hotfixed 2026-03-24, after which the guide author called scorpion 'probably middle of the pack' [consensus, [[d:hunter#1487448189387931749]], [[d:hunter#1484745831117623356]]].

1.18.1 added pet cleave avoidance (~40% less physical cleave damage) [single source, [[d:hunter#1485121037426495529]]]; prefer 2.0 attack-speed pets for Windfury (the proc has an internal cooldown) [single source, [[d:hunter#1489955871776702616]]].

encounters.advice: 4 Horsemen, Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad are 'not BM fights'; elsewhere BM was competitive; raptors work in Naxx 'mostly'.
No humanoids/beasts/giants/dragonkin, so Improved Slaying is worthless there; pet uptime is the challenge and scorpid is unusable on 6 of 9 bosses.
The hunter class call destroys melee weapons; unequip melee weapons before it.
Anubisath shadowflame is avoidable at the deadzone line as MM [single source, [[d:hunter#1491059182638727278]]]; 1.18.1 traps work on the new Onyxia and adds [[d:hunter#1484656535996207226]].

consumables: MM raid consumable list (Spirit of Zanza, Mongoose, Ground Scorpok Assay, Juju Might, Danonzo's/Squid Eel Skewer, Consecrated Sharpening Stone) plus pet Juju Power/Juju Might/Scrolls + Agility Scroll [single source x2, [[d:hunter#1486496184280420533]], [[d:hunter#1491073655382212830]]]
Danonzo's well-fed 'carrots' apply the buff instantly (no 10 s wait) [single source, [[d:hunter#1488738273063862376]]]
mistakes_to_avoid: Not using the capstone (Baited Shot on CC3; Kill Command/Bestial Wrath on 1.18.1).
Letting the pet die or overaggro; for BM this is the Kara40/Naxx pain point.
Starving scorpion poison with Claw, or letting poison stacks drop and losing the Eyes-of-the-Beast snapshot.
Under-buffing the pet as BM (pet scrolls/jujus drive 7-9k Kill Commands).

yaml.stat_priority_note: The same ranged stats as Marksmanship, but in a different order: this array ranks agility and ranged attack power above crit and puts haste last, where the Marksmanship array has haste second and agility last. The BM guide summarises the Marksmanship order as hit to cap, then agility, attack power, crit and haste — that summary is this repository's own prose, not a forum source — while the Marksmanship guide's own bulleted order ranks haste second and agility last. The two arrays therefore differ on haste, agility and attack power, and each follows its own guide's sourced bullets. Ranged attack power ranks above crit because RAP is what feeds the pet through Spirit Bond: Naxx/Kara40 items that trade AP for crit 'improve the hunter's personal DPS but do almost nothing for the pet' [Skurridizo p=170469]. Post-1.18.1 hunter crit still matters because Kill Command needs a hunter crit. Pet-damage set bonuses lose to +9 agility past BWL. Agility and ranged attack power are a tie: no cited post ranks them against each other, so their order in the array above carries no ranking. Grouping them is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.

glance.recommendation: Play the **34/17/0** build and a **Raptor** (Cat or Wind Serpent where bleeds fail). Spam **Steady Shot** between Auto Shots, weave **Arcane Shot** (or Multi-Shot on packs), and fire **Kill Command** the moment it lights up. It has no GCD, so put it in every shot macro. Use **Bestial Wrath** on cooldown. Do not take Aimed Shot, Mortal Shots or Serpent Sting. Gear for ranged AP and Agility: the pet scales on your RAP, not your crit.

glance.rest:
!!! note "What changed in 1.18.1"
    **Baited Shot is gone** ("The barbeque is over"). **Bestial Wrath is back**: 18 s enrage, 1.5 min cooldown, no GCD. The new talent **Scent of Blood** gives your attacks a 5/10/15% chance to enrage the pet for +40% damage for 8 s. **Kill Command** is the capstone: 80% of pet AP, usable after you crit, 8 s cooldown, no GCD. Endurance Training and Thick Hide were raised again. Source: [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23, revised 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). The 1.18.0 guides (Kill Command removes pet CC, Baited Shot on crits, "Sausage Shot") are obsolete.

playbooks.title: Marksmanship Hunter (ranged DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the raid-tested **12/37/2** build. Keep Auto Shot running and never clip it. Cast **Aimed Shot** on cooldown and at once on every **Lock and Load** proc. Fill with **Steady Shot**, and weave **Arcane Shot** after Steady to fish for crits. Skip Multi-Shot and Serpent Sting on a single target. Open trash packs with **Volley**. Get ranged hit to 8% (7% with a +5 ranged weapon skill item or book), then stack Agility and crit. Crit is worth about 50 AP since 1.18.1. | | | |---|---| | Role | Ranged physical DPS; baseline Trueshot Aura; Tranquilizing Shot; safe pulls from 41 yards | | Viability (1.18.1) | **A (raid).** Rotation is now proc-driven, and a good MM sims about equal to Survival on single target Vellasta · 2026-04-09. Overall raid consensus puts it slightly behind Survival and close to BM, mainly because Lock and Load and the ammunition procs are clunky Barwat · 2026-04-02. Parses swing on Lock and Load luck: "MM is just a slot machine" Bobob · 2026-03-25, Alaithan · 2026-04-07. | | Difficulty | High. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Ranged hit to 8%** ("8% never miss") WarKeeper · 2026-04-02. You need 9% without weapon skill, or 8% with a +5 ranged weapon skill item Zae · 2026-03-25. Every 5 points of weapon skill is 1% hit dumbid · 2026-03-24. A +3 racial is only 0.6% hit, so get a +5 source Sofie · 2026-04-09. Ranged attacks never glance, so weapon skill does nothing else for them Zugolas · 2024-07-10. Do not overcap: a common cause of low Naxx parses was 12% ranged hit Boomsky · 2026-03-03. 2. **Agility.** 1 Agility ≈ 3.1 AP Itron · 2026-04-18; about 52–53 Agility = 1% crit Demonhun · 2026-04-09, Sofie · 2026-03-30. 3. **Crit.** It is now "hunter's highest value stat", with no "too much crit" point Barwat · 2026-04-02, Bobob · 2026-03-22. Lock and Load raised crit's value to "50 territory" in effective AP Dresche · 2026-03-26, Zwift · 2026-03-26. Before 1.18.1 it was 30–40. 4. **Ranged AP**, then **haste**. **Contested:** most players call haste weak or even harmful for MM, because it does not shorten the GCD and makes you clip more #1 top Render · 2026-04-07, Boomsky · 2026-04-05. Focus argues haste is worth ~1% DPS per 10% Focus · 2026-04-05. 5. **Armor penetration, Strength and Spell Power: near zero.** Full spell-power consumables add only ~1–2% because Arcane Shot is ~9% of MM boss damage Sofie · 2026-04-07, Sofie · 2026-04-10. Sim-derived weights in Naxx gear (Sofie, using Vellasta's simulator; your gear changes them): Agility 3.35, Crit 47.88, Haste 15.88, Ranged AP 1.00, ranged weapon DPS 13.59, Spell Power 0.43, Armor Pen 0.59, Hit 0 (already capped) Sofie · 2026-04-18. Ranged weapon speed: about **3.3** is optimal limbless · 2026-04-10. It leaves room to weave Arcane Shot without clipping under full haste limbless · 2026-04-10. Steady Shot is normalized to a 2.8 speed, so weapon speed changes timing rather than Steady damage Vellasta · 2026-04-03.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: The current loop is **Aimed → Auto → Steady → Arcane → Auto**, hunting for Lock and Load procs Sofie · 2026-04-01. Hidden timings you need to know: - Every shot has a hidden 0.5 s "shooting" portion that haste cannot shorten. Steady Shot is 1 s + 0.5 s, and only the 1 s part is hasted Boomsky · 2026-02-05, Vellasta · 2026-03-02. - Measured Aimed Shot cast times are 2.15 s with no procs, 1.94 s with Improved Aspects, 1.22 s with Improved Aspects + Lock and Load, and 0.81 s adding Rapid Fire Boomsky · 2026-04-04. Gear haste does not shorten Aimed Shot Alaithan · 2026-04-04. - Aimed Shot has a 1 s GCD; Steady Shot has 1.5 s (reported as a bug) Vellasta · 2026-03-22. Opener: send the pet "exactly at the same time as the tank hits it", and keep it attacking Dresche · 2026-03-21, Dresche · 2026-03-21. Then Hunter's Mark and Auto Shot. Pre-cast Steady Shot and queue Arcane Shot behind it yaboikeenser · 2026-04-03. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **Auto Shot must never be clipped.** Start each cast in the reload window, not in the last 0.5 s before an auto fires Bakingsoda · 2026-02-12. 2. **Aimed Shot** when **Lock and Load** is up (up to 10 s, cast time −1 s). 3. **Aimed Shot** when off cooldown. 4. **Arcane Shot** when **Enchanted (Arcane) Ammunition** is up. It must be cast *after* the Aimed Shot has landed, or it loses the +100% Boomsky · 2026-03-20, flagtutor · 2026-03-22. Play it as "Steady Shot after Aimed, then Arcane right after Steady" Sofie · 2026-03-22. 5. **Steady Shot** as the filler after each Auto Shot. 6. **Arcane Shot** after a Steady when it fits without clipping. It is a cheap crit roll for Lock and Load The J · 2026-03-31. It is also your shot while moving Tydorel · 2026-04-17. 7. **Serpent Sting** only if the raid wants the Nature Ammunition armor debuff: −240 armor that stacks with all other armor debuffs Vellasta · 2026-04-01. It is a personal DPS loss ("100 SP = 100 more damage over 15 seconds") Sofie · 2026-03-22, Kantrul · 2026-03-22, but Sofie still uses it in raids for the debuff Sofie · 2026-03-23. 8. **Multi-Shot: skip on one target.** It cannot trigger Lock and Load Sofie · 2026-03-26. The Fire Ammunition explosion is bugged at a flat ~50–60 damage Boomsky · 2026-03-21, Vellasta · 2026-03-25. Experienced players say that chasing every ammunition proc is "pretty trash". Using only Steady and Arcane to fish for Lock and Load does about the same damage Vellasta · 2026-03-31, The J · 2026-03-31. Dresche forced every ammo type in Kara40 and measured a DPS loss Dresche · 2026-03-23. **Contested:** is Aimed Shot or Steady Shot the "main" button? Sofie first argued Steady, since Aimed depends on procs Sofie · 2026-03-20. By the end of release week most testers ran Aimed on cooldown first Sofie · 2026-03-22, Kantrul · 2026-03-23. During Rapid Fire + Quick Shots, the window between autos shrinks to about 1 s Zugolas · 2025-09-03. Keep Aimed and Steady as the priority, since Rapid Fire cuts both cast times by 40% [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown: | Targets | Do | |---|---| | 1 | Single-target priority above | | 2 | Multi-Shot when it fits (2+ targets) Tydorel · 2026-04-17; spend Fire Ammunition on it | | 3+ | **Volley opener** (3 s cast, 1 s with Barrage 3/3; "free ±2k damage") Hakuna · 2026-03-21, Focus · 2026-03-24 → Multi-Shot → Aimed Shot aimed down a line of mobs → Steady/Arcane | | big packs | Volley + Multi-Shot put one hunter "right below mages" at ~2,500 DPS Zwift · 2026-03-25 | - **Pierce line:** a Lock and Load Aimed Shot hits every enemy between you and your target for full damage. Every extra target can proc Lock and Load again Boomsky · 2026-03-21. The line is very narrow: anything even 1 yd behind the primary target is missed Vellasta · 2026-03-21, Mithreon · 2026-04-02. Sofie found it "way too chaotic" to line up in her first raids Sofie · 2026-03-22. On pure single-target fights, skip it. - On AoE packs, prioritize Explosive (Fire) Ammunition on Multi-Shot for the extra crits that chain into Aimed Shot Boomsky · 2026-03-25. - Volley can only be placed while standing still Focus · 2026-03-24. - The ZG hunter trinket from Renataki resets Volley's cooldown, so it is strong on trash Sofie · 2026-03-21, The J · 2026-04-02.

roleStrategy.heading: Resource and threat management
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Mana is tight until 6 pieces of T3.** Flask of Wisdom is your best friend until then Raggen · 2026-03-23. Fully raid-buffed MM does not go OOM with a paladin seal, Mageblood and Mana Oil Ruiz · 2026-03-24. - **Aspect of the Viper** (level 56, 5% max mana per 5 s) [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). The standard is "start with Hawk until low mana and pop Viper until the end of the fight" Kantrul · 2026-03-03. Viper's mana ticks generate threat, like all mana gain Cleric · 2026-04-09, Stunfisk · 2026-04-09. - Double **Brilliant Mana Oil** on two one-handers, plus Mageblood and Blessing of Wisdom, lets you skip Viper and keep Hawk up Vulpine · 2026-04-17, Vulpine · 2026-04-17. - On a target dummy you go OOM in about 1 minute, versus 1.5–2 minutes before the patch Sofie · 2026-03-21.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Your melee weapons are **stat sticks**. MM prefers two one-handers, which give two slots of stats Dresche · 2026-04-13, Vulpine · 2026-04-17. ### Ranged weapon progression | Phase | Weapon | Source | |---|---|---| | Fresh 60 | Stormwind Vault quest crossbow ("a good starter crossbow") Sofie · 2026-03-10; Black Morass (Wardens of Time) exalted gun, rep is soloable Sofie · 2026-03-18 | [Stormwind Vault](#/instances/stormwind-vault), [Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass) | | MC | Rhok'delar (quest), MC Leaf bow | Rhok'delar demon tactics: see [Leveling](#/class/hunter/leveling) | | BWL / ES | **Ashjre'thul, Crossbow of Smiting (BWL), Nature's Call (ES)** — sims put all three equal Sofie · 2026-04-09, Sofie · 2026-04-09. The BWL crossbow was slowed from 2.6 to 3.1 speed this patch and now sims well limbless · 2026-04-12 | [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair), [Emerald Sanctum](#/instances/emerald-sanctum) | | AQ40 | Larvae of the Great Worm (slightly better) Sofie · 2026-04-09 | | | Naxx | Twilight's Hammer gun (proc-dependent), then Soulstring / Slavemaker Sofie · 2026-04-09 | | | Kara40 | Rain of Spiders Sofie · 2026-04-09, Sofie · 2026-01-23 | [Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan) | Each ranged weapon upgrade was worth roughly +50 DPS on a dummy, and Slavemaker about +100 Sofie · 2026-01-23 (tested before 1.18.1). ### Melee stat sticks | Phase | Pick | Source | |---|---|---| | BWL (Ambershire) | Hakkar main-hand sword + Hakkar dagger (BiS); Nefarian's new axe is close Sofie · 2026-03-30; Noble's Letter Opener (Shen'dralar) + Brutality Blade or Fang of the Faceless; Core Hound Tooth Zwift · 2026-03-30 | | | Endgame | **Kingsfall + Scythe of the Unseen Path**, "the premier BM/MM combo even in full Kara40 BiS" Lilyth · 2026-04-02 | | ### Armor - **Tier:** full **8/8 T2** beats 6/8 T2.5; take T2.5 only if you lack 8/8 T2 Sofie · 2026-03-23. T3.5 pieces are only ~3 Agility better than T3, so keep 6–8 T3 for its mana bonus Sofie · 2026-03-25. The T3.5 set bonus is considered "trash now" Moragil · 2026-03-25 (single source). - **Timbermaw Hold set** (new 1.18.1 mail set, 5-piece bonus): called "so busted" Itron · 2026-03-20, Itron · 2026-03-20; its Agility + AP structure is especially good for BM Focus · 2026-03-22. See [Timbermaw Hold](#/instances/timbermaw-hold). - **Cloak:** Shroud of Dominion "BiS unchallenged" Bakingsoda · 2026-03-20; the Sapphiron cloak (~1 crit + 50 AP) yaboikeenser · 2026-03-20. - **Gloves:** Emerald Sanctum gloves are BiS outside tier Sofie · 2026-03-21. PvP gloves (Multi-Shot bonus) are no longer worth it Sofie · 2026-03-21. - **Neck:** Prestor's Talisman has more effective AP than Onyxia's neck Kalamity · 2026-03-30 and is BiS until the Kel'Thuzad neck Sofie · 2026-03-30. - **Rings:** Quick Strike Ring (1% crit + 30 AP) beats Circle of Applied Force for MM Elm · 2026-04-09. The two new crit/hit rings "brick each other"; the pure-crit ring alone is BiS Karaoke · 2026-04-03. ### Pre-raid There is no maintained post-1.18.1 pre-raid list Survival for the fittest · 2026-04-03. The best "reasonable" list (quest and dungeon only, built around the 8% hit cap; written June 2025) is: Backwood Helm, Mark of Fordring, Truestrike Shoulders, Cape of the Black Baron, Time-Blackened Chestpiece, Warpwood Bindings, Frostchain Gauntlets, Plaguehound Leggings, Windreaver Greaves, 2× Tarnished Elven Ring, Blackhand's Breadth + Royal Seal of Eldre'Thalas, Barbarous Blade, Bloodseeker SaggySack · 2025-06-07. Also consider: - The Dire Maul hunter book trinket ("a really strong trinket") Raggen · 2026-01-16. - Devilsaur Eye as an opener trinket Krulltak · 2025-10-05. - Three Black Morass pieces Elmgren · 2025-11-13. - New Turtle leather pieces from Karazhan Crypt trash Rpecial · 2026-04-05. Contested: Devilsaur Eye loses to other trinkets once you raid, since about 30 s of downtime per 20 s of +150 AP averages only ~60 AP Boomsky · 2026-03-16.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Chasing every ammunition proc: it costs DPS Dresche · 2026-03-23, Vellasta · 2026-03-31. - Casting Arcane Shot while the Aimed Shot is still in flight: you lose the ammo buff flagtutor · 2026-03-22. - Using Multi-Shot on one target Sofie · 2026-03-26. - Stacking haste, or overcapping hit Boomsky · 2026-04-05, Boomsky · 2026-03-03. - Playing MM as a fresh 60 with very low crit: Lock and Load rarely procs. Level and gear as BM first Kantrul · 2026-03-23. - Trusting BetterCharacterStats right after a patch. It misreads ranged crit and hit bonuses, so test on a dummy Bobob · 2026-03-22, Vellasta · 2026-03-21.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 decision loop for the 12/37/2 build. Details are in the sections linked below. 1. **Opener:** 1. Send the pet as the tank hits. 2. Hunter's Mark, then Auto Shot. 3. Start Steady Shot as the Auto Shot fires, and queue Arcane Shot behind it yaboikeenser · 2026-04-03. 4. Rapid Fire and trinkets on the pull ([cooldowns](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps)). 2. **Single-target loop:** Aimed → Auto → Steady → Arcane → Auto ([rotation](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps)). 1. Never clip Auto Shot. 2. Aimed Shot on a **Lock and Load** proc. 3. Aimed Shot on cooldown. 4. Arcane Shot on Enchanted Ammunition, only after the Aimed Shot has landed. 5. Steady Shot as the filler. 6. Arcane Shot after Steady when it fits. 7. No Multi-Shot on one target. Serpent Sting only if the raid wants the Nature Ammunition debuff. 3. **Cooldowns:** - Rapid Fire on pull, or with Bloodlust. - On-use trinkets on the opener. - Feign Death whenever threat gets close. Improved Feign Death is mandatory. 4. **AoE switch rule:** - **2 targets:** Multi-Shot when it fits. - **3+ targets:** Volley opener, then Multi-Shot, then a Lock and Load Aimed Shot down a line of mobs ([AoE](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps)). 5. **Resource rule:** Aspect of the Hawk until you are low on mana, then Aspect of the Viper until the fight ends Kantrul · 2026-03-03. Mana oils and Mageblood let you skip Viper ([resources](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps)). 6. **Movement and situational:** - Arcane Shot while moving Tydorel · 2026-04-17. - Stay out of the dead zone. - Volley needs you standing still.

extraSections.heading: Pet for MM
extraSections.markdown: A Raptor is the standard MM raid pet (Savage Rend, high family modifier) Dresche · 2026-03-23. In Molten Core many mobs are immune to bleed and poison, so use a Cat or a Wind Serpent there Focus · 2026-03-25, maaadcheddar (muckmuck) · 2026-03-25. Without Coordinated Assault, pets are ~11% of MM damage Bobob · 2026-03-20. Full details: [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets).

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **ProcDoc** (MM fork, shows Lock and Load and the current ammunition): `github.com/thezephyrsong/ProcDoc` Zae · 2026-03-21, Zwift · 2026-03-26. - **MetaHunt**: its MM Widget tracks ammunition and Lock and Load; v1.5 can drive a one-button MM rotation with Nampower Meta · 2026-03-31. - **Quiver** is unreliable for the new Aimed Shot cast bar ("don't trust Quiver") Sofie · 2026-03-20. Alternatives: Quartz maaadcheddar (muckmuck) · 2026-03-09, ShotTimer Bakingsoda · 2026-03-16. - **Nampower** silently drops an Arcane Shot queued during Aimed Shot. Raise `NP_MinBufferTimeMs` from 55 to 200 yaboikeenser · 2026-03-25, yaboikeenser · 2026-03-25. - One-press priority macro (SuperCleveRoidMacros; Alysia) Alysia · 2026-03-26: ``` /cast [mydebuff:"Enchanted Ammunition"]Arcane Shot;[mydebuff:"Poisonous Ammunition"& noimmune:nature]Serpent Sting;[mydebuff:"Explosive Ammunition"]Multi-Shot;[nocooldown]Aimed Shot;[norangedclip]Steady Shot; ``` - SuperMacro version (Littlechurch; one spell per press, use it like a Steady button) Littlechurch · 2026-03-21: ``` #showtooltip /firstaction /cast [mybuff:"Lock and Load"] Aimed Shot; [mydebuff:"Explosive Ammunition"] Multi-Shot; [mydebuff:"Enchanted Ammunition"] Arcane Shot; Steady Shot; [mydebuff:"Poisonous Ammunition"] Serpent Sting ``` Given the rotation above, drop the Multi-Shot and Serpent Sting branches for single-target fights.

extraSections.heading: Raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **Kara40 Rupturan, phase 2:** stand exactly at the dead-zone edge. Boulders miss you and you still shoot. Side-step 10 yards with the group on Flamestrike Dresche · 2026-04-07, Dresche · 2026-04-07. The same trick works on AQ40 Anubisaths Dresche · 2026-04-07. - **Kara40 Mephistroth:** hunters are the designated eye-baiters Dresche · 2025-12-04. - **Immunities:** Anomalus (Kara40) and Lava Annihilator (MC) are immune to Arcane Shot and Serpent Sting. The Golem pair and Garr are immune to Serpent Sting Vellasta · 2026-03-22, Bakingsoda · 2026-03-22. - **Chromaggus:** Arcane Vulnerability plus Arcane Ammunition produced a 9,300 Arcane Shot crit Sofie · 2026-03-22. - **Onyxia:** a piercing Aimed Shot crit can make a whelp "stick" to you Boomsky · 2026-03-21. - **C'Thun:** Feign Death does not work (a Turtle anti-exploit change) 30 · 2026-03-18. - **Nefarian:** the hunter class call now breaks **all** equipped weapons, melee and ranged. Bring a repair bot or swap weapons with ItemRack Kaslux · 2026-03-22, Vulpine · 2026-03-22. - Instance pages: [Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core), [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair), [Onyxia's Lair](#/instances/onyxias-lair), [Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan).

standing.notes: Favored raid spec until mid-2025, then fell behind Survival - staff conceded ranged Hunter 'has fallen behind other damage dealers and melee Hunter'. 1.18.1 rebuilt the tree around Aimed Shot, Experimental Ammunition and Lock and Load; no validated build or DPS number exists for it.

rotation_single.claim: FAQ baseline post-1.18.1 loop: Auto -> Aimed -> Ammunition-filler -> Steady -> Aimed -> Ammunition-filler -> Steady, with Auto always in between [single source (guide writer, patch day), [[d:hunter#1484616991951032550]]].

Most-cited practical weave: begin casting Steady the instant Auto is loosed; while Steady casts, spam Arcane so it fires immediately after Steady; repeat. Drop Arcane if conserving mana [consensus, [[d:hunter#1489708299913003218]], [[d:hunter#1489709233007235133]], [[d:hunter#1486314699443277854]]].

Arcane Shot is now a high-priority instant filler (it protects the Aimed reset and hits hard); 'only shoot Steady when there's nothing else to do' [consensus, [[d:hunter#1486255776367382598]], [[d:hunter#1485478994525818951]]].

Post-1.18.1 MM is widely called overloaded and clip-prone; several players preferred the pre-patch feel [consensus among MM players, [[d:hunter#1485676134380343307]], [[d:hunter#1486486042822574122]]].

Dresche's post-Kara40 verdict: MM boss fights great / trash fights awful; 'just prioritize steady, aimed, multi' and the ammunition mini-game was a dps loss [single source (guide writer), [[d:hunter#1485384949455392868]]].
Measured personal dps rose 'at least 15%' on a bad-rotation MC run, expecting 20-25% with practice [single source, [[d:hunter#1484606051881062511]]].
On BWL MM out-dpsed a Survival hunter on every single-target boss but lost overall trash [single source, [[d:hunter#1484692203434414130]]].

rotation_aoe.claim: Volley (3 s cast, -2 s with Barrage) is now genuinely useful on trash, especially with the ZG Renataki trinket resetting its cooldown [consensus, [[d:hunter#1485134951522504955]], [[d:hunter#1485135076483272704]]].

Working AoE threshold: 2-3 targets Multi on cooldown; 4+ Volley on cooldown + Fire-ammunition Multi. No post-1.18.1 benchmark exists, so the crossover is derived [derived, [[d:hunter#1485134951522504955]], [[d:hunter#1485384949455392868]]].
MM still trails Survival on sustained cleave unless the MM hunter gets perfect Aimed-Shot piercing positioning [consensus, [[d:hunter#1484984092184281168]]].

stat_weights.hit: 8% at 300 weapon skill; 1% hit per 5 weapon skill to 315; +5 skill is the useful threshold [consensus, [[d:hunter#1298063246254932059]], [[d:hunter#1485763124253425858]], [[d:hunter#1491594913136115732]]]
stat_weights.spell_power: full SP consumes (~300 SP) = ~1-2% dps [single source, [[d:hunter#1490854183237324840]]]

caps.ranged_hit: 8% at 300 weapon skill (CORRECTED from the forum KB's 9%); 305 -> 7%, 310 -> 6%, 315 -> 5% [consensus, [[d:hunter#1298063246254932059]], [[d:hunter#1485763124253425858]]]
caps.dual_wield_melee: dual-wielding melee autos have a much higher miss rate (~20%+); yellow melee specials use the normal cap [single source, [[d:hunter#1485760027976400966]]]

encounters.advice: No humanoids/beasts/giants/dragonkin, so Improved Slaying is worthless there; MM trash fights are 'awful'.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Order as the playbook's sourced bullets run: hit to the cap your weapon skill implies (9% at 300 skill, 6% at 305 with racial +5 bows/guns), then haste — the Turtle-specific stat, ~0.9% damage per 1% with no diminishing returns — then crit, then attack power and agility. Armor penetration ('generally weak') and spell power (dead weight for MM) are explicitly not stats to gear for. Whether AP enchants or haste win is contested and gear-dependent. Attack power and agility are a tie: no cited post ranks them against each other, so their order in the array above carries no ranking. Grouping them is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.

glance.recommendation: Play the raid-tested **12/37/2** build. Keep Auto Shot running and never clip it. Cast **Aimed Shot** on cooldown and at once on every **Lock and Load** proc. Fill with **Steady Shot**, and weave **Arcane Shot** after Steady to fish for crits. Skip Multi-Shot and Serpent Sting on a single target. Open trash packs with **Volley**. Get ranged hit to 8% (7% with a +5 ranged weapon skill item or book), then stack Agility and crit. Crit is worth about 50 AP since 1.18.1.

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **A (raid).** Rotation is now proc-driven, and a good MM sims about equal to Survival on single target Vellasta · 2026-04-09. Overall raid consensus puts it slightly behind Survival and close to BM, mainly because Lock and Load and the ammunition procs are clunky Barwat · 2026-04-02. facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: High. Two RNG systems (Lock and Load and the Experimental Ammunition cycle) plus auto-shot weaving Crestian · 2026-03-20, Sofie · 2026-03-22

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Ranged safety on mechanics-heavy fights; pierce-line Aimed Shot and Volley on packs Vellasta · 2026-04-09, Zwift · 2026-03-25; real burst in PvP yaboikeenser · 2026-03-22

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Weak for a fresh 60 with low crit, because Lock and Load only triggers on crits Kantrul · 2026-03-23; tighter mana than before the patch Sofie · 2026-03-21, Sofie · 2026-03-21; the dead zone

glance.rest: Before 1.18.1, MM was "auto → Steady → Multi → auto" with Aimed Shot unused. Guides that tell you to skip Aimed Shot, or that talent Steady Shot or Trueshot Aura, are out of date. Both are baseline now Sofie · 2026-04-01, Stunfisk · 2026-03-28.

playbooks.title: Hunter PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** for battlegrounds, play **Marksmanship 0/34/17**: MM down to Lock and Load, Survival down to Survivalist, no Barrage. The **Aimed Shot → Arcane Shot** burst hits armored targets for 2,000+. You also keep full damage when your pet is crowd-controlled. **Beast Mastery** is the easy-mode alternative while pets take no PvP dampening. Survival is strong against warriors and rogues, and weak against casters, paladins and warlocks. Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). **Contested:** is MM or BM the better PvP spec? - **MM:** "MM is way better for pvp rn" The J · 2026-04-16, Moonshow · 2026-04-16. BM becomes "a bit of a deadweight" without Bestial Wrath once a mage or druid CCs the pet, while MM has "more constant damage, waaay more survivability/crowdcontrol" Moonshow · 2026-04-16. - **BM:** "BM pets are monsters in bgs. basically another player on your team" Wuuc · 2026-04-03; "you don't need to be very skilled in pvp to have some fun" Zwift · 2026-04-03. | Spec | PvP rating (1.18.1) | Why | |---|---|---| | Marksmanship | **A** | Well received after the patch: "dynamic, fun and damage are good even on armored people" Neiol · 2026-03-20. A "free kill" once a melee reaches your dead zone Zwift · 2026-04-03 | | Beast Mastery | **A** | Kill Command crits delete casters limbless · 2026-04-12. stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Ranged hit 8%**, then Agility and crit (burst). See [Marksmanship](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps). - **Stamina + resilience** for BM. The pet gets no resilience and dies quickly when focused Focus · 2026-04-12. rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **MM burst:** Aimed Shot, then Arcane Shot while Enchanted Ammunition is up. It "is extremely good now vs anything with high ac" yaboikeenser · 2026-03-22, with Arcane hitting ~1k before crits Zakiluzza · 2026-03-22. Multi-Shot is an opener or finisher on a low-HP target yaboikeenser · 2026-04-11. 1. Open from max range: Aimed Shot → Arcane Shot (Enchanted Ammunition) → Auto → Steady. 2. If a melee closes in: Scatter Shot → step back → Freezing Trap (or Frost Trap + Entrapment) → kite with Concussive Shot. 3. If they reach the dead zone again: Wing Clip, then back off. Deterrence or Feign Death as a last resort. **BM burst:** Bestial Wrath with trinkets, then Kill Command on the next crit. Devilsaur Tooth guarantees the pet's next crit Cleric · 2026-04-10. Send the pet into the backline healer as a "dive tank" junabii · 2026-04-12. **Control rules (Turtle-specific):** - **Freezing Trap after Scatter Shot lasts only 6 s.** They share diminishing returns, and the 10 s DR from 1.12 was not restored Boomsky · 2026-02-08, Boomsky · 2026-02-08. Traps can be trinketed Boomsky · 2025-10-19. - **Entrapment** can root on any tick of the Frost Trap, but only once per trap Dresche · 2026-03-26, Moonshow · 2026-03-26. - **Improved Concussive Shot's stun** is a separate spell. It can be resisted and grounded Boomsky · 2026-04-03. - **Counterspell on a hunter** stops trap drops, even out of Feign Death dindunuffinz · 2025-10-25. - Wing Clip is on a 3 s cooldown and Counterattack was removed Meta · 2026-03-18. The dead zone remains; players want it removed Zwift · 2026-03-18. - Hunter's Mark now reveals stealth only within 15 yards (it was 100) Boomsky · 2026-02-08.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: This is the level-60 decision loop. For the details, see [Burst and control sequences](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-pvp), [Battleground role](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-pvp). Cooldowns come from the 1.18.1 kit. **Marksmanship 0/34/17:** 1. **Opener:** start at max range (8–35 yd for shots). Hunter's Mark, then Aimed Shot (2 s cast, 26 s cooldown) → Arcane Shot while Enchanted Ammunition is up → Auto Shot → Steady Shot. The burst hits armored targets for 2,000+ yaboikeenser · 2026-03-22, Zakiluzza · 2026-03-22. Multi-Shot opens or finishes a low-HP target yaboikeenser · 2026-04-11. 2. **Loop while at range:** Arcane Shot on the move (the reason for Swiftshot) yaboikeenser · 2026-03-20. Concussive Shot (12 s cooldown) to keep distance. Viper Sting on mana users, Serpent Sting otherwise (see [Macros](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-pvp)). Don't stand still casting Steady Shot next to a caster: "any alliance hunter that stays in place trying to do steady shot is an EQ target for me" peter_hammer · 2025-10-19. 3. **Control chain when melee closes in:** Scatter Shot (30 s) → step back → Freezing Trap, or Frost Trap + Entrapment → kite with Concussive Shot. Scatter and Freezing Trap share diminishing returns, so the trap after a Scatter lasts only 6 s Boomsky · 2026-02-08. Traps can be trinketed Boomsky · 2025-10-19. Entrapment roots once per Frost Trap Dresche · 2026-03-26. 4. **Dead zone escape:** Wing Clip (3 s cooldown), then back off (Disengage only drops threat, so it does not move you). Feign Death (30 s) drops targets and lets you place a trap. Deterrence (5 min) is the last resort. Once a melee sits in your dead zone you are "a walking target dummy" Vellasta · 2026-01-25. Night Elves chain Feign Death into Shadowmeld Punk · 2026-01-13. 5. **Target priority:** Viper Sting the healers and hold defensive positions with traps Grillbe · 2025-10-13. Burst the warriors and paladins in plate, because Arcane Shot "is extremely good now vs anything with high ac" yaboikeenser · 2026-03-22. 6. **Reset / drink:** use Scatter → Feign Death → Freezing Trap to "reset the fight over and over if needed" Frumie · 2024-11-21. Drink or switch to Aspect of the Viper only when out of combat, or behind line of sight while a trap holds the target (vanilla baseline). **Beast Mastery:** Bestial Wrath (90 s) with trinkets, then Kill Command (8 s) on the next crit Cleric · 2026-04-10. Send the pet into the backline healer as a dive tank while you kite junabii · 2026-04-12. Expect the pet to be focused or CC'd: resummon it, and never rely on it against warriors junabii · 2026-02-08. **Survival 8/5/38:** you still kite and range as much as you can. Your traps are the real edge: Immolation Trap wins against rogues and warriors Zakiluzza · 2025-09-29, and Entrapment locks chokepoints Vaienna · 2026-04-03. Deterrence, if you took it, is your only defensive cooldown. Casters and warlocks beat you in the dead zone Neiol · 2026-01-07. **Vs class** (the full table is in [Matchups](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-pvp)): - **Warrior:** trinket Hamstring, then Wing Clip and make distance. Expect Intercept + Disarm (pre). - **Rogue:** MM burst survives Cold Blood/Kidney cycles; Survival wins with Immolation Trap. - **Mage:** they Blink + Frost Nova into your dead zone. Against BM they need double Ice Block. - **Paladin:** Freedom ignores stings, slows, roots and traps, so save the burst for after it. - **Shaman / Warlock / Priest:** hard matchups (Frost Shock burst, fear, DoTs). Burst early and use Feign Death to drop targets. - **Counterspell** stops trap drops, even out of Feign Death dindunuffinz · 2025-10-25.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **Defend and control.** Traps (and Shadowmeld for Night Elves) hold defensive positions; Viper Sting the healers Grillbe · 2025-10-13. Entrapment locks chokepoints in AV Vaienna · 2026-04-03. - **Deny movement.** "For WSG though, the #1 best thing a pet can do is keep someone from having freedom of movement. A still player is a dead one" Tarane · 2026-03-24. - **Counterplay against you:** enemies focus your pet. A dead pet is quickly resummoned junabii · 2026-04-12. - **PvP pets:** Wind Serpent (damage), Spider (root), Boar (Charge root), Bat (blocks line of sight, AP debuff), Moth (heal + attack-speed debuff) Tarane · 2026-03-24, Tarane · 2026-03-24. A fast pet interrupts casts more often greygoose · 2023-06-23. Details: [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets).

extraSections.heading: Races
extraSections.markdown: - **Night Elf:** best PvP race "if you can FD+shadowmeld combo" Punk · 2026-01-13. - **Tauren:** War Stomp is "best hunter racial" for stunning someone in your dead zone. It is not a trinket and hits several targets dindunuffinz · 2025-12-25, dindunuffinz · 2025-12-25. - **Gnome:** "the meta pvp race for hunter but no one wants to admit it" junabii · 2026-01-01. - **Orc:** Hardiness now shortens stuns instead of rolling for immunity; players petition for 25% Krulltak · 2025-11-12, Three Gnomes In A Trench Coat · 2025-11-12. - **Undead:** Will of the Forsaken saves your trinket against warlock Seduce and Fear dindunuffinz · 2026-01-02, Kalamity · 2025-10-11.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - Wing Clip in melee, Concussive Shot otherwise yaboikeenser · 2026-03-21: ``` /run if CheckInteractDistance("target",3) then CastSpellByName("Wing Clip") else CastSpellByName("Concussive Shot"); end ``` - Traps with modifiers, auto-Feign in combat (needs CleveRoidMacros) wilku · 2025-12-07: ``` #showtooltip /cast [mod:alt]Explosive Trap; [mod:ctrl] Immolation Trap; [mod:shift] Frost Trap; Freezing Trap /cast [combat] Feign Death /petfollow [combat] ``` - Viper Sting on mana users, Serpent Sting otherwise Bubblechomp · 2026-01-18: ``` /run if (UnitPowerType('target')==0) then CastSpellByName("Viper Sting")else CastSpellByName("Serpent Sting")end ```

cooldowns.use_when: the ~2025-04 change made the trinket remove all CC on a 3-min CD, including Freezing Trap - the single biggest hunter PvP nerf of the era [consensus, [[d:pvp-general#1370452815889174538]], [[d:pvp-general#1370726144814616629]], [[d:hunter#1476452767802593330]]]

resource_rules: Hunters oom faster than casters ('40-50% less mana')
Feign Death + Aspect of the Viper between fights post-1.18.1; drink after Feign Death
Do not spam Viper Sting on a single dispelling target
consumables: Engineering is the concrete PvP kit: Iron Grenade as a universal CC, thorium grenade to break melee range, sapper charges for AoE; 'Engineer is a must for any serious PvP' [consensus, [[d:hunter#1359785441813069986]], [[d:hunter#1011330049057767544]], [[d:hunter#1362480243134304408]], [[d:hunter#1045527107918372884]]]

PvP trinket + Limited Invulnerability Potion + Feign Death to reset; Free Action Potion vs rogue/warrior openers; flasks are rare in PvP [single source, [[d:hunter#1491813464706912308]], [[d:hunter#1301973930600435826]]]

Post-1.18.1 PvP reward sets: Partisan is T2-equivalent, the third tier is T3/T3.5-equivalent, the T2 PvP set is 'garbage' vs T1, WSG-exalted bracers beat T1 for BM; full PvP T3 is ~6.5 months of honour cap [consensus, [[d:hunter#1487247287905288242]], [[d:hunter#1490738219749474304]], [[d:hunter#1487484988633907260]]]
mistakes_to_avoid: Scatter Shot into a trap without pre-placing it (half duration since the DR fix)
Feigning with the pet still attacking (stays in combat) or Aimed Shot on a moving target
Burning Bestial Wrath/Kill Command for damage instead of holding it as the pet's CC-break
Standing in the 8-yd dead zone; swapping to Aspect of the Wolf just to hit a mob twice
Night Elf/Shadowmeld ambush builds - 'Turtle gimped that'
Trueshot Aura or cat pets in PvP
Relying on BM when the enemy can CC your pet and Bestial Wrath is down [[d:hunter#1494186537129218099]]

matchups.hunter_view: Favourable with cooldowns (Wing Clip -> Scatter -> Freezing Trap -> Aimed); Deterrence + Monkey gives ~90% avoidance then the hunter is a free kill for ~5 min; FAP or a trap trinket flips it.

Worst melee matchup; Flare is the only reliable opener-beater; a rogue trinkets the trap, pops Evasion+Sprint and closes; post-1.18.1 the 0/35/16 MM build (Imp Concussive + Entrapment + Imp Wing Clip + Survivalist) is the answer and FAP is the counter.
Historic hunter win line: pre-place Freezing Trap to deny the deadzone, unload at range, scatter for space, FD/Scatter to deny Polymorph; post-1.18.1 MM burst is 'a lot of burst in PvP'.

Losing matchup for most; DoTs ignore kiting and Soul Link tanks the damage. Counterplay: Scatter/FD/Intimidation to break the Drain, Frost Reflector, wind-serpent pressure, save the trinket for Seduce/Fear.
Shadow priest is 'nearly impossible' for many (DoTs + PW:Shield + fear); a burst build can delete them before fear lands or a melee SV/BM pressure build beats under-geared priests.

The 'how do I kill it' matchup: Freedom negates the kite, bubble eats burst, plate blunts ranged, instant Viper dispel. Full duel plan exists (stamina, deep-MM, don't Scatter into trap, Cheetah-kite, Deterrence during bubble); post-2025 buffed hybrids made it worse and Survival is the anti-paladin answer.

Contested: early 'shaman is real kiteable' vs later enhancement too tanky (Frost Shock + Earthbind drags the hunter into the deadzone, 'if windfury procs you die') and elemental a burst race needing nature resist.

Form-dependent and mostly unfavourable: bear 'unkillable and unslowable', boomkin out-ranges, cat most manageable but bleeds + run speed hurt; the WSG job is stopping the druid flag carrier; post-1.18.1 the BM pet is the liability.
The one matchup the low-geared 2025 poster felt confident in; whoever controls the deadzone and lands Scatter/Entrapment first wins, and a fast-attack pet keeps pushback on the other hunter.
