BM PvP pet must have a sprint/dash [single source, [[d:hunter#1492651231305273414]]].

corrections.claim: 30/21/0 timeline: already the recommended shape before Nov 2024 ('the best pvp spec is going to be some kind of scatter shot / intimidation build' [2022, [[d:hunter#979448951113670756]]]); many hunters moved to 0/21/30 after the 2024-09-04 shared-DR fix; post-1.18.1 it is explicitly a fallback, not the recommendation [consensus, [[d:hunter#1280900374596812912]], [[d:hunter#1484432155768524800]]].

PvP dampening applies to all PvP including duels [single source, [[d:hunter#1485349738449469510]]]; post-1.18.1 pets reportedly receive no dampened damage, which is the reason deep BM works [single source, [[d:hunter#1490803074963476650]]]; a later undated 'stealth dampening change' was felt by MM [single source, [[d:hunter#1487217168977498152]]]. No staff confirmation.

Racial advice: keeps Gnome best Alliance but adds a competing camp ('meld is bis for pvp', nelf for AB defence [ [[d:hunter#1166672654351212566]], [[d:hunter#1090547916235604079]] ]) and a strong Tauren camp ('warstomp is best hunter racial, being able to stun someone in your deadzone/melee range, and then cheetah away' [ [[d:hunter#1453792390098714936]] ]); undead is for fear/Seduce vs locks [single source, [[d:hunter#1456421765013049395]]].

Pet training-point priority for PvP: BiS DPS skill > needed resist > rank 8/9 Greater Stamina > leftovers into other resists/armor/dash/bite/claw [single source (guide writer), [[d:hunter#1438241842159423529]]].

pets.claim: Attack speed matters in PvP for spell pushback vs casters ('faster pet attack speed is fucking amazing... it causes spell pushback'); ZG bats and Broken Tooth at 1.0 speed were BiS for that [consensus, [[d:hunter#949500178526777406]], [[d:hunter#979087162496647189]]].

Post-1.18.1 BM PvP pet is the wind serpent, but only with a sprint: 'I dont think id use any pet for bm pvp that didnt have sprint' [single source, [[d:hunter#1492651231305273414]]]; the spider is the most annoying PvP pet [single source, [[d:hunter#1491084492012654592]]].

For Survival PvP the spider is 'a must' for the web/root; scorpid + raptor are also solid depending on target immunities (nature vs bleed) [consensus, [[d:hunter#1454765734562496595]], [[d:hunter#1487807112577941564]]].

bg_role.claim: The hunter's BG value is defensive/utility, not frontline: traps (with Shadowmeld for Alliance) hold positions while warlocks do the offensive FC work [single source, [[d:pvp-general#1427354322395463682]]].

Entrapment locks down chokepoints ('amazing for pvp, AV especially'); concrete BG play is pet on aggro + explosive trap + Flare, Eagle Eye other bases, call rotations, don't try to solo nodes [consensus, [[d:hunter#1489619404449779883]], [[d:hunter#1491490030517092362]]].

Night Elf/Shadowmeld stealth + pet prowl ambush on cappers; for AV the recommendation was MM/BM with an owl or stealthed cat [single source, [[d:hunter#1166672654351212566]], [[d:hunter#1043898429346168832]]].

standing.claim: Pre-1.18.1: 'hunter kind of loses every 1v1 in pvp' - the class-by-class losing wall (gear-dependent) [single source, [[d:hunter#1425287154505875497]], [[d:hunter#1425274763416174624]]] - vs 'the first time in twows history that bm is really viable in pvp' and a BM/marks hybrid as 'the best control' [contested, [[d:hunter#1453645768895234148]], [[d:hunter#1470128511980142696]]].

Post-1.18.1 the class is noticeably better: 'MM hunter has good burst in pvp now' and 'mm and bm hunters are good in pvp now' [consensus, [[d:hunter#1485350312440107078]], [[d:hunter#1489572362868359298]]]; but 'if u dont have the BW CD you are a bit of a deadweight as soon as there is a mage/druid smart enough to cc ur pet' [single source, [[d:hunter#1494186537129218099]]].

Deadzone debate (2026-03): remove/reduce it (loss of Counterattack/Wing Clip/DR counterplay [ [[d:hunter#1483805909397274785]] ]) vs 'Dead zone is part of the vanilla hunter' [ [[d:hunter#1483806089668460695]] ]; a feared post-release '5 yards deadzone + Aimed Shot healing reduction' change [ [[d:hunter#1485331067664601261]] ]. Unresolved.

glance.recommendation: For battlegrounds, play **Marksmanship 0/34/17**: MM down to Lock and Load, Survival down to Survivalist, no Barrage. The **Aimed Shot → Arcane Shot** burst hits armored targets for 2,000+. You also keep full damage when your pet is crowd-controlled. **Beast Mastery** is the easy-mode alternative while pets take no PvP dampening. Survival is strong against warriors and rogues, and weak against casters, paladins and warlocks.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level as **Beast Mastery** with a pet that tanks: a boar early, a Screech bird or a Raptor later. Use a slow ranged weapon (2.6+ speed) and spam **Steady Shot** (baseline from level 20) between Auto Shots. If you want to raid as Survival, level BM to **40**, then respec into Survival for in-combat traps. Respecs cost at most 5g on Turtle limbless · 2026-04-14. From level 45 on, the fastest route to 60 is soloing the Dire Maul East lasher rooms. | Spec | Leveling rating | Why | |---|---|---| | **Beast Mastery** | **S** | "BM till 60, then surv" ThriceWoven · 2026-04-03. The pet is a "demigod" that tanks 2–4 mobs limbless · 2026-04-13. "The best pet is 'dude just spec BM and you auto win'" limbless · 2026-04-08 | | Survival | **C before 40, A after 40** | "surv is very good when you can use traps in combat, which comes at lv40. At lv19 BM leveling is much easier" Zwift · 2026-04-03. At 40 "my levelling speed became ridiculously faster" Sofie · 2025-12-31. It is mana hungry and you do the tanking пиздинг · 2025-10-24 | | Marksmanship | **B** | Works, but "you can go MM and endlessly kite if you're very bored" limbless · 2026-04-10. MM needs crits for Lock and Load, so it is weak when fresh Kantrul · 2026-03-23 | **Contested:** Sofie (4 hunters leveled) says the fastest route is MM to 20, then BM talents, then a Survival respec at 40 Sofie · 2026-02-18. Thalenar and Dinousek find pure Survival leveling easier Thalenar · 2026-03-15, Dinousek · 2026-03-11. Hunters level fast either way: 1–60 in "3 days if you're on Tel'abim and know what you're doing" Sofie · 2026-02-18.

sections.heading: Talent order 10 → 60 (Beast Mastery)
sections.markdown: This order ends on a leveling-oriented **41/10/0** build close to Kekkonen's deep BM Kekkonen · 2026-04-01: - **Swift Aspects first.** Five points in an Aspect talent is "always a good start" Rpecial · 2026-02-04. - sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: What to press in each bracket on the recommended **Beast Mastery** path. The **Survival path** starts at 40 (see the last two brackets). Learn levels, cooldowns and cast times come from the 1.18.1 game data. Talent levels follow the order above. Each bracket also covers the pet: taming, its ability bar, and whether it can tank a dungeon. **Rules for every bracket:** - Pull with the pet, not with a shot. Start shooting when the mob is at about 75–80% health Thula Wena · 2026-01-31. - Growl is a threat ability, not a taunt Sofie · 2026-03-22. Keep **Growl on autocast** when solo, and keep **Claw off**, because Claw burns the focus Growl needs Unchallenged/Undying · 2026-02-04, Dixa · 2025-10-03. - At range, you only pull aggro off the pet at 130% of its threat, not 110% lwif · 2026-03-05. "If you are BM and consistently pull aggro from pet, you are doing something wrong" Zwift · 2026-02-05. - Only a BM pet tanks anything useful Itron · 2026-03-14. As Survival, pet tanking has "really no chance after lv20" lwif · 2026-03-14. - **In a group with a real tank:** turn Growl off Kekkonen · 2025-10-15, and send the pet exactly when the tank hits Dresche · 2026-03-21. Do not use Defensive mode, which attacks as soon as anyone in the party gets aggro Bakingsoda · 2026-02-13. ### Levels 1–9 - **New now:** Auto Shot and Raptor Strike (starting abilities). L4 Aspect of the Monkey, Serpent Sting R1. L6 Arcane Shot R1 (6 s cooldown), Hunter's Mark R1. L8 Concussive Shot (12 s cooldown), Raptor Strike R2. No pet yet. - **Single target:** 1. Aspect of the Monkey on (dodge; vanilla baseline). 2. Auto Shot to pull, then Arcane Shot while the mob runs in. 3. Concussive Shot (from 8), and moonwalk (strafe backward) away for 4–5 more shots Leroy · 2026-01-13. 4. In melee: Raptor Strike on cooldown (6 s, off the GCD) plus auto-attack. 5. Skip Serpent Sting on normal mobs; it costs too much mana Zwift · 2026-03-03. - **Multi-target:** do not pull two. Without a pet, you are the tank (vanilla baseline). ### Levels 10–19 - **New now:** L10 class quest chain: Tame Beast, Call Pet, Dismiss Pet, Feed Pet, Revive Pet, Beast Training, pet Growl R1–R2. Also L10 Aspect of the Hawk R1, Aspect of the Wolf R1, Serpent Sting R2. L12 Mend Pet R1 (heals over 5 s), Distracting Shot R1, Wing Clip R1, Arcane Shot R2. L14 Eyes of the Beast, Eagle Eye, Scare Beast R1. L16 Immolation Trap R1, Mongoose Bite R1, Raptor Strike R3. L18 Multi-Shot R1 (100 mana, 10 s cooldown), Aspect of the Hawk R2, Serpent Sting R3. Talents: Swift Aspects (10–14), Endurance Training (15–19). - **Pet milestones:** - Finish the level-10 chain, or you never get Feed Pet limbless · 2026-04-10. - Tame a **boar/pig**: it eats anything and is cheap to keep Vicent · 2026-01-13. Or tame a Screech bird: Amani Eagle (level 10, Stonetalon) or a Westfall Greater Fleshripper (16–17) Valaen · 2026-04-05, Valaen · 2026-04-05. - At loyalty 1, feed every 2–3 kills and carry spare food Demonhun · 2025-12-07. - Pet bar: Growl on autocast, Bite (or the family skill) on, Claw off. - **Single target:** 1. Aspect of the Hawk on. 2. Send the pet. Wait until the mob is at 75–80%. 3. Hunter's Mark only on elites and long fights. 4. Auto Shot, plus Arcane Shot when mana allows. 5. If the mob turns on you: Concussive Shot, then back off and let Growl take it back. In melee: Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite, and Wing Clip to step away. 6. Mend Pet (from 12) when the pet drops low (vanilla baseline). It heals over 5 s; start it early. - **Multi-target (2 mobs):** 1. Only with a boar or Screech pet. Screech holds AoE aggro Krulltak · 2026-01-24. 2. Shoot the pet's target. Do not Multi-Shot: "it basically shortens the fight by 2s on average, but recovering the mana takes longer" Yoh · 2025-11-18. 3. On beasts, Scare Beast the second mob (1.5 s cast; vanilla baseline). 4. Before 30 you have no Feign Death. Do not pull a third. - **Tanking (dungeons):** let a real tank tank Deadmines and Wailing Caverns. The pet has no taunt, and only Endurance Training so far. No source reports pet-tanking a dungeon this low. ### Levels 20–29 - **New now:** L20 **Steady Shot R1** (1 s cast; baseline), **Aspect of the Cheetah**, Disengage R1, Freezing Trap R1, Mend Pet R2, Arcane Shot R3, Distracting Shot R2. Talent: Coordinated Assault (20). L22 Hunter's Mark R2, Scorpid Sting. L24 Raptor Strike R4, Beast Lore. L26 **Rapid Fire** (5 min cooldown), Immolation Trap R2, Serpent Sting R4. L28 Frost Trap, Arcane Shot R4, Aspect of the Hawk R3, Mend Pet R3. Talents: Pathfinding (21–22), Thick Hide (23–25), Unleashed Fury (26–30). Aimed Shot (a Marksmanship talent) is not on this path, and it is "useless" for BM Hakuna · 2026-03-24. - **Pet milestones:** - Train the new Growl rank at 20 from the pet trainer. It is the only skill learned there, every 10 levels Kekkonen · 2025-10-15. - Do not let the pet fall far behind your level Jay · 2025-12-18. - Loyalty rises with time spent happy (green), not with kills. See [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets). - **Single target:** 1. Aspect of the Cheetah between mobs, Aspect of the Hawk before the pull. 2. Send the pet. Wait until the mob is at 75–80%. 3. Auto Shot, then **Steady Shot after each Auto Shot** without clipping. Steady-only leveling "is a big time saver", because you drink less Sofie · 2026-02-25. 4. Arcane Shot: a cheap Coordinated Assault trigger Prime · 2026-02-21, and your shot while moving. 5. Rapid Fire (from 26) on elites and dangerous pulls. 6. Scorpid Sting only to help the pet tank an elite. No Serpent Sting Zwift · 2026-03-03. - **Resource rule:** send the pet on the next mob and drink while it fights [amanagor (player), 2026-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166261#p166261). - **Multi-target (2–3 mobs):** 1. With Thick Hide, the pet holds 2 mobs, and 3 or 4 is "doable sometimes" limbless · 2026-04-13. 2. Keep shooting the pet's primary target. 3. Traps can only be placed out of combat before 40. Lay Freezing Trap (20) or Frost Trap (28) before the pull and bring the add over it (vanilla baseline). - **Tanking (dungeons):** still let the group's tank tank. Growl off, pet in as the tank hits. ### Levels 30–39 - **New now:** L30 **Feign Death** (30 s cooldown), Multi-Shot R2, Steady Shot R2, Mongoose Bite R2, Aspect of the Beast, Distracting Shot R3, Scare Beast R2. L32 Flare, Raptor Strike R5. L34 Explosive Trap R1, Disengage R2, Serpent Sting R5. L36 Arcane Shot R5, Mend Pet R4, Immolation Trap R3, Viper Sting R1. L38 Aspect of the Hawk R4, Wing Clip R2. Talents: Ferocity (31–35), Scent of Blood (36–38), **Bestial Wrath** (39; 18 s, 90 s cooldown, no GCD). - **Pet milestones:** - Pet Dash at pet level 30 Valaen · 2026-04-07. New Growl rank at 30. - At 35–40, swap the boar for an **eagle** for soloing Vicent · 2026-01-13. Hinterlands Eagles already know Screech rank 3; do not reset them Valaen · 2025-10-17. - **Single target:** 1. Same as 20–29. 2. If the mob turns on you while the pet is alive: Feign Death, and the mob goes back to the pet. 3. Bestial Wrath (39) on elites. - **Multi-target (2–4 mobs):** 1. Pet on the first mob; let Growl or Screech collect the rest. 2. Bestial Wrath on the big pulls. 3. Multi-Shot only when mana allows. 4. If a mob sticks to you: Concussive Shot and kite, or Feign Death. - **Tanking (dungeons, pet tank):** possible from here, once Endurance Training and Thick Hide are maxed. A level-32 BM with a Gorilla tanked all of [Dragonmaw Retreat](#/instances/dragonmaw-retreat) with a level-34 healer (single source; "don't know if I'd recommend this") Vic · 2025-09-26. 1. Pet: Screech bird or Gorilla, with Growl on and Claw off. 2. Pull by sending the pet. The party waits until the first target is at 75–80%. 3. The pet has no taunt, so the DPS must watch threat. Aggro they take is "tough to get back" Vellasta · 2025-09-26. 4. Distracting Shot pulls a loose mob off the healer onto you (a taunt; vanilla baseline). Kite it back to the pet so Growl can take it. 5. Keep Mend Pet rolling. Healers rarely heal pets unless asked Darkaco · 2025-12-28. 6. Bad pull: Feign Death to drop your own threat. The pet stays on the mobs. ### Levels 40–49 - **New now:** L40 **Volley R1** (3 s cast, 60 s cooldown), Trueshot Aura, Aspect of the Pack, Steady Shot R3, Hunter's Mark R3, Freezing Trap R2, Raptor Strike R6, Distracting Shot R4. Talent: **Intimidation** (40; 60 s cooldown). L42 Multi-Shot R3, Serpent Sting R6. L43 **Kill Command** (talent; 8 s cooldown, no GCD). L44 Arcane Shot R6, Mend Pet R5, Explosive Trap R2, Mongoose Bite R3. L46 Aspect of the Wild R1, Immolation Trap R4, Viper Sting R2. L48 Aspect of the Hawk R5, Disengage R3, Raptor Strike R7. Talents: Spirit Bond (41–42), Frenzy (44–47), Bestial Precision (48–49). - **Pet milestones:** - New Growl rank at 40. - A **Wolf** if you want to solo dungeons to 60 Vicent · 2026-01-13. - Improved Mend Pet is "useless unless soloing dungeons" (Hakuna) Hakuna · 2026-03-24; **Contested:** Elmgren finds it useful for elite quests too Elmgren · 2026-03-24. - **Single target:** 1. Send the pet, wait until 75–80%, then Hunter's Mark on long fights. 2. **Kill Command** whenever it lights up, only while the pet is in melee range Darkaco · 2026-03-21. 3. Steady Shot after each Auto Shot. 4. Arcane Shot when moving. 5. Bestial Wrath and Rapid Fire on elites. - **Multi-target:** 1. Pet on mob 1. 2. **Intimidation** hands the pet a second mob: "send pet with intimidation on a baddie, and after one growl, send it to another" [Steakhouse (player), 2024-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106303#p106303). 3. Volley only on 3+ mobs that are all on the pet (it costs 210 mana). - **Tanking (dungeons, pet tank):** "infinitely easier in turtle wow vs classic" Morenth · 2025-12-31. 1. **Kill Command + Bite** to tear aggro back. 2. Dash + a move command to kite. 3. Retarget once a mob goes back to the pet. Feign Death, or steal aggro back with the next Kill Command Morenth · 2025-12-31. 4. Intimidation's stun buys time to rebuild threat Vic · 2025-09-26. 5. Maraudon for 40–45 Vicent · 2026-01-13. ### Levels 50–60 - **New now:** L50 Steady Shot R4, Volley R2, Serpent Sting R7, Distracting Shot R5. L52 Arcane Shot R7, Mend Pet R6. L54 Multi-Shot R4, Explosive Trap R3. L56 **Aspect of the Viper**, Immolation Trap R5, Raptor Strike R8, Viper Sting R3. L58 Aspect of the Hawk R6, Hunter's Mark R4, Volley R3, Mongoose Bite R4, Serpent Sting R8. L60 Steady Shot R5, Arcane Shot R8, Mend Pet R7, Freezing Trap R3, Wing Clip R3, Distracting Shot R6. Talents: Improved Revive Pet (50), Efficiency (51–55), Lethal Shots (56–60). - **Pet milestones:** new Growl rank at 50 and 60. At 60, respec, then pick the raid pet for the spec; see [Pets](#/class/hunter/guide/pets). - **Single target:** same as 40–49. Aspect of the Viper arrives at 56, "a bit too late for any convenience" Hakuna · 2026-03-20. Use it only when you are low on mana. - **Multi-target:** same as 40–49. - **Tanking (dungeons, pet tank):** at 60 the hunter guild pet-tanks the LBRS last boss "with one person spamming mend pet on their screecher/scorpid" junabii · 2025-12-31. Geared hunters have tanked BRD, LBRS, Scholomance and Dire Maul Thalenar · 2026-03-15. ### Ranged vs melee (Survival) leveling | Level | Play | Evidence | |---|---|---| | 1–39 | **Ranged BM.** Survival gives almost nothing before in-combat traps: "At lv19 BM leveling is much easier" | Zwift · 2026-04-03 | | 1–50 (optional) | **Melee weave as BM:** rank-1 Raptor Strike when the mob is on you. Higher ranks "a waste of mana" | Morenth · 2026-01-09 | | 1–60 (niche) | **Full melee from level 1.** Thalenar leveled this way, with Growl off and you tanking. He found it "a lot more fun" and takes Planning Ahead early. Sofie, with 3 hunters leveled, disagrees | Thalenar · 2025-12-26, Thalenar · 2025-12-31, Thalenar · 2025-12-31, Sofie · 2025-12-31 | | 40–60 | **Melee Survival** after the respec. Leveling became "ridiculously faster" with Untamed Trapper. You are the tank "90% of the time", and it is mana hungry | Sofie · 2025-12-31, пиздинг · 2025-10-24 | Keep Steady Shot for pulls and for mobs you cannot reach in melee Minces · 2026-01-28. ### Survival path: levels 40–49 - **New now:** respec at 40 (see [Survival path](#/class/hunter/leveling)): - **Untamed Trapper** lets you place traps in combat. - **Carve** (10 s cooldown). Carve Rank 2 has been trainable since 38; buy it right after the respec. - **Lacerate** (10 s cooldown). - **Deterrence** (10 s, 5 min cooldown). Also Raptor Strike R6 (40), Mongoose Bite R3 and Explosive Trap R2 (44), Immolation Trap R4 (46), Raptor Strike R7 (48). Talents: Lightning Reflexes (41–42), Vicious Strikes (43–44), Swift Aspects (45–49). - **Pet:** a Screech pet for AoE threat Andrew · 2025-01-31, or a Wolf for dungeon soloing Vicent · 2026-01-13. It supports; you tank. - **Single target** (one spam macro, as on the [Survival](#/class/hunter/survival-melee-dps) page): 1. Pull with the pet or a Steady Shot, and let the mob come to you. 2. Raptor Strike on cooldown. 3. Immolation Trap on cooldown, but not on a mob that is about to die Youthwars · 2025-12-20. 4. Mongoose Bite. 5. Lacerate, from the side. 6. Carve. 7. Wing Clip as the last filler. - **Multi-target (2–4 mobs):** 1. Explosive Trap. 2. Carve. 3. Raptor Strike, Mongoose Bite, Lacerate. Explosive Trap and Carve together are the AoE core Krulltak · 2025-10-18. For big pulls: "gather all with frost trap down, then kite round the frost trap dropping explosive on CD" Rpecial · 2026-01-22. - **Resource rule:** drink between pulls. Some Survival levelers dip BM for Coordinated Assault and Swift Aspects because mana is tight Bobob · 2026-03-20. - **Defensive:** Deterrence when a pull goes wrong. Feign Death is less reliable in melee range limbless · 2026-04-17. - **Tanking (dungeons):** in groups you are melee DPS. Growl off, and Feign Death early: in melee you pull aggro at 110% of the tank's threat Zugolas · 2024-12-16. ### Survival path: levels 50–60 - **New now:** L54 Explosive Trap R3. L56 Carve R3, Immolation Trap R5, Raptor Strike R8, Aspect of the Viper. L58 Mongoose Bite R4. Talents: Improved Primal Aspects (50–52), Improved Revive Pet (53–54), Coordinated Assault (55), Unleashed Fury (56–60). - **Single and multi-target:** same as 40–49. - **Dire Maul East lashers (from 45):** 1. Place a Frost Trap before the pull. 2. Let the pet take the initial aggro. 3. Explosive Trap and Carve on cooldown, with a healing potion ready Taintedlove · 2024-11-07. 4. Kite the room in a big circle Vellasta · 2026-03-26. It is doable from 45, harder because of the mobs' aggro range Vellasta · 2026-03-26. The standard pet is a Wolf Vicent · 2026-01-13.

sections.heading: Pull and kill loop (bot-ready)
sections.markdown: 1. **Aspect of the Cheetah** between mobs. Hawk (or Monkey for melee) before the pull. 2. **Send the pet**, and let it build threat. Start shooting when the mob is at about 75–80% health Thula Wena · 2026-01-31. 3. **Hunter's Mark** on longer fights; skip it on trash that dies fast. 4. **Auto Shot**, then **Steady Shot** after each auto. Add **Arcane Shot** for Coordinated Assault procs, and while moving. 5. From 43: **Kill Command** when it lights up, but only while the pet is in melee range Darkaco · 2026-03-21. 6. **2+ mobs:** let the pet hold them; Multi-Shot only if mana allows. Screech pets hold AoE threat Krulltak · 2026-01-24. 7. **Losing aggro, or the pet dies:** Feign Death, or Concussive Shot and kite. Moonwalk (strafe backward) to land 4–5 shots before the mob reaches you Leroy · 2026-01-13. With Cheetah you can kite "any elite taking 0 dmg" Hakuna · 2026-03-24. 8. After the kill: loot, feed the pet if it is yellow, drink only when needed. The pet regenerates in about 2 s Stunfisk · 2026-01-27. Survival from 40: Explosive Trap and Carve on packs; Immolation Trap, Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite on single mobs; Aspect of the Monkey Krulltak · 2025-10-18. AoE farming: gather mobs with a Frost Trap, kite in a circle and drop Explosive Trap on cooldown Rpecial · 2026-01-22.

caveats: No Turtle-specific pre-raid or post-raid BiS list exists as a single forum artifact for any Hunter spec; the pre-raid-60 slot list below is reconstructed from one detailed theorycrafting post (Nurincarinun, 2023) that itemizes the gear it uses, corroborated by named items in other threads. gaps: No BM-specific pre-raid gear list (BM players are told to follow the MM pre-raid list plus the pet-damage bundle).
No Survival-specific gear list by phase; only a short list of melee-only items layered onto the ranged lists.
No slot-by-slot PvP BiS list for any Hunter spec (unlike Rogue's dagger/Subtlety PvP list). PvP gear discussion is limited to weapon picks and general racial/consumable notes.

No leveling-10-29 or leveling-30-49 gear lists; leveling.md gives only a few named upgrades scattered from level ~16 to 60 (Hillsbrad quest crossbow, Beastmaster's set at 60, Maraudon ring, AV ring, Rhok'delar).

The exact post citing the 1.18.1 'T3 4-set = +50 AP to hunter and pet' claim was not reidentified during this pass; it is carried over from synthesis/classes/hunter/beast-mastery-ranged-dps.md, which itself gives no inline URL for that specific sentence.

No source states where the Beastmaster's (T0.5) set, Onyxia Tooth Pendant, Shendralar Trinket, Blackhand's Breadth, Huntsman's Harpoon, Revantusk Shadow Hunter's Longbow, Tarnished Elven Ring, item 83233, Rain of Spiders, or Nerubian Slavemaker drop from or are purchased/quested from; all are marked unknown-in-sources pending the server database.
1.18.1's full tier-set text (post-release) is not in the extracted posts beyond the two single-source fragments above (T2 5-set LoS confirmation and the unverified T3 4-set claim).

guidePages.title: Hunter pets
guidePages.intro:
**Recommendation:**

- **Raid DPS:** a **Raptor from Zul'Gurub** (Bite + Savage Rend; the only source of Savage Rend rank 6). Train Claw too, and switch to it on bleed-immune bosses.
- **Molten Core:** a Cat or Wind Serpent, because many MC bosses are immune to bleeds and poison.
- **Long boss fights as BM:** a Scorpid is the alternative (contested).
- **Leveling and dungeon threat:** a **Screech bird** (owl, carrion bird or bat).
- **Melee-group support for Survival:** a Wolf.
- **PvP:** a Spider (root) or a Wind Serpent (burst).

In every case, keep the pet happy (green), train its resistances for the raid tier, and never leave Claw on autocast next to a real special ability.

sections.heading: How to play
sections.markdown: The pet-control loop, for every spec. 1. **Before the pull:** - The pet is green (happy). Feed it right before the pull; a pet that dies usually stays happy Zwift · 2026-04-07. - Its autocast bar is set: [autocast](#/class/hunter/guide/pets). Never leave Claw on next to a real special. 2. **Solo or leveling:** - Growl on autocast. - The pet pulls. Start shooting at 75–80% Thula Wena · 2026-01-31. - Mend Pet when it drops low. - Level-by-level pets and pet tanking: [Leveling: Gameplay by level](#/class/hunter/leveling). 3. **Group with a tank, or a raid:** - Growl off Kekkonen · 2025-10-15. - Send the pet exactly as the tank hits Dresche · 2026-03-21. - Avoid Defensive mode, which attacks whatever hits a party member Bakingsoda · 2026-02-13. - Use Take Position to park the pet out of cleaves and breaths ([positioning](#/class/hunter/guide/pets)). 4. **Pet tanking (BM only):** - Growl on, with a Screech pet, Gorilla or Scorpid. - Pull threat back with Kill Command + Bite, and use Intimidation to buy time Morenth · 2025-12-31, Vic · 2025-09-26. - Keep Mend Pet rolling junabii · 2025-12-31. - The pet has no taunt. Growl is threat only Sofie · 2026-03-22. 5. **The pet dies:** reviving mid-fight is usually not worth it with under ~30 s left Vellasta · 2026-03-13. 6. **Between fights:** - Refeed at yellow. - Do not dismiss with the spell; it halves happiness ([feeding](#/class/hunter/guide/pets)).

sections.heading: Which abilities to autocast
sections.markdown: Pets hold at most 4 active abilities, Growl included Valaen · 2025-11-04. 1. **Raptor:** Bite + Savage Rend on autocast. Train Claw and use it instead on bleed-immune bosses Zwift · 2026-01-19, Gnomarbates · 2026-04-04, Maahes · 2026-04-08. There is not always enough focus for Bite and Rend together; Bite on autocast "sort of works" but can delay Rend limbless · 2026-04-18. 2. **Claw** is "a focus dump and it's obsolete on any pet that's capable of doing damage" limbless · 2026-04-03. If Claw and Bite are both on autocast, the pet only ever casts Claw Sofie · 2025-12-20. On a plain Cat, Bite on cooldown with Claw as filler beat pure Claw, 115 vs 107 DPS limbless · 2026-04-08. 3. **Growl:** off in raids so the pet does not pull Kekkonen · 2025-10-15. It is a threat ability, not a taunt Sofie · 2026-03-22. 4. **Wind Serpent:** cast Lightning Breath manually, not on autocast, so Kill Command crits it Destroses · 2025-12-25, Kaslux · 2025-12-01. 5. Pets sometimes stop using their abilities. Toggle autocast, or press the ability once Darkaco · 2026-04-17.

sections.heading: Attack speed
sections.markdown: - Pet **damage** is normalized; attack **speed** is not Destroses · 2026-01-25. - **PvE with Windfury Totem:** slower is better. Windfury has an internal cooldown, so bigger swings get more from each proc Zwift · 2026-04-04, limbless · 2026-04-16. The difference between a 1.4 and a 2.0 pet is small yaboikeenser · 2026-04-07. - **BM:** faster pets help Frenzy uptime limbless · 2026-04-17. Haste sources on the pet multiply (a 2.0 pet with Frenzy goes to 1.54) Demonhun · 2025-11-09. - **PvP:** faster pets interrupt casts more often Chubby Piglets · 2026-04-17, Rpecial · 2026-04-17.

sections.heading: Taming and teaching abilities
sections.markdown: 1. Complete the level-10 class questline, or you never get Feed Pet limbless · 2026-04-10. 2. To learn a higher rank or a new ability: 1. Stable your pet. 2. Tame a beast that already knows the ability. 3. Use it in combat until you see "You have learned X (Rank N)" Valaen · 2025-10-04, limbless · 2026-04-04. 4. Teach it from Beast Training to any pet that can learn it Holidae · 2026-02-26. Not every beast of a family knows every ability, so you need the *specific* beast Thalenar · 2025-12-09, Sisco the Kid · 2025-10-01. 3. Upgrading a rank costs only the difference in training points limbless · 2026-04-11. 4. Good sources: - Hinterlands Eagles (35–40) know Screech rank 3 (normally level 48). Do not reset them Valaen · 2025-10-17. - Amani Eagles (level 10, Amani'Alor in Stonetalon) and Westfall Greater Fleshrippers (16–17) have early Screech Valaen · 2026-04-05, Valaen · 2026-04-05. - Only ZG raptors teach Savage Rend rank 6 Raggen · 2026-04-17. - Dash needs pet level 30 Valaen · 2026-04-07. 5. Taming ZG raptors: they are immune to Freezing Trap but not to Fear. Isolate one TheRandomControl · 2026-04-04, Kalamity · 2025-12-27. 6. The MC Magmalash scorpid has several fixed spawn points in a cleared MC. Only one is up at a time limbless · 2026-04-16, Playdoe · 2026-04-16. 7. **"Invalid Target" when taming:** check the mob's exact name. The level-10 quest wants "Surf Crawler", not "Pygmy Surf Crawler" TheTiggar · 2025-12-07, Valaen · 2025-12-07. A pfUI self-cast modifier (for example Alt) can also make you target yourself 𝓐𝓼𝓱𝓮𝓻𝓪 · 2026-02-25. 8. Leveling a pet: it gets XP only from kills that give *you* XP (not from quests or PvP) Destroses · 2026-04-10, Kalamity · 2026-04-07. Leveling a pet far below you is a big time sink Jay · 2025-12-18. At 60, room-pulling lashers levels a pet in a few hours yaboikeenser · 2026-04-12.

sections.heading: Training points and loyalty
sections.markdown: - **Training points = (loyalty level − 1) × pet level**, so 300 at loyalty 6 and level 60 Sisco the Kid · 2025-11-11. A fresh tame that already knows abilities starts negative; this corrects itself Valaen · 2026-04-13. - Spend points on stamina, armor and **resistances for your raid tier**: BWL fire and shadow, AQ nature, Naxx frost and shadow Kaslux · 2026-03-24, Kaslux · 2026-03-24. - **Loyalty comes from time spent happy (green).** Loyalty 1 → 2 takes about an hour of green Destroses · 2025-11-15, Destroses · 2026-03-17. Max loyalty takes about 6 hours Krulltak · 2025-10-08. **Contested:** some say the pet must also gain XP. A pet tamed at your own level supposedly gains no loyalty Ehrenboy93 · 2026-01-13, but others found it purely time-based Sisco the Kid · 2026-01-18. - **Display bug:** loyalty keeps rising but does not "ding" until you zone, relog or dismiss and call the pet yaboikeenser · 2025-12-08, Destroses · 2026-03-17. - Stabled pets lose nothing Sisco the Kid · 2026-03-09. Stable slots: 4 in-game (the 4th costs 250g), the 5th only via a donation glyph Thalenar · 2026-04-07.

sections.heading: Feeding and happiness
sections.markdown: - Food level is what matters. Keep food within about 10 levels of the pet Sisco the Kid · 2026-02-18, Psyker · 2025-12-04. Good food gives +35 happiness per tick; check the combat log Boomsky · 2026-02-23, limbless · 2026-04-14. Level 45 vendor food (Roasted Quail) is fine for a level-60 pet Destroses · 2026-01-27. - Feeding is a heal-over-time for happiness. Feed one item, wait for it to finish, and refeed once happiness drops to yellow Nine · 2025-10-05. - At loyalty 1 a pet needs feeding every 2–3 kills Demonhun · 2025-12-07; at loyalty 6, about once an hour Krulltak · 2025-10-08. A neglected new pet can abandon you Hotdiggity · 2025-12-02. - Dismissing with the spell halves happiness pillow · 2026-04-07. Leave the pet on Stay and walk away instead [Amyloriley (player), 2025-04-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126672#p126672). - Feed right before a pull: a pet that dies usually stays happy Zwift · 2026-04-07. - Macros: - Feed from the first backpack slot: `/run CastSpellByName("Feed Pet") PickupContainerItem(0,1)` Sofie · 2026-01-14. - All-in-one: `/run local c=CastSpellByName if UnitExists("pet") then if UnitHealth("pet")==0 then c("Revive Pet") elseif GetPetHappiness()~=nil and GetPetHappiness()~=3 then c("Feed Pet") PickupContainerItem(0, 1) else c("Dismiss Pet") end else c("Call Pet") end` Dopemania · 2026-01-14.

sections.heading: Scaling and threat
sections.markdown: - Pets get no baseline scaling from you. **Spirit Bond** (BM) converts your RAP into pet AP and pet spell power limbless · 2026-04-09. Pet spell power comes only from Spirit Bond, never from your spell-power gear Itron · 2026-04-09, Valaen · 2025-11-14. - Pet crit is capped around 20% Kaslux · 2026-04-10. About 17 Agility on you gives the pet 1% crit Darkaco · 2026-02-13. - Pet share of damage: ~11% for MM without Coordinated Assault Bobob · 2026-03-20; 10–15% for Survival Rpecial · 2026-03-01; about half for BM Santa Bear · 2026-03-25. - **Threat:** a pet "will never hold threat against any player" in a raid Sofie · 2026-03-14. Only a BM pet tanks anything useful Itron · 2026-03-14. No talent lowers pet threat limbless · 2026-04-07. While leveling as BM, the pet can tank 2–4 mobs limbless · 2026-04-13. - Out of combat, pets regenerate to full in about 2 s Stunfisk · 2026-01-27.

sections.heading: Positioning in raids
sections.markdown: - **Take Position** moves the pet to a spot; use it to hide the pet behind Sapphiron's ice block yaboikeenser · 2026-03-20. Command Pet can get stuck at walking speed; set Follow, then command again Oxy · 2025-12-26, Destroses · 2025-12-26. - Pets on Passive sometimes still follow the tank in Kruzifixxion · 2026-03-26. Defensive stance attacks whatever hits anyone in your party, which can pull the boss off the tank's positioning Bakingsoda · 2026-02-13, teenkr · 2026-02-13. - Healers rarely heal pets unless asked Darkaco · 2025-12-28. - Per-boss notes: see [Beast Mastery](#/class/hunter/beast-mastery-ranged-dps).

guidePages.title: Hunter professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** take **Engineering + Mining** and keep it. Hunters call Engineering the best-in-slot profession: it makes the new +2% crit scope, Enchanted Thorium Shells, sappers and a bag of gadgets, and Mining feeds it and pays for your consumables SliceOfBerry · 2026-03-25, Lilyth · 2026-03-26, IT Mckee · 2026-04-16. At 60 some hunters drop Mining for **Herbalism** to farm their own consumable mats DoctorNo · 2026-04-15. For pure gold, **Herbalism + Alchemy** is "BiS for making gold" Sofie · 2026-02-16. **Skinning/Leatherworking** fit the class fantasy but are weak at 60 SliceOfBerry · 2026-03-25, SliceOfBerry · 2026-04-14. Learn the reworked **Survival** secondary profession for your own arrows.

sections.heading: Best pairs by goal
sections.markdown: | Goal | Pair | Why | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Leveling** | Mining + Engineering, or Mining + Skinning | Mining is the best early gold (copper sold at 1.5g+ a stack), and the hunter's permanent run-speed aspect suits gathering. Engineering gadgets are fun while leveling | Zugolas · 2025-05-04, IT Mckee · 2026-04-16 | | Leveling (alt) | Herbalism or Skinning + Engineering, plus Survival for ammo | Survival now crafts ammo, so you can drop Mining while leveling and keep Engineering | Ushtik · 2026-04-16 | | Leveling (bags) | Tailoring + Skinning early | Make your own 20-slot bags, then switch to a "real" profession | Chubby Piglets · 2026-04-16 (single source) | | **Raiding, Marksmanship / Beast Mastery** | Engineering + Mining (or Herbalism at 60) | +2% crit scope, Enchanted Thorium Shells, gadgets; Mining funds the consumable stockpile | SliceOfBerry · 2026-03-25, Lilyth · 2026-03-26, DoctorNo · 2026-04-15 | | **Raiding, Survival (melee)** | Engineering + Mining | Goblin Sapper Charges are good for Survival; Mining pays off on the ZG solo farm (rich thorium) | Dabcart(rip ambershire) · 2026-04-04, Rangtuk · 2026-04-14, Raggen · 2026-01-07 | | Raiding (alt) | Engineering + Blacksmithing | One regular calls it the best pair because sharpening stones are "so expensive" (single source) | Thalenar · 2025-11-03, Thalenar · 2025-11-03 | | **PvP** | Engineering + Mining | Parachute cloak, Jumper Cables XL, teleporters and trinkets; Mining + Engineering gives "a bit of PvP orientation" | Lundy · 2024-12-23, Dresche · 2025-08-18 | | **Gold-making** | Herbalism + Alchemy; or Mining + Skinning | Alchemy is the gold profession. On an old server (Nordanaar) herb/alch is crowded, and plain gathering (Mining/Skinning) is an alternative because the crafting markets are saturated | Sofie · 2026-02-16, Dresche · 2025-10-06, Dresche · 2025-10-06 | | Gold (dungeon farming) | Engineering + Enchanting | Engineering opens the Dire Maul Tribute door solo; Enchanting disenchants the loot | Elmgren · 2026-01-29, Elmgren · 2025-12-05 |

sections.heading: What each profession gives a hunter
sections.markdown: ### Engineering (the hunter profession) - **Facetted Crystal Scope** (+2% ranged crit, permanent). The schematic comes from the **Draenei Exiles** quartermaster at **Revered** (Moonwhisper Coast, new in 1.18.1) Itron · 2026-03-20, yaboikeenser · 2026-03-21. It takes arcanite mechanisms and about 10 Enchanted Thorium Anomaly · 2026-03-20, and the AH ran out of mats at launch Dresche · 2026-03-21. Players tested +1.9% and +2.5% crit over 1,000 shots Sofie · 2026-03-23, Focus · 2026-03-24. At first it did not show on the weapon or character sheet. BetterCharacterStats was updated on 2026-03-27 to show it Valkory · 2026-03-27. It replaces the old +7 damage scope for all ranged specs Anomaly · 2026-03-20. Engineers sell the craft for mats plus a tip Valkory · 2026-03-22. **Contested:** one player still saw no crit gain on 2026-04-11 Silhouette · 2026-04-11. The older **+3% hit scope** is called "legit garbage", because ranged hunters reach the hit cap easily from gear Itron · 2026-03-25, Faustmeyer · 2026-03-25. See [Marksmanship enchants](#/class/hunter/marksmanship-ranged-dps). - **Enchanted Thorium Shells** (new 1.18.1 gun ammo) Anth · 2026-03-23. Staff name **Cannon Master Willey** as the schematic's source ([Torta (staff), 2026-04-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174367#p174367)). In the hunter channel players were still asking where it drops weeks after release bisman · 2026-04-15. Craftable ammo sits between Thorium and Doomshot; Doomshot is still BiS Meta · 2026-03-24, Hakuna · 2026-03-21. - **Converting ammo:** make bullets with Engineering, then trade them for arrows at the Ironforge inn Sofie · 2025-12-12. On Horde, a Tauren NPC in Orgrimmar who walks between the hunter trainer and the anvil does the same trade for Thorium Shells Raggen · 2025-12-12. - **Gadgets:** parachute cloak, Jumper Cables XL, teleporters, target dummies, a repair bot, trinkets, and a Turtle-added epic goggle "especially strong for hunters" Lundy · 2024-12-23. The Orgrimmar/Stormwind **Portable Wormhole Generators** let you set your hearthstone somewhere else Zugolas · 2025-05-04. - **Sappers:** good for Survival Dabcart(rip ambershire) · 2026-04-04. **Contested** for ranged: one player "tried sappers once, ended gimping my parse" Hakuna · 2026-03-26. - **Dire Maul Tribute:** you must be an engineer yourself to blow the locked door when soloing Elmgren · 2025-11-20. - **Gnomish vs Goblin:** take Gnomish first to build the gadgets, then Goblin for sappers in endgame raiding. Switching loses the Gnomish-only Gadgetstan teleport (pre-1.18.1, single source) bgnome · 2024-12-12. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) **Take Survival on every hunter.** It is free, it has no profession slot cost, and since 1.18.1 it crafts hunter ammo. **The 1.18.1 rework** (release 2026-03-20). Survival now draws from the other professions, has 80+ new recipes, tools that slow, root or trap, gathering bags and fish/meat containers, and Woodcutting ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). What hunters found: - **Arrows:** Bright Wood, Shade Wood, Smooth Ironfeather and **Starfeather** arrows Meta · 2026-03-24. The easy tier is about **17.5 DPS** Hakuna · 2026-03-20. One raider uses Doomshot on progression, Starfeather where it fits, and the 17.5 arrows on farm content because "I won't have to ask people to make them for me" Raggen · 2026-03-25. - **Starfeather Arrows** need Star Wood (Winterspring) and Ironfeathers (moonkin) Bakingsoda · 2026-03-24, plus Enchanted Thorium Kantrul · 2026-04-02. The recipe is a ~6% drop Manaci · 2026-04-02. Players say they cost too much work: "Doomshots are now cheaper than starfeathered" Sendorin · 2026-04-08, Chubby Piglets · 2026-04-08. - **Woodcutting:** trees work like herb nodes, and some need higher Survival skill to cut nabu · 2026-03-21. The Horde trainer is in Orgrimmar near the fishing trainer Oak · 2026-03-21. The skill-by-skill route and tree zones are in [the professions overview](#/professions). - **Skinners** can make a BoP +10 Skinning dagger Manaci · 2026-03-20. A forum player called the Survivalist Skinning Knife useless, because skinning still needs a skinning knife ([Dexday (player), 2026-03-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172785#p172785)). **Contested.** - Survival also makes a **parachute cloak**. It is unclear whether it shares a cooldown with the Engineering one Raggen · 2026-03-27, Raggen · 2026-03-27. - One player verdict: "Tents are ass the rest is solid to use" Chubby Piglets · 2026-04-09 (single source). - Tents were nerfed in 1.18.1 to 25% rested ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). A guild tabard at an inn is said to give rested faster Dinousek · 2026-03-04 (single source). **Before 1.18.1** Survival was a 150-cap skill of torches, campfires, tents and fishing boats with no hunter-specific value. The rework wiped old progression and the Gardening quest ([professions overview](#/professions)). **Gardening:** the hunter channel only mentions it in passing. Gardening foods are "playing nice" ding · 2026-04-01, and Sandswept Carrots are a Gardening crop Destroses · 2026-03-28. There is no hunter-specific case for it. **Not covered by the hunter channel:** Slowing Bolas, Throwable Nets, the gathering trinkets and the Black Lotus sickle. They are Survival crafts ([professions overview](#/professions)), but no hunter reports using them. ### Mining - Mining is the standard partner for Engineering. You get your own Thorium and Arcanite for shells and the scope, and you mine as you farm Lilyth · 2026-03-26. On the ZG solo farm you can mine rich thorium; one Survival hunter reportedly made 5,000g+ in about three weeks this way Raggen · 2026-01-07 (single source). Hateforge Quarry has two guaranteed thorium veins on a ~1.5-minute reset Hakuna · 2026-03-21. ### Herbalism + Alchemy - Alchemy is "BiS for making gold" Sofie · 2026-02-16. Making your own consumables is "very nice" but not a must-have Rangtuk · 2026-04-14. Hunters can only run one tracking spell at a time. Mark nodes with pfQuest and use SuperWoW so the nodes blink Dresche · 2025-10-06. DME lasher farming yields Dreamfoil and Gromsblood, with a chance at Black Lotus DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-05-06. ### Skinning + Leatherworking (skip for raiding) - None of the three LW specialisations suit hunters. Tribal gives no Agility AVRPearn · 2025-11-11, AVRPearn · 2025-11-23. The Devilsaur set is decent pre-raid, but Molten Core replaces it Demonhun · 2025-11-11. - At 60, LW is mostly the Salt Shaker cooldown and crafting Devilsaur or Hide of the Wild for others Holidae · 2026-02-17. Late game it is "really only good for crafting resist gear" SliceOfBerry · 2026-03-25. Players call it "a dead profession" once leveling is done SliceOfBerry · 2026-04-14. - Cured Rugged Hide is a Leatherworking cooldown, not a Skinning one ravela · 2025-10-06. - Skinning on the ZG farm is low value: about 3g for two minutes of skinning panthers Itron · 2026-03-18. - Staff announced in February 2026 that crafting professions would be made more useful Elmgren · 2026-02-17. The 1.18.1 crafted-item upgrade drops (so far only in BWL) may change this later limbless · 2026-04-09. ### Jewelcrafting - Suggested as Jewelcrafting + Mining, an alternative to Engineering + Mining Modwolf · 2026-01-10. Goldsmithing or Gemology both work; look for BoP patterns you want Modwolf · 2026-01-10. - **No profession-locked BiS exists.** No Goldsmith item is on a BiS list, and anyone can apply the gems Rangtuk · 2026-04-14. There are no TBC-style profession-only enchants or gems Rangtuk · 2026-04-14. It is a flavour or gold pick, not a DPS one. ### Enchanting - Optional. It is useful for disenchanting dungeon-farm loot, even at skill 1 Elmgren · 2025-12-05. An enchanter can add **+3 DPS to any 200 ammo** for 1 Large Brilliant Shard + 5 Arcane Dust Kichimaru · 2026-03-22 (single source; the same poster was joking in the message before, so verify in game). Other advice says skip it and park a low-level disenchanting bank alt in a capital instead Dresche · 2025-08-18.

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **Level 1-60:** Mining + Engineering (gadgets while leveling) or Mining + Skinning for gold IT Mckee · 2026-04-16, Zugolas · 2025-05-04. Learn **Survival** early; Apprentice is available at level 1 again after a 1.18.1 hotfix ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608)). 2. **Optional early detour:** Tailoring + Skinning for bags, then switch Chubby Piglets · 2026-04-16. 3. **By 60:** Engineering in one slot Ushtik · 2026-04-16. Get the Draenei Exiles to Revered for the scope; one player reported about 3-4 hours / ~1,000 kills to Revered Zlutus · 2026-03-21. 4. **At 60:** keep Mining for thorium/shells and ZG farming, or swap it for Herbalism to farm consumable mats DoctorNo · 2026-04-15. Skill thresholds for the scope and shells are not stated in the hunter sources.

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: The hunter channel ties no hunter-specific profession bonus to a race. For racials, see [Races and racials](#/class/hunter). Staff made the Goblin racial **Prospecting** grant both Mining and Jewelcrafting skill ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102965#p102965)).

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Farms beat professions** for most hunters. The ZG pyramid/panther kite farm (bijous, coins) is the most efficient once mastered Meta · 2026-03-18. DME lashers are the starter farm from about level 45 Vellasta · 2026-02-10. DM Tribute (needs Engineering) averages about 20g of vendor loot a run Ambroz · 2025-11-19. Maraudon averages about 50g an hour junabii · 2026-02-01. - **Contested:** "Proffs are a scam… no proff makes as much as farming mara" junabii · 2026-02-01 vs "My profession is making me about 100g a day" Rpecial · 2026-02-01. - **Ammo is a hunter tax.** Thorium arrow/shell prices doubled in late 2025 nabu · 2025-12-17. Doomshot can be soloed and sells for about 10g a stack Sofie · 2026-03-27. Survival arrows did not bring prices down on Tel'Abim junabii · 2026-04-08. Making your own shells (Engineering) or arrows (Survival) is the main profession saving. - Silithid Carapace Fragments in Silithus were called the best gold on Ambershire Itron · 2026-04-09.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown: - Where the Enchanted Thorium Shells schematic drops: the staff answer (Cannon Master Willey) is not confirmed by players in the hunter channel. The shells' exact DPS is not stated either. - Skill levels and full reagents for the scope, the shells and the Survival arrows; the Survival skill needed for each arrow tier. - Whether the scope's crit applies to melee (asked, not answered) Rangtuk · 2026-03-26. - What the Survival crowd-control tools (bolas, nets) are worth to a hunter. - Whether the Survival and Engineering parachute cloaks share a cooldown. See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/hunter)

name: Rogue
summary: **Recommendation:** level as **Assassination** (Envenom at 30, Noxious Assault at 40) with the fastest daggers you can find. Raid as **Combat Envenom (24/27/0)**, the Combat/Assassination hybrid that uses Backstab (daggers) or Sinister Strike (swords) to build combo points and Envenom instead of Rupture. It is the best PvE spec from pre-raid gear through Kara40 in the community sim. A raid can also use one **Subtlety** rogue for Improved Expose Armor, Hemorrhage and Mark for Death. Keep a second set of poisoned weapons in your bags: since 1.18.1, Dissolvent and Corrosive Poison only work on some creature types.

overview:
**Recommendation:** level as **Assassination** (Envenom at 30, Noxious Assault at 40) with the fastest daggers you can find. Raid as **Combat Envenom (24/27/0)**, the Combat/Assassination hybrid that uses Backstab (daggers) or Sinister Strike (swords) to build combo points and Envenom instead of Rupture. It is the best PvE spec from pre-raid gear through Kara40 in the community sim. A raid can also use one **Subtlety** rogue for Improved Expose Armor, Hemorrhage and Mark for Death. Keep a second set of poisoned weapons in your bags: since 1.18.1, Dissolvent and Corrosive Poison only work on some creature types.

Turtle WoW reworked all three rogue trees in Class Changes 2 (November 2024) and again in 1.18.0 (Noxious Assault, Dissolvent Poison, a toggled Blade Flurry, Blade Rush). 1.18.1 then nerfed the poison build. Vanilla guides, and most guides written before 2026-03-20, are out of date.

readme.heading: Roles
readme.markdown: - **Melee DPS** (all three trees). Combat Envenom is the current default; deep Assassination is for leveling, fresh 60s and solo play; Combat with Adrenaline Rush is a short-fight alternative Nandieb · 2026-03-26, GumGuzz · 2026-04-10, Nandieb · 2026-03-29, Rheinwg · 2026-04-07. - **Raid support** (Subtlety): Improved Expose Armor and Hemorrhage are raid-wide target debuffs; Mark for Death and Tricks of the Trade buff your party Nuian · 2026-03-29. One Sub rogue per raid is the norm Lhian · 2025-01-22. - **Utility:** Kick, Distract, Sap, Blind, stuns on trash, Vanish for threat resets and trinket swaps, lockpicking. - **Tank (niche):** an avoidance "rogue tank" can hold many bosses up to Naxx, but it has no taunt and weak AoE threat. See [Rogue tank](#/class/rogue/combat-tank). - **Healer / ranged:** none.

readme.heading: What changed in 1.18.1
readme.markdown: The balance pass was posted on 2026-01-23 and revised on 2026-03-19; 1.18.1 went live on 2026-03-20 [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **Corrosive and Dissolvent Poison now only apply to Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead** Mildine · 2026-03-20. Instant and Deadly Poison work on everything except nature-immune targets. You now swap poisons (or whole weapon sets) between packs. The community rated this far worse than the damage nerfs Kyrsie · 2026-03-26, Rheinwg · 2026-03-28. Players are Humanoid, so the physical poisons are gone from PvP Rumpledstillskin · 2026-03-30. - **Taste for Blood** became a 2-point talent (1/1.5/2% physical damage) and **no longer boosts Corrosive or Dissolvent** Cladrius · 2026-03-19, Rheinwg · 2026-04-05. **Noxious Assault** Attack Power scaling went from 35% to 30% Nuian · 2026-01-23. - **Opportunity** 4-20% → 3-15% (aimed at Combat daggers) riku · 2026-01-24. **Blade Flurry's** energy-regen penalty dropped from 30% to 20% [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - The **low ranks** of Deadly, Instant, Corrosive and Dissolvent lost AP scaling (leveling and pre-AQ20 raiding); max ranks were untouched [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Rheinwg · 2026-01-25. - **Ornate Bloodstone Dagger** no longer procs from non-physical, no-cast effects, which ended the OBD/spellstrike build ShotQuality · 2026-02-15. **Fang of Venoxis** and **Dragonfang Blade** were buffed Badknees · 2026-03-12, Rheinwg · 2026-02-16. - **Net effect:** Assassination lost roughly 10% and Combat Envenom about 5% of damage, which put Combat Envenom about 5% ahead Nandieb · 2026-03-23. The new sim rule of thumb is to **never run Rupture and Taste for Blood in an Envenom build** Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-31. - **Hotfixes:** Deadly Poison did double damage for 2-3 days after launch, then was fixed Rheinwg · 2026-03-29, [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139). The Blade Flurry buff-cap bug was fixed in April Rheinwg · 2026-04-18. - **New:** the **Fortune** stat (proc chance on items; capes, necks and trinkets only) GumGuzz · 2026-02-21, and a rogue class-weapon questline (a matched pair of one-handed swords) starting in Timbermaw Hold Rhaena · 2026-02-15, Ionnatra · 2026-03-20, Nandieb · 2026-04-08. Steps and a known bug: [Professions → Class-weapon questline](#/class/rogue/professions). Before 1.18.1, guides told you to run double Dissolvent everywhere, keep a 5-point Rupture up for Taste for Blood, and use the OBD as your main hand. None of that applies now.

readme.heading: Professions
readme.markdown: - **Leveling:** Skinning + Leatherworking on a first character (self-made leather gear); switch at 60 to whatever you need Epickalen · 2026-03-28. - **Raiding:** Engineering is the only profession that adds to your character's power (Goblin Sapper Charges, Gnomish Battle Chicken) Rheinwg · 2026-01-10. Level Gnomish first for the Chicken, then switch to Goblin for sappers Farban · 2025-12-24. **Contested:** one veteran calls it "very overrated" for rogues GumGuzz · 2026-03-25. - **Gold:** naked ZG mining is repeatedly called the easiest rogue farm Searinoxx · 2026-04-03. Disenchanting dungeon drops also works Blindtongue · 2025-11-19, and so does soloing the Hateforge Quarry and LBRS last bosses for Fashion Coins (~40-60 g/h) Allie :3 · 2026-04-03, ohcheese · 2026-04-17. "Anything yielding 40g+/hour is a decent farm" Nandieb · 2026-02-27. - **Poisons** are their own rogue-only skill, and Alchemy does not help with them Rheinwg · 2026-03-28. **Lockpicking** is needed for the class quest chains and pays through box opening. Full guide: [Professions](#/class/rogue/professions) Shared pages: [Professions overview](#/professions) · [PvP systems](#/pvp) (honor, battlegrounds, Warmode) · [Game mechanics](#/mechanics) (buff and consumable stacking, enchant sources) · [Client setup](#/client-setup) (launcher, SuperWoW, addons). playbooks.title: Rogue tank (niche)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** treat rogue tanking as a **dungeon and off-tank** tool, not a main-tank role. An avoidance rogue can reach 95-97% avoidance and hold many bosses up to Naxx. It has no taunt, weak AoE threat, and its only threat tool (**Agitating Poison**) is Nature damage, so it fails on nature-immune bosses. Play the **33/18/0 poison-avoidance** build. Stack Agility, dodge, parry, Defense and Stamina. Chain Ghostly Strike → Flourish → Evasion to stay unhittable. | | | |---|---| | Role | Off-tank / backup tank; dungeon tank; solo boss farming | | Viability (1.18.1) | **C (raid), B (dungeon).** "I do it in raid content up thru naxx but yea threat will always be an issue" Scruff · 2026-01-12. "Mainly dungeon, but some mad lads do limited raid tanking" Epickalen · 2026-02-13 | | Strengths | Near-total physical avoidance in windows; good sustained single-target threat with Noxious Assault or Thunderfury plus Corrosive Epickalen · 2026-01-17, Epickalen · 2026-01-17 | | Weaknesses | No taunt, so no taunt swaps Nettlefield · 2026-02-17; Agitating Poison is Nature and many bosses are immune Nettlefield · 2026-02-17; squishy vs spellcasting bosses and big pulls Nettlefield · 2026-02-11 | **Contested:** Heffey calls it "functionally a non starter in a raid environment" Heffey · 2026-01-01. stats.markdown: - **Priorities:** Stamina (to survive spells), dodge and parry over crit; Agility and Defense enchants on cloak, legs and head; Defense on neck and trinkets Nettlefield · 2026-02-11, Nettlefield · 2026-02-11. - **Conversions:** about 9 Defense or about 14.5 Agility = 1% avoidance Scruff · 2025-11-05. - **Target:** 86.8% passive avoidance against bosses, as shown in BetterCharacterStats' "Defenses vs Bosses" tab, fully buffed Suade · 2026-04-17. Kara40-level gear reaches about 95-97% GumGuzz · 2026-01-17, Premium (Retired) · 2026-01-24. Expect about 7200 HP in a K40-level tank set with consumables Nettlefield · 2026-02-16. - **Pieces:** Kings Edict, an Agility throwing weapon, a hit + haste bracer, T3.5 Agility pieces Nettlefield · 2026-02-16; Hand Wraps of Deadwind and Mephistroth's Cunning Scruff · 2026-02-16; T2.5 for its Agility Nettlefield · 2026-02-16. Upgrades in order: Windwalker or TMH boots over Bloodfang boots Suade · 2026-04-17, Deadwind Wraps Scruff · 2026-04-17, Dagger of Veiled Shadows Suade · 2026-04-17, Fist of the Flamewalker as pre-TMH off hand Scruff · 2026-04-17. - **Weapon skill:** an Assassination tank reaches 315 with Thunderfury + Anasterian's Legacy + AQ40 hands Nettlefield · 2026-02-16. **Contested:** Scruff would rather sit at 308 skill ("I just rock the 308 dagger skill and call it a day in tank spec") than give up Agility for weapon-skill gear Scruff · 2026-02-16.

rotationSingle.heading: Rotation (avoidance chain)
rotationSingle.markdown: 1. **Threat:** Noxious Assault spam with Agitating Poison (or Corrosive on valid targets); Envenom for poison threat Epickalen · 2026-01-17, Nettlefield · 2025-03-04. 2. **Avoidance chain:** Ghostly Strike → Flourish → Ghostly Strike → Evasion → Ghostly Strike → Flourish → Ghostly Strike. Flourish is then on cooldown for about 10 s and you can be hit (and crit) Nettlefield · 2026-02-11, Nettlefield · 2026-02-11. Weaving Juju Escape lets a K40-geared tank "dodge forever" Premium (Retired) · 2026-01-24. 3. **Riposte** whenever it is up. 4. **Multiple mobs:** there is no AoE threat tool. Cleave with Blade Flurry and swap targets to spread threat Nettlefield · 2026-03-05. Sap one and Blind one on 4-mob packs Ionnatra · 2026-02-11. 5. **Tank swaps:** you can't taunt, but you can lower your own threat (Feint, Vanish) so the other tank takes over Nettlefield · 2026-02-17. Mark for Death also helps a tank rogue: about 20% of your AP as party AP and 18% as spell power Scruff · 2026-04-17, and Shadow of Death turns the party's damage into a burst of threat for the tank Suade · 2026-04-17, Scruff · 2026-04-17.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Signing up as the main tank for taunt-swap or nature-immune bosses. - Wearing a DPS set: "you are geared as DPS and your spec is DPS" Nettlefield · 2026-02-11. - Letting Flourish and Ghostly Strike drop at the same time; that is when you get crit Nettlefield · 2026-02-11.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The loop for the **33/18/0 poison-avoidance tank**. It is a dungeon and off-tank role; you have **no taunt**. Details: [Rotation (avoidance chain)](#/class/rogue/combat-tank), [Where it works](#/class/rogue/combat-tank). 1. **Pull:** coat your weapons with **Agitating Poison**, or Corrosive on valid targets Epickalen · 2026-01-17. Pull before the DPS start, because you cannot taunt a mob back. 2. **First GCDs:** **Ghostly Strike → 1-point Flourish**, then the normal threat rotation Allie :3 · 2026-04-03. On a pack, turn **Blade Flurry** on with Ghostly Strike RUTHINAS · 2024-12-06. 3. **Steady threat loop:** **Noxious Assault** spam with Agitating Poison, and **Envenom** at 1 point for poison threat Nettlefield · 2025-03-04. **Riposte** whenever it is up. 4. **Avoidance chain (keep it rolling):** Ghostly Strike → Flourish → Ghostly Strike → **Evasion** → Ghostly Strike → Flourish → Ghostly Strike Nettlefield · 2026-02-11. Juju Escape extends it Premium (Retired) · 2026-01-24. 5. **Multiple mobs:** there is no AoE threat tool. Cleave with Blade Flurry and swap targets to spread threat Nettlefield · 2026-03-05. On 4-mob packs, **Sap** one and **Blind** one Ionnatra · 2026-02-11. 6. **Threat recovery and swaps:** you can't taunt. Hand a boss over by lowering your own threat with Feint or Vanish Nettlefield · 2026-02-17. In a group with a Subtlety rogue tank, Mark for Death → Shadow of Death is a threat burst Suade · 2026-04-17. 7. **Defensive rules:** never let Flourish and Ghostly Strike run out at the same time; that is when you get crit Nettlefield · 2026-02-11. Save Evasion for that gap. Stamina covers the spell damage you cannot dodge. 8. **Avoid:** nature-immune bosses (Agitating Poison does nothing to them), taunt-swap fights, heavy spellcasters and big trash pulls Nettlefield · 2026-02-17, Nettlefield · 2026-02-11.

extraSections.heading: Where it works
extraSections.markdown: - **Dungeons:** the main use Epickalen · 2026-02-13. Raid-geared rogue tanks solo many dungeon bosses (BRD torches, golem and Emperor room, the LBRS last boss) GumGuzz · 2026-02-11, ohcheese · 2026-04-17. - **Raids:** backup-tanked Four Horsemen and BWL dragonkin after the main tank died Badknees · 2026-02-13. Instructor Razuvious without mind control Epickalen · 2026-02-13. Off-tank through Naxx Scruff · 2026-01-12. - **Not:** nature-immune bosses (no Agitating Poison threat), taunt-swap fights, heavy spellcasters, large trash pulls Nettlefield · 2026-02-17, Nettlefield · 2026-02-11.

extraSections.heading: Solo farming setup (tank-style)
extraSections.markdown: pxstxll's solo farming kit (a pull of 2 mechanical and 3 humanoid enemies): 16 points in Combat (dodge, parry, hit, Riposte), the rest in Assassination up to Noxious Assault without Taste for Blood. Gear: 6-piece Darkmantle, Aged Core Leather Gloves, Clutch of Hivaxxis, 2× Twilight Opal Cascade, vampirism enchants on rings and neck. Weapons: Ripper/Distracting Dagger with Instant, and Fang of Venoxis/a second Distracting Dagger with Dissolvent in the bags pxstxll · 2026-04-07, pxstxll · 2026-04-07. Manage Evasion, Flourish and Ghostly Strike on cooldown, and keep health pots and a Stamina Zanza flask on hand pxstxll · 2026-04-07.

standing.source_quality: medium-weak: staff history well documented, one long-time practitioner, no build or numbers after Class Changes 2
standing.notes: A real Turtle mechanic (75%+ avoidance with Flourish, Riposte disarms, Agitating Poison for threat) that staff have curbed since 2021 and say will never be 'true tanking'. Threat is a Nature poison, so poison-immune mobs cannot be tanked. Every posted build predates CC2, which removed Setup, Sleight of Hand and Endurance.

patch_validity.notes: Every build/gear list predates Class Changes 2 (2024-10-12), which removed Setup from Subtlety, removed Sleight of Hand and Endurance, and reshuffled Combat -- no post-CC2 tank build exists in the corpus. Nothing in 1.18.0/1.18.1 directly changed Flourish or Agitating Poison except charge-count fixes (2026-03-03). Status as of the 1.18.1 era is a small, contested niche kept alive by a handful of players; staff has repeatedly signalled this is not an intended tank role. Discord post-1.18.1 keeps the Assa-for-threat / Combat-for-avoidance split and says avoidance is no longer the bottleneck (poison immunity is) [[d:rogue#1460907162426671238]].

resource_rules: Threat comes from Agitating Poison procs (Nature damage + threat) and auto-attack/Sinister Strike weapon damage, not from a dedicated threat multiplier
Engineering grenades and target dummies fill area-threat gaps but drop the rogue's dodge/parry chance to 0% during the cast
No taunt and no on-demand threat cooldown exists for this build

Armor and stamina flasks/elixirs
Engineering grenades and target dummies

Casting a grenade while being hit (avoidance drops to 0% for the cast duration)
Relying on Flourish being up constantly (40-second cooldown)
Assuming the April Fools 'baseline +50% threat' patch note was real
Volunteering for tank-swap fights or crowd-tanking packs (single-target combo points make this unviable)
Assuming avoidance is the problem: post-1.18.1 Discord calls poison immunity the real bottleneck [and avoidance no longer is] [[d:rogue#1460907162426671238]]

yaml.stat_priority_note: The practitioners' order: avoidance first — the claim is that a geared rogue tank passes the 102% avoidance requirement to avoid crushing blows — then stamina, then the threat stats (hit, agility, and weapon skill for poison procs), then resistances for caster bosses. The avoidance numbers are player theorycraft from 2022–2023 and predate 1.17.0's Flourish. No cited post ranks dodge, parry and defense against each other, nor hit, agility and weapon skill against each other, so the order within each of those runs above carries no ranking. Grouping them as avoidance and as threat stats is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.

glance.recommendation: Treat rogue tanking as a **dungeon and off-tank** tool, not a main-tank role. An avoidance rogue can reach 95-97% avoidance and hold many bosses up to Naxx. It has no taunt, weak AoE threat, and its only threat tool (**Agitating Poison**) is Nature damage, so it fails on nature-immune bosses. Play the **33/18/0 poison-avoidance** build. Stack Agility, dodge, parry, Defense and Stamina. Chain Ghostly Strike → Flourish → Evasion to stay unhittable.

playbooks.title: Assassination Rogue (poison melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play deep Assassination (**Noxious Assault, 41/10/0**) while leveling from 40, as a fresh 60, until you have full Darkmantle, and for solo farming and PvP. After that, switch to [Combat Envenom](#/class/rogue/combat-melee-dps). Use the **two fastest weapons** you can find; their damage barely matters. Build combo points with **Noxious Assault**, keep **1-point Envenom and Slice and Dice** up, and dump into **5-point Eviscerate**. Since 1.18.1 you no longer run Rupture or Taste for Blood. **Instant Poison** is your default. Carry a second pair of daggers with **Dissolvent** for the four creature types it still hits. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee DPS (poison); the best rogue spec to carry Improved Expose Armor if your raid wants one | | Viability (1.18.1) | **A early, B later.** Still the better spec while you work toward pre-BiS; Combat Envenom catches up around pre-BiS and overtakes it with full Darkmantle at the latest Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-25. "More of a leveling spec now, but you can still get semi decent results" GumGuzz · 2026-04-10. Its niche is "pvp and solo play" Nandieb · 2026-03-29 | | Difficulty | Low rotation, high logistics (poison types, charges, weapon swaps) | | Strengths | Almost gear-independent ("any 1.3 daggers, put poisons on them") feeder5 · 2026-03-10; poison damage ignores armor; strong solo and vs plate in PvP | | Weaknesses | Does not scale with raid gear: the only raid dagger fast enough is Fang of Venoxis from ZG Scruff · 2026-03-27, Scruff · 2026-03-27; poison swapping in MC and Kara40 Rheinwg · 2026-03-20, Nuian · 2026-04-05; useless on poison-immune bosses | **What 1.18.1 did to it.** Noxious Assault lost AP scaling (35% → 30%), Taste for Blood no longer boosts Dissolvent or Corrosive, and those two poisons now only work on Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead Nuian · 2026-01-23, Mildine · 2026-03-20. Nandieb counts three separate nerfs to Noxious Assault in one patch Nandieb · 2026-04-03. Players measured roughly 10% less damage Nandieb · 2026-03-23. The type restriction, not the numbers, is why people call the spec dead Kyrsie · 2026-03-26.

It ends where the [leveling order](#/class/rogue/leveling) ends. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Assassination | Improved Eviscerate | 3/3 | | Assassination | Malice | 5/5 | | Assassination | Ruthlessness | 3/3 | | Assassination | Murder | 2/2 | | Assassination | Improved Blade Tactics | 3/3 | | Assassination | Relentless Strikes | 1/1 | | Assassination | Lethality | 5/5 | | Assassination | Vile Poisons | 3/3 | | Assassination | Improved Poisons | 3/3 | | Assassination | Efficient Poisons | 3/3 | | Assassination | Envenom | 1/1 | | Assassination | Cold Blood | 1/1 | | Assassination | Vigor | 2/2 | | Assassination | Seal Fate | 5/5 | | Assassination | Noxious Assault | 1/1 | | Combat | Lightning Reflexes | 5/5 | | Combat | Precision | 5/5 | Split **41/10/0**, validated (VALID). stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to 8%** (yellow cap). "The 8% mark is strictly necessary, anything short of 12-14% just has a lot more misses" Epickalen · 2026-01-12. Hit also means more auto-attacks land, and only a landed hit can apply poison Epickalen · 2025-10-31. 2. **Weapon speed** (see Gear). It decides how often your poisons proc; at raid gear each 0.1 s of speed is worth roughly 6 poison DPS GumGuzz · 2025-12-01, Scryu · 2026-01-16. 3. **Haste**: no diminishing returns; always ahead of crit for Assassination Nandieb · 2026-03-18. 4. **AP**: Noxious Assault, Eviscerate and poisons all scale with AP; poisons scale with AP only GumGuzz · 2026-03-22. 5. **Crit** and **Agility** after that. Community AP-equivalents for the Noxious spec: haste 25-28, hit 22-24, crit 18-20, Strength 1.1, Agility 1.6-1.7 Oshy · 2026-03-05. Crit is worth less than for Combat because poisons can only crit from **spell** crit Rheinwg · 2026-01-19, Rheinwg · 2026-01-23. Intellect gives rogues no spell crit Nandieb · 2026-01-18. Dreamshard Elixir-style spell crit adds little, about 3% crit at best Epickalen · 2026-03-28, Rheinwg · 2026-03-28. Weapon skill matters much less than for Combat, because white damage is a small part of the total Heffey · 2026-02-11. Damage profile (pre-patch logs): roughly half poison, 10-20% Noxious Assault, the rest autos and finishers Nandieb · 2026-01-25, Ambroz · 2026-01-07.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: 1. **Opener:** a combo point pre-loaded on the boss (carry it over with Slice and Dice on a critter), or a Noxious Assault Midfinger · 2026-03-10. 2. **Envenom** at 1 combo point, **then Slice and Dice** at 1 combo point. Envenom first is worth about 50 DPS GumGuzz · 2026-03-20, Allie :3 · 2026-03-20. 3. **Noxious Assault** to build combo points; never Backstab or Sinister Strike in this spec GumGuzz · 2025-11-07, Badknees · 2026-01-01. 4. **Eviscerate** at 5 combo points; **Cold Blood** on a 5-point Eviscerate, or on a Noxious Assault when a Seal Fate crit gets you to 5 faster Rheinwg · 2026-03-09. 5. Refresh Envenom and Slice and Dice at 1 point with the Ruthlessness point after a finisher Scruff · 2026-03-04. - **Do not use Rupture.** With Taste for Blood gone from poisons, skipping Rupture sims about 20 DPS higher Nandieb · 2026-03-22. - **Blade Flurry:** usually a loss for Assassination, because poisons don't reach the second target and you lose energy Lightemgee · 2026-01-02, Rheinwg · 2026-03-14. **Contested:** the Combat Gum sim shows it as a gain on some cleave fights Scryu · 2026-03-21. Only turn it on for 2 targets, and only if your sim agrees. - **Poison-immune target:** swap to your other poisoned pair if the target is just nature-immune. If it is immune to all poisons (Twin Emperors), keep going; the Noxious Assault hit still lands.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **Weapons:** the fastest daggers you can get, because Noxious Assault and poisons ignore weapon damage Scruff · 2026-01-16. BiS pairs: **Fang of Venoxis + Distracting Dagger** and **Alcor's Sunrazor + Distracting Dagger** Rhaena · 2026-03-20. Distracting Dagger's +6 dagger skill makes it the off hand to keep; Alcor's has fallen off post-patch Moonveiled · 2026-04-05, Zllig · 2026-04-05. Rhaena's post-patch tests ranked Dragonfang > Fang of Venoxis > Alcor's > Perdition's Rhaena · 2026-03-24. The nerf made slightly slower, higher-DPS daggers "slightly more viable" Nandieb · 2026-01-24. Off-hand speed matters twice as much as main-hand speed (an off-hand weapon needs ~14 extra DPS to offset 0.1 s of speed) Rheinwg · 2026-01-24. - **Budget:** 1.3-speed Julie's Dagger, Finkle's Skinner, 2× Stormfist, or even white 1.3-speed Poniards from a weapon vendor SyriasBizniz · 2025-08-19, Xil · 2025-08-26, Nandieb · 2026-01-06, GumGuzz · 2025-12-11. Gear the rest before chasing weapon damage Nandieb · 2026-01-06. - **Armor, pre-BWL:** 6-piece Darkmantle + Aged Core Leather Gloves + Clutch of Hivaxxis Istrefi · 2026-03-08. 4 Darkmantle + 4 Stormshroud shows more on a dummy but scales worse with raid buffs Istrefi · 2026-03-19. - **BWL:** 4 Darkmantle + 3 T2 (the T2 3-piece adds 5% poison chance) Badknees · 2026-02-17; T2 priority is bracers, boots, then chest Nandieb · 2026-03-01. - **Trinkets:** Hand of Justice, Whip of Encouragement, Royal Seal and Vial of Potent Venoms all sim within ~10 DPS; HoJ + Whip is best Nandieb · 2026-03-19, Nandieb · 2026-03-19. Extra-swing procs are worth more for Assassination because every swing can proc poison Nandieb · 2026-02-17. - **Solo farming:** a vampirism set (2× Blood-etched Fetish, Twilight Opal Cascade, vampirism enchants) plus a Riposte spec lets you solo Damian (the Ripper) and Hateforge Quarry bosses TwistedMindz · 2025-10-13, BDL · 2025-11-23, pxstxll · 2026-04-07, pxstxll · 2026-04-07. See [Hateforge Quarry](#/instances/hateforge-quarry).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Running Rupture + Taste for Blood in 1.18.1 Nandieb · 2026-03-26. - Double Dissolvent everywhere, the pre-1.18.1 habit. It now does nothing to Humanoids, Beasts, Dragonkin and Demons Mildine · 2026-03-20. - Using slow "upgrades" such as Gut Ripper; speed beats weapon damage Nandieb · 2026-02-14. - Using Backstab or Sinister Strike instead of Noxious Assault GumGuzz · 2025-11-07. - Dropping Efficient Poisons Nandieb · 2026-04-01. - Staying Assassination into AQ40 and Naxx with Darkmantle done. Sim Combat Envenom Nandieb · 2026-03-26.
