extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The loop for **Noxious Assault (41/10/0)** at 60. Details: [Single-target rotation](#/class/rogue/assassination-melee-dps) and [Poisons](#/class/rogue/assassination-melee-dps). 1. **Before the pull:** **Instant Poison** on both of your fastest weapons. Keep a second pair coated with **Dissolvent** for Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead ([creature-type rule](#/class/rogue/assassination-melee-dps)). Poison charges last about 20 minutes of fighting Zek · 2026-02-11. 2. **Opener:** a combo point pre-loaded on the boss and carried over with Slice and Dice, or **Noxious Assault** Midfinger · 2026-03-10. Solo, open with **Cheap Shot** from Stealth (see [leveling](#/class/rogue/leveling)). 3. **Single-target loop (top first):** 1. **Envenom** at 1 combo point if it is missing or expiring, then **Slice and Dice** at 1 combo point GumGuzz · 2026-03-20. 2. **Eviscerate** at 5 combo points; **Cold Blood** on it when ready Rheinwg · 2026-03-09. 3. **Noxious Assault** to build. Never Backstab or Sinister Strike GumGuzz · 2025-11-07. 4. **No Rupture** Nandieb · 2026-03-22. 4. **Cooldowns:** Cold Blood (a 5-point Eviscerate, or Noxious Assault into Seal Fate); Vanish for threat resets and trinket swaps; Thistle Tea when energy-starved. 5. **AoE switch:** none. Stay single-target and kill one mob at a time. **Blade Flurry** only for exactly 2 targets, and only if your sim shows a gain (**contested**) Lightemgee · 2026-01-02, Scryu · 2026-03-21. 6. **Resource rule:** the Ruthlessness point after each finisher pays for the 1-point refreshes Scruff · 2026-03-04. Weapon swaps cost a GCD in combat offenshiv · 2025-12-02. 7. **Situational:** if the target is **nature-immune**, swap to your Dissolvent pair. If it is **immune to all poisons** (Twin Emperors), keep pressing Noxious Assault; the hit still lands. Carry Kidney Shot and Kick for dangerous trash.

extraSections.heading: Poisons
extraSections.markdown: ### How poisons work on Turtle - **Procs** come from landed weapon hits, so faster weapons proc more often. Poison damage itself is fixed by rank and scales a little with AP Rheinwg · 2026-01-03, Lightemgee · 2026-01-18. "+x% chance" talents add flat percentage points (30% → 40%) GumGuzz · 2026-01-03. Your total application chance tops out around 101% with Envenom, talents, trinkets and set bonuses Rheinwg · 2026-01-19. - **AP scaling** (max ranks): Instant ~5% of AP, Dissolvent 4.75%, Deadly and Corrosive about 8% over their full duration Rheinwg · 2026-03-12, Lightemgee · 2026-01-18. 1.18.1 cut the low ranks' scaling hard (leveling and pre-AQ20 raiding) [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **School:** Instant and Deadly are Nature, so they ignore armor but are hurt by Nature resistance and nature immunity. Dissolvent and Corrosive are Physical and also ignore armor GumGuzz · 2026-03-20, Jeebs · 2026-03-20. - **Crits** only come from spell crit Rheinwg · 2026-01-19. **Resists** are possible; Efficient Poisons reduces them Rheinwg · 2025-12-19. - **Deadly Poison** on both hands is one debuff, so pair it with Corrosive or a second rank of Deadly Rheinwg · 2026-01-14, Rheinwg · 2026-01-14. Two rogues' Deadly IV share one debuff hybris · 2026-03-24. - **Charges** run out in about 20 minutes of fighting; Efficient Poisons stretches them Zek · 2026-02-11, Farban · 2026-02-11. Poisons, sharpening stones and oils share a slot Rheinwg · 2026-04-07, GumGuzz · 2025-11-12. ### The creature-type rule (1.18.1) > "Corrosive Poison and Dissolvent Poison now both only apply on the following types: Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants & Undead." Mildine · 2026-03-20 | Target type | Instant / Deadly (Nature) | Dissolvent / Corrosive (Physical) | |---|---|---| | Humanoid, Beast, Dragonkin, Demon (players are Humanoid) | yes | **no** | | Undead | yes (Undead are not nature-immune Nandieb · 2026-02-24) | yes | | Giant, Mechanical | yes | yes | | Elemental | usually **immune** (Nature) | yes | | Immune to all poisons (Twin Emperors, BWL Spellbinders, some Stormwind Vault mobs) | no | no AceTony · 2026-03-24, Scruff · 2026-03-24, Rhaena · 2026-03-26 | A player called the change a bugfix, not a balance pass (Discord has no staff signal, so this is not a confirmed staff statement) Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-03-24. The bug report asking to revert it was closed Scruff · 2026-03-26. ### Which poison per spec | Spec | Default | Bosses | Elementals / nature-immune | |---|---|---|---| | Assassination | **Instant** both hands. It has higher base damage than Dissolvent and Taste for Blood no longer helps Dissolvent Nandieb · 2026-03-18, Nandieb · 2026-03-15 | Instant both | **Dissolvent** both | | Combat Envenom | Instant both | Instant both, or Instant + Deadly OH (**contested**) | Dissolvent both | | Combat AR / Subtlety | Instant (trash) | Deadly V MH + Corrosive II OH on Undead/Giant/Mechanical bosses; Deadly V + IV on others Rheinwg · 2026-04-08, Rheinwg · 2026-03-21 | Dissolvent MH + Corrosive OH | | PvP (any) | Instant both; swap an off hand to Crippling when you need it Makelovenot · 2026-03-26 | — | — | Rheinwg's general rule for DoT specs: over ~40 s use DoT poisons, below that Instant/Dissolvent Rheinwg · 2026-03-21. Deadly V and Corrosive II are only available from AQ20 Rheinwg · 2026-02-19. ### Weapon and poison swapping - Keep your **main pair** coated with the poison for the raid's dominant type. Keep a **cheap spare pair** (e.g. two Julie's Daggers from the bank) with the other type, and swap only when you reach an immune pack Nandieb · 2026-03-20. - Common pairings: Fang of Venoxis + Distracting Dagger with one poison, Alcor's Sunrazor + Distracting Dagger with the other (Fang is unique, Distracting Dagger is not) Rhaena · 2026-03-20, Rhaena · 2026-03-20. The Ripper's own Corrosive proc is a different spell and ignores the type rule Rheinwg · 2026-03-26. - Swapping weapons costs a GCD in combat offenshiv · 2025-12-02. - SuperCleveRoidMacros auto-swap by target type nanolespacko · 2026-03-23: ``` /equipmh [type:Undead/Elemental/Giant/Mechanical nomhimbue:Dissolvent_Poison] YourDissolventMHDagger; /equipoh [type:Undead/Elemental/Giant/Mechanical noohimbue:Dissolvent_Poison] YourDissolventOHDagger; /equipmh [notype:Undead/Elemental/Giant/Mechanical mhimbue:Dissolvent_Poison] YourInstantMHDagger; /equipoh [notype:Undead/Elemental/Giant/Mechanical ohimbue:Dissolvent_Poison] YourInstantOHDagger; ``` - ItemRack cannot tell two identical items apart, so don't build both sets from the same dagger ShadoWolf · 2026-03-23. - If swapping is too much hassle on a trash-heavy night, some players run no poisons in MC at all Scruff · 2026-03-26, or stay on Instant through a single immune pack and only switch for a whole immune section ohcheese · 2026-03-20. ### Poisons by raid From Rheinwg's per-raid guide (2026-03-21), the channel's reference Rheinwg · 2026-03-21: | Raid | Trash | Bosses | |---|---|---| | **[Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core)** | Mostly Elementals and Giants: **Dissolvent II**; Core Hounds are low priority; one Instant section | **Dissolvent/Corrosive only:** Garr, Baron Geddon, the two golems, the undead dwarf. **Instant/Deadly only:** the Salamander, the Core Hound boss, Sulfuron, Shazzrah, Majordomo. **Golemagg** (Giant): either Rheinwg · 2026-03-21 | | **[Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair)** | Instant/Deadly only. Spellbinders are immune to all poisons (low priority); Drakonids can have a Nature vulnerability | Instant/Deadly only. Chromaggus swaps between Nature resistance and vulnerability. Assassination: "instant all the way"; Combat: Instant on trash, the two max ranks of Deadly on bosses Rheinwg · 2026-03-21 | | **AQ40** | Instant/Deadly only | Twin Emperors: immune to all poisons. Frost Oils on Viscidus Rheinwg · 2026-03-21 | | **Naxxramas** | Mostly Undead (either works), but some Humanoids and Beasts, so Instant is the easy pick | Most bosses take both types; Faerlina and Maexxna take Instant/Deadly only; Gothik is Dissolvent only (as written in the guide). Combat/Sub: Deadly V + Corrosive II on most bosses, Deadly V + IV on Faerlina/Maexxna Rheinwg · 2026-03-21 | | **[Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan)** | Before Gnarlmoon: Instant. Gnarlmoon → Incantagos (Dragons): Instant. Incantagos → Anomalus (Dragons + Elementals): either. After Anomalus (Undead/Elemental/Mechanical): Dissolvent. After Chess: Dissolvent, then Instant (Humanoids/Demons). Worgen and demon poison immunity was later removed Rheinwg · 2026-03-28 | **Anomalus, Rupturan, Chess:** Dissolvent + Corrosive. **Medivh:** any poison; Combat uses Mind-Numbing, Assassination Dissolvent. All other bosses: Instant/Deadly only Rheinwg · 2026-03-21 | | **[Emerald Sanctum](#/instances/emerald-sanctum)** | Mobs are highly Nature-resistant; Instant still works Ionnatra · 2026-03-22, Dimbei · 2026-03-24 | — | | **[Stormwind Vault](#/instances/stormwind-vault)** | Some mobs are immune to all poisons Rhaena · 2026-03-26, Rhaena · 2026-03-26 | — | Nuian's summary for Ambershire: "in raids it's only mc and kara that you need to worry about it" Nuian · 2026-04-05. On Kara40's Ley Watcher, the nature-affinity elementals take no physical damage, so you cannot proc any poison on them Rheinwg · 2026-03-12, Rheinwg · 2026-03-12.

yaml.stat_priority_note: "Assassination isn't your combat swords mentality of piling on the attack power. It is a balance between dagger speed, armor haste and crit. Attack power is at the bottom of my list" [Shananagans p=149679]. Weapon speed leads because Noxious Assault takes a percentage of attack power rather than weapon damage, so swings only matter for poison application, and roughly half the spec's damage is poison. Hit is 4–5% for dungeon content, more for raids. Dagger weapon skill pushes glancing blows down. One post-1.18.1 poster says to "throw out 1.3 speed mainhands" [Mdzielak p=171653] — single source, no numbers. Crit and agility are a tie: no cited post ranks them against each other, so their order in the array above carries no ranking. Grouping them is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.

glance.recommendation: Play deep Assassination (**Noxious Assault, 41/10/0**) while leveling from 40, as a fresh 60, until you have full Darkmantle, and for solo farming and PvP. After that, switch to [Combat Envenom](#/class/rogue/combat-melee-dps). Use the **two fastest weapons** you can find; their damage barely matters. Build combo points with **Noxious Assault**, keep **1-point Envenom and Slice and Dice** up, and dump into **5-point Eviscerate**. Since 1.18.1 you no longer run Rupture or Taste for Blood. **Instant Poison** is your default. Carry a second pair of daggers with **Dissolvent** for the four creature types it still hits.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Melee DPS (poison); the best rogue spec to carry Improved Expose Armor if your raid wants one

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **A early, B later.** Still the better spec while you work toward pre-BiS; Combat Envenom catches up around pre-BiS and overtakes it with full Darkmantle at the latest Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-25. "More of a leveling spec now, but you can still get semi decent results" GumGuzz · 2026-04-10. Its niche is "pvp and solo play" Nandieb · 2026-03-29

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Low rotation, high logistics (poison types, charges, weapon swaps)

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Almost gear-independent ("any 1.3 daggers, put poisons on them") feeder5 · 2026-03-10; poison damage ignores armor; strong solo and vs plate in PvP

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Does not scale with raid gear: the only raid dagger fast enough is Fang of Venoxis from ZG Scruff · 2026-03-27, Scruff · 2026-03-27; poison swapping in MC and Kara40 Rheinwg · 2026-03-20, Nuian · 2026-04-05; useless on poison-immune bosses

glance.rest: **What 1.18.1 did to it.** Noxious Assault lost AP scaling (35% → 30%), Taste for Blood no longer boosts Dissolvent or Corrosive, and those two poisons now only work on Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead Nuian · 2026-01-23, Mildine · 2026-03-20. Nandieb counts three separate nerfs to Noxious Assault in one patch Nandieb · 2026-04-03. Players measured roughly 10% less damage Nandieb · 2026-03-23. The type restriction, not the numbers, is why people call the spec dead Kyrsie · 2026-03-26.

playbooks.title: Combat Rogue (melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play **Combat Envenom, 24/27/0**. Build combo points with **Backstab** (daggers) or **Sinister Strike** (swords). Keep **1-point Slice and Dice and 1-point Envenom** up, cast Envenom first, and put every other combo point into a **5-point Eviscerate**. Do not use Rupture or Taste for Blood. Stack Agility (Blade Rush speeds up your energy ticks), take a slow, strong main hand and the fastest off hand you can get, and toggle **Blade Flurry** on only while two or more enemies are in reach. Poison both weapons with **Instant Poison** and keep a Dissolvent set for elementals. The 20/31/0 **Adrenaline Rush** build remains an option for short and cleave fights. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee DPS; Kick, stuns on trash, Blade Flurry cleave | | Viability (1.18.1) | **S (raid).** The least-nerfed spec Nandieb · 2026-04-04; in the community sim it beats Combat Adrenaline Rush even in Kara40 gear Nandieb · 2026-04-05. "Forget about 41/10/0. The spec that does all what it does, but better is 24/27/0" Nandieb · 2026-03-26 | | Difficulty | Medium: two buffs to keep up, positioning for Backstab, poison swaps between packs | | Strengths | Scales with Agility gear (Blade Rush), strong cleave with Blade Flurry, daggers and swords are both viable Nandieb · 2026-03-25 | | Weaknesses | Burns poison charges fast; weak on large AoE pulls Badknees · 2026-02-09; needs good weapons, unlike Assassination | **Why it replaced Assassination.** Combat Envenom plays like the old 41/10/0 poison build, except that Backstab or Sinister Strike replaces Noxious Assault as the builder Nandieb · 2026-03-31, Nandieb · 2026-04-01. You give up a "triple nerfed" Noxious Assault and Seal Fate. In exchange you get Blade Rush (haste plus Agility-scaled energy), 5 weapon skill from Weapon Expertise (which frees a gloves slot), and 5% crit from Close Quarters Combat or Hack and Slash Nandieb · 2026-03-27, Nandieb · 2026-04-03. After 1.18.1, Assassination lost about 10% while Combat Envenom had only ever been about 5% behind, which put Combat Envenom 5% ahead Nandieb · 2026-03-23.

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Combat Envenom, daggers, 24/27/0 (recommended) Nandieb's highest-simming BWL build Nandieb · 2026-03-22. It drops Taste for Blood, Rupture and Opportunity, following his rule that "no rogue shall use rupture and envenom in the same build" Nandieb · 2026-03-26. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Assassination | Malice | 5/5 | | Assassination | Ruthlessness | 3/3 | | Assassination | Murder | 2/2 | | Assassination | Improved Blade Tactics | 3/3 | | Assassination | Relentless Strikes | 1/1 | | Assassination | Lethality | 1/5 | | Assassination | Vile Poisons | 3/3 | | Assassination | Improved Poisons | 3/3 | | Assassination | Efficient Poisons | 2/3 | | Assassination | Envenom | 1/1 | | Combat | Lightning Reflexes | 5/5 | | Combat | Improved Backstab | 3/3 | | Combat | Precision | 5/5 | | Combat | Improved Sprint | 2/2 | | Combat | Dual Wield Specialization | 5/5 | | Combat | Close Quarters Combat | 2/2 | | Combat | Surprise Attack | 1/1 | | Combat | Weapon Expertise | 2/2 | | Combat | Blade Rush | 2/2 | Split **24/27/0**, validated (VALID). [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=rogue&t=00532310103321-0503502000521022) · code `AoaDIIDYR-AoDoCAAoRCC-` Why these points: - **Ruthlessness 3/3 always**: "that talent carries rogue builds" Nuian · 2026-03-31. On Turtle it always refunds a combo point after a finisher Rheinwg · 2025-12-20, and that point pays for your 1-point Slice and Dice and Envenom refreshes. - **Blade Rush 2/2**: "every non sub rogue" should take it Nandieb · 2026-04-09. It removes 0.0012 s from the energy tick per point of Agility, so 500 Agility means 20 energy every 1.4 s instead of every 2 s ohcheese · 2026-02-20, Epickalen · 2026-03-27. - **Murder 2/2** is for BWL, where most targets are dragonkin or humanoids. Murder does nothing to Undead or Demons Blackjack · 2025-12-17. Outside BWL, move the two points into **Lethality** Nuian · 2026-03-31. - **Poison talents over Lethality**: moving points out of Lethality into Vile Poisons and Murder simmed the same or better Nandieb · 2026-04-07. Efficient Poisons also cuts poison application time (25/50/75%) and saves charges; skipping it costs about 100 DPS in the sim Rheinwg · 2026-03-20, pxstxll · 2026-04-01. - **Improved Backstab** only helps with daggers. With swords, take **Hack and Slash**; it is the stronger talent with Envenom, and only Improved Backstab makes up the gap on daggers Nandieb · 2026-04-02. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (all VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Combat Envenom, swords, 24/27/0** | Same Assassination points; Combat drops Improved Backstab and Close Quarters for **Setup 3** and **Hack and Slash 2**; build points with Sinister Strike and Surprise Attack | [calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=rogue&t=00532310103321-0500502300501222) · `AoaDIIDYR-AoAoCDAoBSC-` | Nuian Nuian · 2026-03-31, Nuian · 2026-03-31 | | **Combat Envenom, Opportunity/Lethality 24/27/0** | Lethality 5, Taste for Blood 2, Efficient Poisons 3, Murder 1, no Vile/Improved Poisons; Opportunity 5 instead of Lightning Reflexes. The most-posted post-patch build (5 posts), but it keeps Taste for Blood, which the sim rule says to drop | [calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=rogue&t=00531310520031-5003502000521022) · `AoZDIoQAZ-FADoCAAoRCC-` | Uly Uly · 2026-03-21, Uly · 2026-03-21 | | **Adrenaline Rush daggers, 20/31/0** | Lethality 5 + Taste for Blood 2 + Vile Poisons 1; Combat adds Opportunity 5, Aggression 3 and **Adrenaline Rush**. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to 8%** for abilities (Backstab, Sinister Strike, Eviscerate) against a level-63 boss. Every point of weapon skill above 300 adds 0.2% hit, which the character sheet does not show Rheinwg · 2026-01-15, Rheinwg · 2026-01-17. Precision gives 5%. 2. **Agility.** It gives AP, crit (about 1% per 29 Agility) and, through Blade Rush, energy Lightemgee · 2025-12-01. About 400 raid-buffed Agility is where you start to feel the faster ticks; around 800 you reach close to 1-second ticks GumGuzz · 2026-01-19, Epickalen · 2026-01-17. Grace of Air alone "buffs your dps by as much as getting gear upgrades from a whole raid tier" Nandieb · 2026-03-30. 3. **Crit**, up to the crit cap. Crit matters more for Combat than for Assassination, because your autos and Backstabs crit while poisons only crit from spell crit Matt Lender · 2026-01-27. Once you reach the crit cap, take hit again Rheinwg · 2026-04-12. 4. **Hit beyond 8%**: dual wielding adds about 19% miss to both hands' autos, so white hits need about 25% GumGuzz · 2026-01-27, Epickalen · 2026-02-23. Around 16% hit is a comfortable spot where you don't have to worry about the crit cap Rheinwg · 2026-01-31. 5. **Haste and AP.** Haste is multiplicative with Slice and Dice Epickalen · 2025-06-25. | Cap | Value | Source | |---|---|---| | Ability (yellow) hit vs boss | 8% (5% vs same level) | Rheinwg · 2026-01-15 | | Auto-attack (white) hit, dual wield | 25% | Rheinwg · 2026-01-17 | | Crit cap at 25% hit | ~55%; bosses suppress 3% crit | Rheinwg · 2026-04-13, Rheinwg · 2026-03-18 | | Weapon skill | 310 minimum, 313 good, 315 optimal (glancing damage stops improving at 315; the hit from skill keeps counting) | Farban · 2026-03-21, Heffey · 2026-02-11 | Rough stat weights (community napkin math, not a sim): crit ≈ 25 AP per 1% Lightemgee · 2026-04-11; baseline, 1 Agility ≈ 1.7 AP Lightemgee · 2026-04-11. The extra energy Agility gives through Blade Rush is hard to value with napkin math and has to be simmed Scryu · 2026-04-11. For your own gear, sim it on [combatgum.app](https://www.combatgum.app/), the channel's rogue simulator GumGuzz · 2026-03-19.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Opener 1. Before the pull, put a combo point on any mob or critter; it stays there. Cast Slice and Dice on the boss to carry it over (combo-point transfer with Ruthlessness) Midfinger · 2026-03-10, Lightemgee · 2026-01-08. 2. Open with **Backstab** (daggers) or **Sinister Strike** (swords), not a stealth opener. Walking to the boss in stealth costs too much time Rheinwg · 2026-02-03. 3. At 1 combo point: **Envenom**, then **Slice and Dice**. Casting Envenom first is worth about 50 DPS in the sim GumGuzz · 2026-03-20, Allie :3 · 2026-03-20. ### Priority (Combat Envenom) 1. **Envenom** at 1 combo point if it is missing or about to fall off Nandieb · 2026-03-30. 2. **Slice and Dice** at 1 combo point if it is missing or about to fall off. 3. **Eviscerate** at 5 combo points ("5 cp evis, not spam") Nandieb · 2026-03-30. 4. **Surprise Attack** when usable (after the target dodges). A macro that casts it only below 80 energy avoids wasting energy Nuian · 2026-04-10. 5. **Backstab** from behind (daggers) or **Sinister Strike** (swords) to build combo points. **Never Sinister Strike with a dagger**: "you are giga griefing yourself" Nandieb · 2026-04-02. 6. Optional gain: when Slice and Dice or Envenom is about to run out and you hold more than 1 point, a 2-4 point Eviscerate first beats spending the extra points on the buff Nandieb · 2026-03-26. Ruthlessness hands back one combo point after every finisher, so the next buff refresh is usually free Scruff · 2026-03-04. A dodged or parried builder costs only about 7 energy GumGuzz · 2026-03-08. ### Priority (Adrenaline Rush variant) 1. **Slice and Dice** (any combo points) and a **5-point Rupture** for Taste for Blood; keep both up. "Combat is just 2 buffs" Treehide/Verrik · 2026-01-19, Rheinwg · 2026-03-19. 2. **Adrenaline Rush** right after a 5-point Rupture, so its Backstabs happen inside the Taste for Blood window Heffey · 2025-10-05. Pop it once on the pull if the boss dies within ~3 minutes, twice on longer fights Heffey · 2025-12-05. 3. **Eviscerate** with spare points only if both buffs have 20+ seconds left, ideally during Adrenaline Rush Epickalen · 2026-01-19. 4. **Backstab** as the builder. Use Sinister Strike only when a buff is about to drop and you need the cheaper point Epickalen · 2026-01-28. ### Positioning notes - Attacks from behind cannot be parried but can still be dodged 30 · 2025-12-24. - On fights that turn the boss toward you (e.g. Thaddius), swap to a fast weapon and Sinister Strike until you are behind again; macro the swap Treehide/Verrik · 2025-12-07. - `/cast [behind]Backstab;[nobehind]Sinister Strike` (SuperCleveRoidMacros) switches the builder automatically Nuian · 2026-03-29, Nuian · 2026-03-29.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE and cleave
rotationAoe.markdown: **Blade Flurry** is a baseline toggle (level 30). While it is on, your energy regeneration drops by 20% [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) and your hits cleave **one** extra target Farban · 2026-02-04. | Targets in melee | Action | |---|---| | 1 | Blade Flurry **off**; it lowers your single-target damage Jeebs · 2026-02-18 | | 2+ | Blade Flurry **on**; still single-target rotation. Very strong on small packs like the four elementals in MC or paired Onyxia dragons Nandieb · 2026-04-08 | | Many (big trash) | Blade Flurry on; rogue AoE stays weak on large pulls. Sappers help if you care about trash meters Badknees · 2026-02-09, Toppings · 2026-02-09 | - Poisons, weapon procs and bleeds do not hit the second target Rheinwg · 2026-04-07, Vanikeks · 2026-02-23. A slow, hard-hitting main hand carries Sinister Strike and white damage into the cleave. Main-hand speed barely matters in single target, but a fast main hand sacrifices Blade Flurry damage Nandieb · 2026-03-28, Nandieb · 2026-03-26. - On mixed trash, many players leave Instant Poison on both weapons instead of swapping, and still do well with Blade Flurry (MC Shazzrah/Harbinger packs) Nandieb · 2026-04-08. - The buff-cap problem with Blade Flurry Galundra/Estocada · 2026-03-16 was fixed in April 2026 Rheinwg · 2026-04-18. The old macro that cancelled buffs to make room for it Heffey · 2026-03-14 is no longer needed.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: | Cooldown | Use | |---|---| | **Adrenaline Rush** (AR build) | After a 5-point Rupture; once on the pull or twice on long fights (see above). Combine with active trinkets | | **Blade Flurry** | A toggle, not a cooldown: on for 2+ targets, off for 1 | | **Vanish** | Threat reset when you close in on the tank. Also swaps an active trinket for a passive one mid-fight Farban · 2026-01-28, Farban · 2026-01-28. After a Vanish swap, a newly equipped active trinket needs 30 s before you can use it BDL · 2026-04-15 | | **Thistle Tea** | 100 energy, 3-minute cooldown; the channel's "mana pot" Rheinwg · 2026-01-24, andre · 2025-12-06 | | **Evasion / Sprint** | Defensive and mechanics (4-minute cooldowns since Class Changes 2) | | Trinkets | Active AP trinkets and Badge of the Swarmguard on bosses, especially during Adrenaline Rush; passives (DFT) on trash KonradKurze · 2026-03-28 |

roleStrategy.heading: Resource and threat management
roleStrategy.markdown: - Base energy is 20 every 2 seconds Rheinwg · 2026-04-02; Blade Rush shortens the tick (above). - Combo points stay on a target as long as it lives, even if you click away Rheinwg · 2026-01-27. A new combo point on a different target resets them Jay · 2026-03-14. - Double-pressing a finisher can overwrite a 5-point cast with a 1-point one; don't mash finishers Matt Lender · 2026-03-05. - **Threat:** rogues can pull aggro when they pop cooldowns at the start of a fight. Let the tank build threat first, and use Feint or a Vanish in the opener Lightemgee · 2026-04-04, Lightemgee · 2026-04-04. Feint only lowers your threat generation; it does not dump threat Epickalen · 2025-12-30.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Gear is front-loaded: get Darkmantle first ("Darkmantle darkmantle and darkmantle") Nandieb · 2026-03-31. ### Pre-raid and MC - **Armor:** 6/8 Darkmantle (T0.5) + 2 T2 pieces, then a third T2 piece as soon as possible. The T2 3-piece bonus beats Stormshroud, which has no Agility Nandieb · 2026-04-01. Drop Stormshroud by BWL at the latest Nandieb · 2026-04-10. The Darkmantle chain turns in several pieces at a time: bracers, then belt + gloves, then shoulders + boots + legs, then chest + helm Aimss · 2026-03-30. - **Weapons:** Perdition's Blade + Gutgore Ripper was one early Combat Envenom kit (465 unbuffed Agility, 12% haste, 16% hit, 950+ DPS) Uly · 2026-03-21, Uly · 2026-03-21. The Ripper (Stormwind Vault, Damian, 1% drop) is the BiS off hand Nandieb · 2026-03-30, ohcheese · 2026-03-15, Rheinwg · 2026-03-15. Core Hound Tooth beats Perdition's Blade in the main hand because Perdition's has no stats Nandieb · 2026-04-16. - **MC/Ony priorities:** Onyxia's neck, Band of Accuria, the Ragnaros cloak (Cloak of the Shrouded Mists), Aged Core Leather Gloves andre · 2025-12-29, Nandieb · 2026-01-20. ### BWL - **Armor:** 4-piece Darkmantle (head, shoulders, belt, legs) + 3-piece T2 (boots, chest, bracers) beats full T2.5 on a PvE realm; on Tel'Abim probably not, since you won't reach the Agility breakpoint without Kings and Agility totem Purge · 2026-04-04, Purge · 2026-04-04, Purge · 2026-04-04, Rhaena · 2026-04-05. - **Dagger main hand, best to worst:** Death's Sting = Dagger of Veiled Shadows > Dragonfang Blade = Pugio > Felstriker = The Ripper > Core Hound Tooth = Fang of Venoxis Nandieb · 2026-04-16. The off hand must be fast; main-hand speed does not matter in single target Nandieb · 2026-04-02, Nandieb · 2026-04-01. - **Sword main hand:** Thunderfury >> Chromatically Tempered Sword > Crystal Sword of the Blossom = Tempest's Rage > PvP sword > Vis'kag Nandieb · 2026-04-03; Ancient Qiraji Ripper is roughly equal to CTS; Nefarian's axe is best **only for Orcs** Nandieb · 2026-04-10, Nandieb · 2026-04-03. - **Sword off hand:** Anasterian's Legacy is a must-have; without it daggers win Nandieb · 2026-04-03, Nandieb · 2026-04-10. With it, BiS swords edge out BiS daggers in BWL Nandieb · 2026-04-03, Nandieb · 2026-04-03. Part of that is because the top Backstab rank only comes from AQ20 Nandieb · 2026-04-03. For races without a weapon-skill racial the two are "almost dead even" Nandieb · 2026-04-15. - Other sword options: Empyrean Demolisher + Distracting Dagger sims slightly above Crystal Blossom + Anasterian's Nandieb · 2026-04-14. Eskhandar's Right Claw summons a minion that applies −1200 armor instantly with the full set Boa · 2026-04-16, TomiOKA · 2026-04-16. The Kazzak 20% attack-speed mace with the Ripper is "right behind CTS" Im pro vise · 2026-03-28. - **Other BWL pickups, in order of impact:** DFT, Prestor's Talisman, Dragonfang Blade, Venomous Totem, Circlet of Applied Force. Don't spend soft reserves on tier; it comes on its own Nandieb · 2026-04-05. ### AQ and later - **Veiled Shadows** (AQ20): the 2-piece (ring + cloak) is strong enough to replace the Shrouded Mist cloak; the 3-piece is only a small gain over Shrouded Mist, and the dagger is strong enough on its own to compete with Death's Sting Nandieb · 2026-04-05, Zllig · 2026-04-05, Nandieb · 2026-04-05, Nandieb · 2026-04-05. **Contested:** an AQ setup with no Darkmantle and full Veiled Shadows sims well for Nandieb Nandieb · 2026-04-05; another sim had Darkmantle slightly ahead Kananaios · 2026-04-05. - Daggers pull ahead of swords again in AQ because the Veiled Shadows dagger is easy to get Nandieb · 2026-04-14. - **AQ20 2-piece** (cheaper Slice and Dice) is worth about +1 energy per second Vanikeks · 2026-03-02. - From AQ40, Combat needs the **T2.5 chest, gloves and boots**. The chest matters most; boots are less important Rheinwg · 2026-03-05, Rheinwg · 2026-03-05. - **Naxx:** soft-reserve Kingsfall before anything else Premium (Retired) · 2026-01-26. For Combat Envenom the only Naxx off hand that beats the Ripper is Claw of the Frost Wyrm Nandieb · 2026-03-30. ### Trinkets - Before DFT: the haste Flask trinket beats Vial, Royal Seal and Whip when paired with the Darkmantle and Hand of Justice procs Nandieb · 2026-03-29. - DFT is the passive "BiS forever" Zllig · 2026-04-05; add an active AP trinket or Badge for boss burst KonradKurze · 2026-03-28. - The new Onyxia trinket (a Windfury-like group proc) is a strong melee-group support pick with a Shaman in the group Rumpledstillskin · 2026-03-30. - Fortune only appears on capes, necks and trinkets GumGuzz · 2026-02-21. It multiplies an item's proc chance (10% → 12.5%) GumGuzz · 2026-03-21 and does not affect poisons, set bonuses or talents Varnoc · 2026-03-30. ### Cloak Shrouded Mist sims above Time-Lord's in most builds Onzin/Shishi · 2026-03-30. With swords, add Taut Dragonhide Boots for sword skill Scruff · 2026-04-02.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Running Rupture and Taste for Blood in an Envenom build Nandieb · 2026-03-26. - Casting Sinister Strike with a dagger in the main hand Nandieb · 2026-04-02. - Leaving Blade Flurry on in single target, or taking a fast main hand when you want to cleave Jeebs · 2026-02-18, Nandieb · 2026-03-28, Nandieb · 2026-03-26. - Spamming 1-point Eviscerates instead of 5-point ones Nandieb · 2026-03-30. - Keeping Dissolvent on against Humanoids, Beasts, Dragonkin or Demons, where it now does nothing Mildine · 2026-03-20. - Stacking Stormshroud into BWL; it has no Agility Nandieb · 2026-04-01. - Taking Improved Expose Armor in Combat Envenom. It costs you Efficient Poisons ("the worst out of all rogue specs to run iea"), and one tester ran out of poison charges on every trash pack. If the raid wants a rogue on Expose Armor, the Noxious Assault build is the better fit Nandieb · 2026-04-02, Not · 2026-04-03, Nandieb · 2026-04-02.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The loop for **Combat Envenom (24/27/0)** at 60. The reasons and the Adrenaline Rush variant are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/rogue/combat-melee-dps), [AoE and cleave](#/class/rogue/combat-melee-dps) and [Cooldowns](#/class/rogue/combat-melee-dps). 1. **Before the pull:** Instant Poison on both weapons, with a Dissolvent pair in your bags for elementals ([Poisons and weapon sets](#/class/rogue/combat-melee-dps)). Put a combo point on a critter or an add, then carry it to the boss with Slice and Dice Midfinger · 2026-03-10. 2. **Opener:** no stealth opener; walking in stealth costs too much time Rheinwg · 2026-02-03. Open with **Backstab** (daggers) or **Sinister Strike** (swords). At 1 combo point cast **Envenom, then Slice and Dice** GumGuzz · 2026-03-20. 3. **Single-target loop (top first):** 1. **Envenom** at 1 combo point if it is missing or about to fall off. 2. **Slice and Dice** at 1 combo point if it is missing or about to fall off. 3. **Eviscerate** at 5 combo points, not 1-point spam Nandieb · 2026-03-30. 4. **Surprise Attack** when usable and at 80 energy or less Nuian · 2026-04-10. 5. **Backstab** from behind (daggers) or **Sinister Strike** (swords). Never Sinister Strike with a dagger. 4. **Cooldowns:** Thistle Tea (100 energy) when energy-starved; active trinkets on bosses; **Vanish** when you are about to pass the tank on threat Farban · 2026-01-28. Adrenaline Rush build: Adrenaline Rush right after a 5-point Rupture. 5. **AoE switch:** **2 or more** enemies in melee → **Blade Flurry on**, same rotation. **1** → Blade Flurry off. Blade Flurry hits only one extra target, so big packs stay weak Farban · 2026-02-04, Badknees · 2026-02-09. 6. **Resource rule:** energy is 20 every 2 s, faster with Blade Rush and Agility. The Ruthlessness point pays for the next 1-point refresh. Don't mash finishers Matt Lender · 2026-03-05. 7. **Movement and situational:** when the boss faces you, `/cast [behind]Backstab;[nobehind]Sinister Strike` switches your builder Nuian · 2026-03-29. Kick casts. Feint only lowers your threat generation; Vanish resets it Epickalen · 2025-12-30.

extraSections.heading: Poisons and weapon sets
extraSections.markdown: **Rule since 1.18.1:** Dissolvent and Corrosive only land on **Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead**. Instant and Deadly land on everything except nature-immune targets Mildine · 2026-03-20, Rheinwg · 2026-03-28. | Situation | Envenom build | Adrenaline Rush build | |---|---|---| | Trash (default) | **Instant** both hands | Instant both hands | | Boss, normal type | Instant both, or Instant MH + Deadly OH (**contested**) | **Deadly V MH + Corrosive II OH** if the boss is Undead/Giant/Mechanical; **Deadly V + Deadly IV** otherwise | | Nature-immune (elementals) | **Dissolvent** both | Dissolvent MH + Corrosive OH | | Poison-immune (Twin Emperors, BWL Spellbinders) | swap nothing; no poison lands | same | - **Contested (Envenom):** Rheinwg's rule is "envenom shouldnt be running with deadly" Rheinwg · 2026-03-29. A quick dummy test had Instant MH + Deadly OH about 35 DPS (~5%) ahead of double Instant Dare · 2026-03-29, and Rheinwg later added "Deadly and Cor are actually pretty good for Combat envenom" to his guide Rheinwg · 2026-03-21. Sim your own gear. - **Adrenaline Rush and Subtlety** do more damage with Deadly V + IV; Envenom procs Instant so often that it overtakes the DoTs Rheinwg · 2026-04-08. Rheinwg's default for DoT specs is Deadly MH + Corrosive OH on bosses and Instant/Dissolvent on trash Rheinwg · 2026-03-29. Deadly V and Corrosive II only come from AQ20 Rheinwg · 2026-02-19. - Deadly IV is flaky: two rogues' Deadly IV share one debuff, and whether one rogue's IV and V stack properly is disputed hybris · 2026-03-24, Rhaena · 2026-04-09. - **Weapon sets:** keep a second, cheap pair (e.g. Julie's Daggers) coated with the other poison type in your bags and swap when the creature type changes Nandieb · 2026-03-20. A SuperCleveRoidMacros macro can equip the right pair by target type nanolespacko · 2026-03-23. ItemRack cannot tell two identical daggers apart, so use two different items ShadoWolf · 2026-03-23. - Poisons and sharpening stones or oils share the same slot Rheinwg · 2026-04-07. Windfury is an aura on Turtle and does not conflict with poisons Scruff · 2026-01-14. Per-raid poison plan: see [Assassination → Poisons by raid](#/class/rogue/assassination-melee-dps).

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **SuperCleveRoidMacros** (+ SuperWoW, Nampower, UnitXP) is the standard toolkit for conditional macros feeder5 · 2025-11-14, Jay · 2026-03-20. - One-button swords macro (Eviscerate-spam form; change `combo:>1` to `combo:=5` for the 5-point version): `/startattack` · `/cast [nomybuff:"Slice and Dice" combo:=1] Slice and Dice;` · `/cast [nomybuff:envenom combo:=1]Envenom;` · `/cast [usable:"Surprise Attack"]Surprise Attack;` · `/cast [combo:>1] Eviscerate` · `/cast [mypower:>40]Sinister Strike` marcusmadnjgidget · 2026-03-27. - Daggers: `#showtooltip Backstab` · `/startattack` · `/cast [myrawpower:<=80]Surprise Attack` · `/cast [behind]Backstab;[nobehind]Sinister Strike` Nuian · 2026-04-10. - **Lateral** gives timers for Slice and Dice, Expose Armor, Taste for Blood and Envenom; it has a Nampower version Rheinwg · 2026-01-15, Zaszz · 2026-01-21, Rheinwg · 2026-02-23. **DoiteAuras** is a WeakAuras-like alternative Doite · 2025-12-21. **Backstabber** shows whether you are behind the target TwistedMindz · 2026-03-29, Raleias · 2026-03-29. - **TrinketMenu** (newest version) queues a trinket swap that fires on Vanish Heffey · 2026-01-28, Heffey · 2026-01-28. **EzPoison / EasyPoisons** apply poisons in one click; **TW Buy Poisons** buys reagents rey.1982 · 2026-02-21, rey.1982 · 2026-02-21, Weirdthing · 2026-02-21.

extraSections.heading: Raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **MC** is the worst raid for poison swaps (elemental trash next to humanoid bosses) Makelovenot · 2026-03-24; see the per-boss list in [Assassination](#/class/rogue/assassination-melee-dps). Blade Flurry shines on the elemental packs. See [Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core). - **BWL:** everything takes Instant/Deadly; you do not swap poisons in BWL Nandieb · 2026-04-03. On Nefarian's rogue call, Vanish saves you once; a Living Action Potion or the Onyxia cloak a second time Rheinwg · 2026-04-11, Nandieb · 2026-04-11. See [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair). - **AQ40:** Twin Emperors are immune to all poisons; use Frost Oils on Viscidus Rheinwg · 2026-03-21. - **Naxx:** Consecrated Sharpening Stones were a pre-patch pick for Combat daggers after the Spider wing PHPROmega · 2026-02-14. Rheinwg's post-patch plan is Deadly V + Corrosive II on most bosses and Deadly V + IV on Faerlina and Maexxna Rheinwg · 2026-03-21. - **Kara40:** swap by section (see the Assassination page). See [Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan).

yaml.stat_priority_note: Hit first to the 9% special-attack cap (lower with racial or item weapon skill — 305 skill makes 9% easy to reach, 308 is called the optimum). Weapon skill also pushes misses and glancing blows off the hit table. Agility now drives energy regeneration through Blade Rush as well, measured at roughly 0.1 s off the tick per 100 agility. Watch the crit cap: past it, crit and agility lose value and hit becomes the premium stat again. Agility, crit and attack power are a tie: no cited post ranks them against each other, so their order in the array above carries no ranking. Grouping them is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.

glance.recommendation: Play **Combat Envenom, 24/27/0**. Build combo points with **Backstab** (daggers) or **Sinister Strike** (swords). Keep **1-point Slice and Dice and 1-point Envenom** up, cast Envenom first, and put every other combo point into a **5-point Eviscerate**. Do not use Rupture or Taste for Blood. Stack Agility (Blade Rush speeds up your energy ticks), take a slow, strong main hand and the fastest off hand you can get, and toggle **Blade Flurry** on only while two or more enemies are in reach. Poison both weapons with **Instant Poison** and keep a Dissolvent set for elementals. The 20/31/0 **Adrenaline Rush** build remains an option for short and cleave fights.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Melee DPS; Kick, stuns on trash, Blade Flurry cleave

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **S (raid).** The least-nerfed spec Nandieb · 2026-04-04; in the community sim it beats Combat Adrenaline Rush even in Kara40 gear Nandieb · 2026-04-05. "Forget about 41/10/0. The spec that does all what it does, but better is 24/27/0" Nandieb · 2026-03-26

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium: two buffs to keep up, positioning for Backstab, poison swaps between packs

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Scales with Agility gear (Blade Rush), strong cleave with Blade Flurry, daggers and swords are both viable Nandieb · 2026-03-25

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Burns poison charges fast; weak on large AoE pulls Badknees · 2026-02-09; needs good weapons, unlike Assassination

glance.rest: **Why it replaced Assassination.** Combat Envenom plays like the old 41/10/0 poison build, except that Backstab or Sinister Strike replaces Noxious Assault as the builder Nandieb · 2026-03-31, Nandieb · 2026-04-01. You give up a "triple nerfed" Noxious Assault and Seal Fate. In exchange you get Blade Rush (haste plus Agility-scaled energy), 5 weapon skill from Weapon Expertise (which frees a gloves slot), and 5% crit from Close Quarters Combat or Hack and Slash Nandieb · 2026-03-27, Nandieb · 2026-04-03. After 1.18.1, Assassination lost about 10% while Combat Envenom had only ever been about 5% behind, which put Combat Envenom 5% ahead Nandieb · 2026-03-23.

playbooks.title: Subtlety Rogue (raid support)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** bring **one** Subtlety rogue per raid. Its job, in this order: keep a **5-point Improved Expose Armor** on the boss 100% of the time, spam **Hemorrhage** (a raid-wide physical-damage debuff), keep **Tricks of the Trade** rolling on your party with 5-point finishers, and fire **Mark for Death** into a **Shadow of Death** in burst windows (twice per fight with Preparation). Play the **17/0/34** build with a slow, hard-hitting **non-dagger** main hand, and stack Attack Power. Put the Sub rogue in a melee group, ideally with two Shamans. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee DPS with raid and party buffs/debuffs | | Viability (1.18.1) | **A (raid support).** "Less individual dmg than the combat hybrid but more dmg from the raid as a whole" Nuian · 2026-04-02. Its value rises with raid size and melee count Nuian · 2026-03-29 | | Difficulty | The hardest rogue spec: Tricks of the Trade timing, Mark timings, Preparation, energy and combo points all at once Rheinwg · 2026-04-06 | | Strengths | Raid-wide armor and damage debuffs Nuian · 2026-04-02; the "most engaging spec to play" Junak'Salsa · 2026-04-02 | | Weaknesses | Low personal meter numbers; a second Sub adds little; weak in dungeons and small groups Rheinwg · 2026-03-30; PUG leaders often misplace it (caster group, "why is no one sundering") Junak'Salsa · 2026-04-02, Junak'Salsa · 2026-04-02 |

talents.markdown: ### 17/0/34 IEA support (recommended) The post-patch form of the standard "IEA + Hemo support build" Ionnatra · 2026-01-09. It matches Rheinwg's checklist (Ruthlessness, Improved Blade Tactics, Relentless Strikes are musts) Rheinwg · 2026-02-01, and the Combat Gum sim ships presets with and without Expose Armor nanolespacko · 2026-04-08. stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to 8%** from gear Rheinwg · 2026-02-01. 2. **Attack Power** above almost everything. Mark for Death, Shadow of Death and Hemorrhage all scale with it; a steady AP bonus beats a proc Rheinwg · 2026-02-23, Rheinwg · 2026-03-02. 3. **Energy sources** so you can hold the whole rotation (Darkmantle, Stormshroud or AQ20 set bonuses) Rheinwg · 2026-02-23, Rheinwg · 2026-04-07. 4. Crit gains value with the T3 set at Naxx Rheinwg · 2026-01-27.

rotationSingle.heading: Rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Opener 1. **Garrote** (2 cheap combo points; it always procs Tricks of the Trade). Many raiding Subs forget it Rheinwg · 2026-03-31, Rheinwg · 2026-02-01. Use Hemorrhage instead if the boss is bleed-immune Yoridzen · 2026-04-10. 2. **Hemorrhage** to 5 points → **Improved Expose Armor** as early as possible Nuian · 2026-04-04. 3. **Slice and Dice** at 1 point; then Hemorrhage to 5 → **Rupture** for Taste for Blood Nuian · 2026-04-04, Yoridzen · 2026-04-10. 4. Burst: Hemorrhage to 2 points, **Mark for Death** (adds 2 + the Ruthlessness point, tops you up to 5), then **Shadow of Death**, with AP trinkets and potions. Call it out so your group bursts with you Nuian · 2026-04-04, Vegybird · 2026-03-17. ### Sustain priority 1. **Improved Expose Armor** at 5 points if it has under ~10 s left; refresh it before any other finisher Vegybird · 2026-03-17. 2. A **5-point finisher about every 11 s** to keep Tricks of the Trade up; this matters more than perfect Slice and Dice uptime or Shadow of Death on cooldown Vegybird · 2026-03-17. Spamming 1-point Eviscerates just to trigger Tricks of the Trade is a mistake Rheinwg · 2026-03-31. 3. **Slice and Dice** (low combo points) and **Rupture** (5 points, for Taste for Blood). With 5 points, Rupture first, then Slice and Dice with fewer points Rheinwg · 2026-02-14. 4. **Mark for Death → Shadow of Death** on cooldown or in the raid's burst window. After the first one, **Preparation** (7-minute cooldown) resets Mark for a second, e.g. in the execute phase Rheinwg · 2026-02-04, Floccumate · 2026-02-07. 5. **Eviscerate** with spare combo points. 6. **Hemorrhage** as the builder. You want to see only Hemorrhage and Ghostly Strike, not Backstab or Sinister Strike Rheinwg · 2026-02-04. Yoridzen's full sequence: Garrote → Hemorrhage ×3 → IEA → Slice and Dice → Hemorrhage ×4 → Rupture → Hemorrhage ×2 → burst (Quickness potion, trinkets) → Mark → Shadow of Death → Preparation → Slice and Dice → Hemorrhage ×2 → Mark → Shadow of Death → Vanish + trinket swap → Garrote → keep IEA, Slice and Dice and Rupture up Yoridzen · 2026-04-10. ### Advanced - Pre-load a combo point on a critter and carry it to the boss with Slice and Dice Zaszz · 2025-12-10. - Sap the boss before Garrote: it is immune, but Blackjack still applies 10% damage reduction for 8 s. Distract gives −6% hit on the boss Vegybird · 2026-03-17. - Short Naxx sequences (Noth → Heigan → Loatheb, Patchwerk → Grobbulus → Gluth → Thaddius) leave too little downtime for Preparation, so expect one Mark on some bosses Weirdthing · 2026-02-01, Rheinwg · 2026-02-04. - On trash, pop Mark + Shadow of Death on a big pack at the start of the raid, not right before a boss Rheinwg · 2026-02-01. Don't IEA trash or in dungeons Rheinwg · 2026-01-09. - Blade Flurry is generally not for Sub: it costs energy and combo points you need for Tricks of the Trade and Shadow of Death Rheinwg · 2026-01-02, Scruff · 2026-03-06. - Judge yourself on logs, not DPS: cooldowns used, IEA uptime, Tricks of the Trade uptime, Taste for Blood and Slice and Dice uptime Rheinwg · 2026-02-01.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **Main hand: slow, high-damage, not a dagger** ("Sub doesn't play with daggers") Rheinwg · 2026-03-14, Rheinwg · 2026-03-09. BWL: the new **Partisan PvP sword** is BiS Nandieb · 2026-03-29, Rheinwg · 2026-04-08; Gressil, then Castigator, are the next best Rheinwg · 2026-03-11, Rheinwg · 2026-03-11. Deathbringer suffers from having no fitting +skill off hand Nandieb · 2026-03-29. Later: Ancient Qiraji Ripper > C'Thun's fist > Castigator > Gressil > Thunderfall Rheinwg · 2026-01-27. - **Off hand:** fast, ideally with weapon skill Rheinwg · 2026-03-23, Nandieb · 2026-04-02. Leave **the Ripper** to an Assassination or Combat Envenom rogue; on Sub it costs you too much damage Nandieb · 2026-04-03. - **Armor:** Darkmantle for energy early; the AQ20 set is very strong, "he should be using that forever pretty much" Rheinwg · 2026-03-31, Rheinwg · 2026-03-09. At Kara40 level, T3 + T3.5 + Veiled Shadows replace Darkmantle's energy Rheinwg · 2026-04-07, Rheinwg · 2026-01-25. The Deathdealer 5-piece is not worth soft reserves Nandieb · 2026-04-11. T2 priority: bracers > belt > chest > boots > legs > shoulders > head > gloves Midfinger · 2026-04-10. - **Trinkets:** Slayer's Crest over Kiss of the Spider (better with Mark + Shadow of Death) Rheinwg · 2026-03-03. - **Enchants:** Crusader on the main hand; Crusader or Agility on the off hand Nettlefield · 2026-01-09, Rheinwg · 2026-01-09. Some run double Crusader and pop Mark for Death on a Crusader proc Matt Lender · 2026-01-27. AP-leaning armor enchants; ZG Agility on head and legs; Zandalar haste, later Sapphiron, on shoulders Ionnatra · 2026-03-13, Rheinwg · 2026-03-13. - **Races:** Orc and Goblin for min-maxing Rheinwg · 2026-04-16.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Not running IEA as the raid's only Sub ("pointless") Nuian · 2026-04-06, or running it alongside another rogue's IEA Nuian · 2026-04-04. - Using a dagger, Backstab or Sinister Strike Rheinwg · 2026-02-04. - Skipping Ruthlessness, Improved Blade Tactics or Relentless Strikes Rheinwg · 2026-02-01. - Forgetting Garrote at the start Rheinwg · 2026-03-31. - Running Annihilator in a raid that has a Shart'ateth Axe; they share a debuff slot Vegybird · 2026-03-17.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The loop for the **17/0/34 support build** at 60. Your job, in order: Improved Expose Armor uptime, Tricks of the Trade uptime, and Mark for Death windows. Details: [Rotation](#/class/rogue/subtlety-melee-dps), [Group placement](#/class/rogue/subtlety-melee-dps), [Poisons](#/class/rogue/subtlety-melee-dps). 1. **Before the pull:** Deadly V + Deadly IV on normal bosses, or Deadly + Corrosive on Undead, Giant and Mechanical bosses; Instant or Dissolvent on trash. Pre-load a combo point on a critter and carry it with Slice and Dice Zaszz · 2025-12-10. Optionally **Sap the boss** before Garrote: Blackjack still applies Vegybird · 2026-03-17. 2. **Opener:** **Garrote** (Hemorrhage if the boss is bleed-immune) → Hemorrhage to 5 → **Improved Expose Armor** → 1-point **Slice and Dice** → Hemorrhage to 5 → **Rupture** (Taste for Blood) Nuian · 2026-04-04, Yoridzen · 2026-04-10. 3. **Sustain loop (top first):** 1. **Improved Expose Armor** at 5 points if it has about 10 s or less left Vegybird · 2026-03-17. 2. A **5-point finisher about every 11 s** to keep Tricks of the Trade up. Never 1-point Eviscerate spam Rheinwg · 2026-03-31. 3. **Slice and Dice** (low points) and 5-point **Rupture**. 4. **Eviscerate** with spare combo points. 5. **Hemorrhage** as the builder; Ghostly Strike as needed. No Backstab or Sinister Strike. 4. **Cooldowns:** **Mark for Death → Shadow of Death** in the raid's burst window, with AP trinkets and a potion. Call it out. After that, Vanish → Garrote, then **Preparation** for a second Mark Rheinwg · 2026-01-29, Rheinwg · 2026-02-04. 5. **AoE switch:** no Blade Flurry as a rule; it costs the combo points Tricks of the Trade needs Rheinwg · 2026-01-02. The exception is trash that dies before you can reach 5 points anyway Rheinwg · 2026-01-02. Don't put IEA on trash or in dungeons Rheinwg · 2026-01-09. Use Mark + Shadow of Death on a big pack only at the start of the raid, never right before a boss Rheinwg · 2026-02-01. 6. **Resource rule:** Honor Among Thieves has a 1.5 s internal cooldown, which is your main energy limit Rheinwg · 2026-01-24. Lean on the energy set bonuses (Darkmantle, AQ20). 7. **Situational:** stay in a melee group, because Mark and Tricks of the Trade reach only your party. Judge yourself by IEA and Tricks of the Trade uptime, not by DPS Rheinwg · 2026-02-01.

extraSections.heading: What Subtlety brings
extraSections.markdown: Yoridzen's summary: "−2600 armor on boss, +2% phys damage on boss, +4% crit for your group, 16 sec of burst which gives ur group 30% of your ap (or sp for casters and palas)" Yoridzen · 2026-04-08. | Tool | Scope | Effect | |---|---|---| | **Improved Expose Armor** (5 points) | raid (target debuff) | More armor reduction than Sunder; about +5% physical damage for the raid on most bosses Zaszz · 2026-04-11. Shares the Sunder Armor slot and overwrites it; only one rogue should run it Cannondorf · 2026-03-31, 30 · 2026-04-08 | | **Hemorrhage** | raid (target debuff) | Bonus physical damage taken; "literally 4% more damage with good up time" Zaszz · 2025-12-17. One Sub gets about 54% uptime in real parses Zaszz · 2025-12-17 | | **Tricks of the Trade** | party | Crit buff from your finishers; 12 s, so aim for a 5-point finisher about every 11 s to keep 2 stacks up Vegybird · 2026-03-17 | | **Mark for Death** | party | 30% of your AP as AP (and 20% as spell power) for 16 s Lightemgee · 2026-04-06, Yoridzen · 2026-04-08; also gives combo points (2 + the Ruthlessness point) Nuian · 2026-04-04 | | **Shadow of Death** | you | Finisher that stores damage taken by the target and detonates for up to 250% AP at 5 points; Relentless Strikes applies to it Ionnatra · 2026-01-09, Rheinwg · 2026-01-08. It usually detonates "within seconds" Scruff · 2025-12-10 | | **Blackjack** (Sap/Blind on the boss) | raid | 10% damage reduction on the boss; the most impactful Sub utility per Rheinwg Lightemgee · 2026-04-10, Rheinwg · 2026-04-06 | **How many Subs?** "None are needed, 1 is good, 2 is nice to have": one rogue gets 30-40% Hemorrhage uptime, two get 70-80% Weirdthing · 2026-03-23, Weirdthing · 2026-03-23. Only one rogue needs Improved Expose Armor. If two Subs are in the raid, one drops IEA and plays for damage Nuian · 2026-04-04, Nuian · 2026-04-06. A dev put it this way: "sub rogue is incredible support, just the gain from having more than 1 is pretty negligible" Lhian · 2025-01-22. **Improved Expose Armor vs Sunder (situational value).** One tester measured IEA as the only armor debuff at about +150 raid DPS over no debuff, but only +35 over a full 5× Sunder stack ohcheese · 2026-04-01. Its real value depends on whether your warriors sunder. Let warriors Sunder on trash and save IEA for bosses Rheinwg · 2026-01-24.

extraSections.heading: Group placement
extraSections.markdown: Put the Sub in a melee group; Mark for Death and Tricks of the Trade only reach your party. Suggested groups: two Shamans + Feral + Warrior (a T3.5 Paladin instead of the Feral if crit-capped) TwistedMindz · 2026-03-30; when a Hunter + Shaman + 2 Warriors group was proposed, Rheinwg preferred swapping the second Warrior for a second Shaman instead Rheinwg · 2026-03-30, Rheinwg · 2026-03-30. A caster group also works, since Mark for Death gives spell power Rheinwg · 2026-01-26.

extraSections.heading: Poisons
extraSections.markdown: Sub runs DoT poisons on bosses: **Deadly V + Deadly IV** on normal bosses, **Deadly MH + Corrosive OH** on Undead/Giant/Mechanical bosses, Instant or Dissolvent on trash Rheinwg · 2026-04-08, Rheinwg · 2026-03-29. In one BWL sim, Deadly IV on the main hand beat double Instant for Sub Nandieb · 2026-03-29. Use double **Mind-Numbing** on Medivh Vegybird · 2026-03-17. Full rules: [Assassination → Poisons](#/class/rogue/assassination-melee-dps).

glance.recommendation: Bring **one** Subtlety rogue per raid. Its job, in this order: keep a **5-point Improved Expose Armor** on the boss 100% of the time, spam **Hemorrhage** (a raid-wide physical-damage debuff), keep **Tricks of the Trade** rolling on your party with 5-point finishers, and fire **Mark for Death** into a **Shadow of Death** in burst windows (twice per fight with Preparation). Play the **17/0/34** build with a slow, hard-hitting **non-dagger** main hand, and stack Attack Power. Put the Sub rogue in a melee group, ideally with two Shamans.

playbooks.title: Rogue PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play **Assassination (Noxious Assault)** to kill plate and burst in arenas and duels, and **Subtlety (Hemorrhage/Preparation)** for control and outplay. Run **Instant Poison on both weapons**; since 1.18.1 Dissolvent and Corrosive do not work on players, who are Humanoid Rumpledstillskin · 2026-03-30. Keep an off-hand swap with Crippling Poison. Hit cap for abilities is **5%**. Expect a harder time than before: dampening cuts damage and the patch's effect on PvP viability is itself disputed (**contested**, see State below). Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). | | | |---|---| | State (1.18.1) | **Contested.** "Rogue is not really playable in pvp right now" The J · 2026-04-17 vs "it was far from nerfed to ground" Killinu · 2026-04-09. Nandieb calls the patch's effect on the Noxious PvP build "quite negligible" Nandieb · 2026-04-06 | | Assassination | "Plate killer"; loses 1v1 to good casters Kyrsie · 2026-04-06, Deleted User · 2026-04-02 | | Subtlety | The control spec: two of every key button with Preparation, chain CC Nelson · 2026-03-29, whs. · 2026-04-02 | | Combat | "Good for pvp and 1vs1, but you lack control unlike sub" ZeithThedark12 · 2026-04-02 | Before 1.18.1, Dissolvent Poison was described in PvP as "the new physical dmg that ignores armor", force-procced by the level-40 keystone and dealing "insane dmg" Eemo · 2025-10-03. A pre-patch `#pvp-general` tier list put rogues in the top "Z tier" Thirtyseven · 2025-10-11. That build no longer exists.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **Assassination (Zaszz):** sneak up → **Cheap Shot** → **Envenom** → mash **Noxious Assault** until they die or you can **Kidney Shot** → mash more. Against big health pools (bear druids), Cheap Shot → Envenom → Slice and Dice Zaszz · 2026-04-11, Zaszz · 2026-04-11. **Assassination, full stun lock (Not):** Cheap Shot → Envenom → Cold Blood + Noxious Assault → Thistle Tea → Noxious Assault ×2 → Kidney Shot → Noxious Assault until dead. If Tea is on cooldown, Kidney with whatever points you have before Cheap Shot ends Not · 2026-01-16, Not · 2026-01-16. **Without Rupture (post-patch, Nandieb):** Cheap Shot → spam Noxious Assault to 5 points (Thistle Tea if needed; a Seal Fate proc gets you there within the stun) → Kidney Shot → only then Envenom + Slice and Dice Nandieb · 2026-04-12. **Subtlety (Ionnatra):** Garrote → Rupture → Ghostly Strike → Flourish → **Riposte** (disarms on a dodge/parry proc — the rogue kit has no standalone Disarm spell, only the reactive Riposte talent and the utility Disarm Trap) → Evasion → Sinister Strike to 5 → Kidney Shot → Sinister Strike ×2 → Rupture → Vanish out. Bleeds and poison keep ticking while you reopen, and Preparation lets you repeat it Ionnatra · 2026-01-09. Mechanics to know: - **Cheap Shot and Kidney Shot do not share diminishing returns** on this 1.12-based client; that changed only in Cataclysm 1.18.1 WILL SAVE US #LetThemCook · 2025-10-11. - **Blind is no longer a poison.** Poison cleanses, Dwarf Stoneform and cleansing totems do not remove it, and it still resets with Preparation Blackjack · 2026-02-28, Purec · 2025-10-06, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-21. - **Vanish** protects from AoE for one GCD Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop. The full combos are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp), poison setup in [Poisons](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp), and per-class detail in [Matchups](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp). Cooldowns below come from the 1.18.1 client data. **Assassination (Noxious Assault):** 1. **Opener (stealth):** sneak up → `Cheap Shot` → `Envenom` → mash `Noxious Assault`. Against big health pools (bear druids) use Cheap Shot → Envenom → `Slice and Dice` Zaszz · 2026-04-11, Zaszz · 2026-04-11. If you face two enemies, `Sap` one first Rheinwg · 2025-05-21. 2. **Burst:** spend the Cheap Shot stun building to 5 points with Noxious Assault (`Thistle Tea` if short) → `Kidney Shot` (20 s cooldown) → Noxious until dead. `Cold Blood` (3 min) on a Noxious Assault or a 5-point Eviscerate Not · 2026-01-16, Nandieb · 2026-04-12. 3. **Re-lock:** if they trinket the Kidney, Thistle Tea → `Vanish` (5 min) → Cheap Shot again → Noxious into a 5-point Cold Blood Eviscerate Blindtongue · 2025-11-25. 4. **Control chain:** Cheap Shot and Kidney Shot do not share diminishing returns on this client 1.18.1 WILL SAVE US #LetThemCook · 2025-10-11. Add `Gouge` or `Blind` (5 min) when needed Jeebs · 2026-01-16. Don't run Deadly Poison if you plan to Blind Makelovenot · 2026-03-26. 5. **Defence:** with everything on cooldown, `Evasion` (4 min) survives most melee Not · 2026-01-16. Save Evasion and `Sprint` (4 min) to escape Rheinwg · 2025-05-21. **Subtlety (Hemorrhage/Preparation):** 1. **Opener (stealth):** `Garrote` → `Rupture` → `Vanish` and let the bleeds work on cloth Sapboi · 2026-02-28, or run the full chain: Garrote → Rupture → `Ghostly Strike` → `Flourish` → Evasion → Sinister Strike to 5 → Kidney Shot → Sinister Strike ×2 → Rupture → Vanish out Ionnatra · 2026-01-09. 2. **Burst window:** reopen from Vanish with Cheap Shot while the bleeds tick. The Ambush-dagger variant (Ambush → Kidney → autos → Vanish → Ambush) is only for cloth targets Ionnatra · 2026-03-21. 3. **Control chain:** `Preparation` (7 min) resets Vanish and Blind (vanilla baseline: also Sprint and Evasion), giving double Vanish, double Blind and a 5-point Kidney into another 5-point Kidney Badknees · 2026-02-25, Blackjack · 2026-02-28. 4. **Defence:** Vanish protects from AoE for only one GCD Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07. Sub rarely kills plate outside long 1v1s with several resets Kyrsie · 2026-04-06. **Both specs:** - **Target priority:** Assassination kills plate, Subtlety kills cloth and outplays Kyrsie · 2026-04-06. In groups, open on the healer and Sap or Blind the second enemy (vanilla baseline for the healer-first rule). - **Reset / drink:** Gouge, then bandage while they are incapacitated Rheinwg · 2025-05-21. Against warlocks, kill the pet and reset with full cooldowns after eating The Multiverse · 2025-11-08. DoTs are your worst enemy: there is no Cloak of Shadows, only potions that remove DoTs Blindtongue · 2025-11-10. **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp)): - **Frost Mage:** Sprint plus a Free Action Potion, or no chance riku · 2026-02-22. Pool energy for `Deadly Throw` to re-apply Crippling and interrupt the Polymorph after a Blink Zaszz · 2025-12-22. - **Shaman:** always stun them. **Contested:** some call them "easier targets" Nandieb · 2026-04-12, but a 5-6k HP Elemental survives a 5-point Kidney The J · 2026-04-12. - **Warlock:** kill the pet, or Gouge/Vanish through the Death Coil (with an Engineering Shadow Reflector) The Multiverse · 2025-11-08, The Multiverse · 2025-11-08. - **Paladin:** Cheap Shot into their Freedom, Kidney into their trinket, Blind into their bubble; bleed them with Rupture and kite with Crippling Eylo · 2025-04-19. - **Warrior, Hunter:** "easy clap" riku · 2026-02-22.

extraSections.heading: Poisons
extraSections.markdown: - **Instant on both weapons**, always, in battlegrounds Zaszz · 2026-04-11, Dobri · 2026-04-12. - Swap an off hand to **Crippling** when needed. Squibble uses Crippling + Wound/Instant, or Mind-Numbing to surprise casters Squibble · 2026-03-20. - **Avoid Deadly Poison**: it breaks your own Blind and ramps slowly Makelovenot · 2026-03-26. - Off-hand swap macro, looking for any "Poniard" in your bags (change the name to your Crippling weapon): `/run for i=0,4 do for j=1,GetContainerNumSlots(i) do local l=GetContainerItemLink(i,j) if l and string.find(l,"Poniard") then PickupContainerItem(i,j) EquipCursorItem(17) break end end end` Istrefi · 2026-01-09. Fixed-slot version: `/script if ( not CursorHasItem() ) then PickupContainerItem(4,3); PickupInventoryItem(17); PickupContainerItem(4,3); end` Blindtongue · 2025-10-31.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - Rogues struggle in objective BGs because stealth is slow next to mounted players and long cooldowns don't fit short BGs Zaszz · 2025-08-07. - **Alterac Valley:** stealth-cap bunkers and towers behind enemy lines, solo (or sap/kite) graveyard guards, or pick off stray reinforcements Blindtongue · 2025-11-21. - Ranking: Rank 13 → 14 is about 80k honor, and reaching the 20k honor cap took one player 20+ hours of BGs Allie :3 · 2026-04-02.

glance.recommendation: Play **Assassination (Noxious Assault)** to kill plate and burst in arenas and duels, and **Subtlety (Hemorrhage/Preparation)** for control and outplay. Run **Instant Poison on both weapons**; since 1.18.1 Dissolvent and Corrosive do not work on players, who are Humanoid Rumpledstillskin · 2026-03-30. Keep an off-hand swap with Crippling Poison. Hit cap for abilities is **5%**. Expect a harder time than before: dampening cuts damage and the patch's effect on PvP viability is itself disputed (**contested**, see State below).

stats.heading: Stats and caps

The 5% difference hardly matters Jay · 2026-03-20. - **Resilience gear** is not worth the stats you give up Rheinwg · 2026-01-08. Rheinwg would keep Darkmantle over crit-reduction PvP pieces: Assassination is a glass cannon, so kill faster Rheinwg · 2026-01-27. - **Weapons:** Zaszz wants the fastest 1.3-1.5 weapons for Noxious PvP, where other stats matter less Zaszz · 2026-04-11, Zaszz · 2026-04-11. The new PvP rewards are poor for every rogue spec; the old R14 dagger was the hardest hitter on Ambershire Ionnatra · 2026-03-28, Ionnatra · 2026-03-28. Nandieb rates the new Partisan sword best-in-slot for Sub in BWL, and the 2.9-speed Partisan longsword sims almost equal to CTS Nandieb · 2026-03-29, Nandieb · 2026-04-02. rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **Assassination (Zaszz):** sneak up → **Cheap Shot** → **Envenom** → mash **Noxious Assault** until they die or you can **Kidney Shot** → mash more. Against big health pools (bear druids), Cheap Shot → Envenom → Slice and Dice Zaszz · 2026-04-11, Zaszz · 2026-04-11. **Assassination, full stun lock (Not):** Cheap Shot → Envenom → Cold Blood + Noxious Assault → Thistle Tea → Noxious Assault ×2 → Kidney Shot → Noxious Assault until dead. If Tea is on cooldown, Kidney with whatever points you have before Cheap Shot ends Not · 2026-01-16, Not · 2026-01-16. **Without Rupture (post-patch, Nandieb):** Cheap Shot → spam Noxious Assault to 5 points (Thistle Tea if needed; a Seal Fate proc gets you there within the stun) → Kidney Shot → only then Envenom + Slice and Dice Nandieb · 2026-04-12. **Subtlety (Ionnatra):** Garrote → Rupture → Ghostly Strike → Flourish → **Riposte** (disarms on a dodge/parry proc — the rogue kit has no standalone Disarm spell, only the reactive Riposte talent and the utility Disarm Trap) → Evasion → Sinister Strike to 5 → Kidney Shot → Sinister Strike ×2 → Rupture → Vanish out. Bleeds and poison keep ticking while you reopen, and Preparation lets you repeat it Ionnatra · 2026-01-09. Mechanics to know: - **Cheap Shot and Kidney Shot do not share diminishing returns** on this 1.12-based client; that changed only in Cataclysm 1.18.1 WILL SAVE US #LetThemCook · 2025-10-11. - **Blind is no longer a poison.** Poison cleanses, Dwarf Stoneform and cleansing totems do not remove it, and it still resets with Preparation Blackjack · 2026-02-28, Purec · 2025-10-06, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-21. - **Vanish** protects from AoE for one GCD Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07.

roleStrategy.heading: Matchups
roleStrategy.markdown: riku's ranking, hardest first riku · 2026-02-22: | Opponent | Notes | |---|---| | **Frost Mage** | Hardest. You need Sprint on cooldown plus a Free Action Potion, "otherwise 0% chance" | | **Fire / Elemental Shaman** (tanky) | Bursts 2.5-3k plus a DoT; you need Tea and a healing potion on cooldown. **Contested:** Nandieb calls Shamans "one of the easier targets because they don't have defensive cooldown" Nandieb · 2026-04-12; a 5-6k HP Elemental Shaman "won't be dead after 5cp kidney" The J · 2026-04-12. Dobri's routine: Cheap Shot → Noxious Assault → Gouge → Kidney Shot → Thistle Tea → Noxious ×2 → Gouge → Cold Blood + Eviscerate, or Blind and reopen Dobri · 2026-04-12 | | **Warlock, Druid** | Hard; usually needs FAP and most cooldowns | | **Paladin** (Holy/Prot) | Long, annoying fight; you may have to "kill" them three times through their cooldowns | | **Melee, Hunter** | "Easy clap" | Post-patch sentiment: on Ambershire "you win a 1vs1 with full cds against almost any class, locks and mages still own you" Deleted User · 2026-04-02. Assassination loses to any caster 1v1, while Sub keeps a chance through control Deleted User · 2026-04-02. mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Running Dissolvent or Corrosive on players; they do nothing since 1.18.1 Rumpledstillskin · 2026-03-30. - Deadly Poison while planning to Blind Makelovenot · 2026-03-26. - Stacking resilience instead of damage Rheinwg · 2026-01-08.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop. The full combos are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp), poison setup in [Poisons](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp), and per-class detail in [Matchups](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp). Cooldowns below come from the 1.18.1 client data. **Assassination (Noxious Assault):** 1. **Opener (stealth):** sneak up → `Cheap Shot` → `Envenom` → mash `Noxious Assault`. Against big health pools (bear druids) use Cheap Shot → Envenom → `Slice and Dice` Zaszz · 2026-04-11, Zaszz · 2026-04-11. If you face two enemies, `Sap` one first Rheinwg · 2025-05-21. 2. **Burst:** spend the Cheap Shot stun building to 5 points with Noxious Assault (`Thistle Tea` if short) → `Kidney Shot` (20 s cooldown) → Noxious until dead. `Cold Blood` (3 min) on a Noxious Assault or a 5-point Eviscerate Not · 2026-01-16, Nandieb · 2026-04-12. 3. **Re-lock:** if they trinket the Kidney, Thistle Tea → `Vanish` (5 min) → Cheap Shot again → Noxious into a 5-point Cold Blood Eviscerate Blindtongue · 2025-11-25. 4. **Control chain:** Cheap Shot and Kidney Shot do not share diminishing returns on this client 1.18.1 WILL SAVE US #LetThemCook · 2025-10-11. Add `Gouge` or `Blind` (5 min) when needed Jeebs · 2026-01-16. Don't run Deadly Poison if you plan to Blind Makelovenot · 2026-03-26. 5. **Defence:** with everything on cooldown, `Evasion` (4 min) survives most melee Not · 2026-01-16. Save Evasion and `Sprint` (4 min) to escape Rheinwg · 2025-05-21. **Subtlety (Hemorrhage/Preparation):** 1. **Opener (stealth):** `Garrote` → `Rupture` → `Vanish` and let the bleeds work on cloth Sapboi · 2026-02-28, or run the full chain: Garrote → Rupture → `Ghostly Strike` → `Flourish` → Evasion → Sinister Strike to 5 → Kidney Shot → Sinister Strike ×2 → Rupture → Vanish out Ionnatra · 2026-01-09. 2. **Burst window:** reopen from Vanish with Cheap Shot while the bleeds tick. The Ambush-dagger variant (Ambush → Kidney → autos → Vanish → Ambush) is only for cloth targets Ionnatra · 2026-03-21. 3. **Control chain:** `Preparation` (7 min) resets Vanish and Blind (vanilla baseline: also Sprint and Evasion), giving double Vanish, double Blind and a 5-point Kidney into another 5-point Kidney Badknees · 2026-02-25, Blackjack · 2026-02-28. 4. **Defence:** Vanish protects from AoE for only one GCD Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07. Sub rarely kills plate outside long 1v1s with several resets Kyrsie · 2026-04-06. **Both specs:** - **Target priority:** Assassination kills plate, Subtlety kills cloth and outplays Kyrsie · 2026-04-06. In groups, open on the healer and Sap or Blind the second enemy (vanilla baseline for the healer-first rule). - **Reset / drink:** Gouge, then bandage while they are incapacitated Rheinwg · 2025-05-21. Against warlocks, kill the pet and reset with full cooldowns after eating The Multiverse · 2025-11-08. DoTs are your worst enemy: there is no Cloak of Shadows, only potions that remove DoTs Blindtongue · 2025-11-10. **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/rogue/assassination-pvp)): - **Frost Mage:** Sprint plus a Free Action Potion, or no chance riku · 2026-02-22. Pool energy for `Deadly Throw` to re-apply Crippling and interrupt the Polymorph after a Blink Zaszz · 2025-12-22. - **Shaman:** always stun them. **Contested:** some call them "easier targets" Nandieb · 2026-04-12, but a 5-6k HP Elemental survives a 5-point Kidney The J · 2026-04-12. - **Warlock:** kill the pet, or Gouge/Vanish through the Death Coil (with an Engineering Shadow Reflector) The Multiverse · 2025-11-08, The Multiverse · 2025-11-08. - **Paladin:** Cheap Shot into their Freedom, Kidney into their trinket, Blind into their bubble; bleed them with Rupture and kite with Crippling Eylo · 2025-04-19. - **Warrior, Hunter:** "easy clap" riku · 2026-02-22.

extraSections.heading: Poisons
extraSections.markdown: - **Instant on both weapons**, always, in battlegrounds Zaszz · 2026-04-11, Dobri · 2026-04-12. - Swap an off hand to **Crippling** when needed. Squibble uses Crippling + Wound/Instant, or Mind-Numbing to surprise casters Squibble · 2026-03-20. - **Avoid Deadly Poison**: it breaks your own Blind and ramps slowly Makelovenot · 2026-03-26. - Off-hand swap macro, looking for any "Poniard" in your bags (change the name to your Crippling weapon): `/run for i=0,4 do for j=1,GetContainerNumSlots(i) do local l=GetContainerItemLink(i,j) if l and string.find(l,"Poniard") then PickupContainerItem(i,j) EquipCursorItem(17) break end end end` Istrefi · 2026-01-09. Fixed-slot version: `/script if ( not CursorHasItem() ) then PickupContainerItem(4,3); PickupInventoryItem(17); PickupContainerItem(4,3); end` Blindtongue · 2025-10-31.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - Rogues struggle in objective BGs because stealth is slow next to mounted players and long cooldowns don't fit short BGs Zaszz · 2025-08-07. - **Alterac Valley:** stealth-cap bunkers and towers behind enemy lines, solo (or sap/kite) graveyard guards, or pick off stray reinforcements Blindtongue · 2025-11-21. - Ranking: Rank 13 → 14 is about 80k honor, and reaching the 20k honor cap took one player 20+ hours of BGs Allie :3 · 2026-04-02.

glance.recommendation: Play **Assassination (Noxious Assault)** to kill plate and burst in arenas and duels, and **Subtlety (Hemorrhage/Preparation)** for control and outplay. Run **Instant Poison on both weapons**; since 1.18.1 Dissolvent and Corrosive do not work on players, who are Humanoid Rumpledstillskin · 2026-03-30. Keep an off-hand swap with Crippling Poison. Hit cap for abilities is **5%**. Expect a harder time than before: dampening cuts damage and the patch's effect on PvP viability is itself disputed (**contested**, see State below).

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level **Assassination**. It is still the standard 1-60 spec after 1.18.1 Rheinwg · 2026-04-05, and the patch "didnt affect leveling too much" Rheinwg · 2026-04-05. You get power spikes at **30 (Envenom)** and **40 (Noxious Assault)** Rheinwg · 2026-03-06. Until Envenom, use a slow sword, axe or mace with Sinister Strike and 1-point Slice and Dice / Eviscerate. From 40, switch to the **two fastest daggers or fist weapons** you can find (1.3-1.4 speed; quality barely matters) Nandieb · 2026-03-16. The common alternative is Combat with parry and Riposte to 40, then a respec. "You cannot mess up a rogue leveling" build Epickalen · 2026-03-04; respecs cost at most 5 g GumGuzz · 2026-02-18. Expect the class to feel weak until the mid-20s Premium (Retired) · 2025-10-06 and not change much until about 30 Rheinwg · 2026-01-23. Then at 40: "everything absolutely fucking melts" Wells · 2025-11-11. At level 40 with identical gear, one test measured Combat at 95 average DPS and Assassination at 166 Baija · 2025-08-22.

sections.heading: Which route?
sections.markdown: | Route | Pick it if | Sources | |---|---|---| | **A: Assassination 10 → 60** (below) | You want no respec and the biggest spikes; slow weapon + Sinister Strike until 40 is fine | "you can go ass talents just use slow swords or whatever until lvl 40 with noxx" Kyrsie · 2026-03-12; GumGuzz: 1-point Eviscerate spam, "keep pumping assasination until 60" GumGuzz · 2025-12-21 | | **B: Combat to 39, respec at 40** | Hardcore, or you want Riposte/parry survivability early | Combat "will give you a bit more survivability and riposte is an awesome skill when going solo" Nuian · 2026-03-29; Farban's route Farban · 2026-02-04; "Combat till 40 respec to deep assasination" Farban · 2026-03-25 | **Contested:** Lightemgee warns that early Combat has "almost no offensive talents until like 30" Lightemgee · 2026-03-26; Nuian finds Combat easier to start and Assassination slow to come together before 40 Nuian · 2026-03-26. Subtlety is a poor solo leveler Rheinwg · 2026-02-20.
