sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: This is the button plan for **route A (Assassination)**. Where **route B (Combat to 39)** plays differently, a "Route B" line says so. Learn levels, energy costs and cooldowns come from the Turtle 1.18.1 game data. You start with Sinister Strike and Eviscerate rank 1 **(vanilla baseline)**. Every rank listed is a trainer rank unless it says talent or quest. ### Quick reference: openers, finishers, poisons, Blade Flurry **Stealth openers by level** | From | Opener | When to use it | |---|---|---| | 1 | **Stealth** (10 s cooldown). Your speed in Stealth drops by 50% at rank 1, 40% at rank 2 (L20), 35% at rank 3 (L40) and 30% at rank 4 (L60) | Walk in, then open with **Sinister Strike**. It is cheaper than Backstab, and at low level you don't care about Backstab damage Nuian · 2025-10-04 | | 4 | **Pick Pocket** | On humanoids, before the opener Nyx · 2025-10-17 | | 10 | **Sap** (65 energy; 25 s at rank 1, 35 s at L28, 45 s at L48) | Sap one mob of a pair, then kill the other Rheinwg · 2025-11-10 | | 14 | **Ambush** (60 energy), **Garrote** (50 energy, 18 s bleed) | Ambush needs a dagger in the main hand **(vanilla baseline)**. Route A uses a slow sword before 40, so you either skip Ambush or macro-swap a dagger in for it Joxer · 2025-11-03 | | 22 | **Distract** (30 energy, 30 yd) | Turn a mob away before you walk in ("Distract anything that may turn") [Atreidon, 2025-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=158352#p158352) | | 26 | **Cheap Shot** (60 energy, 4 s stun, 2 combo points) | **Your default opener from here to 60**, because it cuts the damage you take Nandieb · 2026-03-03. Calavero's progression: Improved Ambush before 40 (not in route A), Cheap Shot from 40, and from 52 "CS then just wreck faces" Calavero · 2026-01-06, Calavero · 2026-01-06 | Stealth attacks have no hidden crit bonus Epickalen · 2026-02-04. **Combo-point finisher rules by level** | From | Rule | |---|---| | 1 | Eviscerate is your only finisher. Build 3-5 points with Sinister Strike, then Eviscerate **(vanilla baseline)** | | 10 | **Slice and Dice at any number of combo points**, and keep it up. Spam Sinister Strike and refresh Slice and Dice when it runs low Nandieb · 2026-03-03, Rheinwg · 2026-03-07 | | 17 (Ruthlessness 3/3) | On Turtle, Ruthlessness refunds a combo point after every finisher, 100% of the time Rheinwg · 2025-12-20. From here: **1-point Slice and Dice, then 1-point Eviscerate spam** GumGuzz · 2025-12-08 | | 30 | Add **1-point Envenom** to the loop GumGuzz · 2025-11-02. **Kidney Shot** (20 energy, 20 s cooldown) is the stun finisher for dangerous mobs Rheinwg · 2026-02-20 | | 40 (Noxious Assault) | **Stop the 1-point Eviscerate spam** GumGuzz · 2025-11-11. Keep 1-point Envenom and Slice and Dice up, build with Noxious Assault, and finish with Eviscerate. A 4-5 point Rupture is only worth it with Taste for Blood Rheinwg · 2026-02-20 | | 42 | **Flourish** (20 energy, 40 s cooldown), a parry finisher. Use it when mobs turn to attack you or use Whirlwind-style attacks RUTHINAS · 2024-07-09 | | any | Rupture is worse than Eviscerate until you have Taste for Blood. Expose Armor is situational Rheinwg · 2026-03-07, Rheinwg · 2026-02-20. Don't double-press finishers: a 1-point cast can overwrite a 5-point one Matt Lender · 2026-03-05 | **Poisons by level.** The level-20 class quest unlocks poisons Badknees · 2025-12-29. Each coating takes a 3 s cast; Efficient Poisons (levels 31-33 in route A) cuts that time by 25/50/75% Rheinwg · 2026-03-20. | Level | Poison | Use while leveling | |---|---|---| | 20 | **Instant I** (quest), **Crippling I** | Instant on the main hand; off hand Instant Ionnatra · 2026-01-09, or Crippling until you get better poisons Deadlights · 2025-01-18 | | 24 / 38 / 52 | Mind-numbing I / II / III | Situational, against casters **(vanilla baseline)** | | 28 / 36 / 44 / 52 / 60 | Instant II / III / IV / V / VI | Retrain every rank; double Instant is the default | | 30 / 38 / 46 / 54 | Deadly I / II / III / IV | A stacking poison for long fights (Felwood bears, Stranglethorn gorillas) Ionnatra · 2026-01-09. While it is on, your energy regeneration and damage drop. 1.18.0 launched it at −30% energy and −20% damage Repose · 2025-07-25; 1.18.1 cut the energy penalty to 20% [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Your hits cleave exactly **one** extra target Farban · 2026-02-04. Poisons do not cleave Rheinwg · 2026-04-07. - **30-39 (slow weapon, Sinister Strike):** turn it on while 2 or more mobs are in melee range, and off when one is left. With 3 or more targets it out-damages hitting one hard target Ionnatra · 2026-02-04. "Once you get blade flurry, leveling becomes a breeze" DesignerDave · 2026-02-20. - **40-60 (fast daggers, Noxious Assault):** leave it **off**. At least half of your damage is poison, and poison doesn't transfer Lightemgee · 2026-01-02. **Contested:** the Combat Gum sim shows a gain on some cleave fights Scryu · 2026-03-21. - **Contested:** one forum leveler calls it "absolute trash until you get like 800 agility" [Exaltus, 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149418#p149418). One player in near-full Kara40 gear nearly died with it on against a level-50 satyr pack, under the old 30% energy penalty Premium (Retired) · 2025-08-22. ### Levels 1–9 - **New now:** L1 Stealth; L4 Backstab (60 energy), Pick Pocket; L6 Gouge (45 energy, 4 s), Sinister Strike rank 2; L8 Evasion (4-minute cooldown), Eviscerate rank 2. - **Single target:** 1. Walk in, or open from Stealth, with **Sinister Strike** Nuian · 2025-10-04. 2. **Sinister Strike** (40 energy) to 3-5 combo points. 3. **Eviscerate** (30 energy) **(vanilla baseline)**. 4. Most of your damage is auto-attacks. Running out of energy is normal Rheinwg · 2026-02-09. Eat between pulls. - **Multi-target:** don't pull two on purpose. If a second mob joins, **Gouge** one and kill the other, and use **Evasion** from L8 Kjata · 2025-06-22. ### Levels 10–19 - **New now:** L10 Slice and Dice (20 energy), Sap, Expose Armor, Sprint (4-minute cooldown), dual wield (trainer, no quest) Badknees · 2025-12-29; L12 Kick (25 energy, 10 s cooldown), Backstab rank 2; L14 Ambush, Garrote, Sinister Strike rank 3; L16 Eviscerate rank 3, Feint, Pick Lock; L18 Gouge rank 2. sections.heading: Pull and kill loop
sections.markdown: ### Levels 10-39 (slow weapon) 1. Open with **Cheap Shot** once you have it, to reduce the damage you take Nandieb · 2026-03-03. 2. **Sinister Strike** to build points. As a new player, "forget about backstab, forget about eviscerate" for now Nandieb · 2026-03-03. 3. **Slice and Dice** at any combo points; keep it up Nandieb · 2026-03-03. 4. From 17 (Ruthlessness): 1-point Slice and Dice → 1-point Envenom (from 30) → **1-point Eviscerate spam** until the mob dies GumGuzz · 2025-11-02, GumGuzz · 2025-12-08. 5. Most low-level damage is auto-attacks; running low on energy early is normal ("that's the neat part, you don't") Rheinwg · 2026-02-09, Rangtuk · 2026-02-09. ### Levels 40-60 (Noxious Assault, fast weapons) 1. **Cheap Shot** (or Noxious Assault) to open. 2. **1-point Envenom → 1-point Slice and Dice** GumGuzz · 2026-02-03. 3. **Noxious Assault** to build. 4. Finish with **Eviscerate**. On elites and long fights you can add a 4-5 point Rupture, which is only worth it with Taste for Blood GumGuzz · 2025-11-02, Rheinwg · 2026-02-20. 5. **Kidney Shot** to stop damage on dangerous mobs Rheinwg · 2026-02-20. ### Poison-immune mobs Some mobs are immune to your poisons until you get the physical poisons in the low 50s, and your damage drops sharply against them Epickalen · 2025-11-11. Swap to a different weapon and Sinister Strike (or Backstab), use sharpening stones, or Rupture for Taste for Blood and then Eviscerate Rheinwg · 2026-01-17. Dissolvent (52) helps, but it only applies to Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead Mildine · 2026-03-20. ### Multiple mobs With Evasion, Blade Flurry and Slice and Dice up, a rogue can fight three mobs at once. Use Sap and Distract to avoid adds Kjata · 2025-06-22. On 3+ targets, Blade Flurry out-damages a single hard target Ionnatra · 2026-02-04. ### Poisons while leveling Double **Instant** from 20. On long fights (Felwood bears, Stranglethorn gorillas) a stacking poison can do more Ionnatra · 2026-01-09. Dissolvent from 52 on the four types it hits. Poison charges run out in about 20 minutes of fighting ("part of the class fantasy") Zek · 2026-02-11, Rheinwg · 2026-02-11.

sections.heading: Group role while leveling
sections.markdown: You are melee DPS; use Kick, Sap and Blind on dangerous casters. Frontstabbing (standing inside the mob and strafing so Backstab lands from the front) works but gets old fast Epickalen · 2026-01-16, Kyrsie · 2026-04-04. With a friend tanking, a Backstab build is fine Rheinwg · 2026-03-03, Matt Lender · 2026-03-03. Rogue tanking in dungeons is possible (see [Tank](#/class/rogue/combat-tank)).

sections.heading: Lockpicking
sections.markdown: Horde: repeat the poison-quest lockbox on top of a Barrens tower to about 155. The ZF-area +5 lockpicking gloves then take you to 200, and dungeon boxes and BRD doors to 300 riku · 2025-11-09. For 275-300 use BRD or Tyr's Hand in EPL (10 footlockers); Stratholme needs 300 Nandieb · 2026-01-04. You must *cast* Pick Lock on lockboxes Farban · 2026-01-05.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
sections.markdown: - Using daggers and Backstab/Sinister Strike as a brand-new player before 40 Nandieb · 2026-03-03. - Keeping slow, high-DPS weapons after Noxious Assault Nandieb · 2026-01-05. - Hemorrhage as a leveling builder Rheinwg · 2026-02-20. - Forgetting the level-20 poison quest. - Buying a temporary weapon instead of the permanent +5 weapon-skill quest Badknees · 2026-03-27.

leveling.recommendation: Level **Assassination**. It is still the standard 1-60 spec after 1.18.1 Rheinwg · 2026-04-05, and the patch "didnt affect leveling too much" Rheinwg · 2026-04-05. You get power spikes at **30 (Envenom)** and **40 (Noxious Assault)** Rheinwg · 2026-03-06. Until Envenom, use a slow sword, axe or mace with Sinister Strike and 1-point Slice and Dice / Eviscerate. From 40, switch to the **two fastest daggers or fist weapons** you can find (1.3-1.4 speed; quality barely matters) Nandieb · 2026-03-16. The common alternative is Combat with parry and Riposte to 40, then a respec. "You cannot mess up a rogue leveling" build Epickalen · 2026-03-04; respecs cost at most 5 g GumGuzz · 2026-02-18.

gaps:
1. **Combat Envenom vs Adrenaline Rush at Naxx/Kara40.** The sim favors Envenom everywhere; one experienced raider sees AR ahead on fast kills and cleave fights. No logs settle it.
2. **Instant vs Instant + Deadly for Envenom builds.** Rheinwg's rule says double Instant; a dummy test and later edits favor Deadly in the off hand. Deadly IV's shared-debuff bug makes it murkier.
3. **The deep-Assassination build.** Few full Noxious Assault builds were posted after 2026-03-20, because the channel moved to Combat Envenom. The 41/10/0 on the Assassination page is assembled from sourced rules (drop Taste for Blood, keep the Eviscerate package and poison talents), not copied from one post.
4. **Gothik's poison type:** Rheinwg's guide says "Dissolvent only", which clashes with Instant working on non-nature-immune Undead. Untested in the sources.
5. **Taste for Blood and Shadow of Death:** whether Taste for Blood still boosts Shadow of Death, and exactly how Shadow of Death scales, is unconfirmed.
6. **Deadly Poison IV** stacking bugs (between rogues, and IV with V) were reported as fixed and unfixed in the same weeks.
7. **Rogue class weapon** (Timbermaw questline, a matched pair of swords): the questline steps are known, the item stats are not.
8. **Spell-rank training:** no source says which ranks to skip while leveling.
9. **Fortune:** confirmed to multiply item proc chances; whether it touches T2 or Veiled Shadows poison-proc bonuses is disputed.
10. **Post-patch PvP numbers:** burst reports ("halved") and denials both exist; there are no controlled tests.
11. **Rogue tank:** the build is pre-release (2026-02-12) and valid on the 1.18.1 tree, but no post-release tank build or gear sheet was posted.
12. **Crusader vs Agility** for Combat Envenom off hands, and **AP vs Agility** enchants on short fights, rest on single sims or tests.
patchChanges: The balance pass was posted on 2026-01-23 and revised on 2026-03-19; 1.18.1 went live on 2026-03-20 [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **Corrosive and Dissolvent Poison now only apply to Elementals, Mechanicals, Giants and Undead** Mildine · 2026-03-20. Instant and Deadly Poison work on everything except nature-immune targets. You now swap poisons (or whole weapon sets) between packs. The community rated this far worse than the damage nerfs Kyrsie · 2026-03-26, Rheinwg · 2026-03-28. Players are Humanoid, so the physical poisons are gone from PvP Rumpledstillskin · 2026-03-30. - **Taste for Blood** became a 2-point talent (1/1.5/2% physical damage) and **no longer boosts Corrosive or Dissolvent** Cladrius · 2026-03-19, Rheinwg · 2026-04-05. **Noxious Assault** Attack Power scaling went from 35% to 30% Nuian · 2026-01-23. - **Opportunity** 4-20% → 3-15% (aimed at Combat daggers) riku · 2026-01-24. **Blade Flurry's** energy-regen penalty dropped from 30% to 20% [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - The **low ranks** of Deadly, Instant, Corrosive and Dissolvent lost AP scaling (leveling and pre-AQ20 raiding); max ranks were untouched [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Rheinwg · 2026-01-25. - **Ornate Bloodstone Dagger** no longer procs from non-physical, no-cast effects, which ended the OBD/spellstrike build ShotQuality · 2026-02-15. **Fang of Venoxis** and **Dragonfang Blade** were buffed Badknees · 2026-03-12, Rheinwg · 2026-02-16. - **Net effect:** Assassination lost roughly 10% and Combat Envenom about 5% of damage, which put Combat Envenom about 5% ahead Nandieb · 2026-03-23. The new sim rule of thumb is to **never run Rupture and Taste for Blood in an Envenom build** Nandieb · 2026-03-26, Nandieb · 2026-03-31. - **Hotfixes:** Deadly Poison did double damage for 2-3 days after launch, then was fixed Rheinwg · 2026-03-29, [Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139). The Blade Flurry buff-cap bug was fixed in April Rheinwg · 2026-04-18. - **New:** the **Fortune** stat (proc chance on items; capes, necks and trinkets only) GumGuzz · 2026-02-21, and a rogue class-weapon questline (a matched pair of one-handed swords) starting in Timbermaw Hold Rhaena · 2026-02-15, Ionnatra · 2026-03-20, Nandieb · 2026-04-08. Steps and a known bug: [Professions → Class-weapon questline](#/class/rogue/professions). Before 1.18.1, guides told you to run double Dissolvent everywhere, keep a 5-point Rupture up for Taste for Blood, and use the OBD as your main hand. None of that applies now.

gearMarkdown.heading: Caveats
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- Raid tier mapping used below (per structured/glossary.jsonl): T1=Molten Core, T2=Blackwing Lair, T2.5=AQ40, T3=Naxxramas, T3.5=Karazhan 40 (the Trickster set).
- The richest single item-level list in the corpus is Brisspvp's 8/9-Naxx-plus-AQ40-belt PvP BiS list (subtlety-pvp), reused here for both Subtlety and (partly) Combat PvP.

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No item-level leveling gear list for any Rogue spec; synthesis/classes/rogue/leveling.md covers stat priority, weapon-type choice and poison playstyle only, no named gear by level bracket.
- No dedicated raid-t1/raid-t2/raid-t2.5 item lists for Assassination or Combat beyond the general sets progression (Darkmantle/Stormshroud -> Bonescythe/Trickster) and a handful of MC/BWL-adjacent items; the corpus jumps from pre-raid to Naxx/Kara40 gearing.
- Subtlety PvE (melee-dps) has essentially no gear list beyond a single Shadowcraft-set claim; flagged as a gap in the source playbook itself.
- The Combat Tank spec's only slot-by-slot list (Ssai, 2022) predates Class Changes 2 and uses unverified vanilla item names; no updated tank gear list exists post-CC2.
- The Rogue class-weapon questline added in 1.18.1 (Timbermaw Hold, starter quest 42029, starter item 42307 from Peroth'arn) has no stated weapon stats in the extracted posts.
- 10/19 Twink PvP BiS List (t14264) and the general 'BiS list' thread (t13918) point to external Google Sheets and a Discord-pinned spreadsheet; their contents are not text in this corpus and could not be captured.
- A level-29 Rogue/Hunter/Druid twink PvP item list exists in the General forum (t22403) but gives almost only bare item IDs without names, so it could not be used under the 'exact item names as written' rule.

sections.heading: Experts relied on (and why)
sections.markdown:
- **Nandieb:** the channel's most active sim user after the patch. He ran hundreds of Combat Gum comparisons, reported the #1 overall BWL parse with a 24/27/0 swords build, and is vouched for by others ("Nandieb knows his sims"). Combat Envenom build, "rogue law #1", gear rankings, trinkets.
- **Rheinwg:** keeps the pinned leveling/build guide (Google Doc) and wrote the per-raid poison-immunity guide the whole channel uses. Consistent, widely deferred to, corrects others. Poisons, Subtlety, leveling, mechanics.
- **GumGuzz:** author of Combat Gum; extensive in-game proc testing (Servo Arm, dodge/parry refund, Crusader, weapon skill crit). Mechanics, stat rules.
- **Epickalen:** detailed, formula-level answers (energy tick, hit/crit tables, stat weights); a go-to for new players.
- **Zaszz, Vegybird, two raccoons, Nuian, Yoridzen:** practicing Subtlety raiders; the support rotation and group placement.
- **Nettlefield, Scruff, Suade:** practicing rogue tanks (avoidance numbers, gear, the Agitating Poison campaign).
- **Rhaena, Nuian, Kananaios:** Ambershire raiders who posted cross-checking sims and logs.
- **Suade, Zaszz, riku, Ionnatra, Blindtongue:** PvP builds, sequences and matchups.
- **Premium (Retired), Heffey, Treehide/Verrik:** long-time Nordanaar raiders; late-game Combat dagger gear and pre-patch context.

sections.heading: Gaps (what the sources do not settle)
sections.markdown:
1. **Combat Envenom vs Adrenaline Rush at Naxx/Kara40.** The sim favors Envenom everywhere; one experienced raider sees AR ahead on fast kills and cleave fights. No logs settle it.
2. **Instant vs Instant + Deadly for Envenom builds.** Rheinwg's rule says double Instant; a dummy test and later edits favor Deadly in the off hand. Deadly IV's shared-debuff bug makes it murkier.
3. **The deep-Assassination build.** Few full Noxious Assault builds were posted after 2026-03-20, because the channel moved to Combat Envenom. The 41/10/0 on the Assassination page is assembled from sourced rules (drop Taste for Blood, keep the Eviscerate package and poison talents), not copied from one post.
4. **Gothik's poison type:** Rheinwg's guide says "Dissolvent only", which clashes with Instant working on non-nature-immune Undead. Untested in the sources.
5. **Taste for Blood and Shadow of Death:** whether Taste for Blood still boosts Shadow of Death, and exactly how Shadow of Death scales, is unconfirmed.
6. **Deadly Poison IV** stacking bugs (between rogues, and IV with V) were reported as fixed and unfixed in the same weeks.
7. **Rogue class weapon** (Timbermaw questline, a matched pair of swords): the questline steps are known, the item stats are not.
8. **Spell-rank training:** no source says which ranks to skip while leveling.
9. **Fortune:** confirmed to multiply item proc chances; whether it touches T2 or Veiled Shadows poison-proc bonuses is disputed.
10. **Post-patch PvP numbers:** burst reports ("halved") and denials both exist; there are no controlled tests.
11. **Rogue tank:** the build is pre-release (2026-02-12) and valid on the 1.18.1 tree, but no post-release tank build or gear sheet was posted.
12. **Crusader vs Agility** for Combat Envenom off hands, and **AP vs Agility** enchants on short fights, rest on single sims or tests.

guidePages.title: Rogue professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** on your first character, level with **Skinning + Leatherworking**: it keeps your leather gear up to date and does not slow you down Epickalen · 2025-11-02, Epickalen · 2026-03-12. At 60, drop Skinning for **Engineering**. Engineering is the only profession that adds to your damage, mainly through **Goblin Sapper Charges** and the **Gnomish Battle Chicken** Rheinwg · 2026-01-10, Rheinwg · 2026-01-21. For gold, take **Mining** (naked ZG mining is the standard rogue farm) plus Enchanting's **Disenchant** Searinoxx · 2026-04-03, Blindtongue · 2025-11-19. **Herbalism + Alchemy** works at every stage Rheinwg · 2026-02-10. Take **Lockpicking** and **Cooking** as your secondary skills feeder5 · 2026-03-23. Professions matter less for a rogue than for many classes. The whole Engineering package is called "very overrated" GumGuzz · 2026-03-25, and Alchemy does nothing for poisons, which are their own rogue skill Rheinwg · 2026-03-28.

Keep your Cured Rugged Hide for Naxx later | Epickalen · 2025-09-06, Farban · 2025-12-24 | | **Leveling, gold focus** | Mining + Herbalism, or Skinning + Herbalism | Mining + Herbalism earns more but takes more micromanaging | Hambaga · 2025-05-30, Weirdthing · 2025-10-17 | | **Leveling 50-60** | Enchanting (Disenchant) + a gatherer | Disenchant soulbound dungeon greens and blues as you go | Matt Lender · 2026-03-12, Blindtongue · 2025-11-19 | | **Raiding, all DPS specs** (Assassination, Combat, Subtlety) | Engineering + Leatherworking (or Enchanting) | Engineering is the only direct DPS gain. Leatherworking adds Dreamhide Leggings (haste) and the Naxx frost-resistance crafts | Rheinwg · 2026-01-31, Farban · 2026-03-12, Blindtongue · 2025-12-07 | | **Raiding on a budget** | Herbalism + Alchemy | Pays for your own consumables. A speedrun raider recommends two gathering or gold professions | Crite · 2025-06-25, Rheinwg · 2026-01-10 | | **Rogue tank / solo farming** | Jewelcrafting (+ Enchanting) | Vampirism kit: Twilight Opal Cascade, crafted rings, vampirism enchants | Blindtongue · 2025-12-01, TwistedMindz · 2025-10-13 | | **PvP** | Engineering + any | On-demand stuns, extra invisibility, parachutes, wormholes. About 90% of the value is sappers | andre · 2025-11-09, Premium (Retired) · 2026-01-25 | | **Gold-making at 60** | Mining + Enchanting (Disenchant) | Naked ZG mining and disenchanting boss loot are each quoted at over 100 g/h | Purge · 2025-11-19, Purge · 2026-04-17 |

sections.heading: What each profession gives a rogue
sections.markdown: ### Engineering - **Why:** "the only prof that will provide a bonus to your stats" Rheinwg · 2026-01-10. It's "Chicken and Sappers" Rheinwg · 2026-01-21. **Goblin Sapper Charges** are what make it worth taking Epickalen · 2025-10-06, Epickalen · 2025-11-09. Sappers only matter on packs, if you care about trash meters (see [Combat → AoE](#/class/rogue/combat-melee-dps)). - **Gnomish Battle Chicken:** "outside of explosives [it] is the only real DPS increase" Randomhero · 2026-02-10. On Turtle it runs on a fixed trinket timer, about once every 30 minutes, and recent changes removed the old trick of forcing it to proc Heffey · 2026-01-27, Heffey · 2026-01-27. **(single source)** - **Utility:** Orgrimmar wormhole ("bis"), XL jumper cables, parachute, on-demand stuns, extra invisibility, cheap underwater breathing GumGuzz · 2025-11-09, andre · 2025-11-09. The Death Ray, net and mind-control cap are fun PvP toys but not must-haves Randomhero · 2026-02-10. - **Contested value.** One veteran says it is "useful for exactly 1 raid" and that bombs are only required for Viscidus unless you speedrun; he still calls it technically BiS "because any improvement is improvement" Epickalen · 2026-01-27, Epickalen · 2026-01-27, Epickalen · 2026-01-27. Others say most DPS want it Heffey · 2026-01-27. "Throw 3 sappers during raid is good use of 300 engineering?" GumGuzz · 2026-03-25 - **Gnomish or Goblin:** level **Gnomish** first and craft the Battle Chicken, then switch to **Goblin** for sappers. The chicken keeps working after the switch Farban · 2025-12-24, Randomhero · 2026-02-10. Before switching, check your items: any item that "requires Goblin/Gnomish Engineering" stops working on the other specialisation ecthrus · 2025-11-27. - **Buy instead:** Goblin-only items can be bought from other players, but making your own sappers saves money over time Randomhero · 2026-02-10, Rheinwg · 2026-02-10. You need Engineering 250 to *use* Dense Dynamite and Goblin Sapper Charges Farban · 2026-03-12. ### Leatherworking (+ Skinning) - **Dreamhide Leggings** (3% haste, BoP) and the matching belt (1% haste) are LW-only haste pieces Blindtongue · 2025-12-07. The legs appear in current Combat/Assassination BiS lists (T0.5 4p + T2 3p + Dreamhide legs) and beat Bloodmask, but are "such a pain to get" Rheinwg · 2026-03-13, Matt Lender · 2026-03-16. For tanking, T2.5 legs beat them because they carry far more Stamina Scruff · 2026-01-31. - **Naxx:** Naxx gear needs a lot of **Cured Rugged Hide** (~20 g each). Leatherworking also makes frost-resistance gear for Naxx progression Farban · 2026-03-12. Cured Rugged Hide sells for a guaranteed 19-20 g every 72 hours Farban · 2026-01-02. - It also makes fire-resistance gear and a +spell power leather kit Rheinwg · 2026-01-10, plus armor/stamina kits Rheinwg · 2026-03-19. - **Elemental vs Tribal:** Elemental is better for your own gear. Tribal is steadier income (a pre-BiS healing cloak and other druid gear) Epickalen · 2025-10-31. **(single source)** - Some BoP recipes let you charge crafting fees of about 100 g each Epickalen · 2025-11-19. ### Enchanting (Disenchant) - You can disenchant anything at Enchanting skill 1 GumGuzz · 2025-11-04. A 50-silver vendor item becomes 3 g or more in materials GumGuzz · 2025-10-20. - "DE'ing is the most simple reliable way for rogue to make money": you do it on the side while soloing, and level 50-60 greens sometimes give 3 Greater Eternal Essences Blindtongue · 2025-11-19. Farming your T0.5 set with Enchanting leaves you "swimming in money" GumGuzz · 2025-11-04. - Pairs well with Engineering at 60: "Engi for dps, DE to get those mats from unwanted loot" Rheinwg · 2026-01-31. - Most rogue enchants come from Enchanting: everything except the blacksmith belt buckle, the jewelcrafting ring/neck enchants and the quest head/leg/shoulder enchants Rheinwg · 2026-03-19. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle custom) - **Ring and neck +Agility enchants** are jewelcrafter gem enchants GumGuzz · 2026-04-05, Rheinwg · 2026-03-19. A Turtle staff member says enchanted gemstones "are like enchants", so you do not need the Goldsmith specialisation to benefit ([Akalix (staff), 2025-06-19](https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/976193120809123881/1385337387206578301)). Buy them from a jeweler. - **Vampirism / solo kit:** the JC **Twilight Opal Cascade** has 12 Agility instead of 12 Stamina Blindtongue · 2025-12-01. The JC 3% vampirism trinket is "nice, but quite expensive" Abagorni · 2025-10-13, TwistedMindz · 2025-10-13. The crafted Dazzling Aquamarine ring with a vampirism enchant is part of the cheap solo set TwistedMindz · 2025-10-13. See [Assassination → Solo farming](#/class/rogue/assassination-melee-dps) and [Tank](#/class/rogue/combat-tank). - **Value:** "decent trinkets necks … but nothing that screams that you should grab it" Epickalen · 2025-01-15. "There isn't really any choices for rogue atm" in JC Zaszz · 2026-01-10. Pickpocketed gems feed it Fistofate · 2026-01-02. - **Gold:** gritted-paper margins are "an easy 1k gold a week" Epickalen · 2025-11-19. **(single source)** ### Blacksmithing - **Contested and niche.** The blacksmith belt buckle is the belt enchant Rheinwg · 2026-03-19. The Blacksmithing anti-fear trinket is the one reason a player kept the profession over LW Vale Grumby · 2025-12-07. A Sword rogue aims for the Swordsmith runed epic blade Ionnatra · 2026-03-20. - **1.18.1 crafted-weapon upgrades:** BWL drops upgrade items for crafted gear, and you need the matching specialisation to use the result ([Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272)). One player speculates that on a fresh server Blacksmithing "might become bis profession for this phase" Nandieb · 2026-03-23 **(single source, speculative)**. - **Ornate Bloodstone Dagger (OBD, crafted):** the recipe is rare, and crafting fees ran 200-700 g Purge · 2026-01-10. In 1.18.1 **rogue poisons and melee can no longer proc it**. Before the patch it was eating up 8-10% of a rogue's damage Istrefi · 2026-03-08, Scruff · 2026-04-26, Kananaios · 2026-04-26. Some still use it as a 1.3-speed dagger Zllig · 2026-03-25. Don't spend on one for its proc. ### Herbalism + Alchemy - Makes "hella money and save[s] you equally as much" through self-made potions Epickalen · 2025-10-07. Crafting your own flasks is usually cheaper than buying them Rheinwg · 2026-01-10. - It has no poison synergy Rheinwg · 2026-03-28. One raider says Alchemy is "nothing ground breaking since you can buy all those pots" Blindtongue · 2025-12-07. The potion market reportedly crashed because weekly quests flood it with supply Premium (Retired) · 2026-01-25. Raw herb prices are held down by lasher farmers Nandieb · 2026-02-27. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) - **Before 1.18.1:** Survival (cap 150) mostly meant **tents** for rested XP. Rogue levelers advised resting under a tent "every 1,5 levels" TwistedMindz · 2025-10-15. Gardening required Survival 75 ([official site](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening)). - **1.18.1 rework:** Survival now draws on the other professions and has 80+ recipes. It adds tools that slow, root or trap opponents, and gathering bags ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). Tents now only reach 25% rested; non-city taverns reach 100% (same source). Survival crafts include a **Simple Slingshot** usable for ranged pulls ([Atreidon (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172086#p172086)), Slowing Bolas and Throwable Nets ([Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172915#p172915)), and parachutes and gathering trinkets ([Elesion (player), 2026-03-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173031#p173031)). - **Rogue-specific:** Survival has "an early dagger you can craft with +1 dagger skill", worth making while leveling DesignerDave · 2026-03-23 **(single source)**. One gold-focused leveler ran Survival as support alongside Herbalism/Alchemy, Fishing and Cooking Vistarrk · 2026-03-18. The channel says nothing about bolas or nets in rogue PvP. - **Gardening:** **Sour Mountain Berries** (+10 Agility food, tradeable) are grown through Gardening and are a rogue raid food Epickalen · 2026-02-14, Rheinwg · 2025-10-21. Gardening "can be hella lucrative" if you market it Epickalen · 2025-11-19. One player has not confirmed the berries still work after 1.18.1 Raleias · 2026-04-06. ### Lockpicking, Pickpocket, Fishing, Cooking - **Lockpicking** is needed for class quest chains, and it "will make you money as long as you use it" Badknees · 2026-01-08. Fastest route: Hillsbrad → Badlands → Tanaris → Eastern Plaguelands/BRD Nandieb · 2026-01-27. Horde can spam the poison-quest box to about 170 riku · 2026-01-27. - **Pickpocket: stand still.** Pickpocketing while moving can play the loot sound and chat message without putting anything in your bags Rahnd2137 · 2026-02-25, Rahnd2137 · 2026-03-01, Amphion · 2025-01-12. - **Autoloot:** if two addons (for example SuperWoW and another) both have autoloot on, neither loots. Turn it off in one of them feeder5 · 2026-02-25. - **Pocket resets (contested):** one rogue says dungeon mobs only get new pockets when they die or the instance resets Epickalen · 2025-11-23; another saw BRD pockets refill after 15-20 minutes AFK Jay · 2025-11-23. - **Drop odds:** about 7-8% of pickpocketed mobs give a Heavy Junkbox, and BoE epics such as Alcor's Sunrazor come from about 0.125% of boxes, so about 800 boxes per epic on average Nandieb · 2026-02-27, Nandieb · 2026-02-27. Every Heavy Junkbox now also holds a Precise Lock Cylinder (see [Ravenholdt](#/class/rogue/professions)). - **Fishing:** Stonescale Eels earned one player 50-70 g/h Epickalen · 2025-11-19. Fish Oily Blackmouth pools as you pass for Free Action Potions Epickalen · 2026-02-10.

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **1-60:** Skinning + Leatherworking, leveled alongside your character Rheinwg · 2026-02-10, Epickalen · 2026-03-28. **Contested:** one player says professions slow leveling and gold is easier to farm at 60 Nandieb · 2026-03-12. Others got an epic mount two days after hitting 60 through professions, at 30-60 g/h Vistarrk · 2026-03-12, Vistarrk · 2026-03-13. 2. **50-60:** consider Enchanting for Disenchant Matt Lender · 2026-03-12. 3. **At LW 300:** drop Skinning for Engineering. Buy stones on the AH and level to 250 for Dense Dynamite and Sappers Farban · 2026-03-12. Do Gnomish first, then Goblin Farban · 2025-12-24. 4. Dropping a crafting profession loses its recipes, so swapping between JC, BS and others means relearning everything Badknees · 2026-03-13. 5. Alternative: level crafting professions on level-35 alts Yoridzen · 2026-04-12, or feed an alt's Leatherworking/Enchanting from your main's gathering Mage · 2026-04-17.

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: - **Goblin:** the Prospecting racial grants Mining *and* Jewelcrafting skill ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102965#p102965)). The rogue channel names no other race-profession interaction. For racials, see [Races](#/class/rogue).

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Best:** naked Mining in ZG ("best gold farm for rogues and easiest to do") Searinoxx · 2026-04-03, Purge · 2026-04-17; Disenchanting on the side Blindtongue · 2025-11-19. - Skinning is called "probably the worst" gathering profession for gold Purge · 2026-04-17, though Rugged Hide now sells for a gold or two each Epickalen · 2026-01-03. **Contested:** another player calls Mining "a really bad gold maker" Nandieb · 2026-02-27. - Realistic target: "any farm yielding 40g+ an hour is a decent farm" Nandieb · 2026-02-27. Soloing the HFQ last bosses with a vampirism setup, plus vendoring and disenchanting, yields about 40-60 g/h and Fashion Coins Allie :3 · 2026-04-03. - Pickpocketing BRD for raw gold is "terrible" per/hour MouseNo4 · 2025-11-19, Purge · 2025-11-19. It is worth doing for Heavy Junkboxes and BoE epics (see [Pickpocket](#/class/rogue/professions)).

sections.heading: Reputation and quest chains
sections.markdown: ### Ravenholdt reputation | Step | How | Sources | |---|---|---| | Neutral → Friendly | Pickpocket **Syndicate Emblems** from Syndicate humans in Alterac and Hillsbrad and turn them in | Freohr · 2026-03-15 | | Killing Syndicate | Gives no Ravenholdt rep on Turtle | Freohr · 2026-03-15, Im pro vise · 2026-02-13 | | Friendly → Exalted | Turn in **Precise Lock Cylinders**, 10 rep each: about 3,800-3,900 cylinders in total. The turn-in quest needs level 50 | Freohr · 2026-03-12, Epickalen · 2026-03-15, Freohr · 2026-03-16 | - **Where cylinders come from:** every Heavy Junkbox now holds one. They stack to 20 and can be bought and sold on the AH. Only rogues can farm them, but anyone can turn them in Freohr · 2026-03-15, Epickalen · 2026-03-15, Freohr · 2026-03-16. - **Cost:** buying your way to exalted was about 600 g in 2026-02 Im pro vise · 2026-02-13; one rogue spent close to 3k gold on cylinders in 2026-03 Epickalen · 2026-03-12. - **Rewards:** players still called the rep "essentially useless" in 2026-02 Makelovenot · 2026-02-21. The 2026-02-18 changelog moved the Dusksteel Throwing Blade to John Smith in Ravenholdt Manor Makelovenot · 2026-02-21. The class-weapon chain below does not need Ravenholdt rep galebushi · 2026-04-01, Floccumate · 2026-04-08. ### Class-weapon questline (1.18.1) The reward is a matched pair of one-handed swords Ionnatra · 2026-03-20. The starting quest is 42029 on the database Speedz · 2026-04-02. 1. **Start:** the item drops from the secret last boss of [Timbermaw Hold](#/instances/timbermaw-hold), about a 50% drop. One raid member must be Timbermaw exalted and do a quest chain to summon it Floccumate · 2026-04-09, galebushi · 2026-04-01, Nandieb · 2026-04-08. 2. **Steps players listed:** talk to an NPC in Ravenholdt Manor; sneak into Undercity or Stormwind to pickpocket someone (both NPCs are in throne rooms); kill a few elites; sneak into BRD with a Dark Iron dwarf disguise; kill the new BWL boss and an MC boss; bring 10 Elementium Ore galebushi · 2026-04-01, galebushi · 2026-04-01, Floccumate · 2026-04-09, Floccumate · 2026-04-09, galebushi · 2026-04-01, galebushi · 2026-04-01. 3. **Bug:** don't kill the MC boss with the MC weekly quest in your log. For one rogue the quest item then didn't drop, and he had to wait a week galebushi · 2026-04-02. ### Tier 0.5 (Darkmantle) chain - **Cost:** about 500 g Nandieb · 2025-12-16 to 600-700 g on Nordanaar Farban · 2026-01-27; one player guessed 1-2k Zllig · 2026-01-27. - **Lost amulet pieces:** don't delete "Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet" after its quest; the next step needs it. In 2026-02 this soft-locked a rogue's chain and GMs couldn't help Giselle <3 [Paije] · 2026-02-18. A patch a week later let **Bodley** restore Lord Valthalak's Amulet or its pieces Zllig · 2026-02-25.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown: - No sourced skill thresholds for rogue crafts (Dreamhide recipe source, JC vampirism trinket name and skill). - The full list of 1.18.1 Survival recipes, and whether Survival traps or bolas matter in rogue PvP, are not discussed in the rogue channel. - Nothing measures Engineering's actual raid DPS gain for rogues after the Battle Chicken timer change. - Whether 1.18.1 upgradeable crafted weapons include rogue daggers or one-handers was an open question Nandieb · 2026-03-23. See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/rogue)

name: Priest
summary: Priests on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 have three distinct jobs:
recommendation:
Priests on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 have three distinct jobs:

- **Holy** is a top-tier raid healer after the final patch.
- **Discipline** is a custom Holy-damage **Smite** DPS spec, and the best way to level.
- **Shadow** is a support DPS that every raid wants one of, for Shadow Weaving and Vampiric Embrace, even though its damage sits at the bottom of the meters.
overview:
Priests on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 have three distinct jobs:

- **Holy** is a top-tier raid healer after the final patch.
- **Discipline** is a custom Holy-damage **Smite** DPS spec, and the best way to level.
- **Shadow** is a support DPS that every raid wants one of, for Shadow Weaving and Vampiric Embrace, even though its damage sits at the bottom of the meters.

**New player recommendation:** level as Smite (wand, Spirit Tap, Holy, then Discipline; see [Leveling](#/class/priest/leveling)). At 60, pick Holy to heal or Smite/Shadow to DPS.

playbooks.title: Holy Priest (healer)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the post-1.18.1 **14/37/0** raid build, keep **Renew** rolling on tanks, use **Flash Heal** (rank 7 for big damage, rank 1 to top up) as your main single-target heal, and put **Prayer of Healing** on whichever party is hurt. Weave a rank-1 Renew between other heals so **Book of Prayer** refunds mana. Save **Ascendance** for enrage and burst windows. | | | |---|---| | Role | Raid and dungeon healer; raid buffs (Fortitude, Divine Spirit, Shadow Protection, Fear Ward), magic and disease dispels | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Top tier.** Players called the final-patch Holy "amazing" and "lovable" Greendam · 2026-05-15, Lynathel · 2026-04-24, t0uchm3 · 2026-04-19. With the targetable Prayer of Healing, Holy is seen as the second-best AoE healer after Chain Heal shamans Istrefi · 2026-03-19. | | Difficulty | Medium: you pick ranks and spells by hand, and you plan around the 5-second rule and Book of Prayer. | | Strengths | Renew + Flash Heal core, a targetable Prayer of Healing, Ascendance (a 30 s burst cooldown that also breaks CC), Power Word: Shield, the widest healer toolkit | | Weaknesses | Slow casts that faster paladin and shaman heals "snipe" Greendam · 2026-02-17; logs do not count shield absorbs, so meters under-report you Greendam · 2026-01-24; mana is tight while undergeared | Before 1.18.1, Holy was rated the weakest of the healers ("pala > druid/sham > priest") 30 · 2025-11-20. Old guides that call it weak, or that build around Proclaim Champion, are out of date. Proclaim Champion and its connected spells were removed in 1.18.1 Dreamhaze · 2026-01-24, [Jamey, 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid healer 14/37/0 (recommended) This is Bluefear's build ("what im running") Bluefear · 2026-03-30. It is one of several posted 14/37/0 builds that share the same core Bluefear · 2026-03-20, Kabooble · 2026-03-20, tomscorer · 2026-03-26. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Discipline | Mental Agility | 5/5 | | Discipline | Unbreakable Will | 3/5 | | Discipline | Improved Power Word: Fortitude | 2/2 | | Discipline | Inner Focus | 1/1 | | Discipline | Meditation | 3/3 | | Holy | Improved Renew | 3/3 | | Holy | Holy Focus | 2/2 | | Holy | Divine Fury | 5/5 | | Holy | Holy Reach | 2/2 | | Holy | Inspiration | 3/3 | | Holy | Holy Nova | 1/1 | | Holy | Empowered Recovery | 1/2 | | Holy | Improved Healing | 3/3 | | Holy | Spiritual Guidance | 5/5 | | Holy | Book of Prayer | 2/2 | | Holy | Spirit of Redemption | 1/1 | | Holy | Reservoir of Light | 3/3 | | Holy | Spiritual Healing | 5/5 | | Holy | Ascendance | 1/1 | Split **14/37/0**, validated with `talent_tool.py` (VALID). Calculator codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/priest?points=AoDCBD-aAFCAZLoRYAoB-` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=priest&t=00503020103-32050203113521351)) · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/priest/0UIC6I-K5237NDN6` Why these points: - **Spiritual Healing 5/5 is mandatory.** Healing spells lost 15% of base value (ranks above 30) and 15% of their scaling, and 5/5 Spiritual Healing brings you back to the old numbers Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-09, Duciel · 2025-10-09. - **Empowered Recovery: one point is enough.** Only the first point adds the extra Renew tick Blossom · 2026-04-06. Its 3% bonus does not affect Renew itself Greendam · 2026-03-20. Improved Renew 3/3 is taken only because Empowered Recovery requires it. On its own, Improved Renew raises Renew's base value only Greendam · 2025-10-29. - **Book of Prayer 2/2** refunds mana when a heal is a different *spell* from your previous heal. A different rank of the same spell does not count Bluefear · 2026-03-20, t0uchm3 · 2026-03-21. Power Word: Shield and Holy Nova do not count as healing spells for it Aeterna/Hanayanagi · 2026-03-21, Aeterna/Hanayanagi · 2026-03-23. - **Reservoir of Light 3/3** makes Lightwell worth about 4,000 extra smart healing per boss fight, which Bluefear prefers over 3% crit Bluefear · 2026-04-02. The consensus leans towards Reservoir of Light and Holy Reach over flat crit Bluefear · 2026-03-20, Snackz · 2026-03-20. - **Holy Reach 2/2** widens Prayer of Healing's radius, which Snackz calls "pretty huge" compared with 2% crit Snackz · 2026-03-20. It also helps on fights with strict positioning such as Firemaw Istrefi · 2026-03-19. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **More crit** | Move Holy Reach 2 + Holy Nova 1 into Divinity 3 | `AoDCBD-aYFAAYLoRYAoB-` ([calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=priest&t=00503020103-32350003013521351)) | Bluefear: "if you like more crit you can probably move points from holy reach/holy nova" Bluefear · 2026-03-30 | | **Low Spiritual Guidance** (Kabooble) | Spiritual Guidance 2/5 and Holy Reach 1/2; Divinity 5/5 and Empowered Recovery 1/2 instead of Holy Nova | `AoDCBD-aoFBAYLQRYAoB-` ([calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=priest&t=00503020103-32550103013221351)) | Saw only ~30 healing difference between ranks 2 and 4 in full Kara40 gear (single source) Kabooble · 2026-03-20 | | **21/30 hybrid** | Disc Enlighten points in exchange for some Holy throughput | no post-1.18.1 code posted | Lirya: "will make you lose out on some healing numbers but my guess is it will become quite popular" Lirya · 2026-03-27 | !!! warning "Pre-1.18.1 builds" Any build with Proclaim Champion, Champion's Grace, Revive Champion, "Swift Recovery", or a clickable Lightwell is from before 1.18.1. Old deep-Holy builds ran about 17/34/0 Bunker · 2025-04-09, and the Enlighten shape was 21/30/0 DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-04-25. Some Enlighten-healer builds were already dead before Champion's removal, because an earlier nerf cut Enlighten's proc rate from heals Greendam · 2026-03-02.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Healing power** until you reach roughly 1,000. With just under 1k healing power, Flash Heal, Renew and Prayer of Healing are "more then enough" Istrefi · 2026-04-15. 2. **Spell crit.** Inspiration and 150% crit heals favour it [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). 3. **Intellect**, then **Spirit**, then **mp5**, then **Stamina** (same source). Spirit converts to healing through Spiritual Guidance and to regen. Lirya's comparison: +30 Spirit food beats +8 mp5 food Lirya · 2026-03-26. 4. **Haste**: take cheap sources such as haste food and Juju. They matter for landing heals before other healers snipe them ("the difference between 1.1s and 1.2s flash is very real") t0uchm3 · 2026-02-13. Haste sources multiply with each other, and anything that pushes a cast below the 1.5 s GCD is wasted 30 · 2026-02-26, 30 · 2026-02-26. Caps: healing has none. Spell hit only matters for dispels and offensive spells. Useful numbers (tested in-game): - **Coefficients** after the 15% nerf: Renew 0.857, Heal 0.857, Greater Heal 1.0, Flash Heal 0.433, Prayer of Healing 0.433, Lesser Heal 0.433, Power Word: Shield 0.35 Mithreon · 2026-01-26. With 5/5 Spiritual Healing, Renew scales at about 1.12× healing power L-star · 2026-02-27. - **Power Word: Shield** = `942 × (1 + 0.15 Improved PW:S + 0.2 Force of Will) + healing power × 0.35`. The shield talents raise only the base value L-star · 2025-10-13, L-star · 2025-10-13. - A reference Kara40-tier healer reaches about 920 healing and 100-105 mp5 unbuffed 🐹 hamster 🐹 · 2026-02-03.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target healing (priority list)
rotationSingle.markdown: Target priority: you, then the tank, then the other healers, then DPS [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). 1. **Target about to die, and no time for a cast:** cast `Power Word: Shield`, then heal [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). Exception: on warrior and bear tanks, shield only before the pull or in a real emergency. An absorbed hit gives them no rage, roughly 12 rage lost per 1,000 absorbed Duciel · 2025-10-10, [Akos1896, 2025-09-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153177#p153177). 2. **Tank taking heavy damage, or anyone near half health:** `Flash Heal` rank 7 Istrefi · 2026-04-15, Istrefi · 2026-04-10. 3. **Big damage you know is coming (tank buster, enrage):** precast `Greater Heal` rank 1 Istrefi · 2026-04-10. With 8/8 T2, Greater Heal spam is also the tool for steady raid damage (see Gear). 4. **Tanks:** keep `Renew` (max rank) up at all times Istrefi · 2026-04-10. "Always Be cRenewing" Tzychotic · 2026-02-13. 5. **Anyone with a small amount of missing health:** `Flash Heal` rank 1 Istrefi · 2026-04-15. 6. **Between every heal:** cast `Renew` rank 1 on a raid member, or on yourself when nobody needs it, so the next heal is a different spell and Book of Prayer refunds mana Istrefi · 2026-04-10, Bluefear · 2026-03-20. Do not warp your healing to chase refunds. Heal normally and let them happen 30 · 2026-03-27. 7. **Mana conservation:** keep raiders at 80-90% instead of 100%. The missing 10-20% almost never causes a death Daimonoz · 2025-10-17. On a tank you are pre-healing, start the big heal and cancel it at about two-thirds of the cast bar if it is not needed. This keeps you inside long 5-second-rule regen windows Greendam · 2026-04-06. **Contested: Greater Heal's place.** Lirya calls Greater Heal "niche" in 1.18.1, with Prayer of Healing stronger where Greater Heal used to shine Lirya · 2026-03-27. Others keep 8/8 T2 Greater Heal spam for constant-damage fights such as Sapphiron and the first Kara40 boss Klurifax · 2026-03-22, 30 · 2025-12-28. t0uchm3 sees Flash Heal + Renew staying the foundation, with Prayer of Healing strong but not replacing it t0uchm3 · 2026-03-21.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE healing
rotationAoe.markdown: | Situation | Action | |---|---| | 3+ members of one party damaged | `Prayer of Healing` targeted on a member of that party. Since 1.18.1 you can target any group Istrefi · 2026-03-19, even players outside your raid Greendam · 2026-03-20. Rank 2 is the efficient default; use rank 4 to get everyone full fast Istrefi · 2026-04-10. | | Party-wide burst, mana to spare | `Inner Focus` + max-rank Prayer of Healing (a free cast) [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325) | | Repeated raid damage | `Lightwell` placed where the raid stacks: 10 charges or 1 minute, 20% of each direct heal (40% with 3/3 Reservoir of Light) echoed to another wounded player, at most once per 5 s per target Evershine · 2026-01-24, Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-02-17. Prayer of Healing does not trigger it Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-01-24. | | 2 targets | Renew each, Flash Heal the lower one | In dungeons while leveling, Prayer of Healing is worth its mana only if 3 or more people fully benefit Bluefear · 2026-02-12. As a heal, `Holy Nova` is outclassed by Prayer of Healing: rank-1 Prayer of Healing costs about half the mana for the same healing [Itsbacon, 2025-08-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143410#p143410). !!! bug "Lightwell targeting" After release, the new Lightwell ("Splendor of Light") healed full-health players and ignored wounded ones L-star · 2026-04-02, L-star · 2026-04-03. Staff shipped a hotfix for its targeting on 2026-03-24 [Torta, 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139), but the player bug reports came later (April). Treat Lightwell as a bonus, not a planned heal.

roleStrategy.heading: Role duties
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Dispels:** use Rinse or a similar addon. Nefarian's Mind Control showed up as a dispellable "buff", so blind dispel spam can strip allies' buffs L-star · 2025-10-18. - **Buffs:** keep Fortitude, Divine Spirit and Shadow Protection (on shadow fights) up. Avoid buffing tanks, ret paladins and enhancement shamans with extras they do not need. They hit the 32-slot visible buff cap, and a toggled buff pushed into the hidden slots can get stuck on until relog Greendam · 2025-11-05. - **Proactive healing:** pre-HoT and pre-cast on predicted damage instead of reacting. Paladins can spam and druids HoT, so a priest who only reacts gets sniped Pyronus · 2026-03-16.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Shielding warrior or bear tanks on pull (you deny their rage) Duciel · 2025-10-10. - Taking 2/2 Empowered Recovery (the second point adds nothing) Blossom · 2026-04-06. - Alternating ranks of the same spell for Book of Prayer (only different spells count) Bluefear · 2026-03-20. - Counting on Power Word: Shield or Holy Nova to trigger Book of Prayer Snackz · 2026-03-19, Aeterna/Hanayanagi · 2026-03-23. - Following Proclaim Champion or clickable-Lightwell advice (removed or reworked in 1.18.1) Dreamhaze · 2026-01-24. - Casting Holy Nova during Nefarian's priest class call Soundless · 2026-04-13. - Topping everyone to 100%: overhealing burns the mana you need later Daimonoz · 2025-10-17.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 loop for raids. For the reasons, see the linked sections. For dungeons while leveling, see [Leveling: Gameplay by level](#/class/priest/leveling). **Default heal by damage pattern:** | Damage pattern | Default | Notes | |---|---|---| | Tank, steady damage | Max-rank `Renew` always up, then `Flash Heal` R7 when damage is heavy | "Always Be cRenewing" Tzychotic · 2026-02-13 | | Tank, known spike (tank buster, enrage) | Pre-cast `Greater Heal` R1, and cancel it at about two-thirds if not needed | [Single-target](#/class/priest/holy-healer) | | Anyone near half health | `Flash Heal` R7 | Istrefi · 2026-04-15 | | Small damage on one player | `Flash Heal` R1 | Istrefi · 2026-04-10 | | 3+ damaged in one party | `Prayer of Healing` R2 on that party. Use R4, or `Inner Focus` + max rank, to fill them fast | [AoE healing](#/class/priest/holy-healer) | | Constant raid damage with 8/8 T2 | `Greater Heal` R1 spam | **Contested**, see [Single-target](#/class/priest/holy-healer) | | About to die, no time to cast | `Power Word: Shield`, then heal. Not on warrior or bear tanks except before the pull or in a real emergency | Duciel · 2025-10-10 | **Between heals:** cast `Renew` R1 on someone who needs it (or on yourself), so your next heal is a different spell and Book of Prayer refunds mana. Do not bend your healing to chase refunds Istrefi · 2026-04-10, 30 · 2026-03-27. **Triage order:** you → tanks → other healers → DPS [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). Heal raiders to 80–90%, not 100% Daimonoz · 2025-10-17. **Keep up:** Renew on the tanks. Fortitude, Divine Spirit, and Shadow Protection on shadow fights. Inner Fire. Fear Ward on the tank before fears. `Lightwell` before the pull, as a bonus only ([Cooldowns](#/class/priest/holy-healer)). **Mana plan:** 1. Heal in bursts, then stop casting so the 5-second-rule regen ticks Duciel · 2025-06-01. 2. Pre-cast and cancel on tanks instead of spamming small heals Greendam · 2026-04-06. 3. Take a Major Mana Potion early in long fights. Tea and runes share a cooldown ([Mana management](#/class/priest/holy-healer)). 4. Cast max ranks at endgame. Downrank only when you are short on mana (fresh 60, long fights) Greendam · 2026-04-18. **Cooldowns:** - `Ascendance` just before a boss enrages or a burst phase. It also breaks CC on you Dreamhaze · 2026-01-24. - `Inner Focus` for a free max-rank Prayer of Healing or Greater Heal. - `Fade` if you pull aggro. `Desperate Prayer` (Human/Dwarf) for a self emergency. **Dispels and utility:** dispel magic and diseases with Rinse (or a similar addon), and do not blind-spam dispels on Nefarian L-star · 2025-10-18. During Nefarian's priest call, use only Renew and Power Word: Shield Istrefi · 2026-03-20. More in [Role duties](#/class/priest/holy-healer).

extraSections.heading: Mana management
extraSections.markdown: - Heal in bursts, then stop casting so the 5-second rule regen can tick Duciel · 2025-06-01. - Take a Major Mana Potion early in long fights so the next one is ready in time. Tea and Dark or Demonic Runes share a cooldown [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). - **Contested: 3-piece T2 (15% regen while casting).** It is dead weight once your raid is fast and you finish fights with mana left t0uchm3 · 2026-03-31. It remains worth it on long, constant-damage fights t0uchm3 · 2026-03-22. - If you run out on long Kara40 fights, swap in Pendant of Forgotten Names and Ring of Spiritual Fervor (+20% regen while casting each) Fragui · 2026-03-31. - **Downranking:** at endgame you mostly cast max ranks. Downranking belongs to late leveling and a fresh 60 Greendam · 2026-04-18. When you do downrank, Heal rank 2+, Greater Heal rank 1+ and Renew rank 3+ keep full scaling [Sharmaine, 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161280#p161280).

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Healing frames:** Puppeteer (click-casting, heal prediction; the usual beginner pick) IllegallyParkedFrog · 2025-10-22, pfUI raid frames, or Luna Unit Frames Greendam · 2026-04-18. For Prayer of Healing prediction across groups, use t0uchm3's HealComm fix or MarcelineVQ's updated Luna t0uchm3 · 2026-03-25. - **Mouseover:** SuperWoW + SuperCleveRoidMacros for `[@mouseover]` Greendam · 2025-10-04. Example: `/cast [@mouseover help] Flash Heal;[@target help] Flash Heal;[@player] Flash Heal` Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-03. - **QuickHeal** (auto-target and rank): needs SuperWoW + UnitXP and does not work alongside Nampower's queue Greendam · 2026-02-13. Its fork adds Prayer of Healing group targeting (`/qh poh`) Demontap · 2026-03-28. - **Rinse** for dispels Istrefi · 2026-04-18; **LazyRes** for mass resurrection Greendam · 2025-11-22. Do not trust the TheoryCraft addon's priest coefficients on Turtle Greendam · 2025-10-16.

extraSections.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **Nefarian ([BWL](#/instances/blackwing-lair)), priest class call:** only Renew and Power Word: Shield are safe Istrefi · 2026-03-20. Holy Nova counts as direct healing and can kill people, including you Soundless · 2026-04-13. - **Firemaw (BWL):** healers stand at max range. Holy Reach and positioning matter Istrefi · 2026-03-19. - **Anomalus ([Kara40](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan)):** 8/8 T2 Greater Heal works well, but T2 alone cannot reach the Arcane Resistance floor. One recipe reaches 183 AR with enchanted head, legs, rings, cloak and neck plus a druid buff t0uchm3 · 2026-01-09. - **Sapphiron (Naxxramas):** a constant-damage fight where 3-piece T2 shines Klurifax · 2026-03-22. **Contested:** in progression-paced raids that push straight from Loatheb without waiting out the heal debuff, T2 becomes dead weight instead t0uchm3 · 2026-03-22. Renew does not trigger the fight's heal debuff t0uchm3 · 2026-03-22. - **Loatheb (Naxxramas):** Scarab Brooch Snackz · 2026-03-26.

extraSections.heading: Bugs and quirks
extraSections.markdown: - After a respec, especially through the dual-spec device, Spiritual Healing can silently stop applying to Renew (and possibly other heals), making them noticeably weaker than expected. Deleting the WDB cache folder fixes it 🐹 hamster 🐹 · 2026-02-27, L-star · 2026-02-27. - Buff tooltips do not update for talents or set bonuses. The spellbook numbers are the accurate ones Valaen · 2026-03-21.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Langorn's order, agreed with in the replies: healing power, then spell crit (Inspiration plus 150% crit heals), then Intellect, Spirit, mp5, Stamina. Priests convert Spirit well — it gives healing power as well as regeneration — so the five-second rule is the thing to play around; endgame BiS sits at 350–400 Spirit. There is no healing cap; hit only matters for dispels and offensive spells. Power Word: Shield scales with healing power rather than spell power per player testing.

glance.recommendation: Play the post-1.18.1 **14/37/0** raid build, keep **Renew** rolling on tanks, use **Flash Heal** (rank 7 for big damage, rank 1 to top up) as your main single-target heal, and put **Prayer of Healing** on whichever party is hurt. Weave a rank-1 Renew between other heals so **Book of Prayer** refunds mana. Save **Ascendance** for enrage and burst windows.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Raid and dungeon healer; raid buffs (Fortitude, Divine Spirit, Shadow Protection, Fear Ward), magic and disease dispels

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Top tier.** Players called the final-patch Holy "amazing" and "lovable" Greendam · 2026-05-15, Lynathel · 2026-04-24, t0uchm3 · 2026-04-19. With the targetable Prayer of Healing, Holy is seen as the second-best AoE healer after Chain Heal shamans Istrefi · 2026-03-19.

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium: you pick ranks and spells by hand, and you plan around the 5-second rule and Book of Prayer.

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Renew + Flash Heal core, a targetable Prayer of Healing, Ascendance (a 30 s burst cooldown that also breaks CC), Power Word: Shield, the widest healer toolkit

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Slow casts that faster paladin and shaman heals "snipe" Greendam · 2026-02-17; logs do not count shield absorbs, so meters under-report you Greendam · 2026-01-24; mana is tight while undergeared

glance.rest: Before 1.18.1, Holy was rated the weakest of the healers ("pala > druid/sham > priest") 30 · 2025-11-20. Old guides that call it weak, or that build around Proclaim Champion, are out of date. Proclaim Champion and its connected spells were removed in 1.18.1 Dreamhaze · 2026-01-24, [Jamey, 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).

playbooks.title: Discipline Priest ("Smite" DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** on Turtle, Discipline is a Holy-damage DPS spec built around Smite, not a shield healer. Play the **31/20/0** Smite build. Reach **10% haste** and **16% spell hit**, then stack spell power and crit. Loop **Holy Fire → 4 Smites**. Put **Chastise** on your top DPS and **Enlighten** on yourself. | | | |---|---| | Role | Ranged Holy DPS with support tools: Enlighten, Chastise haste on an ally, shields, dispels, emergency heals | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Viable, not top.** "competitive? no. viable? always" Greendam · 2026-04-06. At full BiS, Smite and Shadow do roughly the same DPS, but Shadow gets the raid slot for its debuff and mana return Greendam · 2026-02-13. Snackz's 1.18.1 sim puts Smite BiS at ~1,415 DPS before T3.5 and ~1,462 with T3.5 Snackz · 2026-03-21. Real parses: 1,500+ on Patchwerk Snackz · 2026-04-07, and a first Naxx Smite clear on 4-piece T3 + 5-piece T3.5 Hadjo · 2026-04-17. | | Difficulty | Medium: the rotation is simple, but the haste breakpoint and a missed Holy Fire punish you. | | Strengths | Turtle's unique take on the spec, praised as the only server that "got smiter priest right" limbless · 2026-04-21; the best leveling and farming spec (see [Leveling](#/class/priest/leveling)); off-heals and shields when needed | | Weaknesses | Threat Lynathel · 2026-04-24. Less raid utility than Shadow: some say Smite "brings nothing of value", others disagree (**contested**) L-star · 2026-03-25, Greendam · 2026-04-06. 1.18.1 made Disc gear holy-damage-only, which weakens off-healing 51108 · 2026-03-20, Greendam · 2026-04-01 |

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Smite raid DPS 31/20/0 (recommended) This is the "standard cookie-cutter Disc DPS build" (DemonBoyJr) DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-03-27. It is the most-posted Smite build in the channel (10 identical posts), and it passes the 1.18.1 tree rules. Post-1.18.1 advice is consistent with it: take Inner Focus and Improved Inner Fire Greendam · 2026-04-06, and "piercing light (which again idk why you'd ever drop it)" Snackz · 2026-02-26. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Discipline | Piercing Light | 3/3 | | Discipline | Mental Agility | 5/5 | | Discipline | Improved Power Word: Fortitude | 2/2 | | Discipline | Improved Inner Fire | 2/2 | | Discipline | Inner Focus | 1/1 | | Discipline | Meditation | 3/3 | | Discipline | Searing Light | 3/3 | | Discipline | Purifying Flames | 2/2 | | Discipline | Mental Strength | 3/3 | | Discipline | Enlighten | 1/1 | | Discipline | Force of Will | 5/5 | | Discipline | Chastise | 1/1 | | Holy | Holy Focus | 2/2 | | Holy | Divinity | 5/5 | | Holy | Divine Fury | 5/5 | | Holy | Holy Reach | 2/2 | | Holy | Holy Nova | 1/1 | | Holy | Spiritual Guidance | 5/5 | Split **31/20/0**, VALID. Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/priest?points=DoACRDaAZAAoB-CoFCABAo-` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=priest&t=035000221033231051-025502001005)) · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/priest/3U0E6LF6V-2Z2065` Key talents: - **Divine Fury** is the most important DPS talent, with 20% faster Smites Lirya · 2026-04-12. - **Mental Strength** supplies 3% of your 10% haste target. This haste does not show on the character sheet Snackz · 2026-02-27. - **Searing Light and Purifying Flames** drive the whole rotation. Searing Light makes a Smite instant after a crit; the mana cost of that instant Smite was buffed from 50% to 60% in 1.18.1 Snackz · 2026-01-24. Purifying Flames gives +12% Holy damage for 10 s after Holy Fire [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). - **Piercing Light** gives 6% hit, so you need 10% from gear irotos · 2025-12-08. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Threat** | Silent Resolve 5/5 instead of Improved Fortitude 2 + Meditation 3 | `DooARAaAZAAoB-CoFCABAo-` ([calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=priest&t=035500021003231051-025502001005)) | Pinned video "Discipline" build wily · 2025-07-01. Snackz runs 3/5 threat reduction in Kara40 to give the tank time Snackz · 2026-03-20, Snackz · 2026-03-20. With enough hit from T3.5 you can move Piercing Light points into Resolve Snackz · 2026-02-26. | | **Full T3 (8-piece)** 32/19/0 | Adds Improved PW:Shield 3 + Resurgent Shield 1 and drops Meditation and one Spiritual Guidance point | `DoACRYaAZIAoB-CoFCABAg-` ([calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=priest&t=035000221303231151-025502001004)) | HolyScheiss: "Ressurgent Shield really became a viable option with T3 6-set bonus" HolyScheiss · 2026-05-15 | | **Farming / solo 31/15/5** | Spirit Tap 5, Wand Spec 2; no Spiritual Guidance | `RoACRDaAZAAoB-CoFCAB-F` ([calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=priest&t=215000221033231051-025502001-5)) | Lirya's 60 grinding spec (Chastise interrupt, Force of Will) Lirya · 2026-04-12; the pinned leveling build wily · 2025-07-01 | Without the T3 6-piece, skip the shield talents. After the latest patch "I don't think there's a world where anyone should take the shield talents" Pyronus · 2026-04-17.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Haste to 10%** (10% haste > 16% hit > spell power/crit) Snackz · 2026-02-27. With 10% haste a single Searing Light proc fits 4 Smites into Holy Fire's 10 s Purifying Flames window. Below 10% you need two procs, which is unreliable even at BiS crit Snackz · 2026-03-12. Recipe: 3% from Mental Strength + 2% from food + 5% from gear and enchants Snackz · 2026-01-24, or 7% from gear without the food Koys · 2026-04-15. 2. **Spell hit to 16%** (6% from Piercing Light + 10% from gear) haunt · 2026-01-17, Snackz · 2026-02-20. Holy spells are binary: a spell either fully lands or fully misses Xerq · 2025-12-08. 3. **Crit after 10% haste.** Haste past 10% has little value; after that, crit scales with the Purifying Flames rotation Snackz · 2026-04-08, Tzychotic · 2026-03-30. Roughly 1% crit ≈ 12 spell power, but this moves with your gear Greendam · 2026-02-21, Vascher · 2026-01-12. 4. **Holy spell power**, then Intellect and mana. At high ping (~250 ms) 10% haste may not be enough Xerq · 2026-02-11. Test in-game and watch for "spell not ready" errors Greendam · 2026-02-11, Greendam · 2026-02-11.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Pre-pull:** Inner Fire, and Enlighten on yourself (+15%) or on one non-Smite DPS (+10% each). Two priests cannot stack Enlighten on each other Subzero · 2026-04-06. Chastise the tank on pull for haste and threat Xerq · 2026-03-25. **Opener:** `Inner Focus` → `Holy Fire` → 4× `Smite` → `Holy Fire` Snackz · 2026-01-27. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **`Holy Fire`** to start each cycle (it refreshes Purifying Flames). "1 HF 4 Smite is the rotation regardless how many searing light proc" Greendam · 2025-10-24. If the Holy Fire misses you get no buff, and must hard-cast it again ("ruins your parse") Greendam · 2026-04-06. 2. **`Smite` ×4.** Cast it instantly when Searing Light procs. 3. **Boss dies before the next cycle ends:** skip Holy Fire and finish with Smite + Chastise Greendam · 2025-10-24. 4. **`Chastise`** on cooldown (40 s) on a friendly arcane mage or affliction warlock. It costs you one Smite. Do not cast it on yourself: the GCD makes it a loss Snackz · 2026-01-27, Greendam · 2026-04-06. 5. **`Shadow Word: Pain`** only while moving Snackz · 2026-01-27. 6. **`Pain Spike`** as a trash finisher when the mob has under ~2 s to live HolyScheiss · 2026-05-15. Simple macro: `/castsequence reset=10 Holy Fire, Smite, Smite, Smite, Smite` Greendam · 2025-10-22. **Instant-Smite chains:** the instant Smite has an internal cooldown, and the order of crits matters. If Smite crits, Holy Fire does not, and the resulting instant Smite crits, you get another instant Smite. If Holy Fire also crits, you lose that chance, which some players find punishing Stunfisk · 2026-05-15, Stunfisk · 2026-05-15. ### T3.5 (5-piece) adjustment The 5-piece adds the Burning Zeal DoT. Change the cycle to **4× Smite → Holy Fire → 2× Smite → Shadow Word: Pain** (18.01 s), so the DoT ticks out without being clipped Snackz · 2026-03-21. Snackz first estimated only about +27 DPS, then called the DoT "cracked" after parsing 1,500+ on Patchwerk Snackz · 2026-04-07. Watch for resists. If the set's DoT is resisted, it also removes your Shadow Word: Pain, and you must recast both SW:P and Holy Fire Misandria · 2026-03-24, Misandria · 2026-04-17. Holy Fire on a target that already has SW:P rolls two resist checks Zvyrhol · 2026-04-17. ### Full T3 (8-piece) opener `Chastise` → `Holy Fire` → `Power Word: Shield` → 2× `Smite` → `Holy Fire`. After that, build Chastise and shield stacks toward Blessed Wildfire. HolyScheiss calls it "more loose and fun" than a strict rotation, with 5-6k+ Holy Fire crits fully buffed HolyScheiss · 2026-05-15. Early on, the T3 4-piece stacks capped at 4 in testing, and a bug report was filed Trinqucy · 2026-03-20, Snackz · 2026-03-25.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns, mana and threat
cooldowns.markdown: - **Inner Focus** (3 min): a free Holy Fire opener Snackz · 2026-01-27. - **Chastise** (40 s): the tank on pull, then your top DPS Greendam · 2026-04-06. - **Enlighten**: a 30-minute buff. Re-apply it after deaths. - **Racials:** High Elf is a strong Smite race (a rank-1 Holy Nova can fish Searing Light when low on mana). Night Elf gives about 1% haste. Human gives late-game Spirit. Undead Devouring Plague costs too much mana in a Smite rotation Snackz · 2026-02-28, Snackz · 2026-02-28. - **Mana:** Major Mana Potion and tea on cooldown. "As long as you use tea with mana potions and your guild kills bosses quickly, you will never run out of mana" [Zvyrhol, 2026-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174655#p174655). When low, rank-1 Holy Fire is cheap (about 80 mana) and scales well (same source). - **Threat:** it is the spec's chronic issue Lynathel · 2026-04-24. Use the threat variant, Fade, and the Chastise pull.

roleStrategy.heading: Dungeon, raid and solo notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Twin Emperors (AQ40):** a Smite priest can tank the caster twin with shadow-resistance gear. Skip the slow Holy Fire so you keep threat, and keep Flash Heal, Shield and a Shadow Protection potion as panic buttons. Shadow-resistance gear is harder to find than for Shadow priests Hadjo · 2026-01-15, Hadjo · 2026-01-15, Snackz · 2026-02-26, Snackz · 2026-02-26. - **[Hateforge Quarry](#/instances/hateforge-quarry) final boss:** soloable by a well-geared priest. The adds are immune to Shadow, so Smite or Holy damage and high stamina are needed Greendam · 2026-02-06, Greendam · 2025-10-05. - **Maraudon, Princess:** soloable by a geared Smite priest Snackz · 2025-12-05. - **Dire Maul East lashers:** the signature gold farm (Shield + Holy Nova spam; see [Leveling](#/class/priest/leveling)).

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Playing below 10% haste and relying on double Searing Light procs Snackz · 2026-03-12. - Casting Holy Fire before the cycle ends, which wastes Purifying Flames uptime Greendam · 2026-04-06. - Chastising yourself in raids (a GCD loss) Snackz · 2026-01-27. - Casting SW:P while standing still in raids Snackz · 2026-01-27. - Taking the shield talents without the T3 6-piece Pyronus · 2026-04-17. - Opening Holy Nova on an unestablished tank (it generates threat since 1.18.0) [Jamey, 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159).

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 Smite loop. For the details, see the linked sections. 1. **Pre-pull:** Inner Fire. `Enlighten` on yourself, or on one non-Smite DPS Subzero · 2026-04-06. 2. **Opener:** `Chastise` on the tank on pull Xerq · 2026-03-25 → `Inner Focus` → `Holy Fire` → `Smite` ×4 → `Holy Fire` Snackz · 2026-01-27. 3. **Single-target loop:** `Holy Fire` (refreshes Purifying Flames) → `Smite` ×4, casting the instant Smite whenever Searing Light procs. If Holy Fire misses, hard-cast it again. If the boss dies before the cycle ends, skip Holy Fire and finish with Smite Greendam · 2025-10-24, Greendam · 2026-04-06. Gear variants: [T3.5 5-piece](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps), [T3 8-piece](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps). 4. **Cooldowns:** `Chastise` every 40 s on a friendly arcane mage or affliction warlock, never on yourself in raids. `Inner Focus` goes on the Holy Fire opener Snackz · 2026-01-27, Greendam · 2026-04-06. 5. **AoE switch:** at **4+** targets with tank aggro established, spam `Holy Nova`. On long packs or when low on mana, alternate rank-1 Holy Nova with instant Smites. At 1–3 targets, keep the single-target loop ([AoE](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps)). 6. **Resources:** below 10% haste, the loop needs two Searing Light procs, so hit the haste breakpoint first ([Stats](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps)). Use Major Mana Potion and tea on cooldown. When low, cast rank-1 Holy Fire ([Cooldowns, mana and threat](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps)). 7. **Threat:** Holy Nova makes threat. Let the tank establish first (vanilla baseline). 8. **Movement:** `Shadow Word: Pain` only while moving. `Pain Spike` as a trash finisher when the mob has under about 2 s to live HolyScheiss · 2026-05-15. 9. **Emergencies:** `Power Word: Shield` and `Flash Heal` on yourself or others. Dedicated healing belongs to [Holy](#/class/priest/holy-healer) ([Discipline healing?](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps)).

extraSections.heading: Discipline healing?
extraSections.markdown: A deep-shield Disc healer is not viable at 60. Mana runs out, and the heals are weak compared with deep Holy t0uchm3 · 2026-03-10, L-star · 2026-01-01. A shield build loses about 24% healing against Spiritual Healing Greendam · 2026-03-02. Combat logs cannot attribute absorbs when two shields are on one target, so shield builds cannot even be measured properly Chronicle · 2026-04-17. If you want to heal, play [Holy](#/class/priest/holy-healer). As Smite, keep Flash Heal and Power Word: Shield bound for emergencies.

standing.source_quality: medium: single enumerated build (Langorn 31/13/7); rotation from staff mechanics plus four players; viability contested

leveling_by_bracket.advice: Buy the best wand (enchanting wands are OP); 2/2 Wand Specialization first; shield -> SW:P -> wand. Wanding beats casting before 40.

5/5 Spirit Tap then Holy tree to 5/5 Spiritual Guidance; spirit-stacking + Spirit Tap gives very high spell power for the level range. Fear Ward baseline at 20. Smite starts out-DPSing the wand around 30.
Shadowform comes online; respec Shadow at 42 (40 loses Wand Spec). HC smite works: Spirit Tap chain-pull, frontload 2-5 casts then wand/staff weave. Disc 'comes online' only at 60.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Hit first: the spec needs 10% from items on top of Piercing Light's 6% to reach the 16% boss figure, and hit is weighted far above crit while under the cap. Then spell power (general or Holy), then crit, which fuels Searing Light. Intellect and Spirit/mp5 come last but cannot be zero — stacking pure spell power at the cost of all regeneration causes mana problems on long fights. Crit versus spell power is contested after the Searing Light internal cooldown. Spirit and mp5 are a tie: no cited post ranks them against each other, so their order in the array above carries no ranking. Grouping them is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.
