glance.recommendation: On Turtle, Discipline is a Holy-damage DPS spec built around Smite, not a shield healer. Play the **31/20/0** Smite build. Reach **10% haste** and **16% spell hit**, then stack spell power and crit. Loop **Holy Fire → 4 Smites**. Put **Chastise** on your top DPS and **Enlighten** on yourself.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Ranged Holy DPS with support tools: Enlighten, Chastise haste on an ally, shields, dispels, emergency heals

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Viable, not top.** "competitive? no. viable? always" Greendam · 2026-04-06. At full BiS, Smite and Shadow do roughly the same DPS, but Shadow gets the raid slot for its debuff and mana return Greendam · 2026-02-13. Snackz's 1.18.1 sim puts Smite BiS at ~1,415 DPS before T3.5 and ~1,462 with T3.5 Snackz · 2026-03-21. Real parses: 1,500+ on Patchwerk Snackz · 2026-04-07, and a first Naxx Smite clear on 4-piece T3 + 5-piece T3.5 Hadjo · 2026-04-17.

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium: the rotation is simple, but the haste breakpoint and a missed Holy Fire punish you.

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Turtle's unique take on the spec, praised as the only server that "got smiter priest right" limbless · 2026-04-21; the best leveling and farming spec (see [Leveling](#/class/priest/leveling)); off-heals and shields when needed

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Threat Lynathel · 2026-04-24. Less raid utility than Shadow: some say Smite "brings nothing of value", others disagree (**contested**) L-star · 2026-03-25, Greendam · 2026-04-06. 1.18.1 made Disc gear holy-damage-only, which weakens off-healing 51108 · 2026-03-20, Greendam · 2026-04-01

playbooks.title: Shadow Priest (ranged DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** raids bring one Shadow priest for Shadow Weaving (+15% Shadow damage taken) and for Vampiric Embrace healing and mana. Play **0/20/31** (Spiritual Guidance secondary). Reach **16% spell hit**, then stack **shadow spell power**; ignore haste. Keep **SW:P** up, cast **Mind Blast** on cooldown, and fill with **2 Mind Flays**, clipped by hand. Use VE only when the group actually needs mana or healing. | | | |---|---| | Role | Single-target caster DPS plus support: Shadow Weaving for warlocks, VE mana and healing, shields, dispels, Mind Control duties | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Bottom-tier DPS, but always wanted.** "Shit tier in dps but viable, raids want at least one" Greendam · 2026-03-26. At the highest level Shadow and Disc are both in the worst DPS tier Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. Top players reach ~2,000 DPS on long single-target fights like Patchwerk, which is the spec's best case Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-31, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-31. Its main advocate called it "the best state out of any lvl 60 server" yet still the weakest spec Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-05-02. | | Difficulty | Medium-high: manual Mind Flay clipping, threat control, mana | | Strengths | Raid Shadow damage amplification, mana battery, off-healing through VE, and the ability to tank shadow casters | | Weaknesses | No real AoE Tzeip · 2025-10-29; crit and haste barely matter Orb · 2026-03-15; very high threat Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-11; mana-starved without consumables Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-05-15; 20-yd Mind Flay range; often behind the tank on trash Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-24 |

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Spell hit to 16%** against raid bosses. That is 10% from 5/5 Shadow Focus plus 6% from gear, or 5% plus 1% from a druid's Emerald Blessing Greendam · 2026-04-02, AȥυɾҽSƙყ · 2025-10-19. At 3/5 Shadow Focus you need 10% from gear. 2. **Spell power** (shadow or general), your only real scaling stat Greendam · 2025-11-07. 3. **Crit:** worth about 3-4 spell power per 1% in 1.18.1, because Mind Blast crits now trigger Spirit Tap Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-14, Mendeleev · 2026-04-15. Before 1.18.1 it was about 2.5-3 spell power Shadurloc · 2026-02-22. Only Mind Blast (and Pain Spike) can crit; Mind Flay and SW:P cannot Orb · 2026-03-15. 4. **Spirit:** about 4 Spirit ≈ 1 spell power through Spiritual Guidance Greendam · 2025-11-20. 5. **Haste: zero value.** Mind Flay's channel ignores it and it does not shorten the GCD Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-15, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-19. You would need about 13% haste for a fourth Mind Flay tick, which is not viable irotos · 2025-11-13. **Spell penetration** matters only against high shadow resistance. Most bosses have 10-40 shadow resistance. Mephistroth has ~200 (~125 after Curse of Shadow), so you need about 75 more removed from gear. Kel'Thuzad has ~100 Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-11-07, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-11-08. Mind Flay ticks are binary (each fully lands or fully resists), so being under-penetrated costs you whole ticks Greendam · 2025-11-07. The formula used by the server core: `HitChance = (96 + SpellHit) × (1 − (Resist − Pen) × 0.15/60)` McPewPew · 2026-03-29.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Pre-pull:** Shadowform, Inner Fire, and Power Word: Shield if you expect pushback. **Opener:** `Shadow Word: Pain` (plus `Vampiric Embrace` first only if the fight needs it) → `Mind Blast` → `Mind Flay` ×2 Greendam · 2025-10-22, Shangchi · 2026-02-12. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **`Shadow Word: Pain`** if missing and the target will live at least 3 ticks (~9 s) Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-03. Do not clip DoTs early Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-02-04. 2. **`Mind Blast`** on cooldown, but watch threat. A 3.5k Mind Blast crit with VE running generates about 7,200 threat Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-11, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-02-25. 3. **`Mind Flay`** as filler: 2 per Mind Blast cooldown Myrraka/Joshua · 2025-12-18. Clip the channel by hand right after the last tick you want. Watch the latency band on the cast bar to cancel safely into Mind Blast Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-13. Two 3-tick Flays are more mana-efficient than three 2-tick Flays Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-21. Never stop a Flay by moving; that delay is "REALLY bad" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-17. 4. **`Vampiric Embrace`** only when the group needs mana or healing. Never cast it while Fade is active, and rarely while a trinket is running Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-09, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-24. VE's healing threat is not reduced by Shadow Affinity Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-02-25. 5. **`Fade` before a SW:P refresh** when you wear the T3.5 3-piece (Fade grants +15% Shadow damage for 10 s). With a snapshot-friendly trinket such as Eye of Dormant Corruption, this tested as a net DPS gain Mendeleev · 2025-11-22. On its own, the bonus mostly offsets the GCD Fade costs McPewPew · 2025-04-03. 6. **`Pain Spike`** as a finisher. Even as filler it is "better than 0 dps": most bosses reduce healing, so little of its self-heal-back actually lands Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-02-21. 7. **`Devouring Plague`** (Undead): slightly less damage than SW:P for more mana, barely worth a GCD Izhan · 2026-04-06. **Clipping tools:** Zitronenhaze advises clipping by hand from the start Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-16. Nampower's "queue channeling spells" is easier but slower. **Contested:** Zitronenhaze measured about a 125 ms delay (trainable to ~50 ms) when clipping Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-17; Doomsvilla could not reproduce it on a current Nampower build Doomsvilla · 2026-04-17. **Trinket order** (example: Remains + Essence + Scythe). Pop the passive-cooldown trinket about 30 s before the pull, then Essence on pull, then Scythe. Using Scythe first locks Essence for a minute Greendam · 2026-01-25. The Zandalarian Hero Charm lets you snapshot SW:P at your highest spell power Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-02.

cooldowns.markdown: - **Shadowform** gives a passive 15% in-combat mana regen Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-11-07. Mana is still tight. Sustain means VE plus a mana potion and tea on cooldown, "or you would run dry" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-05-15. Teas are cheap (about 1g for 5 from a vendor) and work like Demonic Runes Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-31. - **Shadow Weaving (1.18.1)** stacks on *you* as you cast. Each shadow spell then applies your full stack count to its target, so new targets get the debuff at once Shadurloc · 2026-01-24. The debuff lasts 9 s (down from 15 s), which players suspect may be too short by design Liddy · 2026-03-21. How several shadow priests' stacks interact was never confirmed irotos · 2026-03-08. - **Fade (1.18.1)** reduces threat by 15% while active and removes a flat amount, but you still gain threat normally, so it only delays a pull Trinqucy · 2026-03-20. - **Threat:** Mind Blast's threat multiplier is 170% (down from 200%) Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-19. VE's healing and mana return add threat on top Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-11. Against a fresh tank, open with SW:P and Mind Flay and delay Mind Blast.

roleStrategy.heading: Utility duties
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Mind Control** (Razuvious, Faerlina): Razuvious needs 16% hit; the T3 2-piece hit bonus counts toward it AȥυɾҽSƙყ · 2026-01-15. On Faerlina, MC the first add on pull and Silence it at once (5 yd range) to stop Poison Volley. Time later MCs right after a Rain of Fire Greendam · 2025-10-27. Early MC breaks are usually caused by range, a Tremor Totem, someone dispelling, or a fat-fingered spell 30 · 2026-02-22. There is also a small per-tick break chance Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-02-14. - **Shadow tanking:** with 315+ shadow resistance a Shadow priest can tank the AQ40 Twin Emperors caster twin and Bishop-type casters. The Empowered Shadow Bolt only hits within about 20 yd. Mendeleev calls it "the easiest tank to heal", sustained by Renew and VE Mendeleev · 2026-03-01, Mendeleev · 2026-03-01. Drop the threat-reduction talents and Salvation for it Misandria · 2025-11-20. A full planned shadow-resistance set (Runed Stygian pieces, Juno's Shadow, Garb of Royal Ascension, Anathema, and more) is posted at IllegallyParkedFrog · 2025-11-21. Shadow priests can also tank the Kara40 Chess event Mendeleev · 2025-10-15.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 Shadow loop. For the details, see the linked sections. 1. **Pre-pull:** `Shadowform`, Inner Fire, and `Power Word: Shield` if you expect pushback. 2. **Opener:** `Shadow Word: Pain` → `Mind Blast` → `Mind Flay` ×2. Cast `Vampiric Embrace` first only if the fight needs mana or healing Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-09. Against a fresh tank, delay Mind Blast ([threat](#/class/priest/shadow-ranged-dps)). 3. **Single-target loop:** keep SW:P up without clipping it, on targets that live 3+ ticks → `Mind Blast` on cooldown → 2 × `Mind Flay` per Mind Blast cooldown, clipped by hand after the last tick you want. Never stop a Flay by moving Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-17. `Pain Spike` as the finisher ([Single-target rotation](#/class/priest/shadow-ranged-dps)). 4. **Cooldowns:** pop trinkets from the passive one first, and snapshot SW:P under them (Zandalarian Hero Charm) Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-02. With the T3.5 3-piece, `Fade` → SW:P refresh Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-11-29. 5. **AoE switch:** at 2–4 targets, single-target the kill target and SW:P extras only if they live 3+ ticks. At **5+**, spam `Holy Nova` until mana runs low (about 9–10 casts) ([AoE](#/class/priest/shadow-ranged-dps)). 6. **Resources:** use Major Mana Potion and tea on cooldown. Use `Vampiric Embrace` only when the group needs mana or healing, and never during Fade Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-05-15, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-09. 7. **Threat:** Mind Blast crits under VE spike threat. Watch the meter and `Fade` before you pull aggro. Fade only delays a pull Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-11, Trinqucy · 2026-03-20. 8. **Movement and range:** Mind Flay reaches only 20 yd, so stay close. While moving, refresh SW:P or cast instants. To heal in an emergency, drop Shadowform ([macro](#/class/priest/shadow-ranged-dps)).

extraSections.markdown: - **Cursive:** accurate SW:P tracking, with a clickable list of mobs in combat Duciel · 2025-11-30, Potatolord · 2026-03-11. - **Quartz3:** shows Mind Flay ticks on the cast bar Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-29. - **Mind Flay without self-interrupting** (pfUI): `/run if pfUI.castbar.player:GetAlpha() ~= 1 then CastSpellByName("Mind Flay") end` Mendeleev · 2026-04-17. - **Out-of-form mouseover Flash Heal:** `/cancelaura Shadowform` + `/cast [@mouseover help] Flash Heal;[@target help] Flash Heal;[@player] Flash Heal` (needs SuperWoW and SuperCleveRoidMacros) Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-03, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-03. - **DoiteAuras** tracks Shadowform as a form and auras beyond the buff cap Doite · 2026-02-07.

extraSections.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **[Kara40](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan):** Anomalus, Gnarlmoon and Kruul are where Shadow shines Mendeleev · 2025-10-15. On Mephistroth, penetration matters (see Stats); Eye of Moam can be used twice, on pull and for phase 2 Greendam · 2025-11-07. His crystals have no shadow resistance, so Holy Nova works on the imps Shadurloc · 2025-11-07. The T3.5 debuff is immune on 3 of 9 bosses Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-24. - **Naxxramas:** Heigan is the fight where the 20-yd Mind Flay range hurts Olivaar of Moments · 2025-12-28. For Anub'Rekhan trash, the current strat starts the run inside the Anub room via invisibility potions, with a paladin waiting outside to gather the packs before the gate; pulling them in with a hunter pet is the older approach Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-16. Pre-patch benchmarks from the top parser: Anub'Rekhan 2,030, Maexxna 1,918, Noth 1,905, Loatheb 1,704 and Patchwerk 1,692 DPS Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-13. - **Nefarian ([BWL](#/instances/blackwing-lair)):** the classic warning is that keeping VE up through the priest class call can kill your group [Jcarrill0, 2019-02-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=2080#p2080). On Turtle, players report the class call only turns direct heals lethal, so VE, Renew and Power Word: Shield are fine to keep running Faded · 2025-12-22. - **Maraudon, Princess:** soloable in Shadow by circling. She drops Blade of Eternal Darkness at about 1% Durzoblint · 2024-08-10, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-02-24. - **Razorfen Kraul:** soloable at 60 as Shadow, using Mind Soothe to skip packs Exhale · 2025-12-10.

extraSections.heading: Bugs and quirks
extraSections.markdown: - **Mind Control drops Shadowform:** when a boss Mind Controls you, you can end up unable to recast Shadowform. Workarounds: be Undead (break the MC), get CC'd by someone, take a mage portal, or relog Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-09, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-07. - Shadow Weaving can stop proccing after you log out while dead, until you relog ft · 2026-04-17, Bluedolf · 2026-04-13. - The Shadowform visual fades after mounting. Reapply Shadowform to restore it Pablito el Grande · 2026-03-17, Shadurloc · 2026-04-08. - After 1.18.1, VE stopped healing warlock Greater demons specifically; imps and succubi still get healed Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-09.

glance.recommendation: Raids bring one Shadow priest for Shadow Weaving (+15% Shadow damage taken) and for Vampiric Embrace healing and mana. Play **0/20/31** (Spiritual Guidance secondary). Reach **16% spell hit**, then stack **shadow spell power**; ignore haste. Keep **SW:P** up, cast **Mind Blast** on cooldown, and fill with **2 Mind Flays**, clipped by hand. Use VE only when the group actually needs mana or healing.

facts.markdown: Single-target caster DPS plus support: Shadow Weaving for warlocks, VE mana and healing, shields, dispels, Mind Control duties

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Bottom-tier DPS, but always wanted.** "Shit tier in dps but viable, raids want at least one" Greendam · 2026-03-26. At the highest level Shadow and Disc are both in the worst DPS tier Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. Top players reach ~2,000 DPS on long single-target fights like Patchwerk, which is the spec's best case Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-31, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-31. Its main advocate called it "the best state out of any lvl 60 server" yet still the weakest spec Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-05-02.

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium-high: manual Mind Flay clipping, threat control, mana

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Raid Shadow damage amplification, mana battery, off-healing through VE, and the ability to tank shadow casters

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: No real AoE Tzeip · 2025-10-29; crit and haste barely matter Orb · 2026-03-15; very high threat Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-11; mana-starved without consumables Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-05-15; 20-yd Mind Flay range; often behind the tank on trash Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-24

playbooks.title: Priest PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** for solo and small-group PvP, play **Discipline (Smite)** for burst and shields, or **Shadow** for sustained pressure and near-undispellable DoTs. Pick by matchup: "both are viable imo. Play what suits you better" Zeraya · 2026-03-29. Do not solo-queue as Holy: "you spend 50% of your time looking at a black & white screen" Zeraya · 2026-03-28. Gear for **stamina**, cap at **3% hit**, and expect a burst meta. Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp).

overview.heading: Spec overview
overview.markdown: | Spec | PvP standing | Strengths | Weaknesses | |---|---|---|---| | **Discipline (Smite)** | Favoured by many priest PvPers | The highest burst (Holy Fire into instant Smites), stronger shields and off-heals Zeraya · 2026-03-29; ally Chastise breaks Sap and Blind [Isvya, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103744#p103744) | More exposed to Curse of Tongues and melee Zeraya · 2026-03-29; off-healing feels weak against Mortal Strike-type debuffs without a 30% healing/mana talent Liracrime · 2025-10-29 | | **Shadow** | Viable | SW:P plus Shadow Weaving applies six debuffs at once, so it is very hard to dispel Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22; VE sustain; Silence; fear | Short Mind Flay range (20 yd), unreliable stuns, one damage school Zeraya · 2026-03-29; 1.18.1 dampening and resilience cut both crits and DoTs, and VE healing is reduced twice Koys · 2026-04-08, Potatolord · 2026-04-01 | | **Holy** | BG healer only | Dispels, shields, Ascendance works as a second CC break DrakeReinz · 2026-03-25 | Cannot win fights alone Shadurloc · 2026-03-23, Zeraya · 2026-03-28 | Both damage specs "suffer from overtuned enhancers and rogues mostly" Zeraya · 2026-03-29. Rogues are the matchup priests complain about most Greendam · 2025-10-11. Pre-1.18.1 tier lists from `#pvp-general` disagree with each other. One post-CC2 list put Smite in A, Shadow in B and Holy in C mtnd · 2025-03-23; a 1.18-preview list put Priest in B saplingsam · 2025-08-14. That channel ends in 2025-11, so it has no post-1.18.1 data. `#pvp-general` also shows Priest was seen as one of the least-played PvP classes on Ambershire ("9/10 games not a priest on horde team") Nandieb · 2025-10-03, and Holy struggled to heal through melee 1v1 Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-03 — yet other posters called Priest (Smite and Holy alike) overtuned. One tier list put Shadow Priest in the top "Z tier" with Shaman, Rogue, Mage and Paladin, and Smite Priest in "S tier"; a reply suggested Holy Priest belonged in F tier instead Thirtyseven · 2025-10-11, Liracrime · 2025-10-11. Ythor separately rated Smite Priest S tier Ythor · 2025-10-21, and Temu called Smite "more insane than Shaman" on the Tel'Abim server, citing priests "regularly going like 37-3 in AB" Temu · 2025-10-24, Temu · 2025-10-24; Bipst disputed the Smite ranking specifically ("no, smite priest is not s tier. Healer priest is good though") Bipst · 2025-10-21. On the healer side, dindunuffinz called Priest an overtuned healer — deceptively tanky, spammable shields, and 500-600 Renew ticks that cancel DoTs — citing one geared Horde priest who reportedly did 1,000,000 healing in a single AV and felt "more tanky than any alliance warrior" dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19, corroborated by a self-described unbiased PvE player Exhale · 2025-10-19. Ythor also flagged a faction imbalance in fear uptime: Horde priests can chain-fear melee much more reliably than Alliance priests Ythor · 2025-10-19.

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Hit: 3%** against level-60 players is enough, so spare Shadow Focus points can go elsewhere DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-31. **Contested:** 3% [Heroclastus, 2024-10-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102752#p102752) vs 4% [Zvyrhol, 2024-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102656#p102656). - **Stamina > Intellect > Spirit** for a big health and mana pool Tzychotic · 2026-02-14. "Stamina is your only defence" [Springboards, 2024-07-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98805#p98805). - **Burst meta:** "in twow you have burst meta anyways, so you need kara gear for pvp" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-19. The 1.18.1 PvP T2/T3 sets have *less* stamina and armor than the old rank 12-14 sets Zeraya · 2026-03-28, Zeraya · 2026-03-28. - **Power Word: Shield scales with healing power.** Disc PvPers who want bigger shields trade damage for +healing Illithris · 2026-04-15, [Gottabe, 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173328#p173328). - **Honor-vendor catch-up on Nordanaar:** Ornate Bloodstone Dagger, Spellwoven Nobility Drape (11 SP, 1% hit), and assorted "of Shadow Wrath" pieces Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-19, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-19. - **Weapons:** Soulseeker (−25 target resistance) for Smite [Zvyrhol, 2024-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102656#p102656). For Night Elves, a bow is PvP-only utility; Time Frozen Bow is called BiS [Blackduck4, 2025-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159517#p159517), Xerq · 2026-02-18. The community-nicknamed "BR dagger" (also BiS for Rogues and Mages) is also "very good" for Priests Jesse Potter · 2025-10-30. - **Trinkets:** the PvP trinket now removes all effects, not just class-specific ones Zuley · 2025-11-19. Reflectors counter specific classes Arkimonday · 2025-04-11. A rogue's Shadow Reflector hard-counters Shadow L-star · 2026-03-23. - **Enchants:** no PvP-specific priest enchant list was posted (gap). Use stamina and spell power versions of the PvE enchants. - **Gear gap:** a forum thread flagged that Priests have no dedicated heal+ PvP set (Druids lack a leather healing PvP set too) Cenandrah · 2025-10-07.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Disc (Smite) 1. Pre-fight: Inner Fire, Enlighten, and Power Word: Shield on yourself. 2. **Opener:** self-`Chastise` → `Inner Fire` → `Holy Fire` (hoping for a crit) → spam `Smite`, using each instant Smite from Searing Light YN · 2025-10-15. 3. Instant Smites have a 1.5 s internal cooldown. Weave another spell between them Misandria · 2025-12-20. One player clocked a Smite-proc chain doing about 5k damage in 3 seconds Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29. 4. Against melee and casters: keep Psychic Scream or Chastise for when a mage channels Arcane Missiles or a warlock casts Dark Harvest. Otherwise shield, dispel, spam Holy Nova and fish for instant Smites Evershine · 2026-01-20. 5. **Chastise as CC or as damage:** if you disorient the target with Chastise, follow with Smite, not Holy Fire. Holy Fire's DoT breaks the disorient [Kobiq, 2024-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111295#p111295). 6. **Ally Chastise:** use it to break Sap or Blind on a teammate [Isvya, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103744#p103744). Chastise priority for haste: affliction warlocks and arcane mages > two-hand melee > dual-wield melee HolyScheiss · 2025-06-14. ### Shadow 1. `Power Word: Shield` on yourself → `Vampiric Embrace` → `Shadow Word: Pain` (with Shadow Weaving it lands as six debuffs, very hard to dispel; players suspect this is unintended) Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22, Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. 2. `Mind Blast` → `Mind Flay` from 20 yd. Against warriors, skip Mind Blast unless it kills: crits give them rage Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. With around 450 spell power, Mind Flay reportedly ticks for 500+ damage, and Blackout can proc back-to-back stuns while you channel it — a common melee complaint Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29. 3. `Pain Spike` as the finisher: "outlast ~80% and then finish you off with an instant" [Atreidon, 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124839#p124839). 4. `Psychic Scream` when melee reaches you. Expect trinkets, WotF and Fear Ward. Against a Fury warrior, bait their Berserker Rage (fear/root break, ~30 s cooldown, Battle Stance only) with a Fear, then land an engineering Net right after; Arms warriors lack that break and can be Netted or Feared immediately, but the Fury talent Deathwish reportedly grants fear immunity in any stance Spiff · 2025-10-27, Spiff · 2025-10-27, Spiff · 2025-10-27. 5. `Silence` aggressive casters such as a frost mage trying to Nova and Arcane Explosion a node PBE(Erzsbet) · 2025-04-13. Blackout is PvP-only, and its 2 s stun is considered "almost useless" Tzeip · 2025-10-06. Some `#pvp-general` posters disputed that Shadow was overpowered at all, since it is "literally locked to a single school of spells unless they drop form" and needs an Affliction-style passive, range-abusing playstyle to be effective Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-10-29, Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-10-29.

A geared warrior can still shred a 5.6k-HP priest in about 5 s | Shadurloc · 2026-03-23, Shadurloc · 2026-03-23, Mmr · 2025-03-17 | | Rogue | Fear and DoT them. DoTs stop re-stealth. mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Solo-queueing as Holy Zeraya · 2026-03-28. - Mind Blast crits on warriors Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. - Holy Fire after a Chastise disorient (the DoT breaks it) [Kobiq, 2024-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111295#p111295). - Wasting fear into a trinket, WotF or Fear Ward. The PvP trinket now removes everything Zuley · 2025-11-19. - Stacking PvE tier sets over stamina [Springboards, 2024-07-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98805#p98805). - Expecting any feedback from Unbreakable Will; players have asked whether it gives any notification when it resists a stun and gotten no confirmed answer, so assume it is silent (vanilla baseline). !!! bug "Mind Vision sniping (fixed)" Mind Vision used to proc the Scythe of Elune weapon effect at extreme range (200+ yd), letting priests kill enemies from far away without engaging Pastor · 2025-10-18. Reported fixed after complaints Shiro · 2025-10-18. 59 twinks: pre-shield and pre-Renew, and "you should only be able to die Vs rogues in a 1vs1" Xerq · 2026-03-13.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP loops. For the details, see [Burst and control sequences](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp), [Matchups](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp) and [Battleground role](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp). Cooldowns are from the 1.18.1 client data. **Discipline (Smite):** 1. **Pre-fight:** Inner Fire, Enlighten (60 s cooldown) and `Power Word: Shield` on yourself. Keep Fear Ward (30 s cooldown) on yourself against fear classes (vanilla baseline). 2. **Burst:** self-`Chastise` (40 s cooldown, 25 yd) → `Holy Fire` → `Smite` spam, taking every instant Smite from Searing Light YN · 2025-10-15. Weave another spell between instant Smites (1.5 s internal cooldown) Misandria · 2025-12-20. Night Elves can weave bow Searing Shot on the move to proc an instant Smite DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-09-03. 3. **Control:** keep `Psychic Scream` (30 s cooldown) or `Chastise` for a key channel or cast, such as Arcane Missiles or Dark Harvest Evershine · 2026-01-20. After a Chastise disorient, follow with Smite, not Holy Fire (its DoT breaks it) [Kobiq, 2024-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111295#p111295). Do not Fear into a PvP trinket, WotF or Fear Ward: the trinket now removes every effect Zuley · 2025-11-19. 4. **Defence:** re-shield, dispel, and spam `Holy Nova` to fish for instant Smites when melee is on you Evershine · 2026-01-20. Kiting works against paladins and shamans; rogues and warriors win without your trinket, so save it for their stun chain Evershine · 2026-01-09. **Shadow:** 1. **Opener:** `Power Word: Shield` on yourself → `Vampiric Embrace` → `Shadow Word: Pain` (six debuffs with Shadow Weaving, very hard to dispel) Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. 2. **Loop:** `Mind Blast` (8 s cooldown) → `Mind Flay` from 20 yd. Skip Mind Blast on warriors unless it kills Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. Play at range and let VE sustain you; stick to your group Jonny Gabagool · 2025-06-22. 3. **Finish:** `Pain Spike` (instant, 30 s cooldown). 4. **Control:** `Psychic Scream` when melee reaches you. `Silence` (45 s cooldown, 20 yd) casters PBE(Erzsbet) · 2025-04-13. Against Fury warriors, bait Berserker Rage with Fear first, then Net Spiff · 2025-10-27. **Healer (BG, Holy or Disc):** 1. **Triage:** yourself first, then others, then DPS: enemies focus healers at once DrSlump · 2025-10-12. In pugs you get no peels, so stand near your melee Grillbe · 2025-10-14. 2. **Default heals:** shield the target taking burst, Renew to cancel DoT pressure, Flash Heal for spikes dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. Greater Heal (3 s cast) only when nobody is on you (vanilla baseline). 3. **Dispels:** Dispel Magic sheep, fear, DoTs, HoJ, Repentance and slows off allies Ratso · 2023-02-11; Chastise an ally to break Sap or Blind [Isvya, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103744#p103744). **Target priority (DPS specs):** squishy casters and healers first. Mana Burn (3 s cast) only on mana-hungry healers such as resto shamans, never paladins L-star · 2026-01-27, Snackz · 2026-01-27. Keep Shadow Word: Pain on the flag carrier Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. **Reset and drink:** out of combat, drink to full and re-buff (Inner Fire, Fortitude, shield) before the next fight; against a rogue, spam rank-1 Holy Nova while you wait so you are not opened on [Itsbacon, 2025-08-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143823#p143823). Drinking and re-buffing between fights is vanilla baseline. **Vs class** (full plans in [Matchups](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp)): - **Warrior:** shield, no Mind Blast crits; Fear after Berserker Rage. - **Rogue:** Fear and DoT them to stop re-stealth; your worst matchup. - **Mage:** consumables against Polymorph; Silence them. - **Warlock / Hunter:** kill or line-of-sight the pet. - **Druid:** outlast with VE; watch cat burst. - **Paladin:** burst before the bubble; dispel Freedom. - **Shaman:** expect Purge on your shield and Fortitude, and a trinket on your Fear. - **Priest:** dispel and Silence war.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **Healer:** a priest healer is especially valuable on Horde, which otherwise lacks defensive magic dispel Guthlac · 2023-05-05. Defensive dispel beats purge because it removes sheep, fear, DoTs, HoJ, Repentance and slows Ratso · 2023-02-11. Enemies focus healers at once, so the priority is: keep yourself alive > keep others alive > DPS DrSlump · 2025-10-12. - **Flag carriers:** Shadow's six-debuff SW:P is close to impossible to dispel off a flag carrier Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. A premade of 1 Rogue, 2 Priest, 2 Mage with the Mage running flag carrier was reported to win every WSG Grillbe · 2025-10-20. - **Support role:** without needing kills, a Priest's suggested job is to deny the enemy kills through dispels and heals, alongside Rogue peels (Sap/stun-combo/Blind) and Mage/Warlock CC support Art of Will · 2025-10-26, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26. - **Stealth detection:** spam rank-1 Holy Nova to avoid being opened on [Itsbacon, 2025-08-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143823#p143823). - **Mana Burn:** use it on mana-hungry resto shamans and other healers, not on paladins (their heals are cheap) L-star · 2026-01-27, Snackz · 2026-01-27. Improved Mana Burn now sits deep in the Shadow tree, out of reach for Holy and Disc L-star · 2026-01-27.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - Self-cast Chastise and keep your target: `/script CastSpellByName("Chastise", 1)` Vane · 2026-04-18. - Chastise whatever you target, or yourself if the target is an enemy: `/script if UnitIsEnemy("target") then TargetUnit("player") CastSpellByName("Chastise") TargetLastEnemy() else CastSpellByName("Chastise") end` [Mosttrustworthy, 2025-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121406#p121406). - Chastise-request pair: the DPS sends `/w chastise me now!` and the priest uses `/target ` + `/cast Chastise` HolyScheiss · 2025-06-14.

overview.heading: Spec overview
overview.markdown: | Spec | PvP standing | Strengths | Weaknesses | |---|---|---|---| | **Discipline (Smite)** | Favoured by many priest PvPers | The highest burst (Holy Fire into instant Smites), stronger shields and off-heals Zeraya · 2026-03-29; ally Chastise breaks Sap and Blind [Isvya, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103744#p103744) | More exposed to Curse of Tongues and melee Zeraya · 2026-03-29; off-healing feels weak against Mortal Strike-type debuffs without a 30% healing/mana talent Liracrime · 2025-10-29 | | **Shadow** | Viable | SW:P plus Shadow Weaving applies six debuffs at once, so it is very hard to dispel Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22; VE sustain; Silence; fear | Short Mind Flay range (20 yd), unreliable stuns, one damage school Zeraya · 2026-03-29; 1.18.1 dampening and resilience cut both crits and DoTs, and VE healing is reduced twice Koys · 2026-04-08, Potatolord · 2026-04-01 | | **Holy** | BG healer only | Dispels, shields, Ascendance works as a second CC break DrakeReinz · 2026-03-25 | Cannot win fights alone Shadurloc · 2026-03-23, Zeraya · 2026-03-28 | Both damage specs "suffer from overtuned enhancers and rogues mostly" Zeraya · 2026-03-29. Rogues are the matchup priests complain about most Greendam · 2025-10-11. Pre-1.18.1 tier lists from `#pvp-general` disagree with each other. One post-CC2 list put Smite in A, Shadow in B and Holy in C mtnd · 2025-03-23; a 1.18-preview list put Priest in B saplingsam · 2025-08-14. That channel ends in 2025-11, so it has no post-1.18.1 data. `#pvp-general` also shows Priest was seen as one of the least-played PvP classes on Ambershire ("9/10 games not a priest on horde team") Nandieb · 2025-10-03, and Holy struggled to heal through melee 1v1 Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-03 — yet other posters called Priest (Smite and Holy alike) overtuned. One tier list put Shadow Priest in the top "Z tier" with Shaman, Rogue, Mage and Paladin, and Smite Priest in "S tier"; a reply suggested Holy Priest belonged in F tier instead Thirtyseven · 2025-10-11, Liracrime · 2025-10-11. Ythor separately rated Smite Priest S tier Ythor · 2025-10-21, and Temu called Smite "more insane than Shaman" on the Tel'Abim server, citing priests "regularly going like 37-3 in AB" Temu · 2025-10-24, Temu · 2025-10-24; Bipst disputed the Smite ranking specifically ("no, smite priest is not s tier. Healer priest is good though") Bipst · 2025-10-21. On the healer side, dindunuffinz called Priest an overtuned healer — deceptively tanky, spammable shields, and 500-600 Renew ticks that cancel DoTs — citing one geared Horde priest who reportedly did 1,000,000 healing in a single AV and felt "more tanky than any alliance warrior" dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19, corroborated by a self-described unbiased PvE player Exhale · 2025-10-19. Ythor also flagged a faction imbalance in fear uptime: Horde priests can chain-fear melee much more reliably than Alliance priests Ythor · 2025-10-19.

stats.markdown: - **Hit: 3%** against level-60 players is enough, so spare Shadow Focus points can go elsewhere DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-31. **Contested:** 3% [Heroclastus, 2024-10-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102752#p102752) vs 4% [Zvyrhol, 2024-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102656#p102656). - **Stamina > Intellect > Spirit** for a big health and mana pool Tzychotic · 2026-02-14. "Stamina is your only defence" [Springboards, 2024-07-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98805#p98805). - **Burst meta:** "in twow you have burst meta anyways, so you need kara gear for pvp" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-19. The 1.18.1 PvP T2/T3 sets have *less* stamina and armor than the old rank 12-14 sets Zeraya · 2026-03-28, Zeraya · 2026-03-28. - **Power Word: Shield scales with healing power.** Disc PvPers who want bigger shields trade damage for +healing Illithris · 2026-04-15, [Gottabe, 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173328#p173328). - **Honor-vendor catch-up on Nordanaar:** Ornate Bloodstone Dagger, Spellwoven Nobility Drape (11 SP, 1% hit), and assorted "of Shadow Wrath" pieces Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-19, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-19. - **Weapons:** Soulseeker (−25 target resistance) for Smite [Zvyrhol, 2024-10-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102656#p102656). For Night Elves, a bow is PvP-only utility; Time Frozen Bow is called BiS [Blackduck4, 2025-11-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=159517#p159517), Xerq · 2026-02-18. The community-nicknamed "BR dagger" (also BiS for Rogues and Mages) is also "very good" for Priests Jesse Potter · 2025-10-30. - **Trinkets:** the PvP trinket now removes all effects, not just class-specific ones Zuley · 2025-11-19. Reflectors counter specific classes Arkimonday · 2025-04-11. A rogue's Shadow Reflector hard-counters Shadow L-star · 2026-03-23. - **Enchants:** no PvP-specific priest enchant list was posted (gap). Use stamina and spell power versions of the PvE enchants. - **Gear gap:** a forum thread flagged that Priests have no dedicated heal+ PvP set (Druids lack a leather healing PvP set too) Cenandrah · 2025-10-07.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Disc (Smite) 1. Pre-fight: Inner Fire, Enlighten, and Power Word: Shield on yourself. 2. **Opener:** self-`Chastise` → `Inner Fire` → `Holy Fire` (hoping for a crit) → spam `Smite`, using each instant Smite from Searing Light YN · 2025-10-15. 3. Instant Smites have a 1.5 s internal cooldown. Weave another spell between them Misandria · 2025-12-20. One player clocked a Smite-proc chain doing about 5k damage in 3 seconds Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29. 4. Against melee and casters: keep Psychic Scream or Chastise for when a mage channels Arcane Missiles or a warlock casts Dark Harvest. Otherwise shield, dispel, spam Holy Nova and fish for instant Smites Evershine · 2026-01-20. 5. **Chastise as CC or as damage:** if you disorient the target with Chastise, follow with Smite, not Holy Fire. Holy Fire's DoT breaks the disorient [Kobiq, 2024-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111295#p111295). 6. **Ally Chastise:** use it to break Sap or Blind on a teammate [Isvya, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103744#p103744). Chastise priority for haste: affliction warlocks and arcane mages > two-hand melee > dual-wield melee HolyScheiss · 2025-06-14. ### Shadow 1. `Power Word: Shield` on yourself → `Vampiric Embrace` → `Shadow Word: Pain` (with Shadow Weaving it lands as six debuffs, very hard to dispel; players suspect this is unintended) Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22, Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. 2. `Mind Blast` → `Mind Flay` from 20 yd. Against warriors, skip Mind Blast unless it kills: crits give them rage Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. With around 450 spell power, Mind Flay reportedly ticks for 500+ damage, and Blackout can proc back-to-back stuns while you channel it — a common melee complaint Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29. 3. `Pain Spike` as the finisher: "outlast ~80% and then finish you off with an instant" [Atreidon, 2025-04-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124839#p124839). 4. `Psychic Scream` when melee reaches you. Expect trinkets, WotF and Fear Ward. Against a Fury warrior, bait their Berserker Rage (fear/root break, ~30 s cooldown, Battle Stance only) with a Fear, then land an engineering Net right after; Arms warriors lack that break and can be Netted or Feared immediately, but the Fury talent Deathwish reportedly grants fear immunity in any stance Spiff · 2025-10-27, Spiff · 2025-10-27, Spiff · 2025-10-27. 5. `Silence` aggressive casters such as a frost mage trying to Nova and Arcane Explosion a node PBE(Erzsbet) · 2025-04-13. Blackout is PvP-only, and its 2 s stun is considered "almost useless" Tzeip · 2025-10-06. Some `#pvp-general` posters disputed that Shadow was overpowered at all, since it is "literally locked to a single school of spells unless they drop form" and needs an Affliction-style passive, range-abusing playstyle to be effective Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-10-29, Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-10-29.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Solo-queueing as Holy Zeraya · 2026-03-28. - Mind Blast crits on warriors Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. - Holy Fire after a Chastise disorient (the DoT breaks it) [Kobiq, 2024-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111295#p111295). - Wasting fear into a trinket, WotF or Fear Ward. The PvP trinket now removes everything Zuley · 2025-11-19. - Stacking PvE tier sets over stamina [Springboards, 2024-07-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=98805#p98805). - Expecting any feedback from Unbreakable Will; players have asked whether it gives any notification when it resists a stun and gotten no confirmed answer, so assume it is silent (vanilla baseline). !!! bug "Mind Vision sniping (fixed)" Mind Vision used to proc the Scythe of Elune weapon effect at extreme range (200+ yd), letting priests kill enemies from far away without engaging Pastor · 2025-10-18. Reported fixed after complaints Shiro · 2025-10-18. 59 twinks: pre-shield and pre-Renew, and "you should only be able to die Vs rogues in a 1vs1" Xerq · 2026-03-13.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP loops. For the details, see [Burst and control sequences](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp), [Matchups](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp) and [Battleground role](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp). Cooldowns are from the 1.18.1 client data. **Discipline (Smite):** 1. **Pre-fight:** Inner Fire, Enlighten (60 s cooldown) and `Power Word: Shield` on yourself. Keep Fear Ward (30 s cooldown) on yourself against fear classes (vanilla baseline). 2. **Burst:** self-`Chastise` (40 s cooldown, 25 yd) → `Holy Fire` → `Smite` spam, taking every instant Smite from Searing Light YN · 2025-10-15. Weave another spell between instant Smites (1.5 s internal cooldown) Misandria · 2025-12-20. Night Elves can weave bow Searing Shot on the move to proc an instant Smite DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-09-03. 3. **Control:** keep `Psychic Scream` (30 s cooldown) or `Chastise` for a key channel or cast, such as Arcane Missiles or Dark Harvest Evershine · 2026-01-20. After a Chastise disorient, follow with Smite, not Holy Fire (its DoT breaks it) [Kobiq, 2024-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111295#p111295). Do not Fear into a PvP trinket, WotF or Fear Ward: the trinket now removes every effect Zuley · 2025-11-19. 4. **Defence:** re-shield, dispel, and spam `Holy Nova` to fish for instant Smites when melee is on you Evershine · 2026-01-20. Kiting works against paladins and shamans; rogues and warriors win without your trinket, so save it for their stun chain Evershine · 2026-01-09. **Shadow:** 1. **Opener:** `Power Word: Shield` on yourself → `Vampiric Embrace` → `Shadow Word: Pain` (six debuffs with Shadow Weaving, very hard to dispel) Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. 2. **Loop:** `Mind Blast` (8 s cooldown) → `Mind Flay` from 20 yd. Skip Mind Blast on warriors unless it kills Shadurloc · 2026-03-23. Play at range and let VE sustain you; stick to your group Jonny Gabagool · 2025-06-22. 3. **Finish:** `Pain Spike` (instant, 30 s cooldown). 4. **Control:** `Psychic Scream` when melee reaches you. `Silence` (45 s cooldown, 20 yd) casters PBE(Erzsbet) · 2025-04-13. Against Fury warriors, bait Berserker Rage with Fear first, then Net Spiff · 2025-10-27. **Healer (BG, Holy or Disc):** 1. **Triage:** yourself first, then others, then DPS: enemies focus healers at once DrSlump · 2025-10-12. In pugs you get no peels, so stand near your melee Grillbe · 2025-10-14. 2. **Default heals:** shield the target taking burst, Renew to cancel DoT pressure, Flash Heal for spikes dindunuffinz · 2025-10-19. Greater Heal (3 s cast) only when nobody is on you (vanilla baseline). 3. **Dispels:** Dispel Magic sheep, fear, DoTs, HoJ, Repentance and slows off allies Ratso · 2023-02-11; Chastise an ally to break Sap or Blind [Isvya, 2024-10-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103744#p103744). **Target priority (DPS specs):** squishy casters and healers first. Mana Burn (3 s cast) only on mana-hungry healers such as resto shamans, never paladins L-star · 2026-01-27, Snackz · 2026-01-27. Keep Shadow Word: Pain on the flag carrier Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. **Reset and drink:** out of combat, drink to full and re-buff (Inner Fire, Fortitude, shield) before the next fight; against a rogue, spam rank-1 Holy Nova while you wait so you are not opened on [Itsbacon, 2025-08-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143823#p143823). Drinking and re-buffing between fights is vanilla baseline. **Vs class** (full plans in [Matchups](#/class/priest/discipline-pvp)): - **Warrior:** shield, no Mind Blast crits; Fear after Berserker Rage. - **Rogue:** Fear and DoT them to stop re-stealth; your worst matchup. - **Mage:** consumables against Polymorph; Silence them. - **Warlock / Hunter:** kill or line-of-sight the pet. - **Druid:** outlast with VE; watch cat burst. - **Paladin:** burst before the bubble; dispel Freedom. - **Shaman:** expect Purge on your shield and Fortitude, and a trinket on your Fear. - **Priest:** dispel and Silence war.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **Healer:** a priest healer is especially valuable on Horde, which otherwise lacks defensive magic dispel Guthlac · 2023-05-05. Defensive dispel beats purge because it removes sheep, fear, DoTs, HoJ, Repentance and slows Ratso · 2023-02-11. Enemies focus healers at once, so the priority is: keep yourself alive > keep others alive > DPS DrSlump · 2025-10-12. - **Flag carriers:** Shadow's six-debuff SW:P is close to impossible to dispel off a flag carrier Zvyrhol · 2026-03-22. A premade of 1 Rogue, 2 Priest, 2 Mage with the Mage running flag carrier was reported to win every WSG Grillbe · 2025-10-20. - **Support role:** without needing kills, a Priest's suggested job is to deny the enemy kills through dispels and heals, alongside Rogue peels (Sap/stun-combo/Blind) and Mage/Warlock CC support Art of Will · 2025-10-26, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26. - **Stealth detection:** spam rank-1 Holy Nova to avoid being opened on [Itsbacon, 2025-08-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143823#p143823). - **Mana Burn:** use it on mana-hungry resto shamans and other healers, not on paladins (their heals are cheap) L-star · 2026-01-27, Snackz · 2026-01-27. Improved Mana Burn now sits deep in the Shadow tree, out of reach for Holy and Disc L-star · 2026-01-27.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - Self-cast Chastise and keep your target: `/script CastSpellByName("Chastise", 1)` Vane · 2026-04-18. - Chastise whatever you target, or yourself if the target is an enemy: `/script if UnitIsEnemy("target") then TargetUnit("player") CastSpellByName("Chastise") TargetLastEnemy() else CastSpellByName("Chastise") end` [Mosttrustworthy, 2025-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=121406#p121406). - Chastise-request pair: the DPS sends `/w chastise me now!` and the priest uses `/target ` + `/cast Chastise` HolyScheiss · 2025-06-14.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level as a **wand + Smite** priest. Take 2/2 Wand Specialization, then 5/5 Spirit Tap, then go down the Holy tree to 5/5 Spiritual Guidance, then into Discipline. Stack Spirit and wand everything until your early 30s, then chain Holy Fire → Smite ×3. Do **not** level Shadow before 40. If you want Shadow, respec at 42-44 and it becomes very strong from there Greendam · 2025-01-22, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-30, limbless · 2026-04-03.

By about 33, a correctly built priest is a "smite machine gun that never needs to drink" Greendam · 2026-01-16. | | **Shadow** | Bad before 40, fine after 40, good after 44 | Shadowform arrives at 40 and Mind Flay rank 4 at 44 Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-01, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-02-23, haunt · 2026-02-22. Before that, deep Shadow kills at roughly half Smite's speed after 30 Greendam · 2025-10-14. sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: What to press in each bracket on the recommended **Smite/Holy** path (talent order above), plus the **Shadow** path after the respec at 42. Learn levels, costs and cast times are from the 1.18.1 game data. Smite Rank 1 and Lesser Heal Rank 1 are known from level 1. Wand use (`Shoot`) costs no mana, so wanding does not stop the 5-second-rule regen (vanilla baseline). Every bracket has a **Healing (dungeons)** block, because this path heals any leveling dungeon Lirya · 2026-02-04, Lirya · 2026-04-12. **Rules that hold for every bracket:** - **Healing ranks:** do not downrank while leveling. Cast the highest rank you have of Lesser Heal, Heal or Greater Heal when the tank needs it, put Renew on the tank, then stop casting so the 5-second rule lets your mana regen Bluefear · 2026-02-12. Pre-cast the big heal and cancel it at about two-thirds of the bar if it is not needed Greendam · 2026-04-06. +Healing gear does little before about 50 and 200+ healing power, so pick Intellect and Spirit over it Lirya · 2025-10-02, Lirya · 2025-11-25. - **Power Word: Shield in groups:** do not shield warrior or druid tanks. An absorbed hit gives them no rage, and rage is their threat. Paladin and shaman tanks and DPS are fine to shield Matriarchy · 2025-07-11, haunt · 2025-07-11. Each shield puts Weakened Soul on the target, so you cannot shield it again for a while (vanilla baseline). - **Healing threat:** Renew ticks can pull mobs the tank has not hit yet. If a new mob joins, move towards the tank haunt · 2025-07-11, haunt · 2025-07-11. Fade on the pull stops loose mobs from running at you Greendam · 2025-10-03. - **Spirit Tap** (from level 12) triggers only on your killing blow. Snipe the last hit with the wand, Smite or Mind Blast, then chain to the next mob while it runs Bluefear · 2026-04-04, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-03-22. ### Levels 1–9 **New now:** L1 Smite R1, Lesser Heal R1, Power Word: Fortitude R1 · L4 Shadow Word: Pain R1, Lesser Heal R2 · L6 Power Word: Shield R1 (45 mana, 4 s cooldown), Smite R2 · L8 Renew R1, Fade R1. Buy a Lesser Magic Wand at about 5 Valaen · 2026-03-23. **Single target:** 1. Buff Power Word: Fortitude, and keep it up. 2. Before the wand: `Smite` ×2 to 3, then melee (vanilla baseline). 3. With a wand: `Shadow Word: Pain`, then `Shoot` until the mob dies Greendam · 2025-11-06. 4. `Power Word: Shield` only if the mob hits hard. Heal between pulls with `Lesser Heal`, then drink when you are under about half mana (vanilla baseline). **Multi-target:** fight one mob at a time. With two mobs: shield yourself, SW:P both, then wand one (vanilla baseline). **Healing (dungeons):** none yet. The first dungeons open at about 13. ### Levels 10–19 **New now:** L10 Mind Blast R1, Lesser Heal R3 (2.5 s), SW:P R2, Resurrection, and your race's two priest spells (quest) · L12 Inner Fire R1, PW:S R2 · L14 Psychic Scream R1 (30 s cooldown), Cure Disease, Renew R2, Smite R3 · L16 Heal R1 (155 mana, 3 s), Mind Blast R2 · L18 Dispel Magic R1, PW:S R3, SW:P R3. Talents: Wand Specialization (10–11), Spirit Tap (12–16), Holy Focus (17–18), Divinity (19). Buy a Greater Magic Wand at 13 Philes · 2026-02-03. Get Cookie's Stirring Rod or Gravestone Scepter at about 18 (see [gear](#/class/priest/leveling)). **Single target (the wand phase):** 1. `Inner Fire` and Fortitude up. 2. `Power Word: Shield` on yourself if the mob hits hard or two are coming (vanilla baseline). 3. `Shadow Word: Pain`. 4. `Shoot` until it dies. From 13, Greater Magic Wand + 2/2 Wand Specialization does more damage than your spells Philes · 2026-02-03. Opening with Mind Blast is optional, and it costs mana you would rather keep. 5. Let Spirit Tap refill your mana instead of sitting down. Drink only when a pull starts below about a third of your mana (vanilla baseline). **Multi-target (2–3 mobs):** 1. `Power Word: Shield` on yourself. 2. `Shadow Word: Pain` on every mob. 3. Wand the one that is lowest. 4. If the shield breaks and more than one mob is on you: `Psychic Scream`, re-shield, heal with `Lesser Heal`, then re-apply SW:P Ionnatra · 2024-12-22. Do not pull 3+ on purpose yet: you have no AoE. **Healing (dungeons): Ragefire Chasm, Wailing Caverns, Deadmines, Shadowfang Keep** | Situation | Press | |---|---| | Tank taking steady damage | `Renew` (max rank). Early dungeons are mostly healable with Renew, with the big heal kept ready for bosses and 3+ mob pulls haunt · 2026-03-06 | | Tank low (about half health) | Max-rank `Lesser Heal` (R3), or `Heal` R1 from 16 when damage is heavy. Let the tank drop to about half instead of spamming Xerq · 2025-10-23 | | Tank about to die | `Power Word: Shield`, then heal. On a warrior tank, only in a real emergency | | DPS took a hit | `Renew`, or nothing if they are above 70% | | Poisoned, diseased or feared ally | `Cure Disease` for diseases (14+). From 18, `Dispel Magic` on friendly-player magic debuffs: fears, sleeps, slows, polymorphs (vanilla baseline). Priests cannot remove poisons or curses | **Contested: Lesser Heal or Heal.** One healer keeps using Lesser Heal while leveling because mana matters more IllegallyParkedFrog · 2026-04-03. Another skips it once Heal is trained Greendam · 2026-04-06. Heal R1 is learned before level 20, so its +healing scaling is reduced. This barely matters at a level with no +healing gear (vanilla baseline). ### Levels 20–29 **New now:** L20 Holy Fire R1 (3.5 s), Flash Heal R1 (1.5 s, 125 mana), Renew R3, Fear Ward, Inner Fire R2, Fade R2, Shackle Undead, Mind Soothe, and the second racial spells · L22 Heal R2, Smite R4, Mind Blast R3 · L24 Holy Fire R2, PW:S R4, Fortitude R3, Mana Burn · L26 Flash Heal R2, Renew R4, SW:P R4 · L28 Heal R3, Mind Blast R4, Psychic Scream R2. Talents: Divinity (19–21), Divine Fury (22–26), Divinity (27–28), Holy Reach (29–30). **Single target:** 1. Pre-cast `Holy Fire` at max range. 2. `Smite` while the mob runs in. 3. `Power Word: Shield` if it hits hard. 4. Wand to finish Leihoey · 2025-12-11. 5. On a weak mob, keep the wand phase going instead: `Shadow Word: Pain` → wand. **Contested:** Greendam rarely casts Holy Fire or Smite before 30, because Gravestone Scepter out-damages them Greendam · 2025-11-06. Divine Fury (from 22) makes Smite your strongest damage talent Lirya · 2026-04-12. **Multi-target (2–3 mobs):** shield → `Holy Fire` on the first mob → `Shadow Word: Pain` on the rest → wand. Keep `Psychic Scream` for when the shield breaks Ionnatra · 2024-12-22. **Healing (dungeons): Blackfathom Deeps, Gnomeregan, Razorfen Kraul, Scarlet Monastery** 1. Keep max-rank `Renew` on the tank. Put a Renew on warlocks who Life Tap, rather than ignoring them L-star · 2025-08-12. 2. When the tank drops, pre-cast max-rank `Heal`, and cancel it at about two-thirds if the tank does not need it Greendam · 2025-08-25. 3. `Flash Heal` only when even Heal spam cannot keep the tank up. It costs more mana and heals less per second Bluefear · 2026-02-12. 4. `Power Word: Shield` if the tank will not live until your next cast lands Greendam · 2025-08-25. 5. `Fear Ward` on the tank before fearing bosses Smerjshhhjr · 2021-05-30. `Shackle Undead` on an extra undead mob in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard or Razorfen Downs (vanilla baseline). 6. **Mana:** a big heal, then 5+ seconds of wanding or nothing, with Renew ticking. Drink between pulls, not during them. ### Levels 30–39 **New now:** L30 Smite R5, Holy Fire R3, PW:S R5, Prayer of Healing R1 (410 mana), Divine Spirit R1, Pain Spike R1 (30 s cooldown), Mind Control, Shadow Protection, Lightwell, Fade R3 · L32 Flash Heal R3, Renew R5, Abolish Disease, Mana Burn R2 · L34 Heal R4, Mind Blast R5, SW:P R5 · L36 Dispel Magic R2, Holy Fire R4, PW:S R6, Fortitude R4, and Holy Nova R3 at the trainer · L38 Flash Heal R4, Renew R6, Smite R6. Talents: Holy Reach 2 (30), Holy Nova (31, 130 mana, instant), Spiritual Guidance (32–36), Piercing Light (37–39). **Single target (the Smite phase):** 1. `Holy Fire` from max range. 2. `Smite` ×3. 3. Snipe the killing blow with `Smite` or max-rank `Mind Blast` so Spirit Tap procs Lirya · 2026-02-04, Bluefear · 2026-04-04. 4. Wand only the last sliver (1–2 shots) Lirya · 2026-04-12. 5. Skip Shadow Word: Pain on normal mobs, because most die before 3 ticks. Keep it for elites and bosses, and cast it while moving Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-17, Bluefear · 2026-04-04. 6. `Pain Spike` (instant) as a finisher when the mob is nearly dead (see [Discipline](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps)). 7. Chain the next mob while Spirit Tap runs. A correctly built priest reaches 33 as "a smite machine gun that never need to drink" Greendam · 2026-01-16. **Multi-target:** 1. 2 mobs: shield → `Holy Fire` → `Shadow Word: Pain` on the second → Smite the first. 2. Bad pull (3+): `Psychic Scream`, shield, heal, then kill one at a time. Or `Mind Control` one mob so the others fight it Ionnatra · 2024-12-22. 3. `Holy Nova` (31+) is too expensive to AoE grind with Lirya · 2026-04-12. Use it only when 2–3 players need healing and about 3 mobs are on you Philes · 2026-04-12. **Healing (dungeons): Scarlet Monastery, Razorfen Downs, Uldaman, Zul'Farrak** Use `Renew` and `Heal`, and skip Lesser Heal. Greater Heal R1 is usually fine. Do not go below Heal R2, or you get the low-level penalty Greendam · 2025-10-24. 7. **Shadow players:** you can still heal dungeons Nugent · 2026-03-27. You must leave Shadowform to cast heals (vanilla baseline). Dispel Magic can be set up in dispel addons so that you do not drop form to cure diseases Greendam · 2025-07-06. ### Levels 50–60 **New now:** L50 Flash Heal R6, Renew R8, Prayer of Healing R3, SW:P R7, Inner Fire R5, Divine Spirit R3, Pain Spike R3 · L52 Greater Heal R3, Holy Nova R5, Mind Blast R8, Mind Flay R5 · L54 Holy Fire R7, PW:S R9, Smite R8 · L56 Flash Heal R7, Renew R9, Psychic Scream R4, Shadow Protection R3 · L58 Greater Heal R4, Mind Blast R9, SW:P R8, Shadow Mend R1 (item-taught, 30 s cooldown; the sources say nothing about it yet) · L60 Holy Fire R8, Holy Nova R6, PW:S R10, Prayer of Healing R4, Mind Flay R6, Fortitude R6, Divine Spirit R4, Prayer of Spirit. items: **Healing ranks:** do not downrank while leveling. Cast the highest rank you have of Lesser Heal, Heal or Greater Heal when the tank needs it, put Renew on the tank, then stop casting so the 5-second rule lets your mana regen Bluefear · 2026-02-12. Pre-cast the big heal and cancel it at about two-thirds of the bar if it is not needed Greendam · 2026-04-06. +Healing gear does little before about 50 and 200+ healing power, so pick Intellect and Spirit over it Lirya · 2025-10-02, Lirya · 2025-11-25.

**Power Word: Shield in groups:** do not shield warrior or druid tanks. An absorbed hit gives them no rage, and rage is their threat. Paladin and shaman tanks and DPS are fine to shield Matriarchy · 2025-07-11, haunt · 2025-07-11. Each shield puts Weakened Soul on the target, so you cannot shield it again for a while (vanilla baseline).

**Healing threat:** Renew ticks can pull mobs the tank has not hit yet. If a new mob joins, move towards the tank haunt · 2025-07-11, haunt · 2025-07-11. Fade on the pull stops loose mobs from running at you Greendam · 2025-10-03.

sections.heading: Pull and kill loop (bot-ready)
sections.markdown: **Levels 1 to ~20 (wand phase):** 1. `Power Word: Shield` on yourself if the mob hits hard or you are pulling two. 2. `Shadow Word: Pain`. 3. `Shoot` (wand) until it dies Greendam · 2025-11-06. Wanding beats casting early on. At 13, Greater Magic Wand + 2/2 Wand Specialization out-damages your spells Philes · 2026-02-03. **Levels ~20 to 30:** 1. Pre-cast `Holy Fire` at max range. 2. `Smite`. 3. `Power Word: Shield` (rank 3 by 20, rank 4 at 24). 4. Wand to finish Leihoey · 2025-12-11. **Level 30+ (Smite phase):** 1. `Holy Fire` from max range. 2. `Smite` ×3. Snipe the killing blow with Smite or max-rank `Mind Blast` so Spirit Tap procs Lirya · 2026-02-04, Bluefear · 2026-04-04. 3. Wand only for the last sliver (1-2 shots) Lirya · 2026-04-12. 4. Drop Shadow Word: Pain after about 30: most mobs die before 3 ticks. Keep it for elites and bosses Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2025-12-17, Bluefear · 2026-04-04. Once you have Purifying Flames and Searing Light you will rarely cast it, except while moving Bluefear · 2026-04-04. 5. Chain straight into the next mob while Spirit Tap is active. **Elites or multiple mobs:** buff → `Power Word: Shield` → `Holy Fire` → `Shadow Word: Pain` → wand ×2. If the shield breaks: `Psychic Scream` (or Mind Control), then re-shield and heal Ionnatra · 2024-12-22. **Melee weaving (optional):** with a slow two-hand staff, melee between wand shots. Wand shots do not reset the swing timer, which adds up to ~30% damage at low levels Greendam · 2025-10-22.

leveling.recommendation: Level as a **wand + Smite** priest. Take 2/2 Wand Specialization, then 5/5 Spirit Tap, then go down the Holy tree to 5/5 Spiritual Guidance, then into Discipline. Stack Spirit and wand everything until your early 30s, then chain Holy Fire → Smite ×3. Do **not** level Shadow before 40. If you want Shadow, respec at 42-44 and it becomes very strong from there Greendam · 2025-01-22, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-30, limbless · 2026-04-03.

No leveling gear bracket exists for Holy (not a recommended leveling spec per the sources) or for level ranges 30-49/50-59 for any spec; only the level-5-29 wand progression (Lesser -> Greater Magic Wand) is concretely sourced.

The shadow-ranged-dps.md claim that a 'Karazhan set' reduces Mind Blast cooldown (attributed only to "Zitronenhaze") could not be traced to a specific post ID in the extracted forum data, so it was omitted here rather than cited without a resolvable URL.

gearMarkdown.heading: Discipline (Smite) — ranged-dps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
### Pre-raid-60

Single source (Tscosomaz's Disco Priest post, written just before 1.18.1). Agreement: **single**.

| Slot | Item | Source | Notes | Citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Head | item 22267 (name not given) | unknown-in-sources (drop location given only by the citing playbook as Karazhan Crypts; the original post gives no name or location, only a database.turtlecraft.gg item link) | "Considered the pre-raid bis" | [Tscosomaz (player), 2025-10-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157662#p157662) |
| Head | item 22080, T0.5 head (name not given) | quest — T0.5 class quest chain | Less SP, +crit instead of +hit — poor fit since Discipline needs hit | Tscosomaz, as above |

Tier heads 16813 (T1) and 16921 (T2) are also named by item ID only; both are called worse than the T0.5 head because
neither carries spell hit ("invalidating the whole set for Disco") — not listed as ranked items since the source
explicitly says not to use them, only mentions them as a complaint about itemization.

**Consumables**: Major Mana Potion; Nordanaar Herbal Tea / Tea with Sugar, Dark/Demonic Runes, Brilliant Wizard Oil,
Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir — [Zvyrhol (player), 2026-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174655#p174655).
Progression raiding also calls out Robe of Sacrifice and Darkmoon Card: Blue Dragon for mana sustain —
[Tess322 (player), 2025-05-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=131166#p131166).

**Stat priority**: spell hit to 10% from gear (Piercing Light gives 6% more, 16% total) is top priority — "spec needs
10% from items ... +spellhit (weight19 if undercap) vs +crit (weight7)" — Tscosomaz, as above; a second player
independently gives up to 16% for bosses, "always 1% miss" — [Zvyrhol (player), 2023-12-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=81512#p81512).
"After T0.5 there is nothing, unless offsets or T2.5" — Tscosomaz — T1/T2 sets carry no spell hit and are explicitly
called unusable for the spec.

### Raid-t2.5

The original T2.5 (Oracle) set was converted pre-1.18.1 into a full Discipline/Smite set: Holy spell power
33/27/39/34/27 across the five pieces, +1% hit on robe and trousers, +1% crit on tiara/mantle —
[Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105276#p105276). Players call it weaker
than BWL/AQ/Naxx off-set pieces (Leggings of Polarity, Boots of Epiphany) and object to it dealing only Holy damage —
"no justifiable reason for T2.5 to only be Holy damage" — [Mcpewpew (player), 2024-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113348#p113348).
1.18.1 5-set rework: Chastise grants 40 spell power and cuts Smite/Holy Fire mana cost 15% for 12s, doubled on a
critical strike — [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272). No
source names the individual T2.5 pieces or their non-Holy-spell-power stats — **gap**.

  ring from aq40", "naxx 24 stam ring", "nefarian tanking neck"), not exact item names.
- No leveling gear bracket exists for Holy (not a recommended leveling spec per the sources) or for level ranges
  30-49/50-59 for any spec; only the level-5-29 wand progression (Lesser → Greater Magic Wand) is concretely sourced.
- The `shadow-ranged-dps.md` claim that a "Karazhan set" reduces Mind Blast cooldown (attributed only to
  "Zitronenhaze") could not be traced to a specific post ID in the extracted forum data, so it was omitted here
  rather than cited without a resolvable URL.
- Item IDs for many named items are not given in any source: Nightwind Leggings, Band of Servitude, Bloodvine set
  pieces, Soulseeker, Time Frozen Bow, the mooncloth fallback boots, Coronet/Shoulderpads/Pants of Faith.
- Discipline T2.5 and Shadow T2.5/T3.5 raid sets have known set-bonus text (itemization changelog) but no per-piece
  item names anywhere in the sources.
- `database.turtlecraft.gg` item links quoted by players (mostly Langorn's guide) are player-reported, not
  staff-confirmed or cross-checked against a client DBC; treat item IDs and drop locations here as provisional
  pending local-server verification (see `AGENTS.md` §3-4).

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown: What the sources do not settle: 1. **Tauren racial numbers.** The exact damage, mana costs and durations of Light of An'she and Spiritwalker, and when the second racial unlocks, are unknown MonthOLDpickle · 2026-04-18. 2. **Smite T1 5-piece bonus.** A tooltip screenshot says 30% pushback avoidance; another player describes +35 spell power with Inner Fire meowww · 2026-03-20, LaZy · 2026-03-21. 3. **Lightwell after the hotfix.** Whether the Splendor of Light targeting fix (2026-03-24) cured the "heals full-HP players" bug reported in April L-star · 2026-04-02. 4. **Shadow Weaving.** Whether the 9 s debuff duration is intended, and how several Shadow priests' stacks interact Liddy · 2026-03-21, irotos · 2026-03-08. 5. **Full per-slot enchant lists for Smite, Shadow and PvP.** Only healer lists and a few DPS slots (shoulders, wrist, weapon, gloves) are sourced. The stats of the Naxx shoulder enchant are not stated. 6. **Renew rank 5.** Whether this rank, inefficient before 1.18.1, was fixed; 1.18.1 only names Heal rank 4 and Flash Heal ranks 3-7. 7. **Sigil of the Ancient Accord for Shadow** stays disputed Ydr · 2026-03-25, and so does Mark of the Champion vs Eye of Dormant Corruption against Undead Mendeleev · 2026-04-17. 8. **PvP after 1.18.1.** `#pvp-general` ends in 2025-11, so the matchups are pre-release apart from a handful of post-release `#priest` posts. Per-spec dampening values are unknown. 9. **Holy vs 21/30 hybrid throughput** in 1.18.1: no parse comparison was posted. 10. **Leveling zone route.** No priest-specific route exists. The dungeon table is limited to instances named for priest loot. 11. **Book of Prayer and T2 8-piece.** Whether the 8-piece's extra "Renew" counts as a separate spell for Book of Prayer.

guidePages.title: Priest professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** on a first priest, level with **two gathering professions** (Herbalism + Mining or Skinning). Every crafting profession costs gold until 60 Greendam · 2026-01-23, Greendam · 2025-09-26. At 60, take **Engineering**. It is the only profession that changes how a priest plays Greendam · 2025-09-26, and since 1.18.1 it makes the Kara BiS spell power goggles Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-22. Pair it with **Alchemy**, or keep **Herbalism** for the Dire Maul lasher farm FishyNeo · 2026-03-20, Duciel · 2025-10-02. If you level only by healing dungeons, Tailoring + Enchanting also works Snackz · 2026-02-28.

sections.heading: What each profession gives a priest
sections.markdown: ### Engineering - **Spell power goggles (1.18.1, BWL).** A new BWL boss drops an item that upgrades the engineering spell power goggles ("spell goggles extreme plus"). It needs **Engineering 270** Ydr · 2026-03-25. Zitronenhaze calls the result "kara BiS": the same base spell power as the previous BiS head, plus a "HUGE sp proc" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-22, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-22. After 1.18.1 he listed the "new engi head" as a Shadow BiS change Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-23. He also rates it above the T3 head's roughly 51 spell power (spirit converted) on average Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-06, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-04-06. That exchange prompted "engineering became an even more bis profession" Potatolord · 2026-04-06. - **Earlier goggles:** Greendam recalls engineering goggles from Kara10 with **2% haste**, and says Engineering is "super worth to have", unlike Goldsmith Jewelcrafting (single source) Greendam · 2026-02-07. Haste matters because Discipline and Holy aim for a 10% haste breakpoint (see [Discipline](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps)). - **Sappers and explosives:** a Shadow priest's trash damage in a raid log was "like 90k … sapper, holy water, jewel" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-13. Casual players and healers can skip it, because healers are "not in sapper range that often" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-23, Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-23. - **PvP:** engineering Nets against warriors: bait Berserker Rage with Fear, then Net Spiff · 2025-10-27. Engineering gear also raises PvP performance in general Evershine · 2026-01-26. ### Tailoring Tailoring is **contested**. It is great while leveling but weak at 60. Greendam calls it "the worst prof atm" Greendam · 2026-01-20. Others point to late-game uses: Arcane and Nature resistance gear and the Mooncloth cooldown Tzychotic · 2026-02-15. | Craft | Who | Notes | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Stormreaver** gloves (4-piece set) | Leveling, 20s | Only the gloves are crafted. The pattern is a rare drop in [Shadowfang Keep](#/instances/shadowfang-keep); the other set pieces drop. "4p set really good for leveling" | Xerq · 2026-02-04 | | **Shadoweave** set | Shadow, leveling | "if you play shadow, shadowweave set is really good" | Greendam · 2025-11-25 | | **Dreamweave** set (Turtle) | All, from 40-45 | Balanced Spirit, Intellect and spell damage/healing. Otherwise skip the low-level crafts until Dreamweave | Greendam · 2025-11-25, Lirya · 2025-11-25, haunt · 2026-01-31 | | **Gloves of Unwinding Mystery** (Turtle, 1.17.0) | Discipline and Holy, fresh 60 into K40 | 22 SP + 2% haste. Snackz was still wearing them in K40 gear for the haste. He puts it at 3%, the item post says 2% (**Contested** figure) | Eemo · 2026-01-27, Snackz · 2026-01-24, Snackz · 2026-01-27 | | **Truefaith Vestments** | Holy, pre-raid | "If you a tailor yourself" (tailor-only) | Saedar · 2026-02-10 | | **Robe of Sacrifice** (Turtle) | Shadow, fresh 60 | Named with the Ornate Bloodstone Dagger as the buy that makes a fresh Shadow 60 out-damage BWL-geared players. The robe sold for about **1k gold**, since few players have the recipe | Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-31, haunt · 2026-01-31, haunt · 2026-01-03 | | Mooncloth / Bloodvine | Old sets | Power-crept for caster DPS. Mooncloth fell below 20g on Ambershire | Alfadir · 2025-10-29 | **Buy it instead:** tailored items are cheap on the AH, so gold from gathering buys them SillyWizard · 2025-03-31. One raider advises skipping Truefaith and Mooncloth pre-BiS altogether and spending the gold on consumables and early raid trinkets t0uchm3 · 2025-10-22. The **Mooncloth** transmute cooldown is the more valuable of the tailoring cooldowns for gold Stunfisk · 2026-01-20. ### Enchanting - **Leveling wands:** "the 2 early enchanting wands have way higher dps than their level and outdps any your spells before lvl20". Greater Magic Wand is the pickup at 13 Greendam · 2025-11-06, Valaen · 2026-03-23. On the Craftsman challenge, "snag enchanting asap and make a wand" Nyxar Sosaria · 2026-03-26. - **At 60:** the Enchanting cooldown item (Enchanted Armor Kit) sells better than tailoring's Greendam · 2026-01-20. Enchanting + Herbalism is "more lucrative" than Tailoring at 60 Evershine · 2026-02-15. - **Downside:** it costs money while leveling. Making money needs rare recipes (e.g. Crusader) and advertising in a capital SillyWizard · 2025-03-31. - **Gap in enchants:** there is no Holy or Shadow spell power glove enchant for priests (mages get one) Misandria · 2026-01-11. ### Alchemy and Herbalism - **Engineering + Alchemy** is the stated PvE endgame pair FishyNeo · 2026-03-20. Alchemy makes your own potions Snackz · 2026-02-26 and covers part of the raid consumable stack on the [Discipline](#/class/priest/discipline-ranged-dps) and [Shadow](#/class/priest/shadow-ranged-dps) pages. - **Herbalism** is the usual partner for the lasher farm. It adds about 20% extra income there Greendam · 2025-09-26. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle) - There are **no Shadow- or Holy-specific gems** Misandria · 2026-01-11. Greendam judged a Goldsmith-crafted helm "not strong enough to take Goldsmith". Another player pointed out you do not need Goldsmith to equip it, so buy it instead Greendam · 2026-02-07, Eemo · 2026-02-07. - A Shadow pre-raid ring list includes "next JC ring", with Pure Elementium Band BiS once BWL opens (single source) FeuNoir/Coup · 2025-12-24. - **Artisan challenge:** priest staves and rings come from Jewelcrafting, which needs Mining. That makes a self-sufficient priest hard; the player who raised it left it unresolved zookee1 · 2024-12-14, zookee1 · 2024-12-14. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) **Should a priest take them?** The priest channel gives no class-specific reason. Nobody discusses Bolas, nets or gathering bags for priests. Take Survival for leveling comfort (tents) and the general utility below, not for priest power. - **Before 1.18.1:** players learned tents themselves from level 5, or used the tents placed outside Orgrimmar and Stormwind to rest while leveling by dungeon Saedar · 2026-01-08, Saedar · 2026-01-08. Another player suggested taking Survival on a leveling partner so tents go where you farm and you run back to the capital less Duciel · 2025-12-01, Duciel · 2025-12-01. Greendam called **Gardening** the better semi-AFK gold farm, though lashers pay more Greendam · 2025-08-01, Greendam · 2025-08-01. - **1.18.1 rework:** Survival now has 80+ recipes, including slow/root/trap tools, gathering bags and Woodcutting [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168). Rested bonus from kills fell to **50%**, and tents cap at **25%** rested, while non-city taverns can still fill to 100% (same source). The full 1-300 route is on the [Professions overview](#/professions) page. - **Priest-specific 1.18.1 comment:** Greendam dismissed a new Survival consumable as "only 3%" and said it needs Gardening crops that nobody plants and that the skill-225 quest also uses, so they cost more than gold (single source) Greendam · 2026-04-10. A player asked whether Survival can craft a wand; nobody answered Kueji · 2026-03-23.

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **1-60:** double gathering. Change at 60 "when you have a better idea what you want to do" Greendam · 2025-09-26. A tailor who is leveling can still make the Stormreaver gloves (20s), Shadoweave (Shadow) and Dreamweave (40-45) Xerq · 2026-02-04, Greendam · 2025-11-25. 2. **At 60:** drop one gathering profession, or Tailoring, for Engineering. Several tailors in the channel did exactly that Evershine · 2026-02-15, Evershine · 2026-01-20. 3. **Engineering 270** before your guild farms BWL, so you can craft the goggle upgrade when it drops Ydr · 2026-03-25.

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: The priest channel reports no racial profession bonuses that matter for priests. See the [Professions overview](#/professions) for Turtle-wide ones.

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Dire Maul East lashers** are the signature priest farm: Holy Nova rank-1 spam in Disc. Herbalism adds about 20% Greendam · 2025-09-26. See [Leveling](#/class/priest/leveling) for the route. - A **DM North / Kara10 trinket-quest loop** makes 60g+ per 5 runs, and more with a second account (single source) DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-30. - **Mining + Skinning:** "hundreds of gold" passively Lynathel · 2026-02-27. - **Buying BoEs at 60** (a few hundred gold) gets a fresh Shadow priest past BWL-geared players, at the cost of Stamina Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-31.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- No source gives the goggles' name, stats or the upgrade item's name, only "spell goggles extreme plus", Engineering 270, a BWL drop and a big SP proc.
- Gloves of Unwinding Mystery haste is 2% or 3% depending on the poster. Whether they are BoE is not stated.
- The priest channel does not discuss Gnomish vs Goblin Engineering, or 1.18.1 Survival tools (Bolas, nets, trinkets).
- Jewelcrafting's priest value is thin: one ring mention and one Goldsmith helm.

See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/priest)
