summary: Shamans on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 are Horde-only (Orc, Troll, Tauren) Lodmat · 2025-04-03, Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-03-06 and fill every role from three trees:
recommendation: Shamans on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 are Horde-only (Orc, Troll, Tauren) Lodmat · 2025-04-03, Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-03-06 and fill every role from three trees: - **Enhancement** is the melee DPS spec and the easiest way into a raid, because its Windfury, Strength of Earth and Grace of Air totems are the best melee buffs in the game Squid · 2026-02-20, Squid · 2026-02-20. - **Tank** (Enhancement with shield talents, the "warden" tank) has the best snap threat of any tank and no defensive cooldown; it is the squishiest tank since 1.18.1. - **Elemental** is a Nature caster that shines in AoE; the old "fire ele" Molten Blast spec died in 1.18.1. - **Restoration** is a Chain-Heal and totem healer; it lost ground to Holy Priests in 1.18.1.
overview: Shamans on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 are Horde-only (Orc, Troll, Tauren) Lodmat · 2025-04-03, Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-03-06 and fill every role from three trees: - **Enhancement** is the melee DPS spec and the easiest way into a raid, because its Windfury, Strength of Earth and Grace of Air totems are the best melee buffs in the game Squid · 2026-02-20, Squid · 2026-02-20. - **Tank** (Enhancement with shield talents, the "warden" tank) has the best snap threat of any tank and no defensive cooldown; it is the squishiest tank since 1.18.1. - **Elemental** is a Nature caster that shines in AoE; the old "fire ele" Molten Blast spec died in 1.18.1. - **Restoration** is a Chain-Heal and totem healer; it lost ground to Holy Priests in 1.18.1. **New player recommendation:** level as **Enhancement** (tank-capable talents), tank or DPS your dungeons, and at 60 respec (5 g) into Enhancement DPS, Tank or Restoration. "Enhancement is the only good spec for shaman leveling if you plan to do *any* solo content" peter_hammer · 2025-10-14; experienced raiders advise starting raids as Enhancement and switching to Elemental around AQ40 gear clesk · 2026-02-14.

readme.heading: What changed for shamans in 1.18.1
readme.markdown: 1.18.1 released on 2026-03-20; the class changes were posted by Jamey on 2026-01-23 and revised on 2026-03-19 ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)), with hotfixes on 03-21, 03-24 and 03-31 ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608), [2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139), [2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173490#p173490)). | Area | Change | What it means in play | |---|---|---| | Tank | Elemental Weapons' Rockbiter flat damage reduction → **Earthen Bulwark** absorb shield (20% of physical damage, tripled with a shield; absorbs 5/10/15% for 8 s; capped at 20% max HP) Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-03-08 | Starts at 0 each pull; at release it built only from auto-attacks (bug, still reported mid-April) Not Normal · 2026-04-13. PvP-motivated peter_hammer · 2026-02-16 | | Tank | T2.5 5-piece now boosts the bulwark instead of Rockbiter's threat; tank tier sets lose spell power | ~6% less threat multiplier Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-25; "T2.5 is now the mitigation set, all other tier sets are threat sets" Not Normal · 2026-03-22 | | Enhancement | Windfury Weapon 20% → 25% per hit; Stormstrike can no longer double-proc Windfury | Net neutral compensation Tirya · 2026-03-21, Not Normal · 2026-04-03 | | Enhancement | Elemental Weapons' Windfury effect: extra attacks give +1% attack speed per stack (up to 6) | Stacked only once per proc for weeks (bug) Not Normal · 2026-03-29 | | Enhancement | Flurry triggers from any crit (spell or melee) | Launch bugs (not from autos; overwritten by Rushing Winds) were fixed by 2026-03-28 Not Normal · 2026-03-28 | | Enhancement / Elemental | Flametongue/Frostbrand spell-power coefficients scale with weapon speed | Missing for ~3 weeks, then FT = 0.16 + 0.03 × speed, FB = 0.25 + 0.04 × speed Not Normal · 2026-04-08 | | Elemental | Flametongue's Elemental Weapons fire bonus now needs a melee hit | The ranged Molten Blast "fire ele" spec is gone; fire folded into Nature Elemental Aest · 2026-03-22 | | Elemental | Earthquake +15% base, 18 s cooldown; "fixed multiple issues" | Measured as hitting twice with no Elemental Fury on the AoE; dropped from single target Zhafu · 2026-03-21, Not Normal · 2026-03-23 | | Elemental | **Call of Earth** replaces Eye of the Storm (Earth Shield charges, pushback avoidance, replenished by offensive Nature spells) | 80% total pushback resistance, no more GCDs spent on Earth Shield Zhafu · 2026-03-20 | | Restoration | T1 8-piece reworked to a 250-point earth wall proc | Ends the T1 Healing-Wave build CantBelieveMyDecidueye · 2026-01-24 | | Restoration | Chain Heal no longer targets Guardians or Totems | Still not a "most wounded" smart heal, by design sailorVEVO · 2026-02-25, Lhian · 2026-03-22 | | All | Swapping relics (totems) in combat costs a GCD | The relic-swap macros are dead Zeruel · 2026-01-24, Haaxor1689 · 2026-01-24 | | All | Lightning Strike's rank 3 moved to the General tab | Macros must call `Lightning Strike(Rank 3)` Holidae · 2026-03-21 | | PvP | Spec-dependent damage dampening, resilience, new 3-tier PvP sets | Zhafu · 2026-03-08, poto · 2026-03-11 | Earlier Turtle changes you will meet in older guides: - **1.18 (2025-08):** Molten Blast and Earthquake added limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2025-08-08; Purge got an 8-second cooldown, Calming Winds became 8/16/25%, Nature's Swiftness became Ancestral Swiftness Galas · 2025-08-14; Totemic Alignment passes ~90% of totem threat to you Ordinary Joe · 2025-08-13; Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem became auras ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102972#p102972)). - **Rockbiter** is a +35% threat modifier (no longer flat threat per hit), so old guides telling tanks to use fast daggers are outdated Squid · 2025-10-05. - **Melee hit cap is 8%**, and every 5 weapon skill is 1% hit Not Normal · 2025-10-03, Zyith · 2025-10-16. - Totem range is 30 yards baseline Zhafu · 2025-11-30.

readme.heading: Totems
readme.markdown: ### Rules - **Unlocks:** Earth totems from the start; Fire at 10, Water at 20, Air at 30, each after a class quest Lionhermit · 2026-03-31. - **No global cooldown:** a totem only locks out its own element for 1.5 s, so you can weave Tremor or cleansing totems mid-rotation or drop four at once Dwi · 2026-03-14. - **All four on one key:** needs the Nampower client mod; then a macro with one `/cast ` line per element Netharia · 2026-03-31, Holidae · 2026-01-29. Addons: Call of Elements (use the MarcelineVQ fork) DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-11 or Sticks and Stones Hjelp · 2026-03-26. - **Totemic Mastery** (Resto) makes beneficial totems last 20% longer Durotavich · 2025-08-20. - **Totem of the Flowing Water** (relic) gives your water totems a party effect, only in combat: Healing Stream +2% healing done/taken, Mana Spring a chance per pulse to restore 1% mana, cleansing totems +10% resist, Fire Resistance −3% fire damage Not Normal · 2025-10-06, Unapologetically proud Shammy · 2025-10-09. - Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom stack Squid · 2025-11-04; resistance totems still don't stack with matching paladin auras Squid · 2025-11-04. ### Windfury Totem mechanics and "twisting" - Windfury Totem is an **aura**: main hand only, single rank, **1 extra attack with no bonus AP**, and a **2-second internal cooldown** (confirmed from a 200-proc log sample) Not Normal · 2026-03-01, Not Normal · 2026-03-27. - It **does nothing for a shaman with a weapon imbue**; any personal imbue blocks both Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem on you. Without an imbue, the two totems stack with each other Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-05, tomo · 2026-02-27. Your own Windfury Weapon (2 extra attacks, ~300 bonus AP each, no internal cooldown) is far stronger Not Normal · 2026-03-01. - **Totem twisting doesn't exist on Turtle:** because Windfury is an aura, it stops the moment you drop Grace of Air Dwi · 2026-03-14, poto · 2025-11-20. - **Windfury vs Grace of Air:** "if 2 damage dealers benefit from WF, use it. Otherwise use Grace of Air" trallnar · 2026-03-26; in a double-shaman group one drops each Not Normal · 2026-01-05. - **Flametongue Totem** adds ~15-20 DPS to a rogue or warrior and ~30 to a paladin (more Judgement of Wisdom procs) Squid · 2025-11-14. It briefly inherited Flametongue Weapon's new spell-power scaling in April 2026 (bug, fixed) Not Normal · 2026-04-08, Not Normal · 2026-04-16. ### Which totems when | Group | Earth | Fire | Water | Air | |---|---|---|---|---| | Melee group (default) | Strength of Earth | Flametongue | Mana Spring | Windfury (or Grace of Air, see rule) | | Caster group | Strength of Earth or Tremor | Searing | Mana Spring | **Tranquil Air** (−20% threat, multiplicative with Salvation) Squid · 2025-11-30, Papairoh · 2025-07-17 | | Tank, boss | Strength of Earth | Searing/Flametongue | Mana Spring | Windfury/Grace | | Tank, trash | **Stoneclaw** (needs Totemic Alignment) | Fire Nova, then Magma if needed | as above | as above ([Tank](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank)) | | Solo leveling | mostly none; Stoneclaw on multi-pulls, Earthbind vs runners | Searing | — | — Not Normal · 2026-03-15 | Situational: **Tremor** breaks fear on drop and pulses every 4 s piraja · 2026-01-11; **Grounding** eats one harmful spell (it works on AQ20's Cyclone and some Chess mechanics, does nothing on Twin Emperors) Rocked · 2026-03-07, Dwi · 2026-03-07; **Poison/Disease Cleansing** when afflicted; **resistance totems** on elemental-damage fights. Don't drop Nature Resistance Totem casually: "your melees will prefer death over no windfury" Dwi · 2026-02-24. **Stoneskin** applies before armor and is nearly useless on bosses Not Normal · 2026-01-06.

readme.heading: Professions
readme.markdown: - **Level with two gatherers** (Herbalism + Mining or Skinning). At 60, end on **Engineering + Herbalism** DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-01. Engineering is "the only one that increases dps" for any spec (Sappers, AoE threat, Force Reactive Disk) Zhafu · 2026-02-18, Zhafu · 2026-02-22. Its teleporters plus Astral Recall give near-mage mobility Nandieb · 2025-11-30. - **Herbalism** pays through the Dire Maul East lasher farm, ~100 g+/hour on a busy server DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-30, Zamka · 2025-10-09. Farming red and black Dragonscales with Skinning is the alternative Not Normal · 2025-10-10. - **Tanks:** Engineering + Jewelcrafting (BoP spell-damage items) 𝓶𝓮𝓮𝓫𝔂𝓫𝓫 · 2025-08-18. Blacksmithing makes the Fiery Chain fire-resistance set Méroulkas · 2026-02-25, poto · 2026-02-21. - **Skip for their own sake:** Alchemy has no shaman-specific perks peter_hammer · 2026-02-13. Leatherworking "is kinda ass" unless you refuse to trade Not Normal · 2026-01-17. Full guide: [Professions](#/class/shaman/professions) Shared pages: [Professions overview](#/professions) · [PvP systems](#/pvp) (honor, battlegrounds, Warmode) · [Game mechanics](#/mechanics) (buff and consumable stacking, enchant sources) · [Client setup](#/client-setup) (launcher, SuperWoW, addons). Tier sets: to swap a tier piece to another spec's version, see [Tier sets: spec exchange](#/mechanics). Ragnaros could drop shaman and paladin Tier 2 legs only once per kill; the reply to a bug report confirmed it as a bug to be fixed "with the next update" (2026-03-13), and on 2026-03-24 players were still asking if the fix was live Nabwek · 2026-03-13, Skylead · 2026-03-24.

readme.heading: Raid placement and utility
readme.markdown: - Every spec ends up in a melee group for Windfury and Strength of Earth; Elemental lacks a caster-group totem of its own Nandieb · 2026-03-19. The channel's "highest rdps melee group": 2 Enhancement shamans, a two-hand Fury warrior and 2 Combat rogues 30 · 2026-03-19. - Every shaman brings Purge, an interrupt (Earth Shock), cleansing totems and Tremor; Restoration adds Spirit Link.

matrix.notes: A Turtle-specific role built on CC2's dedicated tank talents (Ancestral Guardian, Spirit Armor, Totemic Alignment, Shield Specialization) plus Earthshaker Slam. Consensus that it is a fully viable levelling and dungeon tank; contested and generally called the weakest raid tank (no defensive cooldown, almost no mail defence gear, crit/crush immunity unreachable). Earthen Bulwark was reported bugged through 2026-04-07.

Contested only on whether it is boring and whether 1.18.x nerfs hurt. Its only 1.18.1 change was the T1 8-set becoming a 25%-chance absorb proc on Healing Wave / Lesser Healing Wave.

Structural weakness: no raid debuff amplifies Nature, costing roughly 18.4% versus fire/shadow casters, so single-target output is bottom-half while cleave is strong. 1.18.1 gave Earthquake +15% damage and an 18 s cooldown and extended Convection/Concussion to it, but its live behaviour is contested and unconfirmed by staff.

playbooks.title: Tank (Enhancement "warden" tank)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** tank with a **shield and a slow one-hander**, **Rockbiter Weapon** on it and the **15/36/0** tank build. Pull with Chain Lightning, hold packs with **Stoneclaw Totem + Totem of the Tides**, add Fire Nova when your group AoEs, and on single targets press **Earth Shock > Stormstrike > Lightning Strike**. Gear for **Stamina and Armor first** (your shield is the most important item), not Defense or block. You have the best snap threat and no defensive cooldown; you are the squishiest of the four tanks. | | | |---|---| | Role | Main or off-tank from dungeons to Tower of Karazhan; best on add, caster and AoE tanking | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Viable, gear-dependent**. "Shaman tanks can MT the entirety of Kara40" Mithreon · 2026-02-23; one MT reports MTing all of Kara40 after the patch with sub-4k crits from Mephistroth Zamka · 2026-04-12. After 1.18.1 it is "no longer even close to top threat tank, also the squishiest tank" Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-20; the least durable of the four but with "killer" threat, so best as OT/adds tank or a snap-threat MT Not Normal · 2026-03-26. **Contested:** some tanks see no real difference from 1.18 in near-BiS gear Mithreon · 2026-04-05 | | Difficulty | Medium to high: threat is easy ("you have to actively try to lower your threat to lose aggro" in dungeons Holidae · 2026-01-26); survival depends on gear, shield choice and healers | | Strengths | Best-in-class snap and AoE threat, strong vs casters (Grounding, resistance totems, Elemental Warding), totem utility, cheap respec to Enhancement DPS (90% shared talents Zhafu · 2026-03-11) | | Weaknesses | No defensive cooldown ("we are not getting a defensive cd anytime soon" Kokuyo · 2026-01-31); thin mail tank itemization Not Normal · 2026-04-14; Earthen Bulwark resets at pull and after stuns; taunt can be resisted with no backup oi-er · 2026-03-13 |

talents.markdown: ### Standard 15/36/0 (recommended) The standard physical tank build ("the more standard 15/36" Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-27); Holidae's "basic 60 build" for tanking Holidae · 2026-02-15; peter_hammer's tank example peter_hammer · 2025-10-19. It is also where the [leveling order](#/class/shaman/leveling) ends. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Elemental | Convection | 5/5 | | Elemental | Elemental Warding | 3/3 | | Elemental | Elemental Devastation | 3/3 | | Elemental | Elemental Focus | 1/1 | | Elemental | Reverberation | 3/3 | | Enhancement | Ancestral Knowledge | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Totemic Alignment | 2/2 | | Enhancement | Thundering Strikes | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Stable Shields | 3/3 | | Enhancement | Lightning Strike | 1/1 | | Enhancement | Ancestral Guardian | 3/3 | | Enhancement | Flurry | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Spirit Armor | 2/2 | | Enhancement | Elemental Weapons | 3/3 | | Enhancement | Stormstrike | 1/1 | | Enhancement | Element's Grace | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Bloodlust | 1/1 | Split **15/36/0**, VALID. [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=shaman&t=5003313-5025300135203151) Why: - **Spirit Armor** is "literally what makes a shaman tank" poto · 2025-11-08: with Ancestral Guardian your gear armor gets +15% and your shield's armor +30% more Holidae · 2025-11-07. - **Totemic Alignment 2/2**: about 90% of your totems' threat is credited to you; without it Stoneclaw gives the totem the aggro, not you trallnar · 2026-04-08, Not Normal · 2025-12-30. - **Elemental Warding 3/3** (-10% fire/frost/nature damage taken) over Concussion for tanks Andras · 2026-03-10. - **Reverberation + Elemental Focus + Element's Grace**: Reverberation is "more consistent" threat than Thundering Strikes/Flurry, and Element's Grace's crit is "a really big deal" Squid · 2025-10-21, Not Normal · 2025-10-21. - **Ancestral Knowledge, never Shield Specialization:** "shield spec basically does nothing. Better (especially AoE) threat, tight on points | `AoDYLAQDAC-FAVYALBQDIAY-` | "my fav tanking build" Nandieb · 2025-12-20; 22/29 vs 14/37 "is mostly personal preference" Not Normal · 2026-01-06; Ordinary Joe: "full spellhance tank, 22/29 for life" Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-27 | | **23/28 (post-1.18.1)** | As 22/29 but Elemental Mastery instead of the Flurry point (pull burst) | `AoDYLAQDBC-FAVYALAQDIAY-` | oi-er's post-patch tank link oi-er · 2026-03-23, oi-er · 2026-04-03; Elemental Mastery on pull defended by Zamka Zamka · 2026-02-25 | | **13/38 MT (raw threat)** | Concussion 5, Elemental Warding 2, Reverberation 2; adds Enhancing Totems 2 | `AoCYK-FAVYALFQTIAoB-` | Frost: "22/29 is a joke for MTs" on Ambershire, go raw stats and 13/38 Frost · 2026-03-10, Frost · 2026-03-10; loses only "3% mit and 0.3 sec shock cd" Frost · 2026-03-27 | **Contested:** physical 15/36 or 13/38 vs spell 22/29. The spell build gives "crazy AoE threat" and bigger Earth Shock crits Not Normal · 2026-01-20; the physical builds get Bloodlust and Enhancing Totems for the group Not Normal · 2026-01-06 and suit nature-resistant bosses Frost · 2026-03-09. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Stamina and Armor** (equal). "Main stats will always be ARMOR = STAMINA > AGI"; Defense "is a nice addition but never a focus" poto · 2026-02-21. Your **shield's armor** is "probably the single most important thing" Not Normal · 2026-03-26; a bad shield costs ~1000 armor and ~700 HP billienomates · 2025-11-14. Armor gains scale EHP linearly Nandieb · 2026-02-11. 2. **Hit to 8% melee** (4% from gear with the weapon-skill book) Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-28. You cannot dual wield, so hit above 8% does nothing poto · 2026-02-21, poto · 2026-02-21. 3. **Weapon skill to 315** for threat (Stormstrike/Lightning Strike are not normalized); MC gloves + Orc racial + quest book = exactly 315 Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-03-27. 4. **Threat stats:** Strength > spell power > Agility Not Normal · 2026-03-26. A couple of points of spell hit help taunt and Earth Shock reliability Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-29. 5. **Agility** for dodge and crit. Not worth chasing: - **Defense.** Unless you can reach 440 (crit immunity), "it's better to focus on armor and health" Kairion · 2026-01-28; shaman tanks can't reach it in practice Xorlord · 2026-04-05. Crushing blows stay at 15% regardless of Defense Zhafu · 2026-03-04; pushing them off needs ~85-88% avoidance, which mail gear can't reach Not Normal · 2026-02-21. - **Block** and Shield Specialization (above). - Rugged armor kits beat Defense kits unless they get you to 440 Kairion · 2026-01-28. Sample benchmark: a tank at ~8k armor, 5k HP unbuffed and 120 FR asking about MTing Ragnaros was told it should be fine ("if you can tank the last boss of Black Morass you can probably tank Rag") Hobo · 2026-04-02, Boorenka · 2026-04-02; ~250 FR is plenty for Geddon and mostly for Ragnaros OmniSalat · 2026-03-08.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Pull:** Chain Lightning ("an incredible tank tool for pulling") Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-26, Not Normal · 2026-03-26, or Molten Blast into Chain Lightning for opening burst threat Holidae · 2025-11-14. Lightning Shield for the pull, then Water Shield when mana drops to about two thirds Snook · 2026-01-05. Priority: 1. **Earth Shock** on cooldown: about 40% of your threat Not Normal · 2025-12-25, Mikoto Rin · 2026-04-02. 2. **Stormstrike** on cooldown (buffs the next Earth Shock). 3. **Lightning Strike** on cooldown Boorenka · 2026-03-30. 4. Keep **auto-attacking** (it builds the bulwark and is a big threat share at high gear). 5. Refresh Lightning/Water Shield; tea and mana potion on cooldown Boorenka · 2026-02-11. Rules: - Keep **rank 1 Earth Shock** bound only for interrupts when low on mana peter_hammer · 2025-10-05. - **Never hard-cast while being hit**: casting drops your dodge, parry and block to zero Nandieb · 2025-12-03. - Earth Shield is a poor tank tool (small heals vs 1-2k hits); use Water Shield poto · 2025-12-03. - Call out a **resisted taunt** at once so healers pre-cast oi-er · 2026-03-13. **Bot-ready loop:** `on pull: Chain Lightning (or Molten Blast) at range` · `Rockbiter Weapon on MH if missing` · `Earth Shock if ready` · `Stormstrike if ready` · `Lightning Strike if ready` · `auto-attack` · `if mana < 66% and Lightning Shield up → Water Shield` · `taunt (Earthshaker Slam) if target not on you and not resisted`.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE tanking
rotationAoe.markdown: AoE threat is a cost-vs-need hierarchy (Not Normal) Not Normal · 2026-04-10, Not Normal · 2026-04-10: | Situation | Tools | |---|---| | Normal pack | **Chain Lightning pull + Stoneclaw Totem + Totem of the Tides** (Water Shield up), tab Earth Shock / strikes | | Party AoEs hard | Add **Fire Nova Totem** (more up-front than Magma, the standard choice) Not Normal · 2026-03-26 | | Party still pulls | **Magma Totem after Nova**, "last resort, it will destroy your mana" Not Normal · 2026-04-10; use it if mobs live a long time Not Normal · 2026-03-22 | | Emergency snap | Goblin Sapper Charge + Stoneclaw together, plus Fire Nova on a free GCD (it triggers its own GCD, so not truly simultaneous) billienomates · 2025-11-14 | - **Stoneclaw Totem** does not taunt; it pulses about 150 threat every 1.5 s to everything in range, 90% of it credited to you with Totemic Alignment Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-07, trallnar · 2026-04-08. - **Totem of the Tides** (relic from [Stormwrought Ruins](#/instances/stormwrought-ruins)): AoE frost damage whenever you're hit with Water Shield up; "undisputed best for aoe", especially with **Sigil of Ancient Accord** Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-26, Not Normal · 2026-03-26. Sigil procs from its damage Holidae · 2026-02-17 and made up ~7% of one tank's damage on almost every boss Boorenka · 2026-02-17. - **Improved Fire Totems** is still usually taken despite -50% fire totem threat: the 2-second Fire Nova is "insane" QoL Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-03; **Contested:** it loses threat at the 9-second mark and some skip it so Magma "pumps" Zamka · 2026-04-03, Zamka · 2026-02-24. - The bulwark is less reliable on trash (stuns, fears, disarms, AoE burst before it builds) Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-24.

The PvP tank set's raw stamina "absolutely smokes" BWL gear and is BiS in most slots on Ambershire; T2 bracers and chest are the mid upgrade ThatsTheJoke · 2026-03-28, ThatsTheJoke · 2026-03-28, Boorenka · 2026-04-13 | | Trinkets | Zandalari Hero Badge (lasts longest) Zeruel · 2026-01-25; Hatereaver Cog and Araxxna's Husk Zeruel · 2025-11-20, poto · 2026-02-23; Sigil of Ancient Accord for Totem of the Tides builds Boorenka · 2026-02-11; Runed Wardstone for MC/BWL fire fights Nandieb · 2026-02-11; threat: Slayer's Crest over Kiss of the Spider Zhafu · 2026-03-08, Natural Alignment Crystal Not Normal · 2026-03-13, Neltharion's Tear for spell hit Not Normal · 2026-03-13 | | Relic | Totem of the Tides (AoE); Stonebreaker / Thundercaller for single target | After 1.18.1 some tanks run full DPS gear for threat and swap rings, neck and trinkets between tank and threat loadouts poto · 2026-02-24. A fast dagger as tank weapon poto · 2026-02-01. 4. Two-hand tanking hard bosses Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-27. 5. Stoneclaw without Totemic Alignment Not Normal · 2025-12-30. 6. Stoneskin Totem on bosses Not Normal · 2026-01-06. 7. Hard-casting under melee Nandieb · 2025-12-03. 8. Magma Totem on every pull (mana) Not Normal · 2026-04-10. 9. consumables.heading: Weapons and imbues
consumables.markdown: - **Imbue:** Rockbiter on a **slow one-hander**. "SS/LS aren't AP normalized so slow swing speed is king" Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-25; "we don't use daggers anymore, that's old meta" poto · 2026-02-01. - **Bulwark-bug exception:** while bulwark builds only from autos, some tanks swap to a faster weapon (Spineshatter over Deathbringer) to keep it up Boorenka · 2026-04-13. - **Weapon enchant: Crusader**, "always crusader"; Agility only for an avoidance-stacking set Zeruel · 2026-02-03, Zhafu · 2026-02-03. No spell-power enchants for tanks Not Normal · 2026-04-10. | Phase | Weapon | Source | |---|---|---| | Pre-raid | Hand of Edward the Odd (Caverns of Time rep, cheap) | poto · 2026-02-01 | | MC-BWL | **Deathbringer** (slowest, hardest-hitting 1H) | Frost · 2026-02-28, Thataintmilk · 2026-03-25 | | BWL | Spineshatter ("probably BiS from BWL") | Zamka · 2026-02-24 | | Nature-resistant bosses | Carry Modrag'zan as well as Deathbringer | Frost · 2026-03-09 | | AQ40+ | Remnants of an Old God (C'Thun) | Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-03-10 | **Contested:** Hand of Edward the Odd's instant Chain Lightning procs (~1500 threat every 15-20 s) vs the Stormstrike damage lost to a weak stat-stick Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-02-01, poto · 2026-02-02. **2H tanking is not viable** in real content: the shield is ~50% of your armor and gives 10% bonus threat Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-27; Broodlord and Nefarian need a shield Chidi <beta tester> · 2026-03-27. **Contested:** a geared MT says "if you're geared enough you can 2H tank" Frost · 2026-03-27.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 tank loop with the [15/36/0 build](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank). Details: [Single target](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank), [AoE tanking](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank), [Totems](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank), [Earthen Bulwark](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank). 1. **Setup:** Rockbiter Weapon on a slow one-hander, highest-armor shield, Lightning Shield up. Ask for Power Word: Shield before the pull: the bulwark starts at zero Zeruel · 2026-02-16. 2. **Pull:** Chain Lightning Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-26, or Molten Blast into Chain Lightning for more opening threat Holidae · 2025-11-14. 3. **First GCDs:** Earth Shock the kill target, Stormstrike, Lightning Strike, auto-attack; on a pack drop Stoneclaw Totem as they arrive. 4. **Steady threat loop:** **Earth Shock > Stormstrike > Lightning Strike** on cooldown, never stop auto-attacking (autos build the bulwark). Swap Lightning Shield to Water Shield at about two thirds mana Snook · 2026-01-05. 5. **Multi-mob threat:** Stoneclaw Totem + Totem of the Tides with Water Shield up, tab Earth Shock across the pack; add Fire Nova when the party AoEs; Magma after Nova only as a last resort Not Normal · 2026-04-10, Not Normal · 2026-04-10. 6. **Taunt / threat recovery:** Earthshaker Slam (5 yd, 10 s cooldown, off the global cooldown), then Earth Shock. If the taunt is resisted, say so at once Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-13. Emergency snap on a whole pack: Fire Nova + Stoneclaw (+ Goblin Sapper Charge). 7. **Defensive rules:** you have no defensive cooldown. Use healthstones, teas and Stoneshield potions Zhafu · 2026-03-08; tea + mana potion on cooldown for mana Boorenka · 2026-02-11. 8. **Avoid:** hard-casting while being hit (it drops dodge, parry and block to zero) Nandieb · 2025-12-03; rank 1 Earth Shock for threat (it is only for cheap interrupts); Magma on every pull; Stoneskin Totem on bosses; Stoneclaw without Totemic Alignment.

extraSections.heading: How the 1.18.1 tank kit works
extraSections.markdown: **Rockbiter Weapon** is your tank stance. It adds **+35% threat** to everything (since 1.18 a percentage, which is why slow weapons are now best) Squid · 2025-10-05, OmniSalat · 2025-11-30. **Earthen Bulwark** (Elemental Weapons 3/3 with Rockbiter, new in 1.18.1) replaced the old flat 10% damage reduction: "Your physical damage builds up an earthen bulwark for 20% of the damage dealt, tripled while you're wearing a shield. The earthen bulwark absorbs 5/10/15% of incoming damage for 8 seconds or until the bulwark mitigates enough damage. The bulwark's durability cannot exceed 20% of your maximum health" ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-03-08). - It applies **after armor**, then other % reductions, then block value last Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-20. - It starts at **0 every pull** and drops completely after 8 seconds without a landed auto-attack; you cannot build it at range LLVE · 2026-03-30, LLVE · 2026-04-13. - **Live bug:** it builds only from **white auto-attacks**, not Stormstrike or Lightning Strike. A hotfix note on 2026-03-24 said it builds from melee abilities too ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139)), but tanks still reported autos-only in mid-April; "it's a bug rather than a poor design choice", left unfixed "for 3 weeks" Not Normal · 2026-04-13, Not Normal · 2026-04-14. - Impact is gear and fight dependent: 80% uptime on Patchwerk but 40-50% on Naxx trash (stuns, fears, disarms) Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-24; 91% uptime in a Chromaggus log Not Normal · 2026-04-14; some tanks in full mitigation gear have "trouble keeping up bulwark" in BWL Nandieb · 2026-04-13. - The change was aimed at PvP (Restoration shamans using the old flat reduction) peter_hammer · 2026-02-16; the dev expected "for actual tanks it shouldn't change much, tiny nerf at most" but "big nerf for spelltanks" Haaxor1689 · 2026-01-24, Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-01-24. **T2.5 (the only mail tank set)** lost its old Rockbiter threat bonus: its 5-piece now boosts the bulwark (+25% build-up, +3% absorb). That cost roughly 6% of your threat multiplier (1.48 vs 1.57) Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-25. "T2.5 is now the mitigation set, all other tier sets are threat sets" Not Normal · 2026-03-22, and tank tier sets no longer carry spell power Not Normal · 2026-02-15. **No defensive cooldown** exists; community workarounds are healthstones, teas and Stoneshield potions Zhafu · 2026-03-08, Zeruel · 2025-11-21. Ask for Power Word: Shield before the pull: Stormstrike and your first auto build enough bulwark to absorb 10-15% of a crit almost at once Zeruel · 2026-02-16.

standing.source_quality: strong on mechanics/threat/rotation; medium on stats (single-source numbers); weak on post-1.18.1 viability
standing.notes: A Turtle-specific role built on CC2's dedicated tank talents (Ancestral Guardian, Spirit Armor, Totemic Alignment, Shield Specialization) plus Earthshaker Slam. Consensus that it is a fully viable levelling and dungeon tank; contested and generally called the weakest raid tank (no defensive cooldown, almost no mail defence gear, crit/crush immunity unreachable). Earthen Bulwark was reported bugged through 2026-04-07.

patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 replaced Elemental Weapons' Rockbiter passive -10% damage taken with Earthen Bulwark (an absorb shield); the Enh T2.5 5-set was reworked to boost it; both are reported bugged/not stacking from special attacks through 2026-04-07. No post-1.18.1 guide update was posted (Mimiwarmini's promised explanation never came). Talent point allocations and the threat rotation are unaffected. Discord adds the post-1.18.1 AoE-threat priority and the Chromaggus/Nefarian/drakonid notes in `discord:` below. Guide rewrite (guide/classes/shaman/tank.md): talents/rotation/stats refreshed to the post-1.18.1 15/36/0 standard; Earthen Bulwark still reported building only from auto-attacks through 2026-04-14 [[d:shaman#1493387191328571602]].

yaml.stat_priority_note: Mimiwarmini's tanking order; the same guide gives a separate threat order of hit > agility > spell power > crit > strength. Agility versus Strength for second place is CONTESTED: Mimiwarmini prefers Agility because Rockbiter already supplies ~653 attack power and Agility adds threat and survivability, Skegg puts Strength second once you are 60 (Agility second only while leveling), and Akos1896's pre-CC2 order is stam > agi > melee crit > haste > dodge/parry > strength > int. Guide targets pre-raid: 8% physical hit, 17% spell hit, 160 stamina, 100 agility, 6,000 armor, 20 defense.

Fire Nova Totem if the party AoEs
Magma after Nova only as last resort

cooldowns: No defensive cooldown: healthstone, tea, Stoneshield Potion
Tea + mana potion on cooldown
Emergency pack snap: Fire Nova + Stoneclaw (+ Goblin Sapper Charge)
tank: Earthshaker Slam (5 yd, 10 s cd, off GCD) then Earth Shock when a mob leaves you
Rank 1 Earth Shock only for cheap interrupts

glance.recommendation: Tank with a **shield and a slow one-hander**, **Rockbiter Weapon** on it and the **15/36/0** tank build. Pull with Chain Lightning, hold packs with **Stoneclaw Totem + Totem of the Tides**, add Fire Nova when your group AoEs, and on single targets press **Earth Shock > Stormstrike > Lightning Strike**. Gear for **Stamina and Armor first** (your shield is the most important item), not Defense or block. You have the best snap threat and no defensive cooldown; you are the squishiest of the four tanks.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Main or off-tank from dungeons to Tower of Karazhan; best on add, caster and AoE tanking

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Viable, gear-dependent**. "Shaman tanks can MT the entirety of Kara40" Mithreon · 2026-02-23; one MT reports MTing all of Kara40 after the patch with sub-4k crits from Mephistroth Zamka · 2026-04-12. After 1.18.1 it is "no longer even close to top threat tank, also the squishiest tank" Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-20; the least durable of the four but with "killer" threat, so best as OT/adds tank or a snap-threat MT Not Normal · 2026-03-26. **Contested:** some tanks see no real difference from 1.18 in near-BiS gear Mithreon · 2026-04-05

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium to high: threat is easy ("you have to actively try to lower your threat to lose aggro" in dungeons Holidae · 2026-01-26); survival depends on gear, shield choice and healers

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Best-in-class snap and AoE threat, strong vs casters (Grounding, resistance totems, Elemental Warding), totem utility, cheap respec to Enhancement DPS (90% shared talents Zhafu · 2026-03-11)

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: No defensive cooldown ("we are not getting a defensive cd anytime soon" Kokuyo · 2026-01-31); thin mail tank itemization Not Normal · 2026-04-14; Earthen Bulwark resets at pull and after stuns; taunt can be resisted with no backup oi-er · 2026-03-13

playbooks.title: Restoration (healer)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **0/8/43** build. In raids your job is **totems + rank 1 Chain Heal**, with a low-rank Healing Wave for single-target top-ups and max-rank Lesser Healing Wave or an Ancestral Swiftness Healing Wave for emergencies. Stack **healing power and haste**; mp5 and crit are secondary, Spirit does nothing. Use a **mana oil**, not a weapon imbue. | | | |---|---| | Role | Raid AoE healer (Chain Heal), group-buff totems, Spirit Link, Purge, interrupts | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Playable, weakest healer after the patch.** "Your role in raids will largely boil down to dropping totems and spamming chain heal" Not Normal · 2026-04-04; "Resto is just cooked because most people don't want to spam chainheal and be the worst healer" Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-04-04. The same patch buffed Holy Priests: a year-long resto main watched three guild priests out-heal them on almost every kill Svargth · 2026-03-21, and another switched to priest Svargth · 2026-03-24. Before the patch shamans were "usually the backbone of most raid healing" Squid · 2025-12-24 and a shaman always gets a raid spot for totems Zhafu · 2026-02-20 | | Difficulty | Low in rotation, medium in positioning and mana | | Strengths | Chain Heal throughput on stacked raids, totems (Windfury, Strength of Earth, Mana Spring, Tremor, cleansing, resistances), Spirit Link, tank healing is "pretty solid" Not Normal · 2026-03-22 | | Weaknesses | Chain Heal doesn't prioritize the most wounded (see below); one-button gameplay; weak set bonuses; mail healing gear is scarce |

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid 0/8/43 (recommended) The most common level-60 build among five active raiders polled Nick · 2026-02-09; "the standard resto talent setup is to have 5 pts in Ancestral Knowledge, 3 points in Stable Shields, then all other points dumped in resto (you only skip the reincarnate talent and the threat talent)" Not Normal · 2026-04-03; "8/43 is the only non-meme healing spec" peter_hammer · 2026-02-15. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Enhancement | Ancestral Knowledge | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Stable Shields | 3/3 | | Restoration | Improved Healing Wave | 5/5 | | Restoration | Tidal Focus | 5/5 | | Restoration | Ancestral Healing | 3/3 | | Restoration | Tidal Mastery | 5/5 | | Restoration | Healing Way | 3/3 | | Restoration | Healing Focus | 2/2 | | Restoration | Totemic Mastery | 1/1 | | Restoration | Restorative Totems | 5/5 | | Restoration | Improved Water Shield | 3/3 | | Restoration | Tidal Surge | 2/2 | | Restoration | Ancestral Swiftness | 1/1 | | Restoration | Undertow | 2/2 | | Restoration | Improved Chain Heal | 5/5 | | Restoration | Spirit Link | 1/1 | Split **0/8/43**, VALID. Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=-FAAY-FoDoaIFYQKFAB` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman/-U0I-Z3XD5K8V`. [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=shaman&t=-50003-5503532105321251) Why: - **Stable Shields 3/3** gives 9-charge shields peter_hammer · 2025-10-19; **Ancestral Knowledge** is 5% more Intellect. - **Healing Focus 2/2** (70% pushback reduction) plus Earth Shield covers pushback; skipping pushback resistance is "pretty miserable" on raid-wide-damage bosses Not Normal · 2026-03-23, Not Normal · 2026-03-23. - **Spirit Link** is "worth it at least as an oh shit button" peter_hammer · 2026-02-15. - Skip **Improved Reincarnation** and **Nature's Grace** (the Resto threat talent) Chidi <beta tester> · 2026-03-21. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **No Undertow** (Chain Heal only) | Undertow 2 → Improved Reincarnation 1 + Nature's Grace 1 (Undertow can't proc from Chain Heal) | `-FAAY-FoLoaJFYQIFAB` | Nick · 2026-02-09, Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-09 | **Contested:** if you skip Undertow, Diving Instructor Knife says take 2/2 Reincarnation or 2/3 threat, not a 1/1 split Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-09; the poller called the differences "marginal" Nick · 2026-02-09.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: 1. **Healing power** and **haste**, roughly equal Not Normal · 2026-01-06; Not Normal: "heal power > int > mp5 > (spirit doesn't even belong on this list, it does literally nothing for shamans)" Not Normal · 2026-01-06. For raw output haste is "by far our strongest point per stat", worth 12-20 healing power per 1% (more the more healing power you have) Not Normal · 2026-04-08. "Haste is like crack to restos" Not Normal · 2025-12-30. 2. **Intellect.** 3. **mp5**: never a primary consideration; only a tie-breaker when healing power is close Not Normal · 2026-03-26. 4. **Crit**: "does literally nothing useful for resto, unlike e.g. holy paladin" and adds overhealing Not Normal · 2026-01-06. **Caps and breakpoints:** Chain Heal reaches the GCD floor at ~25% haste and Healing Wave rank 4+ at ~34%; typical raid haste from T2.5+ gear and buffs is ~16% Mithreon · 2026-01-25. Chain Heal's haste soft cap is ~33% after multiplicative stacking Not Normal · 2026-01-06. With enough mana consumables, stack healing power Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-08. Low spell ranks scale poorly with healing power (scaling depends on cast time), so don't trade Intellect for +healing to buff a rank-2 Healing Wave Nandieb · 2026-01-01, Cariad · 2026-02-02.

rotationSingle.heading: Healing rotation (raid)
rotationSingle.markdown: **Pre-pull:** Water Shield, mana oil on the weapon, totems for your group. 1. **Drop totems**, then **Chain Heal rank 1** until the pack or phase is over; recall totems and move peter_hammer · 2025-12-05, Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-27. 2. **Chain Heal rank 3** only when raid damage is heavy (it burns mana) peter_hammer · 2026-02-15, Bubkez · 2026-01-25. 3. **Healing Wave rank 3-4** for single-target top-ups: rank 3 is the most mana-efficient rank that isn't crippled by the GCD, rank 4 has almost full scaling Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-27. Add rank 6+ as a secondary single-target heal once your healing power is good; rank 1 Chain Heal stays the raid-healing main Bubkez · 2026-01-25. 4. **Lesser Healing Wave (max rank)** for emergencies: highest single-target HPS but "an absolute mana demolisher"; don't downrank it Not Normal · 2026-01-07, Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-27. 5. **Ancestral Swiftness + max-rank Healing Wave** as the instant emergency heal Hassle · 2026-04-05. 6. **Spirit Link** in burn or enrage phases when a tank is near death. 7. Keep **Water Shield** up; with 2/2 Undertow a Healing Wave below 3 charges restores a charge, at 3 charges it consumes one for mana Chiahna · 2026-03-11. Spell ranks to buy (peter_hammer): Chain Heal ranks 1 and 3, Healing Wave ranks 4/5 and 10 peter_hammer · 2026-02-15. **Chain Heal's targeting:** it lands on your target, then jumps to nearby injured players, preferring your party, but not the most wounded Zhafu · 2025-11-14, Lhian · 2026-03-22. Aim it at clumps (melee, tank stacks) where the jumps can't be wasted. Stack tighter than you would elsewhere: a beta tester measured the jump range at about 7.6 yd instead of the expected 9.8-10 yd and added it to bug report 18234 (2025-11, pre-1.18.1; no later measurement) Chidi <beta tester> · 2025-11-07, Chidi <beta tester> · 2025-11-02. **Bot-ready loop:** `if totems missing → drop group totem set` · `if Water Shield missing → Water Shield` · `if target HP < 35% and Ancestral Swiftness ready → Ancestral Swiftness + Healing Wave (max)` · `elif target HP < 35% → Lesser Healing Wave (max)` · `elif ≥3 injured in a clump → Chain Heal (rank 1; rank 3 if raid damage high)` · `elif one injured → Healing Wave rank 4` · `mana < 40% → tea / potion`. ### Dungeons Use **Healing Wave far more than Chain Heal** unless the whole group is stacked Bezawit · 2026-02-08; one healer mostly uses Healing Wave rank 3 and "never drinks" Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-27. Max-rank Lesser Healing Wave, Healing Wave and Chain Heal on your bars is enough even for hard pulls Holidae · 2026-02-08, Holidae · 2026-02-08.

cooldowns.heading: Spirit Link and cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: - **Spirit Link** is now raid-wide with a 30-yard range, so someone is usually in range Diving Instructor Knife · 2025-11-26; it shares the tank's damage across the raid. It is weak on fights where the raid shouldn't stand near the tank (Twin Emperors) poto · 2025-11-26. **Contested:** Priests' new Ascendance is said to "completely blow Spirit Link out of the water" Svargth · 2026-03-21. - **Ancestral Swiftness** (was Nature's Swiftness): instant next Nature spell; damage spells cast with it deal 25% less Cruelia · 2025-08-14. - **Breath of Solnius** is extra strong on shamans because totem drops can proc it Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-03.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Expecting Chain Heal to find the lowest-health player Lhian · 2026-03-22. 2. Buying +healing to boost low ranks Nandieb · 2026-01-01. 5. A weapon imbue instead of mana oil peter_hammer · 2026-02-15. 6. Chasing the old T1 8-piece Healing Wave build (reworked in 1.18.1) CantBelieveMyDecidueye · 2026-01-24. 7. Chain Heal spam in 5-mans where the group isn't stacked Bezawit · 2026-02-08. 8. enchants.heading: Enchants
enchants.markdown: Healing-power and haste enchants; at moderate gear, compare the HPS a haste enchant adds to your main spell with a healing-power enchant: under-geared Chain Heal spammers usually want healing power Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-01-23. Pre-raid list: +9 SP armor kits, 2% haste shoulders, 1% haste vs +12 SP on helm/legs, +12 healing ring/neck (JC), +10 Int buckle Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31.

consumables.heading: Weapon imbue
consumables.markdown: **No imbue; use a mana oil** peter_hammer · 2026-02-15. Oils can't be applied while an imbue is on the weapon Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2025-12-16.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 healing loop with the [0/8/43 build](#/class/shaman/restoration-healer). Details: [Raid rotation](#/class/shaman/restoration-healer), [Dungeons](#/class/shaman/restoration-healer), [Cooldowns](#/class/shaman/restoration-healer), [Totems](#/class/shaman/restoration-healer). 1. **Keep up:** Water Shield, mana oil on the weapon, the group totem set (Windfury or Grace of Air, Strength of Earth, Mana Spring, a fire totem); drop totems, heal the pack, recall and move peter_hammer · 2025-12-05. 2. **Default heal by damage pattern:** - Raid-wide or stacked group damage → **Chain Heal rank 1**; rank 3 only under heavy raid damage Not Normal · 2026-04-04. - Steady tank damage → **Healing Wave rank 3–4**; rank 6+ once your healing power is good Bubkez · 2026-01-25. - Spike on one target → **max-rank Lesser Healing Wave** ("an absolute mana demolisher") Not Normal · 2026-01-07. - 5-man → Healing Wave far more than Chain Heal unless everyone is stacked Bezawit · 2026-02-08. 3. **Triage:** tank near death → Ancestral Swiftness + max-rank Healing Wave, else Lesser Healing Wave; then clumps (aim Chain Heal at the clump: it does not pick the most wounded); then top-ups. 4. **Mana plan:** tea and mana potion on cooldown; with Undertow a Healing Wave below 3 Water Shield charges restores one, at 3 it turns one into mana Chiahna · 2026-03-11; Fruitcakes for fast downtime mana Zaaparou · 2025-10-05. 5. **Cooldowns:** Ancestral Swiftness (3 min) for the instant emergency heal; Spirit Link (10 min) in burn or enrage phases when a tank is about to die. 6. **Dispels / utility:** Cure Poison and Cure Disease, Poison/Disease Cleansing Totems, Tremor Totem on fear fights, Purge enemy buffs, Earth Shock to interrupt (vanilla baseline).

standing.notes: The most-wanted class/spec combination in the game per multiple sources; Chain-Heal-centric raid AoE healing plus Spirit Link. Contested only on whether it is boring and whether 1.18.x nerfs hurt. Its only 1.18.1 change was the T1 8-set becoming a 25%-chance absorb proc on Healing Wave / Lesser Healing Wave.

rotation_single.action: Chain Heal rank 1 spam is the default raid heal (max rank when heavy raidwide damage lands); Healing Wave rank 4/5 for isolated single-target damage (r3 most mana-efficient, r4 near-max scaling); Lesser Healing Wave only for emergencies (giga mana inefficient, never a routine raid heal); rank-1 Healing Wave pre-pull to set Healing Way and fish the Ancestral Fortitude proc.
R1 -> R2 Chain Heal base-heal gap ~92.5, i.e. ~149 +healing; LHW is never downranked (HW r3 already casts 1.7 s).

rotation_aoe.action: Chain Heal is the only AoE heal; Healing Stream Totem is the supplementary AoE heal. No numeric target threshold exists in the channel.

totems: Totems are off-GCD auras, four droppable at once, stack with oils/poisons; totem twisting is dead post-CC2 [[d:shaman#1361235720567525467]], [[d:shaman#1482118867835687032]].

Cleansing totems are the best water totems: instant/off-GCD, cover the whole party instead of Decursive, and do not trigger the Loatheb debuff [[d:shaman#1377134664648757300]], [[d:shaman#1380690300531380234]], [[d:shaman#1376906060614467704]].
Mana Spring is weaker than Blessing of Wisdom and is not buffed by Resto talents; it is used to refill between pulls [[d:shaman#1374677881292197938]].
Healing Stream is the useful dungeon/raidwide-damage option; contested as 'still bad' [[d:shaman#1374680418707574838]], [[d:shaman#1429871523447050396]], [[d:shaman#1410229297482043403]].

Totem of Calming River is the Resto BiS totem until Naxx (+8 mp5 while Water Shield active, +10 mana per pop, amplified by Improved Water Shield) [[d:shaman#1440622702930169946]], [[d:shaman#1416210028657901588]]; Totem of Flowing Water grants party effects on water totems [[d:shaman#1424838222546210907]].

yaml.stat_priority_note: "Get as much +healing and +int as you can" (Skegg); on a badly geared resto shaman Intellect matters most, with about a 4k mana pool as the target. Mana regeneration is CONTESTED: one camp says ignore mp5, Spirit and percentage-regen gear entirely and solve mana with downranking, tea and potions, the other keeps at least +10% while-casting regen until T2/T2.5. No source gives numeric weights.

heal: Raid-wide / stacked damage: Chain Heal rank 1 (rank 3 under heavy damage)
Steady tank damage: Healing Wave rank 3-4 (rank 6+ with good healing power)
Spike: max-rank Lesser Healing Wave
Tank near death: Ancestral Swiftness + max-rank Healing Wave
5-man: Healing Wave far more than Chain Heal unless the group is stacked
Spirit Link in burn / enrage phases
Mana: tea + potion on cooldown; Undertow keeps Water Shield charges
Dispel: Cure Poison / Cure Disease, cleansing totems, Tremor Totem, Purge
cooldowns: Ancestral Swiftness (3 min) for the instant emergency heal
Spirit Link (10 min) when a tank is about to die

glance.recommendation: Play the **0/8/43** build. In raids your job is **totems + rank 1 Chain Heal**, with a low-rank Healing Wave for single-target top-ups and max-rank Lesser Healing Wave or an Ancestral Swiftness Healing Wave for emergencies. Stack **healing power and haste**; mp5 and crit are secondary, Spirit does nothing. Use a **mana oil**, not a weapon imbue.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Raid AoE healer (Chain Heal), group-buff totems, Spirit Link, Purge, interrupts

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Playable, weakest healer after the patch.** "Your role in raids will largely boil down to dropping totems and spamming chain heal" Not Normal · 2026-04-04; "Resto is just cooked because most people don't want to spam chainheal and be the worst healer" Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-04-04. The same patch buffed Holy Priests: a year-long resto main watched three guild priests out-heal them on almost every kill Svargth · 2026-03-21, and another switched to priest Svargth · 2026-03-24. Before the patch shamans were "usually the backbone of most raid healing" Squid · 2025-12-24 and a shaman always gets a raid spot for totems Zhafu · 2026-02-20

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Low in rotation, medium in positioning and mana

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Chain Heal throughput on stacked raids, totems (Windfury, Strength of Earth, Mana Spring, Tremor, cleansing, resistances), Spirit Link, tank healing is "pretty solid" Not Normal · 2026-03-22

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Chain Heal doesn't prioritize the most wounded (see below); one-button gameplay; weak set bonuses; mail healing gear is scarce

playbooks.title: Enhancement (melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **17/34/0 two-hander build** with **Windfury Weapon** on the slowest good two-hander you can get. Press **Stormstrike > Lightning Strike > shock** (Flame Shock, then Earth Shock, Earth Shock), keep Lightning Shield up and drop your four group totems. Cap **8% melee hit** (4% from gear after talents and the weapon-skill book), push weapon skill toward 315, then stack **Strength** (worth about twice Agility). "Spellhance" (Flametongue, spell power, 22/29) is a niche AoE variant for theorycrafters, covered below. | | | |---|---| | Role | Melee DPS plus the best melee-group buffs in the game (Windfury, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air totems) | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Good, and the easiest raid spot to get**: "the best melee buffs in the game" make an enhancer wanted regardless of personal DPS Squid · 2026-02-20, Zhafu · 2026-02-20. Personal DPS is mid-pack: roughly on par with feral and survival hunter, below warrior and rogue Not Normal · 2026-03-25; about equal to Retribution with far better utility Not Normal · 2026-02-28. Top Patchwerk parses are higher than the best 1.18 ones Not Normal · 2026-04-03. Called "the best spec right now because it has the least bugs" in April 2026 Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-04-04 | | Difficulty | Low to medium: "nothing clips autos, just smash your buttons; the only art is in timing your CDs with procs" Kyle Sussenbach · 2026-03-26 | | Strengths | Windfury burst, self-Bloodlust, party buffs, cleave via Fire Nova and Chain Lightning, can off-tank with the same talents ([Tank](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank)) | | Weaknesses | RNG-heavy damage; threat spikes from Windfury crits (see [Threat](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps)); mana on long fights; only slow axes and maces (no swords, no dual wield) ThatsTheJoke · 2025-10-03, Squid · 2026-02-02 |

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid 17/34/0 (recommended) Not Normal: "at level 60 the standard pve dps build will be this" Not Normal · 2026-04-13; "the cookie cutter build is 17/34" Serow · 2026-03-20; still the answer for DPS talents in mid-April 2026 Hiryu🍉🌈🇵🇹 · 2026-04-18. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Elemental | Convection | 3/5 | | Elemental | Concussion | 5/5 | | Elemental | Elemental Devastation | 3/3 | | Elemental | Elemental Focus | 1/1 | | Elemental | Reverberation | 3/3 | | Elemental | Call of Flame | 2/3 | | Enhancement | Ancestral Knowledge | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Thundering Strikes | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Stable Shields | 3/3 | | Enhancement | Calming Winds | 3/3 | | Enhancement | Lightning Strike | 1/1 | | Enhancement | Flurry | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Enhancing Totems | 2/2 | | Enhancement | Elemental Weapons | 3/3 | | Enhancement | Stormstrike | 1/1 | | Enhancement | Element's Grace | 5/5 | | Enhancement | Bloodlust | 1/1 | Split **17/34/0**, VALID. Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman?points=DoAYLAAC-FAFYYIFATIAoB-` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/shaman/N0JI02-U5IJ52JV`. [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=shaman&t=350031300002-5005303105023151) Why: - **Bloodlust** was always the raid capstone: "the norm was to go bloodlust before 1.18" Not Normal · 2026-03-23. It is a 30-second self-haste window whose melee crits also give your party a short haste buff ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102972#p102972), [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504)). - **Enhancing Totems 2/2** over more fire talents: the Strength of Earth / Grace of Air boost is worth more to a melee group than faster Fire Nova; take Improved Fire Totems for 5-mans instead Not Normal · 2025-10-17, billienomates · 2025-11-04. - **Calming Winds 3/3**: you need the threat reduction in raids (see [Threat](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps)). Tank-spec players who DPS miss only this and Enhancing Totems Zhafu · 2026-03-11, Holidae · 2026-03-11. - **Elemental Focus** (Clearcasting) plus Convection keeps your shocks cheap; Reverberation shortens the shock cooldown. - **Call of Flame 2** is the flex spot: Not Normal's raid alternative moves those 2 points to Improved Fire Totems, "arguable in terms of where they can go" Not Normal · 2025-12-12. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Dungeon / cleave** | Call of Flame 2 → Improved Fire Totems 2 (faster Fire Nova) | `DoAYLAQ-FAFYYIFATIAoB-` | Not Normal · 2025-12-12 | | **Spellhance 22/29** | Flametongue build: Elemental Fury 2, Call of Flame 3, Improved Fire Totems 2, Improved Molten Blast 1; drops Bloodlust, Enhancing Totems and 1 Calming Winds / 1 Element's Grace. See [Spellhance](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps) | `CoAYLBQDAC-FAFYQIFADIAg-` | Not Normal's own build Not Normal · 2026-03-22 | | **Tank-capable** | The 15/36 [Tank](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank) build: about 95% of the DPS talents, minus Calming Winds and Enhancing Totems DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-18, Zhafu · 2026-03-11 | `FADYL-FAVYALFQDIAoB-` | Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-27 | During the first week of 1.18.1 some players respecced to 22/29 Elemental Fury (no Elemental Weapons, no Bloodlust) because Flurry was bugged Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-26; others called that an overcorrection Zeruel · 2026-03-26. The Flurry and Rushing Winds bugs were fixed by 2026-03-28 Not Normal · 2026-03-28, so use Bloodlust again.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Melee hit to 8%.** You have an 8% miss chance; 3% comes from talents, 1% from buying 5 weapon skill (the weapon-skill book), so **4% from gear** Zeruel · 2026-03-13. Each 5 weapon skill above 300 is 1% hit Zyith · 2025-10-16. Flameguard Gauntlets drop the gear requirement further poto · 2025-11-10. After AQ40/Naxx gear you are usually over the cap poto · 2026-03-21. 2. **Weapon skill to 315.** 315 removes the glancing-blow penalty; about 60% of your melee damage can glance, which makes weapon skill "ridiculously valuable up until 315, think like 14 AP at least per point" Not Normal · 2025-10-05, Zeruel · 2026-04-09. Sources: the weapon-skill book, Flameguard Gauntlets (+7 two-hand axe), Ancient Jade Leggings, Orc axe racial. Ancient Jade Leggings are a more efficient source than a Towerforge mace Not Normal · 2026-04-09. 3. **Strength.** 1 Strength ≈ 2.3 AP with Kings; 1 Strength ≈ 2 Agility, always: "str is almost twice as good as agi in terms of dps added per point" Not Normal · 2026-01-15, Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-29. Agility gives shamans no AP, only crit Nandieb · 2026-03-16. 4. **Crit** ≈ 20-25 AP per 1% Not Normal · 2025-12-25. Around 30% unbuffed crit gives good Flurry uptime; stacking far past that costs too much Strength Zhafu · 2025-12-01. Flurry uptime runs 75-95% depending on gear Not Normal · 2026-03-25. 5. **Haste** ≈ 17-18 AP per 1% in pre-Naxx gear Not Normal · 2026-04-01, rising with Kiss of the Spider and the T3.5 5-piece Not Normal · 2025-12-21. 6. **Attack Power** (1 AP = 1). Low value: spell hit (about 6-8 AP per 1%) Not Normal · 2025-12-17; armor penetration (1 Strength ≈ 5 ArP) Not Normal · 2026-04-16; Intellect, Spirit. Stat-weight tables from community sims (MC gear and BWL gear) are posted at oi-er · 2026-03-18 and Kyle Sussenbach · 2026-03-26; Ordinary Joe's sim site models most set bonuses Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-07. **Weapon speed:** always the slowest weapon at comparable quality. Stormstrike and Lightning Strike use your real weapon speed (not normalized), and AP adds AP/14 × speed to every swing, so "slower is just always better" Not Normal · 2026-02-06, Not Normal · 2026-01-13. A 3.8-speed 61 DPS Unstoppable Force beats a 3.3-speed 78 DPS Aspect of Seradane for this reason Not Normal · 2026-01-13.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Pre-pull:** Windfury Weapon on the weapon, Lightning Shield up (9 charges with Stable Shields), totems down: Strength of Earth, Windfury, Flametongue, Mana Spring (see [Totems](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps)). Priority (Not Normal: "stormstrike > lightning strike > flame shock > earth shock" Not Normal · 2025-12-17): 1. **Stormstrike** on cooldown. Let your first white swing land on the boss before the first Stormstrike, or a Windfury proc from it can eat your opening auto Squid · 2025-11-02. 2. **Lightning Strike** on cooldown with Lightning Shield up. It outdamages either shock and can proc Windfury Not Normal · 2025-12-17. 3. **Shock** on cooldown as one loop: **Flame Shock → Earth Shock → Earth Shock**, repeat, "in all circumstances" Not Normal · 2026-04-03; Stormstrike before Earth Shock always poto · 2026-04-03. Flame Shock is also your filler GCD while running in. - Spend Stormstrike's charges on Earth Shock, not on shield procs: its "+25% to the next two Nature damage sources" only boosts the Lightning Shield part of Lightning Strike Zhafu · 2026-02-09, Holidae · 2026-03-24; an Earth Shock is "way better" use Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2025-12-20. - Skip Flame Shock on fire-immune targets; use Frost Shock only to lower threat or against Nature-immune targets DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-12. 4. **Auto-attack** in between; use a `/startattack` macro so autos never stop Zhafu · 2025-12-08, Porkins · 2025-12-08. 5. **Lightning Shield / Water Shield:** Lightning Shield on bosses (with Judgement of Wisdom for mana), Water Shield when mana is short or on trash Not Normal · 2026-01-05. Water Shield gives mana only when it procs (you are hit, or you Lightning Strike), and it has a 2-second internal cooldown Hassle · 2026-04-10, Not Normal · 2026-04-10. Never hold Stormstrike or Lightning Strike waiting for a Windfury window. **Bot-ready loop:** `if not Windfury Weapon → cast Windfury Weapon` · `if Lightning Shield charges = 0 → Lightning Shield` · `Stormstrike if ready` · `Lightning Strike if ready` · `shock if ready: Flame Shock if missing and target not fire-immune and target lives > 9 s, else Earth Shock` · `auto-attack`.

roleStrategy.heading: Threat
roleStrategy.markdown: Enhancement is one of the most threat-spiky DPS specs: "threat is not managed when you get a triple windfury crit" 𝓶𝓮𝓮𝓫𝔂𝓫𝓫 · 2025-03-31; slow non-normalized Stormstrike/Lightning Strike hits add to the spikes Vigrid · 2025-06-18. 1. Take **Calming Winds 3/3** (8/16/25% threat reduction since 1.18) ([Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159)). 2. Ask for **Blessing of Salvation + Tranquil Air Totem**; Tranquil Air is multiplicative with Salvation Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-25, Squid · 2025-11-30. 3. Near the threat ceiling, replace some Earth Shocks with Frost Shock or Flame Shock Zeruel · 2026-03-25. 4. Carry **Limited Invulnerability Potions**: they don't fix threat but the boss won't target you while they are active Not Normal · 2026-04-02. 5. If you still pull with Salvation up, the tank is usually the problem; your threat is easy to read from your DPS Not Normal · 2026-03-25.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The loop a player keeps in mind (or a bot runs) at level 60 with the [17/34/0 build](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps). Details: [Single target](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps), [AoE](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps), [Cooldowns](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps), [Threat](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps). 1. **Before the pull:** Windfury Weapon on the weapon, Lightning Shield up, group totems down (Strength of Earth, Windfury, Flametongue, Mana Spring; see [Totems](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps)). Let the tank build a lead first 𝓶𝓮𝓮𝓫𝔂𝓫𝓫 · 2025-03-31. 2. **Opener:** let the first white swing land, then Stormstrike Squid · 2025-11-02; Flame Shock as the first shock if the target lives more than ~9 s and is not fire-immune. 3. **Single-target loop:** **Stormstrike > Lightning Strike (Rank 3) > shock** on cooldown, auto-attack in between Not Normal · 2025-12-17. The shock is always Flame Shock → Earth Shock → Earth Shock, with Stormstrike before each Earth Shock Not Normal · 2026-04-03. Never hold a strike for a Windfury window. 4. **Cooldowns:** Bloodlust (5 min) at the start once Stormstrike and a shock are rolling, stacked with Blood Fury/Berserking, haste potions and on-use trinkets. 5. **AoE switch:** at **3+ grouped targets** add Fire Nova Totem and Chain Lightning on Clearcasting; on big packs keep Fire Nova going while Chain Lightning is on cooldown; Magma only if mana allows. 6. **Resources:** Lightning Shield on bosses, Water Shield on trash or when mana is short Not Normal · 2026-01-05; tea and mana potion on long fights; ask for Judgement of Wisdom. 7. **Threat:** Calming Winds 3/3, Salvation + Tranquil Air Totem Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-25; near the threat ceiling replace some Earth Shocks with Frost Shock or Flame Shock Zeruel · 2026-03-25. 8. **Movement / situational:** Flame Shock is your filler GCD while running in; skip Flame Shock on fire-immune bosses; re-drop totems when the group moves out of range (vanilla baseline).

extraSections.heading: Spellhance vs classic Strength enhancement
extraSections.markdown: Two Enhancement styles exist on Turtle: | | Classic ("physhance") | Spellhance | |---|---|---| | Imbue | Windfury Weapon | Flametongue Weapon | | Talents | 17/34/0 (Bloodlust) | 22/29/0 (Elemental Fury) Not Normal · 2026-03-25 | | Gear | Strength, AP, crit, hit, weapon skill | Hybrid AP + spell power items, then spell power / spell crit; phys hit capped, spell hit ≤3% from gear Not Normal · 2025-12-04 | | Rotation | Strikes first | Same buttons, but weave Fire Nova and Searing Totem in single target Not Normal · 2026-03-22, Not Normal · 2025-12-17 | | Single target | Best | Never beats classic: 10-15% behind before 1.18.1, estimated 5-8% behind once the 1.18.1 fixes land Not Normal · 2026-03-22, Not Normal · 2026-03-12 | | AoE | Good | Better; "will beat the shit out of physhance on total damage in Kara and ES" Not Normal · 2026-03-12 | | Raids to avoid | none | MC and BWL (many fire-immune bosses): "dogshit bad in mc/bwl" Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-03-14 | Advice: play classic unless you enjoy deep theorycrafting. The self-described "resident spellhance crazy person" does "not recommend spellhance unless you're really into theorycrafting" Not Normal · 2025-12-21. Spellhance details: - **Flametongue scaling** (1.18.1, as measured): spell-power coefficient **0.16 + 0.03 × weapon speed** (Frostbrand 0.25 + 0.04 × speed) Not Normal · 2026-04-08. This change was patch-noted but missing at launch; it landed weeks later Not Normal · 2026-04-01. Flametongue's damage is boosted by Elemental Weapons, Elemental Fury and Call of Flame; the Flametongue *totem* is not Not Normal · 2026-01-15. - **Elemental Weapons' Flametongue effect** (+10/20/30% fire totem and spell damage) now only lasts 5 seconds *after a melee hit*, to keep spell Enhancement in melee ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). - **Stats:** for 2H spellhance 1 spell power ≈ 1 Strength (about 2.1-2.4 AP) Not Normal · 2025-12-13. Physical crit is extra valuable because Elemental Devastation procs from it; a third of crit's value comes from that proc Not Normal · 2025-10-10. - **Weapons:** "typical enh weapons do the trick. Hand of Ragnaros is the dream, I use Maul of the Redeemed Crusader, but Might of Menethil or Shar'tateth would be better" Not Normal · 2026-03-22. - **Molten Blast weaving with a slow two-hander is not a gain:** the lost swing outweighs it Not Normal · 2026-02-09. Fast one-hand builds (Hand of Edward the Odd) that weave instant Molten Blasts are a separate playstyle. - **Rotation (Ordinary Joe):** "Earth Shock > Stormstrike > Lightning Strike, weave in fire totems as mana allows"; spell crit is very good Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-31. - **Elemental Mastery** is "kinda a trap" for spellhance Not Normal · 2026-02-05; Elemental Fury 2/2 plus Element's Grace 5/5 does not fit in 51 points poqoqu0741 · 2026-02-05.

extraSections.heading: Totems for Enhancement
extraSections.markdown: Default melee-group set: **Strength of Earth, Windfury, Flametongue, Mana Spring**; swap Strength of Earth for Tremor on fear fights, add cleansing and resistance totems as needed ([Index: Totems](#/class/shaman)). - **Windfury Totem vs Grace of Air:** "if 2 damage dealers benefit from WF, use it, otherwise use Grace of Air" trallnar · 2026-03-26; Grace of Air is "straight up better for combat rogues" Guyye · 2026-03-26. - Your own totems never buff you while you have an imbue on (see [Imbues](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps)). Drop them anyway for the party.

extraSections.heading: Consumables
extraSections.markdown: Starter kit: **Elixir of the Mongoose, R.O.I.D.S., Juju Power, Dreamshard Elixir, Elixir of Greater Nature Power, Nordanaar Herbal Tea**; drop Nature Power, then R.O.I.D.S., if gold is short Squid · 2025-09-15. Full kit: Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose, Concoction of the Arcane Giant, Concoction of the Dreamwater, Elixir of Greater Nature Power, Elixir of Greater Firepower, R.O.I.D.S., Flask of the Titans or Supreme Power, Spirit/Swiftness of Zanza, Mageblood Potion, Elixir of Superior Defense, Power Mushroom, Rumsey Rum Black Label or Medivh's Merlot, Juju Flurry, Nordanaar Herbal Tea, Major Mana Potion, Goblin Sapper Charge, Potion of Quickness Squid · 2025-09-15. - Juju Power (30 Strength) beats Elixir of the Giants / Arcane Giant (they don't stack) Shifuu · 2025-12-08. - Strength food over haste food until you stack a lot of haste Not Normal · 2025-10-21. - Mana: a paladin's Judgement of Wisdom is the main plan; fewer AoE totems also helps Not Normal · 2025-12-02.

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Lightning Strike rank:** since 1.18.1 macros must call `/cast Lightning Strike(Rank 3)` or they fall back to rank 1 Holidae · 2026-03-21, Holidae · 2026-03-20. - **Strike macro:** `/startattack` + `/cast Stormstrike` (SuperCleveRoidMacros fixes auto-attack toggling off) cinu · 2026-03-26. - **All four totems on one key:** needs **Nampower**; then one `/cast ` line per element Netharia · 2026-03-31, Holidae · 2026-01-29. Totem addons: Call of Elements (MarcelineVQ fork) DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-11 or Sticks and Stones (`/sns`) Hjelp · 2026-03-26. - With Nampower, a mashed macro often fires its last line rather than its first; put your top-priority spell last Squid · 2026-02-20. - **DoiteAuras** tracks shields, Flurry, Stormstrike and imbues, even past the 32-buff display cap Doite · 2026-04-11. - **ShaguDPS** only credits totem damage to you with SuperWoW installed Not Normal · 2026-03-23.

extraSections.heading: Raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **Fire-immune bosses:** in MC Baron Geddon and Ragnaros; in BWL everything except Razorgore, Broodlord and Chromaggus Not Normal · 2025-10-13, Zhafu · 2025-11-30. Drop Flame Shock there. - **Naxxramas mana-burn fights:** on Heigan lean on Judgement of Wisdom and melee after a burn instead of shocking Squid · 2025-12-19. - **Best melee group** cited by the channel: 2 Enhancement shamans, 1 two-hand Fury warrior, 2 Combat rogues 30 · 2026-03-19. - **Buff cap:** at the buff cap Stormstrike's hidden Earth Shock / Lightning Strike bonus stopped applying after 1.18.1 Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-07.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Consensus order. Weapon skill has a hard cap of 315 on Turtle (raised from 308) and the racial bonus is +3, not +5. The melee hit cap is 8%, not 9% — the hidden 1% from vanilla was removed — of which talents give 3% and the weapon-skill book 1%. Crit to about 30–35% keeps Flurry and Clearcasting up; past that Strength (2.3 AP per point, and it scales with talents and buffs) beats Agility (~1.13 AP, plus 1% crit and 1% dodge per 20). Stamina outranks Intellect, Spirit and mp5 — "Pretend mp5 doesnt exist" [Atreidon p=147011] — except for levelers, where Lightning Strike's mana cost still bites.

glance.recommendation: Play the **17/34/0 two-hander build** with **Windfury Weapon** on the slowest good two-hander you can get. Press **Stormstrike > Lightning Strike > shock** (Flame Shock, then Earth Shock, Earth Shock), keep Lightning Shield up and drop your four group totems. Cap **8% melee hit** (4% from gear after talents and the weapon-skill book), push weapon skill toward 315, then stack **Strength** (worth about twice Agility). "Spellhance" (Flametongue, spell power, 22/29) is a niche AoE variant for theorycrafters, covered below.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Melee DPS plus the best melee-group buffs in the game (Windfury, Strength of Earth, Grace of Air totems)

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Good, and the easiest raid spot to get**: "the best melee buffs in the game" make an enhancer wanted regardless of personal DPS Squid · 2026-02-20, Zhafu · 2026-02-20. Personal DPS is mid-pack: roughly on par with feral and survival hunter, below warrior and rogue Not Normal · 2026-03-25; about equal to Retribution with far better utility Not Normal · 2026-02-28. Top Patchwerk parses are higher than the best 1.18 ones Not Normal · 2026-04-03. Called "the best spec right now because it has the least bugs" in April 2026 Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2026-04-04

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Low to medium: "nothing clips autos, just smash your buttons; the only art is in timing your CDs with procs" Kyle Sussenbach · 2026-03-26

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Windfury burst, self-Bloodlust, party buffs, cleave via Fire Nova and Chain Lightning, can off-tank with the same talents ([Tank](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank))

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: RNG-heavy damage; threat spikes from Windfury crits (see [Threat](#/class/shaman/enhancement-melee-dps)); mana on long fights; only slow axes and maces (no swords, no dual wield) ThatsTheJoke · 2025-10-03, Squid · 2026-02-02

playbooks.title: Elemental (ranged caster DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play **Nature Elemental** with the post-1.18.1 **34/3/14** build. Keep **Flame Shock** up and refresh it with **Molten Blast**, fill with **Lightning Bolt**, and cast **Chain Lightning** on Clearcasting (on cooldown once you are well geared); on packs add **Earthquake** and Chain Lightning. Get **12% spell hit from gear** (16% total), then crit, which is also your mana. Elemental needs gear to come online: new raiders are usually advised to start as Enhancement and switch around AQ40. The pre-1.18.1 **"fire ele" (Molten Blast spam) spec is gone**: 1.18.1 made Flametongue's fire bonus require melee hits, and the channel describes fire as "folded into" Nature Elemental. Older guides that tell you to spam Molten Blast are outdated. | | | |---|---| | Role | Ranged spell DPS (Nature, with a Flame Shock/Molten Blast component), strong on trash and multi-target | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Viable, gear-hungry, AoE-leaning**. Single-target DPS "is virtually unchanged" by 1.18.1, AoE is worse because Earthquake is bugged Not Normal · 2026-03-23; Elemental is not the worst caster spec by parses Not Normal · 2026-03-25. Ele and Enhancement "are on the same tier in raids. Ele does better aoe on trash, enh does more single target damage" peter_hammer · 2026-01-23; Ele depends on high target counts for big Earthquakes and Chain Lightnings Zhafu · 2026-02-09. **Contested:** one Kara40-geared Elemental fell to the bottom of the meter in the new BWL mylargeson · 2026-03-22, dismissed as generalizing from one raid Not Normal · 2026-03-22 | | Difficulty | Medium: mana and cast management, Flame Shock tracking, hit/crit balance | | Strengths | Chain Lightning and Earthquake cleave; ranged; totems and interrupts; Tranquil Air Totem for casters | | Weaknesses | Mana; needs a lot of gear ("Ele needs a lot of gear to do something") Kokuyo · 2026-04-03; spell pushback; Nature-resistant bosses; no unique raid buff of its own Misai · 2026-02-11; can't use Atiesh or Scythe of Elune Zhafu · 2026-03-09 |

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Spell hit to 16% total** against bosses. 3% comes from talents, 1% from a druid's Emerald Blessing, so **12% from gear** Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-25, Not Normal · 2026-03-25. Most raid trash is below level 63, so chasing the cap costs damage there Nandieb · 2025-12-21. Hit is "not mandatory" Not Normal · 2025-12-21; 11-14% is the usual target in MC/BWL gear Nandieb · 2025-12-21, and AQ40 gear over-caps easily Dwi · 2025-12-21. 2. **Crit.** It is your mana (Clearcasting from Elemental Focus): past ~12-13% hit and ~500 spell power, crit becomes more valuable than hit 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-09. 3. **Spell power.** 4. **Haste.** 5. **Spell penetration to 15** (bosses have 15 Nature resistance) if nobody brings Thunderfury; "one of the biggest dps gains from a stat (but not after 15)" Nandieb · 2025-12-21. Use +spell-pen ring/amulet enchants or a head/leg enchant Not Normal · 2026-02-12. Weights for gear planners: **hit ≈ 15 SP, crit ≈ 10 SP, haste ≈ 8 SP** Not Normal · 2026-03-12. Int ≈ 59.5 per 1% spell crit Squid · 2025-10-21. Spirit is dead for shamans peter_hammer · 2025-11-02.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: Current (bugged-Earthquake) priority, Not Normal: "that's currently the ideal rotation" Not Normal · 2026-03-23; Ordinary Joe's sim: "flameshock > molten blast (only to refresh flameshock) > earthquake > chainlightning > lightning bolt", with Earthquake "DPS even so you can or can not press it" on one target Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-06, Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-06. 1. **Searing Totem** down (or Flametongue Totem if you sit in a melee group), other totems up. 2. **Flame Shock** on the target (skip on fire-immune bosses). Pop Elemental Mastery and trinkets *before* casting it: Flame Shock snapshots Not Normal · 2025-09-25. 3. **Molten Blast** to refresh Flame Shock before it expires (about every 10-12 s) Not Normal · 2026-03-16. It refreshes to the full 15 s (+3 with a Zul'Farrak totem, +6 with a set bonus) without losing ticks Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-11, Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-11. Once you have the T3.5 3-piece you stop using Molten Blast this way Kokuyo · 2026-03-22. 4. **Chain Lightning** on Clearcasting; on cooldown when mana allows. It beats Lightning Bolt even single target at equal cast time Not Normal · 2026-01-15. Don't cast it without Clearcasting while mana is tight Dwi · 2026-03-21. 5. **Lightning Bolt** filler (about 3 between Chain Lightnings). 6. **Earthquake** on cooldown only when it hits more than one target (see [AoE](#/class/shaman/elemental-ranged-dps)). 7. **No shocks as filler**: they cost a GCD and do less than Lightning Bolt; Earth Shock also pulls more threat gastro · 2026-01-10, Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-01-10. Use Earth Shock only to finish a dying target, to interrupt, or while moving. **Bot-ready loop:** `if Flame Shock missing on target and target not fire-immune → Flame Shock` · `if Flame Shock remaining < cast time + 1 s → Molten Blast` · `if Clearcasting or mana > 60% → Chain Lightning if ready` · `if ≥2 targets in 10 yd → Earthquake if ready` · `else Lightning Bolt` · `if moving → Earth Shock`. **Mana:** tea or mana potion every boss pull is normal while gearing gastro · 2026-02-06, Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-06. Avoid downranking; gear for Clearcasting and use consumables Dwi · 2026-03-22; **Contested:** "downranking is way better than oom" Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-22. A heuristic: downrank if your mana % is below the boss's HP % Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-02-12.
