roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Fire-immune bosses:** MC has Baron Geddon and Ragnaros fully immune and the rest heavily fire-resistant Not Normal · 2025-10-13, poto · 2025-10-31; in BWL all but Razorgore, Broodlord and Chromaggus are immune Zhafu · 2025-11-30. Drop Flame Shock/Molten Blast there. - **Nature resistance: Contested.** "MC and BWL have a decent amount of nature resistance (not immune) and AQ40 has a ton" 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-09 vs "AQ40 doesn't actually have a ton of nature resistant/immune mobs. AQ20 does" Not Normal · 2026-03-09. [Timbermaw Hold](#/instances/timbermaw-hold) mobs are reported highly nature-resistant Mikoto Rin · 2026-03-28. - **Heigan** is a hard fight for any casting hybrid because of the dance Curatewf · 2026-01-24. - Kara40 has invulnerability phases (Gnarlmoon, Sanv, Mephistroth) that break DoT snapshots Squid · 2025-09-23.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Playing the old Molten Blast spam spec poto · 2026-03-08. 2. Using Flametongue Weapon as a caster Phatwater[NA] · 2026-02-09. 3. Chasing 16% hit in MC/BWL gear at the cost of spell power and crit Not Normal · 2025-12-21. 4. Shock spam as filler gastro · 2026-01-10. 5. Chain Lightning without Clearcasting while mana-starved Dwi · 2026-03-21. 6. Earthquake on a single target while it is bugged Not Normal · 2026-03-23. 7. Flame Shock on fire-immune bosses. 8. Skipping a threat-reduction talent Not Normal · 2026-01-13. 9. Popping Elemental Mastery after Flame Shock (no snapshot) Not Normal · 2025-09-25. 10. Starting raiding as Elemental in poor gear; many advise Enhancement until AQ40 clesk · 2026-02-14.

enchants.markdown: | Slot | Enchant | |---|---| | Head / Legs | Spell power, or the spell-penetration enchant if you lack 15 spell pen (worth ~4% DPS without Thunderfury in the raid) Dwi · 2025-12-20 | | Rings / amulet | +spell damage or +spell pen jewelry enchants; only enough pen to reach 15 Not Normal · 2026-02-12 | | Weapon | Spell power | | Other slots | Standard caster enchants (Int, spell power); see Dwi's sheet Dwi · 2025-09-12 |

consumables.heading: Weapon imbues and oils
consumables.markdown: - As a caster, use a **weapon oil** (Brilliant Wizard Oil) instead of Flametongue: Flametongue's fire bonus now needs melee hits Phatwater[NA] · 2026-02-09. Oils cannot go on a weapon that has an imbue Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2025-12-16.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 loop with the [34/3/14 build](#/class/shaman/elemental-ranged-dps). Details: [Single target](#/class/shaman/elemental-ranged-dps), [AoE](#/class/shaman/elemental-ranged-dps), [Cooldowns](#/class/shaman/elemental-ranged-dps), [Totems](#/class/shaman/elemental-ranged-dps). 1. **Before the pull:** weapon oil (no imbue), Searing Totem or Flametongue Totem plus your group totems. 2. **Opener:** Elemental Mastery and on-use trinkets first, **then** Flame Shock, so the whole DoT snapshots Not Normal · 2025-09-25. Skip Flame Shock on fire-immune bosses. 3. **Single-target loop:** Molten Blast only to refresh Flame Shock before it expires → Chain Lightning on Clearcasting (on cooldown when mana allows) → Lightning Bolt filler Ordinary Joe · 2026-04-06. No shocks as filler gastro · 2026-01-10. 4. **Cooldowns:** Elemental Mastery (3 min) and Blood Fury right before a fresh Flame Shock. 5. **AoE switch:** at **2+ targets** Earthquake and Chain Lightning on cooldown, Lightning Bolt filler; at 4+ add Fire Nova Totem when both are on cooldown. Wait for the tank's threat: Earthquake into Chain Lightning on trash "almost certainly" pulls aggro Not Normal · 2026-01-19. 6. **Resources:** don't cast Chain Lightning without Clearcasting while mana is tight Dwi · 2026-03-21; tea or mana potion every boss pull. **Contested:** downranking vs consumables (see [Single target](#/class/shaman/elemental-ranged-dps)). 7. **Movement / situational:** Earth Shock while moving and to interrupt; walk into range every ~2 minutes to re-drop totems for your melee.

extraSections.markdown: | Change | What it means | Source | |---|---|---| | Elemental Weapons' Flametongue bonus (+10/20/30% fire totem/spell damage) now lasts 5 s **after a melee hit** | Kills the ranged Molten Blast spec; use a weapon oil instead of Flametongue as a caster | [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Phatwater[NA] · 2026-02-09 | | Fire spec "reworked into being part of nature elemental" | Rotation: refresh Flame Shock with Molten Blast, keep Chain Lightning and Earthquake on cooldown, Lightning Bolt filler | Therz · 2026-03-21 | | **Contested:** was fire fixed or destroyed? | "They've completely destroyed fire shaman instead of fixing it" Therz · 2026-03-21; the fire build was "the best spec" before sailorVEVO · 2026-01-04 and needed a nerf for decision density, not raw output peter_hammer · 2025-11-12 | | | Earthquake: +15% base damage, cooldown 18 s; "fixed multiple issues" | Players measured it hitting the main target twice Not Normal · 2026-03-22 and its AoE portion ignoring Elemental Fury; "the fixes they were talking about were actually just damage nerfs" Zhafu · 2026-03-21, Not Normal · 2026-03-22; cooldown showed 16 s in game Not Normal · 2026-03-20. extraSections.heading: Totems and group placement
extraSections.markdown: Elemental usually lands in a **melee group** (for Windfury and Strength of Earth), since it has no caster-group totem of its own Nandieb · 2026-03-19; the real issue is that the ideal melee group wants two shamans Not Normal · 2026-03-19. In a caster group, **Tranquil Air Totem** is the main reason to bring you Papairoh · 2025-07-17. Raid support checklist (Dwi) Dwi · 2026-02-24, Dwi · 2026-02-24: - Play like a ranged DPS, but walk into Earth Shock range about every 2 minutes to drop totems for your melee. - Earth Shock while moving and to interrupt enemy heals and volleys. - Use the right resistance totem on elemental-damage fights; refresh Poison/Disease Cleansing totems when party members are afflicted; Tremor Totem for fear fights (drop it ~5.5 s before a telegraphed fear). - Don't drop Nature Resistance Totem casually: "your melees will prefer death over no windfury".

extraSections.heading: Consumables
extraSections.markdown: - Mana potions, Nordanaar/Hyjal tea (separate cooldown from potions), crit elixirs and oils (Dreamshard), Dark/Demonic Rune as the panic button Dwi · 2026-03-21, Dwi · 2026-03-22. - Tea + Superior Mana Potion over Major Mana Potion for cost; PvP rank 6 gets Superior potions almost free billienomates · 2025-12-02, poto · 2025-12-02. - Concoction of the Arcane Giant, Concoction of the Emerald Mongoose, Elixir of Greater Firepower, Elixir of Greater Nature Power and Flask of Supreme Power all stack Not Normal · 2026-01-01. - The new Timbermaw nature-crit potion is not worth its cost (~2% nature crit) Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-28.

standing.source_quality: medium-strong: one prolific near-BiS theorycrafter with deep post-1.18.1 detail, backed by staff mechanics notes and a BiS spreadsheet
standing.notes: The class's caster spec. Structural weakness: no raid debuff amplifies Nature, costing roughly 18.4% versus fire/shadow casters, so single-target output is bottom-half while cleave is strong. 1.18.1 gave Earthquake +15% damage and an 18 s cooldown and extended Convection/Concussion to it, but its live behaviour is contested and unconfirmed by staff.

rotation_single.action: Flame Shock on the boss, then Molten Blast to renew it before it expires, Lightning Bolt filler with Chain Lightning on cooldown (or on Clearcasting at low gear).
Molten Blast stays core in a Nature build; the only claimed exception (5/5 T3.5) is called unproven 'feelscraft' by the channel's Elemental reference.

Do NOT cast Earthquake single-target post-1.18.1: it hits only twice, its AoE portion crits at 1.5x (ignoring Elemental Fury) and it is less DPS than a Lightning Bolt. The 1.18.0 'EQ on cooldown even single-target' advice is superseded.

rotation_aoe.action: Chain Lightning on cooldown with Flame Shock on the longest-lived target.
Run in, drop Fire Nova Totem then Magma Totem; Earthquake only for hard or unreachable packs (and only once the two-hit bug is fixed). Fire Nova is preferred over Magma for up-front damage.
Fire totems and Molten Blast become comfortable from BWL onward, once fire-immune raid mobs are gone.

stat_weights.haste: roughly equal to spell crit until the ~17% single-target softcap.
stat_weights.turning_point: after ~12-13% hit and ~500 spellpower, crit turns up in value.
stat_weights.budget: pre-raid budget line '1 spell hit / 1 spell crit / 9 sp'.

totems: Fire totems inherit the shaman's spell hit/crit and scale with spell power; Searing Totem requires standing within ~30 yd of the boss (also needed for Flame Shock), and Molten Blast re-targets it [[d:shaman#1485260337539317860]], [[d:shaman#1437407581181186079]].
Windfury / Flametongue Totems buff the party only, never the shaman [[d:shaman#1494624498870386748]].
Searing Totem beats Flametongue Totem somewhere between ~300 and 350 total spellpower, and its threat is real [[d:shaman#1462633460689539290]], [[d:shaman#1420041846075297901]].
Improved Stoneskin can beat Elemental Weapons on big AoE pulls [[d:shaman#1484956039773294762]].

yaml.stat_priority_note: Consensus order (Skegg's "hit > crit > spd > int", with haste placed by Atreidon): spell hit to 15–17% against a level-63 boss — Elemental Devastation gives 3% and the T3 four-set another 3%, which can overcap — then crit, which is the mana engine, then haste up to a hard 17% (past that Lightning Bolt is faster than the global cooldown and the extra haste does nothing), then spell power and Intellect.

glance.recommendation: Play **Nature Elemental** with the post-1.18.1 **34/3/14** build. Keep **Flame Shock** up and refresh it with **Molten Blast**, fill with **Lightning Bolt**, and cast **Chain Lightning** on Clearcasting (on cooldown once you are well geared); on packs add **Earthquake** and Chain Lightning. Get **12% spell hit from gear** (16% total), then crit, which is also your mana. Elemental needs gear to come online: new raiders are usually advised to start as Enhancement and switch around AQ40.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Ranged spell DPS (Nature, with a Flame Shock/Molten Blast component), strong on trash and multi-target

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Viable, gear-hungry, AoE-leaning**. Single-target DPS "is virtually unchanged" by 1.18.1, AoE is worse because Earthquake is bugged Not Normal · 2026-03-23; Elemental is not the worst caster spec by parses Not Normal · 2026-03-25. Ele and Enhancement "are on the same tier in raids. Ele does better aoe on trash, enh does more single target damage" peter_hammer · 2026-01-23; Ele depends on high target counts for big Earthquakes and Chain Lightnings Zhafu · 2026-02-09. **Contested:** one Kara40-geared Elemental fell to the bottom of the meter in the new BWL mylargeson · 2026-03-22, dismissed as generalizing from one raid Not Normal · 2026-03-22

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium: mana and cast management, Flame Shock tracking, hit/crit balance

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Chain Lightning and Earthquake cleave; ranged; totems and interrupts; Tranquil Air Totem for casters

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: Mana; needs a lot of gear ("Ele needs a lot of gear to do something") Kokuyo · 2026-04-03; spell pushback; Nature-resistant bosses; no unique raid buff of its own Misai · 2026-02-11; can't use Atiesh or Scythe of Elune Zhafu · 2026-03-09

glance.rest: The pre-1.18.1 **"fire ele" (Molten Blast spam) spec is gone**: 1.18.1 made Flametongue's fire bonus require melee hits, and the channel describes fire as "folded into" Nature Elemental. Older guides that tell you to spam Molten Blast are outdated.

playbooks.title: PvP
playbooks.intro:
**Recommendation:** shamans are one of the strongest PvP classes because every spec can borrow Enhancement's armor talents and still burst. For battlegrounds play **Restoration 13/17/21** (healer with Enhancement armor talents) or an **Enhancement/Elemental hybrid with 30+ Enhancement points**; **spellhance** (Flametongue, spell power) is the strongest damage style, and "PvE-style" two-hand Windfury Enhancement is weak outside a raid's buffs. Stack **Stamina**, get **5% melee / 3% spell hit**, wear mail and a shield against physical classes, and carry free-action and invulnerability potions.

Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp).

PvP sources are thinner than PvE and mostly predate 1.18.1 (2026-03-20); post-patch items are marked.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
**Recommendation:** shamans are one of the strongest PvP classes because every spec can borrow Enhancement's armor talents and still burst. For battlegrounds play **Restoration 13/17/21** (healer with Enhancement armor talents) or an **Enhancement/Elemental hybrid with 30+ Enhancement points**; **spellhance** (Flametongue, spell power) is the strongest damage style, and "PvE-style" two-hand Windfury Enhancement is weak outside a raid's buffs. Stack **Stamina**, get **5% melee / 3% spell hit**, wear mail and a shield against physical classes, and carry free-action and invulnerability potions.

Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp).

PvP sources are thinner than PvE and mostly predate 1.18.1 (2026-03-20); post-patch items are marked.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **Enhancement burst (two GCDs):** shock → two totems → auto → strike: "dead within that small use of 2 gcds and 4 skills" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07; one "went 3.8k > 0 in 1 frame" Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07. **Silence chain (Troll):** Earth Shock (interrupt) → **Hex** → Earth Shock: "a loooong time of not casting or healing at all" Dwi · 2025-09-19. Hexed targets still auto-attack (for half damage) and those autos can push back your casts Grinched · 2026-03-03. **Contested:** whether Hex can be cast while moving Nandieb · 2026-03-03, Grinched · 2026-03-03. **Elemental kite vs melee:** Frost Shock + Earthbind Totem to slow, Fire Nova and Searing Totem for damage, Stormstrike-buffed Earth Shock; all instants, so kiting stays easy Nandieb · 2025-12-13. **Shock choice:** Earth Shock to interrupt or burst Squid · 2025-10-09; Flame Shock on rogues and cats to stop re-stealth Squid · 2025-10-09. **Totem autoswap:** Call of Elements' "autoswitch sets in PvP" drops a counter set based on the target's class Scatty · 2025-10-14.

roleStrategy.heading: Matchups
roleStrategy.markdown: 1v1 difficulty from a shaman's view (Nandieb), hardest to easiest: **Warlock, Rogue, Priest, Druid, Mage, Paladin, Warrior, Hunter**; warlock/rogue can feel impossible at equal gear, priest/druid/mage ~50/50, paladin/warrior/hunter ~80/20 in your favor Nandieb · 2025-11-17, Nandieb · 2025-11-17. Squid would put Druid above Priest Squid · 2025-11-17. | Opponent | Notes | |---|---| | Warlock | Curse of Exhaustion out-slows Frost Shock; "the only real thing you can do is just to try and abuse LoS" Zhafu · 2026-02-07 | | Rogue | "The number one issue is still rogues with dissolvent poison killing you in their opener" Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-02-10; open in Ghost Wolf; Flame Shock against re-stealth | | Priest | ~50/50 | | Druid | ~50/50; Ghost Wolf makes you a Beast (immune to Sap), so Hibernate works on you Loki · 2024-12-12, Loki · 2024-12-12 | | Mage | Grounding eats Polymorph and Frostbolt; "try sheeping when there's 5 shamans, and you'll ping pong groundings" Jesse Potter · 2025-10-03 | | Paladin | Favorable; Purge their seals and blessings (8 s cooldown now) | | Warrior | "arms fucking sucks against Shamans" SkillzMFG · 2025-10-28; Arms can Disarm a two-hander unless you use Weapon Chain limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2025-10-28 | | Hunter | Shamans "manhandle" hunters Bipst · 2025-10-21; "too tanky for hunters" Nandieb · 2025-11-17 |

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and ranks
gear.markdown: - **PvP sets (1.18.1):** three tiers per role: rare ilvl ~71, epic ~77, epic ~92 (top tier behind Conquest Points) poto · 2026-03-11. Set bonuses are the same for all specs (2p +2% crit, 4p +15% Ghost Wolf speed, 6p +35 Stamina, 8p +6% resilience); the healer version adds 30% silence resistance and 40% shorter interrupt lockouts Gurdaz · 2026-03-28, Gurdaz · 2026-03-28. The Field Medic set needs Rank 14 for all pieces Nesushka · 2026-03-28. - **Honor:** Rank 6 is needed to enter the Hall of Legends vendor; the weekly honor cap is 20k (~20 hours) Porkins · 2026-04-09. - **Weapon enchant:** Weapon Chain, not Crusader ("crusader its pve shit"): it stops Disarm Gluom · 2025-10-28, limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2025-10-28. - **Weapons:** Earthshaker with Windfury: "great stun machine for pvp", sometimes perma-stunning with War Stomp Boorenka · 2026-04-11, Boorenka · 2026-04-11. The Arathi Basin exalted dagger (1% crit, 40 SP) is the key early caster PvP item Dwi · 2025-11-20. - **Relic:** Totem of Rotten Roots (healing reduction) for a shock build DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-24, Nandieb · 2025-10-24.

extraSections.heading: Where the class stands
extraSections.markdown: - Pre-1.18.1 the #pvp-general tier lists put shaman on top: "Shaman god tier, rogue, smite priest S tier ..." Ythor · 2025-10-21; "shaman, rogue >>> pala > ..." betcover · 2025-10-21. - Anyone competent kills the shaman first: "they have to die first or you're cooked" Zamka · 2026-02-10. - "Schrödinger's shaman": weak in PvE, yet in a BG "I can kill half the enemy team in a few GCDs ... all while being unkillable and healing the whole horde team" peter_hammer · 2026-03-24. - **After 1.18.1:** the new **dynamic damage dampening** is spec-dependent ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=24132), Zhafu · 2026-03-08); **resilience** "basically turns crits into normal hits" Hopestotem · 2026-04-12; one player finds shaman burst "neutered by dampening and resilience" Bipst · 2026-04-17; another sees "Ele, Locks, and Rogues are all top-tier" Kyle Sussenbach · 2026-03-27. - **1.18 PvP nerfs still in effect:** Purge has an 8-second cooldown; Nature's Swiftness became Ancestral Swiftness (damage spells cast with it deal 25% less) Galas · 2025-08-14; Grounding Totem's cooldown went up ~33% Ennvii · 2025-08-16. - The 1.18.1 Rockbiter rework (Earthen Bulwark) was aimed at Restoration PvP tankiness peter_hammer · 2026-02-16.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop. The details are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/shaman/elemental-pvp), [Defensive tools](#/class/shaman/elemental-pvp), [Battleground role](#/class/shaman/elemental-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/shaman/elemental-pvp). **Damage (spellhance / Enhancement-Elemental hybrid):** 1. **Before the fight:** Lightning Shield up; shield equipped vs Warrior, Rogue, Ret, Feral and Hunter, two-hander only to burst squishies 𝓶𝓮𝓮𝓫𝔂𝓫𝓫 · 2025-04-25. Travel in Ghost Wolf if rogues are around: it makes you a Beast, so you can't be Sapped (but Hibernate works) Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-10, Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-10. 2. **Opener and burst:** shock → two totems → auto → Stormstrike, then Stormstrike-buffed Earth Shock; the whole burst fits in about two GCDs Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07. Against a warlock or mage in the open, burn your cooldowns at the start or you lose Zhafu · 2025-11-17. 3. **Control chain:** Earth Shock interrupt → **Hex** (Troll, 5-min cooldown) → Earth Shock when the 6 s shock cooldown is back Dwi · 2025-09-19, Dwi · 2026-02-13. Tauren: shock → Totemic Slam/War Stomp → shock, or stomp → self-heal Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-13. Hexed targets still auto-attack. 4. **Kite melee:** Frost Shock + Earthbind Totem, Fire Nova and Searing Totem, all instant Nandieb · 2025-12-13. Once Frost Shock hits diminishing returns, switch to Earthbind Loki · 2024-12-12. 5. **Defence:** drop Grounding Totem (20 s cooldown) before a Polymorph or a big nuke; it does nothing against rogue abilities billienomates · 2025-10-08. Free-action and invulnerability potions are your escape; you have no charge, stealth or sprint Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2025-12-02, Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2025-12-02. Flame Shock rogues and cats so they can't re-stealth Squid · 2025-10-09. 6. **Target:** healers first, with shocks and Hex; Purge seals, blessings and shields (8 s cooldown, magic buffs only) Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07. 7. **Reset:** break line of sight, then heal yourself; drink out of combat (vanilla baseline). **Restoration (13/17/21):** 1. **Before the fight:** Earth Shield on yourself and open in Ghost Wolf against rogues Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-10; Water Shield with Totem of the Tides can knock a close rogue or druid out of stealth Zamka · 2026-02-10. 2. **Default heals:** Earth Shield lets you heal in people's faces when they have no interrupt Bipst · 2026-04-17. Use single-target Healing Wave / Lesser Healing Wave in small fights; Chain Heal only when the team is stacked in a big BG fight Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-10, Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-02-10. 3. **Triage:** expect to be focused first Zamka · 2026-02-10. Keep yourself alive, then the target being trained (vanilla baseline). 4. **Emergency:** Ancestral Swiftness (3-min cooldown) is your one instant heal; every other heal is a hard cast, so a team that tunnels you can lock you out Bipst · 2026-04-17. 5. **Utility:** Earth Shock the enemy healer's casts; Grounding Totem against CC; Purge enemy buffs; Poison Cleansing Totem no longer removes Blind Cariad · 2025-11-17. 6. **Mana:** in a big fight, heal until oom from a safe spot; drink between fights (vanilla baseline). **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/shaman/elemental-pvp)): - **Warlock:** Curse of Exhaustion out-slows Frost Shock; abuse line of sight Zhafu · 2026-02-07. - **Rogue:** open in Ghost Wolf, without the Insignia a stunlock kills you Bogorl · 2026-02-04; shield up, Flame Shock against re-stealth. - **Mage:** Grounding Totem eats Polymorph and Frostbolt Jesse Potter · 2025-10-03. - **Druid:** watch for Hibernate while in Ghost Wolf. - **Paladin:** Purge seals and blessings. - **Warrior / Hunter:** favourable; shield vs warriors and Weapon Chain vs Disarm limoseng/Haken/Khang · 2025-10-28.

extraSections.heading: Defensive tools
extraSections.markdown: - **Grounding Totem** eats the next harmful spell on a party member, which is why Frostbolts "redirect" onto a totem 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-31; nothing rogues do is affected by it billienomates · 2025-10-08. - **Poison Cleansing Totem no longer removes Blind** Cariad · 2025-11-17. - **Ghost Wolf vs Sap:** "always start in ghostwolf if you expect rogues, you're a beast and can't be sapped" Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-02-10, Bipst · 2025-10-07; but you can be sapped mid-cast Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07. Ghost Wolf can't be cast indoors Zeruel · 2025-11-04. - **Water Shield + Totem of the Tides** can break a rogue or druid out of stealth if they get close Zamka · 2026-02-10. - **Consumables:** free-action / invulnerability potions make Enhancement "pretty good" Ciftar (Edward the Odd) · 2025-12-02; PvP boots and rocket boots don't stack with Ghost Wolf Zaaparou · 2025-11-03. - **Purge** strips every magic buff, not curses Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-07.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **Healer:** find a safe spot and Chain Heal a stacked team until oom; Chain Heal is for big fights, not duels Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-02-10, Zamka · 2026-02-10. - **Burst/peel:** focus healers with shocks and Hex. - **Mobility:** Tauren can now use Plainsrunning in battlegrounds (it used to be disabled) peter_hammer · 2026-02-13, Saladfingers · 2025-11-24. **Contested:** Improved Ghost Wolf is essential for some (flag running, kiting) Porkins · 2025-11-24, overrated at 60 for others, especially Elemental with 36-yard range Zestitcha · 2025-11-24.

extraSections.heading: Races
extraSections.markdown: | Race | PvP value | |---|---| | Troll | **Hex** (5-min CC); "troll is best for arena because hex is actually good there"; Berserking and Elemental Mastery can be macroed together Nandieb · 2025-11-18; Hex's cooldown would reset per arena Nandieb · 2026-03-03 | | Tauren | War Stomp, +5% HP, Plainsrunning; Totemic Slam's attack/cast-speed debuff is a PvP tool Abuelito · 2025-12-15 | | Orc | Best overall for Enhancement PvP, Tauren second; Troll then Orc for Elemental A N T I · 2026-01-31 |

items.value: Only Grounding/Tremor/Poison Cleansing are reactive in PvP; Earthbind is the main offensive snare; the rest are situational [[d:shaman#1135425193754513459]]

items.claim: Shaman favoured; Frost Shock + Earthbind + Earth Shock every 5-6 s; Prot warrior is the one spec claimed to counter shaman
Contested: shaman tools (Poison Cleansing, Frost Shock, shield/armour) bully rogues, but an equally geared rogue bursts a 6k-armour/4k-HP shaman in a cheap shot + kidney if the trinket is down
Losing/hard: Counterspell locks the shaman out of damage and healing (all Nature); Grounding absorbs one interrupt, no answer to Counterspell then Polymorph then nuke
Losing: Curse of Tongues hard-counters the kit; warlock + rogue are the two most cited shaman counters
Contested: shaman says ranged hunter is its biggest weakness (kites forever); hunter says the shaman tanks the damage and Frost Shocks/Earthbinds into the deadzone
Shaman favoured: Purge strips Fortitude and PW:Shield, then burst; Shadow priest Silence is the ele counter
Ele rated strong vs druids (druids carry Mark of the Wild nature res unless purged, so spell pen matters)
Shaman hard-counters paladin by design (spam Purge, kite, NS burst) at consensus; contested at the top end ('paladin is the strongest 1v1 class')

items: Tauren War Stomp is the best PvP utility and combos with an Iron Grenade for a 4-s stun; +5% HP and extra melee range [[d:shaman#1188211554357887036]].
Orc Hardiness is the anti-paladin/anti-engineering pick (paladin-heavy server); Blood Fury is a burst CD [[d:shaman#1246590462454796299]].
Troll Berserking + Hex (castable moving and while Nature-locked) is called 'best Shaman racial for PvP' by some [[d:shaman#1404506212363665439]]; race ranking is contested.

Engineering is the only profession giving player power; grenades fix the no-hard-CC problem (Gnomish net / HFQ net), plus Insignia, Rocket Helm, Magic Dust, Shard of Nightmare, Hyjal Pipe, Tidal Charm, Nifty Stopwatch; FAPs/LIPs are decisive [[d:shaman#1277660705008386109]], [[d:shaman#1280180094823825481]], [[d:shaman#1406779021345423465]].

High-armour shield + T2.5/T3 is the core; never PvP with a staff. Stack stamina and wear mail (5-5.2k HP, ~60% armour reported on PvP kits) [[d:shaman#1277548797144334359]], [[d:shaman#1319237466409926738]].
Spell penetration is high value vs nature-resist gear (~20 resistance -> +5.2% damage, ~75 SP equivalent); Don Rodrigo's Band named [[d:shaman#1282723201184432140]].
8/8 T3 shock buff (20% shock damage) is what makes ele infamous in PvP pre-1.18.1 [[d:shaman#1359859058848432269]].

Post-1.18.1 PvP gear adds resilience (crit-damage reduction ~-3%/piece) and players say it 'solves' the burst problem in full PvP gear -- 'in full PvP gear you basically just take normal hits' and NS 75% x dampening 0.8 = 60% [[d:shaman#1491924441113038908]], [[d:shaman#1491921578483646464]], [[d:shaman#1467127442731958463]].
Resto PvP gear gap: ranking mail is 'either physical or spell dmg, not a healing variant' and there is little mail healing gear [[d:shaman#1420649996801544302]], [[d:shaman#1423644142906507320]].

Ele PvP is contested in the extreme: 'top 2 pvp spec' [[d:shaman#1373661275296632934]] vs 'losing ~80% of 1v1s' [[d:shaman#1054026335502221322]] and 'really meh ... no spell pushback resistance' [[d:shaman#1454796130146586747]].

Resto PvP is mostly negative ('Full resto is even the worst healer' [[d:shaman#920766236185493524]], 'Why PVP as resto?' [[d:shaman#1405903764476657758]]) with one positive 2023 support claim [[d:shaman#1155156739201699981]] and the 13/17/21 post-1.18.1 spec; net contested.

Enh minority defence: a defensive attrition enh with Grounding/Purge/6-s Earth Shock, 5% hit cap and a shield is rated well [[d:shaman#1204951203620986921]]; pvp-general's mtnd puts 'Autist Sham enhanc' / 'Sham Hybrid' at S for pug PvP [[d:pvp-general#1353324094954934314]].

Post-1.18.1 shaman is reported weaker than vanilla in PvP (nerfed NS, EM gone, purge/grounding CDs) while shield/healer builds are called overtuned [[d:shaman#1485287084997607424]], [[d:shaman#1494663845619437609]], [[d:shaman#1494616234996531281]].

Class/spec dynamic PvP dampening (Magical + Physical) replaced 1.18.0's flat value; shaman numbers never published; players worried about spec detection [[d:shaman#1474075242195583087]], [[d:shaman#1486004180458930238]].

Rockbiter -> Earthen Bulwark was explicitly intended to stop non-Enhancement specs using passive PvP DR; players report it did not stop resto tankiness [[d:shaman#1485997307144048690]], [[d:shaman#1487726640682369034]].
Rank-13+ PvP gear was still TBD for the Amber BWL phase as of 2026-02-28 [[d:shaman#1477242197513601168]].

glance.recommendation: Shamans are one of the strongest PvP classes because every spec can borrow Enhancement's armor talents and still burst. For battlegrounds play **Restoration 13/17/21** (healer with Enhancement armor talents) or an **Enhancement/Elemental hybrid with 30+ Enhancement points**; **spellhance** (Flametongue, spell power) is the strongest damage style, and "PvE-style" two-hand Windfury Enhancement is weak outside a raid's buffs. Stack **Stamina**, get **5% melee / 3% spell hit**, wear mail and a shield against physical classes, and carry free-action and invulnerability potions.

Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp).

PvP sources are thinner than PvE and mostly predate 1.18.1 (2026-03-20); post-patch items are marked.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level as **Enhancement**. Take Enhancement talents down to **Elemental Weapons and Stormstrike** (levels 30-33), then dip **11 points into Elemental for Elemental Focus** (Clearcasting, level 44), then finish Enhancement. From level 44 play **Frostbrand Weapon + Frost Shock + Water Shield**: Elemental Weapons makes Frostbrand procs auto-crit on a Frost-Shocked target, every crit gives Clearcasting, and mana stops being a problem. Keep the armor talents: the same build tanks dungeons, so you get fast queues and can respec at 60 for 5 g. - "Enhancement is the only good spec for shaman leveling if you plan to do *any* solo content" peter_hammer · 2025-10-14; "enh is faster all the way through 60, it's not even really close" DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-09. - "Picking ele for any reason pre-40 is griefing yourself, and picking it pre-60 is still pretty sus but manageable" Not Normal · 2025-12-30. - Resto is "very hard to quest as" Marnibanks · 2026-02-06; you can heal leveling dungeons with Intellect gear and no Resto talents firfir · 2026-02-06. - "Tank shaman hands down best plvler" for dungeon farming Wahisky · 2026-03-09; "the tanking build is ironically better while levelling anyway, especially pre 40" billienomates · 2025-10-31. The consensus path is "putting talents into enh until ele weapons and stormstrike, then start talenting into ele until clearcasting" Not Normal · 2026-04-06, Not Normal · 2025-10-05. If a talent gives you a new button, take it: the must-haves are Lightning Strike, Elemental Focus and Stormstrike peter_hammer · 2026-01-23.

sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: What to press as the recommended **Enhancement** leveler (the [talent order](#/class/shaman/leveling) above), bracket by bracket. Learn levels, cooldowns, cast times and mana costs are the 1.18.1 trainer data; talents show the level at which this guide's order takes them. The same talents tank and heal leveling dungeons: **tank** = Rockbiter on a slow one-hander + the highest-armor shield; **healer** = Intellect gear, no imbue, no Resto talents needed firfir · 2026-02-06. Rules for every bracket: - **Mana is the limit.** Shocks are poor damage per mana while leveling: "enh is fine on mana if you just avoid using shocks" Not Normal · 2026-03-15. Spend spare mana on healing yourself between mobs, and drink when low Porkins · 2025-11-17. - **Totems solo:** Searing Totem when you fight in one spot, Stoneclaw Totem when you pull more than one mob, Earthbind Totem to slow a runner; the rest waste mana Not Normal · 2026-03-15. Fire Nova only when 3+ mobs are on you in one place Netharia · 2026-03-15. - **Totem elements:** Earth from level 1, Fire at 10, Water at 20, Air at 30, each after a class quest Lionhermit · 2026-03-31. The trainer data lists some totem spells earlier (Searing Totem L4, Healing Stream Totem L6), but you need that element's totem before you can drop them (vanilla baseline). - **Resting:** eat/drink to full after a hard pull; don't start a pull under ~40% mana (vanilla baseline). From 26, Lightning Shield when mana is high, Water Shield when it is low Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-01-01. ### Levels 1–9 **New now:** L1 Rockbiter Weapon, Lightning Bolt · L4 Earth Shock R1 (6 s shock cooldown), Stoneskin Totem · L6 Earthbind Totem, Healing Wave R2 · L8 Lightning Shield R1, Rockbiter R2, Earth Shock R2, Stoneclaw Totem R1 (30 s cooldown). **Single target:** 1. Rockbiter on the weapon; Lightning Shield up from 8. 2. Pull by walking in (or one Lightning Bolt if the mob is a caster), then auto-attack. 3. Earth Shock only to interrupt a caster or finish a fleeing mob. 4. After the kill: Healing Wave yourself if below ~50% health, drink if below ~40% mana (vanilla baseline thresholds). **Multi-target:** don't pull more than two. With two: Stoneclaw Totem to hold one, kill the other; Earthbind Totem to get away. **Tanking / healing:** no dungeons yet (the first ones are 17+, see [Dungeons by bracket](#/class/shaman/leveling)). ### Levels 10–19 **New now:** L10 Flametongue Weapon R1, Flame Shock R1, Strength of Earth Totem R1, Searing Totem R2, **Earthshaker Slam** (your taunt: 5 yd, 10 s cooldown, off the global cooldown), Totemic Recall · L12 Fire Nova Totem R1 (15 s cooldown), Healing Wave R3, Purge · L14 Earth Shock R3, Lightning Bolt R3, Stoneskin R2, Cure Disease · L16 Lightning Shield R2, Rockbiter R3, Cure Poison · L18 Flametongue R2, Flame Shock R2, Healing Wave R4, Stoneclaw R2, Tremor Totem. Talents: Ancestral Knowledge (10–14), Stable Shields (15–17, 9 Lightning Shield charges), Thundering Strikes (18–19). **Single target:** 1. Rockbiter or Flametongue: "from 10-20 which imbue you choose doesnt really matter" Not Normal · 2026-03-19. Lightning Shield up. 2. Auto-attack; Searing Totem only if you will fight several mobs in one spot. 3. Earth Shock only for interrupts and kills; skip Flame Shock (don't even buy it) Holidae · 2025-11-07. 4. Heal and drink between mobs. **Multi-target (2–3):** Stoneclaw first, kill one at a time; Fire Nova Totem only with 3+ stacked mobs. Earthbind if it goes wrong. **Tanking (17–19, Wailing Caverns / Deadmines):** rough. Before the armor talents you are "basically as tanky as a rogue" plus a shield Stunfisk · 2025-11-10; "more than 2 mobs in WC was an oom healer and likely a dead sham tank" Porkins · 2026-03-01, and WC mobs resist Earth Shock Koae · 2025-12-12. Better to DPS until 26. If you tank: 1. Rockbiter on a one-hander + shield ("Rockbiter on MH. Drop stoneclaw totem every pack") billienomates · 2025-10-07. 2. Mark a skull, pull with rank 1 Lightning Bolt and line of sight. 3. Tab between mobs: Earth Shock (a lower rank is enough) and auto-attack; skip fire totems until Totemic Alignment DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-10. 4. A mob runs off: Earthshaker Slam, then Earth Shock ("taunt into an earth shock") DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-08-24. 5. Stoneclaw Totem without Totemic Alignment pulls aggro onto the totem, not you Not Normal · 2025-12-30: use it as a distraction. **Healing (17–19):** Healing Wave R3 (L12, 2.5 s, 80 mana) is the default on the tank; Healing Wave R4 (L18, 3 s, 155 mana) for big hits; R2 for small top-ups. Cure Poison / Cure Disease the tank. Stop casting between pulls so mana regenerates (vanilla baseline: 5-second rule). ### Levels 20–29 **New now:** **L20 Lightning Strike** (talent, 9 s cooldown), Frost Shock R1, Frostbrand R1, Lesser Healing Wave R1 (1.5 s), Lightning Bolt R4, Healing Stream Totem R3, Searing R3 · L21–23 Ancestral Guardian · L22 Molten Blast R1 (2 s), Fire Nova R2, Poison Cleansing Totem · L24 Earth Shock R4, Lightning Shield R3, Rockbiter R4, Healing Wave R5, Strength of Earth R2 · L25–26 Spirit Armor · **L26 Water Shield**, Magma Totem, Mana Spring Totem, Flametongue R3 · L28 Stoneclaw R3, Lesser Healing Wave R2, Flametongue Totem, Molten Blast R2 · L29 Totemic Alignment 1/2. **Single target:** 1. **Rockbiter + Lightning Shield**: "rockbiter is king from at least 1-30" because Lightning-Strike-boosted Lightning Shield hits add 25% of your attack power Not Normal · 2025-12-07. 2. **Lightning Strike** on cooldown Not Normal · 2025-08-18. 3. Auto-attack. No shocks for damage. 4. Heal between mobs with the spare mana; from 26 swap to Water Shield when mana runs low. **Multi-target:** Stoneclaw on 2+; Searing Totem if you stay put; Fire Nova (don't buy Magma) for 3+ Holidae · 2025-11-07. **Tanking (start at 26 in Shadowfang Keep)** Koae · 2025-12-12: 1. Rockbiter on a slow one-hander + best-armor shield; Lightning Shield for the pull. 2. **Pull:** mark skull, rank 1 Lightning Bolt with line of sight trallnar · 2026-04-01; from 22 add Molten Blast as mobs run in Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 3. **First GCDs:** Lightning Strike on the skull, Earth Shock (downranked) on the second mob, autos, then tab Earth Shock across the pack Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 4. **Packs:** Stoneclaw every pack. From **29 (Totemic Alignment)** about 90% of totem threat is yours trallnar · 2026-04-08: pull, Stoneclaw, Fire Nova, then "piano earth shock, lightning strike" Holidae · 2025-11-07. At low level Stoneclaw alone does more AoE threat than Magma billienomates · 2025-12-12. 5. **Taunt:** Earthshaker Slam, then Earth Shock. **Emergency:** Earthbind Totem gives the healer time Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 6. **Mana:** Water Shield + Mana Spring at 26 "help a LOT"; use a downranked Earth Shock trallnar · 2026-04-01. Squishiness fades with Ancestral Guardian and is gone at 26–27 with Spirit Armor Holidae · 2026-02-15. **Healing:** 1. Default: **Healing Wave R3** on the tank ("I just spam HW rank 3 or 4") Squid · 2025-10-03; R5 (L24, 3 s, 200 mana) when the tank takes big hits. 2. Lesser Healing Wave (R1 L20, R2 L28) only when the tank drops fast: it is the fastest heal and the least mana-efficient Not Normal · 2026-01-07. 3. Rule of thumb: newest Healing Wave + newest Lesser Healing Wave + a Healing Wave two ranks lower Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 4. Totems: Healing Stream (20) for chip damage Miado · 2025-10-20, Mana Spring (26), Poison Cleansing (22) where poisons land, Strength of Earth for melee. 5. Water Shield from 26; Cure Poison/Disease. Don't Purge mobs while leveling: most Turtle mobs recast the buff the moment it's removed, so you waste mana and a GCD (2025-08, pre-1.18.1) Cariad · 2025-08-14, Galas · 2025-08-15. ### Levels 30–39 **New now:** L30 **Windfury Weapon** R1, Grounding Totem, Nature Resistance Totem, Astral Recall, Searing R4, Elemental Weapons 1/3 · **L31 Stormstrike** (talent, 8 s cooldown) · L32 **Chain Lightning** R1 (2.5 s, 6 s cooldown), Windfury Totem, Healing Wave R6, Lightning Shield R4, Fire Nova R3 · **L33 Elemental Weapons 3/3** (Earthen Bulwark with Rockbiter; Frostbrand auto-crits on a Frost-Shocked target) · L34 Frost Shock R2, Rockbiter R5, Water Shield R2 · L34–38 Convection · L36 Earth Shock R5, Lesser Healing Wave R3, Mana Spring R2, Molten Blast R3 · L38 Lightning Strike R2, Stoneclaw R4, Disease Cleansing Totem, Strength of Earth R3, Frostbrand R3 · L39 Elemental Warding. **Single target:** 1. **Windfury + Water Shield** ("very mana comfy") or Rockbiter + Lightning Shield Not Normal · 2026-03-24. **Contested:** Windfury is "a gamble" against weak leveling mobs poto · 2026-02-27. 2. **Stormstrike** on cooldown. 3. **Lightning Strike** on cooldown. 4. Earth Shock (after Stormstrike) only if the mob is about to die or you have spare mana. 5. Auto-attack. **Multi-target (3):** pull with Chain Lightning, then cycle Stormstrike, Lightning Strike, Earth Shock across them; "water shield will be your go to" TheEgyptianCat · 2025-07-13. Stoneclaw first on bigger pulls. **Tanking (SFK, RFK, Dragonmaw, Stormwrought, SM):** 1. **Pull:** rank 1 Lightning Bolt + Chain Lightning (from 32) for opening threat Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31; Molten Blast into Chain Lightning is "real good opening threat" Holidae · 2025-11-14. 2. **Running in:** Stormstrike target 1, Earth Shock target 2, Lightning Strike target 3; Frost Shock instead of Earth Shock on Nature-resistant mobs Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 3. **Steady loop:** Earth Shock on cooldown (about 40% of your threat Not Normal · 2025-12-25) > Stormstrike > Lightning Strike > auto-attack. 4. **4+ mobs:** Stoneclaw + Fire Nova; Magma only if mobs live long; against fire-resistant mobs Stoneclaw is your only AoE threat Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 5. **From 33, Earthen Bulwark** (Rockbiter + shield) starts at zero every pull and currently builds only from white swings Not Normal · 2026-04-13: keep auto-attacking and never hard-cast while being hit Nandieb · 2025-12-03. 6. **Totem of the Tides** (Stormwrought, 33+): stay on Water Shield for AoE threat and mana trallnar · 2026-04-01. 7. Windfury Totem with 2+ melee DPS, and tell them they tank what they rip Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. **Healing:** Healing Wave R3–R4 as the default, R6 (L32) for heavy tank damage, Lesser Healing Wave R3 (L36) for emergencies. No Chain Heal until 40; you won't miss it much in 5-mans Squid · 2025-10-14. Totems: Mana Spring, Healing Stream, Windfury or Strength of Earth, Disease Cleansing (38) when needed. ### Levels 40–49 **New now:** L40 **Chain Heal** R1 (3 s), Earth Shield R1, Chain Lightning R2, Healing Wave R7, Lightning Shield R5, Windfury R2, mail armor, racial quests (Hex, Feral Spirit, Totemic Slam) · L41–43 Elemental Devastation · L42 Grace of Air Totem, Water Shield R3, Fire Nova R4 · **L44 Elemental Focus** (Clearcasting), Lesser Healing Wave R4, Rockbiter R6 · L45 Totemic Alignment 2/2 · L46–50 Element's Grace · L46 Chain Heal R2, Frost Shock R3, Mana Spring R3 · L48 **Frostbrand R4**, Earth Shock R6, Healing Wave R8, Stoneclaw R5, Chain Lightning R3, Lightning Shield R6. **Single target (40–43):** as 30–39. **From 44:** 1. **Frostbrand + Water Shield** Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-29. 2. Open with **Frost Shock** (rank 1 is enough for the debuff) Holidae · 2025-11-12. 3. **Stormstrike**, **Lightning Strike**, auto-attack: Frostbrand procs auto-crit on the frosted target and give Clearcasting. 4. Refresh Frost Shock when it drops (cheap with Clearcasting). **Multi-target:** Frost Shock the pack one by one or Chain Lightning pull, Fire Nova for 3+; "near infinite mana unless you spam fire totems" Ordinary Joe · 2026-03-29. **Tanking (Crescent Grove, Gilneas 42+, ZF, Maraudon, ST):** fully online at 44 with Clearcasting, mail and Elemental Weapons Ordinary Joe · 2026-01-09. **Swap back to Rockbiter** before tanking. Same loop as 30–39, plus: Lightning Shield for the pull, Water Shield halfway, back to Lightning Shield on Clearcasting Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. Frost Shock on Nature-resistant mobs (Sunken Temple's bottom floor resists Earth Shock poto · 2025-11-06; Maraudon has Nature-immune mobs billienomates · 2025-12-24). **Healing:** damage ramps from Zul'Farrak, where you want Resto talents billienomates · 2025-11-10. Default Healing Wave R3–R4 on the tank, R7–R8 for heavy damage, Lesser Healing Wave R4 (L44) emergencies; Chain Heal R1 only when the group is stacked and taking cleave Bezawit · 2026-02-08. Totems: Windfury if two damage dealers benefit, otherwise Grace of Air trallnar · 2026-03-26; Mana Spring; cleansing totems as needed. ### Levels 50–60 **New now:** L50 Healing Stream R4, Searing R5, **Tranquil Air Totem**, Water Shield R4, Windfury R3 · L51–55 Flurry · L52 Fire Nova R5, Lesser Healing Wave R5, Strength of Earth R4 · L54 Chain Heal R3, Rockbiter R7 · **L56 Bloodlust** (talent, 5 min cooldown), **Lightning Strike R3**, Chain Lightning R4, Earth Shield R3, Healing Wave R9, Lightning Shield R7, Mana Spring R4, Grace of Air R2 · L57–59 Reverberation · L58 Frostbrand R5, Frost Shock R4, Stoneclaw R6, Water Shield R5 · L60 Earth Shock R7, Windfury R4, Lesser Healing Wave R6, Healing Stream R5. **Single target:** as from 44. Bloodlust for elites and hard pulls. Lightning Strike R3 sits on the General tab; macros must call `Lightning Strike(Rank 3)` Holidae · 2026-03-21. **Multi-target:** with good gear Fire Nova into Magma clears packs from 52–54 ("extra nova for green gear") chain · 2025-12-21; Lasher farming works from 52–56 Hassle · 2026-03-30. **Tanking:** same loop as 44+; add Bloodlust for burst threat. See [Tank](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank) for the level-60 loop. **Healing:** from 52 it is safe to go full Resto and level through dungeons Dwi · 2025-11-30. Otherwise: max-rank Lesser Healing Wave, Healing Wave and Chain Heal on your bars covers 60 dungeons Holidae · 2026-02-08; Healing Wave R3 for most of a run lets you "never drink" Diving Instructor Knife · 2026-03-27. items: **Mana is the limit.** Shocks are poor damage per mana while leveling: "enh is fine on mana if you just avoid using shocks" Not Normal · 2026-03-15. Spend spare mana on healing yourself between mobs, and drink when low Porkins · 2025-11-17.

**Totems solo:** Searing Totem when you fight in one spot, Stoneclaw Totem when you pull more than one mob, Earthbind Totem to slow a runner; the rest waste mana Not Normal · 2026-03-15. Fire Nova only when 3+ mobs are on you in one place Netharia · 2026-03-15.

**Totem elements:** Earth from level 1, Fire at 10, Water at 20, Air at 30, each after a class quest Lionhermit · 2026-03-31. The trainer data lists some totem spells earlier (Searing Totem L4, Healing Stream Totem L6), but you need that element's totem before you can drop them (vanilla baseline).

**Resting:** eat/drink to full after a hard pull; don't start a pull under ~40% mana (vanilla baseline). From 26, Lightning Shield when mana is high, Water Shield when it is low Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2026-01-01.

sections.heading: The pull / kill loop
sections.markdown: **Levels 10-29 (Rockbiter):** `Rockbiter + Lightning Shield up` → `auto-attack` → `Lightning Strike on cooldown (from 20)` → `heal between mobs with spare mana, drink when low`. Don't spend mana on shocks: their damage per mana "is pretty poor" Porkins · 2025-11-17. **Levels 30-43:** `Windfury (or Rockbiter)` → `Stormstrike on cooldown` → `Lightning Strike on cooldown` → `Earth Shock if the mob is about to die or you have spare mana`. **Levels 44-60 (Frostbrand):** 1. Open with **Frost Shock** (rank 1 is enough to apply the debuff; the proc damage doesn't depend on the shock's rank) Holidae · 2025-11-12. 2. **Stormstrike**, **Lightning Strike**, auto-attack: every Frostbrand proc on the frosted target is a crit, every crit gives Clearcasting Holidae · 2025-11-12. 3. Refresh Frost Shock (now nearly free with Clearcasting); keep Water Shield up. "Anytime you're in solo content, it's frostbrand+frost shock. It's too good not to use" Holidae · 2026-02-17. **Totems while soloing:** mostly a waste of mana; Searing Totem is good, Stoneclaw buys time on multi-pulls, Earthbind delays a runner Not Normal · 2026-03-15. Fire Nova beats Magma for AoE while leveling Zeruel · 2025-10-31.

leveling.recommendation: Level as **Enhancement**. Take Enhancement talents down to **Elemental Weapons and Stormstrike** (levels 30-33), then dip **11 points into Elemental for Elemental Focus** (Clearcasting, level 44), then finish Enhancement. From level 44 play **Frostbrand Weapon + Frost Shock + Water Shield**: Elemental Weapons makes Frostbrand procs auto-crit on a Frost-Shocked target, every crit gives Clearcasting, and mana stops being a problem. Keep the armor talents: the same build tanks dungeons, so you get fast queues and can respec at 60 for 5 g. - "Enhancement is the only good spec for shaman leveling if you plan to do *any* solo content" peter_hammer · 2025-10-14; "enh is faster all the way through 60, it's not even really close" DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-09. - "Picking ele for any reason pre-40 is griefing yourself, and picking it pre-60 is still pretty sus but manageable" Not Normal · 2025-12-30. - Resto is "very hard to quest as" Marnibanks · 2026-02-06; you can heal leveling dungeons with Intellect gear and no Resto talents firfir · 2026-02-06. - "Tank shaman hands down best plvler" for dungeon farming Wahisky · 2026-03-09; "the tanking build is ironically better while levelling anyway, especially pre 40" billienomates · 2025-10-31.

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No item-level PvP gear list exists for any Shaman spec (unlike Rogue's Subtlety PvP list); Elemental/Enhancement hybrid PvP gearing is qualitative only (set names, no slots).
- No item-level Elemental raid-t2/t2.5/t3/t3.5 gear list; the corpus gives Molten Core boss fire-resistance numbers and post-1.18.1 general raid-choice advice, but no slot-by-slot list past pre-raid.
- Enhancement raid-t3.5 (Stormhowl) has no item-level list in the extracted posts, only that it is the stated upgrade target from T3.
- Enhancement raid-t2.5 (AQ40) has no Enhancement set at all per the sources, and no alternative item list is given for that phase beyond 'stick with T2 plus better 2h/trinkets/rings/neck'.
- Most items in the Enhancement-tank pre-raid-60 and raid-t1 lists (from Mimiwarmini's single detailed post) have no stated drop location; only Araxxna's Husk (Lower Karazhan Halls), Totem of Tides (Stormwrought Ruins) and Hatereaver Cog (Hateforge Quarry) are independently confirmed via structured/entity-index/items.json.
- Restoration has no raid-t1 or raid-t3 item-level gear list (only the pre-raid list and general 'sets are weak, T3.5 better than paladins'' commentary).
- Duids' Elemental pre-raid-and-BiS-by-phase spreadsheet (the single richest apparent Elemental source) is an external Google Sheet; its cell-by-cell content is not captured as text in this corpus, so only the items discussed directly in forum replies could be used here.
- No leveling-10-29 item list beyond the generic tank shield chain notes; Skegg's guide names most items from level 28 onward.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
1. **Earthen Bulwark's final state.** Tanks reported it building only from auto-attacks through at least 2026-04-14 despite a 2026-03-24 hotfix note; no source confirms a fix before the archive ends.
2. **Earthquake's final state.** After the 2026-03-31 hotfix (Aftershock with Elemental Fury) players still reported crit bugs on 04-06; its real single-target value is unsettled, so the Elemental rotation treats it as AoE-only.
3. **Elemental Weapons' Windfury haste stacking** (should give 2 stacks per proc) was still bugged on 2026-04-11; no fix confirmed.
4. **No post-1.18.1 Enhancement or Elemental PvP build** was posted; the PvP damage builds are pre-patch shapes. Shaman-specific dampening and resilience values were never published.
5. **Restoration BiS by phase:** no maintained resto list exists; the page gives per-slot tips only.
6. **Tank build choice** (physical 15/36 or 13/38 vs spell 22/29) has no controlled comparison after 1.18.1 removed spell power from tank sets.
7. **Spellhance** numbers (5-8% behind classic after the fixes) are one theorycrafter's estimate; no post-fix parse set.
8. **Fire resistance gear lists** for tanks are partial; the channel never compiled one.
9. **Nature resistance in AQ40** is contested (see Elemental raid notes).
10. **Hex while moving** is contested between players.
11. **Hardcore-specific play** and a zone-by-zone leveling route are thin (one route suggestion only).

guidePages.title: Shaman professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** level with two gathering professions: **Herbalism + Mining** or **Herbalism + Skinning**. At 60, once you are farming Dire Maul lashers, drop the second gatherer and take **Engineering**. The end state is **Engineering + Herbalism**, the shaman "meta" pair: Engineering is the only profession that adds player power (Sappers, Dynamite, grenades), and Herbalism raises the gold you make from lasher farming, the shaman's best farm DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-08-18, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-01. If you don't care about min-maxing, professions matter little: "Prof choice is relatively inconsequential in classic, unless you want to PvP" Nandieb · 2025-11-30. In that case, pick them for gold.

sections.heading: Best pairs by goal
sections.markdown: | Goal | Pair | Why | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Leveling** | Herbalism + Mining, or Herbalism + Skinning | Gold while you level. Herb/Mining earns more but you have to keep switching the tracking. Skinning is "brain dead and free money, but not lucrative". Don't level Engineering yet | DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-01, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-11 | | Leveling, no farming breaks | Enchanting + Skinning | Disenchant drops and skin as you go, so you never stop to farm materials | Collin · 2026-03-28, Not Normal · 2025-10-11 | | **Enhancement raid** | Engineering + Herbalism | Engineering is "the BiS dps prof"; Goblin Sapper Charges are the reason | Rinzu · 2025-04-19, Not Normal · 2025-10-11 | | **Elemental raid** | Engineering + Herbalism (or Jewelcrafting) | Same Sapper argument. Jewelcrafting has "some pieces that might see some use as elemental for a little while" | Mithreon · 2026-02-28, sailorVEVO · 2026-03-27 | | **Restoration raid** | Engineering + Herbalism, or Jewelcrafting (Gemology) + a gatherer | "Even as Resto dropping Sappers/Dynamite will help your raid clear faster." The custom Gemology staff and ring are hard to beat for healing. **Contested:** "Im not even sure what you would want from JC as a healer" | DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-09-08, Dwi · 2026-02-19, Rinzu · 2025-08-21 | | **Tank** | Engineering + Jewelcrafting | "For tank shaman, engi/jc is bis": JC's BoP spell-damage items (Talisman of Hinderance) and Sapper AoE threat snaps | 𝓶𝓮𝓮𝓫𝔂𝓫𝓫 · 2025-08-18, Kokuyo · 2025-08-21 | | **PvP** | Engineering + anything | Grenades give stuns to "a class that has no CC". sections.heading: What each profession gives a shaman
sections.markdown: ### Engineering - **Goblin Sapper Charges and Dynamite** give mana-free AoE damage and threat, for tanks and DPS alike DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-08-18, Therz · 2025-07-29. Tanks can snap a whole pack with Fire Nova + Sapper + Stoneclaw (see [Tank](#/class/shaman/enhancement-tank)). A low-level, low-gear shaman tank leans on mana potions and "engineering explosives" Zamka · 2026-03-01. - **How much Sappers add is contested.** One player calls it "relatively minor", used only because it is the one direct DPS gain Not Normal · 2025-11-16. In the fastest Kara40 run a Sapper was about 1% of a top DPS player's damage Faithroll · 2025-11-16. One Sapper was also seen making up 7% of a player's damage on Maexxna Squid · 2025-11-16. Others note shamans already have strong AoE threat without Sappers or Force Reactive Disk Zykes · 2025-10-16. - **Force Reactive Disk** is named alongside Sappers as a reason Engineering is "the best prof for basically every spec" billienomates · 2025-10-16, billienomates · 2025-10-16. - **PvP:** stun grenades, Flash Bomb, Goblin Rocket Helmet Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2025-10-20. "Grenades are a great aoe cooldown for any content" Holidae · 2025-09-26. - **Travel:** the Gadgetzan and Winterspring teleporters and the Orgrimmar wormhole, plus Astral Recall, give "the best qol" and near-mage mobility Nandieb · 2025-11-30. - **Goblin vs Gnomish:** "Goblin engineering for sappers are amazing" Therz · 2025-07-29 (single source in this channel). - **Buy the mats.** Don't take Mining just to feed Engineering: "just lasher farm and buy the materials, it's 1000% more efficient" DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-06-29, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-01. ### Herbalism - Herbalism is the gatherer that pairs with the **Dire Maul East lasher farm** (see [Gold](#/class/shaman/professions)) DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-09, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-30. - **Contested:** how much it adds. Some say the value of a lasher run is "tied to the economy of herbs" DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-18. Others call Herbalism "a very minor part of lasher farm" Zaaparou · 2026-02-17. On fresh Ambershire it added only "like 5-10% per hour" Squall · 2025-09-21. - **Tauren** get +15 Herbalism, "a nice boost in early game" .• Øยgคฬค •. · 2024-08-28. ### Alchemy - Alchemy has no shaman-specific perk. "Anything an Alch can make you can just buy with gold," while an alchemist can't use Engineering's tools DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-06-29. The only alchemy trinket is a BoE, and it is not a tank trinket peter_hammer · 2026-02-13. - Profit follows raid demand: with only MC and Onyxia running "you probably won't make much money" peter_hammer · 2025-10-30, Zeruel · 2025-11-04. On fresh Ambershire potions often sold for less than their herbs Squall · 2025-09-21. - Worth it only with Herbalism feeding it Not Normal · 2025-10-11. It is a "good, low-friction" leveling pair Ionnatra · 2026-04-16. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle custom) - **Enchants (Gemology):** ring and neck enchants that "will always be useful" as new gear arrives, and a steady gold earner sailorVEVO · 2026-03-27, peter_hammer · 2025-08-22. Named examples: +12 healing ring/neck enchants for Restoration Bezawit · 2025-09-04; +6 SP ring/amulet enchants, which Elemental can use to cover spell penetration more cheaply Not Normal · 2026-02-12. "Go gemology and sell ring and neck enchants" Spicyahi, Tel'abim · 2025-11-30. - **Tank items:** BoP spell-damage pieces such as **Talisman of Hinderance** 𝓶𝓮𝓮𝓫𝔂𝓫𝓫 · 2025-08-18, a "strong anti magic damage neck" Rinzu · 2025-07-29, and a BoP trinket that is BiS for certain bosses Kokuyo · 2025-08-21. A Goldsmith-only necklace that reduces all spell damage by 5% was raised as a reason to take it (single source, asked as a question) Zykes · 2025-10-16. The JC **+8 defense ring** helps reach crit immunity from AQ40 gear 𝓶𝓮𝓮𝓫𝔂𝓫𝓫 · 2025-07-22. - **Restoration:** an epic BoE pre-raid healing ring, and the epic crafted **Grandstaff of the Shen'dralar Elder** for shamans in the dedicated healer group Bezawit · 2025-09-13, Bezawit · 2025-09-13. The Gemology staff and ring (Shen'dralar recipe) are "hard to beat" Dwi · 2026-02-19. - **Goldsmith staff:** a level-60 Goldsmith staff is an alternative to the Stratholme T0.5 off-hand if you can't get help with that summon Dwi · 2025-09-07. - **Downsides:** leveling JC alongside Mining is costly ("making a single opaline illuminator takes so many resources") chincer · 2025-10-30, and leveling it 1-60 "was not very pleasant" sailorVEVO · 2025-08-22. The route and trainers are in the [Professions overview](#/professions). ### Enchanting - Enchanting needs no gathering partner: any profession or drop that yields greens can be disenchanted Banther · 2025-10-18, Banther · 2025-10-18. It is "always a good choice" as a second profession Not Normal · 2026-01-07. - A bank alt with just enough Enchanting to disenchant BoE drops was a steady, if unspectacular, income on Ambershire Holidae · 2025-11-04. ### Skinning and Leatherworking - Skinning funds **Dragonscale farming**: shamans solo red and black dragonkin elites. Red scales earn about as much per hour as lashers but sell slowly; black scales sell fast for less. The Dragonscale belt buckle recipe from Searing Gorge black dragonkin is the jackpot Not Normal · 2025-10-10, Not Normal · 2025-10-10. Devilsaur leather is another shaman farm on Nordanaar Holidae · 2025-11-04. - **Leatherworking** "is kinda ass unless you're just doing some self imposed challenge of no trading" Not Normal · 2026-01-17. Tribal is the usual pick if you take it Brotherman · 2026-01-18. Stormshroud shoulders and hands are called pre-BiS for Enhancement at ~50 (single source) Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-09-17. ### Blacksmithing - Blacksmithing makes the **Fiery Chain** fire-resistance mail set for tanks poto · 2026-02-21, Méroulkas · 2026-02-25. One Fiery Chain piece plus FR enchants reaches ~300 FR poto · 2025-10-08. - **Towerforge** (crafted, Kara10 tier) head and shoulders are Enhancement pre-raid pieces with a two-hand weapon-skill set bonus. They are expensive (about 600 g for two pieces), and two of the four need AQ20 Small Obsidian Shards. Buy them rather than taking Blacksmithing: they are BoE Akos · 2024-09-18, Zeruel · 2025-11-24, Not Normal · 2025-11-24, Not Normal · 2025-11-24. - Otherwise Blacksmithing is weak for a shaman ("only has weapons") Rinzu · 2025-07-21. **Contested:** "Blacksmithing really doesnt have anything" you can't get elsewhere, apart from raid resistance sets Mist · 2025-04-12. ### Tailoring - Bloodvine's tooltip shows "Requires Tailoring (300)". One reading is that you need Tailoring only for the set bonus, not to equip the pieces (unverified) Dwi · 2025-10-02. Leatherworking, Tailoring and Alchemy all have cooldown crafts worth "a tiny passive income" Rinzu · 2025-09-17. ### Fishing and Cooking (secondary) - Fishing takes no profession slot Not Normal · 2026-01-07. Oily Blackmouth off the Barrens coast sells while you level; Stonescale Eels sell at 60 Ordinary Joe · 2026-01-08. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) - **The shaman channel is nearly silent on the 1.18.1 Survival rework.** Players mention "survival lantern" and "the new survival trinkets" only in passing, as proc-trinket fodder Hassle · 2026-04-09, Ryuuhei · 2026-04-16. No source argues shaman-specific value, so treat Survival as optional open-world and gathering quality of life. - **1.18.1 rework (forum, all classes):** Survival now draws on the primary professions and has 80+ recipes: slowing, rooting and trapping tools, bags for the three gathering professions, fish and meat containers, and Woodcutting [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168). The player 1-300 route includes Slowing Bolas, Throwable Nets, fishing traps and Nutritious Rations [Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172915#p172915). A skill-300 sickle raises the Black Lotus chance [Birtha (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171974#p171974). That is useful for a lasher-farming herbalist, but no shaman source tests it. Tents now give only 25% rested XP [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168). - **Gardening (pre-1.18.1):** the Gardening quest's shovel was called the best 1-hander at level 20 and "good for tanking" otep1616 · 2025-07-04, chincer · 2025-11-17. The 1.18.1 overhaul reset the Gardening quest, so you must redo it [Sylveria (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171863#p171863).

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **1-~50:** two gatherers (Herb + Mining or Herb + Skinning) DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-01. Alternatively, Skinning + Leatherworking until ~50 for Stormshroud Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 2. **~52-54:** start lasher farming Hassle · 2026-03-30. Swap Leatherworking for Herbalism if you had it Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31. 3. **60:** Herbalism for farming plus **Engineering for raiding**; drop Mining or Skinning and buy the Engineering mats with lasher gold Greybull-Ambershire · 2025-08-31, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-01. Another route: "mining and skinning till 35 then engi and mining" MJ (meeyolneer) · 2025-09-17. 4. At 60 the common end pairs are "engi/herb, engi/jc or engi/ench" Rowan · 2025-08-22. On a **fresh server** herb and ore nodes are heavily contested. Players took Skinning, or delayed professions until 60 peter_hammer · 2025-08-29.

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: Shamans are Orc, Tauren or Troll. The one sourced profession link is **Tauren +15 Herbalism** .• Øยgคฬค •. · 2024-08-28. **Plainsrunning** (Tauren) lets you throw Engineering grenades and drink invisibility potions at mount speed, "pretty OP" for world PvP DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-08-10, DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-10-10. Racials otherwise don't affect profession choice (see [Races](#/class/shaman)).

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Dire Maul East lashers** are the default shaman farm from ~52 Hassle · 2026-03-30, Zaaparou · 2025-09-24. About 100 g+/hour on Nordanaar Zamka · 2025-10-09, or ~60 g per 5 lockouts, all 5 done in ~30 minutes DemonBoyJr (Tel’Abim-Horde) · 2025-07-18. Vendor trash is about 3-4 g per run, plus BoEs and herbs Zaaparou · 2026-02-17. Lashers are nature-immune, so **Totem of Tides** is the biggest quality-of-life upgrade poto · 2025-10-12. Running alt accounts on lashers is not a ToS violation Squid · 2025-10-28. - **Alternatives:** Dragonscale and Devilsaur farming (Skinning), Frostsaber and frost-giant Ekos, Ripe Bananas on Tel'Abim Not Normal · 2025-09-22. Shamans can also solo ZG Kyrsie · 2025-10-14. - **Fresh-server caveat:** on Ambershire lasher profits crashed with herb oversupply and low raid demand Nandieb · 2025-11-04. Players found steadier returns there from Leatherworking/Tailoring cooldown crafts Squall · 2025-09-21. - **Gold sinks:** dual spec costs 350 g duck · 2025-07-20. Consumables are expensive, and one player put the weapon-skill quest at about 500 g & Enjoyer · 2025-05-19.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- No source compares Gnomish and Goblin Engineering for a shaman beyond "Goblin for Sappers".
- The Jewelcrafting items shamans name (Talisman of Hinderance, the anti-magic neck, the +8 defense ring, the 5% spell-damage Goldsmith neck) come without skill levels or recipe sources in this channel.
- No shaman-specific test of any 1.18.1 Survival craft (bolas, nets, gathering trinkets, the Black Lotus sickle).
- No post-1.18.1 gold-per-hour figures for lashers.

See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/shaman)

overview:
**Recommendation:** level **Frost**, raid **Arcane** (43/8/0), and keep **Fire** as a second spec for AQ40, Naxx and Kara40, where it can match Arcane. Frost is also the control and PvP spec, and the best spec for soloing and open-world farming. Install **Nampower** on day one; every spec depends on its spell queueing.

Turtle WoW reworked the mage in 1.17.2 ("CC2") and again in 1.18.0. Arcane now plays around the custom **Arcane Rupture** debuff, the baseline **Arcane Surge** and **Temporal Convergence**. Frost has **Icicles** and **Flash Freeze**; Fire has **Hot Streak** and a 4-second, shared **Ignite**. Guides written for vanilla or before 1.17.2 do not apply.

playbooks.title: Arcane Mage (ranged DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** Arcane is the mage raid spec in 1.18.1. Play **43/8/0**. Get **16% spell hit** (10% comes from Arcane Focus, so you only need about 6% from gear and buffs), then stack **spell power and haste** roughly equally, with crit behind them. Keep the **Arcane Rupture** debuff up, fill with **Arcane Missiles**, press **Arcane Surge** only while your total haste is low, and burn **Mind Quickening Gem → Arcane Power** together at full mana. On trash, spam **Arcane Explosion** with the same build. | | | |---|---| | Role | Single-target and AoE ranged caster (Arcane Missiles channel, Arcane Rupture keystone, baseline Arcane Surge) | | Viability (1.18.1) | **The mage meta.** Around 80-90% of raiding mages play it sosqua9- · 2026-03-30. The top-50 Kara40 mage parses were about 40 Arcane to 10 Fire Promey · 2026-03-17. Called "30-40% stronger than frost for PvE" and the most consistent spec, because its many small RNG rolls even out Gustavo · 2026-01-24, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-27. Arcane is also the easiest spec to gear into raids MeIzClone · 2026-02-13. Fire can beat it on long single-target fights such as Patchwerk, but there are few such fights in Naxx and Kara40 Insta · 2026-03-24. | | Difficulty | Medium. The basic loop is simple; the ceiling is haste snapshotting, clean Missile cancels and cooldown timing | | Strengths | 10% hit from talents; best AoE of any mage spec; almost nothing in PvE resists arcane; least gear-dependent spec Luden TA · 2025-10-09, Boomwick · 2025-10-10 | | Weaknesses | 30-yd range; Arcane Power can kill you if you run out of mana EdEddnEdy · 2026-03-06; Kara40's Anomalus and the trash around it are arcane-immune Promey · 2025-12-27; "bursty but super squishy" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-17 |

talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid 43/8/0 (recommended) This is the standard post-1.18.1 raid build. It was posted as a screenshot the day after the patch Bruh · 2026-03-21, and Luden TA linked the same build when a player asked for a level-60 Arcane spec Luden TA · 2026-03-25. There is no separate AoE build: "take the arcane tree... and mash Arcane Explosion" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-10-19, Shared · 2025-11-08. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Arcane | Arcane Subtlety | 2/2 | | Arcane | Magic Absorption | 3/3 | | Arcane | Improved Arcane Missiles | 5/5 | | Arcane | Arcane Focus | 5/5 | | Arcane | Arcane Concentration | 5/5 | | Arcane | Arcane Impact | 3/3 | | Arcane | Arcane Rupture | 1/1 | | Arcane | Temporal Convergence | 3/3 | | Arcane | Arcane Meditation | 3/3 | | Arcane | Arcane Instability | 3/3 | | Arcane | Presence of Mind | 1/1 | | Arcane | Accelerated Arcana | 1/1 | | Arcane | Arcane Potency | 2/2 | | Arcane | Resonance Cascade | 5/5 | | Arcane | Arcane Power | 1/1 | | Fire | Improved Fireball | 5/5 | | Fire | Improved Fire Blast | 3/3 | Split **43/8/0**, VALID. Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage?points=ToFoDIAbZKAoB-FAAY-` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage/FUZ363L7H6-U0I` [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=mage&t=2350550310033311251-50003) Why: - **Arcane Focus 5/5** gives +10% spell hit, so Arcane needs only about 6% from gear to reach the 16% raid cap MeIzClone · 2026-02-06. Fire and Frost get 6% from talents and need about 10% from gear Luden TA · 2025-10-09. - **Arcane Potency** raises your crit bonus from 150% to 200%. Take it before you invest in crit talents, since crit is weak without it Dontlookatme · 2025-10-09. - **Accelerated Arcana** is a cast-time reduction, not haste. That is why the Missiles channel floors look odd (2.82 s and 2.35 s, see Caps) Mynie · 2026-03-20. It also shortens Rupture and Evocation cooldowns Pepopo · 2026-01-18. - **Resonance Cascade** is capped at 4 duplications. It rolls only once per Arcane Explosion cast, however many targets you hit, and duplicates do not trigger on-hit item effects (dev comment relayed by Pepopo) Pepopo · 2025-10-24. - **Improved Fire Blast 3/3:** the 1.18.1 GCD cut makes Fire Blast your movement and filler button (see Rotation). One raider notes "imp fire blast doesn't change much for arcane raiding", so these 8 points are the flex slot PBnJames · 2026-04-10. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Frost flex (trash kiting)** | Put the 8 flex points in Frost to reach Permafrost for Cone of Cold on trash. I have my extra points in permafrost cuz I like to CoC on trash in case I pull threat" PBnJames · 2026-04-10; 8 in Fire (Fire Blast) or Frost (Permafrost) Lyans · 2026-03-25 | | **Dungeon / AoE farm 38/0/13** | Drops Arcane Subtlety, Magic Absorption and the Fire points. Takes Frost Warding 2, Elemental Precision 3, Improved Frost Nova 2, Permafrost 3, Improved Blizzard 3 | `AoFoDIAbZKAoB--QYATAD` | Posted as an experiment ("Not sure how crucial missing those top 2 arcane talents is") Darthok · 2026-03-25 (single source) | | **Mage tank** | Remove the threat-reduction talent (Arcane Subtlety) and skip Arcane Power | — | "basically arcane just without the threat reduce (and no AP)" Izzo · 2026-03-10. See [Mage tanking](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps) | **Before 1.18.1:** Arcane Focus and Magic Absorption swapped places in the tree (Focus is now in row 2).
