stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Spell hit to 16%** against level-63 bosses. The miss table is 3% / 4% / 5% / 16% for targets at your level / +1 / +2 / +3 Dontlookatme · 2025-10-09. With 5/5 Arcane Focus you need 6% more. A druid's Emerald Blessing (+1%) and the two ZG head and leg enchants (+1% each) bring that down to only 3% from gear Beta · 2026-03-21. Even at the cap, spells top out at 99% hit Pepopo · 2026-02-23. Trash below boss level needs far less hit, so hit is worth about 0 for AoE Luden TA · 2025-10-10, PBnJames · 2026-01-21. 2. **Haste and spell power**, roughly equal. 1% haste is worth about 10 SP in pre-raid gear and about 15-20 SP near BiS, because haste gains value the more you have Shared · 2026-01-28, PBnJames · 2026-02-07, Shared · 2025-10-28. Ocra's Kara40/Naxx-geared sim: 1% haste ≈ 16.8 SP, 1% crit ≈ 13.6 SP Ocra · 2025-12-30. Fresh-60 sim on Ambershire: hit ≈ crit ≈ haste ≈ 12 SP Lyans · 2025-12-16. **6% haste is the single biggest breakpoint**; past it, 1% crit or 1% haste ≈ 14 SP Beta · 2026-04-08. Haste's value rises with fight length (Ocra: 13 SP at 30 s, 16.3 SP at 3 min) Ocra · 2026-01-11. 3. **Crit:** about 10 SP per 1% PBnJames · 2026-03-07, Lightemgee · 2025-12-04. For AoE, crit is the best stat Aest · 2026-01-25. 4. **Intellect:** mana plus a little crit. It does not give spell power Lightemgee · 2025-10-19. Aim for a 4,500-5,000 unbuffed mana pool; below that, Arcane Power is hard to use safely Beta · 2026-04-09. 5. **Spirit and MP5:** not chased. Arcane tier sets already carry Spirit, and your mana comes from talents and Mage Armor Shared · 2026-02-13. 6. **Spell penetration:** mostly a dump stat. Your passive talent gives 10 penetration, and Curse of Shadows/Elements covers nearly every boss; the exceptions are AQ20 bosses and Kel'Thuzad's frost resistance Pepopo · 2025-12-02, 30 · 2025-12-16, Dontlookatme · 2025-12-16. **Haste is multiplicative.** Every source (each gear piece, TBoS, Whip, Arcane Power, set bonus) multiplies separately. For example, 1.05 × 1.03 × 1.05 × ~1.01⁸ × 1.30 × 1.05 ≈ 167% cast speed Izzo · 2026-04-03, biloen · 2026-02-14. ### Haste caps (measured) | Cap | Value | Source | |---|---|---| | Arcane Missiles tick floor | 0.475 s per missile with Accelerated Arcana (0.5 s without), which is the 100% haste cap. One player measured 0.470 s (read as rounding) | Dontlookatme · 2025-11-03, Ocra · 2025-12-30, Pinkkee 🐹 · 2025-11-04 | | Missiles channel softcap | 2.82 s with a T2/T3 (+1 s) belt, 2.35 s with any other belt; past it, extra haste adds no ticks | Mynie · 2026-03-20 | | Arcane Rupture GCD floor | Rupture stops improving at **58.3%** haste (in-game test). An earlier sim estimate was ~66.6% | Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-02-10, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-02-10; earlier: Pepopo · 2025-11-07 | | Arcane Surge cutoff | Stop weaving Surge above ~20-30% total haste, because its lockout does not scale with haste. **Contested:** 22% (sim default), 25%, or 30% (older figure) | Ocra · 2026-04-05, Mondalv · 2026-03-24, Shared · 2026-03-24, Pepopo · 2025-10-29 | | GCD | Haste (MQG etc.) does **not** shorten the GCD on this server | Mynie · 2026-02-08 | The cast bar rounds. Nampower's debug log shows the true server channel time (e.g. `Channel start: Arcane Missiles duration 5640`) Pepopo · 2025-10-14, Pepopo · 2025-11-04.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Snapshot rules you must know:** - Arcane Rupture's +20% Missiles bonus and any active haste apply to each missile **when it is cast**, not when it lands. Distance to the target does not matter Pepopo · 2025-10-29, Pepopo · 2025-10-29. - Haste is locked in when the Missiles channel starts. A channel started in the last moment of Arcane Power or MQG keeps that haste for the whole channel Izzo · 2025-10-03. - Rupture is a debuff on the target, but it snapshots like a buff and does not re-check your stats Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-29. **Opener** (Oaks, with logs): on-use SP trinket → `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` → (on a Surge proc: `Arcane Surge`, and pop `Presence of Mind` during Surge's GCD) → `Arcane Missiles` → `Arcane Rupture` → pop `Mind Quickening Gem` + `Arcane Power` during the GCD → Missiles spam Oaks · 2026-02-03. Popping PoM right at the pull risks pulling threat, so many players hold it Swiftmind · 2026-01-13. **Priority** (bot-ready; verbatim structure from Jûun Amelie Jûun Amelie · 2026-03-24): *During Arcane Power (or any big haste window):* 1. **`Arcane Rupture`** if the Rupture debuff is not on the target. 2. **`Arcane Missiles`**. Do **not** press Surge or Presence of Mind in this window Luden TA · 2025-10-27, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-02. *Outside Arcane Power:* 1. **`Arcane Missiles`** if Clearcasting is active. 2. **`Arcane Rupture`** if the debuff is not active. Cancel a Missiles channel for it the moment the debuff drops Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-15, Luden TA · 2025-12-12. 3. **`Arcane Surge`** if it is available (it becomes usable for a few seconds after one of your spells is partially or fully resisted) **and** your total haste is below the Surge cutoff (see Caps). Cast it in the last second of the Rupture debuff, or when no debuff is up Jûun Amelie · 2026-03-24. If you are above ~50% mana, cancel Missiles right away for Surge. Below that, wait until the last moment Beta · 2026-01-31, Beta · 2026-01-31. 4. **`Arcane Missiles`**. 5. **Moving:** `Fire Blast`. It can fish a resist that enables Surge; a Roid-Macros macro combines the two (see Macros) Pepopo · 2025-12-28. **Cancel Missiles cleanly.** Cut the channel right after a missile lands, never mid-tick: use Nampower's double-tap setting or `/script ChannelStopCastingNextTick(); /cast Arcane Rupture` Insta · 2026-03-24, Insta · 2026-03-24. Never re-press Missiles during a channel without Nampower queueing; it clips the last missile Luden TA · 2025-10-08. **End of a haste window:** with Arcane Power or MQG about to expire, most players fire one more Missiles volley rather than refresh Rupture early. Temporal Convergence (free Rupture reset) has its own 15 s internal cooldown. The sim difference between the two approaches is "pretty minimal" Pepopo · 2025-11-17, Pepopo · 2025-11-17. **In full BiS**, Surge procs are rare enough that the rotation becomes Rupture plus Missiles alyflex · 2026-03-05.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown: - **3+ targets: spam `Arcane Explosion` (max rank).** "Uptime and trinket usage" are the two pillars of Arcane AoE Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-11. The same raid build does it Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-10-19. The sources give no clean 2-target threshold (gap); the community sims treat 3 mobs as AoE. - **Pre-stack Sigil of Ancient Accord** with rank-1 Arcane Explosion before the pull, then Explosion on the pack. Sigil procs at most once per 2 s internal cooldown, however many mobs you hit Micro Jackson · 2026-03-11, Micro Jackson · 2026-03-11. - **Threat:** Arcane Explosion threat can rip off weak tanks. Drop to a lower rank of Explosion, or use BoP, Limited Invulnerability Potion or Eye of Diminution sosqua9- · 2026-03-30, sosqua9- · 2026-03-30. Fetish of the Sand Reaver does not share the active-trinket cooldown, so it pairs with Sigil for big pulls Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-28, Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-03-18. One extra Explosion from threat headroom is worth 3-8k damage per pull Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-11. - **Burst packs:** Goblin Sapper Charge + the Arcane Jewel of Wild Magics + Arcane Explosion can do about 50k damage in one GCD Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-13. - **Trash gear:** wear 3 Frost/Fire T3.5 plus 3 Arcane T3.5 for two 3-piece bonuses (Mirror Magic rewinds on Arcane Explosion hits) Pepopo · 2026-03-11. Keep a separate AoE set; players run up to 8 saved outfits Pepopo · 2026-01-28.

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Kara40 ([Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan)):** Anomalus and the trash between the 2nd and 3rd bosses are arcane-immune, so raids swap Arcane mages to Fire (or Frost) for that stretch and often stay Fire for Medivh Promey · 2025-12-27, Aest · 2025-10-30. Many guilds want 200 unbuffed arcane resistance for Kara40 Sellma · 2026-03-15. On **Gnarlmoon**, mages take the blue side for the raven AoE (for example 2 boomkins red, 5-6 mages blue) Luden TA · 2025-10-17. Sigil is best for padding there; one raider runs REoS + the Anomalus trinket on the blue side and Sigil + REoS on the raven side, and Eye of Diminution or Jewel of Wild Magics can replace Mark of the Champion Pinkkee 🐹 · 2025-12-03, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-03. mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Using Arcane Power below full mana or while Mana Shield drains you. You die at 10% mana Malaenia · 2024-10-22. 2. Pressing Arcane Surge or PoM during Arcane Power/MQG, or at all above the haste cutoff Luden TA · 2025-10-27, Mondalv · 2026-03-24. 3. Re-pressing Missiles mid-channel, or cancelling mid-tick. Use Nampower or the stop-next-tick macro Insta · 2026-03-24. 4. Recasting Rupture while its debuff is still up. Refresh it only when it drops Pepopo · 2025-12-11. 5. Stacking haste past the caps (Missiles 0.475 s floor, Rupture 58.3%) with consumables you should have saved Pinkkee 🐹 · 2025-11-04, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-02-10. 6. Gearing hit for trash. Talents already cover sub-boss mobs Luden TA · 2025-10-10. 7. Going Arcane into Anomalus instead of swapping spec Promey · 2025-12-27. 8. Buying the "decreases casting speed" trinket or Dreamthread as pre-raid BiS Hrimnir · 2025-11-11, Shared · 2025-10-29. 9. Using the Gloves of Unwinding Mystery after the nerf when Gloves of Spell Mastery are available Aridhil · 2026-03-20.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 decision loop. The details, with sources, are in the sections below. 1. **Opener:** on-use SP trinket → `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` → `Arcane Rupture` → `Mind Quickening Gem` + `Arcane Power` → Missiles spam ([Single-target rotation](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps)) Oaks · 2026-02-03. Many players hold `Presence of Mind` at the pull for threat reasons (see the opener notes). 2. **Single-target loop, outside Arcane Power:** 1. `Arcane Missiles` on Clearcasting. 2. `Arcane Rupture` whenever the debuff is missing. Cancel Missiles for it right after a missile lands. 3. `Arcane Surge` when it lights up (after a resist) and your total haste is under the [Surge cutoff](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps). 4. `Arcane Missiles`. 3. **During Arcane Power (or any big haste window):** `Arcane Rupture` if the debuff is missing, otherwise `Arcane Missiles`. No Surge and no Presence of Mind in this window Jûun Amelie · 2026-03-24, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-02. 4. **Cooldowns:** `Arcane Power` only at full mana, since it kills you if you run out ZeroRanger · 2025-11-15. Pop `Mind Quickening Gem` first and Arcane Power near the end of MQG Luden TA · 2026-03-19. Juju Flurry and Potion of Quickness go inside Arcane Power. Full table in [Cooldowns](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps). 5. **AoE switch: 3+ targets,** spam max-rank `Arcane Explosion`. Pre-stack Sigil of Ancient Accord with rank-1 Explosion before the pull. Drop an Explosion rank if you pull threat off the tank ([AoE rotation](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps)). 6. **Mana:** Mage Armor always. Gems, tea and runes between Arcane Power windows. `Evocation` just before a server tick, cancelled after the 4th tick ([Mana](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps), Luden TA · 2025-12-22). 7. **Movement:** `Fire Blast`. It can also fish a resist that enables Surge Pepopo · 2025-12-28.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for Arcane
extraSections.markdown: - **No Arcane talent changed.** The community summary was "Nothing for mage is changing... Frost is getting better damage, that's all" Lightemgee · 2026-03-20, Lightemgee · 2026-03-20. - **Improved Fire Blast** now cuts Fire Blast's GCD. This is why the raid build puts 3 points there Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-25. - **Scythe of Elune:** the internal cooldown on its Elune's Wrath proc (about 15 s) is now enforced. Before, Arcane could keep the debuff up almost permanently, so this was "a considerable power loss for arcane" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-27, Aest · 2026-03-30. - **T3.5 "Mirror Magic" 3-piece:** Arcane Explosion, Flamestrike, Cone of Cold, Frost Nova and Blast Wave hits can now "rewind". The bonus is +10% for Arcane spells and +20% for Frost/Fire; Arcane's share was cut from 20% to 10% Pepopo · 2026-03-11, Dontlookatme · 2026-03-11. - **Weapon swaps cost a GCD** now, which kills the old swap-to-proc-weapon trick limbless · 2026-04-03. - **Contested:** on patch day some players reported Rupture and Surge hitting for much less than before, with no explanation PabsRies · 2026-03-20, Lev · 2026-03-27.

extraSections.heading: Mana
extraSections.markdown: - Arcane gets mana regen while casting from talents (Arcane Meditation) and Mage Armor. Measured: 14% regen while casting without Mage Armor, 30% with it, 37-38% with the T2 3-piece Mage Armor bonus Pepopo · 2025-11-14. The server caps regen while casting at 100% Pepopo · 2025-11-12. - The 5-second rule applies: Spirit regen stops for 5 s after you spend mana PBnJames · 2025-10-14. - **+1 s Missiles belts** (Overcharged Belt, T2/T3 belts) scale with haste and noticeably improve mana economy and Arcane Power survival Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-02-24, Luden TA · 2026-03-06. - **T3 6-piece** (mana back on crits during Arcane Power) can leave you above 90% mana 20 s after the pull and allows two Arcane Powers in some Kara40 fights UncleBruce · 2025-12-16, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-05. - With a Paladin in group, Blessing of Wisdom and judged Wisdom can keep a geared Arcane mage near full mana Micro Jackson · 2026-04-01, Klurifax · 2026-03-25. - "Mages do damage with mana... chug all the Nordanaar Tea" Aridhil · 2026-03-13. Night Dragon's Breath shares a cooldown with mana gems and runes Eubo · 2026-02-09. - **Threat:** threat-reduction sources multiply, they do not add: 40% talent × 25% Salvation × 3% cloak ≈ 57% total, not 68% Pepopo · 2025-10-13. Ice Block does not drop threat oh · 2026-02-23.

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Nampower** (client mod) + **Nampower Settings** (addon): "mandatory if u wanna compete" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-04-03. It queues spells to hide latency and stops Missiles clipping. Its double-tap setting (`DoubleCastToEndChannelEarly`) cleanly ends Missiles into Surge or Rupture. Reported gains are 10-25% Luden TA · 2025-10-08, Anima · 2025-12-12. Align the queue window to the average server tick (~55 ms), not your ping Pepopo · 2026-01-23. A third-party "nampower" download was flagged as a trojan, so use the official source Zero · 2025-10-14. - **PoM + Rupture (Nampower):** `/run QueueSpellByName("Presence of Mind");QueueSpellByName("Arcane Rupture");` Pinkkee 🐹 · 2025-11-13. PoM can fail when macroed, so test it Ocra · 2026-03-05. - **Cancel into Rupture:** `/script ChannelStopCastingNextTick(); /cast Arcane Rupture` Insta · 2026-03-24. Without SuperWoW, `/run SpellStopCasting()` works as a stopcast Wizzer · 2025-10-28. - **Moving Surge (Roid-Macros):** `#showtooltip Fire Blast` / `/cast [reactive:Arcane_Surge]Arcane Surge;Fire Blast` Pepopo · 2025-12-28. - **T3.5 5-piece trick:** pop PoM, then `/cancelaura Presence of Mind` to get the 6 s free-mana effect without spending the charge EdEddnEdy · 2026-03-06. - **Full-rotation macros** (SuperCleveRoidMacros + Nampower) exist and reach about 90% of a perfect rotation; purists prefer manual play for edge cases alyflex · 2026-03-05, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-05. - **Proc tracking:** ArcaneSurgeWarning (`github.com/AllinGaming/ArcaneSurgeWarning`), ProcDoc and MPowa. ProcDoc and MPowa need the max-rank Surge on an action bar, not only inside a macro Eubo · 2025-11-25, Pinkkee 🐹 · 2025-12-15. DoiteAuras is the Turtle "WeakAuras light" Doite · 2026-01-13. - **HasteDisplay** (`github.com/Timanaku/HasteDisplay`) shows whether a haste consumable would overshoot the caps Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-05. extraSections.heading: Mage tanking (Twin Emperors and dungeons)
extraSections.markdown: Mage "tanking" is a Turtle niche, never a raid-boss role except for one case: **Twin Emperors (AQ40), where a mage tanks the caster emperor**. Several raiders do it regularly ("I've tanked twins a lot on mage") Luden TA · 2025-11-24, Anima · 2025-12-09. - **Spec:** you must be Arcane, because Improved Arcane Missiles removes pushback. Respec out of Arcane's threat reduction; with it you cannot out-threat the raid, even without Salvation Luden TA · 2025-11-24. Tank spec = "basically arcane just without the threat reduce (and no AP)" Izzo · 2026-03-10. - **Shadow resistance:** stack shadow resistance gear. A Priest's Shadow Protection and Mark of the Wild are needed to break the 335 breakpoint. Fully buffed you have almost 6k HP Anima · 2025-12-09, Anima · 2025-12-09. Anima's gear set: Netherwind Crown, Eidolon Talisman, Arcanist Mantle, Cloak of Untold Secrets, Runed Stygian Belt/Leggings/Boots, 2× Ring of the Elder Warden, Grimoire of Grells + Neltharion's Tear, Brimstone Staff (6,180 unbuffed HP) Anima · 2026-01-03. - **Dampen Magic** on yourself is the one PvE use of Dampen Luden TA · 2025-06-02. - **Dungeon tanking** (novelty): aim for ~4,600 HP, know the pulls, and skip Vampirism gear if you have a healer ZeroRanger · 2026-02-07, ZeroRanger · 2025-11-02. ZeroRanger's kit: stamina first, Ice Barrier + Burrower's Shell (~1,800 effective HP), Lesser Invisibility and Fire/Frost Protection potions ZeroRanger · 2025-11-26, ZeroRanger · 2025-11-26, ZeroRanger · 2025-11-09. Boss pull: `Fireball` → `Fire Blast` → `Counterspell` → `Frost Nova` → Flash-Freeze `Icicles` ZeroRanger · 2025-11-09. - **Gap:** no full mage-tank guide was ever published (one was promised) ZeroRanger · 2026-03-12.

rotation_single.action: In Arcane Power: cast Arcane Rupture whenever the Rupture debuff is down, otherwise channel Arcane Missiles.
Outside Arcane Power: Missiles while Clearcasting -> Rupture when its debuff is down -> Surge at the last second of the Rupture debuff (or outside it) -> Missiles.
Keep the Rupture debuff up; wait for it to fall before re-casting Rupture and cancel the Missiles channel right after a tick without clipping a missile.
Do not press Arcane Surge during Arcane Power/MQG/other big haste; above ~25-30% effective haste drop Surge from the rotation entirely (Surge's wait does not scale with haste).
rotation_single.condition: effective haste > ~25-30%, or a haste cooldown is up

rotation_single.action: Never re-press Arcane Missiles mid-channel without a channel-check (clips the last missile); use /script ChannelStopCastingNextTick() or the nampower double-tap interrupt to cancel cleanly.
When ooming, finish the Missiles channel and then Rupture/Surge for better mana efficiency (lower DPS).
8-piece T3 'direct damaging Arcane spells' benefits only Surge and Rupture, not Missiles.

glance.recommendation: Arcane is the mage raid spec in 1.18.1. Play **43/8/0**. Get **16% spell hit** (10% comes from Arcane Focus, so you only need about 6% from gear and buffs), then stack **spell power and haste** roughly equally, with crit behind them. Keep the **Arcane Rupture** debuff up, fill with **Arcane Missiles**, press **Arcane Surge** only while your total haste is low, and burn **Mind Quickening Gem → Arcane Power** together at full mana. On trash, spam **Arcane Explosion** with the same build.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Single-target and AoE ranged caster (Arcane Missiles channel, Arcane Rupture keystone, baseline Arcane Surge)

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **The mage meta.** Around 80-90% of raiding mages play it sosqua9- · 2026-03-30. The top-50 Kara40 mage parses were about 40 Arcane to 10 Fire Promey · 2026-03-17. Called "30-40% stronger than frost for PvE" and the most consistent spec, because its many small RNG rolls even out Gustavo · 2026-01-24, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-27. Arcane is also the easiest spec to gear into raids MeIzClone · 2026-02-13. Fire can beat it on long single-target fights such as Patchwerk, but there are few such fights in Naxx and Kara40 Insta · 2026-03-24.

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium. The basic loop is simple; the ceiling is haste snapshotting, clean Missile cancels and cooldown timing

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: 10% hit from talents; best AoE of any mage spec; almost nothing in PvE resists arcane; least gear-dependent spec Luden TA · 2025-10-09, Boomwick · 2025-10-10

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: 30-yd range; Arcane Power can kill you if you run out of mana EdEddnEdy · 2026-03-06; Kara40's Anomalus and the trash around it are arcane-immune Promey · 2025-12-27; "bursty but super squishy" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-17

playbooks.title: Fire Mage (ranged DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** Fire is the **second raid spec, from AQ40 onward**. Molten Core and BWL are largely fire-immune, so play Arcane there. Play **10/38/3** with **Improved Fire Blast 3/3**. Get **16% spell hit** (6% comes from Elemental Precision), then stack **crit**, worth about 25 SP per 1% in Kara40 gear. Weave **Fire Blast every 2 Fireballs**, fire **Pyroblast at 5 Hot Streak stacks**, and keep **Fire Vulnerability** at 5 stacks. talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid 10/38/3 (recommended) Supermongo posted this exact build Supermongo · 2025-09-17. A month later he posted it again with the last 3 points left open: "Improved Fire blast (Single target) or Improved Flamestrike (AoE)" Supermongo · 2025-10-20. After 1.18.1, Improved Fire Blast is the rotation-defining talent, so it is the default PBnJames · 2026-04-02, Luden TA · 2026-04-02. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Arcane | Arcane Subtlety | 2/2 | | Arcane | Magic Absorption | 3/3 | | Arcane | Arcane Concentration | 5/5 | | Fire | Improved Fireball | 5/5 | | Fire | Ignite | 5/5 | | Fire | Flame Throwing | 2/2 | | Fire | Improved Fire Blast | 3/3 | | Fire | Incinerate | 2/2 | | Fire | Pyroblast | 1/1 | | Fire | Burning Soul | 2/2 | | Fire | Fire Vulnerability | 3/3 | | Fire | Master of Elements | 3/3 | | Fire | Blast Wave | 1/1 | | Fire | Critical Mass | 3/3 | | Fire | Hot Streak | 2/2 | | Fire | Fire Power | 5/5 | | Fire | Combustion | 1/1 | | Frost | Elemental Precision | 3/3 | Split **10/38/3**, VALID. Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage?points=TAAo-FAqYQKYDLQAoB-AY` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage/F05-UWK1F39H6-0I` [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=mage&t=230005-50523201230313251-003) Why: - **Elemental Precision 3/3** is Fire's hit talent (6%). Fire needs about 7% more from gear after the ZG enchants and the druid buff Beta · 2026-03-21. - **Arcane Concentration and Master of Elements** carry your mana. Without Arcane talents, Fire's mana is a known problem jc473 · 2024-12-25. - **Hot Streak 2/2:** Fireball and Fire Blast crits build stacks that cut Pyroblast's cast time. Fire it at 5 stacks (see Rotation) Luden TA · 2026-03-05. Being flagged as Fire (a Hot Streak or Combustion buff) is also what qualifies you for split Ignite credit Sellma · 2026-03-25. - There is no separate solo build: "Nothing changes in the spec between solo and group fire" Luden TA · 2026-01-22. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **AoE / trash** | Improved Flamestrike 3/3 instead of Improved Fire Blast. Flamestrike is "pretty decent now" with its 2.5 s cast | `TAAo-FAqATKYDLQAoB-AY` | Supermongo · 2025-10-20, Luden TA · 2026-01-22 | | **No Hot Streak 13/35/3** | Skips Hot Streak and Improved Flamestrike; takes Arcane Impact 3 and Flame Throwing 1 | `TAAoD-FApYQKYDLAAoB-AY` | Screenshot build ultratronger · 2026-02-02 (single source). The screenshot's Arcane column read "Arcane Focus 3", which is illegal in the 1.18.1 tree, so this code uses Magic Absorption 3 in that slot |

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Spell hit to 16%:** 6% from Elemental Precision, 2% from the ZG head/leg enchants, 1% from a druid's Emerald Blessing, so about 7% from gear Beta · 2026-03-21. Partial resists also weaken the Ignite you build Luden TA · 2026-03-28. 2. **Crit:** about 25 SP per 1% at Kara40 BiS, "slightly above 25" Aest · 2026-04-14, Jûun Amelie · 2026-03-07. Build toward about 40% crit Lightemgee · 2025-10-16. A solo Fire mage holds Ignite at about 50% Fireball crit Insta · 2026-03-27. 3. **Spell power.** 4. **Haste:** **contested.** In the 1.18.1 rotation, small amounts of haste (Potion of Quickness, Juju Flurry, Atiesh, Scythe procs) sim about 0.5-1% **lower**, because they break the 2-Fireball weave into 3 Fireballs per Fire Blast Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-04-02, Luden TA · 2026-04-02. At about 47-50% haste (MQG + Juju Flurry + Potion of Quickness + haste food) you get clean 3-Fireball weaves again PBnJames · 2026-04-02, PBnJames · 2026-04-02. Before the patch, 3-4% haste let solo Fire chain Fireball → Fire Blast → Fireball inside Ignite Pepopo · 2026-01-24. 5. **Intellect:** mana and a little crit Lightemgee · 2025-10-19.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Opener** (Patchwerk-tested, Pepopo): `Fire Blast` → `Scorch` → `Scorch` → `Scorch` → `Fireball` → `Fire Blast` Pepopo · 2026-03-05. Firing Fire Blast while a Fireball is still in flight banks an extra Fire Vulnerability stack before the Fireball lands Luden TA · 2026-01-29. **Priority** (bot-ready): 1. **`Pyroblast`** at **5 Hot Streak stacks**. Use it at 4 stacks only when the boss is about to die, so the Pyroblast DoT still gets close to its full duration Luden TA · 2026-03-05. 2. **`Fire Blast`** the moment it is off cooldown. With **no haste** that is after exactly **2 Fireballs**. With small haste it is not back yet, so cast a **3rd Fireball** first Luden TA · 2026-03-28, Luden TA · 2026-03-28. "Fire blast all you can (should be every 2/3 fireballs)" Bha! · 2026-03-23. 3. **`Scorch`** to (re)build 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks, but only if the target lives more than about 1 minute Bha! · 2026-03-23. Fire Blast also applies a stack Aest · 2025-11-09. 4. **`Fireball`**. Do **not** stall on extra Scorches to protect a big Ignite; that is a DPS loss. Maximize Fireball, Fire Blast and Pyroblast casts instead Pepopo · 2026-03-05, Pepopo · 2026-03-05. **Multi-Fire-mage openers** (a guild running 4 Fire mages in Kara40): on **Incantagos**, everyone Fire Blasts on the pull for 4 Fire Vulnerability stacks, focuses the adds, then goes Combustion into Fireball/Pyroblast. On **Anomalus**, everyone Fire Blasts, runs to the wall and builds Ignite together, accepting 4 stacks and no double dip for easier coordination Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-04, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-04, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-04.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation
rotationAoe.markdown: Fire's AoE lags behind Arcane's. Fire is "forced to choose between single-target and AoE DPS" Abbe · 2024-12-20. 1. **Rank-1 `Arcane Explosion`** first, to pre-proc trinkets without pulling threat Luux · 2026-03-07. 2. **`Flamestrike` rank 6 → `Flamestrike` rank 5.** Two different ranks let both DoTs tick at once Luux · 2026-03-07. 3. **`Blast Wave`** Luux · 2026-03-07. 4. **`Arcane Explosion`** (max rank) spam Luux · 2026-03-07. - **When to Flamestrike:** only if the mobs stay grouped and alive for a while (e.g. the mage/conjurer packs before Gnarlmoon and after Anomalus in Kara40). If the raid melts trash, just Arcane Explosion + Blast Wave Aest · 2026-01-27, Aest · 2026-02-05. Chained Flamestrike ranks lose value in short fights Luux · 2026-03-07. - Blast Wave reportedly rolls crit once, not per target (single source) Prezla · 2026-01-26. - **Flarecore (ZG) 6-piece** is a big-pull set. Skip it under 10 mobs; it is about 8% of damage at 10 mobs and up to ~50% at 40-60-mob duo pulls (e.g. Dragonmaw Retreat, Stormwrought Ruins) Luden TA · 2026-02-04, Pepopo · 2026-01-23. It causes client lag; the Perfboost mod can hide the effects Pepopo · 2026-01-23, Pepopo · 2026-01-23. The ZG 5-piece Flamestrike bonus is worth building around only for trash Aest · 2026-01-27. - Wear 3 Frost/Fire T3.5 + 3 Arcane T3.5 on trash for the Mirror Magic rewind (+20% for Fire) Pepopo · 2026-03-11. The rewind does not proc Ignite Aest · 2025-10-30.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and mana
cooldowns.markdown: | Cooldown | Use | |---|---| | **Combustion** | After Fire Vulnerability is up, into Fireball/Pyroblast (see the Incantagos opener) Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-04 | | **Mind Quickening Gem** | Save it for fights where it matters (Medivh in Kara40, Faerlina/Heigan in Naxx) rather than every pull Luden TA · 2026-02-11. Its ~5 min cooldown makes it best on short fights; pre-summon and swap to it right before the pull to still get value on a longer fight Izzo · 2026-04-17, Luden TA · 2026-02-26 | | **Blast Wave** | 30 s cooldown; AoE | | **Evocation / gems / tea** | As for any mage. Master of Elements and Arcane Concentration are your in-fight mana |

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **[Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core) and [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair):** do not bring Fire. In BWL "only 3/8 work for Fire" (Vaelastrasz and Nefarian are immune, and Firemaw, Ebonroc and Flamegor are effectively immune) jc473 · 2026-04-15. "Bringing fire into MC is straight up trolling" Lightemgee · 2025-12-23. Chromaggus has only ~15 fire resistance; his gimmick is rotating vulnerabilities biloen · 2026-04-15. Everyone, Fire or not, should mix fire resistance into their gear for Firemaw jc473 · 2026-04-15. - **Fire-viable content before Naxx:** ZG, Kara10/Kara40 (selectively), AQ20/AQ40. AQ40 "isn't the most fire friendly raid" Lightemgee · 2025-12-16, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-16. Outside Broodlord and Chromaggus, most dragons are fire-immune eric4225 · 2025-12-24. - **[Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan):** Fire is the answer to arcane-immune **Anomalus**; Arcane mages swap to Fire there and often stay for **Medivh** Aest · 2025-10-30. **Mephistroth** is the 2nd-best Kara40 fight for Fire Aest · 2025-11-19. Incantagos/Anomalus openers are above. - **Naxx:** **Loatheb** is the Fire showcase ("Fire is better on Loatheb for sure") Gees · 2025-12-01. Apparent missing Ignite ticks there are usually the visible-cap quirk Pepopo · 2026-03-20. **Patchwerk:** solo Fire reached 2k DPS Insta · 2026-03-27. **Faerlina:** pre-pop Greater Fire Protection Potion and Fire Ward Luden TA · 2025-11-12.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **Pre-raid:** the wiki's Fire list includes Spellweaver's Turban, Diana's Pearl Necklace, Shroud of the Nathrezim, Heliotrope Cloak, Shadowguard Robe (Stormwind Vault), Brightspark Gloves, Ban'thok Sash, Skyshroud Leggings, Fire Striders, Blade of Necromancy, Pyric Caduceus, Blackfire Orb and Eye of the Beast ([Mage General FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_General_FAQ)). The crafted Spellwoven Nobility Drape is presumed to have much lower uptime for Fire than for Arcane Shared · 2026-02-19. - **Weapons:** in AQ40, **Femur (Viscidus) + the Twin Emperors offhand**, "the most meaningful upgrade" Aest · 2026-04-10, Aest · 2026-04-10. Endgame: **Kirel'narak** (Mephistroth, Kara40) is "the premium choice, way better than wraith" Aest · 2026-04-10, Aest · 2026-04-10. Desecration is "super mid" for Fire, so put your soft reserve on Kirel'narak Aest · 2026-03-02, Aest · 2026-03-02. Prestor's Rod of Command is "only slightly worse than nef staff" and better once in AQ40 Aest · 2026-03-27. - **Belt:** C'Thun's belt is "the most worthwhile upgrade you can get in AQ40"; prioritize it, since it lasts until Kara40 Aest · 2026-04-10, Aest · 2026-04-10. - **Head:** the T3/T3.5 Frost/Fire helm is worth a missing crit for +11 SP and the set bonus Luden TA · 2026-03-24. Without Scythe of Elune, run the **Yshgolar** head instead of T3; it fills your missing hit Aest · 2026-03-24, Aest · 2026-03-24. - **Trinkets:** MQG is still used in Kara40 whenever it is up Aest · 2026-03-20. Sigil of Ancient Accord and Sphere of the Endless Gulch are "insane if the fight isn't super fast" Aest · 2026-03-27. - **Sets:** Fire uses the regular (non-Arcane) T1-T3 pieces. The T2.5 5-piece is impractical PBnJames · 2025-12-18. The Fire T3.5 5-piece bug report (18568) has no confirmation either way (gap). - **Ring of Burning Talons** ("Conflagration") was meant as a Fire AoE ring but ends up better for Arcane Aest · 2026-04-16.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Bringing Fire to MC/BWL Aest · 2026-04-15. 2. Holding Fire Blast. After 1.18.1 it is your highest-DPS spell, so press it on cooldown Luden TA · 2026-03-28. 3. Casting another Fireball at 5 Hot Streak stacks instead of Pyroblast Luden TA · 2026-03-05. 4. Building Ignite before Fire Vulnerability is stacked Luden TA · 2026-01-29. 5. Nursing a weak or partially resisted Ignite instead of dropping and rebuilding it Luden TA · 2026-03-28. 6. Adding extra Scorches to "extend" a big Ignite Pepopo · 2026-03-05. 7. Stacking small haste sources that break the 2-Fireball weave (contested) Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-04-02. 8. Running 4+ Fire mages without coordination; Ignite is shared, so too many hurt individual DPS Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-27.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 decision loop. The details, with sources, are in the sections below. 1. **Opener:** `Fire Blast` → `Scorch` → `Scorch` → `Scorch` → `Fireball` → `Fire Blast` Pepopo · 2026-03-05. With several Fire mages, stack Fire Vulnerability together before anyone builds Ignite ([Ignite](#/class/mage/fire-ranged-dps)). 2. **Single-target loop** ([Single-target rotation](#/class/mage/fire-ranged-dps)): 1. `Pyroblast` at 5 Hot Streak stacks (at 4 only when the boss is about to die). 2. `Fire Blast` whenever it is off cooldown: every 2 Fireballs with no haste, every 3 with a little haste Luden TA · 2026-03-28. 3. `Scorch` to keep 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks, only if the target lives more than about a minute. 4. `Fireball`. 3. **Cooldowns:** `Combustion` once Fire Vulnerability is up, into Fireball/Pyroblast Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-04. Save `Mind Quickening Gem` for fights where it matters ([Cooldowns and mana](#/class/mage/fire-ranged-dps)). 4. **Ignite:** let a weak Ignite (built from partial resists) drop and rebuild it. Never stall on extra Scorches to protect a big one Luden TA · 2026-03-28, Pepopo · 2026-03-05. 5. **AoE switch** ([AoE rotation](#/class/mage/fire-ranged-dps)): on trash that stays grouped, rank-1 `Arcane Explosion` → `Flamestrike` R6 → `Flamestrike` R5 → `Blast Wave` → max-rank `Arcane Explosion` spam. If the raid melts trash fast, skip Flamestrike and use only Explosion + Blast Wave Aest · 2026-02-05. 6. **Mana:** Master of Elements and Arcane Concentration are your in-fight mana. Gems, tea and `Evocation` as for any mage. 7. **Movement:** `Fire Blast`, then `Scorch` (1.5 s cast) for short stops *(vanilla baseline)*.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for Fire
extraSections.markdown: - **Improved Fire Blast** now cuts Fire Blast's GCD by 0.3/0.6/1.0 s ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-26 rev.](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). Before, a Fireball (~3 s) plus Fire Blast's 1 s GCD took 4 s, the whole Ignite window, so Fire Blast dropped Ignite Pepopo · 2026-01-24, Aest · 2026-01-24. Now Fire Blast is "your highest dps spell by a good margin" Luden TA · 2026-03-28, and every spec's rotation changed Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-25. - Nothing else in the Fire tree changed. The 1.18.0 changes still apply: Ignite back to 4 s, Fire Blast also applies Fire Vulnerability, Blast Wave's cooldown cut, and cheaper Fireball/Flamestrike Arcitec · 2025-08-23, Pepopo · 2025-08-20, leftuser · 2025-03-31. - **Before 1.18.1** guides said to skip Fire Blast except with a ready Pyroblast, or to spam Fireball under MQG. Both are outdated.

extraSections.heading: Ignite: how it works
extraSections.markdown: - A crit applies **Ignite**, which deals 40% of that crit's damage again over **4 s**. Ignite stores up to 5 crits. Any later crit, even at 5 stacks, resets the 4 s timer; if no crit lands within 4 s, Ignite drops biloen · 2026-03-04. It stores 40% of the first 5 crits until it drops, then restarts Luden TA · 2026-03-28. - **Crit needed to keep it rolling:** about 50% for a Fireball → Fire Blast cadence, about 33% for Scorch → Scorch → Fire Blast biloen · 2026-03-04. - **Ignite is shared.** There is one Ignite per target. Every contributing mage refreshes it, and damage and threat are split among the mages who crit into it Sellma · 2026-03-25, Arcitec · 2025-08-23. The sweet spot is **2 Fire mages**; 3 can work after the Fire Blast fix but may be overkill Promey · 2026-01-27, Promey · 2026-01-27. - **Apply Fire Vulnerability before the crit that builds Ignite.** The debuff modifies the stored Ignite value when the crit lands, and Ignite ticks benefit again ("double dip") Luden TA · 2026-01-29, Luden TA · 2026-01-29, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-29. - **Drop a weak Ignite.** If partial resists built a weak Ignite, let it drop and rebuild quickly Luden TA · 2026-03-28. With several Fire mages, one player deliberately drops a weak opening Ignite so the group can build a stronger one Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-29. The BigWigs MageTools module has a shared alert for this: `/bw extra magetools ignitedroptrigger` biloen · 2026-03-04. - The Ignite debuff has a visible stack cap (48), so addons may show "no gain" when there was one. Use Nampower + BigWigs MageTools V2 to track past it Pepopo · 2026-03-20, Pepopo · 2026-03-20.

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **One-button Fire (Roid-Macros):** `#showtooltip` / `/cast [mybuff:"Hot Streak">=#5, noselfcasting:"Pyroblast"] Pyroblast; [nocooldown] Fire Blast; Fireball` alyflex · 2026-03-05. It was written before the Fire Blast fix, and players expected it to work better after 1.18.1 Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-03-05. - **BigWigs MageTools** tracks Ignite ticks, Ignite owner and Fire Vulnerability stacks, and provides the drop-ignite alert Luden TA · 2026-01-16, Pepopo · 2026-01-16. - **aDF** tracks curses, Ignite and boss debuffs Luden TA · 2026-01-15. **ProcDoc** shows Hot Streak stacks Luux · 2026-01-27. - Nampower is needed as for any mage (see [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps)).

standing.source_quality: medium: staff numbers, wiki rotation and 46-point path; standing contested; raid build image not extractable
standing.notes: Content-gated, not preference-gated: fire-immune bosses make it unusable in MC/BWL, and a solo Fire mage mostly buffs other fire users. 1.18.1's Improved Fire Blast GCD reduction (0.3/0.6/1.0 s) is the change Fire players wanted.

patch_validity.written_for: 1.18.0 Fire retune (2025-08-15) plus 1.18.1 Improved Fire Blast change; wiki rotation revised 2026-03-04
patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 raised Improved Fire Blast's GCD reduction to 0.3/0.6/1.0 s, which per Eluaria fixes Fire Blast dropping Ignite; the wiki rotation already uses Fire Blast on cooldown. Superseded: 1.17.2-era Ignite 6 s / Hot Streak 3-rank advice; wiki haste note written for a 6 s Ignite window (now 4 s). Discord (post-1.18.1, consensus) supersedes the 6 s window explicitly: Ignite is 4 s since 1.18.0 [[d:mage#1433239410652086395]], [[d:mage#1488094426352980008]]. Unknown: Fire T3.5 5-set bug (bug report 18568) status — Discord has no confirmation either way, only that the 3-set rewind does not proc Ignite [[d:mage#1433242806238969877]].

rotation_single.action: Open by building 5 Fire Vulnerability stacks with Scorch; Fire Blast also applies a stack (since 1.18.0).

Cast Fire Blast on/near cooldown — post-1.18.1 it is the highest-DPS spell (Improved Fire Blast GCD reduction 0.3/0.6/1.0 s). Weave it after 2 Fireballs at zero haste; with any haste cast a 3rd Fireball to avoid losing uptime.
Pyroblast at 4/5 Hot Streak stacks; Fireball is the default filler and Scorch refreshes Fire Vulnerability / extends Ignite and fills movement.
A solo Fire mage can hold Ignite only with ~50% Fireball crit; otherwise run 2-3 Fire mages and split the Ignite. Only players flagged as Fire (Hot Streak/Combustion buff) qualify for the split.
Drop and rebuild a weakly-built Ignite (partial resists make the stored ignite weak).
Small amounts of extra haste hurt the current Fire rotation unless it is enough to reach the ~47% MQG+consumes window.

ignite_mechanics: Ignite stores 40% of the first five crits; the tick does not grow afterwards [[d:mage#1235700216292835441]], [[d:mage#1487205700340941033]] (pre-1.18.1/post-1.18.1, consensus).
Ignite is 4 s since 1.18.0; the wiki Fire FAQ still computes a 6 s window — superseded [[d:mage#1433239410652086395]], [[d:mage#1488094426352980008]] (post-1.18.1, consensus).

Loatheb: 100% crit from spores makes one giant ignite; a good ignite ~250k with 5 mages, tracked past the 48-debuff visual cap with the BigWigs 'MageTools V2' plugin [[d:mage#900490010200002620]], [[d:mage#1229314969414402108]], [[d:mage#1484297069148770464]] (pre-1.18.1, consensus).

glance.recommendation: Fire is the **second raid spec, from AQ40 onward**. Molten Core and BWL are largely fire-immune, so play Arcane there. Play **10/38/3** with **Improved Fire Blast 3/3**. Get **16% spell hit** (6% comes from Elemental Precision), then stack **crit**, worth about 25 SP per 1% in Kara40 gear. Weave **Fire Blast every 2 Fireballs**, fire **Pyroblast at 5 Hot Streak stacks**, and keep **Fire Vulnerability** at 5 stacks. Fire is strongest with **2 (sometimes 3) Fire mages** feeding one Ignite.

facts.label: Role

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Alternative raid spec, highest ceiling.** "With perfect conditions fire does more damage" than Arcane Aest · 2026-01-27; a solo Fire mage did 2k DPS on Patchwerk after 1.18.1 Insta · 2026-03-27. But "fire never pulls ahead... pretty close in full kara 40 gear" Promey · 2026-03-27, and Arcane wins on most Naxx/Kara40 fights Insta · 2026-03-24. About 10 of the top-50 Kara40 mage parses were Fire Promey · 2026-03-17

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: Medium-high: Ignite management, Fire Blast weaving, coordination with other Fire mages

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Highest boss damage "in perfect/favorable conditions"; longest range; Fire Blast became the strongest button in 1.18.1 Luden TA · 2026-03-28

facts.label: Weaknesses

playbooks.title: Frost Mage (ranged DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** Frost is the **weakest raid spec** in 1.18.1. It is the best spec for **leveling, soloing and control**, and fine in early raids (MC/Onyxia/BWL). If you raid Frost, play **12/0/39**. Get **16% spell hit** (6% from Elemental Precision). Spam **Frostbolt**, cast **Icicles only when Flash Freeze procs**, **Frost Nova** freeze-immune bosses on cooldown from melee range to force procs, and recast **Ice Barrier** on cooldown for its damage buff. For raid DPS in later tiers, switch to [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps). | | | |---|---| | Role | Ranged caster: Frostbolt filler, Icicles bursts on Flash Freeze procs, strongest defensive kit (Ice Barrier, Ice Block, Cold Snap) | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Niche in raids.** In one week's top-100 Kara mage parses there were about 2 Frost vs 90 Arcane Promey · 2026-02-05. "Frost is the spec that needs changes the most" Aest · 2026-03-29. It still "competes with arcane in the earlier raids" but does not scale Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-25, and "frost is ok in slow raids" but degrades on fights under ~1:20, where you cannot drink ** · 2025-10-19. **Contested:** "Frost performs just fine, and in fact does competitive DPS with arcane" Lightemgee · 2026-03-01 | | Difficulty | Medium: few buttons, but proc hunting and positioning for Frost Nova | | Strengths | Survival; big burst windows when Flash Freeze procs; extra damage on frost-weak MC trash Luden TA · 2025-12-10; best leveling and open-world spec | | Weaknesses | Flash Freeze is binary: "It either procs 100% with nova, or 0%" depending on whether the target is freeze-immune Izzo · 2026-04-10. Also: close range for Nova, no pushback protection, no movement filler, no mana-return talent in the tree Almondum · 2026-03-20; poor mana on fast fights ** · 2025-10-19 |

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Spell hit to 16%:** 6% from Elemental Precision, 2% from the ZG head/leg enchants, 1% from Emerald Blessing, so about 7% from gear Beta · 2026-03-21, Luden TA · 2025-10-09. The wiki sim values hit highest for Frost (~18-19 SP per 1% at endgame) ([Mage Frost FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Frost_FAQ)). 2. **Spell power.** 3. **Haste ≈ crit:** about 12-13 SP and 11-12 SP per 1% in the same sim. Haste food is not recommended for Frost oh · 2026-01-24. 4. **Spell penetration** only for Kel'Thuzad (200 frost resistance); everything else needs no penetration once Curse of Shadows or Elements is up 30 · 2025-12-16, 30 · 2025-12-16. Sapphiron is flatly frost-immune 30 · 2026-04-16.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (freeze-immune raid bosses)
rotationSingle.markdown: This rotation applies only to targets that **cannot be frozen**, which is most raid bosses. On freezable mobs (dungeons, open world, some raid trash) Nova and Cone of Cold root the mobs away from the tank, so use the leveling loop instead ([Mage Frost FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Frost_FAQ)). **Pre-pull:** `Ice Barrier`. Its 10%-for-60-s buff now comes from the cast Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-30. **Opener:** `Frostbolt` → `Icicles` → `Frost Nova` → `Icicles` (ZeroRanger) ZeroRanger · 2026-01-31. Luden TA's burst: precast `Frostbolt` → `Cone of Cold` → `Icicles` (if Flash Freeze procs) → `Frost Nova` → `Icicles`, "insanely big burst in a 6 second window" Luden TA · 2025-12-10. **Priority** (bot-ready): 1. **`Icicles`** if Flash Freeze is active. Cast it immediately; the proc makes the channel much faster and resets Icicles' cooldown Lightemgee · 2025-10-22. **Never cast Icicles without the proc.** It roots you, you take extra damage if hit, and it is worse than Frostbolt Pepopo · 2026-04-10, Izzo · 2026-04-10. 2. **`Ice Barrier`** if it is off cooldown (the damage buff is on cast). 3. **`Frost Nova`** if it is off cooldown and you are in melee range of the boss, to force a proc Luden TA · 2025-10-22. 4. **`Cone of Cold`** if you are in range. With Frostbite it can proc Flash Freeze Luden TA · 2025-10-22. 5. **`Cold Snap`** to reset Nova for another Nova → Icicles pair. oh's sequence: Icicles > Nova > Icicles > Cold Snap > Icicles > Nova > Icicles > Frostbolt until Nova is back oh · 2026-01-31. 6. **`Frostbolt`**. Icicles notes: - Icicles roots you for the full channel, even if you cancel it early; only Blink frees you Aest · 2025-10-17, Luden TA · 2025-10-23. Do not start it standing in raid AoE. - Macro: `/cast [mybuff:Flash_Freeze] Icicles; Frostbolt`. It must be `mybuff`, not `buff`, or the queue replacement silently fails Pepopo · 2025-12-27. - Known bugs: Icicles sometimes shows "invalid target" on the boss that procced it Kao · 2025-11-09. A Flash Freeze Icicles cast can be denied outright if you take damage at the exact moment you cast ZeroRanger · 2026-02-21.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE rotation (raid trash)
rotationAoe.markdown: Wiki raid-trash rules ([Mage Frost FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Frost_FAQ)), freeze-immune packs only: - **Up to 5 mobs:** `Cone of Cold` → `Icicles` (if it procs) → `Frost Nova` → `Icicles` → `Arcane Explosion`. - **More than 5 mobs:** `Cone of Cold` → `Arcane Explosion` spam, then Icicles on a survivor at the end. - **Medium packs:** alternate rank-1 `Blizzard` (to fish procs) with `Icicles` on the skull target Promey · 2025-11-26. Fishing with 1 point of Improved Blizzard is "insanely good" on some fights (Garr: fish procs off his adds into Icicles on the boss) and roughly break-even on a generic 5-mob pack Promey · 2026-02-02, Pepopo · 2026-02-02. - Blizzard for damage is dead: "blizzard is dead, coc is alive" Izzo · 2025-11-08.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and mana
cooldowns.markdown: - **Ice Barrier** on cooldown for the damage buff. **Ice Block + Cold Snap** give you a second Block, Nova and Barrier. Ice Block does not drop threat oh · 2026-02-23. - **Mana** is Frost's weak point on fast fights ** · 2025-10-19. Use Evocation, gems and tea as for any mage (see [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps)). - **Trinkets** (wiki sim, 2-min fight): Tear > Mark of the Champion > MQG > REoS > Shard of the Nightmare > Gulch > Eye of Diminution > ToEP > Zandalarian Hero Charm ([Mage Frost FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Frost_FAQ)).

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **[Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core):** Frost is at its best here. Many trash mobs are weak to frost, and between packs Nova forces procs Luden TA · 2025-12-10. On Garr, fish procs off the adds Promey · 2026-02-02. - **AQ40, Viscidus:** Icicles "completely destroy" Viscidus Aest · 2026-02-19. - **[Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan), Anomalus** (arcane-immune): as Frost "you'll die less... due to ice barrier but do less damage than fire" Promey · 2025-12-28. - **Naxx:** Sapphiron is immune to frost 30 · 2026-04-16. On Kel'Thuzad (200 frost resistance) Frost needs spell penetration 30 · 2025-12-16, 30 · 2025-12-16. Constant raid damage (Thaddius) breaks Ice Barrier and hurts Frost Myra_Undertool · 2025-04-03.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **Pre-raid** (wiki Frost list): Spellweaver's Turban, Diana's Pearl Necklace, Boreal Mantle, Shroud of Arcane Mastery, Freezing Lich Robes, Sublime Wristguards, Hands of Power, Ban'thok Sash, Skyshroud Leggings, Kayser's Boots of Precision, Ring of the Academy / Rune Band of Wizardry / Don Mauricio's Band, Witchblade, Tome of Shivering Secrets ([Karazhan Crypt](#/instances/karazhan-crypt)), Bonecreeper Stylus, Blackfire Orb, Fabric of Time ([Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass)) ([Mage General FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_General_FAQ)). - **Rings:** Dragonslayer's Signet for Frost Saedar · 2025-12-23. - **Weapons:** Desecration is "pretty decent for frost" Aest · 2026-03-02. - **Wand:** bring a Frost wand to Viscidus Luden TA · 2026-03-18. - **Sets:** Frost uses the regular tier pieces. On trash, wear 3 Frost/Fire T3.5 + 3 Arcane T3.5 for Mirror Magic (+20% for Frost on rewind) Pepopo · 2026-03-11. - **Loop of Unceasing Frost** does not freeze anything (it applies a +fire-damage Frostbite debuff) and does not interact with Flash Freeze Aest · 2026-04-14.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Casting Icicles without a Flash Freeze proc Pepopo · 2026-04-10. 2. Frost Nova / Cone of Cold on raid mobs that **can** be frozen; you root them off the tank ([Mage Frost FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Frost_FAQ)). 3. Icicling while standing in AoE, or trying to cancel the root without Blink Luden TA · 2025-10-23. 4. Skipping Frostbite in a raid build. Without it only Nova can proc Flash Freeze Luden TA · 2025-10-22. 5. Letting Ice Barrier sit on cooldown; since 1.18.1 the cast itself is the damage buff Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-30. 6. Using `buff` instead of `mybuff` in the Icicles macro Pepopo · 2025-12-27. 7. Expecting Flash Freeze from Free Action Potion or Freedom targets (removed) Luden TA · 2026-03-25. 8. Taking 5/5 Winter's Chill as the only Frost mage (2-3 is enough) ([Mage Frost FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Frost_FAQ)).

enchants.heading: Enchants and consumables
enchants.markdown: - Enchants as for Fire: Presence of Sight on head/legs Aridhil · 2026-03-13, Power of the Scourge (+15 SP / 1% crit) on shoulders for Fire/Frost Aridhil · 2026-03-13, Enchanted Armor Kit on boots Aridhil · 2026-04-08, +30 Spell Damage on the weapon Boomwick · 2025-11-27. - Consumables: Flask of Supreme Power, Elixir of Greater Frost Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Dreamshard Elixir, Dreamtonic, Mageblood Potion, Spirit of Zanza, Tel'Abim food (SP), Brilliant Wizard Oil Aest · 2025-03-28, Izzo · 2025-12-21.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 decision loop. On freezable mobs (open world, dungeons, some raid trash) play the [leveling loop](#/class/mage/leveling) instead: Nova and Cone of Cold root freezable mobs away from the tank. 1. **Pre-pull:** `Ice Barrier`. Its +10% Frost damage for 60 s starts on the cast Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-30. 2. **Opener:** `Frostbolt` → `Icicles` (if Flash Freeze procs) → `Frost Nova` (if you are in melee range) → `Icicles` ZeroRanger · 2026-01-31, Luden TA · 2025-12-10. 3. **Single-target loop** (details in [Single-target rotation](#/class/mage/frost-ranged-dps)): 1. `Icicles` only while Flash Freeze is active. Never cast it without the proc. 2. `Ice Barrier` when it is off cooldown. 3. `Frost Nova` when it is off cooldown and you are in melee range of a freeze-immune boss. 4. `Cone of Cold` when you are in range. 5. `Cold Snap` to reset Nova for another Nova → Icicles pair. 6. `Frostbolt`. 4. **Cooldowns:** Ice Barrier on cooldown; Cold Snap for a second Nova, Barrier or Ice Block; on-use trinkets as in [Cooldowns and mana](#/class/mage/frost-ranged-dps). Ice Block does not drop threat oh · 2026-02-23. 5. **AoE switch** (freeze-immune packs, see [AoE rotation](#/class/mage/frost-ranged-dps)): up to 5 mobs, `Cone of Cold` → `Icicles` → `Frost Nova` → `Icicles` → `Arcane Explosion`. More than 5 mobs, `Cone of Cold` → `Arcane Explosion` spam. Never Blizzard for damage. 6. **Mana:** Frost runs dry on fast fights ** · 2025-10-19. Use mana gems and tea first and `Evocation` when low (see [Arcane: Mana](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps)). Drink between pulls. 7. **Movement:** Icicles roots you for its whole channel, and only Blink frees you, so never start it in raid AoE Aest · 2025-10-17. While moving, use the instants: `Cone of Cold`, `Frost Nova`, `Fire Blast` *(vanilla baseline)*.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for Frost
extraSections.markdown: - **Ice Barrier:** +5% Frost damage while the shield holds and +10% Frost damage for 1 minute after you cast it ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). That is 15% total while the barrier holds, the same as before, but you now keep 10% after it breaks Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-30. Players called it a minor QoL change Jûun Amelie · 2026-01-31. The buff can look like it vanished when the shield breaks; that was a pfUI display issue Luux · 2026-03-21, Luux · 2026-03-21. - Nothing else. "Frost is getting better damage, that's all" Lightemgee · 2026-03-20. Its mana problems were not addressed Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-24. - **Earlier (still relevant):** Flash Freeze no longer procs from Free Action Potion or Blessing of Freedom, because "you could just delete people" Luden TA · 2026-03-25. Ragnaros was made freeze-immune, so Flash Freeze works on him Abbe · 2025-06-17. Improved Blizzard's slow was cut hard (see [Leveling](#/class/mage/leveling)).

glance.recommendation: Frost is the **weakest raid spec** in 1.18.1. It is the best spec for **leveling, soloing and control**, and fine in early raids (MC/Onyxia/BWL). If you raid Frost, play **12/0/39**. Get **16% spell hit** (6% from Elemental Precision). Spam **Frostbolt**, cast **Icicles only when Flash Freeze procs**, **Frost Nova** freeze-immune bosses on cooldown from melee range to force procs, and recast **Ice Barrier** on cooldown for its damage buff. For raid DPS in later tiers, switch to [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps).

playbooks.title: Mage PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** in 1.18.1 play **Arcane with Ice Block ("PoM Block", 30/0/21)** for burst, or the **17/0/34 Frost/Arcane hybrid** for control and survival. Gear **Stamina** first, then **crit > spell power > haste**. Do not play a "Frostbolt turret". The 1.18.1 dampening and resilience changes cut mage burst, so mage wins with **CC**: Polymorph, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Improved Counterspell, Blink and Ice Block, with burst windows in between. Mage beats melee, struggles against hunters and shamans, and is even with warlocks. Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). | | | |---|---| | Standing (1.18.1) | **Contested.** One player says "mage is one of the best pvpers rn if u play arcane frost" ** · 2026-04-08; another calls it mid-level in BGs, "not the strongest in 1v1 but obviously very strong cc and high skill cap opportunities for outplays" Gees · 2026-04-07. Against that: "you need atleast 13-15 frostbolts to kill the average pvp geared melee class" Vent · 2026-04-07, and Cone of Cold hit for 71 at 700 SP Achylles · 2026-03-22. "Mage has shifted from a burst class to more of a control class" Vent · 2026-04-07 | | Shape of the class | "Mage farms the everliving shit out of melee and mage gets the everliving shit farmed out of it by most ranged" andre · 2025-11-18 | | Pre-1.18.1 tier lists | Shaman god tier > Rogue/Smite Priest S > **Warlock/Mage/Druid A** > Hunter/Paladin B > Warrior F Ythor · 2025-10-21; Shaman, Rogue >>> Paladin > **Mage**/Priest/Lock > Druid/Warrior > Hunter betcover · 2025-10-21 |

The linked build below was run in BGs by that poster ("i usually run this in bg") Nobo · 2025-12-07, ** · 2025-12-07. After 1.18.1: "arcane with ice block... 30/0/21. a little less tanky than deep frost but better offensively" Gees · 2026-04-05, Gees · 2026-04-07; "Go POMBLOCK even if we got heavily nerfed damage, you're still annoying in battlegrounds" Dan1tello · 2026-04-09. | Tree | Talents | |---|---| | Arcane (30) | Arcane Subtlety 2, Improved Arcane Missiles 5, Arcane Concentration 5, Magic Attunement 1, Arcane Impact 3, Arcane Rupture 1, Improved Mana Shield 2, Improved Counterspell 2, Presence of Mind 1, Accelerated Arcana 1, Arcane Potency 2, Resonance Cascade 5 | | Frost (21) | Frost Warding 2, Elemental Precision 3, Frostbite 1, Improved Frost Nova 2, Permafrost 3, Cold Snap 1, Improved Blizzard 3, Shatter 5, Ice Block 1 | Split **30/0/21**, VALID. Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage?points=QoAoLISABKAo--QYBTBDAoB` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage/CU598C07H--CI8I90V` [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=mage&t=205005131220001125--20301230130051) On low-SP realms you can try maxing Shatter or Resonance Cascade; "resonance cascade rupture is really good in wsg against efc" ** · 2025-12-07, ** · 2025-12-07. ### Frost/Arcane hybrid 17/0/34 (control) "17 pts arcane (so you can take improved counterspell) everything else in frost", keep Ice Barrier, and the playstyle "still uses a lot of arcane missiles" Gees · 2025-12-06, Gees · 2025-12-06. stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Stamina first**, then **crit > spell power > haste** Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-04. Spirit is useless in PvP, since there is no in-combat regen Nocapskibidi · 2025-10-03. "If ur like 3k hp ur probably gonna have a bad time and need to lean in to glass cannon gameplay" Gees · 2026-04-07. - **Hit:** about 3% against level-60 players Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-06. - **PvP gloves:** the new ones are sometimes preferred over Khadgar's set (−8 SP, +15 Stamina, +10 spell penetration, +4 Int) Aest · 2026-03-12. - **Spell penetration** is useful in PvP but not in PvE ([Mackylol (player), 2024-02-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=88341#p88341)). - **Trinkets:** ZHC or ToEP for the PoM burst doja · 2026-04-09. Scythe of Elune and the "of the Lost" set are common in BGs Aridhil · 2026-04-08. - Enchants and PvP consumables: the sources give no PvP-specific list (gap). Use the PvE enchants from [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps), with Stamina where you have a choice.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **Arcane burst:** `Presence of Mind` + trinket → hard-cast `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` spam. "PoM+Trinket+Arcane Rupture one shots when it crits, doubles and instability keep you going." After PoM is down, "just arcane missile bot" doja · 2026-04-09, doja · 2026-04-09. Missiles keep hitting after the target breaks line of sight: they are 30-yd channels that stay locked on, and about 1 s of exposure is enough for a full channel Zestitcha · 2025-10-23, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-10-23, Kyrsie · 2025-10-03. **Contested:** a full Rupture + Missiles kill needs about 8 s of uninterrupted free-casting lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-03. **Hybrid opener:** `Amplify Magic` on the enemy (it puts them in combat, which blocks a warrior's Charge) → rank-1 `Frostbolt` (slow, under 1 s cast) → `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` BLS · 2025-12-06, Gees · 2025-12-06. **Frost opener:** `Polymorph` → `Frost Nova` (Polymorph heals the target to full, so do not burst into it) → max-range `Frostbolt`. Use rank-1 Frostbolt to slow and open distance for the long cast Arle · 2025-11-30, Arle · 2025-11-30, Arle · 2025-11-30. **Control, not turret:** heavy Cone of Cold, Sheep, Counterspell and trinket use, then Missiles; Ice Block + Blink to reset Aridhil · 2026-04-08. Keep rank-1 Frostbolt on your bars, use Fire Ward / Frost Ward against matching casters, and Scorch other mages doja · 2026-04-09. **Target priority:** kill or CC a pure caster's damage source, then finish them; kite non-casters indefinitely Lightemgee · 2025-11-05, Lightemgee · 2025-11-05.

roleStrategy.heading: Matchups
roleStrategy.markdown: | Enemy | Plan | Sources | |---|---|---| | **Warrior** | Mage is a hard counter. Polymorph, Frost Nova, Counterspell, rank-1 Frostbolt, Blink, Ice Block. Counterspell or Amplify Magic first puts him in combat so he cannot Charge. "A warr literally cant touch a mage if u dampen magic them and deadzone their intercept." His answer is a Free Action Potion, and FAPs are expensive because of mages | Gees · 2025-12-06, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-04-08, Zestitcha · 2025-11-04, Mannenbrough · 2023-04-09 | | **Rogue** | "A skill matchup without pots"; with a Free Action Potion the rogue wins, because the FAP kills your shatter combo. Both classes have among the highest duel skill ceilings | Noctissal · 2024-08-30, Zoomer · 2023-05-02 | | **Paladin** | Kite and reset: Nova → Counterspell → Polymorph. Hand of Freedom does not stop Polymorph, so poly through Improved Freedom (15 s duration, 24 s cooldown) and burst after it. Freedom also hard-counters a deep-Frost mage's slow-based kit (Frostbite, Frost Nova, Permafrost). Dispelling Freedom is the "I WIN" button, and in duels the paladin usually loses the mana war. "Sheep and ignore" works | Afraido · 2025-11-04, Izzo · 2025-11-04, Liracrime · 2025-05-26, Dracilli · 2025-10-03, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-20 | | **Shaman** | Hard. "Shamans OS mages even on turtle". Counterspell is your win condition, since it locks out both damage and healing. Grounding Totems ping-pong your sheep, and can also silently eat a Frostbolt aimed at the shaman (it looks like your spell "redirected" to the totem). Fire/Frost Ward against his shocks | BLS · 2026-01-15, nati bati yi · 2023-03-05, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-03, doja · 2026-04-09, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-31 | | **Hunter** | Losing ("you might be SOL"). Double Multi-Shot from 41 yd deletes a mage and cannot be interrupted without hard CC. Play around the deadzone and line of sight | Lightemgee · 2025-11-05, Guthlac · 2023-06-19, Guthlac · 2023-05-05 | | **Warlock** | Roughly even and formulaic at high gear. He Spell Locks your opening Missiles or Rupture; you Ice Block through his interrupt window; a second Missiles can be met by Death Coil. At T3+ with Scythe, one completed Missiles channel can win. Warlocks often don't expect PoM Rupture. A lock with his Felhunter out has no defensive left if someone else joins | lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-21, Aridhil · 2026-03-22, Lightemgee · 2025-11-05 | | **Druid (feral)** | You usually lose 1v1: low mage HP, plus the post-shift stun after he breaks Polymorph. Trinket, get distance and hope for crits. mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Playing a Frostbolt turret into dampening and resilience Aridhil · 2026-04-08. 2. Bursting into your own Polymorph; it heals the target to full Arle · 2025-11-30. 3. Trading ranged damage with hunters in the open Guthlac · 2023-06-19. 4. Letting a warrior Charge you: Counterspell or Amplify Magic first Gees · 2025-12-06. 5. Blinking early against druids; save the trinket for the Bash DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07. 6. Going into PvP with ~3k HP and PvE glass-cannon gear, then trying to play control Gees · 2026-04-07.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop. Details are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp), [Builds](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp). Mage wins with control and short burst windows, not as a Frostbolt turret Aridhil · 2026-04-08. **Arcane, PoM Block 30/0/21 (burst):** 1. **Opener (range):** `Presence of Mind` (3 min) + ZHC/ToEP trinket → instant `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` spam doja · 2026-04-09. Cast PoM on its own, not in a macro Ocra · 2026-03-05. 2. **Burst:** after PoM, keep Rupture up (15 s cooldown) and "arcane missile bot" doja · 2026-04-09. Missiles keep hitting through broken line of sight once locked on Zestitcha · 2025-10-23. A hard-cast kill needs about 8 s of free casting (**Contested**) lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-03, so land CC first. 3. **Control chain:** `Polymorph` one target, `Frost Nova` (25 s) and `Cone of Cold` (10 s) to peel melee, `Counterspell` (30 s; Improved Counterspell adds a silence, vanilla baseline) a caster's key cast Aridhil · 2026-04-08. Never damage your own Polymorph target; it heals to full Arle · 2025-11-30. 4. **Defence/escape:** `Blink` (15 s) out of stuns and melee; `Ice Block` (5 min) is full immunity but does not drop threat oh · 2026-02-23; `Cold Snap` (10 min) resets Frost Nova, Cone of Cold and Ice Block (vanilla baseline). Fire Ward / Frost Ward against matching casters doja · 2026-04-09. Arcane is "bursty but super squishy" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-17: burst one or two targets, then get out ZeroRanger · 2025-11-28. **Frost/Arcane hybrid 17/0/34 (control):** 1. **Opener (range):** `Amplify Magic` on the enemy (puts him in combat, so a warrior cannot Charge) → rank-1 `Frostbolt` (quick slow: 1.5 s base cast, shorter with Improved Frostbolt) → `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` BLS · 2025-12-06, Gees · 2025-12-06. Frost alternative: `Polymorph` → `Frost Nova` → max-range rank-11 `Frostbolt` (3 s base cast) Arle · 2025-11-30. 2. **Loop:** `Ice Barrier` (30 s) up before and during the fight (vanilla baseline) → rank-1 Frostbolt to keep the slow → Rupture/Missiles in each window you get Gees · 2025-12-06. 3. **Control and defence:** as Arcane above; this build keeps Ice Barrier on top of Ice Block and Cold Snap Gees · 2025-12-06, and trades burst for survival (deep Arcane is "better offensively" but less tanky) Gees · 2026-04-05. **Both specs:** - **Target priority:** Counterspell or CC the pure caster's damage source, then burst him; kite non-casters "forever" Lightemgee · 2025-11-05. Against a healer + DPS, Polymorph the healer and burst the DPS (vanilla baseline). In team fights your value is CC, Improved Counterspell and Ice Blocks Gees · 2026-04-07. - **Reset/drink:** Ice Block + Blink to break a bad fight Aridhil · 2026-04-08. Spirit is useless because there is no in-combat regen Nocapskibidi · 2025-10-03, so drink or Evocate (8 min) only out of combat or behind line of sight (vanilla baseline). **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp)): - **Warrior:** Counterspell/Amplify Magic first so he cannot Charge; Nova, kite, rank-1 Frostbolt Gees · 2025-12-06. - **Rogue:** skill matchup; his Free Action Potion breaks your shatter combo Noctissal · 2024-08-30. - **Paladin:** Polymorph through Freedom, burst after it ends Afraido · 2025-11-04. - **Shaman:** hard ("shamans OS mages") BLS · 2026-01-15; Counterspell locks out his damage and healing nati bati yi · 2023-03-05; watch Grounding Totem. - **Hunter:** losing Lightemgee · 2025-11-05; play the deadzone and line of sight Guthlac · 2023-05-05, Mmr · 2023-05-05. - **Warlock:** even; Ice Block through his Spell Lock window lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-21. - **Feral druid:** Blink out of Pounce and save the trinket for his Bash DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for PvP
extraSections.markdown: - **Dampening** became class- and spec-dependent, and the numbers were never published ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). Many players "wanted to get away from the burst meta" Luden TA · 2026-04-07. - **Resilience** on the new PvP gear reduces spell crit damage too, not only melee Vent · 2026-04-08. Since December 2025 it reduces the whole critical hit, not just the bonus part, so the older bug report #17804 ("only the crit portion", about half as effective) no longer applies ([Torta (staff), 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161356#p161356), Grey · 2026-03-20). Details: [PvP systems → Dampening and resilience](#/pvp). - **The PvP gear and points system was overhauled.** The new top set is "insane", though old rank 13/14 grinders felt shortchanged Aest · 2026-03-28, Gees · 2026-03-28. Before this, even R14 players wore PvE T3/T3.5 in BGs BLS · 2025-12-29. - **Earlier nerfs that still shape Frost:** the Shatter nerf, and Flash Freeze no longer procs off Free Action Potion or Freedom ("you could just delete people") ** · 2025-12-06, Luden TA · 2026-03-25.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **Flag carrier:** "Pretty strong flag carrier if you have fap" Gees · 2026-04-07. One premade (1 Rogue, 2 Priests, 2 Mages) claims to win every WSG with a mage carrying Grillbe · 2025-10-20. Even outnumbered, a Frost mage can Ice Block and spin the flag rather than die immediately: "how is anyone winning a 7v1? you can ice block and spin the flag as a frost mage" Kyrsie · 2025-10-20. - **Team fights:** "good usage of cc, improved counterspell, and iceblocks makes for strong utility in team fights" Gees · 2026-04-07. Rupture + Resonance Cascade bursts the enemy flag carrier ** · 2025-12-07. - **Leveling in BGs** is viable and gives strong XP Beta · 2026-03-29.

extraSections.heading: Races for PvP
extraSections.markdown: - **Undead:** Will of the Forsaken, plus a flat 2% damage against Undead and Humans Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-04-15. **Gnome:** Escape Artist Kairion · 2022-11-19. **Orc/Troll** are the top PvE-damage picks, but the same source favors **Gnome/Dwarf**'s defensive racials for PvP dindunuffinz · 2025-12-07. **Human:** Perception now shares the GCD, which weakens it Lightemgee · 2025-11-04. See [the overview](#/class/mage) for PvE.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - **Ice Block / Cold Snap toggle** (Lua): casts Cold Snap if Ice Block is on cooldown, otherwise Ice Block, or cancels Ice Block if it is up Goajos · 2025-06-16. - **Ice Block cancel-and-recast:** `/stopcasting` `/cancelaura Ice Block` `/stopcasting` `/cast Ice Block` ([Mage General FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_General_FAQ)). - **Moving Surge:** `/cast [reactive:Arcane_Surge]Arcane Surge;Fire Blast` Pepopo · 2025-12-28. - **PoM + Rupture:** cast PoM on its own; macroed with another spell it often fails Ocra · 2026-03-05.

glance.recommendation: In 1.18.1 play **Arcane with Ice Block ("PoM Block", 30/0/21)** for burst, or the **17/0/34 Frost/Arcane hybrid** for control and survival. Gear **Stamina** first, then **crit > spell power > haste**. Do not play a "Frostbolt turret". The 1.18.1 dampening and resilience changes cut mage burst, so mage wins with **CC**: Polymorph, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Improved Counterspell, Blink and Ice Block, with burst windows in between. Mage beats melee, struggles against hunters and shamans, and is even with warlocks.
