One poster calls it "only good vs same opponents" dindunuffinz · 2025-10-20.

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Stamina first**, then **crit > spell power > haste** Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-04. Spirit is useless in PvP, since there is no in-combat regen Nocapskibidi · 2025-10-03. "If ur like 3k hp ur probably gonna have a bad time and need to lean in to glass cannon gameplay" Gees · 2026-04-07. - **Hit:** about 3% against level-60 players Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-06. - **PvP gloves:** the new ones are sometimes preferred over Khadgar's set (−8 SP, +15 Stamina, +10 spell penetration, +4 Int) Aest · 2026-03-12. - **Spell penetration** is useful in PvP but not in PvE ([Mackylol (player), 2024-02-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=88341#p88341)). - **Trinkets:** ZHC or ToEP for the PoM burst doja · 2026-04-09. Scythe of Elune and the "of the Lost" set are common in BGs Aridhil · 2026-04-08. - Enchants and PvP consumables: the sources give no PvP-specific list (gap). Use the PvE enchants from [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps), with Stamina where you have a choice.

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **Arcane burst:** `Presence of Mind` + trinket → hard-cast `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` spam. "PoM+Trinket+Arcane Rupture one shots when it crits, doubles and instability keep you going." After PoM is down, "just arcane missile bot" doja · 2026-04-09, doja · 2026-04-09. Missiles keep hitting after the target breaks line of sight: they are 30-yd channels that stay locked on, and about 1 s of exposure is enough for a full channel Zestitcha · 2025-10-23, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-10-23, Kyrsie · 2025-10-03. **Contested:** a full Rupture + Missiles kill needs about 8 s of uninterrupted free-casting lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-03. **Hybrid opener:** `Amplify Magic` on the enemy (it puts them in combat, which blocks a warrior's Charge) → rank-1 `Frostbolt` (slow, under 1 s cast) → `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` BLS · 2025-12-06, Gees · 2025-12-06. **Frost opener:** `Polymorph` → `Frost Nova` (Polymorph heals the target to full, so do not burst into it) → max-range `Frostbolt`. Use rank-1 Frostbolt to slow and open distance for the long cast Arle · 2025-11-30, Arle · 2025-11-30, Arle · 2025-11-30. **Control, not turret:** heavy Cone of Cold, Sheep, Counterspell and trinket use, then Missiles; Ice Block + Blink to reset Aridhil · 2026-04-08. Keep rank-1 Frostbolt on your bars, use Fire Ward / Frost Ward against matching casters, and Scorch other mages doja · 2026-04-09. **Target priority:** kill or CC a pure caster's damage source, then finish them; kite non-casters indefinitely Lightemgee · 2025-11-05, Lightemgee · 2025-11-05.

roleStrategy.heading: Matchups
roleStrategy.markdown: | Enemy | Plan | Sources | |---|---|---| | **Warrior** | Mage is a hard counter. Polymorph, Frost Nova, Counterspell, rank-1 Frostbolt, Blink, Ice Block. Counterspell or Amplify Magic first puts him in combat so he cannot Charge. "A warr literally cant touch a mage if u dampen magic them and deadzone their intercept." His answer is a Free Action Potion, and FAPs are expensive because of mages | Gees · 2025-12-06, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-04-08, Zestitcha · 2025-11-04, Mannenbrough · 2023-04-09 | | **Rogue** | "A skill matchup without pots"; with a Free Action Potion the rogue wins, because the FAP kills your shatter combo. Both classes have among the highest duel skill ceilings | Noctissal · 2024-08-30, Zoomer · 2023-05-02 | | **Paladin** | Kite and reset: Nova → Counterspell → Polymorph. Hand of Freedom does not stop Polymorph, so poly through Improved Freedom (15 s duration, 24 s cooldown) and burst after it. Freedom also hard-counters a deep-Frost mage's slow-based kit (Frostbite, Frost Nova, Permafrost). Dispelling Freedom is the "I WIN" button, and in duels the paladin usually loses the mana war. "Sheep and ignore" works | Afraido · 2025-11-04, Izzo · 2025-11-04, Liracrime · 2025-05-26, Dracilli · 2025-10-03, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-20 | | **Shaman** | Hard. "Shamans OS mages even on turtle". Counterspell is your win condition, since it locks out both damage and healing. Grounding Totems ping-pong your sheep, and can also silently eat a Frostbolt aimed at the shaman (it looks like your spell "redirected" to the totem). Fire/Frost Ward against his shocks | BLS · 2026-01-15, nati bati yi · 2023-03-05, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-03, doja · 2026-04-09, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-31 | | **Hunter** | Losing ("you might be SOL"). Double Multi-Shot from 41 yd deletes a mage and cannot be interrupted without hard CC. Play around the deadzone and line of sight | Lightemgee · 2025-11-05, Guthlac · 2023-06-19, Guthlac · 2023-05-05 | | **Warlock** | Roughly even and formulaic at high gear. He Spell Locks your opening Missiles or Rupture; you Ice Block through his interrupt window; a second Missiles can be met by Death Coil. At T3+ with Scythe, one completed Missiles channel can win. Warlocks often don't expect PoM Rupture. A lock with his Felhunter out has no defensive left if someone else joins | lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-21, Aridhil · 2026-03-22, Lightemgee · 2025-11-05 | | **Druid (feral)** | You usually lose 1v1: low mage HP, plus the post-shift stun after he breaks Polymorph. Trinket, get distance and hope for crits. Never let him pounce you; Blink out and save the trinket for his Bash | A Wro · 2025-11-05, Lightemgee · 2025-11-05, DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07 | | **Mage** | Scorch other mages doja · 2026-04-09. An enemy's Arcane Reflector can kill a channeling mage with reflected Missiles, or bounce a Polymorph back Jesse Potter · 2025-10-19 | |

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Playing a Frostbolt turret into dampening and resilience Aridhil · 2026-04-08. 2. Bursting into your own Polymorph; it heals the target to full Arle · 2025-11-30. 3. Trading ranged damage with hunters in the open Guthlac · 2023-06-19. 4. Letting a warrior Charge you: Counterspell or Amplify Magic first Gees · 2025-12-06. 5. Blinking early against druids; save the trinket for the Bash DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07. 6. Going into PvP with ~3k HP and PvE glass-cannon gear, then trying to play control Gees · 2026-04-07.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop. Details are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp), [Builds](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp). Mage wins with control and short burst windows, not as a Frostbolt turret Aridhil · 2026-04-08. **Arcane, PoM Block 30/0/21 (burst):** 1. **Opener (range):** `Presence of Mind` (3 min) + ZHC/ToEP trinket → instant `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` spam doja · 2026-04-09. Cast PoM on its own, not in a macro Ocra · 2026-03-05. 2. **Burst:** after PoM, keep Rupture up (15 s cooldown) and "arcane missile bot" doja · 2026-04-09. Missiles keep hitting through broken line of sight once locked on Zestitcha · 2025-10-23. A hard-cast kill needs about 8 s of free casting (**Contested**) lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-03, so land CC first. 3. **Control chain:** `Polymorph` one target, `Frost Nova` (25 s) and `Cone of Cold` (10 s) to peel melee, `Counterspell` (30 s; Improved Counterspell adds a silence, vanilla baseline) a caster's key cast Aridhil · 2026-04-08. Never damage your own Polymorph target; it heals to full Arle · 2025-11-30. 4. **Defence/escape:** `Blink` (15 s) out of stuns and melee; `Ice Block` (5 min) is full immunity but does not drop threat oh · 2026-02-23; `Cold Snap` (10 min) resets Frost Nova, Cone of Cold and Ice Block (vanilla baseline). Fire Ward / Frost Ward against matching casters doja · 2026-04-09. Arcane is "bursty but super squishy" Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-17: burst one or two targets, then get out ZeroRanger · 2025-11-28. **Frost/Arcane hybrid 17/0/34 (control):** 1. **Opener (range):** `Amplify Magic` on the enemy (puts him in combat, so a warrior cannot Charge) → rank-1 `Frostbolt` (quick slow: 1.5 s base cast, shorter with Improved Frostbolt) → `Arcane Rupture` → `Arcane Missiles` BLS · 2025-12-06, Gees · 2025-12-06. Frost alternative: `Polymorph` → `Frost Nova` → max-range rank-11 `Frostbolt` (3 s base cast) Arle · 2025-11-30. 2. **Loop:** `Ice Barrier` (30 s) up before and during the fight (vanilla baseline) → rank-1 Frostbolt to keep the slow → Rupture/Missiles in each window you get Gees · 2025-12-06. 3. **Control and defence:** as Arcane above; this build keeps Ice Barrier on top of Ice Block and Cold Snap Gees · 2025-12-06, and trades burst for survival (deep Arcane is "better offensively" but less tanky) Gees · 2026-04-05. **Both specs:** - **Target priority:** Counterspell or CC the pure caster's damage source, then burst him; kite non-casters "forever" Lightemgee · 2025-11-05. Against a healer + DPS, Polymorph the healer and burst the DPS (vanilla baseline). In team fights your value is CC, Improved Counterspell and Ice Blocks Gees · 2026-04-07. - **Reset/drink:** Ice Block + Blink to break a bad fight Aridhil · 2026-04-08. Spirit is useless because there is no in-combat regen Nocapskibidi · 2025-10-03, so drink or Evocate (8 min) only out of combat or behind line of sight (vanilla baseline). **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/mage/arcane-pvp)): - **Warrior:** Counterspell/Amplify Magic first so he cannot Charge; Nova, kite, rank-1 Frostbolt Gees · 2025-12-06. - **Rogue:** skill matchup; his Free Action Potion breaks your shatter combo Noctissal · 2024-08-30. - **Paladin:** Polymorph through Freedom, burst after it ends Afraido · 2025-11-04. - **Shaman:** hard ("shamans OS mages") BLS · 2026-01-15; Counterspell locks out his damage and healing nati bati yi · 2023-03-05; watch Grounding Totem. - **Hunter:** losing Lightemgee · 2025-11-05; play the deadzone and line of sight Guthlac · 2023-05-05, Mmr · 2023-05-05. - **Warlock:** even; Ice Block through his Spell Lock window lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-21. - **Feral druid:** Blink out of Pounce and save the trinket for his Bash DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed for PvP
extraSections.markdown: - **Dampening** became class- and spec-dependent, and the numbers were never published ([Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). Many players "wanted to get away from the burst meta" Luden TA · 2026-04-07. - **Resilience** on the new PvP gear reduces spell crit damage too, not only melee Vent · 2026-04-08. Since December 2025 it reduces the whole critical hit, not just the bonus part, so the older bug report #17804 ("only the crit portion", about half as effective) no longer applies ([Torta (staff), 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161356#p161356), Grey · 2026-03-20). Details: [PvP systems → Dampening and resilience](#/pvp). - **The PvP gear and points system was overhauled.** The new top set is "insane", though old rank 13/14 grinders felt shortchanged Aest · 2026-03-28, Gees · 2026-03-28. Before this, even R14 players wore PvE T3/T3.5 in BGs BLS · 2025-12-29. - **Earlier nerfs that still shape Frost:** the Shatter nerf, and Flash Freeze no longer procs off Free Action Potion or Freedom ("you could just delete people") ** · 2025-12-06, Luden TA · 2026-03-25.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **Flag carrier:** "Pretty strong flag carrier if you have fap" Gees · 2026-04-07. One premade (1 Rogue, 2 Priests, 2 Mages) claims to win every WSG with a mage carrying Grillbe · 2025-10-20. Even outnumbered, a Frost mage can Ice Block and spin the flag rather than die immediately: "how is anyone winning a 7v1? you can ice block and spin the flag as a frost mage" Kyrsie · 2025-10-20. - **Team fights:** "good usage of cc, improved counterspell, and iceblocks makes for strong utility in team fights" Gees · 2026-04-07. Rupture + Resonance Cascade bursts the enemy flag carrier ** · 2025-12-07. - **Leveling in BGs** is viable and gives strong XP Beta · 2026-03-29.

extraSections.heading: Races for PvP
extraSections.markdown: - **Undead:** Will of the Forsaken, plus a flat 2% damage against Undead and Humans Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-04-15. **Gnome:** Escape Artist Kairion · 2022-11-19. **Orc/Troll** are the top PvE-damage picks, but the same source favors **Gnome/Dwarf**'s defensive racials for PvP dindunuffinz · 2025-12-07. **Human:** Perception now shares the GCD, which weakens it Lightemgee · 2025-11-04. See [the overview](#/class/mage) for PvE.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - **Ice Block / Cold Snap toggle** (Lua): casts Cold Snap if Ice Block is on cooldown, otherwise Ice Block, or cancels Ice Block if it is up Goajos · 2025-06-16. - **Ice Block cancel-and-recast:** `/stopcasting` `/cancelaura Ice Block` `/stopcasting` `/cast Ice Block` ([Mage General FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_General_FAQ)). - **Moving Surge:** `/cast [reactive:Arcane_Surge]Arcane Surge;Fire Blast` Pepopo · 2025-12-28. - **PoM + Rupture:** cast PoM on its own; macroed with another spell it often fails Ocra · 2026-03-05.

glance.recommendation: In 1.18.1 play **Arcane with Ice Block ("PoM Block", 30/0/21)** for burst, or the **17/0/34 Frost/Arcane hybrid** for control and survival. Gear **Stamina** first, then **crit > spell power > haste**. Do not play a "Frostbolt turret". The 1.18.1 dampening and resilience changes cut mage burst, so mage wins with **CC**: Polymorph, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold, Improved Counterspell, Blink and Ice Block, with burst windows in between. Mage beats melee, struggles against hunters and shamans, and is even with warlocks.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level as **Frost**. It is the safest spec (quick-cooldown CC, you can kite almost anything) and the default for Hardcore. At 60, respec to [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps) for raids. Train spells from **all three schools**, buy a **wand** early, and gear **Intellect, Stamina and spell power**. Ignore hit until you fight mobs 3 levels above you. Arcane becomes good at level **24** (Arcane Missiles rank 3) and is a fine choice for dungeon-heavy leveling from ~30. Blizzard AoE grinding no longer works on Turtle; AoE farming now means **Frost Nova → Flamestrike → Cone of Cold → Arcane Explosion** kiting.

sections.heading: Which spec to level
sections.markdown: | Spec | Verdict | Sources | |---|---|---| | **Frost** | **Default.** Easy (one main spell), safe (quick CC), strong solo ("you can kite any mob indefinitely"), but slower kills | LoveSpongez · 2025-12-26, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-12-26; "for HC frost will be the safest pick" Valaen · 2026-03-21; "the chill spec to level" BLS · 2026-02-01 | | **Arcane** | Viable, but squishy and mana-hungry early. It picks up at **24**, when Arcane Missiles rank 3 does 280 total damage vs 144 for rank 2 Valaen · 2026-03-20, Sellma · 2026-03-16. Level Fire or Frost "until at least level 24" Valaen · 2026-02-17; the talents reachable around 35-40 are "what will really make it fun" Luden TA · 2026-02-21. One adviser would not go Arcane "until like 30/40" andre · 2025-12-26. In 35-60 dungeons its mana pool is too small, so Frost or Fire are preferred there Beta · 2026-01-30 | as cited | | **Fire** | Fun, gets higher Fireball ranks earlier and has longer range, but is crit-dependent, and crit is scarce at low level Bigmagik Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-11, Simbuca · 2026-01-03. Good for normal-sized dungeon pulls Beta · 2026-01-30 | as cited | A simple rule from the channel: dying too much → Frost single target; kills too slow → Fire; want to AoE-grind → Frost AoE andre · 2025-12-26. "All 3 can work fine" Valaen · 2026-03-20. **At 60:** if you will quest, dungeon and PvP, stay deep Frost Luden TA · 2026-04-10. If you go straight into raiding, go full Arcane.

sections.heading: Talent order: Frost (10-60)

Frostbite 3/3 + Permafrost 3/3 by level 20 is the first big spike ("you'll have the easiest time of your life killing mobs sometimes before they even get to you") ** · 2026-01-19. sections.heading: Talent order: Arcane (10-60, ends in the raid build)
sections.markdown: Use this if you level Arcane from the start, or if you respec into it (at level N, place the first N−9 points of this table). sections.heading: Talent order: Fire (10-60, ends in the Fire raid build)
sections.markdown: This is the wiki Fire FAQ path in its own order: Improved Fireball > Elemental Precision > Burning Soul > Arcane Concentration as early priorities, and "you don't need to put ANY points into Arcane focus" ([Mage Fire FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Fire_FAQ)). The wiki leaves the last 5 points free; here they finish the [Fire raid build](#/class/mage/fire-ranged-dps) (Improved Fire Blast, Flame Throwing) Supermongo · 2025-09-17. sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: What to press, bracket by bracket, for the **Frost** leveling path above. Learn levels, mana costs, cooldowns and cast times come from the 1.18.1 game data. Talents follow the [Frost talent order](#/class/mage/leveling). The [Arcane](#/class/mage/leveling) and [Fire](#/class/mage/leveling) paths are summarised after the Frost brackets. Mages cannot heal, and dungeon tanking is a novelty (see [Mage tanking](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps)), so there are no tank or heal lists here. In dungeons you are DPS and the group's water. Talent effects marked *(vanilla baseline)* are the classic tooltips. Check the in-game tooltip for Turtle's numbers. ### Levels 1–9 - **New now:** Fireball and Frost Armor rank 1 at level 1 *(vanilla baseline: starting spells)*. L1 Arcane Intellect. L4 Frostbolt R1 (25 mana, 1.5 s cast), Conjure Water R1. L6 Fireball R2 (45 mana, 2.0 s), Fire Blast R1 (instant, 8 s cooldown, 20 yd), Conjure Food R1. L8 Frostbolt R2 (1.8 s), Arcane Missiles R1, Polymorph R1. - **Single target:** 1. `Frostbolt` from max range to slow the mob. At these levels Frostbolt is the slow and Fireball is the damage gray · 2026-04-04. Fireball gets new ranks sooner than Frostbolt Luden TA · 2025-10-07. 2. `Fireball` until the mob reaches you ** · 2026-01-18. 3. `Fire Blast` as it closes or to finish, then wand Kolima · 2026-03-16. At these levels a good wand can hit harder than your spells Lightemgee · 2026-04-04. 4. Eat and drink together after every fight or two ** · 2026-01-19, Klurifax · 2024-12-16. - **Multi-target:** avoid it. Early on a mage "lacks the tools to kite" Lightemgee · 2026-04-04. If two mobs come, `Polymorph` one and kill the other limbless · 2026-04-04. ### Levels 10–19 - **New now:** L10 Frost Nova R1 (55 mana, 25 s cooldown, 8 s root), Frost Armor R2, Conjure Water R2. L12 Fireball R3, Conjure Food R2. L14 Frostbolt R3 (2.2 s), Arcane Explosion R1 (75 mana), Fire Blast R2. L16 Flamestrike R1 (195 mana, 2.5 s), Arcane Missiles R2. L18 Fireball R4. Talents: Improved Frostbolt 10-14 (shorter Frostbolt cast, *vanilla baseline*), Frostbite 15-17 (chill effects can freeze, *vanilla baseline*), Permafrost from 18. - **Single target:** once Improved Frostbolt is in, Frostbolt becomes the main button. 1. `Frostbolt` from max range. Cast 1-2 more while the mob walks in Kolima · 2026-03-16. 2. When it reaches melee range: `Frost Nova` (rank 1), walk back to max range and start casting again ** · 2026-01-19. Rank 1 is the only Nova you ever need Luden TA · 2025-08-06. 3. `Frostbolt` until it is low, then `Fire Blast` or wand to finish. 4. Taking a few hits is fine. You get the health back while you drink ** · 2026-01-19. - **Multi-target (2 mobs):** `Polymorph` the second mob, then run the single-target loop. Arcane Explosion AoE is possible from 14 if you bring enough mana and health items, but it is hard before Cone of Cold Flannery · 2025-02-17. ### Levels 20–29 - **New now:** L20 Frostbolt R4 (65 mana, 2.6 s), Blink (15 s cooldown), Evocation (8 min cooldown), Mana Shield R1, Frost Armor R3, Polymorph R2, Blizzard R1, Conjure Water R3, teleports. L22 Arcane Explosion R2 (120), Scorch R1, Fire Blast R3, Frost Ward, Conjure Food R3. L24 Counterspell (30 s), Flamestrike R2 (250), Fireball R5, Arcane Missiles R3. **L26 Cone of Cold R1** (210 mana, 10 s cooldown), Frost Nova R2, Frostbolt R5 (the game data already gives rank 5 a 3.0 s base cast). L28 Conjure Mana Agate (first mana gem), Blizzard R2, Mana Shield R2, Arcane Intellect R3. Talents: Permafrost 3/3 at 20, which with 3/3 Frostbite is the first big spike ** · 2026-01-19. Improved Frost Nova 21-22, Ice Shards 23-27, Shatter 28-29. - **Single target:** 1. `Frostbolt` ×1-2 from max range. 2. `Frost Nova` in melee range. From 28, with Shatter, follow it with a `Frostbolt` or `Fire Blast` into the frozen mob for the frozen-target crit bonus *(vanilla baseline mechanic)*. You can Shatter single mobs too Pinkkee 🐹 · 2025-08-28. 3. Walk to range and `Frostbolt`. If the mob breaks free and Nova is down, use `Cone of Cold` rank 1 as a cheap slow ([Mage Levelling FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Levelling_FAQ)). 4. Finish with `Fire Blast` or wand. 5. Emergency: `Blink` away. `Counterspell` a caster's heal or big spell. 6. Out of mana with a mob still up: `Evocation`, which restores mana over 8 s on its 8-minute cooldown. - **Multi-target (from 26):** start the [AoE loop](#/class/mage/leveling) on 3+ mobs you can gather. Before 26, keep pulls to 1-2 mobs. With Blizzard alone, "mobs just close the distance too fast" JohnnyRoten · 2025-12-31, and Blizzard-kiting is dead Izzo · 2025-11-08. ### Levels 30–39 - **New now:** L30 **Ice Block** (talent), Ice Armor R1, Arcane Explosion R3 (185), Fire Blast R4, Fireball R6, Conjure Water R4. L31 **Cold Snap** (talent, 10 min cooldown). L32 Frostbolt R6, Flamestrike R3 (360), Arcane Surge R1 (usable for a few seconds after one of your spells is resisted), Frost Ward R2, Conjure Food R4. L34 Cone of Cold R2, Mage Armor R1, Scorch R3. L36 Blizzard R3, Mana Shield R3. L38 Frostbolt R7, Arcane Explosion R4 (250), Fire Blast R5, Conjure Mana Jade. Talents: Shatter 3-5 at 32-34, Frost Channeling 35-37, Elemental Precision 38-39. - **Single target:** same as 20-29, plus: - Armor: `Ice Armor` by default, `Mage Armor` against casters PaulGreenEye · 2024-02-11. - If a fight goes bad: `Blink` → `Ice Block` → `Cold Snap` to reset Nova and Block (from 31). - **Multi-target:** AoE farming is fully online now. Dabyrie's Farmstead (Arathi) is the usual 30-36 spot ultratronger · 2025-04-13. Pull only what one Nova plus Cone of Cold cycle can control. Keep Ice Block and Cold Snap for the pull that goes wrong. ### Levels 40–49 - **New now:** L40 **Ice Barrier** (talent, 30 s cooldown), Frost Nova R3 (keep rank 1 on your bar), Flamestrike R4 (470), Ice Armor R2, Polymorph R3, Conjure Water R5, portals. L42 Cone of Cold R3 (380), Fireball R8, Arcane Intellect R4, Conjure Food R5. L44 Frostbolt R8, Blizzard R4. L46 Arcane Explosion R5 (315), Ice Barrier R2, Mage Armor R2, Fire Blast R6. L48 Flamestrike R5 (580), Conjure Mana Citrine. Talents: Elemental Precision 3/3 at 41, Arctic Reach 42-43, Piercing Ice 44-46, Improved Cone of Cold 47-49. - **Single target:** 1. `Ice Barrier` before the pull, and again whenever it is off cooldown. Against mobs that will not break it (ranged mobs), rank 1 saves mana and still gives the damage bonus jc473 · 2025-01-21. 2. `Frostbolt` ×1-2 → `Frost Nova` (rank 1) → Shatter `Frostbolt` → walk → `Frostbolt` → `Cone of Cold` if it breaks free → `Fire Blast` or wand to finish. 3. Do not use Icicles while leveling. Its self-root is dangerous, and it is only good on freeze-immune targets ([Mage Frost FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Frost_FAQ)), Pepopo · 2025-02-06. - **Multi-target:** the AoE loop with bigger pulls. Cast Ice Barrier before you gather. ### Levels 50–60 - **New now:** L50 Cone of Cold R4 (465), Frostbolt R9, Ice Armor R3, Conjure Water R6. L52 Ice Barrier R3, Blizzard R5, Mana Shield R5, Conjure Food R6. L54 Arcane Explosion R6 (390), Frost Nova R4, Fire Blast R7, Fireball R10. L56 Frostbolt R10, Flamestrike R6 (680), Arcane Intellect R5, Arcane Brilliance (tome). L58 Cone of Cold R5 (555), Ice Barrier R4, Mage Armor R3, Conjure Mana Ruby. L60 Conjure Water R7 (quest), Ritual of Refreshment (tome), Frostbolt R11 and Fireball R12 (tomes). Talents: Arcane Subtlety 50-51, Magic Absorption 52-54, Arcane Concentration 55-59 (Clearcasting procs make the next spell free, *vanilla baseline*). - **Single target:** same as 40-49. Spend Clearcasting procs on your most expensive spell (a max-rank Frostbolt, or Cone of Cold in AoE) *(vanilla baseline)*. - **Multi-target:** Dire Maul East lashers from about 54 (see [the lasher farm](#/class/mage/leveling)). At 60, respec for raids ([Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps), [Fire](#/class/mage/fire-ranged-dps)). ### AoE farming by level The loop itself is in [AoE farming](#/class/mage/leveling): `Frost Nova` → `Flamestrike` → `Cone of Cold` → kite in a circle with `Arcane Explosion` → repeat. The table gives the ranks to use and the mana for one cycle, totalled from the game data. | Level | Loop | Ranks (mana) | One cycle (Nova + Flamestrike + Cone + 4 Explosions) | |---|---|---|---| | 14-25 | 1-3 mobs only: `Frost Nova` → `Arcane Explosion` ×2-3 → walk away → repeat when Nova is back. Possible but hard before Cone of Cold Flannery · 2025-02-17 | Nova R1 (55), Explosion R1-R2 (75/120); Flamestrike R1-R2 (195/250) from 16 | about 300-400 (Nova + 3 Explosions) | | 26-33 | The full loop. `Frost Nova` rank 1 → `Flamestrike` timed to land just before Nova breaks → `Cone of Cold` as they break free → circle-kite with Explosion → Cone again on cooldown limbless · 2024-11-26, biloen · 2025-02-02 | Nova R1 (55), Flamestrike R2 (250), Cone R1 (210), Explosion R2-R3 (120/185) | about 1,000 | | 34-41 | Same. Drop a rank only when mana is short, or in a group with a weak tank sosqua9- · 2026-03-30. - **Flamestrike:** use the highest rank that still leaves mana for the Cone of Cold and Explosions of the same cycle Aridhil · 2026-04-08. - **Before the pull,** check that your mana covers at least one full cycle from the table. If you run low mid-pull, stop nuking and kite in slows: permanent chill lets you kite until Nova is back biloen · 2025-02-02. - **Clearcasting** (from 55): spend it on Cone of Cold or a max-rank Explosion *(vanilla baseline)*. ### Conjuring and drinking | Level | Conjure | Note | |---|---|---| | 4 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 | Conjure Water R1-R6 | Recast each time you train a rank. **Always use rank 1 Frost Nova** Luden TA · 2025-08-06.
**Use max-rank Arcane Explosion** for damage. Drop a rank only when mana is short, or in a group with a weak tank sosqua9- · 2026-03-30.
**Flamestrike:** use the highest rank that still leaves mana for the Cone of Cold and Explosions of the same cycle Aridhil · 2026-04-08.

sections.heading: The pull and kill loop
sections.markdown: **Frost / general (bot-ready):** 1. Pull with `Frostbolt` from max range. Cast 1-2 more if the mob is slow to arrive Kolima · 2026-03-16, ** · 2026-01-18. 2. When the mob reaches melee: `Frost Nova`, then walk to max range ** · 2026-01-19. 3. `Frostbolt` again. If it breaks free early and Nova is down, use `Cone of Cold` (rank 1 to save mana) ([Mage Levelling FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Levelling_FAQ)). 4. Finish with `Fire Blast` (instant) or a wand shot when it is low Kolima · 2026-03-16. 5. If a fight goes bad: `Blink` away, then `Ice Block` (from 30), `Cold Snap` to reset. 6. Eat and drink together after the fight. "Mage is mostly about drinking and eating early game" ** · 2026-01-19. **Fire:** `Fireball` spam, `Fire Blast` while moving or to finish, `Frost Nova` and walk if the mob reaches you ([Mage Levelling FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Levelling_FAQ)). **Arcane:** `Arcane Missiles` is your main button (Improved Arcane Missiles removes pushback). Open with `Arcane Rupture` only on high-HP mobs, since it costs a lot of mana ([Mage Levelling FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Levelling_FAQ)). Up to the 50s it plays as an "Arcane Missiles turret" limbless · 2026-04-20. **Getting hit is fine** ** · 2026-01-19. Early on the mage "lacks the tools to kite"; later you handle 3-4 mobs at once Lightemgee · 2026-04-04. At very low levels Frostbolt is mainly the slow and Fireball the damage gray · 2026-04-04. Polymorph one mob when you fight two limbless · 2026-04-04.

sections.heading: AoE farming
sections.markdown: **What changed:** Improved Blizzard's slow was cut repeatedly, and mobs now walk through the Blizzard before it finishes. "Blizzard is dead, coc is alive" Izzo · 2025-11-08, Saedar · 2025-12-28. With Permafrost, 3/3 Improved Blizzard is a 50% slow (40% without) Dontlookatme · 2025-11-22. **Contested** older figures: 75% → 50% Luden TA · 2025-10-24, or 65% → 40% with the duration cut from 2 s to 1.5 s Lucius · 2025-10-23. Players now use "coc/nova/flamestrike kiting" Gees · 2026-04-03. **Build:** Boomwick's Frost/Fire AoE farm build (also suggested for Hardcore): "Frost nova into flamestrike+Coc and then you kite", no Improved Blizzard Boomwick · 2025-11-12, Boomwick · 2025-11-12, Boomwick · 2025-11-12. | Tree | Talents | |---|---| | Fire (15) | Impact 5, Ignite 5, Improved Flamestrike 3, Burning Soul 2 | | Frost (35) | Frost Warding 2, Elemental Precision 3, Frostbite 3, Improved Frost Nova 2, Permafrost 3, Ice Shards 5, Cold Snap 1, Arctic Reach 2, Frost Channeling 3, Shatter 5, Ice Block 1, Icicles 1, Improved Cone of Cold 3, Ice Barrier 1 | Split **0/15/35** (50 points as posted, 1 free), VALID. Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage?points=-AooADC-QYDTpAToBLAAB` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage/-5U0IC-CIKN6FV906` [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=mage&t=-055000302-2030323510235113001) **Contested:** older advice skips **Frostbite** for AoE, because "it'll ruin your AoE pull if one gets frozen"; take Permafrost instead ([Rudyraccoon (player), 2024-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107433#p107433)). Others keep it to freeze elites in place Luden TA · 2025-09-26. The wiki's AoE leveling table follows that rule (no Frostbite). Leveling it level by level: | Level | Talent | New rank | |---|---|---| | 10-11 | Frost Warding | 1→2 | | 12-14 | Elemental Precision | 1→3 | | 15-17 | Permafrost | 1→3 | | 18-19 | Improved Frost Nova | 1→2 | | 20-24 | Ice Shards | 1→5 | | 25-29 | Shatter | 1→5 | | 30 | Ice Block | 1 | | 31 | Cold Snap | 1 | | 32-34 | Improved Cone of Cold | 1→3 | | 35-36 | Arctic Reach | 1→2 | | 37-39 | Frost Channeling | 1→3 | | 40 | Ice Barrier | 1 | | 41-43 | Piercing Ice | 1→3 | | 44-48 | Impact (Fire) | 1→5 | | 49-53 | Ignite (Fire) | 1→5 | | 54-56 | Improved Flamestrike (Fire) | 1→3 | | 57-58 | Arcane Subtlety | 1→2 | | 59-60 | Burning Soul (Fire) | 1→2 | End state **2/15/34**, VALID (order from the [Mage Levelling FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Levelling_FAQ), whose table stops at 59; the level-60 point is Burning Soul 2/2). Codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage?points=Q-AooADC-QYYTpAToBDAAB` · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/mage/C-5U0IC-CL2N6FV306` [Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=mage&t=2-055000302-2033023510235103001) For AoE-farm talents, Akanamu advises maxing Elemental Precision plus the Cone of Cold talents, and picking up Amplify Magic to help pull packs Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-26. **The AoE loop** (bot-ready): 1. Gather the pack (wand, rank-1 Fire Blast or body pull). 2. `Frost Nova` (the pack is rooted). 3. `Flamestrike`, timed to land just before Nova breaks. Mobs break Nova at different times Luden TA · 2025-11-08, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-10-03. 4. `Cone of Cold` as they break free Luden TA · 2025-10-24. 5. Kite **in a circle** (backpedalling lets them catch up) and spam `Arcane Explosion` when they catch up. Reapply `Cone of Cold` on cooldown ([Mage Levelling FAQ (wiki)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Levelling_FAQ)), Aridhil · 2026-04-08. 6. When Nova is back: rank-1 `Frost Nova` → `Flamestrike` → `Cone of Cold` again, using the highest Flamestrike rank your mana allows Aridhil · 2026-04-08. A pure-Frost variant skips Nova and Flamestrike: Cone of Cold + Arcane Explosion only ZeroRanger · 2025-11-08. Cone of Cold and Arcane Explosion have no target cap Lightemgee · 2025-11-15, Boomwick · 2025-11-17. About 1% of Cone of Cold casts do nothing to a grouped pack (unexplained bug) Amber · 2025-11-15. Leveling Arcane below ~24 and expecting it to feel good Valaen · 2026-03-20. 4. Stacking hit while leveling; it only matters against mobs 3 levels above you Izzo · 2025-11-01, Shared · 2025-12-02. 5. leveling.recommendation: Level as **Frost**. It is the safest spec (quick-cooldown CC, you can kite almost anything) and the default for Hardcore. At 60, respec to [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps) for raids. Train spells from **all three schools**, buy a **wand** early, and gear **Intellect, Stamina and spell power**. Ignore hit until you fight mobs 3 levels above you. Arcane becomes good at level **24** (Arcane Missiles rank 3) and is a fine choice for dungeon-heavy leveling from ~30. Blizzard AoE grinding no longer works on Turtle; AoE farming now means **Frost Nova → Flamestrike → Cone of Cold → Arcane Explosion** kiting.

gaps:
1. **Arcane Surge haste cutoff:** 22% (sim), 25% or 30%; there is no agreed number.
2. **Arcane Rupture's GCD floor:** 58.3% (in-game test) vs ~66.6% (earlier sim).
3. **The Arcane Rupture/Surge damage drop** reported on 1.18.1 patch day was never explained.
4. **2-target AoE threshold** for Arcane and Fire: no clean number exists; 3+ targets = Arcane Explosion is convention.
5. **Frost's mana problems** were never addressed or explained. The binary Flash Freeze design has no dev response.
6. **Fire:** small haste costing DPS in the new 2-Fireball weave is sim-based and **contested**. The Fire T3.5 5-piece bug (report 18568) is unconfirmed either way. Blast Wave crit-per-target is single source.
7. **PvP:** 1.18.1 per-class dampening numbers were never published. There are no PvP-specific enchant or consumable lists, and no current matchup data for Priest. Most `#pvp-general` matchup material predates 1.18.1.
8. **Mage tanking:** no complete tank talent build or full guide was ever posted (one was promised). The tank spec exists only as "Arcane minus threat reduction and Arcane Power".
9. **Gear:** the source of the +9 Arcane "Crystallized Topaz" JC recipe is unknown. Several BiS lists are single-source screenshots. Whether Sigil of Ancient Accord's proc uses your hit against raid bosses is untested.
10. **Leveling:** the talent orders here are built from the wiki's tables plus cited Discord advice, not taken whole from one player's leveling log. There is no leveling BiS list. The AoE-spot bracket list is from before 1.18.1.
11. **Unanswered mechanics:** whether Winter's Chill crit stacks additively; whether multiple Scythe haste summons stack; whether Resonance Cascade duplicates trigger item procs (the dev comment says no, one player disputes it).
12. **Ignored:** late messages about an "Arcane Blast at level 64" rotation and "T8" refer to a different game context and were not used.
patchChanges: Mages got "one to two sentences every major update" Promey · 2026-03-10: - **Improved Fire Blast** now reduces Fire Blast's GCD (0.3/0.6/1.0 s). Fire Blast became the highest-DPS button for Fire, and the Arcane raid build takes it too Luden TA · 2026-03-28, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-25. - **Ice Barrier:** +10% Frost damage for 60 s after the cast, plus +5% while the shield holds. **Contested:** some call it a straight buff, "still has 5% on shield, just 10% is split off independent" Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-30; others dismiss it as a QoL change, not a real buff, since it "changes almost nothing for frost" Jûun Amelie · 2026-01-31. - **Scythe of Elune**'s Arcane proc cooldown is now enforced, a real loss for Arcane Aest · 2026-03-30. **Mirror Magic** (T3.5 3-piece) now triggers from AoE spells Pepopo · 2026-03-11. - **PvP:** class-dependent dampening, and resilience that reduces spell crits, turned mage from "a burst class to more of a control class" Vent · 2026-04-07. The PvP gear system was overhauled Gees · 2026-03-28. - **Weapon swaps now cost a GCD** limbless · 2026-04-03. The **Fortune** stat arrived, but most proc items got internal cooldowns at the same time Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-20. - **Not addressed:** Arcane Surge rework, Frost's mana problems Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-24, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-01-24.

caveats: The only itemized pre-raid list for Mage comes from the community wiki's General FAQ page (authority: wiki, the least reliable tier per AGENTS.md) — the wiki itself says "no up-to-date pre-raid BiS, you can just jump right into raids." Forum threads asking for a BiS list (t13188, t18636, t22994) got no substantive answers; one reply just linked the wiki/AtlasLoot.

No raid-tier slot-by-slot BiS list exists for any Mage spec in any source; only tier-set bonus text, isolated named items, and one post naming a handful of BWL-era trinkets/weapons for Arcane (single source, post-1.18.1).

No Mage forum post is staff-authored on gear (0 staff posts touch itemization directly in the Mage forum's 683 posts); the itemization changelog (Dragunovi, 2026-02-15) is the only staff gear source, and it only lists numeric tweaks to existing items, not slot recommendations.
No leveling gear list exists for Mage at all (explicit gap in `leveling.md`) — only generic stat priority (Int > Stam) and two named early items.

Hit to 16% (10% talent + 6% gear) is first priority; then haste ≈ spell power (roughly 17-20 SP per 1% haste) per player formula "20SP = 14 DPS, 1 Haste = 9.1 DPS, 1 Crit = 9.1 DPS ... Spell penetration: "you can pretty much ignore magic penetration, useful for PvP but I can't think of any PvE fight where it would be worth gearing towards" — [Mackylol (player), 2024-02-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=88341#p88341).

**No gear sources exist.** The Arcane PvP playbook states outright: "no rotation guide or stat list exists." The only
adjacent remark is an unattributed cross-forum note that Arcane's alternate tier sets "scale with haste and [are] a
sought-after stat" — not attributable to a specific post, so not listed as a citation here.

All: [Mage Fire FAQ (wiki, rev. 2026-03-04)](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Mage_Fire_FAQ). Plus the general list
(Sorcerer's Regalia, Kara10 items, T1 BoE belt/bindings — see Arcane above). Enchant: gloves Fire Power.
Consumables: generic caster list (mana tea, mana potions, Brilliant Wizard Oil).

**Stat priority**: "you really want 2-4% haste minimum + spellpower to ensure that you can get off 2 fireballs within
the 6 second Ignite window" (wiki) — written for the old 6s Ignite; with the 4s Ignite restored in 1.18.0 the haste
requirement is, if anything, stricter, but no source recomputed it (**gap**). Hit cap 16% → crit ≥ hit-under-cap →
spell power → haste.

### Raid tiers — fragments only, contested bug status

Regular (non-Arcane) T1/T2/T3 sets are used. Frost/Fire T3.5 3-set: "proc chance increased from 10% to 35% and
replicated damage increased from 10% to 20%. Now has a 4 second cooldown" —
[1.18.0 itemization changelog (staff), t20103](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=20103); players reported
it broken repeatedly through late 2025 (bug-report id 18568) and the 1.18.1 notes only confirm Mirror Magic "now
triggers correctly" — **whether the Fire 5-set itself is fixed is unknown**. Loop of Unceasing Frost's fire-damage
increase stacks with Improved Scorch (changelog, 2024-12-11). No per-piece item names given — **gap**.

gearMarkdown.heading: Frost — pvp
gearMarkdown.markdown:
**No named armor pieces exist for Frost PvP.** Consumables: Greater Fire Protection Potion ("blocks 2600 dmg, and
you can drink it up to an hour early", 2-min CD; recommended against Fire/PoM-Pyro mages) —
[Atolius (player), 2025-06-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=134628#p134628); Zanza potion (~3g) —
[Springboards (player), 2024-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107470#p107470).

**Stat notes**: no Turtle-specific PvP stat weights exist; a direct question went unanswered —
[Perkamov (player), 2025-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161504#p161504). Stamina is valued:
"USE STAMINA ... full t3+life gem+stamina enchants" (advice given to a warrior fighting mages) —
[Springboards (player), 2024-11-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107471#p107471); a well-geared mage
has "~3k HP in PvP gear" — [Xiangyu (player), 2025-08-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148046#p148046).
Spell penetration is "useful for PvP" —
[Mackylol (player), 2024-02-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=88341#p88341), but resistance gear
itself is rare in PvP — [Manletow (player), 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157292#p157292).

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No source gives a complete slot-by-slot raid-tier (T1 through T3.5) BiS list for any Mage spec — only tier-set
  bonus text and, for Arcane post-1.18.1, a single post naming two trinkets and one weapon for BWL.
- Arcane PvP has zero gear/stat sources — the playbook explicitly notes "no rotation guide or stat list exists."
- Frost PvP has no named armor pieces at all — only two consumables and general stamina/spell-penetration advice.
- No leveling gear list exists for Mage in any bracket — `leveling.md` states this as an explicit gap; only Int >
  Stam stat priority and two unnamed early items (Amber Rings, a battlemage staff) are given.
- Almost every pre-raid item above has no item ID — sources give names and (usually) a drop location, but not a
  database ID, except the Kara10 items (61251-61450 range) that one 2023 forum post links directly.
- Sorcerer's Regalia (T0.5) individual piece names are not given anywhere; referenced only as a set.

sections.heading: Experts relied on (and why)
sections.markdown:
- **Pepopo:** author of Nampower and of the community simulator (pepopo978/wowsim). He posts coefficient tables, server-tick and haste-cap measurements and relays dev comments, and he corrects himself when tests disagree. Arcane mechanics, Frost builds and the Fire opener.
- **Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation:** Kara40 Arcane/Fire raider. Wrote HasteDisplay and a patched Quartz, posts logs, and gives detailed cooldown and threat advice. Arcane rotation, trinkets, Fire openers with 4 Fire mages.
- **Luden TA:** Arcane/Fire raider, a regular Twin Emperors mage tank, and author of the Frost raid build. Very active on Fire's post-1.18.1 cadence. Fire rotation, Frost build, mage tanking, leveling spec advice.
- **Aest:** top Fire parser on Nordanaar/Kara40 and widely deferred to. Fire gear, Fire vs Arcane balance, Ignite math.
- **Shared:** gear lists for Ambershire (fresh server) and the fresh-60 path; revises his own advice after tests. Pre-raid, trinkets, cloak progression.
- **Dontlookatme:** hit-table math and Arcane leveling talent order.
- **Ocra, biloen, Mondalv, Zatyg:** sim numbers (stat weights, trinket priority, T2 vs off-pieces).
- **Lightemgee, Izzo, Beta, Sellma:** frequent, mostly accurate answers on races, hit caps, haste stacking and consumables.
- **ZeroRanger, Anima:** the channel's practical mage tanks (dungeons, Naxx trash, Twin Emperors gear).
- **lowlifeopinions** (`#pvp-general`): measured PvP matchup reasoning, deferred to even by opponents.

sections.heading: Gaps (what the sources do not settle)
sections.markdown:
1. **Arcane Surge haste cutoff:** 22% (sim), 25% or 30%; there is no agreed number.
2. **Arcane Rupture's GCD floor:** 58.3% (in-game test) vs ~66.6% (earlier sim).
3. **The Arcane Rupture/Surge damage drop** reported on 1.18.1 patch day was never explained.
4. **2-target AoE threshold** for Arcane and Fire: no clean number exists; 3+ targets = Arcane Explosion is convention.
5. **Frost's mana problems** were never addressed or explained. The binary Flash Freeze design has no dev response.
6. **Fire:** small haste costing DPS in the new 2-Fireball weave is sim-based and **contested**. The Fire T3.5 5-piece bug (report 18568) is unconfirmed either way. Blast Wave crit-per-target is single source.
7. **PvP:** 1.18.1 per-class dampening numbers were never published. There are no PvP-specific enchant or consumable lists, and no current matchup data for Priest. Most `#pvp-general` matchup material predates 1.18.1.
8. **Mage tanking:** no complete tank talent build or full guide was ever posted (one was promised). The tank spec exists only as "Arcane minus threat reduction and Arcane Power".
9. **Gear:** the source of the +9 Arcane "Crystallized Topaz" JC recipe is unknown. Several BiS lists are single-source screenshots. Whether Sigil of Ancient Accord's proc uses your hit against raid bosses is untested.
10. **Leveling:** the talent orders here are built from the wiki's tables plus cited Discord advice, not taken whole from one player's leveling log. There is no leveling BiS list. The AoE-spot bracket list is from before 1.18.1.
11. **Unanswered mechanics:** whether Winter's Chill crit stacks additively; whether multiple Scythe haste summons stack; whether Resonance Cascade duplicates trigger item procs (the dev comment says no, one player disputes it).
12. **Ignored:** late messages about an "Arcane Blast at level 64" rotation and "T8" refer to a different game context and were not used.

guidePages.title: Mage professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** professions matter less for a mage than for most classes. Pick them for gold and convenience, not for DPS Luden TA · 2024-11-19, sosqua9- · 2025-12-09. **Level with two gathering professions** (Herbalism is the best for gold) Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-27, Aest · 2025-12-10. At 60 the usual raiding setup is **Engineering + one other**. Engineering is "bis" but not mandatory, and for a mage it mostly means **Goblin Sapper Charges** on AoE packs Shared · 2026-02-03, Gees · 2025-12-18. If this is your first character, **Herbalism + Alchemy** is the safest long-run pair Gees · 2025-12-18. **Tailoring** is worth it only long enough to make **Robe of the Archmage**. After that you can drop it and keep wearing the robe Luden TA · 2025-12-10, Luden TA · 2025-12-10.

sections.heading: Best pairs by goal
sections.markdown: | Goal | Pair | Why | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Leveling** | Two of Herbalism / Mining / Skinning | Gathering pays while you level. You can swap Herbalism for Engineering at 60 | Gees · 2025-12-18 | | **Raiding: Arcane** | Engineering + any (often Tailoring for the robe, then something else) | Sapper + Arcane Explosion is the only profession-based raid damage. **Contested:** some say skip it because Arcane's trinket slots are already crowded | Pepopo · 2025-11-13, Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-13, Lightemgee · 2025-11-13 | | **Raiding: Fire / Frost** | Engineering + any | Same argument: Sappers on AoE packs. The sources name no spec-specific craft for Fire or Frost | Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2026-03-30, Izzo · 2025-10-01 | | **Fresh 60 gearing** | Tailoring (then drop it) | Robe of the Archmage (BoP) is BiS until BWL. The other good tailoring pieces are BoE and can be bought | Shared · 2025-11-03, Shared · 2025-11-07 | | **PvP** | Engineering + any | Players consistently call it "engi for pvp" | Izzo · 2025-10-01, Izzo · 2025-12-25, sosqua9- · 2025-12-09 | | **Gold-making** | Herbalism + Alchemy, or Enchanting + Jewelcrafting | Alchemy is "the best gold saving/gold making prof in the long run". Enchanting + JC earn well only if you advertise both | Gees · 2025-12-18, Aest · 2025-12-10 |

sections.heading: What each profession gives a mage
sections.markdown: ### Engineering - **Goblin Sapper Charge:** it is off the GCD, so you can weave it between Arcane Explosions Pepopo · 2026-04-14. Each one costs about 4g Micro Jackson · 2026-03-30. The cooldown is the same 5 minutes as in classic (single source) Pepopo · 2026-04-14. A raider reports Sapper + Arcane Jewel of Wild Magics + Arcane Explosion doing about 50k damage in one GCD on a big Naxx spider pack Akanamu, Conqueror of Desolation · 2025-11-13. - **1.18.1 goggles:** you craft the new Engineering goggles, then upgrade them with an item from the new BWL boss Memesh · 2026-03-21. Their proc gives **+200 SP and -10% haste**. That should be strong for AoE and weak for single target, because the haste loss "almost cancels out" the spell power (single source) PBnJames · 2026-04-16, PBnJames · 2026-04-16. - **Leveling:** the Green Lens "of Wrath" (+35 damage) needs Engineering and was suggested around level 40 L-star · 2025-11-11. - **Utility:** Engineering portals to Gadgetzan and Everlook add "even more portals" Saedar · 2025-12-30, Izzo · 2025-12-25. - **Gnomish or Goblin?** The mage channel has no answer to this Limpan · 2026-03-30, Esporeno · 2026-03-30. One player suggests a race-change trick: level as a Gnome, craft the Gnome-only BoP items, then switch to Goblin to craft your own rocket boots (single source) roguecraft · 2026-03-30. - The **Goblin Brainwashing Device** (4 saved talent builds, about 350g) comes from Gurubashi Arena or the donation shop, not from Engineering. Most mages who swap specs buy one Aridhil · 2026-03-21, limbless · 2026-04-15, Izzo · 2026-03-10. ### Tailoring | Craft | Bind | Who wants it | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Robe of the Archmage** | BoP | Every spec at fresh 60. BiS until BWL; the T1 robe has hit | Shared · 2025-11-03, Shared · 2025-11-07 | | **Spellwoven Nobility Drape** | BoE (Shen'dralar rep) | Arcane's cloak until the Sapphiron cloak; AoE BiS forever | Shared · 2025-11-07, Shared · 2026-01-30 | | **Gloves of Unwinding Mystery** | BoE | Pre-raid/early raid BiS gloves | Shared · 2025-11-07, sosqua9- · 2025-12-09 | | **Gloves of Spell Mastery** | — | Replaces Unwinding Mystery; costs 10 Mooncloth + 6 Golden Pearl | Aridhil · 2026-03-20 | | **Resistance sets** | BoE | Resist fights | Shared · 2025-11-07 | | **Mooncloth** | cooldown | T3 and T3.5 crafting | MeIzClone · 2026-02-07, sosqua9- · 2025-12-09 | - **Buy it instead:** apart from the robe, the good crafts are BoE with thin margins Aest · 2025-12-10. Mooncloth saves about 10g per 5-day cooldown (2 Felcloth at about 9-10g each against about 28-30g for a Mooncloth), so buying it is often fine BLS · 2025-12-25, BLS · 2026-02-17. Dreamthread gear is "not worth it" Shared · 2025-11-07. - **Contested:** "Tailoring is kind of just a meme" Aest · 2025-12-10, against "you will need it for T3" (Mooncloth) MeIzClone · 2026-02-07. Players expected no new tailoring gear in 1.18.1 Aest · 2026-03-22. The 1.18.1 crafted-item upgrade system could change that PBnJames · 2026-02-17. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle-custom) - **+6 Arcane SP ring/neck enchant**, made by a Jewelcrafter. Arcane uses it on ring and neck. One customer was asked for about 15 Rough Stone + 15 Silk Cloth sosqua9- · 2026-01-30, Junpei · 2026-01-30. - **Crystallized Topaz** (+9 Arcane damage on ring/amulet, likely uses Imperial Topaz) exists in 1.18.1, but its recipe source is unknown sosqua9- · 2026-03-20, alyflex · 2026-04-06, PBnJames · 2026-03-30. - A Jewelcrafting spell-penetration option (+5) is useful only on trash with 15 arcane resistance Pepopo · 2025-12-02. - Jewelcrafting makes "tons of good caster offhands" but no caster main-hand Bramnur · 2025-12-15. Pair it with Enchanting and advertise both Aest · 2025-12-10, Aest · 2025-12-10. Gemology and Enchanting are among the few crafts with lasting endgame demand Lightemgee · 2025-11-20. ### Alchemy and Herbalism - You make your own raid consumables. The mage raid kit is Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Elixir of Greater Arcane Power and Dreamshard Elixir (see [Arcane](#/class/mage/arcane-ranged-dps)) Bruh · 2025-11-13. Others can craft them for you, so Alchemy is a convenience, not a requirement Luden TA · 2025-12-10. - While leveling, a mage has no heal. Take First Aid and buy cheap potions, or make them with Herbalism/Alchemy Dishonor · 2025-10-25. ### Enchanting - It is useful for disenchanting and for collecting rare enchants Arle · 2025-12-18. Tailoring + Enchanting is the classic cloth-caster pair Lightemgee · 2026-04-04. It earns gold only if you advertise Aest · 2025-12-10. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) - **Before 1.18.1:** Survival capped at 150. Its main use was the **Traveler's Tent**, which grants rested XP and stacks with nearby tents. Mages used tents like everyone else ([Speedz1337, 2024-05-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94431#p94431), [official site](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening)) Afraido · 2025-11-05, Afraido · 2025-11-05. - **1.18.1 rework:** Survival now has 80+ recipes that draw on the primary professions. These include slowing, rooting and trapping tools, gathering bags and Woodcutting ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). Players also report gathering trinkets and a skill-300 sickle that raises the Black Lotus chance ([Birtha, 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171974#p171974)). Tents now cap rested XP at 25%, and rested XP gives a 50% bonus instead of 100% ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). - **For mages:** the channel says Survival "can be tough" to level after the patch because some materials are expensive, and that Skinning helps because many new Survival recipes use its materials sosqua9- · 2026-04-04, sosqua9- · 2026-04-04. The channel has **no mage-specific case** for Survival tools or for Gardening. Treat both as optional. Gardening needs Survival 75; its crops give food buffs ([official site](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening)).

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **1-60:** level two gathering professions. Crafting is not worth much while leveling Leery, Pibble Disciple · 2026-01-27. 2. **At 60:** swap one gathering profession, usually Herbalism, for Engineering if you raid seriously or PvP Gees · 2025-12-18. 3. **Tailoring detour:** learn Tailoring, craft Robe of the Archmage, then drop it. The robe stays wearable Luden TA · 2025-12-10, Luden TA · 2025-12-10. Crafting your own Mooncloth for T3 is optional, since you can buy it sosqua9- · 2026-04-04. 4. Skill thresholds for mage-relevant recipes are not stated in the mage sources (see the general [Professions overview](#/professions)).

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: - **Gnome:** the Engineering racial (vanilla baseline). Gnome-only BoP engineering crafts are the reason for the Gnome-then-Goblin race-change trick (single source) roguecraft · 2026-03-30. - **Goblin:** Goblin-only engineering recipes (rocket boots) roguecraft · 2026-03-30. The Goblin Prospecting racial also grants Jewelcrafting skill ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102965#p102965)). - **High Elf / Human:** one player says their reputation and enchanting racials "don't up your damage in raid" biloen · 2026-01-05. A question on whether the High Elf enchanting bonus matters for crafting went unanswered ganktrain_umberto · 2025-03-22.

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Herbalism** is the mage's steady gold profession Aest · 2025-12-10. Herb prices crashed on Nordanaar in late 2025, because of lasher-farm oversupply and a cheap herb item; Gromsblood sold for 8-15s Faelune · 2025-12-10, Faelune · 2025-12-10. A mage with 300 Herbalism reports only about 30g/hour in DME Rizzrakk · 2025-10-08. - **Mining** is a fine second income profession BLS · 2025-12-25, BLS · 2026-02-17. - The class farms (Dire Maul East lashers from level 54, conjured level-55 water on the AH) need no profession. See [Class overview: Gold](#/class/mage) Kitsu · 2025-12-09, Zekeal · 2026-04-04. - Engineering "doesn't make gold", and Sappers cost money malorak · 2025-01-29, Micro Jackson · 2026-03-30.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- Gnomish vs Goblin Engineering specialisation for mages: nobody in the channel answered.
- The name and exact stats of the 1.18.1 Engineering goggles, and whether Arcane should use them, are unsettled.
- The recipe source of the +9 Arcane Jewelcrafting enchant (Crystallized Topaz) is unknown.
- Skill levels for mage-relevant crafts are not in the mage sources.
- There is no mage-specific evaluation of the 1.18.1 Survival tools (bolas, nets) for PvP or leveling kiting.

See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/mage)

summary: **Recommendation:** level as **Affliction**, or Demonology on Hardcore. At 60, start raiding as Affliction, because Suppression's free 10% hit makes gearing easy Shortmo · 2026-04-17. Move to **Demonology** once you have hit gear and The Black Book, if your raid is organised Mima · 2026-04-03. Play Fire Destruction for dungeons, trash-heavy raids and Mephistroth. For PvP, play Affliction.

overview: **Recommendation:** level as **Affliction**, or Demonology on Hardcore. At 60, start raiding as Affliction, because Suppression's free 10% hit makes gearing easy Shortmo · 2026-04-17. Move to **Demonology** once you have hit gear and The Black Book, if your raid is organised Mima · 2026-04-03. Play Fire Destruction for dungeons, trash-heavy raids and Mephistroth. For PvP, play Affliction. The warlock is a ranged caster with DoTs, drains, demons and the class's raid utility: curses, Healthstones, Soulwell and summons. Turtle reworked it three times: Class Changes 2 (late 2024), 1.18.0 (August 2025) and 1.18.1 (March 2026). Most classic guides no longer apply. There is no Dark Pact Fistofate · 2026-04-06; Drain Soul is a real damage spell L-star · 2025-12-01; greater demons (Infernal, Felguard, Doomguard) are 3-minute raid cooldowns.

readme.heading: What changed in 1.18.1 (gameplay impact)
readme.markdown: Official notes: [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23, revised 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Live 2026-03-20. | Change | What it means for you | |---|---| | **Unleashed Potential** procs on any direct damage (not only crits) and shows a buff rey.1982 · 2026-02-04 | 3 stacks in about 3 s L-star · 2026-03-23. Demonology went from niche to the top spec. | | **Searing Pain**: 2.0 s base cast (1.5 s with 5/5 Bane), 57% spell-power scaling, 1 s GCD, +20% base damage [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Feenik · 2026-03-20 | Fire Destruction became playable; Searing Pain is also Demonology's stacking spell. | | **Hellfire**: 6.66% spell power per tick; mana paid over the channel W · 2026-03-24 | Cheaper and stronger AoE, but still "underwhelming" in practice iwasPickleRick · 2026-03-24. | | **Curses of Shadows, Elements and Recklessness**: 1 s GCD W · 2026-03-21 | Faster curse duty; Curse of Recklessness fear-juggling in PvP. | | **Ritual of Doom**: 3 s cast, 1 helper, never kills anyone. **Demon Gate**: Felguard appears in 4 s Sarimal · 2026-01-27, sailorVEVO · 2026-04-09 | Greater demons are much easier to summon. | | **Soul Link** 25% → 20%; **enslaved and greater demons take 50% less healing** (moved off the warlock); **Felhunter/Infernal armor -30%**; **Avoidance** now also reduces cleave damage Feenik · 2026-03-24, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24, Lightemgee · 2026-03-23 | Health Funnel is your pet's healer. Pets survive boss cleaves better. | | **Sinister Pursuit** moved to Demonology (pet speed); **Master Conjuror** removed rengartop · 2026-01-24 | Sacrifice builds take 2/3 Demonic Aegis instead Sehnsucht · 2026-03-20. | | **Healthstone** single 1,200 HP stone; **Soulwell** costs 3 shards; one Soulstone no longer covers the raid Killajive · 2026-01-24, rengartop · 2026-01-24, Lightemgee · 2026-03-20 | Plan shards. | | **Affliction T3 4-piece**: Curse of Agony +100% for its first 4 ticks. **T3.5 3-piece**: Siphon Life bonus cut 50% → 25% (the damage too, not only the mana) Frolegacy · 2026-03-06, Dalak · 2026-03-20 | T2.5 stays the Affliction mid-game set. | | **Class weapon Thil'phoral** from Timbermaw Hold; now procs from periodic damage TowelDruid · 2026-04-02, sailorVEVO · 2026-04-07 | A long questline (see [Affliction gear](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps)). | Carried over from 1.18.0 and still true: - Nightfall procs from every Drain Soul tick Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-12-03, Lightemgee · 2025-12-03. - Rapid Deterioration turns haste into faster DoT ticks Vladizlav · 2025-11-24. - Fel Concentration is 2 points and protects Fear and Howl of Terror Lightemgee · 2025-08-15. - Curse of Exhaustion is only 10% without Affliction's Improved Curse of Exhaustion Inertia · 2025-07-25. - Demonic Sacrifice cannot be combined with greater demons sailorVEVO · 2025-11-27. - Master Demonologist gives greater demons +10% crit Szalor · 2025-10-04. **Bugs you will meet:** - Greater-demon pathing broke in January 2026 and was never fixed Tapka · 2026-04-19. - Shaman Tremor Totem used to break Enslave Demon, killing greater demons on summon; this was fixed sailorVEVO · 2026-04-02, sailorVEVO · 2026-04-07. - Malediction's Curse of Agony ignores Suppression's hit biloen · 2026-02-05.

readme.heading: Professions
readme.markdown: - **Endgame:** Engineering + Alchemy. Engineering is "the no-brainer choice" (sappers, grenades, reflectors, rocket boots), and Alchemy is always good for consumables sailorVEVO · 2026-01-11, Gilnean · 2025-10-06. - **Tailoring** was called the BiS profession on Ambershire Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-02, but its only real bind-on-pickup payoff is Mooncloth and the robe; the cloak and gloves are BoE, so you can buy them L-star · 2025-12-20. **Jewelcrafting:** Gemology over Goldsmithing Karina · 2025-10-14. - **Leveling:** Tailoring + Skinning, Alchemy + Herbalism, or Tailoring + Enchanting sailorVEVO · 2026-01-11. Enchanting alone is discouraged Mirror · 2025-06-17. - **Gold:** Dire Maul East lashers with Herbalism Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-03, Dezmar · 2026-01-27, a solo ZG Imp route (about 200 g/h) Qazdur · 2026-01-30, and Hyjal satyrs as Affliction Frolegacy · 2026-03-06. playbooks.title: Affliction Warlock (DoT / drain DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the pinned post-1.18.1 **35/11/5** build and sacrifice your demon. Keep your assigned curse, Curse of Agony, Corruption and Siphon Life on the boss. Fill every free GCD with **Drain Soul**, and break it for **Nightfall** procs. Cast **Dark Harvest** only when Shadow Vulnerability is up and every DoT has about 10 seconds left, or to finish a dying target. Gear for 6% hit, then spell power and haste. Affliction stays "about as strong as Demo, #1 or close #2" on bosses per the class designer, since it is built for long fights W · 2026-03-20, W · 2026-03-20.
