talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Raid 35/11/5 (recommended) Afraido pinned this build on release day Afraido · 2026-03-19. The same shape is the community wiki's "Affliction Drain" link. The only change is **2/3 Demonic Aegis** instead of 2/2 Sinister Pursuit. In 1.18.1 Sinister Pursuit took the old Improved Healthstone slot and speeds up the demon you are going to sacrifice anyway Erko · 2026-03-20, Mofie · 2026-03-20, Sehnsucht · 2026-03-20. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Affliction | Suppression | 5/5 | | Affliction | Improved Corruption | 5/5 | | Affliction | Improved Life Tap | 1/2 | | Affliction | Improved Drains | 2/2 | | Affliction | Improved Curse of Agony | 3/3 | | Affliction | Fel Concentration | 2/2 | | Affliction | Grim Reach | 2/2 | | Affliction | Nightfall | 2/2 | | Affliction | Soul Siphon | 3/3 | | Affliction | Rapid Deterioration | 2/2 | | Affliction | Siphon Life | 1/1 | | Affliction | Malediction | 1/1 | | Affliction | Shadow Mastery | 5/5 | | Affliction | Dark Harvest | 1/1 | | Demonology | Demonic Embrace | 5/5 | | Demonology | Soul Entrapment | 3/3 | | Demonology | Demonic Aegis | 2/3 | | Demonology | Demonic Sacrifice | 1/1 | | Destruction | Shadow Vulnerability | 5/5 | Split **35/11/5**, validated with `talent_tool.py` (VALID). Calculator codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock?points=FoAKaASDRBFAB-ArCAAB-F` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=warlock&t=550012320223210151-053020001-5)) · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock/Z08K2FD1V-5IC06-U` Why these points: - **Suppression 5/5** gives 10% hit to Affliction spells only, so you need just 6% from gear Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-27, Morsmordre · 2026-01-06. - **Rapid Deterioration 2/2** is a flat 6% haste on Affliction spells. At rank 2, all of your haste also speeds up DoT ticks; rank 1 applies only half of it Vladizlav · 2025-11-24. It does not affect Immolate, Hellfire or Rain of Fire Not Normal · 2026-01-09. - **Soul Siphon 3/3** makes Drain Soul hit harder for each Affliction effect on the target, which is why you keep four effects up [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102973#p102973). Curse of Shadows also counts as an effect Not Normal · 2026-02-18. - **Malediction** makes Curse of Shadows, Elements or Recklessness also apply your highest-rank Curse of Agony [Torta (staff), 2025-03-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504). It does not work with Curse of Tongues, Weakness or Doom Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-25. - **Shadow Vulnerability 5/5** (the old Improved Shadow Bolt) is a 20% shadow damage debuff. Drain Soul ticks can apply it since 1.18.0 Lightemgee · 2025-08-15. - **Soul Entrapment + Demonic Sacrifice** give extra damage while no demon is out. Sacrificing the Imp gives +4% spell damage; Soul Entrapment gives +6% with no demon [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159). - Crit and Intellect talents are skipped. DoTs and channels cannot crit Lynathel · 2026-04-10. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Threat / Improved Stones (31/17/3)** | Adds Improved Stones 2/2 (Voidstone goes from 10% to 15% threat reduction Nusabi · 2026-04-08), Fel Domination and Curse of Exhaustion; drops instant Corruption and 2 points of Shadow Vulnerability. The 2 Sinister Pursuit points are only a row filler. | `FAISaICDRBFAB-CrDABBQ-D` ([calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=warlock&t=501022321023210151-2530301012-3)) | Summonjutsu: take it when you pull threat; drop it for more Shadow Vulnerability and instant Corruption if you are the only warlock in the raid Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-14, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-16 | | **Hit-capped, no Nightfall** | Once gear covers hit, move points from Suppression and Nightfall into range (Grim Reach) or other talents | no full code posted | Lynathel Lynathel · 2026-04-11 (single source) | | **Keep the pet** | Skip Soul Entrapment/Demonic Sacrifice and run an unsacrificed Succubus for extra damage | none | **Contested:** Bigdots estimates about 10% extra DPS; Gilnean and Wells argue that uptime, positioning and the Succubus's fragility make it worse, and nobody posted test numbers Bigdots · 2025-10-21, Gilnean · 2025-10-21, Stunfisk · 2025-10-21 | !!! warning "Old builds" Builds that show points in an Affliction row-4 "Sinister Pursuit" or in Master Conjuror are from 1.18.0 or earlier. 1.18.1 moved Sinister Pursuit to Demonology and removed Master Conjuror [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Anything with Dark Pact, Amplify Curse or 5-point Fel Concentration predates the 2024 rework.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to 16% total.** Suppression gives 10%, so get **6% from gear**. With the Emerald Blessing buff you need only 5% Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-27, Pacyn · 2025-11-09. Players call hit cap the biggest priority for Affliction Frolegacy · 2026-03-05. - Suppression does not cover Shadow Bolt, Death Coil or other non-Affliction spells Araz/Kris · 2026-04-09. Nightfall Shadow Bolts cannot miss [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460). - Bug: Curse of Agony applied by Malediction does not get Suppression's hit, so it resists more often than it should biloen · 2026-02-05, Mima · 2025-11-04. 2. **Spell power (shadow or generic)** and **haste** next. Haste gets more valuable as your spell power rises: - About 13 SP per 1% haste at 500 SP and 0% haste; about 14.7 SP per 1% at 500 SP and 10% haste Taffy · 2026-04-04. - About 18 SP per 1% at 700 SP TowelDruid · 2026-01-02, and roughly 20 SP at 1,000 SP Refrigerador · 2026-04-10. - **Contested:** yugi says flat spell damage beats haste yugi · 2026-04-10. Use about 12 SP early and 16+ SP late as your conversion Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-04. 3. **Stamina.** Life Tap turns your health into mana, and the Affliction tier sets have little stamina [Akarui, 2025-07-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=137847#p137847), [Kentorianx, 2025-01-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115165#p115165). 4. **Crit and Intellect: worthless.** DoTs and drains do not crit, so only stamina, shadow damage, hit and haste matter Lynathel · 2026-04-10, rqo · 2025-11-07. 5. **Spell penetration:** only against high-resist bosses such as Mephistroth. Resistance cannot go below zero, so extra penetration is wasted Afraido · 2026-03-17. !!! note "Haste breakpoints" On Turtle, haste shortens a DoT's or channel's duration and tick interval instead of adding ticks Zent · 2026-01-24. The rounding creates apparent "breakpoints" (e.g. 13% and 22-23%) Frolegacy · 2026-03-17. **Contested:** Nezu, Afraido and biloen tested this and found no real DPS cliffs; they call the breakpoint table "a scam many people fell for" Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2026-03-19, Afraido · 2026-03-19, biloen · 2026-03-17. One concrete threshold: Corruption needs 15% haste to fit a 7th tick into its 18 s biloen · 2026-04-10. Do not skip an upgrade to "stay on a breakpoint".

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (raid boss)
rotationSingle.markdown: **Opener** (you are the curse warlock): 1. Pop your haste and spell-power cooldowns first (Potion of Quickness, Juju Flurry, racial, on-use trinket). DoTs (and channels) keep the buffs you had when you cast them for their whole duration Vladizlav · 2025-12-16, Vladizlav · 2025-12-16. 2. **Assigned curse** (Shadows, Elements or Recklessness; 1 s GCD since 1.18.1 Afraido · 2026-01-26, [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). Malediction adds Curse of Agony. 3. **Corruption** (instant). 4. **Siphon Life.** 5. **Drain Soul.** Its ticks apply Shadow Vulnerability. If threat is tight, ramp more gently: Siphon Life → Corruption → Curse → Drain Soul. The weakest, longest DoTs go first so the tank can build a lead Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-03-18. **Priority list** (top wins): 1. **Nightfall proc up → Shadow Bolt.** It is instant and cannot miss. Break a Drain Soul channel for it, but never break Dark Harvest Vladizlav · 2025-11-27, silly guy · 2026-04-14. It is worth casting at any haste now that Drain Soul costs mana per tick Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-04. 2. **Assigned curse missing → recast it.** 3. **Curse of Agony missing → Curse of Agony.** Malediction does not refresh a Curse of Agony that fell off on its own, so recast it yourself. A beta tester confirmed this is intended Chidi <beta tester> · 2026-01-26. 4. **Corruption missing → Corruption.** 5. **Siphon Life missing and the target will live its full duration → Siphon Life** Shortmo · 2026-02-11. 6. **Dark Harvest** only when all three are true: Shadow Vulnerability is up, every DoT has about 10 s or more left, and nothing will interrupt the 8 s channel. Otherwise use it as a finisher on a dying target Buubah · 2026-03-09, biloen · 2026-04-18. 7. **Drain Soul** as the filler. Cancel it right after a tick when you need the GCD, never mid-tick Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-30, Hyasur · 2025-11-13. It costs mana per tick, so cancelling wastes nothing Frolegacy · 2026-03-11. 8. **Life Tap** when mana will not cover the next cycle. Demonic Runes or Dark Runes save a GCD Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-09. Rules: - **Never clip a DoT early.** Reapply when it falls off. The one exception: if Siphon Life has under ~5 s left and you have a free GCD, let it finish and then reapply Curse of Agony and Corruption together Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-30. - **Never cast Immolate** as Affliction Afraido · 2026-03-05. - **Never hard-cast Shadow Bolt.** Only Nightfall procs [Grizb37, 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174185#p174185). - **Refresh after a cooldown.** When you pop an on-use spell-power trinket, reapply your DoTs so that two full cycles fit inside its window Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-30. ### Dark Harvest: why top players barely use it - Drain Soul scales about 20% per tick over 6 ticks, roughly 120% spell power in total. Dark Harvest is about 100% biloen · 2026-04-03. - Dark Harvest's 30% faster ticks shorten your DoTs' remaining uptime, which hurts Soul Siphon. It also cannot apply Shadow Vulnerability the way Drain Soul does biloen · 2026-04-18. - A sim at 640 SP / 16% hit, over 180 s, gave about 857 DPS for Drain Soul only and 848 DPS with Dark Harvest biloen · 2026-02-18. - Top parsers run 3-4 DoTs plus Drain Soul and "don't bother" with Dark Harvest Casius · 2026-04-18, tajen · 2026-03-31. - Exception: with the **T2.5 5-piece bonus**, Dark Harvest gains a large final tick (400%), which makes it worth casting Buubah · 2026-03-09, Buubah · 2026-03-10. - Casting Dark Harvest when your DoTs have under ~5-6 s left is a loss: they expire mid-channel Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-27. - Bug: Dark Harvest is supposed to reset its cooldown when the target dies mid-channel, but players report it does not rey.1982 · 2026-01-21. Before 1.18.1 the standard advice was "Dark Harvest on cooldown after a Drain Soul". That changed once Drain Soul became the stronger spell.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE and multi-target
rotationAoe.markdown: | Situation | What to do | |---|---| | Trash that dies in under ~10 s | One Corruption plus Drain Soul, or just your raid curse. "DH without dots is useless" Karen · 2025-10-10, Dixa · 2025-10-05. In melee-heavy raids, cast Curse of Recklessness and "chill" Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-24. | | 2-3 targets that live longer | Curse (with Curse of Agony) on each target and Corruption on 2-3, then Drain Soul or Dark Harvest the kill target Poulpup · 2025-11-03. How deep to dot depends on raid speed: Curse of Agony on every mob, Corruption on the 2nd or 3rd mob in fast raids (the 1st in slow pugs), Dark Harvest the first corrupted mob Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2026-04-09. | | More than 3 dot targets | Stop multi-dotting. Beyond 3 targets you spend more time reapplying than draining 𝐂𝖆𝖑𝖆𝖒𝖎𝖙𝖔𝖘 · 2025-11-25. | | 5+ stacked mobs | Spread Siphon Life (it heals you a lot), then Hellfire or Rain of Fire for the rest Eskay Rogue · 2026-02-26. Warn the tank and healers first. | You need at least ~12% haste for useful trash damage. Raids with 3 warlocks and a shadow priest keep Shadow Vulnerability up on trash and do much better Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-24, Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-24. Use Cursive's multicurse, e.g. `/cursive multicurse Corruption|HIGHEST_HP` biloen · 2026-03-09. It skips crowd-controlled and out-of-combat targets by default Pepopo · 2026-03-13.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns, resources and threat
cooldowns.markdown: - **Mana:** Life Tap is your engine. The T3.5 3-piece returns 25% of Siphon Life's drain (it was 50% before 1.18.1) Dalak · 2026-03-20. At 60 you rarely drink. - **Threat:** warlocks have no threat-reduction talent Afraido · 2026-03-18. Your tools: - **Voidstone:** -10% threat, 15% with Improved Stones Nusabi · 2026-04-08. Afraido's table: 90% threat with Demonic Sacrifice (Succubus) or Voidstone, 81% with both, 76.5% with Sacrifice plus Improved Stones Afraido · 2026-03-18. - **Blessing of Salvation** or **Tranquil Air Totem** Sitgarath · 2025-11-02. - **Limited Invulnerability Potion** as an emergency threat drop Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-09. - At ~80-85% of the tank's threat, wand or hold Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-29. - **Healthstone:** now a single 1,200 HP stone Killajive · 2026-01-24. **Spellstone** works like a second healthstone but strips all magic effects from you Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-25. **Felstone** is the usual stone in groups Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-02-23, but its healing generates threat, which can pull mobs onto you Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. - **Death Coil** is your only emergency self-heal. Save it.

roleStrategy.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Curse duty:** talk with the other warlocks and split Shadows, Elements and Recklessness. Malediction gives each of you Curse of Agony anyway. On the Chess event, someone has to keep Curse of Tongues up and reapply it about every 20 s, because Malediction does not work with it Mima · 2026-01-24. - **Mephistroth** ([Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan)): about 200 shadow resistance; the crawlers are immune to shadow and the hellfire imps to fire Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-24, Afraido · 2026-03-18. Curse of Shadows gives 75 penetration and two penetration enchants 50, so you need about 75 more from gear Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-30. Alternatively, Eye of Moam plus Curse of Shadows brings him to 5 resistance; Affliction warlocks take turns using the trinket Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-07. DoTs lose less to resistance than fire spells, so Affliction still edges out Fire there L-star · 2026-02-11. - **Gnarlmoon:** multi-dot the owls. It is the "best use case for playing affliction" L-star · 2026-03-18. - **Kruul and Rupturan:** high armor and hard pet positioning favour Affliction over Demonology Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-11-04. - **Thaddius:** Affliction out-damages Demonology (L-star: about 2,100 vs 1,600 DPS), partly because greater demons cannot follow across the gap L-star · 2026-02-21. - **Chess and Anomalus:** Fel Concentration matters on Chess, where a constant shadow aura pushes back channels Rollbluntz · 2025-10-22. For Anomalus, L-star wore crafted legs, hat, neck and cloak for about 200 arcane resistance L-star · 2026-03-09. - **Naxx trash:** on squishy trash such as Gothik trainees and the abomination-wing adds, Karen uses Drain Soul instead of Dark Harvest ("DH without dots is useless") Karen · 2025-10-10, Bebber · 2025-10-10. - **Twin Emperors room (AQ40):** Viscidus needs nature resistance as a gear check Deleted User · 2025-10-15. - **Channels and turning:** keyboard-turning breaks Drain Soul and Drain Life; mouse-turning does not Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-08.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: ### Pre-raid - Buy "of Shadow Wrath" greens and start raiding. A full pre-raid BiS list is not needed. Pick up standouts like the Kara10 quest trinket and the Sunken Temple offhand Chandalen · 2026-04-05. - **Black Morass** (Wardens of Time reputation) gives 6-8 important pre-raid pieces Bigdots · 2025-10-28: a sword, shoulders and a ring Karen · 2025-12-26. See [Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass). - The **T0.5 questline** gives purple, T1-level pieces Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-05. - Bigdots' crafted/rep/quest pre-raid set (hit and haste locally capped): Crown of Molten Ascension, Choker of Enlightenment, Grasp of Eternity, Fireproof Cloak, Robe of Sacrifice, Flarecore Wraps, Blade of Infinite Mysteries, Tome of Shadow Force, Felheart Handwraps/Sash/Leggings/Boots, Ring of the Academy, Whip of Encouragement, Orb of Kaladoon Bigdots · 2025-11-19, Bigdots · 2025-11-19, Bigdots · 2025-11-19. **Contested:** Lightemgee calls Robe of Sacrifice worse than crafted alternatives Lightemgee · 2025-11-04. - Community pre-BiS planner (set the filter to dungeon-only): `tylerdelrosario.github.io/WarlockBisDemo/` Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-05. ### Raid (by tier) | Phase | Key pieces | Sources | |---|---|---| | MC / Onyxia | **Gloves of Unwinding Mystery** (2% haste; still BiS into Kara40 despite a spell-power nerf) Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-15, sailorVEVO · 2026-02-19. Trinkets: **Whip of Encouragement** (3% haste) over Blackfire Orb 𝐂𝖆𝖑𝖆𝖒𝖎𝖙𝖔𝖘 · 2025-11-12; Orb of Kaladoon, Talisman of Ephemeral Power Bigdots · 2025-10-03. The T1 3-piece (+5% Drain Soul) is worth about 48 SP biloen · 2026-04-18. Offhand from Nefarian's head quest; Cloak of Consumption (ZG) over Drape of Nordrassil lowlifeopinions · 2025-12-01, v3xthecat · 2026-01-15. The T2 5-piece is only about 3% of your damage biloen · 2026-04-11. | [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair) | | AQ40 / Naxx / ES | **5/5 T2.5** is BiS until Kara40 or T3.5 Bebber · 2025-12-30, Buubah · 2026-03-09. mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Hard-casting Shadow Bolt or Immolate. - Casting Dark Harvest on cooldown, into a knockback, or with under 5 s left on your DoTs. - Clipping DoTs early, or letting Siphon Life fall off (you lose a Soul Siphon stack). - Assuming Malediction keeps Curse of Agony up. It does not refresh a Curse of Agony that fell off Chidi <beta tester> · 2026-01-26. - Stacking crit or Intellect. - Skipping the 6% gear hit because "Suppression covers it". - Keeping the pet on aggressive near a boss. An Imp pulled Kruul early in one raid [Grizb37, 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165986#p165986). - Letting soul shards overflow, or running out of them. Shards stack to 3 Szalor · 2025-11-15.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown:
The decision loop for a level-60 raid boss with the 35/11/5 build. The reasons and sources are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps), [AoE and multi-target](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps) and [Cooldowns, resources and threat](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps).

1. **Before the pull:** summon the Imp and **Demonic Sacrifice** it for +4% spell damage. Sacrifice the Succubus instead if you are threat-capped ([Pets](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps)). Carry a Felstone, or a Voidstone for threat.
2. **Opener:** haste and spell-power cooldowns → assigned curse (Malediction adds Curse of Agony) → Corruption → Siphon Life → Drain Soul. If threat is tight, open Siphon Life → Corruption → curse → Drain Soul.
3. **Single-target loop (top wins):**
    1. Nightfall proc → Shadow Bolt. Break a Drain Soul for it, never a Dark Harvest.
    2. Assigned curse missing → curse.
    3. Curse of Agony missing → Curse of Agony. Malediction does not refresh it.
    4. Corruption missing → Corruption.
    5. Siphon Life missing, and the target will live its full 30 s → Siphon Life.
    6. Dark Harvest only when Shadow Vulnerability is up, every DoT has ≥~10 s left and nothing will interrupt the 8 s channel. Otherwise use it as a finisher ([why](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps)).
    7. Drain Soul as the filler. Cancel it right after a tick.
    8. Life Tap when mana will not cover the next cycle.
4. **Cooldowns:** pop trinkets and potions *before* you (re)apply DoTs, because DoTs keep the buffs they were cast with. Death Coil is your emergency heal. A Limited Invulnerability Potion is your emergency threat drop.
5. **AoE switch:**
    - 1 target: the loop above.
    - 2-3 targets that live longer than ~10 s: curse and Corruption on each, then drain the kill target.
    - Trash that dies in under ~10 s: one Corruption plus Drain Soul, or just your curse.
    - Never dot more than 3 targets.
    - 5+ stacked mobs: spread Siphon Life, then Hellfire or Rain of Fire (warn the tank).
6. **Resources and threat:** Life Tap is your mana; you rarely drink. At ~80-85% of the tank's threat, wand or hold.
7. **Movement:** refresh the instants (curses, Corruption, Siphon Life) and Nightfall Shadow Bolts while you move. Start a channel only once you can stand still (vanilla baseline). Never cast Immolate, and never hard-cast Shadow Bolt.

extraSections.markdown: - **Required:** SuperWoW + **Cursive** + **Nampower**. Cursive is the most accurate DoT tracker Sehnsucht · 2025-10-13. leveling_by_bracket.advice: Imp from the level-1 class quest; buy the best wand available (no spells compare early); Voidwalker quest ~8-10.
Voidwalker tanks; Corruption + Curse of Agony then wand; first 7 talents Imp Corruption + Imp Life Tap.
Succubus at 20; drain tanking is NOT online yet — wand out-damages and out-efficiencies early Drain Life until the late-30s rank.
Shadoweave tailoring set is the leveling power spike (buy from AH if not a tailor); +shadow damage gear and skip Immolate; big Drain Life rank at 38; Scarlet Monastery for gear.
Voidwalker loses aggro to Shadoweave spell power; the Warlock becomes the tank (DoTs + Drain Life + Life Tap).
Infernal quest at 50; Doomguard + Soulwell at 60; Affliction AoE-farms by dotting 3-4 mobs and kiting with Curse of Exhaustion; Dire Maul East lashers is the classic end farm.
Demo is the safe HC pick; Affliction drain-tanking + rank-1 Curse of Recklessness (35 mana, with Malediction) is reported strong through the 40s.

glance.recommendation: Play the pinned post-1.18.1 **35/11/5** build and sacrifice your demon. Keep your assigned curse, Curse of Agony, Corruption and Siphon Life on the boss. Fill every free GCD with **Drain Soul**, and break it for **Nightfall** procs. Cast **Dark Harvest** only when Shadow Vulnerability is up and every DoT has about 10 seconds left, or to finish a dying target. Gear for 6% hit, then spell power and haste. Ignore crit.

facts.markdown: Low to medium. The rotation is simple, but good play takes DoT tracking addons and clean channel cancelling.

playbooks.title: Demonology Warlock (pet / greater-demon DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** in a raid that pulls on time and heals your pet, play the **0/34/17** build. Summon a greater demon before every pull: Felguard for burst and AoE, Infernal for fire-immune bosses and whenever it is off cooldown, Doomguard for single-target. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to about 6%, aim for 11-12%.** Your demon inherits about 90% of your hit plus a flat 3% Wildpants · 2026-04-16. - Its melee ("orange hits") only needs 8% on a boss, so 6% on you stops those misses Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-03-27, Blackfox · 2026-04-16. - Demon *spells* (Firebolt, Lash of Pain, Torment) and your own spells need the full 16% Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-17. - Summonjutsu targets 11-12% Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-03-27; Lightemgee says 8-10% "is just fine" Lightemgee · 2026-04-18. 2. **Crit.** Past 6% hit, each 1% crit is worth more than 1% hit Afraido · 2025-12-09. All your crit goes to the demon as well, and demon melee crits for 200% Lightemgee · 2026-03-31, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-28. Summonjutsu values crit at about 1.6-1.8× its normal worth for Demonology Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-17. Above ~30% crit your demon starts to lag slightly behind 1:1 Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-28. 3. **Spell power.** Unleashed Potential gives your demon a share of your spell power as spell power and attack power Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. Generic spell power helps every school. School-specific spell power only helps pet abilities of that school Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-28. **Contested:** whether the attack-power part uses your highest school or only shadow Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-28, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-08. 4. **Intellect** (Fel Intellect gives your demon 30% of your Intellect as its spell power Afraido · 2026-03-19) and **Stamina** (Fel Stamina, Power Overwhelming's health cost, Soul Link). 5. **Haste: none for the demon.** It only makes Unleashed Potential stack a bit faster W · 2026-03-31. Afraido's values at ~1,000 SP: 1% hit ≈ 18 SP, 1% crit ≈ 13 SP for your own damage Afraido · 2026-03-15.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Before the pull:** 1. Summon the greater demon for this boss (see [Greater demons](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps)). Give it time to come in: the Felguard appears 4 s after Demon Gate Sarimal · 2026-01-27; Ritual of Doom is now a 3 s cast with one helper clicking sailorVEVO · 2026-04-09. 2. Set the demon's autocasts: Felguard **Cleave on**, **Felstorm manual**; Doomguard **Infernal Blade on** Mmatsutake · 2026-04-07, 𝐂𝖆𝖑𝖆𝖒𝖎𝖙𝖔𝖘 · 2025-11-25. Greater demons forget their pet-bar layout every summon L-star · 2025-10-04. 3. On short fights, pre-stack Unleashed Potential on the last trash pack. Snapshot it with a trinket, then carry it into the boss Szalor · 2026-01-27, L-star · 2026-01-27. **Opener:** pet attack (no GCD) → curse → Shadow Bolt until Unleashed Potential has 3 stacks Mmatsutake · 2026-04-07. Any direct-damage hit adds a stack, so 3 stacks take about 3 s L-star · 2026-03-23. On the 3rd stack: on-use trinket (The Black Book), Power Overwhelming, Felstorm L-star · 2026-02-18. **Priority list** (top wins): 1. **Pet not attacking → pet attack.** `/script PetAttack();` works when `/petattack` fails Afraido · 2026-03-16. After a Take Position, re-issue the attack or the pet stops Tapka · 2026-01-27. 2. **Power Overwhelming off cooldown and the demon can afford 40% of its base health → Power Overwhelming** (no GCD) Mmatsutake · 2026-04-07. Tell your healers, because it slowly kills the pet 𝐂𝖆𝖑𝖆𝖒𝖎𝖙𝖔𝖘 · 2025-11-25. It also removes CC from the demon L-star · 2025-11-20. 3. **Unleashed Potential about to expire (lost to movement) → any direct-damage spell, or one tick of rank-1 Health Funnel or Mana Funnel** Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-08. 4. **Curse missing → curse.** When you are free to choose, use **Curse of Recklessness**: greater demons deal physical damage, and it also helps the tank's threat Stunfisk · 2026-03-27. 5. **Corruption, only if it will run its full duration** Mmatsutake · 2026-04-07. On trash, add Immolate/Corruption only if mobs live longer than ~18 s Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-03-18. 6. **Shadow Bolt** as the filler. On short fights, use 2 Searing Pain + Shadowburn, or 3 Searing Pain, to rebuild stacks faster Mmatsutake · 2026-04-07. Shadowburn while moving 𝐂𝖆𝖑𝖆𝖒𝖎𝖙𝖔𝖘 · 2025-11-25. 7. **Demon below ~50% and no AoE coming → Health Funnel.** Life Tap when low on mana. **Unleashed Potential snapshot rules:** the spell power it transfers is captured on the **first** stack, and the attack-power conversion on the **last** stack Lightemgee · 2026-03-23, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. Pop spell-power trinkets so they are active on the 3rd stack L-star · 2026-02-18.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE and trash
rotationAoe.markdown: - **Felguard is your AoE.** Felstorm plus Hellfire are your top AoE tools; Felstorm is "surprisingly strong" even as pure single-target DPS, and locks have topped Kara40 trash/Chess Storm parses with this combo Sehnsucht · 2026-01-25, Gilnean · 2026-01-25. Felstorm has no threat reduction; let the tank AoE-taunt first or the Felguard dies W · 2026-02-21. - On trash: deploy the demon, keep a greater demon alive, Curse of Recklessness, then Shadow Bolt. Add Immolate/Corruption only on mobs that live over ~18 s Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-03-18. - Infernal plus Power Overwhelming plus 3-stack Unleashed Potential plus Hellfire does top AoE on stacked trash [Momohomo, 2026-04-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=174180#p174180). - **Thresholds:** 1-2 targets: single-target rotation. 3+ stacked targets that live more than a few seconds: Felstorm, then Hellfire if the tank holds threat. Fast trash: curse and Shadow Bolt only. - Anub'Rekhan is the "absolute demo boss" for Felstorm Maven · 2025-11-07.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns, resources and threat
cooldowns.markdown: - **Power Overwhelming:** 40% of the demon's *base* health (changed from total health) Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-25; no GCD. - **Fel Domination:** instant re-summon for when the pet dies mid-fight or you need a Voidwalker shield W · 2026-02-24. - **Mana:** Demonology has the worst mana economy of the specs Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-19. Life Tap, the Imp's cost reduction, mana potions. L-star skips Potion of Quickness because mana runs out ("quickness is a luxury only affli can afford") L-star · 2026-01-27. - **Threat:** Demonology is often threat-capped Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-25. Greater demons can out-threat tanks "straight up" a minute into a fight Szalor · 2025-11-15, and they cannot receive Salvation Szalor · 2025-11-15. Your only options are pulling the demon back or letting it die Szalor · 2026-03-23.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **No tier set is built for Demonology.** "Get some hit, some crit" L-star · 2026-03-18. Demonology and Destruction default to the T1/T2 sets; T2.5 and T3 default to the Affliction versions and must be exchanged at the token vendor peter_hammer · 2026-03-19. - **T2 3-piece** is flat spell power Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-19. **T3 8-piece** beats T2.5/T3.5 mixes for Demonology, except standout pieces such as the Leggings of Polarity Szalor · 2026-02-27. T3 boots, chest and shoulders are pre-Kara40 BiS; add the head or belt for the 4-piece Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2026-01-13. - **The Black Book** (BWL) is "the best thing for demonology warlocks hands down" Lightemgee · 2025-12-04; it is as mandatory as Mind Quickening Gem is for mages derrurak · 2026-01-24. Hit gear plus The Black Book is the point where Demonology passes Affliction Mima · 2026-04-03. - **Pet trinkets:** the Ancient Cornerstone Grimoire (Onyxia) gives +5% pet and enslaved-demon damage and health since 1.18.1 Quadella · 2026-03-06. A rare in Moonwhisper Coast drops a trinket with +3% demon damage oi-er · 2026-03-23. The AQ20 Unspoken Names ring set 2-piece gives +5% pet damage balake · 2023-05-30; whether it works on greater demons is unconfirmed Lightemgee · 2026-03-28. - **Weapons:** Bag of Whammies is near-best until the Sapphiron eye or the AQ scepter Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-04. Later: Black Morass sword or Lucid Nightmare plus an offhand, or Shadow Wing Focus Staff biloen · 2026-03-30. The Onyxia staff from Broodcommander Axelus (80 SP, 1% crit, summons whelplings) works for early BWL Mima · 2026-03-30. Between two pieces, take the one with more hit Wildpants · 2026-04-11. - **MC phase targets:** stay above 500 SP and 25% crit while adding hit; BWL belt and bracers are the next hit pieces Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-28. For hit, Angelista's Grasp (BWL belt) Lightemgee · 2026-03-23. - **Naxx-level example** (Summonjutsu's log): T2 helm with the ZG enchant, Dianna's Pearl Necklace, T3 shoulders, Cloak of Consumption, Bracers of Arcane Accuracy, T2 gloves/pants/boots, T3 belt, AQ20 set ring, Band of Concentration, The Black Book, Wraith Blade, Bag of Whammies, Wand of Fates Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-21. - Cloak: Sapphiron's cloak over Drape of Nordrassil Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2026-01-04.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Summoning a greater demon mid-fight or with under 3 minutes of boss left; letting it time out and turn on you. - Popping trinkets before the 3rd Unleashed Potential stack. - Power Overwhelming on a low-health pet during AoE; not telling healers. - Forgetting to re-set Felstorm to manual and Cleave to autocast after each summon. - Leaving the pet in unavoidable damage: Four Horsemen marks, Thaddius, Sapphiron's blizzard, Heigan's dance Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-07-31, L-star · 2025-09-20. - Letting Felstorm run before the tank has AoE threat. - Taking Demonic Sacrifice together with Soul Link. - Stacking haste as Demonology.

enchants.heading: Enchants, oils and consumables
enchants.markdown: - **Enchants:** the same slots as [Affliction](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps), but take spell power, crit and hit over haste, since haste does not help your demon W · 2026-03-31. Head/legs: ZG enchant Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-21. - **Weapon:** Wizard Oil or Blessed Wizard Oil Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-21. - **Stones:** Felstone for groups; Firestone for dungeons and solo play Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-02-23. Firestone crit does **not** carry over to your demon Szalor · 2025-10-05. - **Raid kit:** Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Elixir of Shadow Power or Greater Firepower, Dreamshard Elixir, Dreamtonic, wizard oil, spell-damage food Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-21, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. Elixir of Shadow Power boosts both the Succubus's melee and Lash of Pain; Firepower only Lash of Pain Deleted User · 2025-10-04.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown:
The decision loop for a level-60 raid boss with the 0/34/17 build. The reasons and sources are in [Single-target rotation](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps), [AoE and trash](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps), [Greater demons](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps) and [Cooldowns, resources and threat](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps).

1. **Before the pull:** summon this boss's greater demon ([which one](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps)). Set its autocasts: Felguard Cleave on, Felstorm manual; Doomguard Infernal Blade on. Keep the pet on passive or defensive. On short fights, pre-stack Unleashed Potential on the last trash pack.
2. **Opener:** pet attack → curse (Recklessness if you are free to choose) → Shadow Bolt until Unleashed Potential has 3 stacks. Then on-use trinket → Power Overwhelming → Felstorm.
3. **Single-target loop (top wins):**
    1. Pet not attacking → pet attack.
    2. Power Overwhelming ready, and the demon can afford 40% of its base health → Power Overwhelming (no GCD).
    3. Unleashed Potential about to fall off → any direct-damage spell, or one tick of rank-1 Health Funnel or Mana Funnel.
    4. Curse missing → curse.
    5. Corruption only if it will run its full duration.
    6. Shadow Bolt as the filler. On short fights, use Searing Pain and Shadowburn.
    7. Demon below ~50%, with no AoE coming → Health Funnel.
    8. Life Tap when low on mana.
4. **Cooldowns:** a greater demon stays under your control for 3 minutes. Finish it with Power Overwhelming before it breaks free. Use Fel Domination for an instant resummon when a lesser demon dies ([Cooldowns](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps)).
5. **AoE switch:**
    - 1-2 targets: the single-target loop.
    - 3+ stacked targets that live more than a few seconds: Felstorm, then Hellfire if the tank holds threat. Let the tank AoE-taunt before Felstorm.
    - Fast trash: curse and Shadow Bolt only.
6. **Resources and threat:** this spec has the worst mana of the three. Use Life Tap and mana potions, and skip Potion of Quickness. Greater demons cannot receive Salvation. If one out-threats the tank, pull it back or let it die.
7. **Movement:** use Shadowburn while you move. Re-issue pet attack after every Take Position.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Demonic Precision passes 90% of your spell hit and crit to the demon (CC3), which is why Demonology shares gear with Destruction and why the wiki's priority is "Hit and Crit". Spell power then matters twice over: Unleashed Potential converts 15% of your bonus spell damage per stack (up to three) into the demon's attack and spell power. Stamina is wanted for Power Overwhelming, which costs 40% of the demon's base health, and for Soul Link.

glance.recommendation: In a raid that pulls on time and heals your pet, play the **0/34/17** build. Summon a greater demon before every pull: Felguard for burst and AoE, Infernal for fire-immune bosses and whenever it is off cooldown, Doomguard for single-target. Open with pet attack → curse (Recklessness if you are free to choose) → Shadow Bolt. Once Unleashed Potential reaches 3 stacks, press trinkets, Power Overwhelming and Felstorm. Keep your demon alive yourself with Health Funnel. Gear for about 6% hit, then crit and spell power. Haste does nothing for your demon.

facts.label: Role
facts.markdown: Ranged DPS where the demon deals most of the damage; raid curses

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **S (raid bosses) in organised raids, B-C in pugs.** After release, Demonology "took over the throne" Tatica ツ · 2026-03-21; players call it "the meta" Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-03-31. L-star placed 2nd overall and 4th on trash in a 1:45 Kara40, above the mages L-star · 2026-03-23. It collapses when pulls are late, healers ignore the pet or the raid wipes and burns your greater demon Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-22. The class designer calls it the highest ceiling but "pretty sweaty" W · 2026-03-24.

facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: High. You manage cooldowns, pet health, pet positioning and a 3-minute greater-demon timer.

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Highest boss damage; Felguard's Felstorm is "potentially the strongest AoE in the game" W · 2026-02-21; hit and crit feed both you and the demon; least gear-dependent spec for a fresh 60 Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: "The cooldown spec" Minces · 2026-01-24: at best about 24 minutes of greater-demon uptime per hour Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. No way to reduce pet threat Szalor · 2026-03-23. Greater demons died on most Kara40 bosses before the cleave fix Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2026-01-25. Greater-demon pathing stayed broken from January 2026 to the server's end Tapka · 2026-04-19.

glance.rest: Before 1.18.1, Unleashed Potential only procced from crits ("not enough uptime without a crit focused build"), and Demonology was a niche short-fight spec embodiedchaos · 2025-10-28. The release made Unleashed Potential proc from any direct damage rey.1982 · 2026-02-04, and Demonology rose to the top.

playbooks.title: Destruction Warlock (Fire "Firelock" and Shadow SM/Ruin)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play **Fire 0/11/40** once you are past the fire-immune raids and have about 16% hit from gear. Open Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate, keep Immolate up, press Soul Fire, Conflagrate and Shadowburn on cooldown, and spam **Searing Pain** in between. Sacrifice your Imp. For Molten Core, Blackwing Lair and Onyxia, play Affliction or Demonology instead. **SM/Ruin** (30/0/21, Shadow Bolt) still works, but it is behind Affliction at every gear level people have tested. | | | |---|---| | Role | Ranged burst DPS (Fire) or Shadow Bolt DPS (SM/Ruin); raid curses; the class's AoE (Hellfire, Rain of Fire) | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Fire: B (raid), A (dungeons and trash).** "Fire lock is fine post-bwl, but you'll never be able to compete with drain or demo locks" Fauxnetic · 2026-04-13. "Big bursty, really fun in dungeon, but not raid viable atm" Fr6'P · 2026-04-13. One player ranks it second after Demonology post-patch Tatica ツ · 2026-03-21; it performs well on Mephistroth Rob0t · 2026-04-16. **SM/Ruin: C.** "Largely untouched" by the patch Lightemgee · 2026-03-20, and behind Affliction in matched-gear sims biloen · 2026-01-24. | | Difficulty | Medium. The rotation is short; the hard part is threat and mana. | | Strengths | Front-loaded burst (Soul Fire crits around 6k) Duroz · 2026-03-23; the best spec for smashing through dungeons and killing elites fast Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-01; good on trash Duroz · 2026-01-31 | | Weaknesses | Needs **all 16% hit from gear** (no hit talent), and the burst on pull has no threat reduction, so you need a good tank biloen · 2026-04-06. Fire-immune bosses in MC, BWL and Onyxia Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-19, Mima · 2026-03-30, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-27. Falls off in late raid tiers Dezmar · 2026-03-25. | Before 1.18.1, Nezu summed it up as "fire and sm/ruin underperform in every branch of the pve content tree. There's nobody playing fire in raids" Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2026-01-25. The patch reworked Searing Pain: 2.0 s base cast, 57% spell-power scaling, 1 s GCD, Bane cuts up to 0.5 s from its cast, and later +20% base damage [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071), Afraido · 2026-01-26, Feenik · 2026-03-20. W called the spell-power change "basically a +14% spell power scaling buff" for Searing Pain W · 2026-01-27. **Contested:** how high Fire's ceiling is. Not Normal argues that too few people play it seriously for logs to show its ceiling Not Normal · 2025-12-23. Frolegacy concluded it is still the worst spec overall Frolegacy · 2026-03-18.

Demonic Aegis replaces the old Improved Healthstone points, which became Sinister Pursuit (pet speed) in 1.18.1 Erko · 2026-03-20, biloen · 2026-03-20. - **Bane 5/5** brings Searing Pain from 2.0 s to 1.5 s [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **Improved Soul Fire 2/2:** Soul Fire's buff increases your fire damage and refunds the shard; it now applies on cast, so it cannot be lost to a miss [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460). - **Conflagrate** consumes 3 s of Immolate for damage instead of removing it [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102973#p102973). - **Aftermath** (Immolate damage and a slow) and Pyroclasm (stun) are "nice but very unreliable" Afraido · 2026-03-28. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: **Fire:** 1. **Hit to 16%, all from gear** biloen · 2026-04-06. One Destro planner reached cap on Ambershire with about 15% from gear PBnJames · 2026-04-01. 2. **Crit and spell power.** Fire, SM/Ruin and Demonology gear the same way: spell power and crit Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. Afraido's values at ~1,000 SP: 1% hit ≈ 18 SP, 1% crit ≈ 13 SP Afraido · 2026-03-15. 3. **Haste:** helps Searing Pain now that it has a real cast time. Use haste potions and Juju Flurry as Destruction too Sehnsucht · 2026-03-26. 4. **Stamina** for the shards and Life Taps. **SM/Ruin:** hit to 16% (Suppression covers only your DoTs), then crit and spell power. **Contested:** rqo argues haste beats crit because Shadow Bolt is only ~65% of SM/Ruin damage rqo · 2026-01-24. Summonjutsu counters that crits are more mana-efficient, and haste makes you Life Tap more Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. L-star puts Shadow Bolt at 55-60% of SM/Ruin damage L-star · 2026-04-07.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Fire **Opener:** Soul Fire (pre-cast before the pull) → Immolate → Conflagrate Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21, Karen · 2026-04-21. **Priority list** (top wins): 1. **Improved Soul Fire buff missing and Soul Fire ready → Soul Fire.** It still hits harder per cast than Searing Pain, and its buff boosts Conflagrate, Immolate and Searing Pain Duroz · 2026-03-23. 2. **Immolate missing → Immolate.** If the target will die within 9 s, skip it and cast Searing Pain Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26. 3. **Conflagrate ready and Immolate up → Conflagrate.** 4. **Shadowburn ready → Shadowburn**, unless you are short on mana (it is inefficient) Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. 5. **Assigned curse missing → curse** (1 s GCD). 6. **Searing Pain** as the filler. It costs only about 151 mana at 60 with 5/5 Cataclysm Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26. 7. **Life Tap** when needed; use mana potions and tea Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. **Contested — Corruption and Curse of Agony:** L-star keeps Corruption in, because "anything that isn't searing pain is huge dps increase" L-star · 2026-02-01. Twospooky's Naxx advice drops both Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. Biloen notes it depends on how much of your spell power is fire-only biloen · 2026-02-01. Also: do not chain instant casts back to back Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. On the first pull, burst carefully: Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate is "extremely bursty on pull with no threat reduction" biloen · 2026-04-06. ### SM/Ruin 1. **Curse** (Shadows, Recklessness or Elements; Malediction adds Curse of Agony) → **Corruption** dobbyatmos · 2026-02-26. 2. **Shadow Bolt** spam. 3. **Shadowburn** on a low target when you cannot fit a Shadow Bolt dobbyatmos · 2026-02-26. 4. **Siphon Life** on long fights (e.g. Patchwerk); **Drain Soul** as filler on long-lived targets while Shadowburn is on cooldown dobbyatmos · 2026-02-26. 5. **Nightfall proc → instant Shadow Bolt.** In dungeons, skip the DoTs and just Shadow Bolt TowelDruid · 2026-03-25.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns, resources and threat
cooldowns.markdown: - **Soul Fire** (30 s cooldown, costs a shard, refunded by Improved Soul Fire), **Conflagrate**, **Shadowburn** (costs a shard) — on cooldown. - **Mana:** Fire burns more mana than the other specs. Sacrifice the Felhunter instead of the Imp to Life Tap less, and bring mana potions and tea Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. - **Threat:** no reduction talent. Use Voidstone (15% with Improved Stones Nusabi · 2026-04-08), Salvation, and hold off the full opener until the tank has a lead. - **Firestone:** +2% fire crit, doubled to 4% by Improved Stones Szalor · 2025-10-05. Its fire proc scales only with your level (about 64 damage at 60) Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-03.

roleStrategy.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Fire-immune bosses:** MC Ragnaros and Baron Geddon (plus the fire elemental; use Shadow Bolt) Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-27, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-19; BWL Vaelastrasz, the three drakes and Nefarian — Broodlord, Chromaggus and most BWL trash are fine Mima · 2026-03-30; Onyxia Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-27. See [Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core), [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair), [Onyxia's Lair](#/instances/onyxias-lair). - **Mephistroth** (Kara40): Destruction performs well on him Rob0t · 2026-04-16. Searing Pain is Demonology's main spell there too L-star · 2026-03-23. The hellfire imps are fire-immune and the crawlers shadow-immune Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-24. - **Thaddius:** hold Conflagrate and Shadowburn until you have a Polarity Charge stack. **Loatheb:** take the first spore. **Four Horsemen:** do not Shadowburn Zeliek; watch threat Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. - **Dungeons:** Fire is the spec for fast group leveling and elite burn-downs Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-01. Tanking with Fire is covered in [Warlock tanking](#/class/warlock/guide/warlock-tank).

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **No dedicated Destruction tier set.** Destro uses the Demonology T1/T2 sets by default peter_hammer · 2026-03-19; Lightemgee calls them "atrocious for destro" Lightemgee · 2025-11-19. - **AQ40 Implements of Unspoken Names** (ring, kris, shroud): the ring gives +1% crit, +1% hit and +14 spell damage; the 2-piece gives +5% pet damage; the **3-piece** cuts Immolate's cast by 0.5 s and makes Conflagrate deal 3 s of Immolate damage without consuming it Agitation / Jinxi · 2025-07-28. - **T3.5 Destruction 5-piece** is close to worthless. It does about half its apparent intended value, and two bug reports were closed as "working as intended" Andrion · 2026-02-13. Its Felfire Punishment was about 1% of total damage in real Kara40 logs Szalor · 2026-02-27. - **Timbermaw Hold 3-piece** for Fire: legs and shoulders are the best slots to replace T3 #1 top Render · 2026-04-10. The TMH hit trinket is best for Fire locks Afraido · 2026-04-16. - **True Band of Sulfuras** becomes attractive for Fire, because its proc needs direct-damage casts biloen · 2026-03-27. - **Ornate Bloodstone Dagger:** about a 5% spell-power coefficient on its proc, poor value Not Normal · 2026-01-07. W's "Fire & Shadow" style uses it: alternate Shadow Bolt and Searing Pain so the fire-school proc lands while you cast Searing Pain and does not push you back W · 2026-05-16. - **Class weapon Thil'phoral** ([Timbermaw Hold](#/instances/timbermaw-hold)): on a heroic dummy, a Demo-Fire lock did slightly more with Thil'phoral plus the Onyxia offhand than with the Kirel Narak offhand Zythius · 2026-04-16. - **SM/Ruin example** (L-star): full T2.5, Wraith Blade, the Naxx negative-resistance offhand, Bindings of Contained Magic, Affliction T3 ring, Kara10 Medivh ring, the Naxx resistance-shred pendant, Remains of Overwhelming Power, Neltharion's Tear, later the Scythe L-star · 2026-01-24.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Bringing Fire to fire-immune bosses.
- Casting Shadow Bolt in a Fire spec [Spritzbube, 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169207#p169207).
- Opening with the full burst before the tank has threat.
- Hellfire without warning the healers, or into a cleaving pack.
- Chaining instants back to back and wasting Shadowburn shards while mana-starved.
- Expecting Pyroclasm stuns from Hellfire.
- Playing SM/Ruin below T2.5 hit levels and blaming the spec.

enchants.heading: Enchants, oils, consumables
enchants.markdown: - **Enchants:** the same slots as [Affliction](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps), but take spell power and crit over haste. Community wiki: gloves Fire Power for Fire [community wiki](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Warlock). - **Weapon:** Brilliant Wizard Oil. - **Consumables:** mana potions and tea Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21; Potion of Quickness and Juju Flurry Sehnsucht · 2026-03-26; Greater Firepower for Fire; flasks and elixirs as for [Affliction](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps). extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown:
The decision loop at level 60. The reasons and sources are in [Fire](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps), [SM/Ruin](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps), [AoE](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps) and [Cooldowns, resources and threat](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps).

**Fire (0/11/40):**

1. **Before the pull:** sacrifice the Imp, or the Felhunter if mana is your limit. Carry a Firestone. Bring about 16% hit from gear.
2. **Opener:** pre-cast Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate. This is very bursty with no threat reduction, so give the tank a lead first.
3. **Single-target loop (top wins):**
    1. Improved Soul Fire buff missing and Soul Fire ready → Soul Fire.
    2. Immolate missing → Immolate. Skip it if the target dies within 9 s.
    3. Conflagrate ready and Immolate up → Conflagrate.
    4. Shadowburn ready → Shadowburn, unless you are short on mana.
    5. Assigned curse missing → curse.
    6. Searing Pain as the filler.
    7. Life Tap when needed.
4. **Cooldowns:** Soul Fire, Conflagrate and Shadowburn go on cooldown. Do not chain instant casts back to back.
5. **AoE switch:**
    - 1-3 targets: Immolate each, then Searing Pain in mark order.
    - 3-5+ targets stacked on the tank: Hellfire.
    - A pack that cleaves or needs range: Rain of Fire.
6. **Resources and threat:** Fire uses the most mana of the specs. Use mana potions and tea, and sacrifice the Felhunter if you Life Tap too often. For threat, use Voidstone and Salvation.
7. **Movement:** Conflagrate, Shadowburn and curses are instant; save them for when you have to move. Fire-immune bosses (MC, BWL, Onyxia): play Affliction or Demonology instead.

**SM/Ruin (30/0/21):** curse (Malediction adds Curse of Agony) → Corruption → Shadow Bolt spam. Nightfall proc → instant Shadow Bolt. Use Shadowburn on a low target when a Shadow Bolt will not fit. On long fights, add Siphon Life, and Drain Soul while Shadowburn is on cooldown. In dungeons, skip the DoTs and just cast Shadow Bolt.

glance.recommendation: Play **Fire 0/11/40** once you are past the fire-immune raids and have about 16% hit from gear. Open Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate, keep Immolate up, press Soul Fire, Conflagrate and Shadowburn on cooldown, and spam **Searing Pain** in between. Sacrifice your Imp. For Molten Core, Blackwing Lair and Onyxia, play Affliction or Demonology instead. **SM/Ruin** (30/0/21, Shadow Bolt) still works, but it is behind Affliction at every gear level people have tested.

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)

"Big bursty, really fun in dungeon, but not raid viable atm" Fr6'P · 2026-04-13. talents.heading: Talent build
talents.markdown: ### Fire 0/11/40 (recommended) Afraido pinned this on release day Afraido · 2026-03-19. It takes **Intensity 2/2** (pushback protection) instead of the wiki's Destructive Reach (range), which Afraido called a mistake Afraido · 2026-03-19. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Demonology | Demonic Embrace | 5/5 | | Demonology | Soul Entrapment | 3/3 | | Demonology | Demonic Aegis | 2/3 | | Demonology | Demonic Sacrifice | 1/1 | | Destruction | Cataclysm | 5/5 | | Destruction | Bane | 5/5 | | Destruction | Aftermath | 3/3 | | Destruction | Intensity | 2/2 | | Destruction | Shadowburn | 1/1 | | Destruction | Devastation | 5/5 | | Destruction | Improved Searing Pain | 5/5 | | Destruction | Improved Soul Fire | 2/2 | | Destruction | Improved Immolate | 5/5 | | Destruction | Ruin | 1/1 | | Destruction | Emberstorm | 5/5 | | Destruction | Conflagrate | 1/1 | Split **0/11/40**, validated with `talent_tool.py` (VALID). Calculator codes: `talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock?points=-ArCAAB-AoFYRoAFVIAoB` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=warlock&t=-053020001-0505321500525151)) · `talents.turtlecraft.gg/warlock/-5IC06-55KB0WVV` Why these points: - **The 11-point dip** is the cheapest way to Demonic Sacrifice: Imp sacrifice for +4% spell damage, plus Soul Entrapment's +6% with no demon out [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159). Demonic Aegis replaces the old Improved Healthstone points, which became Sinister Pursuit (pet speed) in 1.18.1 Erko · 2026-03-20, biloen · 2026-03-20. - **Bane 5/5** brings Searing Pain from 2.0 s to 1.5 s [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). - **Improved Soul Fire 2/2:** Soul Fire's buff increases your fire damage and refunds the shard; it now applies on cast, so it cannot be lost to a miss [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460). - **Conflagrate** consumes 3 s of Immolate for damage instead of removing it [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102973#p102973). - **Aftermath** (Immolate damage and a slow) and Pyroclasm (stun) are "nice but very unreliable" Afraido · 2026-03-28. Pyroclasm rolls only once per Hellfire channel, not per tick Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-08, so it is skipped. ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Range (wiki / Summonjutsu)** | Destructive Reach 2/2 instead of Intensity 2/2. More range, less threat, and a bigger Hellfire radius; no pushback protection | `-ArCAAB-AoFYBoCFVIAoB` | Summonjutsu's Searing Pain build Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26; Afraido prefers Intensity Afraido · 2026-03-19 | | **Fel Domination** | Drop Shadowburn for Fel Domination for faster re-sacrifices after wipes | swap in the calculator | Summonjutsu Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26 | | **Shadow Bolt Destro (17/3/31)** | Affliction to Nightfall (Suppression 5, Improved Corruption 5, Improved Life Tap 2, Improved Curse of Agony 3, Nightfall 2), Soul Entrapment 3, Shadow Vulnerability instead of Cataclysm, Emberstorm only 2/5 | `FoAQYAC-AD-FAFYAoCAVIAQB` ([calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=warlock&t=55002030002-003-5005300502025121)) | Summonjutsu: "this one runs shadow bolt" Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26 | | **Demo-Fire hybrid** | 0/34/17 Demonology with Cataclysm instead of Shadow Vulnerability, Searing Pain as filler | see [Demonology](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps) | Fauxnetic · 2026-04-13, Zythius · 2026-04-16 | ### SM/Ruin 30/0/21 (Shadow Bolt) TowelDruid's post-release link TowelDruid · 2026-03-25. SM/Ruin keeps the Imp for Blood Pact; it has no Demonology points. | Tree | Talent | Points | |---|---|---| | Affliction | Suppression | 5/5 | | Affliction | Improved Corruption | 5/5 | | Affliction | Improved Life Tap | 2/2 | | Affliction | Improved Curse of Agony | 3/3 | | Affliction | Grim Reach | 2/2 | | Affliction | Nightfall | 2/2 | | Affliction | Soul Siphon | 2/3 | | Affliction | Rapid Deterioration | 2/2 | | Affliction | Siphon Life | 1/1 | | Affliction | Malediction | 1/1 | | Affliction | Shadow Mastery | 5/5 | | Destruction | Shadow Vulnerability | 5/5 | | Destruction | Demonic Swiftness | 2/2 | | Destruction | Bane | 5/5 | | Destruction | Shadowburn | 1/1 | | Destruction | Devastation | 5/5 | | Destruction | Destructive Reach | 2/2 | | Destruction | Ruin | 1/1 | Split **30/0/21**, validated with `talent_tool.py` (VALID). An Atiesh holder is often SM/Ruin, because the staff's raid buff is worth more than personal DPS Braszunda · 2025-10-25.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: **Fire:** 1. **Hit to 16%, all from gear** biloen · 2026-04-06. One Destro planner reached cap on Ambershire with about 15% from gear PBnJames · 2026-04-01. 2. **Crit and spell power.** Fire, SM/Ruin and Demonology gear the same way: spell power and crit Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. Afraido's values at ~1,000 SP: 1% hit ≈ 18 SP, 1% crit ≈ 13 SP Afraido · 2026-03-15. 3. **Haste:** helps Searing Pain now that it has a real cast time. Use haste potions and Juju Flurry as Destruction too Sehnsucht · 2026-03-26. 4. **Stamina** for the shards and Life Taps. **SM/Ruin:** hit to 16% (Suppression covers only your DoTs), then crit and spell power. **Contested:** rqo argues haste beats crit because Shadow Bolt is only ~65% of SM/Ruin damage rqo · 2026-01-24. Summonjutsu counters that crits are more mana-efficient, and haste makes you Life Tap more Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. L-star puts Shadow Bolt at 55-60% of SM/Ruin damage L-star · 2026-04-07.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Fire **Opener:** Soul Fire (pre-cast before the pull) → Immolate → Conflagrate Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21, Karen · 2026-04-21. **Priority list** (top wins): 1. **Improved Soul Fire buff missing and Soul Fire ready → Soul Fire.** It still hits harder per cast than Searing Pain, and its buff boosts Conflagrate, Immolate and Searing Pain Duroz · 2026-03-23. 2. **Immolate missing → Immolate.** If the target will die within 9 s, skip it and cast Searing Pain Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26. 3. **Conflagrate ready and Immolate up → Conflagrate.** 4. **Shadowburn ready → Shadowburn**, unless you are short on mana (it is inefficient) Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. 5. **Assigned curse missing → curse** (1 s GCD). 6. **Searing Pain** as the filler. It costs only about 151 mana at 60 with 5/5 Cataclysm Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26. 7. **Life Tap** when needed; use mana potions and tea Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. **Contested — Corruption and Curse of Agony:** L-star keeps Corruption in, because "anything that isn't searing pain is huge dps increase" L-star · 2026-02-01. Twospooky's Naxx advice drops both Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. Biloen notes it depends on how much of your spell power is fire-only biloen · 2026-02-01. Also: do not chain instant casts back to back Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. On the first pull, burst carefully: Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate is "extremely bursty on pull with no threat reduction" biloen · 2026-04-06. ### SM/Ruin 1. **Curse** (Shadows, Recklessness or Elements; Malediction adds Curse of Agony) → **Corruption** dobbyatmos · 2026-02-26. 2. **Shadow Bolt** spam. 3. **Shadowburn** on a low target when you cannot fit a Shadow Bolt dobbyatmos · 2026-02-26. 4. **Siphon Life** on long fights (e.g. Patchwerk); **Drain Soul** as filler on long-lived targets while Shadowburn is on cooldown dobbyatmos · 2026-02-26. 5. **Nightfall proc → instant Shadow Bolt.** In dungeons, skip the DoTs and just Shadow Bolt TowelDruid · 2026-03-25.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE
rotationAoe.markdown: | Targets | What to do | Source | |---|---|---| | 1-3 | Immolate each target, then kill in mark order with Searing Pain | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-08 | | 3-5+, stacked on the tank | **Hellfire.** It ticks for about 300-350 fully specced; use it on 5+ packs such as Emerald Sanctum trash and the packs before Gnarlmoon | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-27, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-27 | | Pack that cleaves or needs range | **Rain of Fire** (ticks every second; its coefficient roughly doubled in 1.18.0) | Not Normal · 2025-12-23 | Numbers: - **Hellfire** in 1.18.1: 6.66% spell power per tick; 15 ticks add up to 99.9% W · 2026-03-24. Its mana is now paid across the channel instead of up front [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071). Players still found the real gain small iwasPickleRick · 2026-03-24. - Hellfire roots you in the pack, damages you and generates heavy threat. Wrathstone cuts the self-damage by 30% but adds 40% fire threat [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102973#p102973). Warn the tank and healers. - Before the Hellfire buff, Rain of Fire beat Hellfire above ~1,200 SP Deleted User · 2025-10-08. No post-buff comparison was posted. - **Bug:** Rain of Fire misses targets in some ZG, AQ20, 5-man and Scholomance spots where Hellfire still hits Frolegacy · 2026-02-26, Frolegacy · 2026-02-26. Warlock AoE is still called weak overall L-star · 2026-02-09. "If there is one thing Destro should be good at, it is AoE" Afraido · 2026-03-24.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns, resources and threat
cooldowns.markdown: - **Soul Fire** (30 s cooldown, costs a shard, refunded by Improved Soul Fire), **Conflagrate**, **Shadowburn** (costs a shard) — on cooldown. - **Mana:** Fire burns more mana than the other specs. Sacrifice the Felhunter instead of the Imp to Life Tap less, and bring mana potions and tea Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. - **Threat:** no reduction talent. Use Voidstone (15% with Improved Stones Nusabi · 2026-04-08), Salvation, and hold off the full opener until the tank has a lead. - **Firestone:** +2% fire crit, doubled to 4% by Improved Stones Szalor · 2025-10-05. Its fire proc scales only with your level (about 64 damage at 60) Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-03.

roleStrategy.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Fire-immune bosses:** MC Ragnaros and Baron Geddon (plus the fire elemental; use Shadow Bolt) Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-27, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-19; BWL Vaelastrasz, the three drakes and Nefarian — Broodlord, Chromaggus and most BWL trash are fine Mima · 2026-03-30; Onyxia Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-27. See [Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core), [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair), [Onyxia's Lair](#/instances/onyxias-lair). - **Mephistroth** (Kara40): Destruction performs well on him Rob0t · 2026-04-16. Searing Pain is Demonology's main spell there too L-star · 2026-03-23. The hellfire imps are fire-immune and the crawlers shadow-immune Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-24. - **Thaddius:** hold Conflagrate and Shadowburn until you have a Polarity Charge stack. **Loatheb:** take the first spore. **Four Horsemen:** do not Shadowburn Zeliek; watch threat Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21. - **Dungeons:** Fire is the spec for fast group leveling and elite burn-downs Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-01. Tanking with Fire is covered in [Warlock tanking](#/class/warlock/guide/warlock-tank).

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: - **No dedicated Destruction tier set.** Destro uses the Demonology T1/T2 sets by default peter_hammer · 2026-03-19; Lightemgee calls them "atrocious for destro" Lightemgee · 2025-11-19. - **AQ40 Implements of Unspoken Names** (ring, kris, shroud): the ring gives +1% crit, +1% hit and +14 spell damage; the 2-piece gives +5% pet damage; the **3-piece** cuts Immolate's cast by 0.5 s and makes Conflagrate deal 3 s of Immolate damage without consuming it Agitation / Jinxi · 2025-07-28. - **T3.5 Destruction 5-piece** is close to worthless. It does about half its apparent intended value, and two bug reports were closed as "working as intended" Andrion · 2026-02-13. Its Felfire Punishment was about 1% of total damage in real Kara40 logs Szalor · 2026-02-27. - **Timbermaw Hold 3-piece** for Fire: legs and shoulders are the best slots to replace T3 #1 top Render · 2026-04-10. The TMH hit trinket is best for Fire locks Afraido · 2026-04-16. - **True Band of Sulfuras** becomes attractive for Fire, because its proc needs direct-damage casts biloen · 2026-03-27. - **Ornate Bloodstone Dagger:** about a 5% spell-power coefficient on its proc, poor value Not Normal · 2026-01-07. W's "Fire & Shadow" style uses it: alternate Shadow Bolt and Searing Pain so the fire-school proc lands while you cast Searing Pain and does not push you back W · 2026-05-16. - **Class weapon Thil'phoral** ([Timbermaw Hold](#/instances/timbermaw-hold)): on a heroic dummy, a Demo-Fire lock did slightly more with Thil'phoral plus the Onyxia offhand than with the Kirel Narak offhand Zythius · 2026-04-16. - **SM/Ruin example** (L-star): full T2.5, Wraith Blade, the Naxx negative-resistance offhand, Bindings of Contained Magic, Affliction T3 ring, Kara10 Medivh ring, the Naxx resistance-shred pendant, Remains of Overwhelming Power, Neltharion's Tear, later the Scythe L-star · 2026-01-24.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Bringing Fire to fire-immune bosses.
- Casting Shadow Bolt in a Fire spec [Spritzbube, 2026-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169207#p169207).
- Opening with the full burst before the tank has threat.
- Hellfire without warning the healers, or into a cleaving pack.
- Chaining instants back to back and wasting Shadowburn shards while mana-starved.
- Expecting Pyroclasm stuns from Hellfire.
- Playing SM/Ruin below T2.5 hit levels and blaming the spec.

enchants.heading: Enchants, oils, consumables
enchants.markdown: - **Enchants:** the same slots as [Affliction](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps), but take spell power and crit over haste. Community wiki: gloves Fire Power for Fire [community wiki](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Warlock). - **Weapon:** Brilliant Wizard Oil. - **Consumables:** mana potions and tea Twospooky 😇 · 2026-04-21; Potion of Quickness and Juju Flurry Sehnsucht · 2026-03-26; Greater Firepower for Fire; flasks and elixirs as for [Affliction](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps). Goblin Sapper Charges on Naxx spider trash dindunuffinz · 2026-01-11.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown:
The decision loop at level 60. The reasons and sources are in [Fire](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps), [SM/Ruin](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps), [AoE](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps) and [Cooldowns, resources and threat](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps).

**Fire (0/11/40):**

1. **Before the pull:** sacrifice the Imp, or the Felhunter if mana is your limit. Carry a Firestone. Bring about 16% hit from gear.
2. **Opener:** pre-cast Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate. This is very bursty with no threat reduction, so give the tank a lead first.
3. **Single-target loop (top wins):**
    1. Improved Soul Fire buff missing and Soul Fire ready → Soul Fire.
    2. Immolate missing → Immolate. Skip it if the target dies within 9 s.
    3. Conflagrate ready and Immolate up → Conflagrate.
    4. Shadowburn ready → Shadowburn, unless you are short on mana.
    5. Assigned curse missing → curse.
    6. Searing Pain as the filler.
    7. Life Tap when needed.
4. **Cooldowns:** Soul Fire, Conflagrate and Shadowburn go on cooldown. Do not chain instant casts back to back.
5. **AoE switch:**
    - 1-3 targets: Immolate each, then Searing Pain in mark order.
    - 3-5+ targets stacked on the tank: Hellfire.
    - A pack that cleaves or needs range: Rain of Fire.
6. **Resources and threat:** Fire uses the most mana of the specs. Use mana potions and tea, and sacrifice the Felhunter if you Life Tap too often. For threat, use Voidstone and Salvation.
7. **Movement:** Conflagrate, Shadowburn and curses are instant; save them for when you have to move. Fire-immune bosses (MC, BWL, Onyxia): play Affliction or Demonology instead.

**SM/Ruin (30/0/21):** curse (Malediction adds Curse of Agony) → Corruption → Shadow Bolt spam. Nightfall proc → instant Shadow Bolt. Use Shadowburn on a low target when a Shadow Bolt will not fit. On long fights, add Siphon Life, and Drain Soul while Shadowburn is on cooldown. In dungeons, skip the DoTs and just cast Shadow Bolt.

glance.recommendation: Play **Fire 0/11/40** once you are past the fire-immune raids and have about 16% hit from gear. Open Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate, keep Immolate up, press Soul Fire, Conflagrate and Shadowburn on cooldown, and spam **Searing Pain** in between. Sacrifice your Imp. playbooks.title: Warlock PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play **Affliction 35/5/11** with a **Felhunter** or **Succubus**. Put Curse of Exhaustion on melee, DoT everyone from 36 yards, and Drain while they chase you. Save Death Coil for the moment a rogue or warrior reaches you. Destruction (Fire burst) and Soul Link Demonology are the alternatives: Destruction for burst when your group peels for you, Soul Link or greater demons for duels and arenas. Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). | Spec | PvP standing (1.18.1) | Why | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Affliction** | **Best** ("S") | Curse of Exhaustion: 40% slow, 36 yd, instant, no cooldown. Everything you cast has 36 yd range. Dark Harvest "hits like a truck" once geared | Fuggle the Dampened · 2026-04-02, Afraido · 2026-04-08, Afraido · 2026-04-08, sailorVEVO · 2025-12-25 | | **Destruction (Fire)** | **Contested** ("A" to "wheelchair") | Burst with slows, stuns and crits secures kills vs kiting classes. But: no Curse of Exhaustion and everything is hard-cast | For: Qazdur · 2026-03-28, Livius · 2026-04-18. Against: Tapka · 2026-03-28 | | **Demonology** | **B** | Great in duels and arenas (greater demons "can't be cc'd and will one shot every spec"); weak in battlegrounds, where one Fear, Banish or Hamstring on your pet wastes your cooldowns | Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-08, dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07, L-star · 2026-01-17 | **Contested standing overall.** The devs said warlocks had the highest PvP win rate on the server, and used that to justify the 1.18.1 nerfs W · 2026-01-25. Players on Ambershire called warlocks "very squishy, and relatively harmless" Zent · 2026-01-24. #pvp-general's pre-release tier list put Warlock in C, "getting heavily nerfed after being dominant" saplingsam · 2025-08-14. Post-release, #pvp-general opinion split by build: Bipst calls locks "very good... oppressive damage and can be quite tanky if they go double shield [Soul Link]" and annoying to casters via the Felhunter's dispel and silence Bipst · 2025-10-21; Kyrsie counters that the average lock is Fire-specced without Soul Link and is "one shot or go home" Kyrsie · 2025-10-21. **1.18.1 PvP damping and resilience:** both hit warlocks twice, because most of their damage is DoTs Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. One player felt he hit "like a wet noodle" jack.e · 2026-04-05. **Contested:** Afraido says "your target dies 1 or 2 seconds later than before, not a big deal" Afraido · 2026-04-08. Curse of Agony still ramps: 3 ticks of 50, 3 of 100, 3 of 150 Afraido · 2026-04-08. Curse of Exhaustion is now "hard to use if you aren't affli" Lightemgee · 2026-04-11. Soul Link was cut to 20% for PvP reasons [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Stamina first, then spell power.** Haste is worth less than in PvE Morweyn · 2026-02-06. Crit for Destruction. - **Hit:** 3% for level-60 targets Afraido · 2026-03-04. There is always about 1% miss left over Knarlsburg · 2026-01-17. - **Best PvP gear is PvE gear** Actualrodent · 2025-07-28: 2 pieces of the PvP set for the stamina bonus, the rest raid pieces Mmr · 2023-10-13. A full-PvP-geared warlock reaches about 6.8k health, the Voidwalker about 8k Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-01. - **The 1.18.1 PvP set** bonuses favour Destruction while most PvP warlocks play Affliction Knarlsburg · 2026-04-08; L-star wished he had bought the old gloves L-star · 2026-03-28. - **The Rank 12 (AB) PvP set 2-piece** is called an underrated stat stick, a solid option specifically for locks, similar to some other classes' cheap 2-piece PvP set bonuses lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-11, lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-11. - **The PvE Tier 2.5 ("Dark Harvest") set bonus also matters in PvP:** it adds a stacking burst effect that ramps with your Shadow Vulnerability stacks over a fight, landing roughly 1,400 extra damage "at the end" on top of Dark Harvest's own ~400-450 Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29. - **Rank-8 PvP gloves** plus Intensity give 105% pushback protection on Searing Pain Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-01. - **Trinkets:** Zandalarian Hero Charm or Restrained Essence of Sapphiron, reflectors, and a PvP trinket Ratso · 2023-01-10. Everyone swaps trinkets constantly Fuggle the Dampened · 2025-01-16. The PvP trinket also breaks stuns Sarimal · 2024-11-30. - **Enchants:** stamina-first and cheap: 100 HP chest, ZG head and legs, Sapphiron shoulders, spell-power bracers Mmr · 2024-09-09. - **Stones:** **Spellstone** removes all magic buffs and debuffs from you, including magical silences Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-12-26. It is "giga strong against sp, warlocks and mages" Cpox · 2024-02-21. It shares the Healthstone cooldown. - **Consumables:** Free Action Potion, Flask of the Titans, arcane bombs Sehnsucht · 2025-07-15. Limited Invulnerability Potions and the Voidwalker's Sacrifice deny a warrior rage Karen · 2025-08-31. Greater Holy Protection Potions against paladins [Erhog, 2023-11-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=78940#p78940). - **Engineering** is the PvP profession: grenades, reflectors, rocket boots and helmet Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2024-09-17, Mima · 2025-09-23. The Cloaking Device trinket keeps you invisible while you cast (e.g. a Soul Fire), unlike an Invisibility Potion, which breaks on cast 1.18.1 WILL SAVE US #LetThemCook · 2025-10-16, AxenPunker · 2025-10-16.

rotationSingle.heading: Control and burst sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **Fear rules:** Seduction shares diminishing returns with Fear, but fear-breaking effects do not break it lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. On Turtle, Will of the Forsaken gives 3 s of immunity instead of 5 lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. Many Horde PvP players are Undead, so the non-Fear tools matter Sehnsucht · 2026-03-23. Curse of Recklessness now has a 1 s GCD, which makes it "the best pvp spell u can cast" for fear-juggling: it stops a feared target from fleeing until you swap curses Fuggle the Dampened · 2026-04-05, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. **Curse pick, contested:** one player calls Curse of Shadow (5 min, -70 resistance, +10% shadow damage taken, castable on many targets) stupidly strong for PvP; Verlyn disagrees — he says Curse of Tongues, Exhaustion, Elements or no curse at all is usually the better pick, and he uses Curse of Shadow almost exclusively on enemy Felhunters to lower their shadow resistance before Banishing them Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-16, Verlyn · 2025-10-16. **Useful tricks:** a Healthstone can be handed to an ally roughly every 2 minutes Thirtyseven · 2025-10-06. Fel Domination cuts pet-summon cast time to 1.5 s, useful for a fast re-pet after a kill or a death lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-07. Soulstone-into-Shadow Bolt (rezzing an ally straight into a nuke) is called "a killer combo" Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07. **Affliction kite (default):** 1. Curse of Exhaustion on the melee target. 2. Corruption, Curse of Agony, Siphon Life (all instant) Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. 3. Walk away and let the DoTs work. Drain Life or Drain Soul while they are slowed. Without a dispel, Dark Harvest can put about 5k damage through a single Fear in about 7 s Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-16. 4. Fear or Howl of Terror when they close; Death Coil as the emergency peel. 5. Shadowburn or Nightfall Shadow Bolt to finish. Summonjutsu: "Corruption, CoA, Siphon life, Shadowburn" can kill a fresh-60 target while you walk away Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. **Destruction burst:** Seduce to force the trinket → Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate for a near one-shot rqo · 2025-12-16. **Contested:** spell data gives Soul Fire a 6 s cast (no talent in the kit shortens it), but a player reports 4 s; either way it needs CC to land Ionnatra · 2026-04-07, Ionnatra · 2026-04-08. Geared targets can no longer be one-shot this way Afraido · 2026-04-08. The roughly 20% global PvP damage dampening is blamed: old 5k Soul Fires are gone, so the full combo is now Soul Fire (about 3.5k) → reapply Seduce → Immolate (about 1.5k) → Conflagrate (about 2k) → Shadowburn (about 1.5k) instead of a single opener Noctissal · 2025-10-26, Noctissal · 2025-10-26, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26. **Demonology duel opener:** pre-sacrifice the Voidwalker for the shield, then summon the Felguard. It is "easily countered when you know what you're doing" sailorVEVO · 2026-01-26. Against a warrior, keep the Felguard on top of yourself so he cannot hit you without eating Felstorm L-star · 2025-10-05.
