roleStrategy.markdown: | Opponent | Verdict | How | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Warrior** | Favoured if you keep range | Curse of Exhaustion before Charge, Death Coil, walk. The Voidwalker shield and LIP deny rage | Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-01-21, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-09-13, Mmr · 2025-03-17 | | **Rogue** | Hard; easy as Affliction with a trinket | They open, you trinket → Death Coil → double Fear → Curse of Exhaustion → DoTs → drain. Without a trinket: Seduce when they jump you, or catch them in stealth with the Felhunter | Morweyn · 2026-03-08, Morweyn · 2026-03-08, Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-04-06 | | **Paladin** | Contested | The Felhunter eats Hammer of Justice and Repentance and silences; the Voidwalker in paladin-heavy battlegrounds. Bubble makes them "a nightmare"; heavy paladin dispels strip Affliction. Paladins cannot Fear demon pets on Turtle (no Turn Evil). A good paladin interrupts or survives your Dark Harvest channel (30 s cooldown, cannot be dispelled, only blocked by Divine Shield), and can bubble immediately after breaking a Fear via Death Coil to push your next Fear onto a short diminishing-returns window (about 4-5 s). **Bug:** using Divine Shield against a Succubus's Seduce can leave the paladin stuck seduced | Darg · 2023-08-13, JP Morgan Intern · 2025-11-08, dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22, Purec · 2025-10-22, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-22 | | **Hunter** | Favoured, except against Beast Mastery | Kill the pet first; smart hunters max the pet's shadow and arcane resistance | Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-01-21, Dixa · 2025-09-19 | | **Priest** | Favoured | Spell Lock + Curse of Tongues, or Seduce + Curse of Tongues. Spellstone clears shadow silences | Liracrime · 2025-06-12, Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-12-26 | | **Shaman** | Warlock on paper, shaman in practice | Curse of Exhaustion is "a must vs shamans". Curse of Tongues counters the kit, but Tremor and Grounding make Fear unreliable | dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07, Jerome · 2023-08-07, Sarimal · 2025-01-04 | | **Druid** | Favoured | "Any decent warlock is a nightmare for a druid" | Doc · 2023-07-29 | | **Feral Druid** | The one near-unwinnable matchup | "The only instant loss as a warlock is a fucking feral druid." Their stealth-detection cone means they get the opener even with the Felhunter out, unless you constantly turn 360°; Grillbe reports dying "100 to 0 in 3 seconds" as an Alliance lock. Thorn's Pod trinket (removes Fear, 1-hour cooldown) is the recommended counter, alongside Death Coil for the reflector | Grillbe · 2025-10-13, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13, Grillbe · 2025-10-14, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13 | | **Mage** | Mage-favoured against Affliction | Decursive mages strip your curses. Destruction is closer, but fire reflectors and the fire-immunity trinket counter it. **Formulaic at T3+:** their opening Arcane Missiles/Arcane Rupture is answered by Spell Lock (risky if it resists); they Ice Block through the lockout; answer a second Arcane Missiles with Death Coil if it's up. A second answer on your side wins it; with a Scythe of Elune at T3+, one completed Arcane Missiles channel can win it outright for the mage | WL/hunt · 2026-02-08, dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07, lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-21, lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-21, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-21 | | **Warlock** | Pet and CC race | Felhunter Devour Magic plus Spell Lock. A Succubus-spec opponent is close to unbeatable 1v1 without a Restoration or Lucidity Potion: the fight comes down to killing their Succubus before she seduces again, otherwise you get chain-seduced into a Soul Fire | Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-03-10, Kyrsie · 2025-10-11, Kyrsie · 2025-10-11 | | **2+ melee** | Losing | No mobility, a 2-minute Death Coil, and Fear as your only peel | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-07-28 |

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Fighting at melee range, or hard-casting Shadow Bolt on a melee target. - Opening Fear on an Undead player before they have used Will of the Forsaken. - Leaving Lash of Pain on autocast, so Seduction gets cancelled. - Burning a greater demon in a battleground where a single Fear or Banish wastes it dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. - Destruction against a fire-reflector or fire-immunity target dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. - Using Death Coil early and having no peel when the rogue re-opens.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop for each build. The details are in [Control and burst sequences](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp), [Pets](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp), [Battlegrounds](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp). **Every build, before and between fights:** - **Pet:** "succubus is great vs rogues, felhunter vs casters", the Voidwalker against warriors L-star · 2025-09-02. Turn off Lash of Pain autocast and run the Felhunter manually ([Pets](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp)). - **Position:** sit at max range and do your rotation from there Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-19. - **Reset:** Healthstone or Spellstone; they share a cooldown Lightemgee · 2025-08-13. Fel Domination (5-min cooldown) brings a re-summon down to 1.5 s after your pet dies lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-07. Life Tap, then drink back to full mana out of combat (vanilla baseline). **Affliction 35/5/11 (default):** 1. **Opener (36 yd, all instant):** Curse of Exhaustion on the melee → Corruption → Curse of Agony → Siphon Life Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. Against a caster healer, use Curse of Tongues plus Spell Lock or Seduce Liracrime · 2025-06-12. 2. **Loop:** walk away and let the DoTs tick. Drain Life or Drain Soul while the target is slowed. Drain channels cannot be kicked or pummelled Gilnean · 2025-10-29. If no dispel is around, cast Dark Harvest (30 s cooldown) into a Fear Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-16. 3. **Finish:** Shadowburn (15 s cooldown) or a Nightfall Shadow Bolt. Never hard-cast Shadow Bolt into melee L-star · 2025-11-01. 4. **Control chain:** Fear (1.5 s cast; Fel Concentration stops pushback on it) Lightemgee · 2025-08-15 → Curse of Recklessness to juggle the feared target Fuggle the Dampened · 2026-04-05 → Howl of Terror (40 s cooldown, 2 s cast) when a second melee arrives → Death Coil (2-min cooldown) as the last peel. - **DR:** Seduction shares diminishing returns with Fear lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. - Do not open with Fear on an Undead player; Will of the Forsaken gives 3 s immunity lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. 5. **Defence:** against stun openers, trinket first and Death Coil after Morweyn · 2026-03-08. Drink a Limited Invulnerability Potion when a melee is on you Gilnean · 2025-10-29. Spellstone clears magic silences. 6. **Target priority:** - Put the Felhunter's Spell Lock on the enemy healer ("8sec silence on enemy healer") Deaddlnside · 2026-02-26. - DoT and slow the melee who push in, or the flag carrier. - Against a hunter, kill the pet first. - In premades, do not DoT targets your team has crowd-controlled Grillbe · 2025-10-13. **Destruction 5/5/39 (burst when your group peels):** 1. **Opener:** Seduction to force the trinket rqo · 2025-12-16. 2. **Burst:** Soul Fire (30 s cooldown; it needs CC to land) → re-Seduce → Immolate → Conflagrate (10 s cooldown) → Shadowburn Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26. 3. **Control and defence:** you have no Curse of Exhaustion, so rely on Fear, the Curse of Recklessness juggle and Death Coil. The slows, stuns and crits are what secure kills on kiters such as warriors Livius · 2026-04-18. 4. **Avoid:** fire-reflector and fire-immunity-trinket targets. Swap to your DoTs or to a different target dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. **SM/Ruin 30/0/21 (open world, BGs):** play the Affliction loop with the Imp at range. The build keeps full Curse of Exhaustion and Fear pushback protection Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-07. **Soul Link Demonology 5/34/12 (duels, arenas):** 1. **Opener:** Voidwalker Sacrifice for the shield, then summon the greater demon. It is "easily countered when you know what you're doing" sailorVEVO · 2026-01-26. 2. **Arena:** Inferno (10-min cooldown) and Demon Gate reset each match, so spend them every match Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-08. 3. **Against melee:** keep the Felguard on top of yourself L-star · 2025-10-05. 4. **Not in BGs:** one Fear, Banish or Hamstring on the pet wastes the whole cooldown dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. **Vs class** (sources and the full table are in [Matchups](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp)): - **Warrior:** Curse of Exhaustion before he can Charge, then Death Coil and walk. The Voidwalker shield or a LIP denies him rage. - **Rogue:** trinket → Death Coil → double Fear → Curse of Exhaustion → DoTs → drain. - **Feral druid:** the near-unwinnable matchup. Carry Thorn's Pod. - **Hunter:** pet first. - **Priest:** Spell Lock or Seduce, plus Curse of Tongues. - **Paladin:** the Felhunter eats Hammer of Justice and Repentance. Expect a bubble after your Death Coil, which moves your next Fear into diminishing returns. - **Shaman:** Curse of Exhaustion is a must. Tremor and Grounding make Fear unreliable. - **Mage:** Spell Lock the first Arcane Missiles and Death Coil the second. - **Warlock:** kill their Succubus before she seduces again.

extraSections.markdown: | Pet | Use | Sources | |---|---|---| | **Felhunter** | Default. Spell Lock on the enemy healer ("10% dmg << 8sec silence on enemy healer"), Devour Magic, Paranoia against stealth. Keep it on manual; bait Counterspell by faking a Drain Soul or opening with a fire spell | Deaddlnside · 2026-02-26, Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-06 | | **Succubus** | Seduction CC, "best pvp pet by far" for 3v1 kills. extraSections.heading: Battlegrounds
extraSections.markdown: - **Sit at max range and do your PvE rotation.** Standing close to Curse of Tongues casters gets you killed Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-19. - **Arathi Basin:** be a time-waster at a node. Fear, Seduce and DoTs can hold 3 players Lightemgee · 2025-07-01. - **Alterac Valley:** mass-DoT the front line Suade · 2025-07-14. - **Do not spread DoTs on everything** in premades; they break your team's CC. Keep the Felhunter on passive next to you, or the Succubus stealthed in position, and never send the pet into five enemies Grillbe · 2025-10-13. - **Warsong Gulch:** Felhunter on the enemy healer. Devour Magic the enemy flag carrier's buffs while you spam Curse of Exhaustion on him Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-03-10. - Affliction is "by far the best spec" for solo-queue battlegrounds Deleted User · 2026-02-07. Against organised teams with two decursing mages or druids, "ur curses done" WL/hunt · 2026-02-08. **Contested:** other voices call Affliction the weakest PvP spec and say you have to respec Destruction-Fire to be competitive Gamba · 2025-01-29.

extraSections.markdown: | Race | PvP value | Source | |---|---|---| | **Undead** | Best PvP racial: Will of the Forsaken (3 s immunity on Turtle). Its +2% damage to humanoids does not work on players | Cyric · 2026-04-07, lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05, Lightemgee · 2026-04-07 | | **Orc** | Blood Fury: +120 spell power for 15 s ("basically a free trinket") and +5% pet damage. The stun-resist racial was nerfed hard | Cyric · 2026-04-07, Cyric · 2026-04-07 | | **Troll** | Affliction pick | suddeNslow · 2026-04-01 | | **Gnome, Human** | Gnome and Forsaken top Summonjutsu's list; Human is third for Perception against rogue and druid openers | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-31 | | **Goblin** | Sprint as an escape; otherwise middling | sailorVEVO · 2026-03-31 | Alliance warlocks have it harder: "if you play alliance like me you can't fear in pvp either" L-star · 2026-04-09. Dwarf warlocks (new in 1.18.1) have no PvP evaluation in the sources. **Contested:** dindunuffinz argues a warlock is disproportionately valuable and rare on Alliance, and that Curse of Tongues is especially strong there because Horde's caster-heavy comps rely on mage/druid decurses to clear it dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13, dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13; Kyrsie disputes it — "if warlock was really that useful on alliance we would see more of them" Kyrsie · 2025-10-13.

glance.recommendation: Play **Affliction 35/5/11** with a **Felhunter** or **Succubus**. Put Curse of Exhaustion on melee, DoT everyone from 36 yards, and Drain while they chase you. Save Death Coil for the moment a rogue or warrior reaches you. Destruction (Fire burst) and Soul Link Demonology are the alternatives: Destruction for burst when your group peels for you, Soul Link or greater demons for duels and arenas.

overview.heading: Overview

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Stamina first, then spell power.** Haste is worth less than in PvE Morweyn · 2026-02-06. Crit for Destruction. - **Hit:** 3% for level-60 targets Afraido · 2026-03-04. There is always about 1% miss left over Knarlsburg · 2026-01-17. - **Best PvP gear is PvE gear** Actualrodent · 2025-07-28: 2 pieces of the PvP set for the stamina bonus, the rest raid pieces Mmr · 2023-10-13. A full-PvP-geared warlock reaches about 6.8k health, the Voidwalker about 8k Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-01. - **The 1.18.1 PvP set** bonuses favour Destruction while most PvP warlocks play Affliction Knarlsburg · 2026-04-08; L-star wished he had bought the old gloves L-star · 2026-03-28. - **The Rank 12 (AB) PvP set 2-piece** is called an underrated stat stick, a solid option specifically for locks, similar to some other classes' cheap 2-piece PvP set bonuses lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-11, lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-11. - **The PvE Tier 2.5 ("Dark Harvest") set bonus also matters in PvP:** it adds a stacking burst effect that ramps with your Shadow Vulnerability stacks over a fight, landing roughly 1,400 extra damage "at the end" on top of Dark Harvest's own ~400-450 Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-29. - **Rank-8 PvP gloves** plus Intensity give 105% pushback protection on Searing Pain Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-01. - **Trinkets:** Zandalarian Hero Charm or Restrained Essence of Sapphiron, reflectors, and a PvP trinket Ratso · 2023-01-10. Everyone swaps trinkets constantly Fuggle the Dampened · 2025-01-16. The PvP trinket also breaks stuns Sarimal · 2024-11-30. - **Enchants:** stamina-first and cheap: 100 HP chest, ZG head and legs, Sapphiron shoulders, spell-power bracers Mmr · 2024-09-09. - **Stones:** **Spellstone** removes all magic buffs and debuffs from you, including magical silences Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-12-26. It is "giga strong against sp, warlocks and mages" Cpox · 2024-02-21. It shares the Healthstone cooldown. - **Consumables:** Free Action Potion, Flask of the Titans, arcane bombs Sehnsucht · 2025-07-15. Limited Invulnerability Potions and the Voidwalker's Sacrifice deny a warrior rage Karen · 2025-08-31. Greater Holy Protection Potions against paladins [Erhog, 2023-11-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=78940#p78940). - **Engineering** is the PvP profession: grenades, reflectors, rocket boots and helmet Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2024-09-17, Mima · 2025-09-23. The Cloaking Device trinket keeps you invisible while you cast (e.g. a Soul Fire), unlike an Invisibility Potion, which breaks on cast 1.18.1 WILL SAVE US #LetThemCook · 2025-10-16, AxenPunker · 2025-10-16.

rotationSingle.heading: Control and burst sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: **Fear rules:** Seduction shares diminishing returns with Fear, but fear-breaking effects do not break it lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. On Turtle, Will of the Forsaken gives 3 s of immunity instead of 5 lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. Many Horde PvP players are Undead, so the non-Fear tools matter Sehnsucht · 2026-03-23. Curse of Recklessness now has a 1 s GCD, which makes it "the best pvp spell u can cast" for fear-juggling: it stops a feared target from fleeing until you swap curses Fuggle the Dampened · 2026-04-05, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. **Curse pick, contested:** one player calls Curse of Shadow (5 min, -70 resistance, +10% shadow damage taken, castable on many targets) stupidly strong for PvP; Verlyn disagrees — he says Curse of Tongues, Exhaustion, Elements or no curse at all is usually the better pick, and he uses Curse of Shadow almost exclusively on enemy Felhunters to lower their shadow resistance before Banishing them Gnomeburger Orgon · 2025-10-16, Verlyn · 2025-10-16. **Useful tricks:** a Healthstone can be handed to an ally roughly every 2 minutes Thirtyseven · 2025-10-06. Fel Domination cuts pet-summon cast time to 1.5 s, useful for a fast re-pet after a kill or a death lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-07. Soulstone-into-Shadow Bolt (rezzing an ally straight into a nuke) is called "a killer combo" Thirtyseven · 2025-10-07. **Affliction kite (default):** 1. Curse of Exhaustion on the melee target. 2. Corruption, Curse of Agony, Siphon Life (all instant) Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. 3. Walk away and let the DoTs work. Drain Life or Drain Soul while they are slowed. Without a dispel, Dark Harvest can put about 5k damage through a single Fear in about 7 s Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-16. 4. Fear or Howl of Terror when they close; Death Coil as the emergency peel. 5. Shadowburn or Nightfall Shadow Bolt to finish. Summonjutsu: "Corruption, CoA, Siphon life, Shadowburn" can kill a fresh-60 target while you walk away Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. **Destruction burst:** Seduce to force the trinket → Soul Fire → Immolate → Conflagrate for a near one-shot rqo · 2025-12-16. **Contested:** spell data gives Soul Fire a 6 s cast (no talent in the kit shortens it), but a player reports 4 s; either way it needs CC to land Ionnatra · 2026-04-07, Ionnatra · 2026-04-08. Geared targets can no longer be one-shot this way Afraido · 2026-04-08. The roughly 20% global PvP damage dampening is blamed: old 5k Soul Fires are gone, so the full combo is now Soul Fire (about 3.5k) → reapply Seduce → Immolate (about 1.5k) → Conflagrate (about 2k) → Shadowburn (about 1.5k) instead of a single opener Noctissal · 2025-10-26, Noctissal · 2025-10-26, Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26. **Demonology duel opener:** pre-sacrifice the Voidwalker for the shield, then summon the Felguard. It is "easily countered when you know what you're doing" sailorVEVO · 2026-01-26. Against a warrior, keep the Felguard on top of yourself so he cannot hit you without eating Felstorm L-star · 2025-10-05.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Fighting at melee range, or hard-casting Shadow Bolt on a melee target. - Opening Fear on an Undead player before they have used Will of the Forsaken. - Leaving Lash of Pain on autocast, so Seduction gets cancelled. - Burning a greater demon in a battleground where a single Fear or Banish wastes it dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. - Destruction against a fire-reflector or fire-immunity target dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. - Using Death Coil early and having no peel when the rogue re-opens.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP decision loop for each build. The details are in [Control and burst sequences](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp), [Pets](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp), [Battlegrounds](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp) and [Matchups](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp). **Every build, before and between fights:** - **Pet:** "succubus is great vs rogues, felhunter vs casters", the Voidwalker against warriors L-star · 2025-09-02. Turn off Lash of Pain autocast and run the Felhunter manually ([Pets](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp)). - **Position:** sit at max range and do your rotation from there Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-19. - **Reset:** Healthstone or Spellstone; they share a cooldown Lightemgee · 2025-08-13. Fel Domination (5-min cooldown) brings a re-summon down to 1.5 s after your pet dies lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-07. Life Tap, then drink back to full mana out of combat (vanilla baseline). **Affliction 35/5/11 (default):** 1. **Opener (36 yd, all instant):** Curse of Exhaustion on the melee → Corruption → Curse of Agony → Siphon Life Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-24. Against a caster healer, use Curse of Tongues plus Spell Lock or Seduce Liracrime · 2025-06-12. 2. **Loop:** walk away and let the DoTs tick. Drain Life or Drain Soul while the target is slowed. Drain channels cannot be kicked or pummelled Gilnean · 2025-10-29. If no dispel is around, cast Dark Harvest (30 s cooldown) into a Fear Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-16. 3. **Finish:** Shadowburn (15 s cooldown) or a Nightfall Shadow Bolt. Never hard-cast Shadow Bolt into melee L-star · 2025-11-01. 4. **Control chain:** Fear (1.5 s cast; Fel Concentration stops pushback on it) Lightemgee · 2025-08-15 → Curse of Recklessness to juggle the feared target Fuggle the Dampened · 2026-04-05 → Howl of Terror (40 s cooldown, 2 s cast) when a second melee arrives → Death Coil (2-min cooldown) as the last peel. - **DR:** Seduction shares diminishing returns with Fear lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. - Do not open with Fear on an Undead player; Will of the Forsaken gives 3 s immunity lowlifeopinions · 2025-10-05. 5. **Defence:** against stun openers, trinket first and Death Coil after Morweyn · 2026-03-08. Drink a Limited Invulnerability Potion when a melee is on you Gilnean · 2025-10-29. Spellstone clears magic silences. 6. **Target priority:** - Put the Felhunter's Spell Lock on the enemy healer ("8sec silence on enemy healer") Deaddlnside · 2026-02-26. - DoT and slow the melee who push in, or the flag carrier. - Against a hunter, kill the pet first. - In premades, do not DoT targets your team has crowd-controlled Grillbe · 2025-10-13. **Destruction 5/5/39 (burst when your group peels):** 1. **Opener:** Seduction to force the trinket rqo · 2025-12-16. 2. **Burst:** Soul Fire (30 s cooldown; it needs CC to land) → re-Seduce → Immolate → Conflagrate (10 s cooldown) → Shadowburn Jesse Potter · 2025-10-26. 3. **Control and defence:** you have no Curse of Exhaustion, so rely on Fear, the Curse of Recklessness juggle and Death Coil. The slows, stuns and crits are what secure kills on kiters such as warriors Livius · 2026-04-18. 4. **Avoid:** fire-reflector and fire-immunity-trinket targets. Swap to your DoTs or to a different target dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. **SM/Ruin 30/0/21 (open world, BGs):** play the Affliction loop with the Imp at range. The build keeps full Curse of Exhaustion and Fear pushback protection Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-07. **Soul Link Demonology 5/34/12 (duels, arenas):** 1. **Opener:** Voidwalker Sacrifice for the shield, then summon the greater demon. It is "easily countered when you know what you're doing" sailorVEVO · 2026-01-26. 2. **Arena:** Inferno (10-min cooldown) and Demon Gate reset each match, so spend them every match Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-11-08. 3. **Against melee:** keep the Felguard on top of yourself L-star · 2025-10-05. 4. **Not in BGs:** one Fear, Banish or Hamstring on the pet wastes the whole cooldown dindunuffinz · 2026-02-07. **Vs class** (sources and the full table are in [Matchups](#/class/warlock/demonology-pvp)): - **Warrior:** Curse of Exhaustion before he can Charge, then Death Coil and walk. The Voidwalker shield or a LIP denies him rage. - **Rogue:** trinket → Death Coil → double Fear → Curse of Exhaustion → DoTs → drain. - **Feral druid:** the near-unwinnable matchup. Carry Thorn's Pod. - **Hunter:** pet first. - **Priest:** Spell Lock or Seduce, plus Curse of Tongues. - **Paladin:** the Felhunter eats Hammer of Justice and Repentance. Expect a bubble after your Death Coil, which moves your next Fear into diminishing returns. - **Shaman:** Curse of Exhaustion is a must. Tremor and Grounding make Fear unreliable. - **Mage:** Spell Lock the first Arcane Missiles and Death Coil the second. - **Warlock:** kill their Succubus before she seduces again.

glance.recommendation: Play **Affliction 35/5/11** with a **Felhunter** or **Succubus**. Put Curse of Exhaustion on melee, DoT everyone from 36 yards, and Drain while they chase you. sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level as **Affliction** with the **Voidwalker** tanking. Open with Curse of Agony and Corruption, add Siphon Life on mobs that live long enough, then drain or wand. Juggle 2-3 mobs at once (Voidwalker on one, Fear on one, you on one). Pick **Demonology** instead if this is your first warlock or a Hardcore character. Pick **Fire** only if you mostly run dungeons and can buy spell-power gear. The Affliction talent order below ends exactly on the raid build, so you need no respec at 60. "Aff for speed, demo for safety" Chud · 2026-02-02, Chud · 2026-02-11. Warlocks level so well that you can reach 60 with points spent almost at random, or none at all renegade · 2026-03-15, sailorVEVO · 2026-01-26. | Spec | When | Why | Sources | |---|---|---|---| | **Affliction** (default) | Normal leveling, open-world farming | The lowest downtime; faster than Demonology; 10% hit from Suppression | Gilnean · 2025-10-14, Afraido · 2025-12-15, sailorVEVO · 2026-03-15 | | **Demonology** | First warlock, Hardcore, soloing elites | "Slowest but safe and easy": the Voidwalker is tankier and holds threat more consistently, and Demonology relies on stamina and Intellect rather than spell power | Afraido · 2025-12-15, sailorVEVO · 2026-03-15, Vladizlav · 2025-12-16 | | **Destruction (Fire)** | Dungeon-heavy leveling on an alt with spell-power gear | Burns elites fast for groups Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-01, but it is mana-hungry, pulls threat off your demon, and gets Soul Fire only at 30 and Conflagrate at 40 Afraido · 2026-03-05 | Not Normal · 2026-02-12 | **Contested:** Dreamhaze calls anything but Demonology "pointless" for leveling, because a funnel-healed Voidwalker makes every elite "just a stamina check" Dreamhaze · 2025-11-20, Dreamhaze · 2025-11-20. Most other posters recommend Affliction. For the 1.18.1 "Trial of Heroism" (elite-only XP) challenge, sailorVEVO recommends Affliction for its 10% hit sailorVEVO · 2026-03-15.

L-star says to keep the demon out and not sacrifice L-star · 2025-11-01. Lightemgee argues a sacrificed demon wastes "a second fighting ally" Lightemgee · 2026-04-06.

sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: What to press, bracket by bracket, for the recommended **Affliction + Voidwalker** path. Each bracket ends with a **Demonology path** line that lists what changes if you follow the [Demonology order](#/class/warlock/leveling) instead. Learn levels, ranks and cast times come from the 1.18.1 client data. Talents follow the orders above. Warlocks have no healing role, and demon-tanking notes appear only in the brackets where they apply. **Rules for every bracket:** - **Always have a demon out.** Resummon it between pulls, never mid-pull, unless you have Fel Domination. The Voidwalker is the leveling pet from level 10 Wells · 2025-10-14. - **DoT first, then Fear.** New spell applications break Fear, but DoT ticks rarely do Bones · 2025-06-25, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. - **Never clip Curse of Agony.** Its biggest ticks come at the end Gilnean · 2025-10-10. Put Siphon Life only on mobs that will outlive it. - **Life Tap** when you are near full health and below ~50% mana Xi · 2026-01-06. Eat when your health is low and no drain can fix it. There is no Dark Pact on Turtle Fistofate · 2026-04-06. - **Keep the Voidwalker ahead on threat.** Send it to the next mob a few seconds before the current one dies Chandalen · 2026-04-05. Torment adds a fixed amount of threat and only gains a rank every 10 levels, so the Voidwalker holds badly at levels X7-X9. Pull fewer mobs then peter_hammer · 2025-10-29. ### Levels 1–9 - **New now:** L1 Imp (class quest), Immolate R1, Shadow Bolt (your starting spell) · L4 Corruption R1 (1.5 s cast), Curse of Weakness · L6 Life Tap R1, Shadow Bolt R2 · L8 Curse of Agony R1, Fear R1 (1.5 s cast, 20 yd). Buy the best wand you can Stunfisk · 2023-06-04. - **Demon:** Imp, with Firebolt on autocast (vanilla baseline). **Single target** 1. Send the Imp. 2. Levels 1-3: Immolate → Shadow Bolt → wand or melee to finish. 3. From 4: Corruption → Immolate (only if the mob is still above ~50%) → wand. 4. From 8: **Curse of Agony** (instant, starts the long timer) fusedpro · 2025-10-20 → Corruption → wand. 5. From 6: Life Tap by the rule above. Drink when both bars are low; this is normal before the Voidwalker (vanilla baseline). **Multi-target:** avoid pulls of more than one mob, because the Imp cannot tank. If a second mob joins at level 8+, DoT both, then Fear the one that is not on you and kill the other. **Demonology path:** identical, because no talents exist yet. ### Levels 10–19 - **New now:** L10 **Voidwalker** (class quest), Drain Soul R1, Demon Armor R2, Create Healthstone (Minor) · L12 Health Funnel R1, Shadow Bolt R3 (2.8 s) · L14 Corruption R2, Drain Life R1, Curse of Recklessness R1 · L16 Life Tap R2, Unending Breath · L18 Curse of Agony R2, Searing Pain R1, Create Soulstone (Minor). - **Talents:** Improved Corruption 1-5 (L10-14; Corruption is **instant from 14**), Suppression 1-3 (L15-17), Improved Life Tap 1 (L18), Improved Drains 1 (L19). - **Demon:** Voidwalker, with Torment on autocast. Upgrade its Torment rank as soon as you can [Eversongwoods, 2025-02-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=118780#p118780). Keep Demon Armor up. **Single target** 1. **Send the Voidwalker** and let it land a Torment. 2. **Curse of Agony.** 3. **Corruption.** 4. **Filler:** wand, or **Drain Soul**. At level 15 on a dummy, Drain Soul held 31.5 DPS, Drain Life 23 and Shadow Bolt 33 falling to 28 as mana ran out ysocereal · 2026-01-17. **Contested:** "0 reason to wand after like level 20" peter_hammer · 2026-01-17 vs "Voidwalker + dots and wand = infinite farm" Quadella · 2026-02-15. 5. **Drain Life** (from 14) instead of the filler when your health is low. 6. Finish with Drain Soul when you need soul shards (see [Soul shards](#/class/warlock/leveling)). 7. Life Tap by the rule. Between pulls, Health Funnel the Voidwalker if it is low and you have health to spare (vanilla baseline). **Multi-target (2-3 mobs)** 1. Voidwalker on mob A. 2. Curse of Agony and Corruption on A, then on B. 3. **Fear B** after its DoTs are on. From 14, a Curse of Recklessness on the feared mob stops it fleeing, so it stays in place; swap to another curse to let it run again Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. 4. Drain or wand the mob that is on you, then the next. 5. **Do not pull more** at levels 17-19, when Torment falls behind, or when your health is below ~60% (vanilla baseline). **Demon tanking (dungeons):** a Voidwalker with Health Funnel can tank or off-tank low-level dungeons. It "will give you aggro issues when dealing with multiple mobs" and is not beginner-friendly Andrion · 2026-02-15. In a group with a real tank, bring the **Imp** instead (ranged, stamina buff, Fire Shield) Rahnd2137 · 2025-12-30. It stays invisible and pulls less by accident Darkride · 2026-03-23. **Demonology path:** Demonic Embrace 1-5 (L10-14), Fel Intellect 1-3 (L15-17), Soul Funnel 1 (L18), Improved Corruption 1 (L19). The loop is Voidwalker → DoTs → Drain Life or wand. Pull the next mob with the Voidwalker once the current one is at half health, and Health Funnel it instead of resting Dreamhaze · 2025-11-20. Corruption keeps its cast time until 23. ### Levels 20–29 - **New now:** L20 **Succubus** (class quest), Immolate R3, Shadow Bolt R4 (3.0 s), Rain of Fire R1, Demon Armor R3, Health Funnel R2, Ritual of Summoning · L22 Drain Life R2, Create Firestone, Eye of Kilrogg · L24 Corruption R3 (18 s), Drain Soul R2, Drain Mana R1, Fear R2 (15 s) · L26 Life Tap R3, Searing Pain R2, Create Healthstone · L28 Curse of Agony R3, Curse of Recklessness R2, Shadow Bolt R5, Health Funnel R3, Banish R1. - **Talents:** Improved Drains 2 (L20), Fel Concentration 1-2 (L21-22), Improved Curse of Agony 1-3 (L23-25), Soul Siphon 1-3 (L26-28), Nightfall 1 (L29). - **Demon:** stay on the **Voidwalker** for solo pulls. The Succubus does more damage but is squishy, and she is only "a bit better if you have demonic swiftness" L-star · 2025-12-30. Many players still switch to her from 20 Mima · 2025-10-18. **Single target:** same as 10-19, plus: - **Nightfall proc (from 29) → instant Shadow Bolt.** Otherwise do not hard-cast Shadow Bolt L-star · 2025-11-01. - Drain tanking is not online yet. "25 is too early"; the wand or Drain Soul is the better filler until the late-30s Drain Life rank Dixa · 2025-08-27. - With Soul Siphon, get all your DoTs up before you drain. **Multi-target:** 2-3 mobs, as above. Rain of Fire R1 costs 295 mana, which is too expensive for solo play; keep it for groups. **Demonology path:** Improved Corruption 2-5 (L20-23; instant at 23), Improved Drains 1-2 (L24-25), Improved Life Tap 1-2 (L26-27), Suppression 1 (L28), Fel Concentration 1 (L29). Soul Funnel makes the Voidwalker very hard to kill. With 5/5 Fel Stamina and 2/2 Soul Funnel it "can pull 3+ mobs at a time" Pandion · 2024-11-16. ### Levels 30–39 - **New now:** L30 **Felhunter** (class quest), **Siphon Life** (talent, 30), Soul Fire R1 (6 s cast), Hellfire R1, Immolate R4, Drain Life R3, Demon Armor R4, Enslave Demon R1, Shadow Ward R1, Create Soulstone (Lesser) · L32 Curse of the Elements R1, Create Felstone · L34 Corruption R4, Rain of Fire R2, Searing Pain R3, Drain Mana R2 · L36 Life Tap R4, Shadow Bolt R6, Health Funnel R4, Create Spellstone · L38 **Curse of Agony R4, Drain Life R4, Drain Soul R3, Siphon Life R2**, Soul Fire R2. - **Talents:** Siphon Life (L30), Malediction (L31), Nightfall 2 (L32), Rapid Deterioration 1-2 (L33-34), Shadow Mastery 1-5 (L35-39). - **Demon:** Voidwalker solo. The Felhunter is the PvP and utility pet biloen · 2026-03-10. **Single target** 1. Send the Voidwalker. 2. **Curse:** Curse of Agony. With Malediction, cast a **rank-1 Curse of Recklessness** instead: it costs 35 mana and still applies your max-rank Curse of Agony Vladizlav · 2025-12-05, cd dd · 2026-01-11. 3. **Corruption.** 4. **Siphon Life** if the mob will live long enough fusedpro · 2025-10-20. 5. **Drop Immolate** from here on (Crash.Rush stopped at 33) Crash.Rush · 2026-03-27. 6. **Filler:** below level ~34, wand; above that, Drain Life when you need health, otherwise Drain Soul biloen · 2026-04-05, fusedpro · 2025-10-20. 7. Nightfall proc → Shadow Bolt. 8. Life Tap by the rule. Drain tanking starts to work with the level-38 Drain Life rank Dixa · 2025-08-27. Keep a **Felstone** (32) in groups. Its healing generates threat, so let the Voidwalker hit first Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. **Multi-target (2-3 mobs):** Voidwalker on one, full DoTs (curse, Corruption, Siphon Life) on each, Fear one, drain the one on you. Siphon Life on every mob is also your healing. **Demonology path:** Fel Concentration 2 (L30), Soul Funnel 2/2 (L31), Fel Domination (L32), Fel Stamina 1-4 (L33-36), Nether Studies 1-3 (L37-39). Nether Studies adds 45% to Torment, which is big for the Voidwalker's threat L-star · 2026-02-20. Soul Funnel 2/2 lets you fight elites head-on Stunfisk · 2026-02-19. Fel Domination gives you an instant resummon when the demon dies mid-fight W · 2026-02-24. ### Levels 40–49 - **New now:** L40 **Dark Harvest** (talent; trainer R2 at 50), Howl of Terror R1, Mana Funnel R1, Immolate R5, Demon Armor R5, Create Soulstone, Fear R3 (20 s), Felsteed · L42 **Death Coil R1**, Hellfire R2, Create Wrathstone, Curse of Recklessness R3, Searing Pain R4, Shadow Ward R2 · L44 **Curse of Shadow R1**, Corruption R5, Shadow Bolt R7, Enslave Demon R2, Health Funnel R5, Drain Mana R3 · L46 Drain Life R5, Life Tap R5, Rain of Fire R3, Soul Fire R3, Curse of the Elements R2, Banish R2, Create Healthstone (Greater) · L48 Curse of Agony R5, Siphon Life R3. - **Talents:** Dark Harvest (L40), Grim Reach 1-2 (L41-42), Suppression 4-5 (L43-44), Shadow Vulnerability 1-5 (L45-49). - **Demon:** Voidwalker. Your DoTs now out-threat it, so "as Affliction, you will usually be tanking the mob". Switch from Drain Soul to Drain Life when your health gets low Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. **Single target** 1. Send the Voidwalker. 2. **From 44: Curse of Shadow** (Malediction adds Curse of Agony) fusedpro · 2025-10-20. Before 44, keep using rank-1 Recklessness. If Curse of Agony falls off, recast it yourself: Malediction does not refresh it Chidi <beta tester> · 2026-01-26. 3. **Corruption → Siphon Life.** 4. **Drain Soul** for damage, **Drain Life** when low. 5. **Dark Harvest** only on elites. On normal mobs it is weak, because they die too fast Sakkaro · 2025-11-04. 6. Nightfall proc → Shadow Bolt. Life Tap by the rule. 7. **Emergency:** Death Coil (42) to heal and stop a mob, then Healthstone. **Multi-target (3-4 mobs)** 1. Voidwalker on the first mob; DoT all of them. 2. Fear one, or use **Howl of Terror** (40, 2 s cast) when a pull goes bad (vanilla baseline). 3. With the optional Curse of Exhaustion talents, you can drag 4-5 mobs with slows and DoTs if your mana pool allows Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-22. Stay below 3-4 mobs without them. **Demon tanking (dungeons):** the 5-man "void tank" needs Wrathstone (42), Bane and Soul Link: "really can't do it until you get wrathstone bane and soul link" Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-02. That means a Demonology/Destruction build, not this Affliction order. See [Warlock tanking](#/class/warlock/guide/warlock-tank). **Demonology path:** Master Summoner 1-2 (L40-41), Power Overwhelming (L42), Unholy Power 1-3 (L43-45), Fel Stamina 5 (L46), Master Demonologist 1-3 (L47-49). Do not use Power Overwhelming while leveling "unless using the void with its consume shadows" Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-14. Even a Demonology Voidwalker eventually struggles to hold threat late vincentfm · 2026-04-12. ### Levels 50–60 - **New now:** L50 **Infernal** (Inferno quest), Dark Harvest R2, Death Coil R2, Immolate R6, Demon Armor R6, Mana Funnel R2, Searing Pain R5, Curse of Tongues R2, Create Soulstone (Greater) · L52 Shadow Bolt R8, Drain Soul R4, **Create Voidstone**, Health Funnel R6, Shadow Ward R3 · L54 Corruption R6, Drain Life R6, Hellfire R3, Howl of Terror R2, Soul Fire R4 · L56 Life Tap R6, Curse of Recklessness R4 · L58 Curse of Agony R6, Siphon Life R4, Death Coil R3, Rain of Fire R4, Create Healthstone (Major) · L60 Shadow Bolt R9, Drain Soul R5, Immolate R7, Dark Harvest R3, Curse of Shadow R2, Curse of the Elements R3, Demon Armor R7, Health Funnel R7, Create Soulstone (Major), Ritual of Doom (quest), Dreadsteed (quest). - **Talents:** Demonic Embrace 1-5 (L50-54), Soul Entrapment 1-3 (L55-57), Demonic Aegis 1-2 (L58-59), **Demonic Sacrifice** (L60). - **Demon:** Voidwalker until 60. At 60, sacrifice the Imp for raids ([Affliction: How to play](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps)). **Single target:** same as 40-49. Train every Drain Soul rank L-star · 2025-12-01. **Multi-target and farming:** Affliction farms by dotting 3-4 mobs, keeping them slowed with Curse of Exhaustion and kiting until they die, tapping as needed. Felstone and Siphon Life healing keep you in "resource equilibrium" Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-23. For Hellfire farms (Hyjal snakes, Dire Maul East lashers), see [AoE leveling and farming](#/class/warlock/leveling). **Demonology path:** Master Demonologist 4-5 (L50-51), Soul Link (L52), then the order's remaining points. At 60, respec to the [raid build](#/class/warlock/demonology-ranged-dps). ### Soul shards (all levels) | Rule | Detail | |---|---| | Get them | Finish mobs with **Drain Soul** (vanilla baseline). Rank 1 is enough when the shard is the point [Snipesta, 2025-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119257#p119257) | | Spend them on | Resummoning the Voidwalker, Succubus or Felhunter (the Imp is free), Healthstone and Soulstone, Soul Fire and Shadowburn (vanilla baseline). Ritual of Summoning costs 1 per summon fusedpro · 2025-10-26; Ritual of Souls (Soulwell) costs 3 rengartop · 2026-01-24 | | Get them back | A demon that despawns (flight path, out of range) refunds its shard, except the first one after you log in Karen · 2025-12-13, Karen · 2025-12-13. ShardCapPlus deletes extras fusedpro · 2025-10-12 | | Before a dungeon | Carry enough for a Healthstone, a Soulstone and 1-2 demon resummons (vanilla baseline) |

sections.heading: Pull and kill loop (Affliction, bot-ready)
sections.markdown: 1. **Send the Voidwalker** (Torment on autocast). Send it to the *next* mob a few seconds before the current one dies, so it builds a threat lead Chandalen · 2026-04-05. 2. **Curse of Agony**, or from 44 **Curse of Shadows** with Malediction fusedpro · 2025-10-20. 3. **Corruption** (instant from level 14). 4. **Siphon Life** if the mob will live long enough fusedpro · 2025-10-20. 5. **Filler:** below level ~34, wand; above that, Drain Life when you need health or Drain Soul for damage biloen · 2026-04-05, fusedpro · 2025-10-20. A level-15 dummy test: CoA → Corruption → Drain Soul held 31.5 DPS sustained, vs 23 with Drain Life and 33 falling to 28 with Shadow Bolt (mana) ysocereal · 2026-01-17. 6. **Nightfall proc → Shadow Bolt.** Otherwise do not hard-cast Shadow Bolt while leveling L-star · 2025-11-01. 7. **Life Tap** when you are near full health and below ~50% mana Xi · 2026-01-06. 8. **Next mob:** repeat. The Voidwalker's regeneration means you rarely stop Stunfisk · 2025-10-14. **Two or three mobs:** DoT all of them first, then Fear one. Fear breaks on new spell applications, not on DoT ticks, so DoT *before* you Fear Bones · 2025-06-25, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. Keep one on the Voidwalker, one feared, one on you biloen · 2026-04-05. **Curse of Recklessness stops a feared mob from fleeing**; swap to another curse to let it run again Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-05. Never apply Immolate early in the loop. Immolate is dropped once you have Siphon Life (Crash.Rush stopped at 33) Crash.Rush · 2026-03-27, and it is never part of the endgame Affliction rotation. **Demonology loop:** send the Voidwalker, DoT, then Drain Life or wand. Pull the next mob with the Voidwalker once the current one is at half health; Soul Funnel heals it for free Dreamhaze · 2025-11-20, Dreamhaze · 2025-11-20.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
sections.markdown: - Opening with Immolate, or hard-casting Shadow Bolt, instead of DoT + wand/drain. - Clipping Curse of Agony early; its biggest ticks are at the end Gilnean · 2025-10-10. - Fearing before you DoT, so the DoT application breaks the Fear. - Letting the Voidwalker fall behind on threat. Send it ahead a few seconds early. - Taking Unleashed Potential, Sinister Pursuit or Improved Curse of Weakness while leveling. - Buying pre-raid "BiS" lists at 50 instead of Shadoweave and "of Shadow Wrath" greens. - Running out of soul shards for Soul Fire, Healthstones and resummons. Shards stack to 3 per slot Szalor · 2025-11-15.

caveats: No source gives a complete slot-by-slot raid-tier BiS list for any Warlock spec — only a single player's flat, unordered gear list (5mman's post, called "dated" by its own author), tier-set bonus text, and scattered named items. Forum threads that directly asked for a BiS list (`t6834`, `t20477`, `t15091`, `t22994`) mostly got "there's pretty much no need" or a dead Google-Sheets link back, not an answer.

`leveling.md` states explicitly that no Warlock-forum thread gives a leveling item list (a thread asking, `t15091`, got zero replies) — bots should fall back to general upgrade heuristics, not an invented list.

Item IDs are almost never given; where a forum post does give a database.turtlecraft.gg item link (Mustachiocat's 2023 list) the item names were not stated by the poster, only the numeric IDs and a one-word source tag.

brackets.stat_notes: Route advice (Grubi450, 2023-05-31): "Join a guild that is looking for a warlock and you will get the bloodvine set free of charge if you bring the mats. Do Sunken Temple once while leveling for the Soul Harvester, it's almost as good as pre raid bis but very easy to get. When you reach 60 spam Stormwind Vaults since you can enslave the fire/frost imp ... get your bis trinket, wand and ring (reward from the tome quest for Alliance) as well some random caster gear. Do LBRS once as a 10 man raid to get the Eye of the Beast quest, start your MC/BWL/Ony attunement, finish UBRS for attunements and Eye of the Beast ... sections.heading: Gaps (what the sources do not settle)
sections.markdown: 1. **No post-release, like-for-like comparison** of Affliction vs Demonology vs Fire at equal gear. The rankings rest on parses and opinion (Tatica ツ · 2026-03-21 vs W · 2026-03-20). 2. **Unleashed Potential's attack-power school:** highest school or shadow only? Nezu/Papaverine/Mooncrazed · 2025-10-28, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-04-08. 3. **Does Devastation raise your demon's crit?** W says yes, Summonjutsu says no Afraido · 2026-03-23, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-01-26. 4. **Haste breakpoints:** tested as not real by Nezu and biloen, but some players still report a noticeable step (12% → 13%) after release Ton Kie · 2026-03-31. 5. **Late Affliction gearing:** full T3 vs a T2.5/T3 mix never got a clean test Tatica ツ · 2026-02-26. 6. **PvP damping:** the per-spec values were never published; whether warlocks were hit hard is disputed. 7. **Dwarf warlock:** no PvE or PvP evaluation beyond one-line opinions. 8. **Leveling route:** there is no zone-by-zone route or full dungeon-by-bracket list, only named item pickups. 9. **Hellfire vs Rain of Fire after the 1.18.1 Hellfire buff:** no comparison posted. 10. **Resilient Shadows:** players doubt it works Deleted User · 2026-01-15. 11. **Blood Fury's value:** sources quote 60 SP and 120 SP Gilnean · 2025-10-16, Cyric · 2026-04-07. 12. **Doomguard vs Felguard/Infernal single-target:** unresolved. L-star calls Doomguard "on par with Infernal and Felguard on single target" L-star · 2026-04-06, while W says Doomguard is single-target and Felguard is the AoE demon W · 2026-03-24. 13. **Shadow Oil and Shadow Vulnerability:** whether the oil's Shadow Bolt applies the debuff was never answered Planetes_04 · 2026-03-15. 14. **Demonology-specific enchants:** no source gives a per-slot list; the pages reuse Affliction's slots with spell power over haste. 15. **Dark Harvest's cooldown reset on kill** was reported as not working; no fix was confirmed rey.1982 · 2026-01-21.

guidePages.title: Warlock professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** level with a **gathering pair** (Mining + Skinning, or Herbalism + Alchemy), then run **Engineering + Alchemy** (or Engineering + Herbalism) at 60. Engineering is "the no-brainer choice" for endgame and Alchemy "is always good" sailorVEVO · 2026-01-11, sailorVEVO · 2026-01-18. Tailoring is optional. Its one bind-on-pickup payoff is Mooncloth for T3/T3.5, and its best warlock pieces are Bind on Equip, so you can buy them L-star · 2025-12-20, L-star · 2025-12-20. If you take Jewelcrafting, choose **Gemology**, not Goldsmithing Karina · 2025-10-14, sailorVEVO · 2025-10-23.

sections.heading: What each profession gives a warlock
sections.markdown: ### Engineering - **The consensus endgame profession.** The main value is Goblin Sapper Charges, the Battle Chicken, and reflectors and grenades for PvP dindunuffinz · 2026-01-11. Sappers are "very good" on the Viscidus fight and on Naxx spider trash, and they add a big damage boost when 20+ players use them dindunuffinz · 2026-01-11. The Destruction page lists sappers for Naxx spider trash ([Destruction](#/class/warlock/destruction-fire-ranged-dps)). - **Pre-raid head:** the Karazhan-10 engineering helm is an alternative to Crown of Molten Ascension (single source) Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-04. - **"Selfish" profession:** most of what you make is usable only by engineers, so it has little market value (60) Enginuity🏹 · 2025-08-25. Mima calls it "more so a PvP thing"; in a hardcore endgame guild "sapper charges are a must" Mima · 2025-09-23. - **Gnomish or Goblin:** to min-max, take Gnomish until you have crafted every Gnomish-only item, then unlearn and relearn as Goblin. If you pick only one, take Goblin for sappers (single source) TowelDruid · 2026-01-02, TowelDruid · 2026-01-02. - **Training gate:** past skill 150 you need an Artisan-or-higher trainer, for example Roxxik in Orgrimmar, to learn Expert Engineering Valaen · 2026-04-03, Valaen · 2026-04-03. ### Alchemy (and Herbalism) - Make your own consumables. Karen takes Alchemy "for ease of consumes", but an alt can do that job too Karen · 2026-01-18. The raid consumable list (Dreamshard Elixir, Elixir of Shadow Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Major Mana Potion, protection potions and more) is on [Affliction](#/class/warlock/affliction-ranged-dps) Karen · 2025-10-13. - **Transmute cooldown:** "the transmute cd is nice" Stunfisk · 2025-10-06. Alts on transmute and Mooncloth cooldowns are the passive-income plan (see [Gold](#/class/warlock/professions)). - Level-35 mana potions are a cheap Alchemy skill-up, so they are cheap on the AH peter_hammer · 2026-01-12. ### Tailoring - **What is worth it:** Mooncloth for T3 and T3.5 L-star · 2025-12-20. The **Core Felcloth Bag** (MC materials) is the endgame soul bag: it holds shards and demon-summoning reagents, and its reagent-refund chance is 25% Lightemgee · 2025-12-04, Feenik · 2026-03-25, L-star · 2025-11-02. - **BoE, so buy it:** the tailored cloak is good for Demonology and Destruction, and the gloves are BiS for Affliction L-star · 2025-12-20. The haste tailoring gloves from Karazhan-10 are a pre-raid pick Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-04, Lax · 2026-03-24. The Dire Maul-reputation tailored cloak is still used in Kara40 on Demonology (single source) L-star · 2025-12-11. - **BoP robe:** "not like you need it" L-star · 2025-12-20. Some pre-raid prebis items only make sense for a tailor Karen · 2025-12-26. - **Bloodvine** is weak now. Its hit moved onto the individual pieces and its set passive is "not very good" Lightemgee · 2025-12-30, Lightemgee · 2025-12-30. Asked about Bloodvine for a non-tailor, biloen runs 3-piece T1 with off-pieces and suggests the Kara10 chest biloen · 2026-03-23, biloen · 2026-03-23. - **Leveling:** the **Shadoweave** set lasts from level 37 to 60; buy it if you are not a tailor sailorVEVO · 2026-03-15. - **Against it:** "Every guild has someone who can help you make things" Bebber · 2025-10-06. Tailoring also uses the same cloth as First Aid bandages, and warlocks lean on bandages for downtime (60) Enginuity🏹 · 2025-08-25. If you do both, level Tailoring and First Aid together, one cloth tier at a time Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-06. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle custom) - **Gemology over Goldsmithing.** Gemology makes ring and neck enchants that "always will be in demand". Goldsmithing makes "overly expensive prebis items" that get replaced, and it "becomes increasingly ass as the game progresses" Karina · 2025-10-14, sailorVEVO · 2025-10-23, Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-20. sailorVEVO: level Goldsmithing only "when ur rich" sailorVEVO · 2025-10-14. Enchanted gemstones work "like enchants": anyone can use them, with no specialisation needed — [Akalix (staff), 2025-06-19](https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/976193120809123881/1385337387206578301). - **Warlock uses:** hit rings and neck with JC enchants biloen · 2026-02-24; +8 resistance jewelry enchants for tank-lock resistance sets L-star · 2026-02-13; vampirism enchants on rings and neck for the lasher farm Tyrona · 2025-11-15, biloen · 2026-04-10; a 2% haste JC neck (single source) Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-12-06. - Pair it with **Mining** to supply your own materials for staves, rings and trinkets (60) Enginuity🏹 · 2025-08-25. It is expensive to level, but Gemology "will start making money back eventually" Karina · 2025-10-14. ### Enchanting - **Not for leveling.** Mirror lists the problems: it is click-heavy, it needs rods, the Artisan trainer is inside an elite instance, and it only becomes profitable at the very end Mirror · 2025-06-17. - At 60 it makes gold if you advertise in chat rqo · 2025-11-25. Vampirism bracer and boot enchants help the lasher-farm set biloen · 2026-04-10. ### Leatherworking, Mining, Skinning - Cured Rugged Hides sell to players buying T3 tokens; Mooncloth and Arcanite Bars "always sell" (single source) Stunfisk · 2026-03-13, Stunfisk · 2026-03-13. - Mining + Skinning is the "keep gold flowing to buy consumables" option Mima · 2025-09-23. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) - **1.18.1 rework (official):** Survival now "draws from other primary professions". It has 80+ new recipes, tools that slow, root or trap opponents, bags for the three gathering professions, and Woodcutting — [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168). Player-reported crafts include Throwable Net, Slowing Bolas, Nutritious Rations, gathering trinkets and a slingshot for ranged pulls — [Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2026-03-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172915#p172915), [Atreidon (player), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172086#p172086). The 1–300 route and trainers are in the [Professions overview](#/professions). - **Warlock channel:** one PvP player says he needs "to level Survival for those nets and other stuff", to handle melee that reach him (single source) Afraido · 2026-03-28. The channel does not otherwise discuss Survival or Gardening for warlocks. Take Survival for open-world and PvP nets/bolas if you want them; it has no known raid value. - **Tents and rested XP (1.18.1):** kills now give 50% rested bonus (was 100%), and tents only fill up to 25% rested — [Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168). Before 1.18.1, tents gave full rested bonus. - **Gardening:** needs Survival 75 — [official site](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening). The 1.18.1 overhaul reset the Gardening quest — [Sylveria (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171863#p171863). The warlock channel mentions it only as an alternative to farming WL/hunt · 2026-01-27.

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - **Dire Maul East lashers** (58+) is the standard warlock farm. With Herbalism for the Dreamfoil it earns about 80–100 g/h on Ambershire, capped at 4 instance resets per hour Dezmar · 2026-01-27, Dezmar · 2026-01-27, Tapka · 2026-04-05. **Contested:** one player calls it "generally shit" now that herb prices are low JP Morgan Intern · 2025-12-31. - **Herbs to an Alchemy alt:** make your own consumables and sell the rest Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-03. - **Cooldown alts:** "5 or more lvl 35 alts with transmute/mooncloth cds" earn a "passive" 200–300 g a week (single source) Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2025-11-03. L-star farms Hyjal satyrs for Felcloth to feed his Mooncloth alts L-star · 2026-02-11. - **Other farms:** a solo ZG route with the Imp (about 200 g/h) Qazdur · 2026-01-30; Hyjal demon satyrs as Affliction for cloth and shards Frolegacy · 2026-03-06; Moonwhisper Coast elementals Metsys · 2026-04-10; MC/ZG raid weeklies Ionnatra · 2026-04-08. Warlock gold-farming is generally rated below hunter's, at least for ZG ("no other class is allowed to farm zg") biloen · 2026-02-11. - **Mount:** the level-60 Dreadsteed quest includes epic riding for about 400–450 g, much less than other classes pay. Another warlock can supply materials and save you about 250 g vincentfm · 2026-04-02, Fauxnetic · 2026-04-18.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- No warlock source puts numbers on the gain from sappers or grenades, or lists which 1.18.1 Survival crafts are worth it for a warlock.
- No source lists Gemology recipes with warlock stats (e.g. shadow spell power); only "hit" and "+8 resistance" enchants are named.
- The Goblin vs Gnomish Engineering advice comes from single sources.

See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/warlock)

guidePages.title: Warlock tanking (niche)
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** warlock tanking is a **niche role, not a real tank spec**. sections.heading: How to play
sections.markdown:
The tank loop at level 60. The details are in [Pull and threat loop](#/class/warlock/guide/warlock-tank) (5-man), [Threat rotation](#/class/warlock/guide/warlock-tank) (Twin Emperors) and [Where it works](#/class/warlock/guide/warlock-tank).

**5-man "void tank" (0/33/18, Wrathstone up):**

1. **Pull:** send the Voidwalker in with Torment, or run in and chain-DoT with Felstone up.
2. **First GCDs:**
    - Caster or melee pairs: Immolate every target, then tab Searing Pain.
    - Packs: DoT the group, then Hellfire once the mobs converge on you.
3. **Steady threat:** keep Immolate up and cast Searing Pain on the kill target. Every fire spell gets the Wrathstone threat bonus.
4. **Multi-mob threat:** Hellfire keeps the pack. Health Funnel, Felstone, Healthstone and Voidwalker Sacrifice are your only AoE healing-threat tools.
5. **No taunt, so no threat recovery:** keep the group's burst in check. Death Coil or Fear a loose mob that heads for the healer. Against kicks, bait the interrupt and hold threat with a fire wand plus Immolate.
6. **Defensive rules:** Soul Link and the Voidwalker's Master Demonologist bonus carry your damage reduction. Keep the Voidwalker alive with Health Funnel, and use Healthstone. **Contested:** whether potions such as Stoneshield make it practical (see the table above).
7. **Avoid:** tanking before you have Wrathstone, Bane and Soul Link; any content with frequent silences or school lockouts (Stratholme); treating vampirism healing as threat.

**Twin Emperors caster tank (0/17/34, shadow resistance):** after each teleport you need about 5k threat within a few seconds. Cast Immolate → Conflagrate → Searing Pain spam, with Shadow Ward on cooldown. Curse of Doom is an optional burst. Never cast Shadow Bolt, because it has no pushback protection. Park your pet in the middle of the room.

sections.heading: Twin Emperors: shadow-resistance tank
sections.markdown: You tank **Vek'lor**, the caster, whose Shadow Bolts need shadow resistance. ### Shadow resistance - About **210-220 total shadow resistance** removes the full-damage (non-partial) results from Shadow Bolt. After that, hits cap around 3k Not Normal · 2026-02-16, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2026-03-18. - **Contested:** some players want 315. L-star calls that "huge overkill" L-star · 2026-02-16. - Gear: the vanilla shadow-resistance set, the Argent Dawn exalted trinket, and Jewelcrafting +8 resistance enchants on rings and neck L-star · 2026-02-13. - Cinamo's sum (1.18.0 tree): 221 from gear + 24 from 3/3 Demonic Aegis Demon Armor + 60 from Prayer of Shadow Protection (does not stack with Mark of the Wild) + 10 from Gift of Arthas = 315 Cinamo/Odessyus · 2025-09-04. - A Felhunter adds 60 more if you keep it out. The pure-Destruction build gives it up, and with it Soul Link's damage transfer, but gets "crazy threat" biloen · 2026-02-24. ### Build: Demonic Sacrifice + Improved Stones + deep Destruction (0/17/34) "I think going demonic sac, improved stones and then rest in destro is bis" (biloen) biloen · 2026-02-24. The talent plus a paladin's Concentration Aura reaches 100% Lightemgee · 2026-04-02. - **Stamina.** Vampirism gear does **not** generate threat, so do not count it as a threat tool Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-31. - **Hit** matters for tanking bosses beyond Kara10/ZG-tier content Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-07-20. ### Pull and threat loop 1. Send the Voidwalker in with Torment, or run in and chain-DoT with Felstone up Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-08-02. 2. When the pack converges on you, **Hellfire** Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-08-02. 3. On caster or melee pairs (e.g. 2-3 ogres in BRD), Immolate them all and tab Searing Pain Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-07-20. 4. Your only AoE *healing* threat tools are Felstone, Healthstone, Voidwalker Sacrifice and Health Funnel Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-31. Health Funnel creates AoE healing threat Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-31. 5. Against interrupts (LBRS), bait the kick and hold threat with a fire wand plus Immolate Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-04. 6. If you lose a mob, you cannot taunt it back. Keep your group's burst in check and use Death Coil or Fear on the loose mob. ### Where it works | Content | Verdict | Source | |---|---|---| | Dire Maul (all wings, including tribute), BRD | Doable; DM North's last boss can burst you with low-geared healers | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-04, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-10 | | Kara10 ([Lower Karazhan Halls](#/instances/lower-karazhan-halls)) | An Alliance lock with Salvation can tank most of it; one boss needs a synced tank swap. Summonjutsu solo-tanked Howlfang | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-02, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-07-31 | | ZG, AQ20 trash | Niche off-tanking works | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-30, W · 2026-03-25 | | Stratholme Live | Impossible (monks kick every 2 s, 4 s school lock) | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-30 | | Stratholme Dead | Not doable either, same verdict as Live: the spell lockout and silence shut you down | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-12-10 | | [Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass) final boss | "Really really rough" | Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-10-30 | | Onyxia (whelps, P3) | A lock tanked the whelps with DoTs, Drain Life and Siphon Life spam; L-star's guild lock tanks Onyxia and MC as Affliction | Frolegacy · 2026-01-24, L-star · 2026-01-26 | You would want two healers instead of one, but that is hard to arrange in a pug, so Ghost9626 does not consider warlock tanking viable there; for an organised party, it may be simpler to just run Hellfire without Wrathstone and bring a paladin tank instead Ghost9626 | Warlock Shift Lead · 2026-03-30.

sections.heading: Common mistakes
sections.markdown:
- Trying to tank without Wrathstone, Soul Link and pushback protection.
- Casting Shadow Bolt as the Twins tank.
- Expecting vampirism or Felstone healing to hold threat.
- Tanking anything with frequent silences or interrupts.
- Forgetting to recast Demon Armor after changing Demonic Aegis points.

name: Druid
summary: Druids on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 fill every role from four specs that share three talent trees:
recommendation:
Druids on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 fill every role from four specs that share three talent trees:

- **Feral Bear** is a real main tank: the best sustained single-target threat and the biggest health pool, weaker since 1.18.1 in the first seconds of a pull.
- **Feral Cat** is a strong single-target melee DPS on bleedable bosses, with no AoE at all.
- **Restoration** is a strong HoT raid healer, but a raid wants only one or two.
- **Balance** (Moonkin) is the lowest DPS spec in the game, brought for its utility.
overview: Druids on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 fill every role from four specs that share three talent trees: - **Feral Bear** is a real main tank: the best sustained single-target threat and the biggest health pool, weaker since 1.18.1 in the first seconds of a pull. - **Feral Cat** is a strong single-target melee DPS on bleedable bosses, with no AoE at all. - **Restoration** is a strong HoT raid healer, but a raid wants only one or two. - **Balance** (Moonkin) is the lowest DPS spec in the game, brought for its utility. **New player recommendation:** level as **Feral** (Feral Swiftness first, respec into Omen of Clarity at 30) and tank or heal your dungeons on the way; see [Leveling](#/class/druid/leveling). At 60 pick Bear to tank, Cat to melee, or Restoration to heal. "All 4 specs are viable at endgame and brought to raids. Feral leveling is fastest, balance is viable. Leveling as resto sucks" Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-09-03.

readme.heading: What changed for druids in 1.18.1
readme.markdown: 1.18.1 ("Nightmares of Ursol") released 2026-03-20 ([Jamey, 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)). The community summary: "Bear = threat nerf, Cat = no change, Boomies = look like buff but it is a nerf" Mitou · 2026-03-21. | Area | Change | What it means in play | |---|---|---| | Bear | Maul threat modifier 175% → 160%, Savage Bite 225% → 213% Ionnatra · 2026-02-08, Micro Jackson · 2026-02-16 | About 10-20% less threat in practice, mostly in the first 10 s Holydruid · 2026-03-20; still top sustained threat. Feral Instinct becomes a must Alfras · 2026-01-24 | | Balance | Balance of All Things 5 → 3 points, now needs your DoT on the target (Wrath refunds mana vs Insect Swarm; Starfire +3/6/9% crit vs Moonfire); Eclipse procs 40%/60%; Moonfury 4/8/12% ([Jamey](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | Longer Starfire casts; less RNG; roughly the same ~40% DPS gap Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10 | | Balance | Two new idols (Equilibrium, Acidity) Angrycat / Powershift · 2026-03-20 | Both weaker than Ebb and Flow Krokat · 2026-03-31 | | Cat | No changes: "no time to look at Cats" Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-01-26; the Kara40 Shieldrender Talisman was nerfed Ash · 2026-02-15 | Same rotation as 1.18.0 | | Resto | T3.5 5-piece Blooming Bud cut to a 20 s timer Moonshroud · 2026-02-18; Tree of Life aura now updates from current Spirit Xerq · 2026-02-25 | The set bonus is near worthless; no more aura snapshot trick | | All | Swapping idols in combat costs a GCD Comentor · 2026-03-01 | Idol-dancing rotations are dead | | All | Iron Counterweight can go on staves 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-20 | Atiesh bears get 3% haste | | All | New **Fortune** stat (raises item proc chances) Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-02-16 | Useless in Cat/Bear Form, where chance-on-hit never procs Habu · 2026-02-20 | | Other classes | Holy Paladin T3.5 set cut ~83% Micro Jackson · 2026-01-27; priest Renew buffed Micro Jackson · 2026-03-24; paladin snap threat buffed Shardphoenix · 2026-03-26 | Resto lost its top-healer spot to priests; bear lost pull threat to paladins | Earlier Turtle changes you will meet in older guides: - **Reshift** (1.18.0): drops and re-enters your form in one click; the modern powershift and snare-break button Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-06-01, Comentor · 2026-01-11. - **Omen of Clarity** is a passive, not a buff you cast, and procs far more often than in vanilla 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-08, Kay9Cop (Grakkus) · 2025-11-21. - **Wolfshead Helm** became a head enchant from a repeatable Moonglade quest Lyrazia · 2025-10-11, Whatshername · 2026-04-14. - **Manual Crowd Pummeler** no longer works in form Voodoo · 2026-01-18. - The **hit cap** is 8% melee (no +3-level suppression) Rustam · 2026-04-09. - **Moonkin Form** at level 30 Dreamhaze · 2025-12-01; Mark and Gift of the Wild castable in Moonkin Form, but not Rebirth Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-03-14, Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-02-18. - **Armor has no hard cap**; bear armor is useful to ~23k Micro Jackson · 2026-02-09. - Most **consumables and bandages work in Cat/Bear Form**, but sappers and grenades cancel it Nesquikbunny · 2026-02-27, Coxy · 2026-02-17. - In Cat and Bear Form your weapon is a **stat stick**: its damage, speed and "chance on hit" do nothing; "Equip:" effects work chincer · 2025-11-28. - **Swift Travel Form** (100% speed) comes from a level-60 questline that needs the Emerald Sanctum; see [Leveling](#/class/druid/leveling).

readme.heading: Professions
readme.markdown: - **Level with two gathering professions**, since crafting is a money sink early Micro Jackson · 2026-03-15. Herbalism fits druids best, because you can herb from Swift Travel Form Floatin · 2026-04-14. - **At 60, Herbalism + Alchemy** covers raid consumables and healer mana potions Moss Treader · 2026-01-14. **Engineering** is the one profession with unique raid tools Tephus · 2025-11-06, but sappers and most gadgets do not work in Cat or Bear Form. That makes it a Balance/Resto pick, not a feral one DrakeReinz · 2026-03-24, Viertakt · 2026-02-14. - **Leatherworking** helps while leveling and has little value later Viertakt · 2026-02-14. Elemental Leatherworking crafts the "extra good" Convergence of the Elements leggings Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. Turtle also adds ring and neck enchants (Jewelcrafting) and belt buckles (Blacksmithing) Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. playbooks.title: Feral Bear (tank)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **11/35/5 tank build** (Feral Instinct, Thick Hide, Feral Charge, Carnage, Improved Shred, Furor). Get **8% hit**, then gear two sets: a **threat** set (haste, Strength, crit) and a **mitigation** set (Stamina, armor). Open every boss the same way: **Cat Form → Tiger's Fury → Bear Form → Mighty Rage Potion → Maul + Savage Bite**, then **Maul on every swing**, **Savage Bite** on Clearcasting or high rage, **Swipe** on 2+ mobs or at full rage. Bear is still the strongest sustained single-target threat tank, but since 1.18.1 it is weaker in the first seconds of a pull, and it takes more damage than warriors or paladins. | | | |---|---| | Role | Main tank or off-tank; the best single-target threat and the biggest health pool, with the weakest AoE threat and few defensive buttons Tephus · 2026-01-25, Tephus · 2026-01-27 | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Contested, still raid-viable.** "Bears are actually BiS tanks at top-end raiding" Tephus · 2026-04-11; the post-nerf "dooming was unwarranted", but bear no longer dominates the roster Habu · 2026-04-13. Paladins now win snap threat with the new libram and Consecration Shardphoenix · 2026-03-26. Micro Jackson rated bear 9.5/10 after the patch Micro Jackson · 2026-03-22. | | Difficulty | Low: "end game bear is great but simple" Tephus · 2026-02-18 | | Strengths | Sustained threat on long bosses; huge HP; flexes to cat DPS and off-tank; the "best all-around dungeon tank" Eepyman · 2026-04-08 | | Weaknesses | No parry or block, so no crit/crush immunity; about 2x the damage taken of other tanks Shardphoenix · 2026-03-26; dodged or parried openers leave no fallback Shardphoenix · 2026-03-26; Swipe hits only 3 targets Shardphoenix · 2026-04-07 |
