stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: Keep two sets and swap by fight: bear BiS questions are always "mitigation vs threat" Comentor · 2025-12-06. 1. **Hit to 8%** (5% from gear with Natural Weapons). "Hitcap > everything else, we get parried/dodged/blocked enough as is" Viertakt · 2026-04-07. **Taunt/Growl use spell hit** (16% base miss vs bosses), which matters on Four Horsemen Tephus · 2026-01-20, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-01-23. 2. **Threat set: haste, Strength, crit.** Haste is "absolutely the best stat by FAR for threat", because Maul rides the swing timer Lyrazia · 2025-09-11. About 1% haste ≈ 12 Strength Micro Jackson · 2025-10-27. One set of weights: AP 1, Agility 1.5, Strength 2.2, Crit 25, Haste 26, Hit 36 Ash · 2026-02-02. **Contested: Agility.** "Agi is bait ... triple the threat gains from 3 Haste over 25 Agi" Ash · 2026-02-19 vs "Agi is superior if you are not crit capped and plan to do Kara" 𝔅𝔩𝔢𝔰𝔦𝔰𝔦 · 2026-02-21. Strength gives 2 AP; Agility gives crit, dodge and 2 unscaled armor Albu · 2026-03-08, Micro Jackson · 2026-04-08. Bear white-hit crit caps at about 52.5% with 8% hit Zoeferal · 2026-02-21. 3. **Mitigation set: Stamina, then armor.** Armor on rings, trinkets, neck and weapon is "massive value", because those slots are multiplied by Dire Bear Form (about 3.6x) Tephus · 2025-11-29, Akos · 2025-11-29. Look for leather with green (bonus) armor text Tephus · 2026-02-10. Armor from enchants, kits and food is **not** multiplied Viertakt · 2025-10-10, Shared · 2026-02-17. 4. **Armor has no hard cap on Turtle.** Value is linear to about 16.6-17.3k, still worth it to about 22-23k, then drops sharply Micro Jackson · 2026-02-09, Medvedev · 2025-11-15. 22k armor ≈ 78% reduction against a level-63 boss Tephus · 2026-01-20. 5. **Defense and dodge are weak.** Bears cannot push crits off the table without parry and block; 440 defense needs nearly full T2/T3 and is called a trap Tephus · 2025-12-28, Medvedev · 2025-10-15. **Contested:** dodge. Camp A: near zero or negative, since dodge costs rage and makes damage spikier Micro Jackson · 2025-10-27, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-12-23. Camp B: valuable for big trash pulls and with Ancient Brutality's rage-on-dodge Ivina · 2025-10-27, Lyrazia · 2025-12-02. Never enchant dodge Lyrazia · 2025-09-11. **Fresh-60 enchant priority:** haste > Strength > armor > Stamina rel · 2026-02-11.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Pre-pull (about 10 s before):** Regrowth → Rejuvenation → Cat Form → **Tiger's Fury** → Bear Form FeerZero · 2026-02-15. Tiger's Fury's Blood Frenzy haste survives the shift into Bear Comentor · 2025-12-01. Furor plus a rage-on-shift head enchant give up to ~15 rage Dziadmroz · 2026-02-15. Self-HoTs also generate healing threat on everything you enter combat with Micro Jackson · 2025-10-27. **Pull:** Faerie Fire (Feral), or a ranged pull, then **Mighty Rage Potion** and open **Maul + Savage Bite** Atriana · 2026-02-16, Dziadmroz · 2026-02-21. Never open with Growl: it does nothing on a mob with no threat list Micro Jackson · 2025-10-28. Feral Charge generates no threat Holidae · 2025-10-29. Pop **Enrage** (or Berserk) when the Tiger's Fury Blood Frenzy runs out Leido · 2026-04-01. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **`Maul`** queued on every swing; it is the threat engine LillaGummen · 2026-02-20, Micro Jackson · 2026-04-08. 2. **`Savage Bite`** (6 s cooldown) when you have **Clearcasting** or **rage > 50** (some use 35) Micro Jackson · 2026-04-08, Sagesse · 2026-04-07, LillaGummen · 2026-02-20. With **T3 8-piece**, use it on every cooldown to keep the damage-reduction stacks Dziadmroz · 2026-03-09. 3. **`Swipe`** if **2+ mobs** or **rage is full** (Sagesse: above 75 rage) Micro Jackson · 2026-04-08, Sagesse · 2026-04-07. On a single target it is only a rage dump with poor threat Valarya · 2026-03-21. 4. **`Faerie Fire (Feral)`** when no other GCD is needed LillaGummen · 2026-02-20. 5. **`Growl`** only to take back a mob or to answer a double dodge/parry at the pull. Taunt is off the GCD, so you can let a caster open first and taunt past them Tephus · 2025-10-27. 6. **`Reshift`** (Bear → Bear) for a burst of rage when rage-starved, timed around the swing; do not overdo it, since it costs Maul uptime Micro Jackson · 2026-01-18, Sagesse · 2026-04-07. Maul, Swipe and Savage Bite do not share a GCD Medvedev · 2025-11-08. **Enrage** increases damage taken; skip it when your healers struggle Habu · 2026-02-28. While leveling (rage-starved), do not open with Maul; use autos and Swipe after the first Roar Stunfisk · 2025-11-12. ### The 1.18.1 threat nerf | Ability | Threat modifier | Real loss | |---|---|---| | Maul | 175% → 160% | ≈ 9% on Maul | | Savage Bite | 225% → 213% | ≈ 5.6% on Bite | The official note subtracted percentage points, not a relative 15%/12% Micro Jackson · 2026-02-16, Ionnatra · 2026-02-08. In practice players measured about 10-20% total loss, worst in the first ~10 s ("the first 10 seconds are a nightmare now") Holydruid · 2026-03-20, Sha · 2026-03-24. Over a long fight bear still out-threats a warrior once its lead is built Holydruid · 2026-03-24. On Ambershire, some tanks barely noticed it Fikey · 2026-03-22, and dungeon tanking is unaffected Mr. Berold · 2026-03-25. **Threat help:** Kiss of the Spider (near-essential) and Atiesh Valarya · 2026-03-24; Salvation on the highest-threat non-tank Dinousek · 2026-02-20. Horde on Tel'Abim has no Salvation and relies on bear threat most Viertakt · 2025-12-01.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE threat
rotationAoe.markdown: Bear AoE is the weakest of the tanks: tab-target and Swipe (3 targets), and focus one mob at a time unless a paladin or shaman is in the group chincer · 2025-11-26, Coxy · 2026-02-17. | Pack | Action | |---|---| | Any pull | Pre-HoT yourself, **Maul the kill target**, tab and **Swipe** the others, Faerie Fire (Feral) on loose adds Micro Jackson · 2025-10-27. Mark targets and ask DPS to wait for one Maul Holydruid · 2025-10-25 | | 2-3 mobs | Swipe + Maul; Savage Bite on Clearcasting GolgothaTheGreen · 2025-12-30 | | 4+ mobs | Split 2-3 mobs per tank Repl01d_Brocsa · 2026-01-27. Pre-cast Hurricane at the front mob so the pack runs through it Dinousek · 2026-02-17 | | Big packs (Naxx skitterers, ES whelps) | **Idol of Evergrowth**: Demoralizing Roar deals your Thorns damage to every mob hit, uncapped (~120 threat per cast; Thorns up to 44 with T1+T2 set bonuses) Micro Jackson · 2025-11-19, ykls · 2025-12-24, walhartiscute · 2026-02-17. It only beats Swipe at about 15 mobs Elmcdee · 2025-12-12 | - **Dragonbreath Chili** and **Oil of Immolation** add AoE threat Dinousek · 2026-02-17, walhartiscute · 2026-02-17. - **Sapper Charges and dynamite knock you out of Bear Form**; they are useless for bear AoE Coxy · 2026-02-17. - Windfury and Flametongue totems help bear threat a lot; Windfury beats the Agility totem TowelDruid · 2026-03-07, Tephus · 2026-02-27. - The AQ20 set lets Swipe hit a 4th target TowelDruid · 2026-03-07.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and survival
cooldowns.markdown: - **Barkskin** (60 s): cast it in caster form before shifting; the buff persists in Bear Form, at the cost of 20% attack speed Micro Jackson · 2026-04-01, Micro Jackson · 2025-10-28. **Barkskin (Feral)** has a 10-minute cooldown Micro Jackson · 2026-01-27. - **Frenzied Regeneration** was nerfed for PvP reasons and heals little Dexter Syphex · 2024-11-18. - **Berserk** is your fear break Comentor · 2026-01-19. - **Bandages** work in Bear Form on Turtle Nesquikbunny · 2026-02-27; potions and most consumables work in form 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-08-30. - Bear Form has a built-in 10% lifesteal Stunfisk · 2026-02-08. - Emergency: a cat who rips threat can shift to Bear and has about a 50/50 chance to live until the tank taunts Kelushka · 2026-03-30.

roleStrategy.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **[Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass):** Hibernate the extra adds in 3- and 4-mob packs (they apply −50% armor, bleeds or stuns if left up) and Barkskin before the bridge. The final boss has the most armor of any NPC and hits very hard Hassle · 2026-01-12, Modwolf · 2026-01-12, Micro Jackson · 2025-11-21. - **[Kara10](#/instances/lower-karazhan-halls) Clawlord Howlfang:** his stacking debuff strips all your armor. Let a DPS soak the first stacks, take over near 10 stacks, or bring a warrior off-tank Micro Jackson · 2025-11-20, Micro Jackson · 2025-11-20. - **Incantagos:** pre-HoT, FF + Roar on pull, Rage Potion, spam Roar until the first two adds die; do not let warriors Bloodrage before you have aggro Viertakt · 2026-01-17, Holydruid · 2026-01-17. - **Twin Emperors:** Vek'nilash's Unbalancing Strike cuts 100 defense and causes crushing blows; do not Roar or Swipe the neutral scorpions Viertakt · 2025-12-20, Viertakt · 2025-12-20. - **Nefarian** is tankable with a Stoneshield Potion and the ZG trinket; expect spikes on Shadowflame Viertakt · 2026-02-05. - **Four Horsemen:** spell hit for Taunt (Nat Pagle's Broken Reel) 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-01-23. - **Mephistroth** (Kara40): full boss uptime is hard because of Hellfire; bears still open with the 8-piece set Kyrsie · 2026-04-10, Velanir · 2026-04-10.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Tier sets: **T2 and T3 are itemized for bear**, T1/T2.5/T3.5 for cat Lyrazia · 2026-04-08. ### Pre-raid | Slot | Item | Source | |---|---|---| | Chest, weapon | Time-Blackened Chestpiece and the polearm from [Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-20 | | Hands, feet (or 2H) | [Karazhan Crypt](#/instances/karazhan-crypt) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-20 | | Waist, trinkets | [Hateforge Quarry](#/instances/hateforge-quarry): last-boss belt, the hit trinket, and the **Hatereaver Cog** armor trinket | Lyrazia · 2025-09-20, Stunfisk · 2025-10-22 | | Trinket | Blackhand's Breadth (LBRS) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-20 | | Neck | Mark of Fordring (Eastern Plaguelands) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-20 | | Cloak | Silvermoon honored cloak (Alliance) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-20 | | Ring | The Torta questline ring: "almost 700 armor more in Dire Bear Form" | chincer · 2025-11-15 | | Weapon | Gavel of the Northwind (pre-raid bear BiS in 2025); Unyielding Maul | Elesion · 2025-01-03, Stunfisk · 2025-10-22 | Black Morass is the fresh-60 gear check: "if you can survive pulls in there, you're good to tank raids" Holidae · 2025-11-21. Use a full tank build there Dziadmroz · 2026-03-21. ### Raid - **Weapon:** Blessed Qiraji War Hammer (AQ40) is BiS even against Kara40 weapons, except for pure-mitigation setups Micro Jackson · 2025-10-29. Herald of Woe (mace) takes Iron Counterweight Viertakt · 2026-02-06. **Atiesh** now takes Counterweight too (staves were allowed in 1.18.1) 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-20. Forgotten Raven's Mallet is the best Kara40 threat/mitigation weapon without Atiesh Angrycat / Powershift · 2025-04-18. - **Chest / belt:** T2 chest and belt are "meh"; take the T2.5 chest and the C'Thun belt, with the Dragonhide belt as a stepping stone FeerZero · 2026-02-15. The T2.5 2-piece is strong Angrycat / Powershift · 2026-01-08. - **AQ40:** Gloves of the Hidden Temple, Ring of Emperor Vek'lor; AQ40 hits harder physically than BWL Medvedev · 2025-10-30, Medvedev · 2025-10-30. - **T3:** a mitigation set; 8-piece gives about 8% damage reduction, mainly worth it on high-damage fights like Patchwerk or Loatheb. It does not make you crit-immune, unlike a paladin tank Shardphoenix · 2026-04-10, Velanir · 2026-04-10. The T3 6-piece bonus is weak 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-02-12. Swap in stamina off-pieces (Four Horsemen legs, C'Thun belt) for the hardest fights Dziadmroz · 2025-12-01. - **Kara40:** Forgotten Hide Helm ("best threat AND mitigation helm in the game"), Tunic of Demonic Deception (threat), Felforged Nathrezim Veil, Branch of Resolute Defense, Handwraps of Dead Winds (best threat gloves), Loop of Hardened Slate (best mitigation ring) Angrycat / Powershift · 2025-04-18. - **PvP shoulders:** Veteran's Dragonhide Epaulets out-stat the T2.5 shoulders for threat and need only 6 pieces for the set bonus (85k honor + 3.5k conquest for the set) 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-30. - **Timbermaw Hold:** its 3-piece bonus is "broken" for a threat set Holydruid · 2026-03-28. ### Trinkets | Set | Trinkets | Source | |---|---|---| | Threat | **Kiss of the Spider + Heart of Dreams** (Emerald Sanctum) | Holydruid · 2026-03-18, Zoeferal · 2025-11-19 | | Mitigation | **Hatereaver Cog + Arraxxna's Husk** (Kara10) | Holydruid · 2026-03-18, Lyrazia · 2026-02-11 | | Off-tank / flex | Blackhand's Breadth over Mark of Tyranny | Micro Jackson · 2026-03-18 | | Four Horsemen | Nat Pagle's Broken Reel (ZG) for Taunt hit | 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-01-23 | - **Lion Horn of Stormwind** gives the party ~5% haste at about 50% uptime; two copies reach ~95% Holydruid · 2026-03-18. **Contested:** it mostly buffs the melee group, not you Coxy · 2025-10-25. - **DFT** is "fine but not incredible", because hit is easy to find on Turtle Tephus · 2026-02-23, Stunfisk · 2026-03-18. Hand of Justice is mediocre Tephus · 2025-10-22. ### Idols **Idol of Brutality** (Stratholme Undead; Maul −30% and Swipe −20% rage cost) has "no alternative anywhere" and stays BiS Micro Jackson · 2025-06-24, Micro Jackson · 2025-10-20, Micro Jackson · 2026-04-01. To farm it without the Magistrate fleeing: enter the main gate, open the right-side gate, clear along the wall and sneak up (bring a disease dispel or Jungle Remedy) Jamayca · 2026-03-04. **Idol of Evergrowth** is the AoE option (see above). The new-raid bear idol is judged poor Holydruid · 2026-04-03.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Opening a pull with Growl, or with Feral Charge for threat Micro Jackson · 2025-10-28, Holidae · 2025-10-29. 2. Using Demoralizing Roar with a warrior in the group Lyrazia · 2025-09-11. 3. Stacking dodge or defense enchants Lyrazia · 2025-09-11. 4. Using armor kits: the form does not multiply them Viertakt · 2025-10-10. 5. Throwing sappers in Bear Form: they cancel the form Coxy · 2026-02-17. 6. Enraging while healers struggle Habu · 2026-02-28. 7. Asking healers to shield you; the shield removes your rage from damage taken Sagesse · 2026-04-07. 8. Dropping hit below the cap for stats Viertakt · 2026-04-07.

consumables.heading: Consumables
consumables.markdown: - **Pull:** Mighty Rage Potion (≈132 AP for 20 s) or Quickness Potion (≈133 AP-equivalent for 30 s; better on long fights) GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-03-13, GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-03-13. Enrage + Rage Potion + Kiss of the Spider + Juju Flurry is the boss-pull combo Dziadmroz · 2026-02-15. - **Stats:** Juju Power, Elixir of the Mongoose, R.O.I.D.S., Juju Might/Firewater, Elixir of Superior Defense LillaGummen · 2026-02-24. Buffs of the same bucket do not stack Micro Jackson · 2026-02-24. - **Food:** Danonzo's 2% haste food rated above Power Mushroom for threat LillaGummen · 2026-02-24; Hardened Mushroom and Gurubashi Gumbo stack poisonouscabbage · 2026-02-02. - **Defense:** Greater Stoneshield Potion (Black Morass pulls), Limited Invulnerability Potion, Free Action Potion Holidae · 2025-11-21, Medvedev · 2026-01-16.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 tank loop; details and sources in the sections linked. For leveling dungeons, see [Gameplay by level](#/class/druid/leveling). 1. **Pull (about 10 s before):** Regrowth → Rejuvenation → Cat Form → **Tiger's Fury** → Bear Form. Pull with **Faerie Fire (Feral)** or a ranged spell; never with Growl or Feral Charge ([pre-pull](#/class/druid/feral-tank)). 2. **First GCDs:** Mighty Rage Potion → **Maul** + **Savage Bite** together (no shared GCD) → Maul on every swing → Faerie Fire (Feral) → **Enrage** or **Berserk** when the Blood Frenzy haste ends. 3. **Steady threat:** **Maul** always → **Savage Bite** on Clearcasting or above 50 rage (every cooldown with T3 8-piece) → **Swipe** on 2+ mobs or above ~75 rage → Faerie Fire (Feral) as filler. When rage-starved, Reshift sparingly ([priority](#/class/druid/feral-tank)). 4. **Multi-mob:** pre-HoT yourself, Maul the kill target, tab and Swipe the rest (3-target cap). Mark targets and ask DPS to wait for one Maul. With 4+ mobs, split them between tanks. Idol of Evergrowth plus Demoralizing Roar only for very large packs ([AoE threat](#/class/druid/feral-tank)). 5. **Taunt and recovery:** **Growl** (off the GCD) only to take a mob back, or after a double dodge or parry at the pull. When a pack runs loose, Limited Invulnerability Potion then **Challenging Roar** Sagesse · 2025-08-31. 6. **Defensive cooldowns:** **Barkskin** (60 s; cast in caster form before shifting), **Barkskin (Feral)** (10 minutes) for spikes, Berserk to break fear. Skip Enrage when healers struggle. Bandages and potions work in form ([survival](#/class/druid/feral-tank)). 7. **Avoid:** Demoralizing Roar with a warrior in the group, stacking dodge, asking for shields, sappers in form, and dropping below the hit cap ([mistakes](#/class/druid/feral-tank)).

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - Charge into Bear: `#showtooltip Feral Charge` / `/cast [noform:2] !Bear Form` / `/cast Feral Charge` (needs SuperWoW, Nampower and CleveRoid) poisonouscabbage · 2025-11-23. - A spammable Dire Bear Form that never shifts you out: `/cast [nomybuff:Dire_Bear_Form] Dire Bear Form` 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-03-25. - Sagesse's set: Maul that casts Savage Bite at 25+ rage, Swipe with retarget, mouseover Growl, "LIP + Challenging Roar", FF + Roar, a bear Tiger's Fury, one-button Barkskin Sagesse · 2025-08-31. - **Threatplates/Tankplates** (SuperWoW) color nameplates by your aggro owebsterdesign · 2025-10-28. **LazyPig** auto-removes Salvation in Bear Form Micro Jackson · 2025-11-18. - A Brainwashing Device respec wipes character-specific macros from your bars; ActionBarProfile fixes that Toshka · 2026-03-24, poisonouscabbage · 2026-03-24.

standing.source_quality: strong on stats/mechanics; medium on the current build (link-only); weak-medium single-source on post-1.18.1 standing
standing.notes: Favored pre-1.18.1 (staff called Bear overperforming in Dec 2024). 1.18.1 cut Maul threat -15% and Savage Bite threat -12%; post-patch standing is contested between Noephix ('no reason to bring a bear tank') and Velanyr ('8 of the fastest 10 Kara guilds still use one'). No logs either way.

patch_validity.notes: Talent tree structurally unchanged by 1.18.1. 1.18.1 reduced Maul threat modifier by 15% and Savage Bite threat modifier by 12% (official, eff. 2026-03-20). Discord's community math converts that to ~9% Maul, ~5.6% Savage Bite, ~7-8% total bear threat. Post-1.18.1 standing is contested: the pre-release view was 'bear is the best tank in raids, a little overturned', the post-release view is that bears lose their main advantage [[d:druid#1483016079209926688]] [[d:druid#1484733781331021875]]. Bear threat has no log-verified post-nerf number (gap).

discord.scope: bear threat/rotation/gear math and the 1.18.1 threat nerf

sources.claim: Official 1.18.1 note: Maul threat modifier -15%, Savage Bite threat modifier -12%; developer comment 'Feral Bears have been overly prominent in their threat output, leaving little room for other tanks to shine'
Community math: Maul 175% - 15% ~= 9% threat reduction
Savage Bite 225% - 12% ~= 5.6% nerf; Maul 'around 9%'. Not total threat (haste/staff enchant also matter)
Tephus: '~8% threat nerf' for Maul
Tephus: 'between it and bite, bear is looking at like a total 7% threat nerf'
'prot does really bad threat right now, bear is literally 1.5-2x the threat that prot does (assuming naxx/kara gear)'
Pre-release consensus was 'bear is best tank in raids, a little overturned' for threat
Post-release: 'Savage Bite dodge/Parry is very noticeable in early threat gain' - a dodged/parried Savage Bite leaves bear with no fallback threat button [[d:druid#1484741482169499689]]
Players report losing threat to warriors with Salvation; 'no reason to bring a bear over warrior/paladin' is contested, not settled
Bear rotation: Tiger's Fury from Cat before the pull (~20% haste, 18s), always queue Maul, Savage Bite at >35 rage or Clearcasting, FF on a spare GCD, Swipe as rage dump
Rage-threshold macro: 0<Rage<100 Maul; 20<Rage<100 Maul+Swipe; 50<Rage<100 Maul+Savage Bite+Swipe
With T3 8-piece, use Savage Bite every cooldown to refresh the damage-reduction buff
Rage potion on pull is the best snap-threat opener
'haste is by far the best stat for bear in term of threat generation' - Maul rides the swing timer, 'like heroic strike for fury prot but even more powerful'
'Agi is bait. like triple the threat gains from 3 Haste over 25 Agi'
Rage-pot opener ~132 AP equivalent vs 5% haste ~133 AP equivalent for a 20s window; haste scales better with gear
Bear idol list 2026-03-06: Idol of the Ironfur, Idol of Crushing Maul, Idol of Ursoc's Resolve, Idol of the Unyielding Bear, Idol of the Savage Counter, Idol of the Protector
'The best idol is Idol of Brutality... It reduces your 2 main spells by 30% and 20% cost, Maul and Swipe'
Enchants for bear: counterweight on weapon, haste on shoulder, threat on gloves are 'really strong'
Bear consumables: Juju Power, Elixir of the Mongoose, R.O.I.D.S., Elixir of Firewater, Elixir of Superior Defense, 2% haste or +20 Str food, crystal ward; STR/AP buffs do not stack
Bear AoE = Swipe + FF per add; Demoralizing Roar groups mobs but is not sustained threat
Twin Emperors: bear cannot tank the caster emperor - historically bear's weakest fight
Vael: bear is strong (fight timer); rage potion + Bite/Maul opener
Chromaggus: Savage Bite every 6s matters 'after patch' vs a 10s swing timer
Bear killed Sapphiron with 0 frost resist in full AQ40 gear
Pure bear differs from pure cat by taking threat/armor/stealth (Feral Instinct, Thick Hide, Brutal Impact, Feral Charge, Savage Fury) instead of Feral Aggression
'As Feral Bear tank there are not that many talents to spend on except balance (Omen of Clarity) + feral tree' - no dedicated optimal bear tree was ever settled

glance.recommendation: Play the **11/35/5 tank build** (Feral Instinct, Thick Hide, Feral Charge, Carnage, Improved Shred, Furor). Get **8% hit**, then gear two sets: a **threat** set (haste, Strength, crit) and a **mitigation** set (Stamina, armor). Open every boss the same way: **Cat Form → Tiger's Fury → Bear Form → Mighty Rage Potion → Maul + Savage Bite**, then **Maul on every swing**, **Savage Bite** on Clearcasting or high rage, **Swipe** on 2+ mobs or at full rage. Bear is still the strongest sustained single-target threat tank, but since 1.18.1 it is weaker in the first seconds of a pull, and it takes more damage than warriors or paladins.

playbooks.title: Restoration (healer)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **18/0/33 Tree of Life build** (Moonglow, Preservation, Swiftmend, Nature's Swiftness, Improved Tranquility). Stack **healing power**, then Spirit. Pre-HoT the tank, keep **Rejuvenation** and **Regrowth** rolling on whoever is taking damage (Rejuv first, so Preservation boosts the Regrowth), finish expiring HoTs with **Swiftmend**, and hold **Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch** and **Tranquility** for emergencies. A raid wants **one resto druid, two at most**. | | | |---|---| | Role | Raid HoT healer and tank healer; the Tree of Life Spirit aura for its group; Tranquility (30-minute cooldown); Innervate, Rebirth, decurse and poison removal | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Good, slot-capped.** "Good all end game", but no longer the best healer: priests took that spot in 1.18.1 Valarya · 2026-03-28. A Renew heals 850 per tick where Rejuvenation does about 456 Micro Jackson · 2026-03-27. The Holy Paladin T3.5 set nerf (about −83%) removed the old ceiling Micro Jackson · 2026-01-27. Micro Jackson rated resto 7/10 Micro Jackson · 2026-03-22. | | Difficulty | High: "Good resto druids are very good, mediocre resto druids are bad" Micro Jackson · 2025-11-20 | | Strengths | Regrowth has the best healing-power scaling in the game Micro Jackson · 2026-02-07; Tranquility; proactive HoTs; the Spirit aura; mana efficiency; can DPS or tank in other forms | | Weaknesses | HoTs from two restos overwrite each other; buff-cap problems in 40-man raids; can't heal other parties the way Prayer of Healing can Micro Jackson · 2026-04-11, Hassle · 2026-04-11; no strong direct heal in Tree Form |

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown: 1. **Healing power** is king FlameBRS · 2025-11-10. If you mostly spam Rejuvenation, more healing power beats crit and haste, which do nothing for HoTs Micro Jackson · 2026-02-12. 2. **Spirit:** worth about 0.2 healing power for yourself, or about 1 healing power if your aura buffs 5 healers in your group Micro Jackson · 2026-03-09. It also regenerates mana: druid MP2 = Spirit/5 + 15 Micro Jackson · 2025-12-16. 3. **MP5:** Spirit matters more for Tree builds; non-Tree Nature's Grace builds lean on crit and haste instead, and value Intellect a bit more than Tree does FlameBRS · 2025-11-10. 4. **Intellect:** about half a healing power; the weakest healing stat Micro Jackson · 2026-03-09. Scaling (with talents): Regrowth ≈ 20% on the direct heal + ≈ 112% on the HoT (≈ 132% total); Rejuvenation ≈ 101%; Healing Touch ≈ 110% Micro Jackson · 2026-02-07, Micro Jackson · 2026-02-07. Only direct heals crit; HoTs never do, and haste does not speed up HoT ticks Micro Jackson · 2025-11-25. **Healing power you need** (one experienced healer's guide): 0 in full blues for MC/ZG/AQ20/Kara10; ~0-300 for BWL; 900+ for Kara40 (he runs 1,600) Habu · 2026-02-22, Micro Jackson · 2026-02-22.

rotationSingle.heading: Healing rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: **Before the pull:** Rejuvenation, then Regrowth, on the tank Micro Jackson · 2025-10-16. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **Emergency (tank below ~30%)**: **`Nature's Swiftness` → max-rank `Healing Touch`** (two key presses; the client cannot combine them in one macro click) poisonouscabbage · 2026-02-20. Or **`Swiftmend`** on a target with a HoT. 2. **`Swiftmend`** on a target whose Rejuvenation or Regrowth is about to expire: "insane healing per mana" Micro Jackson · 2025-06-07. 3. **`Rejuvenation`** on a damaged target without it, before Regrowth (Preservation) Voodoo · 2026-03-07. 4. **`Regrowth`** on the tank and on spiky damage. Micro Jackson's split is 60-70% Regrowth Micro Jackson · 2026-02-23: "Sometimes 20 seconds of HOT is way too long and you're better off with Rejuv. Sometimes damage is spiky and then Regrowth is better" Micro Jackson · 2026-02-12. 5. **Do not HoT full-health targets**: faster healers overwrite the need Micro Jackson · 2025-10-16. 6. **`Tranquility`** when the whole raid is low (30-minute cooldown; about 100k healing per cast) Valarya · 2026-03-28. You must leave Tree Form to cast it Breaddy · 2025-04-12. **Ranks** (from the pinned guide) Habu · 2026-03-08: | Spell | Rank | Use | |---|---|---| | Regrowth | 9 | Tanks and melee | | Regrowth | 4 | Casters, other healers, pets | | Rejuvenation | 11 (max) | Default | | Rejuvenation | 5 | On rogues and ferals, to proc the T3 2-piece bonus | | Rejuvenation | 1 | On yourself with the T3 2-piece: about 180 mana per 12 s for one GCD Micro Jackson · 2026-03-27 | - Early in raiding, Regrowth ranks 3/6/9; with better gear 4/7/9. Rank 3 is close to the most mana-efficient Micro Jackson · 2025-11-15. - Avoid ranks below level 20: they take a healing-power penalty; rank 4+ is usually better Micro Jackson · 2026-01-05. - On trash use lower ranks; on bosses, with good gear, higher ranks are fine Micro Jackson · 2025-10-21. - Max-rank Healing Touch is actually better value per mana than HoTs at typical gear; HoTs pull ahead only at endgame healing power and cost reductions Micro Jackson · 2026-03-19. **Two resto druids:** coordinate. One tree gives the full aura value; a second gives none and overlaps HoTs, so split the work (one Rejuv-only, one Regrowth-only) Micro Jackson · 2025-11-06. When another druid's HoT replaces yours, your old HoT turns into an instant heal for 50% of its remaining value Dreamwind · 2026-04-05. **Contested:** whether that Efflorescence effect needs Tree Form: "works in any form" Dreamwind · 2026-04-05 vs "locked to Tree of Life form" Valarya · 2026-02-01. Four resto druids in one raid is "griefing" Valarya · 2026-03-28.

cooldowns.heading: Mana and cooldowns
cooldowns.markdown: - **Innervate:** at about 600 Spirit it gives 100% mana regen for 15 s Micro Jackson · 2026-01-26. Swap to a Spirit weapon (e.g. Staff of the Dreamer) just before self-Innervate for more mana poisonouscabbage · 2026-01-25. - **Trash** costs more mana than bosses; with the T3.5 40% Meditation pieces you can spam max ranks on bosses Micro Jackson · 2025-10-21. - Items that give "% of Spirit regen while casting" keep regen going inside the 5-second rule Aelgagar · 2026-02-15. - **Abolish Poison** beats Cure Poison for the same mana; it re-dispels every 2 s Ubivaka · 2025-11-20. - **Tranquility** can top 300k healing with T3.5, ~2,400 healing power and an Anomalous Bomb; its 30-minute cooldown means 1-2 casts per raid Micro Jackson · 2026-02-25. Sapphiron's aura ticks interrupt it Treezus (Lifelike AI) · 2024-11-03.

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **MC** has too little sustained damage for trees to shine; resto gains on paladins from BWL onward Micro Jackson · 2025-11-15. - **Thaddius:** use speed boots so you can make the jump without leaving Tree Form Micro Jackson · 2026-02-23. - **Knockbacks** (Magma Surgers, Rupturan adds) cause a 1-2 s movement lock in Tree Form, though you can still cast 🎄⛄ Bapi⛄🎄 · 2026-02-26. - **Nefarian's druid call** forces Cat Form; you can shift back to Tree during it Bluefear · 2026-03-24. - **Kara40 Anomalus:** priests' Prayer of Healing is the "cheat skill" there, comparable to Tranquility Micro Jackson · 2026-04-11, Micro Jackson · 2026-04-11. - **Timbermaw Hold portal boss:** druids are immune to the stacking Portal debuff, so guilds send a druid inside Dziadmroz · 2026-04-04.

The 5-piece Blooming Bud was nerfed to a 20 s timer: about 8k healing over a whole Kara40 clear | Micro Jackson · 2026-03-27, akitoe · 2026-03-27, akitoe · 2026-04-06 | Naxx-tier setup: 5/5 T3.5 + 2/8 T3 + off-pieces Micro Jackson · 2025-11-12. After the Blooming Bud nerf, raw-healing-power off-pieces such as Bishop's Helm and Mephistroth's shoulders beat the T3.5 bonus Micro Jackson · 2026-03-20. The Timbermaw Hold healer set has too many dead stats for a Rejuv healer Micro Jackson · 2026-03-27. ### Trinkets and weapons - **Eye of the Dead + Breath of Solnius** is a BiS pair; Eye of the Dead does not consume Rejuvenation Cowmoohflage/Arrowgance · 2026-03-29. Breath of Solnius suits Regrowth spam on Kruul, Anomalus, Chess, Sapphiron, Thaddius and Gothik Micro Jackson · 2026-03-16; its uptime is ~35-40% Midgard · 2026-03-29. - **Warmth of Forgiveness** only as an emergency mana tool once potions and tea are used akitoe · 2026-03-29. - The **Loop of Infused Renewal** ring (a free Rejuvenation on Healing Touch) suits the HT build: with full T2.5 it gives Healing Touch "a huge boost" Micro Jackson · 2026-01-26, Micro Jackson · 2026-01-26. - **Beacon of the Emerald Dream** is a good mid-tier staff Micro Jackson · 2026-03-12. The Grandstaff of the Shendralar does not proc from HoT ticks (bug) Frood · 2026-02-06. ### Idols All resto idols are "mediocre/bad" Micro Jackson · 2025-09-27: Idol of Health (faster Healing Touch; AQ40) Eepyman · 2026-04-10, Idol of Longevity (+25 mana per HT), Idol of the Forgotten Wilds (a weak plant heal), Idol of Rejuvenation (+50 to Rejuv). The random "sproutling" heal idol averaged about 100 extra healing per Regrowth in Naxx, mostly overhealing Micro Jackson · 2025-10-26.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Bringing more than two resto druids without assigning HoT duties Valarya · 2026-03-28. 2. Casting Regrowth before Rejuvenation, which wastes Preservation Voodoo · 2026-03-07. 3. Only ever casting one HoT; Rejuv and Regrowth solve different problems Micro Jackson · 2026-02-12. 4. HoTing full-health targets Micro Jackson · 2025-10-16. 5. Expecting Tranquil Spirit to make Rejuvenation cheaper Micro Jackson · 2026-04-04. 6. Taking Intellect over healing power; Intellect is the weakest healing stat FlameBRS · 2025-11-10. 7. Keeping the T3.5 5-piece for Blooming Bud after the nerf Micro Jackson · 2026-03-20. 8. Skipping Brilliant Wizard Oil (or using Mana Oil instead) because the tooltip shows it as spell damage, not healing Micro Jackson · 2026-02-23.

consumables.heading: Consumables
consumables.markdown: akitoe's resto list akitoe · 2025-08-21: - **Always:** Mageblood Potion, Dreamshard Elixir, Elixir of Fortitude, Cerebral Cortex Compound, Flask of Distilled Wisdom, Brilliant Wizard Oil (or Brilliant Mana Oil). - **Mana burst:** Nordanaar Herbal Tea, Major/Superior Mana Potion. - **Defensive:** Limited Invulnerability Potion. - **Food/drink:** Medivh's Merlot Blue or any Tribute alcohol, plus Nightfin Soup, Danonzo's Tel'Abim Medley or Empowering Herbal Salad. Dire Maul alcohol (+25 Spirit, −5 Intellect) stacks with Merlot Blue Micro Jackson · 2026-02-23. - Top healers stack every Spirit buff to about 900 Spirit before entering the raid Micro Jackson · 2026-02-18.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown:
The level-60 healing loop; details and sources in the sections linked. For dungeon healing while leveling, see [Gameplay by level](#/class/druid/leveling).

1. **Default heal by damage pattern:**
   - **Tank:** pre-HoT Rejuvenation then Regrowth (Rank 9) before the pull, and keep both rolling ([rotation](#/class/druid/restoration-healer)).
   - **Spot damage:** max-rank Rejuvenation for steady chip damage; Regrowth for spikes (Rank 4 on casters, healers and pets).
   - **Raid-wide:** Rejuvenation on the damaged players; **Tranquility** (out of Tree Form, 30-minute cooldown) when the whole raid is low.
2. **Triage:** tank below ~30%: **Nature's Swiftness → max-rank Healing Touch**, or **Swiftmend** → Swiftmend a HoT that is about to expire → Rejuvenation, then Regrowth (Preservation) → never HoT full-health targets.
3. **Keep up:** your HoTs on the tanks and Tree of Life Form for the group aura. With a second resto druid, split duties (one Rejuvenation, one Regrowth).
4. **Mana plan:** lower ranks on trash, higher on bosses. **Innervate** yourself (swap in a Spirit weapon first). Use Tea and Mana Potions ([mana](#/class/druid/restoration-healer), [consumables](#/class/druid/restoration-healer)).
5. **Cooldowns:** Nature's Swiftness for the emergency Healing Touch; Tranquility once or twice per raid; Innervate.
6. **Dispels and utility:** **Abolish Poison** over Cure Poison; Remove Curse; Rebirth (out of form).

extraSections.heading: Addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Puppeteer** raid frames show HoT timers and aggro; after the patch it broke Swiftmend for some until they restarted the client and updated addons Oaks · 2026-03-24, Comentor · 2026-03-24. **Luna** frames are the alternative Valarya · 2026-02-27. - In pfUI, enable Unit Frames → Raid → Buff/Debuff Indicators → "Show Time Left"; showing timers on other players may need SuperWoW Puffin · 2026-04-12. - On buffed tanks your HoTs may be active but invisible past the visible buff cap; track by cast, not by buff Tephus · 2026-03-11. - HealBot disables its bars in Tree Form unless you patch `HealBot_GetShapeshiftForm()` Julchat · 2025-08-06. A Smartbuff fork works with Tree Form Livin · 2026-01-13.

glance.recommendation: Play the **18/0/33 Tree of Life build** (Moonglow, Preservation, Swiftmend, Nature's Swiftness, Improved Tranquility). Stack **healing power**, then Spirit. Pre-HoT the tank, keep **Rejuvenation** and **Regrowth** rolling on whoever is taking damage (Rejuv first, so Preservation boosts the Regrowth), finish expiring HoTs with **Swiftmend**, and hold **Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch** and **Tranquility** for emergencies. A raid wants **one resto druid, two at most**.

facts.label: Role

facts.label: Viability (1.18.1)
facts.markdown: **Good, slot-capped.** "Good all end game", but no longer the best healer: priests took that spot in 1.18.1 Valarya · 2026-03-28. facts.label: Difficulty
facts.markdown: High: "Good resto druids are very good, mediocre resto druids are bad" Micro Jackson · 2025-11-20

facts.label: Strengths
facts.markdown: Regrowth has the best healing-power scaling in the game Micro Jackson · 2026-02-07; Tranquility; proactive HoTs; the Spirit aura; mana efficiency; can DPS or tank in other forms

facts.label: Weaknesses
facts.markdown: HoTs from two restos overwrite each other; buff-cap problems in 40-man raids; can't heal other parties the way Prayer of Healing can Micro Jackson · 2026-04-11, Hassle · 2026-04-11; no strong direct heal in Tree Form

playbooks.title: Feral Cat (melee DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play the **11/35/5 bleed/Claw build**. On any target that can bleed, keep **Rake** and **Rip** up, keep **Tiger's Fury** up, spam **Claw**, and spend 5 combo points on **Ferocious Bite** (Carnage refreshes both bleeds). On bleed-immune targets, drop the bleeds and switch to **Shred + Ferocious Bite + Reshift** (powershifting). Get **8% hit** (5% from gear), then stack Strength, Agility and Attack Power. Your weapon is a stat stick: only its stats and "Equip:" effects count in Cat Form. | | | |---|---| | Role | Single-target melee DPS; Leader of the Pack crit aura, Innervate, battle rez, emergency off-tank | | Viability (1.18.1) | **Good single-target, no AoE.** Rated A/A- on bleedable single-target bosses and B on bleed-immune ones Micro Jackson · 2026-03-05. "Fine/strong until AQ40 and early Naxx", then it falls behind in Kara40, where cat gets only sidegrades Shardphoenix · 2026-04-08, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. It counts only your own bleeds, not another druid's or class's FANGOdruid · 2026-01-19, Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-01-19. It buffs Claw, not Rake Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-12-25. - **Ancient Brutality** returns energy on your bleed ticks, which is why the bleed rotation needs little powershifting Shardphoenix · 2026-03-17, danimaroo · 2026-03-26. - **Carnage 2/2**: a 5-combo-point Ferocious Bite refreshes Rip and Rake Invadertim · 2025-10-08, Littlechurch · 2026-02-27. The refresh does not show on training dummies, but it happens soul_n_mind · 2026-03-07. - **Blood Frenzy** makes Tiger's Fury a permanent haste/energy buff; one player calls it "the enabler for feral not to suck" lunara · 2025-12-05. - **Furor + Improved Shred** keep the powershift/Shred rotation available for bleed-immune bosses 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-11-01. - The 4 filler points in row 1 of Balance can be Improved Nature's Grasp 4/4 instead of 2 + Sylvan Blessing 2 (next table). ### Variants | Variant | What changes | Code (VALID) | Source | |---|---|---|---| | **Improved Nature's Grasp 4/4** | Balance filler 4 into Improved Nature's Grasp, no Sylvan Blessing; the same Feral and Resto points | `BgAaAI-FgADAaDSQIFQB-Ao` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=druid&t=0140003201-540003003232221521-05)) | TowelDruid's raid answer, "You don't need the threat talent if you're not tanking and Feral Swiftness doesn't work inside (most) raids" TowelDruid · 2026-02-16, TowelDruid · 2026-02-16 | | **Shred-heavy (Ferocity 4 / Feral Aggression 5)** | Ferocity 4/5, Feral Aggression 5/5: more Ferocious Bite damage, dearer Claw. For raids where you Shred most of the time | `BSAaAI-EoADAaDSQIFQB-Ao` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=druid&t=0122003201-450003003232221521-05)) | "Ferocious Bite has a very high usage rate, so ... Feral Aggression increasing Ferocious Bite damage is more valuable" Alfras · 2026-01-08 | | **Cat who off-tanks** | Use the [Feral Bear](#/class/druid/feral-tank) build (Feral Instinct 3, Thick Hide 3, Feral Charge 1, no Open Wounds/Feral Aggression) | `BSAaAI-FAYYBaDSQIFQB-Ao` ([Open in talent calculator](https://xian55.github.io/tortoise-db-viewer/?talents=druid&t=0122003201-503030013232221521-05)) | Micro Jackson: tanks "can still shred as cat when your target dies" Micro Jackson · 2025-12-01 | **Contested:** Open Wounds as a raid talent. Some call it "mostly a leveling talent" because raids Shred more Alfras · 2026-01-12; the post-1.18.1 top parses use Claw, so Open Wounds stays Ash · 2026-04-11. Points are tight: "points are very tight for feral (especially cat)", so keep two builds in your Brainwashing Device Shardphoenix · 2026-04-13. Since 1.18.1 you can no longer run cat and bear talents in one build, so swapping roles needs a respec Shardphoenix · 2026-04-10.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Hit to 8%** against raid bosses. Natural Weapons gives 3%, so you need **5% from gear**. Every point is equally valuable up to 5% and worthless after Micro Jackson · 2026-02-19, Viertakt · 2026-02-14. Turtle removed the 1% hit suppression against +3-level targets, so the cap is 8%, not 9% Rustam · 2026-04-09. Most trash (level 61-62) needs only about 5% total Stunfisk · 2025-12-09. 2. **Strength and Agility, roughly equal.** With Heart of the Wild, 1 Strength = 2.4 feral AP; 1 Agility = 1 AP plus 0.05% crit (20 Agility = 1% crit) Rustam · 2026-04-08, Krokat · 2026-01-20. Bleeds scale with AP, so Strength is at least as good as Agility on bleedable targets Micro Jackson · 2025-10-23. **Contested:** which is slightly better; the sheets show "only very slightly better" either way 𝔅𝔩𝔢𝔰𝔦𝔰𝔦 · 2026-02-21. 3. **Attack Power** (1 AP = 1). The "Attack Power in forms" line on staves and polearms is what makes a weapon good Shardphoenix · 2026-03-30. 4. **Crit** until the crit cap. With hit capped, the white-hit crit soft cap is 53.5% (hard cap 93.5%) Viertakt · 2026-02-14. The T2.5 5-piece bonus is the main thing that overshoots it Stunfisk · 2026-02-08. One weight: 1% crit ≈ 31 AP Tephus · 2025-06-02. 5. **Haste: contested.** The vanilla sims call it cat's worst stat, because only white hits benefit and cats have no weapon skill Micro Jackson · 2025-10-13. Several experienced players value 1% at about 26 AP on Turtle, since Tiger's Fury is always up and more swings mean more Omen procs Micro Jackson · 2025-11-28. Haste multiplies (10% and 20% give 1/(1.1×1.2)) Blackfox · 2026-03-16. It becomes good with the T3.5 set Micro Jackson · 2025-10-28. Not useful: Intellect on tier gear, since energy no longer comes from mana Inovatu · 2025-04-02; weapon skill ("does not affect ferals at all") Micro Jackson · 2026-02-10; weapon damage and speed Holidae · 2025-11-25; **Fortune** (1.18.1), since chance-on-hit never procs in form Habu · 2026-02-20; Armor Penetration, since most raid bosses are brought to 0 armor by the raid anyway Micro Jackson · 2026-04-11. Existing stat-weight sheets use vanilla assumptions and "no one has done the correct calculations for TWOW yet" Micro Jackson · 2025-11-28. For gear choices use Krokat's feral sim (`krokats.github.io/feral-sim`) or Angrycat's Feral DPS sheet Bobetz · 2026-01-15, Ilithyia · 2026-01-11.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Bleedable target (Claw build) **Opener:** Prowl → **Tiger's Fury** just before an energy tick → **Pounce** (counts as a third bleed) → **Rake** → **Rip** → Claw to 5 → **Ferocious Bite** 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-12, Micro Jackson · 2026-01-30, Micro Jackson · 2025-06-09. Without stealth, open with **Faerie Fire (Feral)** (it can proc Omen) Littlechurch · 2026-02-27. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **`Tiger's Fury`** if its buff is missing. It is off the GCD and your strongest button: 18 s of attack speed plus 10 energy every 3 s when talented Tephus · 2026-01-20, Micro Jackson · 2026-02-05. 2. **`Rip`** if Rip is missing, the target can bleed and you have **5 combo points**. On a fight shorter than about 30 s, Rip at 1-3 combo points instead Micro Jackson · 2025-11-10, Thalamier · 2026-03-15. 3. **`Ferocious Bite`** at **5 combo points** while Rip is up; Carnage refreshes Rip and Rake. On bosses, never Bite below 5 combo points Micro Jackson · 2025-12-15. On trash that dies fast, Bite at 4 Angrycat / Powershift · 2025-12-15. 4. **`Rake`** if missing poisonouscabbage · 2026-01-19. 5. **`Shred`** if you have **Clearcasting** and are behind the target. Clearcasting always goes into Shred, even at 5 combo points, unless Rip is about to expire Medvedev · 2025-10-15. 6. **`Claw`** as the filler. "If the boss is not bleed immune Claw will always out dps Shred if played well"; all top 1.18.1 parses use Claw Ash · 2026-04-11. 7. **`Reshift`** when energy is below about 28-32, Tiger's Fury has under 3 s left and no energy tick is about to land. It refunds up to 60 energy with Furor and the Wolfshead enchant Micro Jackson · 2026-03-10, Copperage · 2026-01-11. At 28 energy you are one tick from another Shred, so use it; at 27 you are two ticks away Shardphoenix · 2026-03-16. Notes: - **Contested: Claw vs Shred with bleeds up.** Claw with 2-3 bleeds beats Shred per energy Micro Jackson · 2026-01-30. Shred with the Idol of Laceration is close at high gear, and some EU players still Shred on Patchwerk Medvedev · 2025-12-19, Maturi · 2026-04-10. The 1.18.1 top parses settle it for Claw Ash · 2026-04-11. - **Reshift drops the Tiger's Fury buff**, but Blood Frenzy's attack speed persists, so recast TF after every Reshift Řezáč · 2026-03-16. That is why you Reshift only when TF is about to expire anyway: "don't PS every GCD, only every ~16-18 s" Coxy · 2025-10-25. - An in-raid test on Kruul found powershifting and not powershifting "within error margin" for two similarly geared cats Shardphoenix · 2026-03-16. Staff hold that "powershifting will always perform better" as a tool Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-03-16. - Bleed AP scaling is weak (Rake ticks 2% AP, Rip 4% AP), so snapshotting bleeds with potions is pointless Micro Jackson · 2025-11-24. ### Bleed-immune target (powershift build) Rake and Rip do nothing; Pounce still stuns, but its bleed icon is only visual Micro Jackson · 2026-01-12. 1. **`Tiger's Fury`** if missing. 2. **`Ferocious Bite`** at 5 combo points Littlechurch · 2026-02-27. 3. **`Shred`** from behind. Claw is bad without bleeds Micro Jackson · 2025-12-03. 4. **`Reshift`** below 28 energy, timed so the next energy tick lands right after you return to form Shardphoenix · 2025-06-09. Wear the **Wolfshead head enchant** for this; without it the 1% haste head enchant is the alternative 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-11-01. The Idol of Laceration helps here ("good bleed-immune option") Kelushka · 2025-12-25. ### Bleed-immune bosses | Raid | Immune | Source | |---|---|---| | [Molten Core](#/instances/molten-core) | **Contested:** "only 3 of 12" (Geddon, Ragnaros, Thaurissan) vs "about half" of MC. Baron Geddon can still be raked but not ripped | Mootant · 2026-03-27, drago · 2025-11-03, Shardphoenix · 2026-03-17, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-06-04 | | [Blackwing Lair](#/instances/blackwing-lair) | All bosses bleed | Blackfox · 2025-10-09 | | Naxxramas | All bosses bleed, including Kel'Thuzad and Sapphiron (tested). The small Garr-copy adds do not. **Contested:** older posts name KT, Sapphiron and Twin Golems as immune | drago · 2026-01-16, Medvedev · 2026-01-16, Micro Jackson · 2026-01-26, Dexter Syphex · 2025-04-05 | | [Tower of Karazhan](#/instances/tower-of-karazhan) | Anomalus, Medivh, the Chess event and Rupturan (confirmed by the class designer); Kruul phase 2; Echo's adds. About two thirds of the raid is immune | Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-02-07, Thalamier · 2026-03-05, Kelushka · 2026-02-16, Ash · 2026-01-26 | | [Timbermaw Hold](#/instances/timbermaw-hold) | Two bosses | Kelushka · 2026-03-28 | The class designer is open to "remedies" for bleed-immune targets, but none shipped Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-02-16.

rotationAoe.heading: AoE
rotationAoe.markdown: Cat has **no AoE and no cleave**, which the class designer confirmed as intent: "the envisioned design for Feral Cat is to be focused on single target damage" Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-02-16. | Targets | Action | |---|---| | 1-2 | Normal rotation on the kill target | | 3+ | Keep single-targeting. If the tank needs help, shift to **Bear** and **Swipe** (3-target cap) Gabmoon · 2026-01-14. Leaving form to **Hurricane** is only worth it with a spell-power set or Atiesh Dziadmroz · 2026-02-10 |

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and utility
cooldowns.markdown: - **Tiger's Fury:** keep it up 100% of the time; it is off the GCD Tephus · 2026-01-20. - **Berserk:** 6-minute cooldown, too long to use on every boss; save it for the long bleedable bosses Thalamier · 2026-01-27. - **Trinkets** with on-use effects: use at the pull and in the last 20% of the fight (ZHC, ToEP) Breaddy · 2025-10-12. - **Idol swapping** costs a GCD since 1.18.1 Comentor · 2026-03-01, and a macro swap triggers a ~30 s internal cooldown; cats are energy-capped, so this matters less than for Balance Krokat · 2026-03-31. The one swap still discussed is Idol of Savagery for the opening Rip, then Idol of Ferocity Micro Jackson · 2025-12-15. Non-Claw idols are "not worth using now that idol-swapping is disabled", but keep them in the bank FlameBRS · 2026-04-08. - **Utility:** Leader of the Pack (3% crit aura), Innervate, Rebirth (only out of form) Dziadmroz · 2026-02-14, Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-01-13. Innervate a healer; one player jokes that it buys a feral's survival Hassle · 2026-04-08. - **Threat:** Cower costs 50 energy for little effect Alfras · 2026-01-14. If you pull aggro, a shift to Bear gives roughly a 50/50 chance to survive until the tank taunts Kelushka · 2026-03-30.

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Kruul** (Kara40) is cat's best fight, and cat still rarely tops it Thalamier · 2026-01-27, Thalamier · 2026-03-21. **Patchwerk** favours the T3.5 5-piece Shardphoenix · 2026-03-26. - **BWL Chromaggus**, undergeared: Shred / Ferocious Bite / Rip priority Alfras · 2026-01-12. - **Nefarian's druid call** forces Cat Form even if you never trained it Micro Jackson · 2026-03-24. - **Naxx:** a cat can briefly tank hard-hitting trash with the right trinkets; the abomination before Kel'Thuzad is the exception Zoeferal · 2025-11-23. - **Resistances:** see the [Feral Bear](#/class/druid/feral-tank) table; off-tanking cats on Huhuran/Viscidus want 150+ nature resistance Habu · 2026-04-10.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: Tier sets: **T1, T2.5 and T3.5 are itemized for cat; T2 and T3 for bear** Lyrazia · 2026-04-08. Look for "Feral Attack Power" on items Gloomshroud · 2026-02-09. ### Leveling to fresh 60 Weapon progression (stat sticks): Smite's Mighty Hammer (18) → Manual Crowd Pummeler (28, stats only now) → Thornroot Maul (32) → Grimlock's Charge (42) → Ice Barbed Spear (51) → the sheet at 60 Micro Jackson · 2026-03-20, Voodoo · 2026-01-18. See [Leveling](#/class/druid/leveling). ### Pre-raid | Slot | Item | Source | |---|---|---| | Weapon | **Rod of the Churning Hourglass** (Black Morass reputation); beats Finkle's Lava Dredger for cat once Heart of the Wild and Kings are counted | LuckyUserOfAdblock · 2025-11-09, drago · 2026-01-08 | | Head | Thornweave Mask ([Black Morass](#/instances/black-morass)) | drago · 2025-11-16 | | Neck | Mark of Fordring (Eastern Plaguelands quest); Onyxia's neck is better if you have it | fusedpro · 2025-10-08 | | Cloak | Quel'dorei Hero's Cloak (Silvermoon honored, Alliance) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-19 | | Chest | Time-Blackened Chestpiece (Black Morass) | drago · 2025-11-16 | | Hands / feet | Rotworn Grips, Miasma Walkers ([Karazhan Crypt](#/instances/karazhan-crypt)) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-19 | | Waist | Shadowruned Girdle ([Hateforge Quarry](#/instances/hateforge-quarry) last boss); later the ZG quest belt from "A Collection of Heads", best until C'Thun | Lyrazia · 2025-09-19, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09 | | Legs | Flamewrath Leggings (crafted) are worth crafting; Devilsaur Leggings are the only Devilsaur piece worth it | Lyrazia · 2025-10-23, Zotnar · 2025-07-24 | | Rings | Tarnished Elven Ring ×2 (Dire Maul Tribute), Blackstone Ring (Princess), Don Julio's Band (AV reputation) | Lyrazia · 2025-09-19 | | Trinkets | Blackhand's Breadth (LBRS/Ony attunement); Corrosive Core (HFQ) if you need hit | Lyrazia · 2025-09-19 | Skip the Devilsaur set; better pieces replace it quickly Lyrazia · 2025-09-19. Feet are feral's weakest slot Stunfisk · 2025-10-23. ### Raid progression - **MC / Onyxia:** Rod of the Churning Hourglass over Finkle's; MC gauntlets are BiS gloves for a long time LuckyUserOfAdblock · 2025-11-09, Shardphoenix · 2026-03-25. Never-Ending Agony is BiS only if you still need hit; give it to the cat before the bear Lyrazia · 2025-11-29. - **AQ40:** C'Thun belt Shardphoenix · 2026-03-25. Keep the **T2.5** set bonus until you can complete 5 pieces of T3.5 MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-11-25. The T2.5 3-piece favours Claw, the 5-piece Shred Stunfisk · 2025-12-19. - **Naxx:** cat gear "almost disappears"; your AQ40 pieces carry you Shardphoenix · 2026-04-08, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. - **Kara40:** Tunic of Demonic Deception and Choker of the Talon are the big upgrades; Talon helm, boots and shoulders, Felforged Nathrezim Veil, Mephistroth's Cunning come next Angrycat / Powershift · 2025-04-18. Only the T3.5 boots, pauldrons and neck are good Shardphoenix · 2026-03-26. Kara40 gloves are worse than T1 gloves Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27. At full Kara BiS, the Mephistroth belt beats the C'Thun belt because you no longer need hit Shardphoenix · 2026-04-10. The Mephistroth ring (32 Agility, 1% haste) is worth prioritising akitoe · 2026-02-19. - **Contested:** the T3.5 5-piece. Shardphoenix swaps it out on movement-heavy fights; others say full boss uptime makes it mandatory Shardphoenix · 2026-04-10. - **Timbermaw Hold set:** probably better than T2.5 (similar stats, much better bonus); best as 5 pieces with non-set boots Angrycat / Powershift · 2026-04-12. Its 5-piece may not stack with Tiger's Fury (bug report 21747; possibly visual) Possum · 2026-04-09. - **Weapons:** Atiesh is BiS for feral, the only DPS spec that keeps it in Kara40 Shardphoenix · 2026-03-26. Order: Atiesh > MoM > Spear > Eye of Nerub Holydruid · 2026-03-28. Raka'shishi gives large AP in forms, but its extra-attack proc is disabled while shapeshifted Tyrona · 2026-01-24. 1.18.1 hotfix: Yoxtez gained 224 Feral Attack Power ([Torta, 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608)). - **Crafted:** Convergence of the Elements leggings (Elemental Leatherworking) are "extra good" Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. ### Trinkets - Early: Zandalarian Hero Charm and Talisman of Ephemeral Power Breaddy · 2025-10-12; Blackhand's Breadth Lyrazia · 2025-09-19. - Progression: Earthstrike / Heart of Dreams → **Kiss of the Spider + Heart of Dreams** → Slayer's Crest or the KT trinket in Naxx Lyrazia · 2025-11-19, Zoeferal · 2025-11-19. Molten Emberstone is about 20 free DPS on use Micro Jackson · 2026-01-26. Vial of Potent Venoms and Blackhand's Breadth beat Draenei Exile's Trinket, whose real proc rate is below its tooltip (about 3.7%, tested, not the ~10%) FANGOdruid · 2026-03-31, FANGOdruid · 2026-04-06. - **Shieldrender Talisman** (Kara40) was nerfed in 1.18.1: its 4 armor-ignoring attacks get burned by low-value autos Kelushka · 2026-02-16, Habu · 2026-02-20. - Low value for cat: DFT and Accuria (you are hit-capped by AQ40; give them to a rogue or warrior) Lyrazia · 2025-11-29; Hand of Justice (it resets the swing timer, worth about half a real extra attack) Micro Jackson · 2025-12-09; Chromie's quest trinket (a near-permanent −10% haste debuff) Haruchon · 2025-11-16. ### Idols **Idol of Ferocity** (BRD) is BiS Ash · 2026-04-11, Jarttroz · 2026-03-02. **Idol of Laceration** (Shred refund after finishers) is the bleed-immune option Kelushka · 2025-12-25. mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: 1. Running the bleed rotation on a bleed-immune boss Littlechurch · 2026-02-27. 2. Biting below 5 combo points on a boss, which loses the Carnage refresh Micro Jackson · 2025-12-15. 3. Reshifting every time you run low: it drops Tiger's Fury; wait until TF is about to expire Coxy · 2025-10-25. 4. Spending Clearcasting on Claw instead of Shred Medvedev · 2025-10-15. 5. Over-capping hit. Above 8% total it is worthless Micro Jackson · 2026-02-19. 6. Farming the Manual Crowd Pummeler for its effect: it no longer works in form Voodoo · 2026-01-18. 7. Gearing by weapon DPS or chance-on-hit procs; only stats and "Equip:" count chincer · 2025-11-28. 8. Taking DFT or Accuria from a rogue or warrior once you are hit-capped Lyrazia · 2025-11-29.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown:
The level-60 loop; details and sources in the sections linked. For leveling, see [Gameplay by level](#/class/druid/leveling).

1. **Opener:** Prowl → **Tiger's Fury** just before an energy tick → **Pounce** → **Rake** → **Rip** → Claw to 5 → **Ferocious Bite**. Without stealth, open with **Faerie Fire (Feral)** ([opener](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps)).
2. **Single-target loop (target can bleed):** Tiger's Fury if missing → Rip if missing at 5 combo points (1-3 on fights under ~30 s) → Ferocious Bite at 5 with Rip up (Carnage refreshes both bleeds) → Rake if missing → Shred on Clearcasting from behind → **Claw** ([priority](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps)).
3. **Bleed-immune target:** Tiger's Fury → Ferocious Bite at 5 → Shred from behind → Reshift below 28 energy ([powershift](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps), [immune bosses](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps)).
4. **Cooldowns:** Tiger's Fury at 100% uptime (off the GCD). **Berserk** (6-minute cooldown) on long bleedable bosses. On-use trinkets at the pull and in the last 20% ([cooldowns](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps)).
5. **AoE switch:** there is none. Keep hitting the kill target at any target count. At 3+ mobs, shift to Bear and Swipe only if the tank needs help ([AoE](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps)).
6. **Resource rule:** **Reshift** when energy is under ~28-30, no tick is due and Tiger's Fury has under 3 s left, then recast Tiger's Fury. At 28 energy you are one tick from a Shred ([priority](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps)).
7. **Situational:** keep 8% melee hit. If you pull threat, shift to Bear until the tank taunts; Cower is weak. Innervate a healer; Rebirth only out of form ([cooldowns](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps)).

yaml.stat_priority_note: Melee hit cap is 8%, or 5% with Natural Weapons 3/3; hit above the cap does nothing and cannot reduce dodge or parry, which key off weapon skill. Cat form is permanently stuck at 300 weapon skill, so a feral cannot buy down glancing blows the way other melee can. Strength and Agility are the scaling stats because forms convert weapon-slot items into flat Feral Attack Power. Crit is valued but no source gives it a weight. Haste is CONTESTED and the community considers it overvalued by item designers, since only about 20–30% of feral damage comes from auto-attacks. Intellect on the T2.5/T3.5 sets is contested — useful for PvP shifting, considered wasted stat points in PvE. Strength and Agility are a tie: no cited post ranks them against each other, so their order in the array above carries no ranking. Grouping them is this repository's reading of the sources listed above.

glance.recommendation: Play the **11/35/5 bleed/Claw build**. On any target that can bleed, keep **Rake** and **Rip** up, keep **Tiger's Fury** up, spam **Claw**, and spend 5 combo points on **Ferocious Bite** (Carnage refreshes both bleeds). On bleed-immune targets, drop the bleeds and switch to **Shred + Ferocious Bite + Reshift** (powershifting). Get **8% hit** (5% from gear), then stack Strength, Agility and Attack Power. Your weapon is a stat stick: only its stats and "Equip:" effects count in Cat Form.

playbooks.title: Balance (Moonkin, ranged DPS)
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** play **37/0/14** (Balance of All Things 3/3, Eclipse, Guidance of the Dream 3/3, Genesis 3/3). Aim for **16% spell hit** (12-14% is the realistic pre-Kara40 target), then spell power and crit. Keep **Moonfire** and **Insect Swarm** on your target, cast **Starfire** in Arcane Eclipse and **Wrath** in Nature Eclipse, and fish for the next Eclipse in between. Use **Hurricane** on 3-4+ mobs, and on trash only once you have the T3.5 3-piece. stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Spell hit to 16%** against raid bosses (17% miss minus the unavoidable 1%). Natural Weapons gives 3%, and the Emerald Blessing raid buff +1%, so you need 12% from gear Micro Jackson · 2025-12-03, Habu · 2026-03-15, Eepyman · 2026-04-08. A resisted spell cannot crit and cannot proc Eclipse, so hit is worth more than for other casters Yoshi 🌵 · 2026-03-28. Level-62 mobs need only 5% Micro Jackson · 2025-12-03. - **Contested: how close to cap.** "12 total is reasonable, 16 total is ideal" Haruchon · 2026-03-30; most Naxx-geared boomkins sit near 13% because that is "all the setup can get" Eepyman · 2026-04-08. Sims sometimes show dropping ~3% hit for crit as a small gain, but Hotverdomme-Nord keeps hit for consistency Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-16. 2. **Spell power.** Arcane still out-damages Nature overall on bosses, so arcane-only spell power beats nature-only Micro Jackson · 2026-04-03. 3. **Crit.** Eclipse's bonus scales with your crit chance ("10% plus 60% of your spell crit") BalCrix · 2025-08-09. **Contested:** after the Eclipse rework crit no longer triggers Eclipse, so the sims value it lower; Micro Jackson argues it is still undervalued Micro Jackson · 2025-12-03, Micro Jackson · 2025-12-03. 4. **Haste** only at breakpoints. You need 8% haste to bring Starfire from 2.6 s to the 2.5 s breakpoint; anything between is wasted Tyrona · 2026-03-27, Koalafurieux - BUFF BOOMIES · 2026-03-27. About 1% haste ≈ 11 spell power at those breakpoints Koalafurieux - BUFF BOOMIES · 2026-03-27. Krokat's best haste configuration gained only ~10 DPS Krokat · 2026-03-27. Hurricane does not scale with haste Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-11-20. 5. **Intellect and MP5** come last: take spell power and fix mana by downranking Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-14. One sim's weights (spell power = 1): Arcane SP 0.53, Nature SP 0.47, Hit% 21.45, Crit% 17.52, Haste% 12.81, Spell penetration 1.56 Micro Jackson · 2025-12-10. Haste has no fixed value; run Krokat's sim (`krokats.github.io/Boomkin-sim`) or Kangaraxxus's calculator with your own gear Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-08, Kangaraxxus · 2026-03-22. **Spell penetration:** the new 1.18.1 food gives 15 spell penetration, matching a level-63 boss's base resistance; the Ring of Swarming Thought or a +15 spell penetration bracer enchant saves swapping food Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-23, Micro Jackson · 2026-03-23.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation
rotationSingle.markdown: How Eclipse works: **Wrath** can grant **Arcane Eclipse** (buffs Starfire); **Starfire** can grant **Nature Eclipse** (buffs Wrath). Each lasts 15 s with its own 30 s cooldown, and only one can be active at a time BalCrix · 2025-08-09, Vinsing · 2025-12-04. DoTs snapshot the Eclipse bonus when applied Treehide/Verrik · 2025-05-06. **Opener:** pre-cast **Starfire** on the kill target as the tank pulls. If it grants Nature Eclipse, go straight to Wrath; if not, apply your DoTs and continue Breaddy · 2026-04-04, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-14. Against a fresh tank, start with **Insect Swarm** instead to avoid early threat, then Moonfire Krokat · 2026-03-27. Priority (bot-ready): 1. **`Moonfire`** if missing on your target. Your Starfire crit bonus needs it on the target you are hitting Floccumate · 2026-04-14. 2. **`Insect Swarm`** if missing on your target (Wrath mana refund; it also lowers the mob's chance to hit by 2%) Xeede · 2025-10-15. 3. **Arcane Eclipse active → `Starfire`.** Keep Moonfire up as long as possible. If less time is left in Eclipse than one Starfire takes, reapply Moonfire instead, so the refreshed DoT keeps the Eclipse bonus Habu · 2026-04-15. 4. **Nature Eclipse active → `Wrath`.** Do not reapply Insect Swarm mid-window; refresh it only in the last GCD when no further Wrath fits Habu · 2026-04-15, Voodoo · 2025-12-30. 5. **No Eclipse → fish.** Alternating Starfire and Wrath simmed higher than pure Wrath spam at fight start Krokat · 2026-03-27. If one Eclipse is on cooldown, cast the spell that can proc the other. 6. If an Eclipse procs mid-cast of the opposing spell, **let the cast finish**; interrupting it loses DPS Micro Jackson · 2025-12-11. 7. **`Moonfire`** to finish a target at ~1% HP, and while moving Voodoo · 2025-11-18. **Contested: pure Wrath spam.** Right after the patch, several players found spamming Wrath out-damaged Starfire even in Arcane Eclipse, because 3 s Starfires get pushed back Cowmoohflage/Arrowgance · 2026-03-21, Lythany · 2026-03-21. Later sims and Hotverdomme-Nord favour a normal Starfire-in-Arcane rotation Krokat · 2026-03-27, Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16.

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns, mana and utility
cooldowns.markdown: - **No burst cooldown.** Use on-use trinkets on the first crit of a burn window Micro Jackson · 2025-05-06. - **Mana:** Nordanaar Herbal Tea and Major Mana Potion on cooldown, plus Mageblood Habu · 2026-03-14. Innervate yourself when needed; the T3 2-piece strengthens Innervate on others Breaddy · 2025-12-30. Mana regen while casting caps at 100% Micro Jackson · 2026-04-03. - **Faerie Fire:** usually one Balance druid keeps it up, because it needs spell hit; skip it on short trash Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-02-15. - **Emerald Blessing** (Emerald Sanctum unlock): +1% spell hit, +10% movement speed and some mana regen for the raid; one druid should always keep it active Eepyman · 2026-04-08. - **Decurse:** on Kruul it costs you DPS Habu · 2026-03-28. - Mark and Gift of the Wild can be cast in Moonkin Form Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-03-14; Rebirth and Tranquility cannot Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-02-18, Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-13. - **Moonkin tanking** is possible on Twin Emperors and the Chess Bishop with shadow resistance ("not GOOD, but DOABLE") Conchim · 2026-04-12, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-12.

roleStrategy.heading: Raid notes
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Anomalus** (Kara40) is arcane-immune: pre-cast Starfire on critters near the pull to fish a Nature Eclipse, or hope a warlock's demon breaks free Breaddy · 2026-04-04. Arcane resistance needed is contested (roughly 100-200+) Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-02, Habu · 2026-04-10. - **BWL trash:** summoner adds are spell-immune; drakonids resist every school but one, so boomkin trash damage is RNG Breaddy · 2026-04-04. - **AQ40:** Ouro has above-average nature resistance Breaddy · 2026-01-04. - **Naxx spider wing:** Moonfire while moving to the next pack, fishing a Nature Eclipse on arrival Breaddy · 2026-02-17. - **Timbermaw Hold** has a nature-immune boss Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. - Best relative fights: Rupturan (#36 at 1,368 DPS in one log), Kruul, Medivh; longer fights favour DoTs Koalafurieux - BUFF BOOMIES · 2026-03-28, Micro Jackson · 2026-04-06.

gear.heading: Gear
gear.markdown: ### Pre-raid and early raids - No official pre-raid list exists; build one in the gear planner with spell power > hit (to cap) > crit > Intellect SteveNash · 2025-12-05. - A pre-1.18.1 list (Verdict): Diana's Pearl Necklace, Dreamwind Spaulders (Hyjal quest), Runic Leather Armor and Pants, T1 belt/bracers, Gloves of Spell Mastery (Tailoring, good until AQ40), the Stormwind Vault quest ring (1% hit), the Scholomance last-boss ring, Orb of Kaladoon (Karazhan Crypt quest) Verdict · 2024-12-15. - Keep the **T1 3-piece** until AQ-tier gear; the T2 set bonus is weak Haruchon · 2025-10-17, VoodooDiesel · 2026-03-17. ZG's boomkin-specific rewards (the exalted neck, the Balance enchant) are weak Philaine · 2024-11-25, Sir Shimbles · 2025-06-05. - Boomkins do poorly in T1-T2 gear and "come online" around AQ40 Treehide/Verrik · 2025-02-25, Bobob · 2026-04-17. ### Naxx and Kara40 - **Pre-Kara40 BiS:** 8/8 T3 plus one strong off-piece. Best off-pieces: Ysgholar, then Polarity Leggings; Sapphiron's cloak beats the Veil Treehide/Verrik · 2025-11-21. Others: Dark Storm Gauntlets, Eye Stalk, Arcane Accuracy Bracers, Gothik bracers, Rime-covered boots Treehide/Verrik · 2025-11-21. - **Naxx:** Soulseeker, Gem of Trapped Innocents, the T3 ring and Seal of the Damned; Pendant of the Faceless on non-undead bosses Floccumate · 2026-01-22, Floccumate · 2026-01-22, Heisenberg · 2026-01-22. - **Kara40:** you get T3.5 faster than a full 8/8 T3, so prioritise the T3.5 pieces and key off-pieces (Sapphiron trinket, Seal of the Damned) over forcing 8/8 T3 Micro Jackson · 2025-12-01. Khadgar's Guidance is the BiS ring; the Warlord/Marshal PvP gloves are next-best for PvE Koalafurieux - BUFF BOOMIES · 2026-03-28. ### Trinkets - **Scythe of Elune** (legendary): +40 spell power, 4% stats, a damage proc with a ~5-8% vulnerability debuff and a summon, "300%+ better than the second runner up" Micro Jackson · 2026-02-02. It takes a Father Lycan world-boss kill with a 2% drop plus a rare recipe, and it can take a boomkin from 12th to 4th in a raid Micro Jackson · 2026-02-02, Lyrazia · 2025-12-08. - Otherwise: **Talisman of Ephemeral Power** and **Zandalarian Hero Charm** Eepyman · 2026-03-27; **Neltharion's Tear** for hit unless you have Scythe Khanaar · 2026-02-08; Eye of Diminution when threat is tight; the Sapphiron trinket on long fights; undead/demon trinkets against those types xDowoh · 2026-02-08. **Contested:** whether ToEP and ZHC share a cooldown Yoshi 🌵 · 2026-04-14. - Heart of Decay is weak single-target but procs twice per Hurricane on 6-7 mobs; static spell-power trinkets beat it Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-15, Micro Jackson · 2026-04-15. ### Idols Krokat's 120 s sim, % DPS over no idol (AQ40 / Naxx / Kara40 BiS) Krokat · 2026-03-31: | Idol | Gain | |---|---| | **Idol of Ebb and Flow** (Starfire −0.2 s; Cla'kora, 17% drop) | +2.9% / +3.4% / +3.3% | | Idol of the Moon | +1.3% / +1.3% / +1.2% | | Idol of Equilibrium (new) | +1.1% / +1.1% / +0.9% | | Idol of Acidity (new) | +0.9% / +0.7% / +1.0% | Ebb and Flow stays BiS Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-23, Heisenberg · 2026-03-01. extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown:
The level-60 loop; details and sources in the sections linked. For leveling, see [Gameplay by level](#/class/druid/leveling).

1. **Opener:** pre-cast **Starfire** on the kill target as the tank pulls. If it grants Nature Eclipse, go straight to Wrath; otherwise apply the DoTs. With a fresh tank, open with **Insect Swarm** instead ([rotation](#/class/druid/balance-ranged-dps)).
2. **Single-target loop:** **Moonfire** if missing → **Insect Swarm** if missing → Arcane Eclipse: **Starfire** (reapply Moonfire when less time is left than one Starfire) → Nature Eclipse: **Wrath** (refresh Insect Swarm only in the last GCD) → no Eclipse: alternate Starfire and Wrath to fish. Let a cast finish when an Eclipse procs mid-cast.
3. **Cooldowns:** there is no burst cooldown. Use on-use trinkets on the first crit of a burn window; Innervate yourself when low ([cooldowns](#/class/druid/balance-ranged-dps)).
4. **AoE switch:** fast-dying trash: Moonfire only. 2-3 mobs: DoT the ones that will live. **3-4+ mobs:** pre-cast Starfire for a Nature Eclipse, then **Hurricane**. Do not DoT more than 2-3 mobs first ([AoE](#/class/druid/balance-ranged-dps)).
5. **Resource rule:** Nordanaar Herbal Tea and Major Mana Potion on cooldown, plus Mageblood. Skip Faerie Fire on short trash ([mana](#/class/druid/balance-ranged-dps)).
6. **Movement and situational:** Moonfire while moving and to finish a mob at ~1%. One Balance druid keeps Faerie Fire up; keep Emerald Blessing active; decurse. Shift out of Moonkin Form for Rebirth and Tranquility.

extraSections.heading: What 1.18.1 changed
extraSections.markdown: | Change | Detail | Effect | |---|---|---| | **Balance of All Things** | 5 → 3 points. Wrath on a target with **your Insect Swarm** refunds 10/20/30% of its mana; Starfire gets **+3/6/9% crit** against a target with **your Moonfire** ([Jamey, 2026-01-23 / 01-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | The old Boon buffs, which cut Starfire's cast time and stayed on you after the DoTs fell off, are gone, so Starfire casts are longer Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-16, Jesh · 2026-03-20. The DoT must be on the **exact target** you nuke; banking the buff off another mob no longer works rutherbird · 2026-03-22 | | **Eclipse** | Wrath's chance to proc 30% → **40%**, Starfire's 50% → **60%** ([Jamey, 2026-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)) | "Proc rates feel great" Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10 | | **Moonfury / Wrath** | Moonfury to 4/8/12%; Wrath and Moonfury buffed ~10% "because there is no nature curse" Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-03-07 | A small damage gain | | **New idols** | Idol of Equilibrium (new Onyxia boss) and Idol of Acidity (new BWL boss) | Both lose to Ebb and Flow (see Idols) Krokat · 2026-03-20 | Community verdict: "look like a buff but it is a nerf" Mitou · 2026-03-21; Krokat's sim put the new peak DPS about 5% lower Krokat · 2026-01-24. The class designer confirmed the Starfire numbers are mathematically correct; the weakness is the longer cast time Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-03-21. Devs reportedly were "cooking" further boomkin changes before the server's end Micro Jackson · 2026-04-10.

standing.source_quality: strong on mechanics (two long write-ups plus dozens of replies); medium on the post-1.18.1 numeric outcome
standing.notes: Only Druid caster-DPS spec. 1.18.1 reworked Balance of All Things (5->3 points), raised Moonfury to 4/8/12% and changed Eclipse proc chances to 40% Wrath / 60% Starfire (2026-03-19 revision); players report a net ~15% DPS loss (single source, no logs).

patch_validity.written_for: 1.17.2 / 1.18.0 Eclipse rework (Wrath 30%/Starfire 50% proc chance, bonus = 10% + 60% of spell crit)
patch_validity.notes: 1.18.1 changed Eclipse proc chances to Wrath 40%/Starfire 60% (2026-03-19 revision) and raised Moonfury to 4/8/12% (2026-01-26). Balance of All Things was reduced 5 -> 3 points and reworked TWICE: the 2026-01-26 revision gave Starfire -0.2/0.4/0.6 s cast time vs Moonfire'd targets [[d:druid#1465349903348924598]]; the 2026-03-19 revision REPLACED that with +3/6/9% crit, which players read as a net nerf. Any pre-release note quoting the cast-time version is stale. Post-1.18.1: community calls Balance the worst 'proper' DPS spec, sims show 1.18 peak 1549.2 vs 1.18.1 1454.0 DPS [[d:druid#1464380870935969944]]; the numeric magnitude is still not log-verified.

yaml.stat_priority_note: Crit is rated far above haste — "1% crit equal to around 4-5% Haste. It might even be worse" — because crit triple-dips (damage per cast, the Nature's Grace haste proc, and the Eclipse multiplier) while haste only really helps Starfire. Hit is hard to cap from set gear alone (the nine-piece T3 set carries only 4% spell hit), and several top players deliberately trade a few percent of hit for crit. Spell power is the baseline scaling stat with no numeric weight given. Item design loads Balance gear with haste, which the source calls a mismatch.

glance.recommendation: Play **37/0/14** (Balance of All Things 3/3, Eclipse, Guidance of the Dream 3/3, Genesis 3/3). Aim for **16% spell hit** (12-14% is the realistic pre-Kara40 target), then spell power and crit. Keep **Moonfire** and **Insect Swarm** on your target, cast **Starfire** in Arcane Eclipse and **Wrath** in Nature Eclipse, and fish for the next Eclipse in between. Use **Hurricane** on 3-4+ mobs, and on trash only once you have the T3.5 3-piece. Expect bottom-tier damage and bring the utility.

playbooks.title: Druid PvP
playbooks.intro: **Recommendation:** in battlegrounds play **Feral** (11/35/5 with Feral Charge, Feral Swiftness and Open Wounds) and fight with your **whole kit**: Cat for openers and bleeds, **Bear** the moment you are stunned or focused, caster form for HoTs and roots, Travel Form to reset. Druids are not a burst class; you win by outlasting ("rotting players down over time") and by carrying objectives Rustam · 2026-04-10. Balance is fun in team fights but weak 1v1; Restoration is the weakest PvP healer, so play a hybrid if you want to heal. Server-wide PvP rules (honor as a currency, rank, the 1.18.1 PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode, dampening and resilience) are on [PvP systems](#/pvp). | Spec | PvP | Why | |---|---|---| | **Feral** | **B** | The best WSG flag carrier and AB defender; "a menace" when played with every form GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. Weak into rogues, shamans and paladins #1 Shaman Hater · 2026-04-10 | | **Balance** | **B-** | "Not great 1v1 ... in a teamfight if your positioning is good, it absolutely pumps" Lythany · 2026-03-21. The 1.18.1 Starfire is "incredibly garbage" in PvP, and dampening cut boomkin damage Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-14, Eepyman · 2026-04-04, Eepyman · 2026-04-04 | | **Restoration** | **C** | "The worst pvp healer by a large margin" 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-09-26; HoTs lose to burst and get dispelled Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27. It is tanky in solo BG queues Moonshow · 2026-03-27 | Overall the class is **B-tier, C on Alliance** because "shamans eat druids for breakfast" Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27. Cross-class lists put druid in the middle: A-tier behind Shaman, Rogue and Smite Priest Ythor · 2025-10-21, or below Shaman, Rogue and Paladin betcover · 2025-10-21.
