stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Every stat has some use**, because you use every form Tephus · 2025-11-07. The general PvP rule is Stamina > crit > main stat Bipst · 2025-10-07. - **Balance:** stack Stamina and armor; do not go full spell power ([Turboman, 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160309#p160309)). - **Hit:** spell hit cap in PvP is 3% Habu · 2026-03-15. The melee PvP hit cap was asked but never answered Emde ❤ · 2025-10-24. - **Resilience** reduces critical damage and damage-over-time taken; stacked, it "basically turns crits into normal hits" Hopestotem · 2026-04-12. Since December 2025 it reduces the whole critical hit, not just the bonus part, so the older bug report #17804 ("only the crit portion", about half as effective) no longer applies ([Torta (staff), 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161356#p161356), Grey · 2026-03-20). Details: [PvP systems → Dampening and resilience](#/pvp). - **PvP sets:** the 4-piece gives +15% movement speed in Bear, Cat and Travel Form outdoors, multiplicatively with other speed bonuses; ferals rarely give it up Jamx · 2025-03-25. The blue and purple sets count as different sets, so 2 + 4 pieces stack both bonuses Lythany · 2026-03-28. Each tier needs the previous one; one druid put each at about 30k honor (~9 weeks) Aecheur · 2026-03-28. **Contested:** Thirtyseven's totals are 24,000 honor for Tier 1 and 144,000 for Tier 2 Thirtyseven · 2026-04-11 (see [PvP systems → The 1.18.1 PvP sets](#/pvp)). **Contested:** the druid set has the least Stamina of any class's PvP set (98 vs 147-154) Miaupow · 2026-03-24, Lyrazia · 2026-03-24. - **Weapons:** the upgraded "Veteran" PvP weapons sit slightly below Naxx level Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. The 4-piece bonus of the Balance and Resto PvP sets was called as useless as any class has Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-29; it has since been changed to 15% dispel protection Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-30. - **Professions:** Blacksmithing has a fear-immunity trinket for feral PvP Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. Engineering is strong in PvP generally, but grenades and sappers need you out of Cat/Bear Form Micro Jackson · 2026-03-10. - **Consumables:** flasks and elixirs stay until you die, even in battlegrounds Micro Jackson · 2026-03-23. Limited Invulnerability Potion (6 s physical immunity, ~2-minute cooldown) is everywhere against melee betcover · 2025-10-29. - **Stealth detection** (seeing rogues first): Catseye Goggles +18, Catseye Elixir +10, the druid PvP gloves +10 ([Blackduck4, 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157346#p157346)).

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Feral 1. **Opener:** Prowl → **Pounce** → **Rake** → **Rip**. Bleeds ignore armor, which is why the bleed build works in PvP THICCNICK · 2025-10-17. 2. **Before the stun ends:** get the target past half health with bleeds, then shift **Bear** to finish, or **Bash** and go back to Cat to Shred for 5 more seconds GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. 3. If they trinket the stun, stay in Bear; otherwise go back to Cat and **Berserk** (single source) AlloyMorph · 2025-09-05. 4. **Heal loop:** "Bash into omen Regrowth and a rejuv and you're basically going to outsustain the world" Death · 2024-06-08. 5. **Against any melee, fight in Bear** or you will be melted Dziadmroz · 2025-10-17. 6. **Break roots and slows by shifting;** Reshift does it in one click Comentor · 2026-01-11. Limits: you cannot cast Nature's Grasp in Bear Form, nor Barkskin while stunned Miaupow · 2026-03-24. Nature's Grasp procs about 35% of the time, and Starfire's stun about 15% Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16. There is no interrupt in Cat Form: shifting to Bear to Bash costs 2 GCDs Meow · 2025-01-27. ### Balance 1. **Dot and kite:** Moonfire + Insect Swarm at range, Entangling Roots on melee, a Wrath or a Nature's Grace Starfire when safe, HoTs between DoTs. "Never try to play moonkin as a pure caster" ([Turboman, 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254)). 2. **Surprise Starfire:** use an invisibility trinket and start Starfire from stealth; swap the trinket out just before the cast lands Endxx🧯 · 2026-03-22. 3. Roots break within ~3 s of damage, and a priest dispels all your DoTs in one GCD (no dispel protection) Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10. ### Restoration Keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm up while you out-heal the damage; a standard PvE resto can outlast most classes 1v1 while mana holds Dreamwind · 2026-04-05. Against rogues see the table below.

roleStrategy.markdown: | Opponent | Plan | Source | |---|---|---| | **Warrior** | Attrition: root and kite, shift out of Hamstring, DoT while running, reset with Travel Form | Floccumate · 2024-12-01 | | **Rogue** | Be in Bear Form when the opener lands; save the PvP trinket for Kidney Shot, not the first stun. Flash Bomb (10 s fear, 1-minute cooldown) is a kill if your trinket is down. "The only class that has a chance against shamans rn is paladin" | Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27, #1 Shaman Hater · 2026-04-10 | | **Paladin** | Losing for feral: Holy Strike → Seal of Command → Judgement burst, then HoJ/Repentance to lock you out of heals | ricardo · 2025-08-05, ([Springboards, 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84993#p84993)) | | **Mage** | Do not open with Pounce; they Blink out and save the trinket for your Bash. Balance can out-range Arcane mages | DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-31 | | **Warlock** | A slow fight: kite, heal, kill the pet, avoid the Death Coil-fear-silence cycle. Decurse helps but will not win it | Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16 | | **Priest** | Any priest dispels your DoTs and HoTs in one GCD, and Balance has no dispel protection | Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10, Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27 | | **Hunter** | A good Survival hunter keeps full ranged pressure even with the pet slept or rooted | Mot · 2026-03-25 | **Contested:** some players report resto HoTs as undispellable ("so annoying") AxenPunker · 2025-10-21, while druids complain that priests and shamans dispel them freely Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP loops. The details are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/druid/balance-pvp), [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp) and [Battleground role](#/class/druid/balance-pvp). A 1v1 as a druid "is a battle to outlast, and in group settings its providing utility" Tephus · 2026-02-02. **Feral (11/35/5):** 1. **Opener (stealth):** Prowl → `Pounce` → `Rake` → `Rip`. Bleeds ignore armor THICCNICK · 2025-10-17. Against a mage, do not open with Pounce, because they Blink out and save the trinket for your Bash DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07. 2. **Burst:** get the target past half health with bleeds before the Pounce stun ends. Then shift to Bear to finish, or `Bash` and go back to Cat to Shred for 5 more seconds GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. If they trinket, stay in Bear; if not, go Cat → `Berserk` (6-minute cooldown; single source) AlloyMorph · 2025-09-05. At 5 combo points on a low target, use Ferocious Bite (vanilla baseline). 3. **Control:** `Bash` (4 s stun, 60 s cooldown) is your only stun after the opener. Cat Form has no interrupt, and shifting to Bear to Bash costs 2 GCDs Meow · 2025-01-27. `Feral Charge` (15 s cooldown, 8–25 yd) is your gap-closer and interrupt. Don't break your own bleeds with Entangling Roots or Hibernate; roots break on damage (vanilla baseline). 4. **Defence:** fight any melee in Bear Dziadmroz · 2025-10-17. Shift, or `Reshift`, to break roots and slows Comentor · 2026-01-11. Save the PvP trinket for Kidney Shot, not the first stun (see [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)). Barkskin is not castable while stunned, and Nature's Grasp not in Bear Miaupow · 2026-03-24. 5. **Heal:** only in lulls or when you have to shift out anyway, e.g. to leave a Frost Nova Miaupow · 2026-03-25. Omen of Clarity allows `Bash` → Omen `Regrowth` → `Rejuvenation` Death · 2024-06-08. **Balance (30/0/21):** 1. **Opener (range):** `Moonfire` + `Insect Swarm`. For a surprise opener, start Starfire from invisibility-trinket stealth Endxx🧯 · 2026-03-22. 2. **Loop:** kite and DoT, Entangling Roots on melee, HoTs between DoTs. Cast Wrath, or a Nature's Grace Starfire, only when safe ([Turboman, 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254)). "Just moonfire spam and use Nature's Grace procs to cast Starfire" 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-08. 3. **Control:** roots break within ~3 s of damage Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10. Nature's Grasp procs about 35% of the time and Starfire's stun about 15%, so neither is a plan Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16. 4. **Defence:** Nature's Swiftness (3-minute cooldown) + Healing Touch is your clutch heal. It needs two presses Micro Jackson · 2025-12-19; "Nature's Swiftness is crazy" Frumie · 2024-11-21. Tank hits in Bear when caught Frumie · 2024-11-21. Moonkin Form can be Sapped Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-14. **Restoration / healer hybrid:** 1. **Default heals:** Regrowth and Rejuvenation while moving, not Healing Touch: "it is mostly ya" Vinsing · 2025-10-13, THICCNICK · 2025-10-13. Keep Nature's Swiftness for burst on you or a partner, and Swiftmend (15 s cooldown) for instant top-ups. 2. **Pressure:** keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm up while you out-heal the damage, as long as mana holds Dreamwind · 2026-04-05. 3. **Weak spots:** HoTs lose to burst and get dispelled by priests and shamans Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27. **Contested:** others report them as undispellable AxenPunker · 2025-10-21. Skip Tree of Life in PvP Valarya · 2026-02-01. 4. **Utility:** Remove Curse and Cure Poison on partners (vanilla baseline). Innervate (6-minute cooldown) when you are low on mana (vanilla baseline). **For every spec:** - **Target priority:** in battlegrounds, peel for and heal flag carriers, and defend nodes ([Battleground role](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)). Beyond that, the sources give no druid-specific kill order. The usual rule is to kill the healer if you can lock them out, and otherwise the lowest-armor DPS (vanilla baseline). - **Reset / drink:** Travel Form out to reset ("going cheetah and running away") THICCNICK · 2025-10-13. Drink out of combat, and re-Prowl (Cat) before you re-engage (vanilla baseline). **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)): - **Warrior:** root, kite, shift out of Hamstring, and Travel Form to reset. - **Rogue:** be in Bear when the opener lands, and trinket Kidney Shot. - **Shaman:** the hardest matchup. Purge strips HoTs, and Enhancement burst kills Cat. - **Paladin:** a losing matchup for Feral, because HoJ or Repentance locks you out of heals. - **Mage:** no Pounce opener. Balance can out-range Arcane. - **Warlock:** kill the pet, and avoid the Death Coil → fear → silence chain. Feral nearly always lands the opener on a warlock dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13. - **Priest / Hunter:** expect one-GCD dispels / full ranged pressure even with the pet slept.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **WSG flag carrier** (feral): Bear or normal Travel Form with the PvP set speed bonus; you cannot carry the flag in Swift Travel Form Meow · 2025-01-14. - **AB / AV:** defend and spin flags; "could turn the tides at any spot in AV" GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. - **Balance** in team fights, with good positioning, from range Lythany · 2026-03-21.

extraSections.heading: Races
extraSections.markdown: - **Tauren:** +5% Stamina and War Stomp (not usable in forms); Plainsrunning; the PvP min-max pick. "Stomp + Entangling Roots on a warrior/rogue, then Travel Form away" GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-03-14, Holydruid · 2026-02-17, ([Jammyxx, 2023-03-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36461#p36461)). - **Night Elf:** Shadowmeld also passively lowers enemy stealth detection while you Prowl Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-23. - **Moonkin Form can be Sapped;** Cat and Bear cannot Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-14.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - Cancel a form: `/unshift` (not `/cancelform`) DrakeReinz · 2026-03-14. - Feral Charge into Bear: `/cast [noform:2] !Bear Form` / `/cast Feral Charge` (SuperWoW, Nampower, CleveRoid) poisonouscabbage · 2025-11-23. - One key for Growl (Bear), Prowl (Cat) and mouseover Entangling Roots (caster) Rahnd2137 · 2026-02-11. - Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch needs two presses; the client cannot cast both from one click Micro Jackson · 2025-12-19. - A travel macro: mount when standing still, Travel Form when moving or in combat, Aquatic Form when swimming Invadertim · 2025-09-16.

extraSections.heading: Honor
extraSections.markdown: - **Since 1.18.1 honor is a currency:** it is credited immediately and spent at vendors, and the weekly standings race is gone ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). The weekly cap is **20,000 honor** Dodging · 2026-03-28, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-28. - **Rank:** Rank Points decay each week, but your rank doesn't drop Grey · 2026-03-28, Floccumate · 2025-12-17. **Contested:** some players reported being de-ranked after 1.18.1 (see the PvP systems page). - **Weekly reset:** the night from Tuesday to Wednesday, EU time Pastor · 2025-10-25, Meow · 2025-10-29. Full rules (what gives honor, Rank Points, the PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode): [PvP systems](#/pvp).

glance.recommendation: In battlegrounds play **Feral** (11/35/5 with Feral Charge, Feral Swiftness and Open Wounds) and fight with your **whole kit**: Cat for openers and bleeds, **Bear** the moment you are stunned or focused, caster form for HoTs and roots, Travel Form to reset. stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Every stat has some use**, because you use every form Tephus · 2025-11-07. The general PvP rule is Stamina > crit > main stat Bipst · 2025-10-07. - **Balance:** stack Stamina and armor; do not go full spell power ([Turboman, 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160309#p160309)). - **Hit:** spell hit cap in PvP is 3% Habu · 2026-03-15. The melee PvP hit cap was asked but never answered Emde ❤ · 2025-10-24. - **Resilience** reduces critical damage and damage-over-time taken; stacked, it "basically turns crits into normal hits" Hopestotem · 2026-04-12. Since December 2025 it reduces the whole critical hit, not just the bonus part, so the older bug report #17804 ("only the crit portion", about half as effective) no longer applies ([Torta (staff), 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161356#p161356), Grey · 2026-03-20). Details: [PvP systems → Dampening and resilience](#/pvp). - **PvP sets:** the 4-piece gives +15% movement speed in Bear, Cat and Travel Form outdoors, multiplicatively with other speed bonuses; ferals rarely give it up Jamx · 2025-03-25. The blue and purple sets count as different sets, so 2 + 4 pieces stack both bonuses Lythany · 2026-03-28. Each tier needs the previous one; one druid put each at about 30k honor (~9 weeks) Aecheur · 2026-03-28. **Contested:** Thirtyseven's totals are 24,000 honor for Tier 1 and 144,000 for Tier 2 Thirtyseven · 2026-04-11 (see [PvP systems → The 1.18.1 PvP sets](#/pvp)). **Contested:** the druid set has the least Stamina of any class's PvP set (98 vs 147-154) Miaupow · 2026-03-24, Lyrazia · 2026-03-24. - **Weapons:** the upgraded "Veteran" PvP weapons sit slightly below Naxx level Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. The 4-piece bonus of the Balance and Resto PvP sets was called as useless as any class has Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-29; it has since been changed to 15% dispel protection Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-30. - **Professions:** Blacksmithing has a fear-immunity trinket for feral PvP Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. Engineering is strong in PvP generally, but grenades and sappers need you out of Cat/Bear Form Micro Jackson · 2026-03-10. - **Consumables:** flasks and elixirs stay until you die, even in battlegrounds Micro Jackson · 2026-03-23. Limited Invulnerability Potion (6 s physical immunity, ~2-minute cooldown) is everywhere against melee betcover · 2025-10-29. - **Stealth detection** (seeing rogues first): Catseye Goggles +18, Catseye Elixir +10, the druid PvP gloves +10 ([Blackduck4, 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157346#p157346)).

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Feral 1. **Opener:** Prowl → **Pounce** → **Rake** → **Rip**. Bleeds ignore armor, which is why the bleed build works in PvP THICCNICK · 2025-10-17. 2. **Before the stun ends:** get the target past half health with bleeds, then shift **Bear** to finish, or **Bash** and go back to Cat to Shred for 5 more seconds GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. 3. If they trinket the stun, stay in Bear; otherwise go back to Cat and **Berserk** (single source) AlloyMorph · 2025-09-05. 4. **Heal loop:** "Bash into omen Regrowth and a rejuv and you're basically going to outsustain the world" Death · 2024-06-08. 5. **Against any melee, fight in Bear** or you will be melted Dziadmroz · 2025-10-17. 6. **Break roots and slows by shifting;** Reshift does it in one click Comentor · 2026-01-11. Limits: you cannot cast Nature's Grasp in Bear Form, nor Barkskin while stunned Miaupow · 2026-03-24. Nature's Grasp procs about 35% of the time, and Starfire's stun about 15% Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16. There is no interrupt in Cat Form: shifting to Bear to Bash costs 2 GCDs Meow · 2025-01-27. ### Balance 1. **Dot and kite:** Moonfire + Insect Swarm at range, Entangling Roots on melee, a Wrath or a Nature's Grace Starfire when safe, HoTs between DoTs. "Never try to play moonkin as a pure caster" ([Turboman, 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254)). 2. **Surprise Starfire:** use an invisibility trinket and start Starfire from stealth; swap the trinket out just before the cast lands Endxx🧯 · 2026-03-22. 3. Roots break within ~3 s of damage, and a priest dispels all your DoTs in one GCD (no dispel protection) Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10. ### Restoration Keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm up while you out-heal the damage; a standard PvE resto can outlast most classes 1v1 while mana holds Dreamwind · 2026-04-05. Against rogues see the table below.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP loops. The details are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/druid/balance-pvp), [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp) and [Battleground role](#/class/druid/balance-pvp). A 1v1 as a druid "is a battle to outlast, and in group settings its providing utility" Tephus · 2026-02-02. **Feral (11/35/5):** 1. **Opener (stealth):** Prowl → `Pounce` → `Rake` → `Rip`. Bleeds ignore armor THICCNICK · 2025-10-17. Against a mage, do not open with Pounce, because they Blink out and save the trinket for your Bash DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07. 2. **Burst:** get the target past half health with bleeds before the Pounce stun ends. Then shift to Bear to finish, or `Bash` and go back to Cat to Shred for 5 more seconds GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. If they trinket, stay in Bear; if not, go Cat → `Berserk` (6-minute cooldown; single source) AlloyMorph · 2025-09-05. At 5 combo points on a low target, use Ferocious Bite (vanilla baseline). 3. **Control:** `Bash` (4 s stun, 60 s cooldown) is your only stun after the opener. Cat Form has no interrupt, and shifting to Bear to Bash costs 2 GCDs Meow · 2025-01-27. `Feral Charge` (15 s cooldown, 8–25 yd) is your gap-closer and interrupt. Don't break your own bleeds with Entangling Roots or Hibernate; roots break on damage (vanilla baseline). 4. **Defence:** fight any melee in Bear Dziadmroz · 2025-10-17. Shift, or `Reshift`, to break roots and slows Comentor · 2026-01-11. Save the PvP trinket for Kidney Shot, not the first stun (see [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)). Barkskin is not castable while stunned, and Nature's Grasp not in Bear Miaupow · 2026-03-24. 5. **Heal:** only in lulls or when you have to shift out anyway, e.g. to leave a Frost Nova Miaupow · 2026-03-25. Omen of Clarity allows `Bash` → Omen `Regrowth` → `Rejuvenation` Death · 2024-06-08. **Balance (30/0/21):** 1. **Opener (range):** `Moonfire` + `Insect Swarm`. For a surprise opener, start Starfire from invisibility-trinket stealth Endxx🧯 · 2026-03-22. 2. **Loop:** kite and DoT, Entangling Roots on melee, HoTs between DoTs. Cast Wrath, or a Nature's Grace Starfire, only when safe ([Turboman, 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254)). "Just moonfire spam and use Nature's Grace procs to cast Starfire" 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-08. 3. **Control:** roots break within ~3 s of damage Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10. Nature's Grasp procs about 35% of the time and Starfire's stun about 15%, so neither is a plan Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16. 4. **Defence:** Nature's Swiftness (3-minute cooldown) + Healing Touch is your clutch heal. It needs two presses Micro Jackson · 2025-12-19; "Nature's Swiftness is crazy" Frumie · 2024-11-21. Tank hits in Bear when caught Frumie · 2024-11-21. Moonkin Form can be Sapped Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-14. **Restoration / healer hybrid:** 1. **Default heals:** Regrowth and Rejuvenation while moving, not Healing Touch: "it is mostly ya" Vinsing · 2025-10-13, THICCNICK · 2025-10-13. Keep Nature's Swiftness for burst on you or a partner, and Swiftmend (15 s cooldown) for instant top-ups. 2. **Pressure:** keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm up while you out-heal the damage, as long as mana holds Dreamwind · 2026-04-05. 3. **Weak spots:** HoTs lose to burst and get dispelled by priests and shamans Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27. **Contested:** others report them as undispellable AxenPunker · 2025-10-21. Skip Tree of Life in PvP Valarya · 2026-02-01. 4. **Utility:** Remove Curse and Cure Poison on partners (vanilla baseline). Innervate (6-minute cooldown) when you are low on mana (vanilla baseline). **For every spec:** - **Target priority:** in battlegrounds, peel for and heal flag carriers, and defend nodes ([Battleground role](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)). Beyond that, the sources give no druid-specific kill order. The usual rule is to kill the healer if you can lock them out, and otherwise the lowest-armor DPS (vanilla baseline). - **Reset / drink:** Travel Form out to reset ("going cheetah and running away") THICCNICK · 2025-10-13. Drink out of combat, and re-Prowl (Cat) before you re-engage (vanilla baseline). **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)): - **Warrior:** root, kite, shift out of Hamstring, and Travel Form to reset. - **Rogue:** be in Bear when the opener lands, and trinket Kidney Shot. - **Shaman:** the hardest matchup. Purge strips HoTs, and Enhancement burst kills Cat. - **Paladin:** a losing matchup for Feral, because HoJ or Repentance locks you out of heals. - **Mage:** no Pounce opener. Balance can out-range Arcane. - **Warlock:** kill the pet, and avoid the Death Coil → fear → silence chain. Feral nearly always lands the opener on a warlock dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13. - **Priest / Hunter:** expect one-GCD dispels / full ranged pressure even with the pet slept.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **WSG flag carrier** (feral): Bear or normal Travel Form with the PvP set speed bonus; you cannot carry the flag in Swift Travel Form Meow · 2025-01-14. - **AB / AV:** defend and spin flags; "could turn the tides at any spot in AV" GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. - **Balance** in team fights, with good positioning, from range Lythany · 2026-03-21.

extraSections.heading: Races
extraSections.markdown: - **Tauren:** +5% Stamina and War Stomp (not usable in forms); Plainsrunning; the PvP min-max pick. "Stomp + Entangling Roots on a warrior/rogue, then Travel Form away" GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-03-14, Holydruid · 2026-02-17, ([Jammyxx, 2023-03-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36461#p36461)). - **Night Elf:** Shadowmeld also passively lowers enemy stealth detection while you Prowl Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-23. - **Moonkin Form can be Sapped;** Cat and Bear cannot Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-14.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - Cancel a form: `/unshift` (not `/cancelform`) DrakeReinz · 2026-03-14. - Feral Charge into Bear: `/cast [noform:2] !Bear Form` / `/cast Feral Charge` (SuperWoW, Nampower, CleveRoid) poisonouscabbage · 2025-11-23. - One key for Growl (Bear), Prowl (Cat) and mouseover Entangling Roots (caster) Rahnd2137 · 2026-02-11. - Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch needs two presses; the client cannot cast both from one click Micro Jackson · 2025-12-19. - A travel macro: mount when standing still, Travel Form when moving or in combat, Aquatic Form when swimming Invadertim · 2025-09-16.

extraSections.heading: Honor
extraSections.markdown: - **Since 1.18.1 honor is a currency:** it is credited immediately and spent at vendors, and the weekly standings race is gone ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). The weekly cap is **20,000 honor** Dodging · 2026-03-28, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-28. - **Rank:** Rank Points decay each week, but your rank doesn't drop Grey · 2026-03-28, Floccumate · 2025-12-17. **Contested:** some players reported being de-ranked after 1.18.1 (see the PvP systems page). - **Weekly reset:** the night from Tuesday to Wednesday, EU time Pastor · 2025-10-25, Meow · 2025-10-29. Full rules (what gives honor, Rank Points, the PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode): [PvP systems](#/pvp).

glance.recommendation: In battlegrounds play **Feral** (11/35/5 with Feral Charge, Feral Swiftness and Open Wounds) and fight with your **whole kit**: Cat for openers and bleeds, **Bear** the moment you are stunned or focused, caster form for HoTs and roots, Travel Form to reset. Druids are not a burst class; you win by outlasting ("rotting players down over time") and by carrying objectives Rustam · 2026-04-10. Balance is fun in team fights but weak 1v1; Restoration is the weakest PvP healer, so play a hybrid if you want to heal.

stats.heading: Stats and gear
stats.markdown: - **Every stat has some use**, because you use every form Tephus · 2025-11-07. The general PvP rule is Stamina > crit > main stat Bipst · 2025-10-07. - **Balance:** stack Stamina and armor; do not go full spell power ([Turboman, 2025-11-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160309#p160309)). - **Hit:** spell hit cap in PvP is 3% Habu · 2026-03-15. The melee PvP hit cap was asked but never answered Emde ❤ · 2025-10-24. - **Resilience** reduces critical damage and damage-over-time taken; stacked, it "basically turns crits into normal hits" Hopestotem · 2026-04-12. Since December 2025 it reduces the whole critical hit, not just the bonus part, so the older bug report #17804 ("only the crit portion", about half as effective) no longer applies ([Torta (staff), 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161356#p161356), Grey · 2026-03-20). Details: [PvP systems → Dampening and resilience](#/pvp). - **PvP sets:** the 4-piece gives +15% movement speed in Bear, Cat and Travel Form outdoors, multiplicatively with other speed bonuses; ferals rarely give it up Jamx · 2025-03-25. The blue and purple sets count as different sets, so 2 + 4 pieces stack both bonuses Lythany · 2026-03-28. Each tier needs the previous one; one druid put each at about 30k honor (~9 weeks) Aecheur · 2026-03-28. **Contested:** Thirtyseven's totals are 24,000 honor for Tier 1 and 144,000 for Tier 2 Thirtyseven · 2026-04-11 (see [PvP systems → The 1.18.1 PvP sets](#/pvp)). **Contested:** the druid set has the least Stamina of any class's PvP set (98 vs 147-154) Miaupow · 2026-03-24, Lyrazia · 2026-03-24. - **Weapons:** the upgraded "Veteran" PvP weapons sit slightly below Naxx level Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. The 4-piece bonus of the Balance and Resto PvP sets was called as useless as any class has Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-29; it has since been changed to 15% dispel protection Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-30. - **Professions:** Blacksmithing has a fear-immunity trinket for feral PvP Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. Engineering is strong in PvP generally, but grenades and sappers need you out of Cat/Bear Form Micro Jackson · 2026-03-10. - **Consumables:** flasks and elixirs stay until you die, even in battlegrounds Micro Jackson · 2026-03-23. Limited Invulnerability Potion (6 s physical immunity, ~2-minute cooldown) is everywhere against melee betcover · 2025-10-29. - **Stealth detection** (seeing rogues first): Catseye Goggles +18, Catseye Elixir +10, the druid PvP gloves +10 ([Blackduck4, 2025-10-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157346#p157346)).

rotationSingle.heading: Burst and control sequences
rotationSingle.markdown: ### Feral 1. **Opener:** Prowl → **Pounce** → **Rake** → **Rip**. Bleeds ignore armor, which is why the bleed build works in PvP THICCNICK · 2025-10-17. 2. **Before the stun ends:** get the target past half health with bleeds, then shift **Bear** to finish, or **Bash** and go back to Cat to Shred for 5 more seconds GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. 3. If they trinket the stun, stay in Bear; otherwise go back to Cat and **Berserk** (single source) AlloyMorph · 2025-09-05. 4. **Heal loop:** "Bash into omen Regrowth and a rejuv and you're basically going to outsustain the world" Death · 2024-06-08. 5. **Against any melee, fight in Bear** or you will be melted Dziadmroz · 2025-10-17. 6. **Break roots and slows by shifting;** Reshift does it in one click Comentor · 2026-01-11. Limits: you cannot cast Nature's Grasp in Bear Form, nor Barkskin while stunned Miaupow · 2026-03-24. Nature's Grasp procs about 35% of the time, and Starfire's stun about 15% Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16. There is no interrupt in Cat Form: shifting to Bear to Bash costs 2 GCDs Meow · 2025-01-27. ### Balance 1. **Dot and kite:** Moonfire + Insect Swarm at range, Entangling Roots on melee, a Wrath or a Nature's Grace Starfire when safe, HoTs between DoTs. "Never try to play moonkin as a pure caster" ([Turboman, 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254)). 2. **Surprise Starfire:** use an invisibility trinket and start Starfire from stealth; swap the trinket out just before the cast lands Endxx🧯 · 2026-03-22. 3. Roots break within ~3 s of damage, and a priest dispels all your DoTs in one GCD (no dispel protection) Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10. ### Restoration Keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm up while you out-heal the damage; a standard PvE resto can outlast most classes 1v1 while mana holds Dreamwind · 2026-04-05. Against rogues see the table below.

extraSections.heading: How to play
extraSections.markdown: The level-60 PvP loops. The details are in [Burst and control sequences](#/class/druid/balance-pvp), [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp) and [Battleground role](#/class/druid/balance-pvp). A 1v1 as a druid "is a battle to outlast, and in group settings its providing utility" Tephus · 2026-02-02. **Feral (11/35/5):** 1. **Opener (stealth):** Prowl → `Pounce` → `Rake` → `Rip`. Bleeds ignore armor THICCNICK · 2025-10-17. Against a mage, do not open with Pounce, because they Blink out and save the trinket for your Bash DrakeReinz · 2025-06-07. 2. **Burst:** get the target past half health with bleeds before the Pounce stun ends. Then shift to Bear to finish, or `Bash` and go back to Cat to Shred for 5 more seconds GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. If they trinket, stay in Bear; if not, go Cat → `Berserk` (6-minute cooldown; single source) AlloyMorph · 2025-09-05. At 5 combo points on a low target, use Ferocious Bite (vanilla baseline). 3. **Control:** `Bash` (4 s stun, 60 s cooldown) is your only stun after the opener. Cat Form has no interrupt, and shifting to Bear to Bash costs 2 GCDs Meow · 2025-01-27. `Feral Charge` (15 s cooldown, 8–25 yd) is your gap-closer and interrupt. Don't break your own bleeds with Entangling Roots or Hibernate; roots break on damage (vanilla baseline). 4. **Defence:** fight any melee in Bear Dziadmroz · 2025-10-17. Shift, or `Reshift`, to break roots and slows Comentor · 2026-01-11. Save the PvP trinket for Kidney Shot, not the first stun (see [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)). Barkskin is not castable while stunned, and Nature's Grasp not in Bear Miaupow · 2026-03-24. 5. **Heal:** only in lulls or when you have to shift out anyway, e.g. to leave a Frost Nova Miaupow · 2026-03-25. Omen of Clarity allows `Bash` → Omen `Regrowth` → `Rejuvenation` Death · 2024-06-08. **Balance (30/0/21):** 1. **Opener (range):** `Moonfire` + `Insect Swarm`. For a surprise opener, start Starfire from invisibility-trinket stealth Endxx🧯 · 2026-03-22. 2. **Loop:** kite and DoT, Entangling Roots on melee, HoTs between DoTs. Cast Wrath, or a Nature's Grace Starfire, only when safe ([Turboman, 2025-08-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=143254#p143254)). "Just moonfire spam and use Nature's Grace procs to cast Starfire" 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-10-08. 3. **Control:** roots break within ~3 s of damage Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-10. Nature's Grasp procs about 35% of the time and Starfire's stun about 15%, so neither is a plan Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-16. 4. **Defence:** Nature's Swiftness (3-minute cooldown) + Healing Touch is your clutch heal. It needs two presses Micro Jackson · 2025-12-19; "Nature's Swiftness is crazy" Frumie · 2024-11-21. Tank hits in Bear when caught Frumie · 2024-11-21. Moonkin Form can be Sapped Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-14. **Restoration / healer hybrid:** 1. **Default heals:** Regrowth and Rejuvenation while moving, not Healing Touch: "it is mostly ya" Vinsing · 2025-10-13, THICCNICK · 2025-10-13. Keep Nature's Swiftness for burst on you or a partner, and Swiftmend (15 s cooldown) for instant top-ups. 2. **Pressure:** keep Moonfire and Insect Swarm up while you out-heal the damage, as long as mana holds Dreamwind · 2026-04-05. 3. **Weak spots:** HoTs lose to burst and get dispelled by priests and shamans Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27. **Contested:** others report them as undispellable AxenPunker · 2025-10-21. Skip Tree of Life in PvP Valarya · 2026-02-01. 4. **Utility:** Remove Curse and Cure Poison on partners (vanilla baseline). Innervate (6-minute cooldown) when you are low on mana (vanilla baseline). **For every spec:** - **Target priority:** in battlegrounds, peel for and heal flag carriers, and defend nodes ([Battleground role](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)). Beyond that, the sources give no druid-specific kill order. The usual rule is to kill the healer if you can lock them out, and otherwise the lowest-armor DPS (vanilla baseline). - **Reset / drink:** Travel Form out to reset ("going cheetah and running away") THICCNICK · 2025-10-13. Drink out of combat, and re-Prowl (Cat) before you re-engage (vanilla baseline). **Vs class** (full table in [Matchups](#/class/druid/balance-pvp)): - **Warrior:** root, kite, shift out of Hamstring, and Travel Form to reset. - **Rogue:** be in Bear when the opener lands, and trinket Kidney Shot. - **Shaman:** the hardest matchup. Purge strips HoTs, and Enhancement burst kills Cat. - **Paladin:** a losing matchup for Feral, because HoJ or Repentance locks you out of heals. - **Mage:** no Pounce opener. Balance can out-range Arcane. - **Warlock:** kill the pet, and avoid the Death Coil → fear → silence chain. Feral nearly always lands the opener on a warlock dindunuffinz · 2025-10-13. - **Priest / Hunter:** expect one-GCD dispels / full ranged pressure even with the pet slept.

extraSections.heading: Battleground role
extraSections.markdown: - **WSG flag carrier** (feral): Bear or normal Travel Form with the PvP set speed bonus; you cannot carry the flag in Swift Travel Form Meow · 2025-01-14. - **AB / AV:** defend and spin flags; "could turn the tides at any spot in AV" GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-02-16. - **Balance** in team fights, with good positioning, from range Lythany · 2026-03-21.

extraSections.heading: Races
extraSections.markdown: - **Tauren:** +5% Stamina and War Stomp (not usable in forms); Plainsrunning; the PvP min-max pick. "Stomp + Entangling Roots on a warrior/rogue, then Travel Form away" GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-03-14, Holydruid · 2026-02-17, ([Jammyxx, 2023-03-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36461#p36461)). - **Night Elf:** Shadowmeld also passively lowers enemy stealth detection while you Prowl Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-23. - **Moonkin Form can be Sapped;** Cat and Bear cannot Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-10-14.

extraSections.heading: Macros
extraSections.markdown: - Cancel a form: `/unshift` (not `/cancelform`) DrakeReinz · 2026-03-14. - Feral Charge into Bear: `/cast [noform:2] !Bear Form` / `/cast Feral Charge` (SuperWoW, Nampower, CleveRoid) poisonouscabbage · 2025-11-23. - One key for Growl (Bear), Prowl (Cat) and mouseover Entangling Roots (caster) Rahnd2137 · 2026-02-11. - Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch needs two presses; the client cannot cast both from one click Micro Jackson · 2025-12-19. - A travel macro: mount when standing still, Travel Form when moving or in combat, Aquatic Form when swimming Invadertim · 2025-09-16.

extraSections.heading: Honor
extraSections.markdown: - **Since 1.18.1 honor is a currency:** it is credited immediately and spent at vendors, and the weekly standings race is gone ([Jamey (staff), 2026-03-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169701#p169701)). The weekly cap is **20,000 honor** Dodging · 2026-03-28, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-28. - **Rank:** Rank Points decay each week, but your rank doesn't drop Grey · 2026-03-28, Floccumate · 2025-12-17. **Contested:** some players reported being de-ranked after 1.18.1 (see the PvP systems page). - **Weekly reset:** the night from Tuesday to Wednesday, EU time Pastor · 2025-10-25, Meow · 2025-10-29. Full rules (what gives honor, Rank Points, the PvP sets, Conquest, battlegrounds, Warmode): [PvP systems](#/pvp).

glance.recommendation: In battlegrounds play **Feral** (11/35/5 with Feral Charge, Feral Swiftness and Open Wounds) and fight with your **whole kit**: Cat for openers and bleeds, **Bear** the moment you are stunned or focused, caster form for HoTs and roots, Travel Form to reset. sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown: **Recommendation:** level as **Feral**. Take **Feral Swiftness** first for cat movement speed, then at **level 30** (Travel Form) **respec into Omen of Clarity** and continue down the Feral tree; take Furor last. "You can tank every leveling dungeon in this spec. If you equip int/spirit gear you can also heal them just fine" (the pinned, dev-endorsed advice) Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-09-04, Modwolf · 2026-02-28. Balance is a viable, slower alternative. Do not level as Restoration: "Leveling as resto sucks" Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-09-03. | Spec | Leveling | Why | |---|---|---| | **Feral** | **S** | Near-zero downtime, movement speed, tanks every dungeon Viertakt · 2025-10-14, Tephus · 2026-01-14; druid leveling is A-tier overall, "right behind hunter and warlock" Shardphoenix · 2026-03-27 | | **Balance** | **B** | Fun, strong with Moonkin Form + Hurricane at 30 Voodoo · 2026-02-16, but mana downtime: roughly half the speed of Feral per one player carricay · 2026-03-29, "never faster than feral" chincer · 2025-10-30 | | **Restoration** | **C** | Much slower; every spec heals dungeons with an Intellect set in the bags Holidae · 2025-10-31, 🎄⛄ Bapi⛄🎄 · 2026-02-24 |

sections.heading: Gameplay by level
sections.markdown: What to press at each level on the recommended **Feral** path, using the talent order above. Learn levels and costs come from the 1.18.1 game data. Your role changes with level: a caster from 1 to 9, **Bear** from 10, and **Cat** from 20, with Bear kept for packs and tanking. Heal with an Intellect set in your bags. A short [Balance path](#/class/druid/leveling) follows the brackets. ### Levels 1–9 **New now:** Wrath and Healing Touch Rank 1 are starting spells (vanilla baseline); L1 Mark of the Wild · L4 Moonfire, Rejuvenation · L6 Thorns, Wrath Rank 2 (1.7 s cast) · L8 Entangling Roots (1.5 s cast, outdoors only), Healing Touch Rank 2 (2 s cast). **Single target:** 1. Buff Mark of the Wild, and Thorns from level 6. 2. Pull with **`Wrath`** and keep casting it: "Before level 10, you should be casting Wrath almost exclusively" Bonjwa · 2025-10-05. 3. From level 4, cast **`Moonfire`** once per mob, or on one that flees. 4. Melee with your staff only when your mana is low Bonjwa · 2025-10-05. 5. From level 8, on a mob that hits hard: **`Entangling Roots`**, step out of melee range, Wrath, and re-root when it breaks. "Root the thing, hit the thing, repeat until dead" Micro Jackson · 2026-02-03. Roots work only outdoors Holidae · 2025-11-23. 6. Between pulls, Rejuvenation or Healing Touch yourself, then drink. These levels are "dreadful", so push to 10 for Bear Form chincer · 2025-10-05. **Multi-target:** avoid it. If a second mob joins, root one and Wrath the other (vanilla baseline). ### Levels 10–19 **New now:** L10 **Bear Form**, **Maul**, **Growl** (class quest), Demoralizing Roar, Rejuvenation Rank 2, Moonfire Rank 2; Ferocity talent 10-14 (cheaper Maul) · L12 **Enrage** (60 s cooldown), **Regrowth** Rank 1 · L14 **Bash**, Healing Touch Rank 3, Cure Poison (quest) · L15-17 Open Wounds (it pays off only from Cat Form at 20) · L16 **Swipe**, Rejuvenation Rank 3 · L18 Maul Rank 2, **Faerie Fire**, **Hibernate**, Regrowth Rank 2; Feral Instinct talent 18-19 (threat). The Bear Form quest mob hits hard: root it and hit it from range Micro Jackson · 2026-02-03. Then stay in Bear until 20. As a caster you "will be oom very often, literally after every 2-3 mobs" SilverWF · 2025-10-10. **Single target (Bear):** 1. Pull from range with **`Moonfire`** (or **`Faerie Fire`** from 18), then shift to **Bear Form** before the mob arrives Jizzie · 2025-10-15. 2. **`Enrage`** if you start with no rage (60 s cooldown). "Dont be scared to use rage cooldown" Dziadmroz · 2025-07-16. 3. **`Maul`** whenever you have the rage; it replaces your next swing and does not use the GCD Deekin Bearcat · 2023-04-27. 4. **`Bash`** to stop a caster's cast or a fleeing mob. Feral has no reliable snare Holidae · 2025-11-23. 5. After the kill, shift out, **`Rejuvenation`** or **`Regrowth`** yourself, then shift back Hassle · 2026-04-09. **Multi-target (2-3 mobs):** pull with Moonfire, shift to Bear, **`Demoralizing Roar`**, then from 16 **`Swipe`** and tab-target Maul ([Chev03, 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165791#p165791)). Swipe hits at most 3 targets, so do not pull more than 3 Myrmer · 2026-03-07. Before 16, pull one or two at a time. **Tanking (dungeons):** - **Form and gear:** Bear Form in your normal leather questing gear; bear and cat gear overlap completely while leveling Hassle · 2026-04-08. - **Pull:** Regrowth yourself, Moonfire one mob, Faerie Fire another, shift to Bear, Swipe and Maul, then Demoralizing Roar Jizzie · 2025-10-15. Healing yourself before the pull gives you threat on every mob you enter combat with Dziadmroz · 2025-07-16. - **Opening threat:** Demoralizing Roar for a little threat on the whole pack, then skull-mark and Maul your main target GolgothaTheGreen · 2025-12-30, Dziadmroz · 2025-07-16. - **Steady threat:** tab through the pack with Maul, and Swipe once you have it. **Contested:** "Early game swipe is honestly more threat than maul. You're rage starved" Stunfisk · 2025-10-18, and a Maul opener "cripples your rage income" Stunfisk · 2025-11-12. Dziadmroz says Maul mostly and Swipe to burn extra rage until you have the rage-on-crit talent Dziadmroz · 2025-07-16. - **Taunt:** **`Growl`** only to take a mob back. It does nothing on a mob with no threat list, so never open with it Micro Jackson · 2025-10-28. It is off the GCD; save it for the mob that someone pulls off you Tephus · 2025-10-27. - **Defense:** Enrage adds damage taken; skip it when your healer struggles Habu · 2026-02-28. Hibernate a Beast add (Beasts and Dragonkin only; vanilla baseline). Bash interrupts. - **When:** Deadmines is tankable and healable from level 10 Micro Jackson · 2026-01-09. Wailing Caverns is rough before Swipe. **Contested:** the 1.18.1 data has Swipe at 16; one player says to wait for level 20 Stunfisk · 2025-11-24. A DPS two levels above you will pull threat anyway, so leveling threat talents change little fakeRR · 2026-02-28. **Healing (dungeons):** - Carry an Intellect set and swap into it; no Restoration talents are needed Holidae · 2025-10-29, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2026-02-12. - Default: your highest **Rejuvenation** on the tank first. If they keep taking damage, your second-highest **Regrowth**. For small dips, rank-1 **Healing Touch**. If the tank keeps dropping, your second-highest Healing Touch. Max rank is rarely needed Voodoo · 2025-11-20. - Ranks learned before level 20 take a large healing-power penalty, which matters once you wear +healing gear Micro Jackson · 2026-01-05. - **Cure Poison** from 14. Mana: regen restarts 5 s after your last cast (the 5-second rule; vanilla baseline), so drink between pulls instead of topping up full-health players. ### Levels 20–29 **New now:** L20 **Cat Form**, **Claw** (45 energy), **Rip**, **Prowl**, Insect Swarm, Starfire, Rebirth, Healing Touch Rank 4 (3 s cast); Feral Swiftness talent 20-21 · L22 **Shred** (60 energy), Rejuvenation Rank 4; **Feral Charge** talent (22) · L23-25 Sharpened Claws · L24 **Rake**, **Ferocious Bite**, **Tiger's Fury**, Regrowth Rank 3, Swipe Rank 2, Remove Curse · L25 **Faerie Fire (Feral)** (no cost) · L26 Dash, Maul Rank 3, Healing Touch Rank 5; **Blood Frenzy** talent 26-27 · L28 **Challenging Roar** (10-minute cooldown), Claw and Rip Rank 2, Cower, Rejuvenation Rank 5; Predatory Strikes 28-29. From 20, Cat is your main form drago · 2025-12-09. Energy ticks 20 every 2 s Lyrazia · 2025-05-22. **Single target (Cat):** 1. Pull with **`Insect Swarm`** or Moonfire, or walk in with **`Prowl`**. Insect Swarm costs less and lowers the mob's chance to hit you Xeede · 2025-10-15. **`Faerie Fire (Feral)`** is the common ranged pull Habu · 2026-02-28. 2. From 26 (Blood Frenzy): **`Tiger's Fury`** before the pull and whenever it drops. It is off the GCD Tephus · 2026-01-20. Before the talent, skip it: "Without talent this skill is like not existing" Dziadmroz · 2025-12-26. 3. From 24: **`Rake`**. 4. **`Claw`** to build combo points. 5. **`Rip`** early, at 1-2 combo points, on mobs that die fast. "If I wait until 3-4 the mob is pretty much dead" Roy · 2026-03-31. Rip at 5 only on tougher mobs Micro Jackson · 2025-11-10. 6. **`Claw`** until the mob dies. At these levels ignore combo points; Ferocious Bite is "not worth" the energy `'Betkins · 2026-02-03. Bite only if it finishes the mob Moonchase · 2026-05-25. 7. In a group, behind the mob: **`Shred`** instead of Claw TwoAcross · 2026-04-03. Bleed-immune mob: Shred, and Bite at 3-4 combo points poisonouscabbage · 2026-02-03. 8. **Runners:** Feral Charge (from Bear) or Bash Holidae · 2025-11-23. 9. **Rest:** you regain mana while in Cat Form, so shift out, heal and shift back; drinking is rarely needed Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. **Multi-target:** Cat has no AoE Koae · 2026-01-14. With 2-3 mobs, pull with a DoT, shift to **Bear**, Swipe and tab-Maul. "Bear's safer, but cat is quicker", so pick per pull Arcomage · 2024-10-11. **Tanking:** Same as above, plus: - **Pre-pull (from 26):** Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Cat Form, **Tiger's Fury**, Bear Form, about 10 s before the pull FeerZero · 2026-02-15. The Blood Frenzy haste stays through the shift into Bear Comentor · 2025-12-01. - **Faerie Fire (Feral)** on the pull and on loose adds Sagesse · 2026-04-07. - **Feral Charge** (from 22) interrupts casters and closes the gap to the next pack Hassle · 2026-03-03. It makes no threat, so do not pull with it Holidae · 2025-10-29. - **Challenging Roar** (28): the emergency when a whole pack runs at the healer. Its 10-minute cooldown makes it once per dungeon (vanilla baseline). At 60 tanks macro it with a Limited Invulnerability Potion Sagesse · 2025-08-31. - To finish a single mob once threat is safe, shift to Cat and Shred Micro Jackson · 2025-12-01. **Healing:** Same as above, plus Healing Touch Rank 4 (20) as your main spammable heal. Healing Touch Rank 4 with your best Rejuvenation is "perfectly fine pre-40" FishyFish ><((('> · 2025-05-01. You can keep casting it "pretty much forever with normal mana regen" Arcomage · 2025-01-31. **Rebirth** (20) works only out of form Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-01-13. **Remove Curse** from 24. ### Levels 30–39 **New now:** L30 **respec for Omen of Clarity** (see the talent order), **Travel Form**, Tranquility, Regrowth Rank 4, Shred Rank 2, Bash Rank 2 · L32 Ravage, Ferocious Bite Rank 2, Healing Touch Rank 6; Feral Charge back (32) · L33-35 Sharpened Claws · L34 Maul Rank 4, Rake Rank 2, Swipe Rank 3, Rejuvenation Rank 6 · L36 **Pounce** (50 energy, from Prowl), **Frenzied Regeneration**, Rip Rank 3, Tiger's Fury Rank 2, Regrowth Rank 5; Blood Frenzy back 36-37 · L38 Claw and Shred Rank 3, Healing Touch Rank 7, Hibernate Rank 2; Predatory Strikes 38-40. After the respec, Blood Frenzy is gone until 36, so Tiger's Fury is not worth pressing from 30 to 35. **Omen of Clarity** is passive and procs on about 10% of hits Tephus · 2026-03-03. **Single target (Cat):** 1. From 36 (Blood Frenzy and Pounce): **`Prowl`** → **`Tiger's Fury`** → **`Pounce`** → **`Faerie Fire (Feral)`** → **`Rake`** → Claw → **`Rip`** → Claw → Bite TwoAcross · 2026-04-03. "Once u get Rip, Rake and Pounce, u get 90%+ Claw damage" chongers · 2025-11-30. 2. Before 36: Faerie Fire (Feral) → Rake → Claw → Rip → Claw, as in 20-29. 3. **Clearcasting** (Omen): spend it on Shred if you are behind the mob, otherwise Claw ([Captain4k, 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907)), Medvedev · 2025-10-15. 4. Rip at 1-4 combo points on fast-dying mobs, 5 on tough ones Mr. Berold · 2026-03-31. 5. Faerie Fire (Feral) also procs Omen Sendorin · 2025-11-17. **Multi-target:** Same as above. In Bear, Omen procs give you free Swipes ([Captain4k, 2026-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165907#p165907)). **Tanking:** Same as above, plus: "When you get the swipe skill and omen of Clarity its a chill breeze" Stunfisk · 2026-04-07. Spend Clearcasting on Swipe or Maul. Frenzied Regeneration (36) heals little since its PvP nerf Dexter Syphex · 2024-11-18. **Healing:** Same as above, plus: - **Omen** is your mana plan: a Clearcasting proc makes the next Healing Touch or Regrowth free. "Omen is your way to free cast" Valarya · 2026-03-19. Only direct casts proc it, not HoT ticks Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-01-22. - **Sylvan Blessing** (in the 30 respec) triggers only on your own killing blow, so finish nearly dead mobs with Moonfire Voodoo · 2025-11-28. - **Tranquility** (30, 750 mana) heals the whole party when everyone is low; you must shift out of form to cast it Breaddy · 2025-04-12. ### Levels 40–49 **New now:** L40 **Dire Bear Form**, **Innervate** (6-minute cooldown), Hurricane, Ferocious Bite Rank 3, Rejuvenation Rank 7, Tranquility Rank 2 · L41-42 **Ancient Brutality** (bleed ticks refund energy) · L42 Maul Rank 5, Faerie Fire (Feral) Rank 3, Regrowth Rank 6 · L43-44 **Primal Fury** (extra combo point, and rage, on crits) · L44 **Barkskin** (60 s cooldown), **Barkskin (Feral)** (10-minute cooldown), Rake Rank 3, Rip Rank 4, Swipe Rank 4, Healing Touch Rank 8 · L45 **Berserk** talent (6-minute cooldown) · L46 Shred Rank 4, Pounce Rank 2, Rejuvenation Rank 8; Heart of the Wild 46-50 · L48 Claw Rank 4, Ferocious Bite Rank 4, Tiger's Fury Rank 3, Regrowth Rank 7. **Single target:** Same as above. With Ancient Brutality, "rake-rip-spam claw" is the whole loop Silenced · 2026-03-31. With Primal Fury, a crit while building gives an extra combo point Ingham · 2026-02-11. **Multi-target:** Same as above. **Tanking:** Same as above, in **Dire Bear Form**, plus: - **Barkskin** (60 s): cast it in caster form before you shift. The buff stays in Bear Form, at the cost of 20% attack speed Micro Jackson · 2026-04-01, Micro Jackson · 2025-10-28. Use it before a hard pull. - **Barkskin (Feral)** (10 minutes) is your emergency button Micro Jackson · 2026-01-27. - **Berserk** (45) is your fear break Comentor · 2026-01-19. - After the rage-on-crit talent, "mix Maul+Swipe and cycle targets when swiping 3+ mobs" Dziadmroz · 2025-07-16. - **Innervate** your healer when they run dry. **Healing:** Same as above, plus **Innervate** (40) on yourself when low; with high Spirit it gives "100% mana regen for 15 seconds" Micro Jackson · 2026-01-26. How long untalented healing holds up is **contested**: "until around LvL 45" Valarya · 2026-03-19, "until 50+" Silenced · 2026-04-09, or "until 60 dungeons" Hassle · 2026-04-14. ### Levels 50–60 **New now:** L50 Healing Touch Rank 9, Maul Rank 6, Tranquility Rank 3, Rebirth Rank 4 · L51-52 **Carnage** (Ferocious Bite refreshes your bleeds) · L52 Rip Rank 5, Rejuvenation Rank 9, Barkskin (Feral) Rank 2 · L53 Leader of the Pack · L54 Rake Rank 4, Shred Rank 5, Swipe Rank 5, Regrowth Rank 8; Feral Swiftness 54-55 · L55 the **Wolfshead head enchant** quest (energy and rage on shift) Yoshi 🌵 · 2026-03-26 · L56 Ferocious Bite Rank 5, Healing Touch Rank 10; **Furor** 56-60 · L58 **Savage Bite** (30 rage, 6 s cooldown), Maul Rank 7, Claw Rank 5, Rejuvenation Rank 10 · L60 Rip Rank 6, Tiger's Fury Rank 4, Regrowth Rank 9; **Reshift** (level 60 per players Hassle · 2025-10-06; the game data gives it no learn level); Swift Travel Form questline. **Single target (Cat):** 1. Tiger's Fury → Rake → Rip → Claw to 5 combo points → **`Ferocious Bite`**, which refreshes both bleeds Aircyy · 2025-11-01. 2. With Furor and the Wolfshead enchant, a shift back into Cat Form gives up to 60 energy Copperage · 2026-01-11. At 60, **`Reshift`** when you are under 30 energy, no tick is due and Tiger's Fury has under 3 s left. Recast Tiger's Fury after it Littlechurch · 2026-03-10. 3. From here, follow [Feral Cat: How to play](#/class/druid/feral-melee-dps). **Multi-target:** Same as above. **Tanking:** Same as above, plus Savage Bite: 1. **Pre-pull:** Cat → Tiger's Fury → Bear. Furor and the head enchant give about 15 rage per shift Dziadmroz · 2026-02-15. Add a Mighty Rage Potion on big pulls, and **Berserk** once Blood Frenzy ends Leido · 2026-04-01. 2. **`Maul`** always. 3. **`Swipe`** if more than 2 mobs, or when rage is full. 4. **`Savage Bite`** above 50 rage Micro Jackson · 2026-04-08. Maul, Swipe and Savage Bite do not share a GCD Medvedev · 2025-11-08. 5. **Black Morass** (60) is a gear check: Hibernate one mob in each 3- and 4-mob pack, since they apply −50% armor, bleeds and stuns Dziadmroz · 2026-01-12, Hassle · 2026-01-12. At 60, see [Feral Bear: How to play](#/class/druid/feral-tank). **Healing:** Same as above. Max-rank Healing Touch gives more healing per mana than HoTs at leveling gear levels Micro Jackson · 2026-03-19. At 60, respec to [Restoration](#/class/druid/restoration-healer) to heal raids. ### Balance path by bracket For the Balance talent order above. **Cure Poison** from 14. Mana: regen restarts 5 s after your last cast (the 5-second rule; vanilla baseline), so drink between pulls instead of topping up full-health players.

**Pre-pull (from 26):** Regrowth, Rejuvenation, Cat Form, **Tiger's Fury**, Bear Form, about 10 s before the pull FeerZero · 2026-02-15. The Blood Frenzy haste stays through the shift into Bear Comentor · 2025-12-01.
**Faerie Fire (Feral)** on the pull and on loose adds Sagesse · 2026-04-07.
**Feral Charge** (from 22) interrupts casters and closes the gap to the next pack Hassle · 2026-03-03. It makes no threat, so do not pull with it Holidae · 2025-10-29.

**Challenging Roar** (28): the emergency when a whole pack runs at the healer. Its 10-minute cooldown makes it once per dungeon (vanilla baseline). At 60 tanks macro it with a Limited Invulnerability Potion Sagesse · 2025-08-31.
To finish a single mob once threat is safe, shift to Cat and Shred Micro Jackson · 2025-12-01.

**Omen** is your mana plan: a Clearcasting proc makes the next Healing Touch or Regrowth free. "Omen is your way to free cast" Valarya · 2026-03-19. Only direct casts proc it, not HoT ticks Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-01-22.
**Sylvan Blessing** (in the 30 respec) triggers only on your own killing blow, so finish nearly dead mobs with Moonfire Voodoo · 2025-11-28.
**Tranquility** (30, 750 mana) heals the whole party when everyone is low; you must shift out of form to cast it Breaddy · 2025-04-12.

**Barkskin** (60 s): cast it in caster form before you shift. The buff stays in Bear Form, at the cost of 20% attack speed Micro Jackson · 2026-04-01, Micro Jackson · 2025-10-28. Use it before a hard pull.
**Barkskin (Feral)** (10 minutes) is your emergency button Micro Jackson · 2026-01-27.
**Berserk** (45) is your fear break Comentor · 2026-01-19.
After the rage-on-crit talent, "mix Maul+Swipe and cycle targets when swiping 3+ mobs" Dziadmroz · 2025-07-16.
**Innervate** your healer when they run dry.

sections.heading: The kill loop (Cat)
sections.markdown: Bot-ready, for a single mob: 1. From range, optionally **`Moonfire`** or **`Insect Swarm`** to pull (Insect Swarm is cheaper and lowers the mob's hit chance) Xeede · 2025-10-15. 2. **`Prowl`** → **`Tiger's Fury`** → **`Pounce`** (once learned) → **`Faerie Fire (Feral)`** → **`Rake`** TwoAcross · 2026-04-03. 3. **`Claw`** until 1-2 combo points on a fast-dying mob, or to 5 on a tougher one, then **`Rip`** Mr. Berold · 2026-03-31, TwoAcross · 2026-04-03. 4. **`Claw`** to 5 combo points; **`Ferocious Bite`** if it will finish the mob, otherwise keep Clawing Moonchase · 2026-05-25. At low level ignore combo points: Rake + Claw, since Bite costs too much energy `'Betkins · 2026-02-03. 5. **Behind the mob** (grouped), use **`Shred`** instead of Claw TwoAcross · 2026-04-03. 6. **Bleed-immune mob:** Shred + Ferocious Bite at 5 combo points poisonouscabbage · 2026-02-03. 7. **Low HP after the fight:** shift out, **`Rejuvenation`/`Regrowth`**, shift back. Nature's Grasp is rarely needed Hassle · 2026-04-09. **Two or three mobs:** pull with a DoT, shift to **Bear**, **Swipe** and tab-Maul ([Chev03, 2026-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=165791#p165791)). Bear is safer, cat is quicker Arcomage · 2024-10-11. Feral has no reliable slow for fleeing mobs: use Bash, Feral Charge, or kill them fast Holidae · 2025-11-23. **Downtime:** you regenerate mana in form, so heal, shift back and keep going Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. Sylvan Blessing's 15 s of full regen after a killing blow also works in form Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-02-04, Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-02-04.

sections.heading: The kill loop (Balance)
sections.markdown: 1. Open with **`Starfire`**, then **`Wrath`, `Wrath`** Voodoo · 2026-03-18. 2. On harder mobs: Starfire → Moonfire → **`Entangling Roots`** → Insect Swarm, let the DoTs tick, finish with Wrath or Starfire. Recast Moonfire only on an Omen proc JTK · 2024-12-07. 3. Use rank-1 Entangling Roots and rank-1 Moonfire for mana efficiency while farming Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-03-18. 4. Melee between casts with Omen of Clarity and Natural Weapons to regain mana Lyrazia · 2025-04-15. 5. With 2/2 Sylvan Blessing and 1/3 Owlkin Frenzy you "never go OoM" while farming open-world mobs Yoshi 🌵 · 2026-03-19. Before level 30 a Balance leveler still swaps to Cat or Bear when mana runs low Conchim · 2026-04-12.

sections.heading: Swift Travel Form (level 60)
sections.markdown: A 100% speed outdoor travel form, separate from normal Travel Form. It has a 3 s cast, no combat or indoor use, and mount-speed items do not affect it, so it is slower than an enchanted mount Holidae · 2025-10-23, 𝔅𝔩𝔢𝔰𝔦𝔰𝔦 · 2026-02-16. It also unlocks a stag glyph for normal Travel Form, lets you carry a party member ("Ride of the Wild"), and lets you gather herbs without shifting Holidae · 2025-10-23, Floatin · 2026-04-14. It cannot carry the WSG flag Meow · 2025-01-14. Questline (dev-posted, 2025-01) Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-01-04, with difficulty notes Ginbear/Orangered · 2025-02-05: 1. **Mount Hyjal In Turmoil:** speak with Loganaar in Moonglade, travel to Nordanaar. Easy. 2. **Shadowed Spectre:** investigate west of Darkhollow Pass, Hyjal. Easy. 3. **The Son of Cenarius:** 20 Bright Dream Shards to Keeper Remulos, western Moonglade. Shards drop from satyrs near Nordanaar (shared loot) Holidae · 2026-03-19. 4. **Tethered Memories:** Bough of Cenarius (Dreamstalker, Bough Shadow, Ashenvale), Crystalline Ray of Moonlight (Venethas, cave north of Everlook), Jade Scale of the Dreamer (Solnius, [Emerald Sanctum](#/instances/emerald-sanctum) raid). The Emerald Sanctum must be open on your realm Wawds · 2025-11-02. 5. **The White Stag:** kill the Spectre (~150k HP, ~3,000 melee hits, a long-range Shadow Bolt Volley, a knockback near a cliff, an AoE fear). Bring shamans for Tremor Totem (doable with under 10 people with them) and drag it uphill away from the cliff faces Viertakt · 2026-02-19, Modwolf · 2026-03-06. 6. **Woven Dreams:** 10 Viridian Mushrooms (Jademir Lake, Feralas), 10 Dreamhide, 6 Dreamthread, 20 Greater Dreamless Sleep Potions. The expensive step: about 300-600g, cheaper with guild crafters Izhan · 2025-01-14. 7. **The Eternal Sleeper:** Seradane, Hinterlands. Hits very hard; kite with a friend Ginbear/Orangered · 2025-02-05. 8. **Under the Vibrant Moonlight:** Twilight Grove, Duskwood. Root and nuke from range with a group Ginbear/Orangered · 2025-02-05. **Solo dragon challenge (Rethevus / Dreamer's Challenge, Moonglade):** by 2026 players describe a solo fight in this chain Eepyman · 2026-03-25, Modwolf · 2026-03-18. Three methods work: - **Caster (easiest):** Sleep the helper add (it makes the dragon CC-immune), Root the dragon, line-of-sight its faerie, and kill the darter adds while standing on them for health and mana. Dispel poison and curse at once (the curse stuns for ~8 s). **Never use DoTs.** Nuke with ~6 Wraths only while it sleeps after an enrage, then re-root and re-sleep Micro Jackson · 2025-10-16, 𝓜𝓲𝓭𝓸𝓴𝓸 ฅ₍^◕ᴥ◕^₎ฅ · 2025-08-17. Expect about 10-14 minutes, 2 Innervates and 2 mana potions Modwolf · 2026-03-18, Koalafurieux - BUFF BOOMIES · 2025-09-10. - **Rank-1 Wrath ticks:** root, sleep and chip it with rank-1 Wraths akitoe · 2026-03-18. - **Bear:** face-tank it with ~10% lifesteal gear, Carnage and a stack of Poison Resistance elixirs (or a shaman's Poison Cleansing Totem) Livin · 2025-08-20, Holydruid · 2026-03-18. **Ride of the Wild bug:** to be carried, the passenger must put **you** on their Ignore list Astrasa · 2026-03-15, Micro Jackson · 2026-03-04. A passenger takes full fall damage Rielke · 2026-02-23.

gear.about: Gear recommendations for Druid (Balance ranged DPS, Feral melee DPS, Feral tank, Restoration healer) by spec/role and level bracket, with where-to-obtain, built from the Druid forum (f42), the Itemization forum's relic list and 1.18.1 changelog, and the existing class playbooks' "Gear, enchants and consumables" sections. Like every other class read for this series, no maintained Turtle-specific pre-raid or raid BiS list exists for any Druid spec/role; the strongest source found is a single level-49 "twink" gear list for Balance (leveling-30-49), which is unusually complete.
caveats: No pre-raid or raid BiS list exists for any Druid spec/role in the sources. "Balance gear is nonexistent" (t5704, 2023) is a representative thread title; the reply consensus is that leveling caster gear with actual spellpower is rare for every class, not uniquely absent for Druid, but that Balance-specific leather+spellpower gear barely exists before Molten Core/Tier 1.

Item IDs are filled only where a post links database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N (Turtle's own item database), which is the case for nearly every item in the leveling-30-49 Balance list (t16360) and the relic list (t8229).

The leveling-30-49 Balance list is explicitly a level-49 twink list (a character parked below 50 for a fixed PvP/dungeon bracket, not a leveling-through-49 progression list) — it names the BiS ceiling for that bracket, not a route to reach it.

Faction-mirrored items (an Alliance version and a Horde version of the same conceptual reward) are recorded as the source wrote them; only one faction's item is kept as the primary entry per slot where both exist, to control file size — the other faction's exact name is in the equivalent bracket note or omitted; see gaps.

Restoration's pvp-60 bracket below is built directly from a single General/Druid-forum thread (t19402) that is NOT reflected in synthesis/classes/druid/restoration-pvp.md (that playbook file has no Gear section at all) — flagged as a primary-source addition beyond what the existing playbooks captured.

gearMarkdown.heading: Gaps
gearMarkdown.markdown:
- No pre-raid-60 gear item list exists for Feral DPS, Feral tank (beyond one trinket), or Restoration; only Balance has a rich leveling list (twink-specific, not a leveling route) and a discussion thread naming crafted/dungeon options rather than a ranked list.
- The Kara40 armor-ignoring trinket nerfed in 1.18.1 (Feral DPS) is never named in the sources that discuss it.
- "Smoking Heart of the Mountain" was asked about as a possible Feral tank trinket but never confirmed or denied.
- The level-29 twink PvP gear list for Feral Druid, Hunter and Rogue ([t22403](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=22403)) names every item only via raw `database.turtlecraft.gg/?item=N` links with no item names in the post text — unusable without a live database lookup; not included above.
- "That new Wailing Caverns idol?" appears in the leveling-30-49 Balance list as an open question with no name resolved.
- No enchant list exists for any Druid spec/role beyond the single Wolfshead Helm mention for Feral and the leveling-30-49 Balance thread's unanswered enchant question.
- No raid-t1 or raid-t3.5 gear exists for Feral tank, and no raid-tier gear at all exists for Restoration beyond the T3.5 set-bonus design complaint (not a gear recommendation).
- Faction-mirrored item names in the leveling-30-49 Balance list are not reproduced in full above; see [t16360](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=16360) directly for both factions' exact names.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown: What the sources do not settle: 1. **Feral stat weights.** Nobody produced Turtle-correct numbers; haste and Strength-vs-Agility stay contested Micro Jackson · 2025-11-28, Micro Jackson · 2026-04-17. 2. **Bleed-immune bosses in MC and Naxx.** Counts disagree (3 of 12 vs "half" of MC; "all Naxx bleeds" vs KT/Sapphiron/Golems immune) Mootant · 2026-03-27, Medvedev · 2026-01-16, Hassle · 2026-01-26. 3. **Bear vs paladin/warrior after 1.18.1.** No log aggregation; field reports range from "barely noticed" to "the first 10 seconds are a nightmare" Fikey · 2026-03-22, Sha · 2026-03-24. 4. **Balance post-patch rotation.** Pure Wrath spam vs Starfire-in-Arcane was not settled by logs Cowmoohflage/Arrowgance · 2026-03-21, Tyrona · 2026-04-04. 5. **Efflorescence.** Whether the HoT-overwrite heal still needs Tree Form Dreamwind · 2026-04-05, Valarya · 2026-02-01. 6. **Arcane resistance for Anomalus.** 100 to 225+ are all reported Hotverdomme-Nord · 2026-04-02, Habu · 2026-04-10. 7. **No full pre-raid BiS list** for Balance or Restoration in text form; the channel points to external sheets (Angrycat, Krokat, Bapi's guide) Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2025-09-03. 8. **Resto enchants per slot** are only in Bapi's guide, which is not quoted in the sources. 9. **Endorsed PvP point lists** exist only for Balance (Midoko) and a hybrid (Modwolf); the feral PvP build here is assembled from advice. Per-spec PvP dampening values are unknown Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-04-09. 10. **The Swift Travel Form solo challenge.** When the Moonglade dragon fight was added to the questline, and its exact place in the chain, is not stated Eepyman · 2026-03-25. 11. **Sylvan Blessing's current tooltip.** A late-2025 rework to a stacking proc was reported Voodoo · 2025-11-06, but a January 2026 screenshot shows the killing-blow version Micro Jackson · 2026-01-28. 12. **Late changes before the server's end.** Undocumented armor/threat shifts reported in May 2026 are unconfirmed Astrasa · 2026-05-27; prototype talents shown in April were never implemented Fat Pibble with Air Pods · 2026-04-18.

guidePages.title: Druid professions
guidePages.intro: **Recommendation:** start with **two gathering professions**, because crafting is a money sink early on Micro Jackson · 2026-03-15. **Herbalism** is the druid's natural gathering skill: you can pick herbs without leaving (Swift) Travel Form Floatin · 2026-04-14, Lyrazia · 2024-11-14. At 60, most druids run **Herbalism + Alchemy**, which saves gold on consumables and gives healers their mana potions Tephus · 2025-11-06, Moss Treader · 2026-01-14. **Engineering** is the only profession with unique raid tools, and it suits **Balance and Restoration**. It is a poor fit for **ferals**: bombs and sappers do not work in Cat or Bear Form DrakeReinz · 2026-03-24, Micro Jackson · 2026-03-10. No profession has a must-have druid-only BiS item, so beyond Engineering, choose for gold or convenience Robo Cop · 2024-11-17, Tephus · 2025-11-06.

sections.heading: What each profession gives a druid
sections.markdown: ### Herbalism - Herb from Travel or Swift Travel Form without shifting out Floatin · 2026-04-14. "Dual box herbing is my most gold/hour" Micro Jackson · 2025-10-06. - You can track only one node type at a time, so Herbalism + Mining means switching tracking constantly Micro Jackson · 2025-10-06. - Herbs keep their value because every flask needs a Black Lotus Ethere · 2025-12-06. Low-level herbs are "crazy cheap", though; copper from Mining earns more early Comentor · 2025-12-06. - **Contested:** in January 2026, one veteran dropped Herbalism on two characters. By then "every herb is a couple of silver, and Black Lotus is 18g with 4% drop chance" Micro Jackson · 2026-01-08, Micro Jackson · 2026-01-08. By April, Dreamfoil and Golden Sansam were "back to like 1g each" Eepyman · 2026-04-08. Check your server's prices. ### Alchemy - The raid-consumable profession. It "stays valuable/relevant untill lategame" Viertakt · 2026-02-14, and healers get mana potions from it Moss Treader · 2026-01-14. - Alchemy (or Leatherworking) gives you daily cooldowns and cheaper self-made consumables poisonouscabbage · 2026-01-08. - **Swift Travel Form** needs Greater Dreamless Sleep Potions among its materials. The whole questline costs about 300-600g in items Izhan · 2025-01-14, Molti · 2025-03-04. ### Engineering - It is the one profession with unique raid tools, and some call it "the best profession by a mile" Tephus · 2025-11-06, DrakeReinz · 2026-03-24. - **Forms:** Engineering items work in Moonkin and Tree Form, not in Cat or Bear Form Micro Jackson · 2026-03-10. A grenade thrown in Bear Form does nothing, although the patch notes claimed otherwise Hedda · 2025-10-25. Sappers take you out of Bear Form Coxy · 2026-02-17. **Contested:** one feral says "there is alot of good stuff you can use in and out of form", with only sappers needing you to leave form Viertakt · 2025-11-29. - For ferals, the use is grenades on the pull and the **Gnomish Battle Chicken** haste buff for you and your party Medvedev · 2025-11-01, Medvedev · 2025-10-25. Hardcore players value its bombs and target dummies Micro Jackson · 2025-11-12. ### Leatherworking - One player calls it "the most valuable for us, regardless of spec" Melqart · 2025-10-06. The later consensus is that it has little late-game value and makes little gold. **Tribal** is the pick for convenient gear and kits while leveling and early at 60 Tephus · 2026-01-27, Tephus · 2026-01-27. - The leather gear you can craft from your own kills runs "always about 15 levels below you" Koae · 2026-01-03. Casters get little from it until around level 32 chincer · 2025-11-20. - **Elemental Leatherworking** (a Turtle specialisation) crafts the **Convergence of the Elements** leggings, which are "extra good". The recipe is not trivial to get Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09, Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. Cat players also rate the crafted **Flamewrath Leggings** "by alot" the best piece of their set Lyrazia · 2025-10-23. - There are BoP recipes for Emerald Sanctum pieces Comentor · 2026-03-24. Swift Travel Form also needs Dreamhide, a pattern many consider otherwise useless Izhan · 2025-01-14. - **Buy instead:** Devilsaur leather sells well at first, but the market crashes fast; flipping the raw leather beat crafting it Holidae · 2025-11-03, Holidae · 2025-11-03. Devilsaur Leggings are the only Devilsaur piece cats rate Zotnar · 2025-07-24. ### Jewelcrafting (Turtle-custom) - Jewelcrafters can enchant rings and necklaces Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. Anyone can apply these enchants for you, as with Enchanting GolgothaTheGreen · 2026-03-14. - Mining + Jewelcrafting gets you "a few BoP BiS rings" poisonouscabbage · 2026-01-08. Resto can buy a crafted healer ring instead; it takes a +12 healing enchant Outrage · 2026-01-02, Micro Jackson · 2026-02-17. - Among specialisations, "it's gemology all the way"; nobody reported anything positive about Goldsmithing (single source) Micro Jackson · 2025-09-16. - Leveling it takes a lot of copper; you need Mining or must buy the ore on the AH chincer · 2025-11-13, Habu · 2026-03-07. ### Blacksmithing - Blacksmiths make **belt buckles** Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. Ferals use the +10 Strength buckle Micro Jackson · 2025-11-27. For Resto, the 8 healing power buckle is "like 50% better" than the 10 Intellect one Micro Jackson · 2026-02-23. You can buy the buckles; you do not need the profession. - A Blacksmithing trinket gives fear immunity for feral PvP (single source) Shardphoenix · 2026-03-28. ### Tailoring and Enchanting - **Tailoring:** Gloves of Spell Mastery last a Balance druid until AQ40 (pre-1.18.1 list) Verdict · 2024-12-15. Dreamthread for Swift Travel Form is another Tailoring pattern few people learn Izhan · 2025-01-14. - **Enchanting:** a steady leveling income, because you can disenchant outgrown gear at any skill level Holidae · 2025-11-23. Enchanting + Jewelcrafting is also suggested as a pair poisonouscabbage · 2026-01-08. ### Survival and Gardening (secondary professions) - **Before 1.18.1:** Survival tents gave rested XP. One player called tent-camping the fastest way to level Koae · 2026-01-04. Resto players "tree-punched" for mana with a Survival lantern and the BoED dagger: the lantern's melee zap triggered the dagger's shadow damage and mana return. The lantern was a high-level Survival craft ("125 or so iirc") Comentor · 2026-03-19, Comentor · 2026-03-19. The official list describes the **Repaired Electro-Lantern** as "+4 Spirit ... adds a zap to melee attacks" ([official site, Survival & Gardening](https://turtlecraft.gg/survival-and-gardening)). - **1.18.1 rework:** Survival got 80+ new recipes. These include slowing, rooting and trapping tools, bags for the three gathering professions, and Woodcutting ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). A skill-300 crafted sickle raises the chance of finding Black Lotus, which matters to herbalists ([Birtha (player), 2026-03-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171974#p171974)). Tents are now capped at 25% rested ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). - The rework reset progress. After 1.18.1, a feral farming the dagger said he now had to "level survival to get the ton berry lantern", and was told that leveling Survival "is worse than it was before" Hassle · 2026-04-01, Modwolf · 2026-04-01. - **Gardening:** the druid channel says nothing druid-specific about it. See the [Professions overview](#/professions).

sections.heading: When to pick up and swap
sections.markdown: 1. **Level 1-60:** two gathering professions, such as Herbalism + Skinning or Herbalism + Mining Micro Jackson · 2026-03-15, Micro Jackson · 2026-02-18. If you take Leatherworking for kits and armor, plan to drop it later Viertakt · 2026-02-14. For a leveling bear, Leatherworking against Alchemy makes a "negligible difference" Comentor · 2026-03-24, Stunfisk · 2026-03-24. 2. **At 60:** keep Herbalism and add **Alchemy**. On Balance or Resto, take **Engineering** instead if you want its raid tools Afraido · 2025-12-24, Micro Jackson · 2026-03-10. 3. Run cooldown crafts such as Mooncloth, Arcanite Bar and Cured Rugged Hide on alts rather than your main Habu · 2026-04-05, Viertakt · 2026-02-14. No skill thresholds are stated in the druid sources.

sections.heading: Race interactions
sections.markdown: Only Tauren and Night Elves can be druids. Tauren have the Cultivation racial (vanilla baseline), which one player wanted to use by taking Herbalism + Alchemy El Don · 2023-04-06. A joke claims Tauren females and Night Elves are "bis" for ZG mining runs Holydruid · 2026-03-14. The sources name no other race-profession interaction for druids. Racials are covered in the [Class overview](#/class/druid).

sections.heading: Gold
sections.markdown: - Gathering professions pay very well on Nordanaar Micro Jackson · 2025-10-20. - **ZG mining runs in Stealth** at 60 are "a decent gold source" Habu · 2026-03-07, Holydruid · 2026-03-14. - Druids "can't cheese much content". Un'Goro fire elementals are a workable general-purpose farm. Dire Maul lashers are immune to Nature damage, so Thorns and Moonfire do not work on them Aecheur · 2026-03-28, Aecheur · 2026-03-28. - Herbing lashers has no competition, but a druid does it much worse than a hunter, mage or paladin Hassle · 2026-04-08, Eepyman · 2026-04-08. - For steady income, keep cooldown alts (a claimed ~80g/day from 10 alts), and add Fishing Micro Jackson · 2026-04-02, Micro Jackson · 2026-02-13.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- No Discord list of Survival or Gardening recipes worth making for a druid after 1.18.1, beyond the lantern.
- No confirmed recipe source for Convergence of the Elements or the Elemental Leatherworking questline.
- Which Engineering items do work in Cat and Bear Form is **contested**, and nobody has published a tested list.
- The Blacksmithing fear-immunity trinket is unnamed (single source).

See also [Professions overview](#/professions) · [Class overview](#/class/druid)
